abstract.text: Importance: Vertical relationships (eg, ownership or affiliations, including joint contracting) between physicians and health systems are increasing in the US. Objective: To analyze how vertical relationships between primary care physicians (PCPs) and large health systems are associated with changes in ambulatory and acute care utilization, referral patterns, readmissions, and total medical spending for commercially insured individuals. Design, Setting, and Participants: This case-control study with a repeated cross-section, stacked event design analyzed outcomes of patients whose attributed PCP entered a vertical relationship with a large health care system in 2015 or 2017 compared with patients whose attributed PCP was either never or always in a vertical relationship with a large health system from 2013 to 2017 in the state of Massachusetts. The sample consisted of commercially insured patients who met enrollment criteria and who were attributed to PCPs who were included in the Massachusetts Provider Database in 2013, 2015, and 2017 and for whom vertical relationships were measured. Enrollee and claims data were obtained from the 2013 to 2017 Massachusetts All-Payer Claims Database. Statistical analyses were conducted between January 5, 2021, and June 5, 2023. Exposure: Evaluation-and-management visit with attributed PCP in 2015 to 2017. Main Outcomes and Measures: Outcomes (which were measured per patient-year [ie, per patient per year from January to December] in this sample) were utilization (count of specialist physician visits, emergency department [ED] visits, and hospitalizations overall and within attributed PCP's health system), spending (total medical expenditures and use of high-price hospitals), and readmissions (readmission rate and use of hospitals with a low readmission rate). Results: The sample of 4 030 224 observations included 2 147 303 females (53.3%) and 1 881 921 males (46.7%) with a mean (SD) age of 35.07 (19.95) years. Vertical relationships between PCPs and large health systems were associated with an increase of 0.69 (95% CI, 0.34-1.04; P < .001) in specialist visits per patient-year, a 22.64% increase vs the comparison group mean of 3.06 visits, and a $356.67 (95% CI, $77.16-$636.18; P = .01) increase in total medical expenditures per patient-year, a 6.26% increase vs the comparison group mean of $5700.07. Within the health care system of the attributed PCPs, the number of specialist visits changed by 0.80 (95% CI, 0.56-1.05) per patient year (P < .001), a 29.38% increase vs the comparison group mean of 2.73 specialist visits per patient-year. The number of ED visits changed by 0.02 (95% CI, 0.01-0.03) per patient year (P = .001), a 14.19% increase over the comparison group mean of 0.15 ED visits per patient-year. The number of hospitalizations changed by 0.01 (95% CI, 0.00-0.01) per patient-year (P < .001), a 22.36% increase over the comparison group mean of 0.03 hospitalizations per patient-year. There were no differences in readmission outcomes. Conclusions: Results of this case-control study suggest that vertical relationships between PCPs and large health systems were associated with steering of patients into health systems and increased spending on patient care, but no difference in readmissions was found.

10.1001/jamahealthforum.2023.2875.abstractZh: 重要性：在美国，医生与医疗系统之间的纵向关系（如所有权或隶属关系，包括联合签约）正在增加。目的：分析初级保健医生与大型医疗系统之间的纵向关系如何影响商业保险客户的门诊和急性护理使用、转诊模式、再入院情况以及总医疗费用。设计、实施与参与者：本研究采用病例对照研究设计，采用重复横截面、堆叠事件设计，分析了2015年或2017年与大型医疗系统建立纵向关系的初级保健医生所负责的患者，与那些在2013年至2017年间从未或始终与大型医疗系统建立纵向关系的初级保健医生所负责的患者进行比较。样本包括符合入组标准的商业保险客户，这些患者被归类为在2013年、2015年和2017年纳入马萨诸塞州医生数据库中的初级保健医生所负责的患者，并且这些患者的纵向关系得到了测量。入组数据和索赔数据来自2013年至2017年的马萨诸塞州全支付者索赔数据库。统计分析在2021年1月5日至2023年6月5日期间进行。暴露因素：2015年至2017年间与初级保健医生进行的评估与管理访问。主要结果与测量指标：结果（在本样本中按患者年计算，即每年1月至12月每患者的使用情况）包括使用情况（专科医生就诊次数、急诊部门就诊次数以及整个医疗系统内的住院次数）、医疗费用（总医疗费用以及高价医院的使用情况）以及再入院情况（再入院率以及低再入院率医院的使用情况）。结果：样本包含4,030,224个观察值，其中女性2,147,303人（占53.3%），男性1,881,921人（占46.7%），平均年龄为35.07岁（标准差19.95岁）。PCP与大型医疗系统之间的纵向关系表现为：患者年专业就诊次数增加0.69次（95%置信区间：0.34-1.04；P < 0.001），比对照组平均次数增加22.64%，患者年总医疗支出增加356.67美元（95%置信区间：77.16-636.18美元；P = 0.01），比对照组平均支出增加6.26%，即增加5700.07美元。在相关PCP所负责的医疗系统中，患者年专业就诊次数增加了0.80次（95%置信区间：0.56-1.05）（P < 0.001），比对照组平均次数增加29.38%。急诊就诊次数增加了0.02次（95%置信区间：0.01-0.03）（P = 0.001），比对照组平均次数增加14.19%。住院次数增加了0.01次（95%置信区间：0.00-0.01）（P < 0.001），比对照组平均次数增加22.36%。在再住院情况方面，未发现差异。结论：这项病例对照研究的结果表明，PCP与大型医疗系统之间的纵向关系导致患者被引导至这些医疗系统，并增加了患者护理的支出，但在再住院情况方面未发现差异。

abstract.text: Importance: Physicians' knowledge about each other's quality is central to clinical decision-making, but such information is not well understood and is rarely harnessed to identify exemplars for disseminating best practices or quality improvement. One exception is chief medical resident selection, which is typically based on interpersonal, teaching, and clinical skills. Objective: To compare care for patients of primary care physicians (PCPs) who were former chiefs with care for patients of nonchief PCPs. Design, Setting, and Participants: Using 2010 to 2018 Medicare Fee-For-Service Consumer Assessment of Healthcare Providers and Systems (CAHPS) survey data (response rate, 47.6%), Medicare claims for random 20% samples of fee-for-service beneficiaries, and medical board data from 4 large US states, we compared care for patients of former chief PCPs with care for patients of nonchief PCPs in the same practice using linear regression. Data were analyzed from August 2020 to January 2023. Exposures: Receiving the plurality of primary care office visits from a former chief PCP. Main Outcomes and Measures: Composite of 12 patient experience items as primary outcome and 4 spending and utilization measures as secondary outcomes. Results: The CAHPS samples included 4493 patients with former chief PCPs and 41 278 patients with nonchief PCPs. The 2 groups were similar in age (mean [SD], 73.1 [10.3] years vs 73.2 [10.3] years), sex (56.8% vs 56.8% female), race and ethnicity (1.2% vs 1.0% American Indian or Alaska Native, 1.3% vs 1.9% Asian or Pacific Islander, 4.8% vs. 5.6% Hispanic, 7.3% vs 6.6% non-Hispanic Black, and 81.5% vs. 80.0% non-Hispanic White), and other characteristics. The Medicare claims for random 20% samples included 289 728 patients with former chief PCPs and 2 954 120 patients with nonchief PCPs. Patients of former chief PCPs rated their care experiences significantly better than patients of nonchief PCPs (adjusted difference in composite, 1.6 percentage points; 95% CI, 0.4-2.8; effect size of 0.30 standard deviations (SD) of the physician-level distribution of performance; P = .01), including markedly higher ratings of physician-specific communication and interpersonal skills typically emphasized in chief selection. Differences were large for patients of racial and ethnic minority groups (1.16 SD), dual-eligible patients (0.81 SD), and those with less education (0.44 SD) but did not vary significantly across groups. Differences in spending and utilization were minimal overall. Conclusions and Relevance: In this study, patients of PCPs who were former chief medical residents reported better care experiences than patients of other PCPs in the same practice, especially for physician-specific items. The study results suggest that the profession possesses information about physician quality, motivating the development and study of strategies for harnessing such information to select and repurpose exemplars for quality improvement.

10.1001/jamainternmed.2023.0025.abstractZh:
重要性：医生之间对彼此质量的了解是临床决策的核心，但这类信息并未得到充分理解，也很少被用于识别最佳实践或质量改进的典型案例。一个例外是首席医疗住院医师的选拔，这通常基于人际沟通、教学能力和临床技能。  
目的：比较由前首席医疗住院医师负责的患者护理与由非首席医疗住院医师负责的患者护理。  
设计、背景和参与者：利用2010至2018年医疗保险按服务收费的医疗服务提供者系统评估调查数据（响应率为47.6%），随机选取20%的按服务收费的受益人进行医疗保险索赔分析，以及来自美国四个大州的医疗委员会数据，通过线性回归方法比较前首席医疗住院医师与非首席医疗住院医师在同一诊所内对患者护理的情况。数据分析时间范围为2020年8月至2023年1月。  
暴露因素：从前首席医疗住院医师处接受最多的门诊就诊。  
主要结果和测量指标：以12项患者体验指标为主要结果，以4项支出和利用指标作为次要结果。  
结果：CAHPS样本包括前首席医疗住院医师负责的患者4493名，非首席医疗住院医师负责的患者41,278名。两组在年龄（平均73.1岁 vs 73.2岁）、性别（女性比例均为56.8%）、种族和民族（1.2% vs 1.0%为美洲原住民或阿拉斯加原住民，1.3% vs 1.9%为亚洲人或太平洋岛民，4.8% vs 5.6%为西班牙裔，7.3% vs 6.6%为非西班牙裔黑人，81.5% vs 80.0%为非西班牙裔白人）及其他特征方面相似。医疗保险索赔样本中，前首席医疗住院医师负责的患者为289,728名，非首席医疗住院医师负责的患者为2,954,120名。前首席医疗护理人员的患者对其护理体验的评价明显优于非首席医疗护理人员的患者（综合评分差异为1.6个百分点；95%置信区间为0.4-2.8；效应量相当于医生绩效分布标准差的0.30倍；P = .01），其中包括对医生特定沟通能力和人际交往能力的评价明显更高，这些能力通常在选拔首席医疗护理人员时会被重视。对于种族和族裔少数群体患者、双重资格患者以及教育水平较低的患者，差异较大（分别为1.16标准差、0.81标准差和0.44标准差），但这些差异在不同群体间并不显著。总体来看，在支出和利用率方面差异很小。结论与意义：本研究表明，前首席医疗护理人员的患者与同一诊所的其他医疗护理人员相比，其护理体验更好，尤其是在医生特定方面。研究结果表明，该职业拥有关于医生质量的信息，这激励我们开发并研究利用这些信息来选拔和重新配置优秀医生，以提升医疗质量。

abstract.text: Importance: There is evidence that Republican-leaning counties have had higher COVID-19 death rates than Democratic-leaning counties and similar evidence of an association between political party affiliation and attitudes regarding COVID-19 vaccination; further data on these rates may be useful. Objective: To assess political party affiliation and mortality rates for individuals during the initial 22 months of the COVID-19 pandemic. Design, Setting, and Participants: A cross-sectional comparison of excess mortality between registered Republican and Democratic voters between March 2020 and December 2021 adjusted for age and state of voter registration was conducted. Voter and mortality data from Florida and Ohio in 2017 linked to mortality records for January 1, 2018, to December 31, 2021, were used in data analysis. Exposures: Political party affiliation. Main Outcomes and Measures: Excess weekly deaths during the COVID-19 pandemic adjusted for age, county, party affiliation, and seasonality. Results: Between January 1, 2018, and December 31, 2021, there were 538 159 individuals in Ohio and Florida who died at age 25 years or older in the study sample. The median age at death was 78 years (IQR, 71-89 years). Overall, the excess death rate for Republican voters was 2.8 percentage points, or 15%, higher than the excess death rate for Democratic voters (95% prediction interval [PI], 1.6-3.7 percentage points). After May 1, 2021, when vaccines were available to all adults, the excess death rate gap between Republican and Democratic voters widened from -0.9 percentage point (95% PI, -2.5 to 0.3 percentage points) to 7.7 percentage points (95% PI, 6.0-9.3 percentage points) in the adjusted analysis; the excess death rate among Republican voters was 43% higher than the excess death rate among Democratic voters. The gap in excess death rates between Republican and Democratic voters was larger in counties with lower vaccination rates and was primarily noted in voters residing in Ohio. Conclusions and Relevance: In this cross-sectional study, an association was observed between political party affiliation and excess deaths in Ohio and Florida after COVID-19 vaccines were available to all adults. These findings suggest that differences in vaccination attitudes and reported uptake between Republican and Democratic voters may have been factors in the severity and trajectory of the pandemic in the US.

10.1001/jamainternmed.2023.1154.abstractZh:
重要性：有证据表明，倾向于共和党的县在COVID-19死亡率方面高于倾向于民主党的县，同时也有类似证据表明政党归属与对COVID-19疫苗接种的态度之间存在关联；进一步的数据可能对此有所帮助。  
目标：评估在COVID-19大流行初期22个月期间，不同政党归属与个体死亡率之间的关系。  
设计、背景与参与者：对2020年3月至2021年12月期间，注册为共和党和民主党选民的人的超额死亡率进行了横断面比较，并调整了年龄和选民登记状态。数据分析使用了2017年佛罗里达州和俄亥俄州的选民数据和2018年1月1日至2021年12月31日的死亡记录。  
暴露因素：政党归属。  
主要结果与测量指标：调整了年龄、县、政党归属和季节性因素后的COVID-19大流行期间每周超额死亡人数。  
结果：从2018年1月1日至2021年12月31日，研究样本中有538,159名俄亥俄州和佛罗里达州的25岁及以上个体死亡。死亡时的中位年龄为78岁（四分位距：71-89岁）。总体而言，共和党选民的超额死亡率比民主党选民高出2.8个百分点，即15%。在2021年5月1日疫苗普及后，调整后的分析显示，共和党选民与民主党选民之间的超额死亡率差距从-0.9个百分点（95%置信区间：-2.5至0.3个百分点）扩大到7.7个百分点（95%置信区间：6.0-9.3个百分点）；共和党选民的超额死亡率比民主党选民高出43%。在疫苗接种率较低的县，共和党选民与民主党选民之间的超额死亡率差距更大，这一差异主要出现在俄亥俄州的选民中。结论与意义：在这项横断面研究中，观察到在俄亥俄州和佛罗里达州，随着新冠疫苗普及到所有成年人之后，政治党派归属与超额死亡率之间存在关联。这些发现表明，共和党选民与民主党选民在疫苗接种态度及实际接种率上的差异，可能是导致美国疫情严重程度和演变轨迹的因素之一。

abstract.text: Importance: Individuals with Alzheimer disease and related dementias (ADRD) frequently require skilled nursing facility (SNF) care following hospitalization. Despite lower SNF incentives to care for the ADRD population, knowledge on how the quality of SNF care differs for those with vs without ADRD is limited. Objective: To examine whether persons with ADRD are systematically admitted to lower-quality SNFs. Design, Setting, and Participants: Cross-sectional analysis of Medicare beneficiaries hospitalized between January 1, 2017, and December 31, 2019, was conducted. Data analysis was performed from January 15 to May 30, 2022. Participants were discharged to a Medicare-certified SNF from a general acute hospital. Patients younger than 65 years, enrolled in Medicare Advantage, and with prior SNF or long-term nursing home use within 1 year of hospitalization were excluded. Exposures: The quality level of all SNFs available at the patient's discharge, measured using publicly reported 5-star staffing ratings. The 5-star ratings were grouped into 3 levels (1-2 stars [reference category, low-quality], 3 stars [average-quality], and 4-5 stars [high-quality]). Main Outcomes and Measures: The outcome was the SNF a patient entered among the possible SNF destinations available at discharge. Differences in the association between SNF quality and SNF entry for patients with and without ADRD were assessed using a conditional logit model, which simultaneously controls for differences in discharging hospital, residential neighborhood, and the other characteristics (eg, postacute care specialization) of all SNFs available at discharge. Results: The sample included 2 619 464 patients (mean [SD] age, 81.3 [8.6] years; 61% women; 87% were White; 8% were Black; 22% with ADRD). The probability of discharge to higher quality SNFs was lower for patients with ADRD. If the star rating of an SNF was high instead of low, the log-odds of being discharged to it increased by 0.31 for patients with ADRD and by 0.47 for those without ADRD (difference, -0.16; P < .001). The weaker association between quality and entry for patients with ADRD indicates that they are less likely to be discharged to high-quality SNFs. Conclusions and Relevance: The findings of this study suggest that patients with ADRD are more likely to be discharged to lower-quality SNFs. Targeted reforms, such as ADRD-specific compensation adjustments, may be needed to improve access to better SNFs for patients with ADRD.

10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2022.55134.abstractZh:
重要性：患有阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆症的患者在住院后通常需要接受专业护理机构的护理。尽管专业护理机构对于照顾这类患者的积极性较低，但关于这些患者与未患此类疾病的患者在护理质量上的差异，目前了解甚少。  
目的：研究患有阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆症的患者是否会被系统地分配到质量较低的护理机构。  
设计、背景与参与者：本研究采用横断面分析，针对2017年1月1日至2019年12月31日期间住院的Medicare受益人进行。数据分析工作于2022年1月15日至5月30日完成。参与者是从普通急性医院出院后入住Medicare认证的护理机构的患者。年龄小于65岁、参加Medicare Advantage计划，以及住院前一年内曾使用过护理机构或长期护理院的患者被排除在外。  
暴露因素：所有在患者出院时可选择的护理机构的服务质量水平，通过公开报道的5星级人员配置评级来衡量。这些5星级评级被分为三个等级：1-2星（参考类别，低质量）、3星（平均质量）和4-5星（高质量）。  
主要结果与测量指标：研究关注的是患者在出院时可能选择的护理机构。通过条件逻辑模型评估了护理机构质量与患者选择护理机构之间的关系，该模型同时考虑了出院时所有护理机构的医院类型、居住区域以及其他特征（如术后护理专业化程度）的差异。  
结果：样本包括2,619,464名患者（平均年龄81.3岁，标准差8.6岁；61%为女性；87%为白人；8%为黑人；22%患有阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆症）。患有ADRD的患者被转至质量更高的SNF的可能性较低。如果SNF的星级评分较高而非较低，那么患有ADRD的患者被转至该SNF的log-odds会增加0.31，而没有ADRD的患者则会增加0.47（差异为-0.16；P < .001）。患有ADRD的患者在质量与入院之间的关联较弱，这表明他们被转至高质量SNF的可能性较低。结论与意义：本研究的结果表明，患有ADRD的患者更可能被转至质量较低的SNF。可能需要采取有针对性的改革措施，例如对ADRD患者进行专门的补偿调整，以改善患有ADRD的患者获得更好SNF的机会。

abstract.text: Importance: During the first 2 years of the COVID-19 pandemic, inpatient and ambulatory care declined dramatically. Little is known about prescription drug receipt during this period, particularly for populations with chronic illness and with high risk of adverse COVID-19 outcomes and decreased access to care. Objective: To investigate whether receipt of medications was maintained during the first 2 years of the COVID-19 pandemic among older people with chronic diseases, particularly Asian, Black, and Hispanic populations and people with dementia, who faced pandemic-related care disruptions. Design, Setting, and Participants: This cohort study used a 100% sample of US Medicare fee-for-service administrative data from 2019 to 2021 for community-dwelling beneficiaries aged 65 years or older. Population-based prescription fill rates were compared for 2020 and 2021 vs 2019. Data were analyzed from July 2022 to March 2023. Exposure: The COVID-19 pandemic. Main Outcomes and Measures: Age- and sex-adjusted monthly prescription fill rates were calculated for 5 groups of medications commonly prescribed for chronic disease : angiotensin-converting enzyme inhibitors and angiotensin receptor blockers, 3-hydroxy-3-methylglutaryl coenzyme A (HMG CoA) reductase inhibitors (statins), oral diabetes medications, asthma and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease medications, and antidepressants. Measurements were stratified by race and ethnicity group and dementia diagnosis. Secondary analyses measured changes in the proportion of prescriptions dispensed as a 90-day or greater supply. Results: Overall, the mean monthly cohort included 18 113 000 beneficiaries (mean [SD] age, 74.5 [7.4] years; 10 520 000 females [58.1%]; 587 000 Asian [3.2%], 1 069 000 Black [5.9%], 905 000 Hispanic [5.0%], and 14 929 000 White [82.4%]); 1 970 000 individuals (10.9%) were diagnosed with dementia. Across 5 drug classifications, mean fill rates increased by 2.07% (95% CI, 2.01% to 2.12%) in 2020 and decreased by 2.61% (95% CI, -2.67% to -2.56%) in 2021 compared with 2019. Fill rates decreased by less than the mean overall decrease for Black enrollees (-1.42%; 95% CI, -1.64% to -1.20%) and Asian enrollees (-1.05%; 95% CI, -1.36% to -0.77%) and people diagnosed with dementia (-0.38%; 95% CI, -0.54% to -0.23%). The proportion of fills dispensed as 90-day or greater supplies increased during the pandemic for all groups, with an increase per 100 fills of 3.98 fills (95% CI, 3.94 to 4.03 fills) overall. Conclusions and Relevance: This study found that, in contrast to in-person health services, receipt of medications for chronic conditions was relatively stable in the first 2 years of the COVID-19 pandemic overall, across racial and ethnic groups, and for community-dwelling patients with dementia. This finding of stability may hold lessons for other outpatient services during the next pandemic.

10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2023.13919.abstractZh: 重要性：在COVID-19大流行的前两年，住院和门诊护理服务急剧下降。关于这一时期处方药的使用情况知之甚少，尤其是对于那些患有慢性疾病且面临较高的COVID-19不良后果风险的人群，以及那些获得护理机会较少的人群。目的：研究在COVID-19大流行的前两年，患有慢性疾病的老年人，特别是亚裔、黑人及西班牙裔人群，以及患有痴呆症的人群，是否仍然能够获得药物治疗。设计、背景与对象：本研究为队列研究，使用了2019至2021年间美国Medicare按服务收费行政数据中的100%样本，对象为65岁或以上的社区居住受益人。比较了2020年和2021年与2019年的基于人口的处方药使用率。数据分析时间为2022年7月至2023年3月。暴露因素：COVID-19大流行。主要结果与指标：计算了5类常用于慢性疾病的药物的月处方使用率，这些药物包括血管紧张素转换酶抑制剂和血管紧张素受体拮抗剂、3-羟基-3-甲基戊二酰辅酶A还原酶抑制剂（他汀类药物）、口服糖尿病药物、哮喘和慢性阻塞性肺病药物以及抗抑郁药。测量结果按种族和族裔群体以及痴呆症诊断情况进行了分层。次要分析测量了作为90天或更长时间供应而发放的处方比例的变化。结果：总体而言，平均每月的受惠者人数为18,113,000人（平均年龄74.5岁，标准差7.4岁；其中女性10,520,000人，占58.1%；亚洲人587,000人，占3.2%；黑人1,069,000人，占5.9%；西班牙裔905,000人，占5.0%；白人14,929,000人，占82.4%）。在1,970,000名患者中（占10.9%），被诊断出患有痴呆症。在5类药物中，2020年的平均配药率增加了2.07%（95%置信区间，2.01%至2.12%），而2021年则减少了2.61%（95%置信区间，-2.67%至-2.56%），与2019年相比有所下降。与黑人、亚洲人和痴呆症患者相比，配药率的下降幅度较小：黑人患者的配药率下降不到1.42%（95%置信区间，-1.64%至-1.20%），亚洲人患者的配药率下降1.05%（95%置信区间，-1.36%至-0.77%），痴呆症患者则下降了0.38%（95%置信区间，-0.54%至-0.23%）。在疫情期间，所有群体的90天或更长时间内的配药比例均有所上升，每100次配药平均增加了3.98次（95%置信区间，3.94次至4.03次）。结论与意义：本研究发现，与面对面医疗服务相比，在COVID-19大流行的前两年，慢性疾病的药物配药率总体保持稳定，无论种族和族裔背景如何，也适用于居住在社区的痴呆症患者。这一稳定性发现可能为未来大流行期间的其他门诊服务提供借鉴。

abstract.text: Separating selection bias from moral hazard in private health insurance (PHI) markets has been a challenging task. We estimate selection bias and moral hazard in Australia's mixed public-private health system, where PHI premiums are community-rated rather than risk-rated. Using longitudinal cohort data, with fine-grained measures for medical services predominantly funded by PHI providers, we find consistent and robust estimates of advantageous selection among hospitalized cardiovascular disease (CVD) patients. Specifically, we show that in addition to their risk-averse attributes, CVD patients who purchase PHI use fewer services that are not covered by PHI providers (e.g., general practitioners and emergency departments) and have fewer comorbidities. Finally, unlike previous studies, we show that ex-post moral hazard exists in the use of specific "in-hospital" medical services such as specialist and physician services, miscellaneous diagnostic procedures, and therapeutic treatments. From the perspective of PHI providers, the annual cost of moral hazard translates to a lower bound estimate of $707 per patient, equivalent to a 3.03% reduction in their annual profits.

10.1002/hec.4605.abstractZh: 在私人健康保险市场中，区分选择偏差与道德风险是一项具有挑战性的任务。我们针对澳大利亚混合公共-私人健康体系中的选择偏差和道德风险进行了估算，该体系中的健康保险保费是基于社区评估而非风险评估来确定的。利用纵向队列数据，并针对主要由健康保险提供者资助的医疗服务进行了细致的测量，我们发现住院心血管疾病患者中存在明显的选择优势。具体而言，我们发现，除了风险规避的特性外，购买健康保险的心血管疾病患者使用的医疗服务较少，这些服务通常不由健康保险提供者提供，例如全科医生和急诊部门的服务，同时他们的合并症也较少。与以往的研究不同，我们发现在使用特定“住院”医疗服务时存在道德风险，例如专科医疗服务、诊断程序和治疗方案。从健康保险提供者的角度来看，这种道德风险的年度成本相当于每位患者707美元的支出，这相当于他们年度利润的3.03%的减少。

abstract.text: We study the health impact of food and beverage price promotion strategies-multi-buy offers and price discounts, typically biased toward unhealthy product categories-in British consumer retail. We are the first to employ econometric models from the marketing literature to analyze the impact of price promotions with a focus on population health. Our dynamic, reduced form demand model incorporates endogenous inventory (stock piling), consumption rates imputed from repeat purchases and allows for unobserved household heterogeneity. We find that removing price discounts is more effective for reducing purchase volume compared to removing multi-buy offers for 10 out of 12 food and drink groups, particularly those products for which price reduction is more common than multibuy. We find that price promotions induce consumption-and waste -through behavioral effects, associated with increased household inventory (stockpiling).

10.1002/hec.4607.abstractZh: 我们研究了英国消费品零售领域食品和饮料价格促销策略对健康的影响，这些策略包括多买优惠和价格折扣，通常倾向于对不健康产品类别进行优惠。我们是第一个运用市场营销文献中的计量经济模型来分析价格促销对人群健康影响的研究。我们的动态简化需求模型包含了内生库存（囤积行为）、从重复购买中推断出的消费率，并考虑了未观察到的家庭异质性。我们发现，在12个食品和饮料类别中，有10个类别通过取消价格折扣比取消多买优惠更能有效减少购买量，尤其是那些价格降低更为常见的产品。我们还发现，价格促销会通过行为效应导致消费和浪费，这与家庭库存的增加有关。

abstract.text: Sugar-sweetened beverage taxes have become an increasingly popular policy to combat the worldwide obesity epidemic, but relatively little is known about their impact on health outcomes, particularly among high school aged students. In this paper, I use public-use data from the Youth Risk Behavioral Surveillance System to determine whether high school students living in three of the American cities which have implemented Sugar-sweetened beverage taxes have experienced public health improvements. Using an event-study design that compares outcomes in treated districts to a group of similar control districts, I find reductions in soda consumption in Philadelphia and average body mass index in Philadelphia, San Francisco and Oakland, with suggestive evidence that the improvements are concentrated among female and non-white respondents in both cases.

10.1002/hec.4609.abstractZh: 含糖饮料税已成为应对全球肥胖流行病的热门政策，但关于其对健康结果的影响，尤其是对高中生的影响，目前了解甚少。本文利用青少年风险行为监测系统的公共数据，研究在美国实施含糖饮料税的三个城市中的高中生是否经历了公共卫生方面的改善。通过事件研究设计，将实施该政策的地区与类似的对照地区的结果进行比较，发现费城和旧金山奥克兰的碳酸饮料消费量和平均体重指数有所减少，并且有迹象表明这些改善主要集中在女性和非白人受访者身上。

abstract.text: This paper studies the impact of a ban on late-night off-premise alcohol sales between 10 p.m. and 5 a.m. in Germany. We use three large administrative data sets: (i) German diagnosis related groups-Statistik, (ii) data from a large social health insurance, and (iii) Road Traffic Accident Statistics. Applying difference-in-differences and synthetic-control-group methods, we find that the ban had no effects on alcohol-related road casualties, but significantly reduced alcohol-related hospitalizations (doctor visits) among young people by around 9 (18) percent. The decrease is driven by fewer hospitalizations due to acute alcohol intoxication during the night-when the ban is in place-but not during the day.

10.1002/hec.4610.abstractZh: 本文研究了德国在晚上10点至凌晨5点禁止夜间无店铺酒精销售政策的影响。我们使用了三个大型行政数据集：(i) 德国诊断相关组统计资料，(ii) 来自大型社会保险的数据，以及(iii) 交通事故统计数据。通过差异分解法和合成对照组方法分析发现，该禁令对与酒精相关的道路伤亡没有影响，但显著减少了年轻人的酒精相关住院次数（就诊次数），减少了约9%（18%）。这一减少主要源于夜间实施禁令时因急性酒精中毒导致的住院次数减少，而白天则没有这种减少。

abstract.text: This study examines the impact of Omnibus Immigration Laws on the mental health of the Hispanic populations in the U.S. We use a Difference-in-Differences framework and data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System Survey of Centers for Disease Control and Prevention for the 2000-2016 period that contains information on more than 400 thousand Hispanics residing in the U.S. We find that the most stringent provision, namely, "show me your papers" laws, adversely affects the mental health of Hispanics and contributes to an increase of 12%-16% in the number of unhealthy mental days and an increase of 13%-18% in the probability of having frequent mental distress in the states with "show me your papers" laws. OIL provisions that enforced the use of E-Verify or limited the use of public benefits to unauthorized immigrants did not have any effect on mental health. The study also examines (1) police stops, (2) physical health, insurance, and employment status, (3) co-ethnic density, and (4) immigration enforcement awareness as potential mechanisms that could lead to a deterioration in the mental health of Hispanics. The evidence indicates their vulnerability to strict immigration enforcement. The social and public health cost should be carefully evaluated when formulating and implementing immigration policies.

10.1002/hec.4611.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了综合移民法对美国西班牙裔人群心理健康的影响。我们采用差异法框架，并参考了疾病控制与预防中心在2000至2016年期间进行的行为风险因素监测系统的数据，该数据涵盖了美国境内40多万西班牙裔人口的信息。研究发现，最严格的移民法条款，即“出示证件”条款，对西班牙裔的心理健康产生了负面影响，导致不健康心理日的数量增加了12%至16%，在实施该条款的州，频繁出现心理困扰的概率也上升了13%至18%。而要求使用E-Verify系统或限制未经许可的移民享受公共福利的移民法条款，则对心理健康没有显著影响。研究还考察了以下因素是否可能导致西班牙裔的心理健康恶化：(1)警方拦截；(2)身体健康状况、保险情况及就业状况；(3)同族人口密度；(4)移民执法意识。研究结果表明，西班牙裔在面对严格的移民执法时，其心理健康状况较为脆弱。在制定和实施移民政策时，应仔细评估这些社会与公共卫生成本。

abstract.text: Even though prior research has investigated the relationship between same-sex partnership recognition policies and health outcomes, the impact of same-sex marriage laws on sexually transmitted infections has not received much attention. Using state-level panel data from 2000 to 2019, I show that marriage equality legislation decreases the spread of (shorter-term) syphilis infections and of (longer-term) human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) and acquired immunodeficiency syndrome (AIDS) infections among the general population. Event study analyses correcting for non-staggered treatment implementation confirm these negative effects, but also suggest that standard difference-in-differences models understate the impact of the legislation by up to 8% points. Further analysis supports that these legislation effects operate through three mechanisms: increasing social tolerance, strengthening relationship commitment, and expanding health care access and coverage for HIV/AIDS prevention and treatment. Disaggregating the results by sexual behavior reveals that legal access to same-sex marriage leads to sizable decreases in AIDS rates among men who have sex with men (MSM) (the most at-risk population for an infection). Even though there is economically significant evidence that the legislation improves sexual health of the heterosexual population due to increased utilization of preventive sexual health care, the legislation does not have a direct impact on infection rates for the non-MSM population.

10.1002/hec.4612.abstractZh: 尽管先前的研究已经探讨了同性伴侣关系认定政策与健康结果之间的关系，但同性婚姻法律对性传播感染的影响却未受到太多关注。通过利用2000至2019年的州级面板数据，我发现婚姻平等立法减少了普通人群中梅毒感染以及人类免疫缺陷病毒（HIV）和获得性免疫缺陷综合征（艾滋病）感染的传播。经过校正非阶梯式实施时间的事件研究分析，证实了这些负面效应，但同时也表明标准差异模型低估了该立法的影响，高达8个百分点。进一步分析表明，这些立法效应通过三种机制发挥作用：增加社会容忍度、加强关系承诺，以及扩大针对HIV/AIDS预防和治疗的医疗保健服务和覆盖范围。按性行为类型细分结果后发现，同性婚姻的法律保障使得男男性行为者（MSM）中的艾滋病发病率显著下降（这是感染风险最高的群体）。尽管有经济上的证据表明，由于预防性性健康护理的利用率增加，该立法改善了异性恋群体的性健康，但该立法对非MSM群体的感染率并没有直接的影响。

abstract.text: The current health crisis has particularly affected the elderly population. Nursing homes have unfortunately experienced a relatively large number of deaths. On the basis of this observation and working with European data (from SHARE), we want to check whether nursing homes were lending themselves to excess mortality even before the pandemic. Controlling for a number of important characteristics of the elderly population in and outside nursing homes, we conjecture that the difference in mortality between those two samples is to be attributed to the way nursing homes are designed and organized. Using matching methods, we observe excess mortality in Sweden, Belgium, Germany, Switzerland, Czech Republic and Estonia but not in the Netherlands, Denmark, Austria, France, Luxembourg, Italy and Spain. This raises the question of the organization and management of these nursing homes, but also of their design and financing.

10.1002/hec.4613.abstractZh: 当前的健康危机对老年人群体产生了特别大的影响。不幸的是，养老院中出现了相当数量的死亡案例。基于这一观察，并结合欧洲的数据（来自SHARE），我们想探讨在疫情之前，养老院是否就存在过度死亡的问题。在控制了老年人群体在养老院内外的一些重要特征后，我们推测这两种样本之间的死亡差异可能源于养老院的设计和组织方式。通过匹配方法分析，我们发现瑞典、比利时、德国、瑞士、捷克共和国和爱沙尼亚存在过度死亡现象，而在荷兰、丹麦、奥地利、法国、卢森堡、意大利和西班牙则没有。这引发了关于这些养老院的组织和管理方式，以及其设计和融资问题的思考。

abstract.text: Mental health problems impose substantial individual and societal costs over the life-cycle. The age-profile of mental health problems is, however, not well understood. Hence, we study the age-profile of mental health while introducing minimal bias to reach identification. Using mental health data from the United States Panel Study of Income Dynamics we apply first difference estimation to derive an unbiased estimate of the second derivative of the age effect as well as an estimate up to a linear period trend of the first derivative. Next, we use a battery of estimators with varying restrictions to approximate the first derivative. Our results suggest that the age profile of mental health in the US is not U-shaped and we find tentative evidence that the age-profile could follow an inverse U-shape where individuals experience a mental health high during their life course. Further analyses, using German and Dutch data, confirm that these results do not only apply to the US, but also to Germany and the Netherlands.

10.1002/hec.4614.abstractZh: 心理健康问题在人的一生中带来巨大的个人和社会成本。然而，心理健康问题的年龄分布特征尚未得到充分理解。因此，我们研究了心理健康问题的年龄分布特征，同时尽量减少偏差以得出准确的结果。利用美国收入动态研究小组提供的心理健康数据，我们通过差分估计法得出年龄效应的二阶导数无偏估计值，以及一阶导数的线性周期趋势估计值。接下来，我们使用多种具有不同限制的估计方法来近似一阶导数。我们的研究结果表明，美国的心理健康问题年龄分布并非U形分布，并且有初步证据表明，年龄分布可能呈现倒U形，即个体在生命过程中会经历心理健康的高峰期。进一步的分析表明，这些结果不仅适用于美国，也适用于德国和荷兰。

abstract.text: Intimate Partner Violence (IPV) continues to be a major public health concern that can both respond to economic policies and affect economic outcomes. Few studies regarding IPV, however, take a gender inclusive approach towards its identification. Using a sample of both men and women from rural Kenya, we are the first, to our knowledge, to conduct a list experiment with cohabiting married couples to identify the prevalence of physical violence on both men and women. We find that 14 percent of respondents agree with the statement "my spouse regularly hits me". In contrast to other survey evidence that uses direct elicitation, we find no differences in the prevalence of male-to-female and female-to-male violence. We provide supporting evidence that bidirectional IPV accounts for the lack of gender differences. A complete understanding of the typology of IPV can be crucial for policies seeking IPV reduction.

10.1002/hec.4616.abstractZh: 亲密伴侣暴力（IPV）仍然是一个重大的公共卫生问题，它既可以通过经济政策得到缓解，也可能影响经济结果。然而，关于IPV的研究中，很少有研究采用性别包容的方法来进行研究。我们使用肯尼亚农村地区的男性和女性样本，进行了首次针对同居已婚夫妇的列表实验，以了解男女之间身体暴力的普遍程度。我们发现，14%的受访者同意“我的配偶经常打我”这一说法。与其他采用直接询问方法的调查相比，我们没有发现男性和女性之间暴力行为的普遍程度存在差异。我们的研究还提供了支持性证据，表明双向的IPV解释了性别差异缺失的原因。全面了解IPV的类型对于寻求减少IPV的政策来说至关重要。

abstract.text: The Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) has an extensive literature documenting positive effects on infant health outcomes, specifically preterm birth, low birthweight, small size for gestational age, and infant mortality. However, existing studies focus on average effects for these relatively infrequent outcomes, thus providing no evidence for how WIC affects those at greatest risk of negative infant health outcomes. Our study focuses on documenting how WIC's infant health effects vary by level of risk. In doing so, we leverage a uniquely rich database describing maternal and infant outcomes and risk factors. Additionally, we use high dimensional data to generate predictions of risk and combine these predictions with the novel double machine learning method to stratify the effects of WIC by predicted risk. Our estimates of WIC's average treatment effects align with those in the existing literature. More importantly, we document significant variation in the effects of WIC on infant health by predicted risk level. Our results show that WIC is most beneficial among those at greatest risk of poor outcomes.

10.1002/hec.4617.abstractZh: 妇女、婴儿和儿童特殊补充营养计划（WIC）的相关文献中大量记载了其对婴儿健康结果的积极影响，尤其是早产、低出生体重、妊娠年龄较小以及婴儿死亡率等方面。然而，现有研究主要关注这些相对罕见结果的平均效应，并未提供关于WIC如何影响那些面临最大婴儿健康风险群体的证据。我们的研究重点在于记录WIC对婴儿健康的效应如何因风险水平而异。为此，我们利用了包含丰富数据和信息的数据库，其中包括母亲和婴儿的相关结果及风险因素。此外，我们还利用高维数据来预测风险，并将这些预测结果与新型双机器学习方法相结合，以根据预测风险对WIC的效应进行分层分析。我们得出的WIC平均治疗效果估计结果与现有文献中的结果一致。更重要的是，我们发现WIC对婴儿健康的效应在不同风险水平下存在显著差异。研究结果表明，WIC对那些面临最大不良结果风险的群体最为有益。

abstract.text: Airborne transmission of the COVID-19 virus increased the need for health policies to reduce transmission in congregate settings associated with minimal risk before the pandemic. While a large literature estimates tradeoffs between policies designed to reduce negative health outcomes, no empirical research addresses consumer willingness to pay (WTP) for health policies designed to reduce airborne virus transmission. Using survey data from 1381 fans of professional sports, we estimate consumers' WTP for reduced likelihood of coronavirus transmission through mask and social distancing policies using a stated preference approach. The results indicate increased attendance likelihood if the venue requires masks and limits attendance, with significant heterogeneity in WTP across risk scenarios and sports. We characterize consumers as casual fans who prefer a mask requirement but are indifferent to capacity constraints, strong fans who are anti-maskers and prefer capacity constraints, and a second group of casual fans with positive WTP under both mask and limited capacity requirements. For example, casual fans' WTP for masking, $38 per National Basketball Association (NBA) game attended, is more than double their WTP for capacity constraints only. Strong fans' WTP for attending capacity constrained NBA games was $490, more than 400% higher than the pre-pandemic average WTP of $105.

10.1002/hec.4618.abstractZh: COVID-19病毒的空气传播增加了在疫情之前，针对低风险聚集场所实施减少传播的健康政策的必要性。虽然大量文献探讨了旨在减少负面健康后果的政策之间的权衡，但尚无实证研究探讨消费者对于旨在减少空气传播病毒的政策的支付意愿。我们利用来自1381名职业体育赛事粉丝的调查数据，采用偏好法估算了消费者对于通过佩戴口罩和社交距离政策来降低冠状病毒传播可能性的支付意愿。结果表明，如果场馆要求佩戴口罩并限制入场人数，观众出席的可能性会增加，且不同风险情景和体育项目下的支付意愿存在显著差异。我们将消费者分为三类：偏好口罩要求但对容量限制无差别的普通粉丝、反对口罩要求且偏好容量限制的忠实粉丝，以及对于口罩和容量限制都有积极支付意愿的普通粉丝。例如，普通粉丝对于每场NBA比赛佩戴口罩的支付意愿为38美元，这一数值是仅对容量限制支付意愿的两倍多。而忠实粉丝对于参加容量限制的NBA比赛支付的意愿为490美元，比疫情前的平均支付意愿105美元高出400%以上。

abstract.text: Policymakers have historically attempted to influence quality in nursing homes through the imposition of minimum staffing standards and through the public dissemination of quality on websites like Care Compare. One current Federal standard necessitates a registered nurse (RN) on duty for at least eight consecutive hours each day. In 2018, the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services announced that they would incentivize compliance with this requirement by downgrading nursing homes with 7+ days without an RN present during the quarter by one star on their Care Compare staffing domain quality rating. This study evaluates the impact of this new enforcement mechanism. Using an intent-to-treat sample of nursing homes at risk for downgrade with difference-in-differences and event study models, it finds that the policy increased compliance and staffing levels. Using the policy to instrument for full compliance, it finds that the daily presence of an RN causally improves several quality dimensions.

10.1002/hec.4619.abstractZh: 历史上，政策制定者试图通过设定最低人员配置标准以及在像Care Compare这样的网站上公开宣传护理机构的质量来影响护理机构的质量。目前的一项联邦标准要求注册护士每天至少连续工作8小时。2018年，医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心宣布，将对未能遵守这一要求的护理机构进行处罚，即在Care Compare的 staffing领域评分中降低其星级，每有7天以上没有注册护士在岗，就会降低一个星级。本研究评估了这一新执行机制的影响。通过使用意图治疗样本和差异-差异模型以及事件研究模型，研究发现该政策提高了遵守率和人员配置水平。通过将政策作为工具来实现完全遵守，研究发现注册护士的日常在场显著改善了多个质量维度。

abstract.text: Several studies have concluded that legalizing medical marijuana can reduce deaths from opioid overdoses. Drawing on micro data from the National Survey on Drug Use and Health, a survey uniquely suited to assessing patterns of substance use, we examine the relationship between recreational marijuana laws (RMLs) and the misuse of prescription opioids. Using a standard difference-in-differences (DD) regression model, we find that RML adoption reduces the likelihood of frequently misusing prescription opioids such as OxyContin, Percocet, and Vicodin. However, using a two-stage procedure designed to account for staggered treatment and dynamic effects, the DD estimate of relationship between RML adoption and the likelihood of frequently misusing prescription opioids becomes positive. Although event study estimates suggest that RML adoption leads to a decrease in the frequency of prescription opioid abuse, this effect appears to dissipate after only 2 or 3 years.

10.1002/hec.4620.abstractZh: 多项研究得出结论，将医用大麻合法化可以减少阿片类药物过量导致的死亡。基于《国家药物使用与健康调查》中的微观数据，该调查非常适合评估物质使用的模式，我们研究了娱乐性大麻法律与处方阿片类药物滥用之间的关系。通过标准差异-差异回归模型分析发现，娱乐性大麻法律的实施降低了频繁滥用如奥施康定、培科塞特和维柯丁等处方阿片类药物的可能性。然而，通过采用两阶段程序来考虑分阶段治疗和动态效应后，娱乐性大麻法律实施与频繁滥用处方阿片类药物之间的关联变为正相关。尽管事件研究估计表明娱乐性大麻法律的实施有助于减少处方阿片类药物滥用的频率，但这种效应在仅2到3年后似乎就消失了。

abstract.text: I study the effect of a change in the mandatory manufacturer rebate and a price freeze on wholesale prices for pharmaceuticals on competition by parallel imports. First, I analyze the effect of a manufacturer rebate on competition by parallel imports in a two-country model. Second, I exploit a policy reform in Germany in 2010 that increased the manufacturer rebate by 10 percentage points. Using a data set with prescription drugs with competition from parallel imports, I estimate the effect of the change in the manufacturer rebate on competition by parallel imports. The model predicts that an increase in the manufacturer rebate increases the market share of parallel imports. The rebate decreases the manufacturer's revenues from domestic distribution. In response, the manufacturer lowers the wholesale price for a foreign distributor, resulting in a competitive advantage for and an increase in the market share of parallel imports. The estimation shows that the increase in the manufacturer rebate by 10 percentage points has increased the market share of parallel imports by approximately 18%-35% and has increased the number of importers by up to 17%.

10.1002/hec.4621.abstractZh: 我研究了强制性制造商回扣变更以及价格冻结对药品批发价格的影响，以及这对平行进口竞争的影响。首先，我在一个双国模型中分析了制造商回扣对平行进口竞争的影响。其次，我利用德国在2010年的一项政策改革，该改革将制造商回扣提高了10个百分点。我使用了一个包含处方药的数据集，该数据集考虑了平行进口的竞争情况，来估计制造商回扣变更对平行进口竞争的影响。模型预测，制造商回扣的增加会提高平行进口的市场份额。回扣的增加会降低制造商来自国内分销的收入。作为回应，制造商会降低对外销商的批发价格，从而为平行进口带来竞争优势，并增加其市场份额。估计结果显示，制造商回扣增加10个百分点后，平行进口的市场份额增加了约18%-35%，并且进口商的数量增加了多达17%。

abstract.text: This study investigates whether changes in risk perception play a critical role in improving of preventive behaviors and health outcomes by examining the 2009 H1N1 influenza (or swine flu) pandemic in Korea. We employ a difference-in-differences estimation strategy by comparing the differential effects of the H1N1 outbreak on the confirmed cases of diseases which can be prevented by preventive behaviors (e.g., intestinal infections) and the cases of diseases which cannot (e.g., injuries). Using unique administrative data from South Korea's National Health Insurance Service (NHIS), we find that the exogenous increase in health risk reduced the incidence of intestinal infections compared to the injuries during the H1N1 influenza outbreak. The reduction was the most substantial among children under five years of age, with a 25.4% decline in cases of intestinal infections relative to injuries. Our findings are robust across various alternative specifications. We provide suggestive evidence that active adoption of preventive behaviors is one of the channels underlying the unexpected decrease in diarrhea cases. The effects, however, faded away shortly after the end of the pandemic and did not last in the long run.

10.1002/hec.4622.abstractZh: 本研究通过考察2009年韩国的H1N1流感（或猪流感）大流行，探讨风险感知的变化在改善预防行为和健康结果方面是否起着关键作用。我们采用差异-差异估计策略，比较H1N1疫情对可通过预防行为预防的疾病（如肠道感染）病例与无法预防的疾病（如伤害）病例的影响。利用韩国国家健康保险服务局提供的独特行政数据，我们发现H1N1流感疫情期间健康风险的外部增加降低了肠道感染的发生率，这一减少在五岁以下儿童中最为显著，肠道感染病例相比伤害病例减少了25.4%。我们的研究结果在各种替代假设下均具有稳健性。我们有证据表明，积极采取预防行为是导致腹泻病例意外减少的一个途径。然而，这些效应在大流行结束后不久便逐渐消失，且并未在长期内持续存在。

abstract.text: A largely unexplored part of the financial incentive for physicians to participate in preventive care is the degree to which they are the residual claimant from any resulting cost savings. We examine the impact of two preventive activities for people with serious mental illness (care plans and annual reviews of physical health) by English primary care practices on costs in these practices and in secondary care. Using panel two-part models to analyze patient-level data linked across primary and secondary care, we find that these preventive activities in the previous year are associated with cost reductions in the current quarter both in primary and secondary care. We estimate that there are large beneficial externalities for which the primary care physician is not the residual claimant: the cost savings in secondary care are 4.7 times larger than the cost savings in primary care. These activities are incentivized in the English National Health Service but the total financial incentives for primary care physicians to participate were considerably smaller than the total cost savings produced. This suggests that changes to the design of incentives to increase the marginal reward for conducting these preventive activities among patients with serious mental illness could have further increased welfare.

10.1002/hec.4623.abstractZh: 在医生参与预防保健的财务激励因素中，一个尚未充分探索的方面是，他们作为任何由此带来的成本节约的剩余承担者所扮演的角色。我们研究了英国初级保健实践中对严重精神疾病患者实施的两种预防活动（护理计划和年度身体健康检查）对初级保健实践及二级保健实践成本的影响。通过双部分面板模型分析连接初级和二级保健的患者层面数据，我们发现，前一年的这些预防活动与当前季度的成本降低有关，无论是在初级还是二级保健领域。我们估计，存在大量的有益外部性，而初级保健医生并非这些外部性的剩余承担者：二级保健的成本节约是初级保健成本节约的4.7倍。这些活动在英国国家卫生服务体系中得到了激励，但初级保健医生参与的总财务激励远远低于所产生的总成本节约。这表明，改变激励措施的设计，以增加对严重精神疾病患者实施这些预防活动的边际奖励，可能会进一步提升福利水平。

abstract.text: Informal carers report lower evaluative wellbeing than non-carers. In contrast to this literature and our own analysis of evaluative wellbeing, we find carers have a small but higher level of experienced wellbeing than non-carers do. To investigate why, we use decomposition analysis which separates explanatory factors into how time is used and how those uses of time are experienced. We analyze activities and associated experienced wellbeing measured in ten-minute intervals over two days by 4817 adults from the 2014/15 UK Time Use Survey. We use entropy balancing to compare carers with a re-weighted counterfactual non-carer group and then apply Oaxaca-Blinder decomposition. The experienced wellbeing gap of 0.066 is the net result of several substantial competing effects of time use. Carers experienced wellbeing would be higher by 0.188 if they had the same patterns and returns to time use as non-carers which is driven by sleep, time stress and alternative characteristics of time use. However, leisure and non-market activities serve to dampen this increase in experienced wellbeing. Initiatives to improve and assess carer wellbeing should pay close attention to how carers spend their time.

10.1002/hec.4624.abstractZh: 非正式照顾者报告的评价幸福感低于非照顾者。与现有文献及我们自己对评价幸福感的分析不同，我们发现照顾者的经验幸福感虽然较低，但水平高于非照顾者。为了探究原因，我们采用了分解分析法，将解释因素分为时间的使用方式以及这些时间使用方式所带来的体验。我们分析了2014/15年度英国时间使用调查中4817名成年人两天内以十分钟间隔记录的活动及其相关的体验幸福感。通过熵平衡法，我们将照顾者与一个重新加权的非照顾者对照组进行比较，然后应用Oaxaca-Blinder分解法。0.066的体验幸福感差距是时间使用方式多种相互竞争效应共同作用的结果。如果照顾者与非照顾者在时间使用模式及时间回返方面保持一致，那么他们的体验幸福感将高出0.188，这主要受到睡眠、时间压力以及时间使用的其他特征的影响。然而，休闲活动和非市场活动则削弱了这种体验幸福感的提升。旨在改善和评估照顾者幸福感的举措应重点关注照顾者如何分配时间。

abstract.text: Community Health Centers offer coordinated and comprehensive responses to primary care needs. Our study aims at assessing whether the introduction of such organizational model improved health outcomes measured by inappropriate emergency visits among diabetics in the Emilia-Romagna region of Italy. Using difference-in-differences methods within a staggered treatment setting, we estimate the effect of Community Health Center participation on inappropriate hospital emergency visits between year 2010 and year 2016. We distinguish between emergency department admissions for varying time spans, occurring at daytime during working days, at night-time, as well as during weekends. We show that, the causal effect of the adoption of the community care model leads to a reduction in the probability of inappropriate admissions by an amount ranging between 1.6 and 1.7% points during working days at daytime, with large facilities responsible for most gains by experiencing a decrease ranging between 4 and 3% points. Conversely, we detect no difference at night-time and during weekends. Our results point out that the coordinated care model increases appropriateness among vulnerable patients, and that extending opening hours and the range of services can further enhance such benefits.

10.1002/hec.4625.abstractZh: 社区健康中心为初级保健需求提供协调且全面的服务。本研究旨在评估这种组织模式的应用是否改善了意大利艾米利亚-罗马涅地区糖尿病患者的急诊就诊情况。通过分阶段处理的方法，我们估计了从2010年到2016年间，社区健康中心参与对糖尿病患者不当急诊就诊的影响。我们区分了不同时间段的急诊入院情况，包括工作日白天的、夜间以及周末的就诊情况。结果显示，采用社区护理模式后，工作日白天的不当急诊入院概率降低了1.6%至1.7%，而规模较大的医疗机构这一降幅更为显著，减少了4%至3%。相反，夜间和周末的就诊情况并未出现差异。我们的研究结果表明，协调的护理模式能够提升弱势患者的就诊适宜性，而延长开放时间和服务范围则能进一步增强这些益处。

abstract.text: This paper re-examines a well-established hypothesis postulating that life expectancy augments incentives for human capital accumulation, leading to global income differences. A major distinguishing feature of the current study is to estimate heterogeneous panel data models under a common factor framework, which explicitly accounts for parameter heterogeneity, unobserved common factors (UCFs), and variables' non-stationarity. In sharp contrast to most previous studies, I find that the impact of health improvements on human capital accumulation turns out to be imprecisely estimated at conventionally accepted levels of statistical significance. I demonstrate that conventional estimates of the educational returns to rising longevity are derived from estimating misspecified models at least partially due to parameter heterogeneity and the presence of UCFs.

10.1002/hec.4626.abstractZh: 本文重新审视了一个广为认可的假设，即预期寿命的增加会提升人力资本积累的激励，从而导致全球收入差异。本研究的一个主要特点是采用共同因素框架来估计异质性面板数据模型，该框架能够明确考虑参数异质性、未观测的共同因素以及变量的非平稳性。与大多数先前的研究不同，我发现健康改善对人力资本积累的影响在常规统计显著性水平上的估计并不准确。我证明，对长寿带来的教育回报的传统估计，至少部分是由于参数异质性和共同因素的存在，而导致了模型设定错误。

abstract.text: This paper evaluates the causal effects of changes in reference prices (RP) on prices, copayments, and overall expenditures for off-patent pharmaceuticals. With reference pricing, firms set prices freely and the health plan covers the expenses only up to a certain threshold. We use quarterly data of the German market for anti-epileptics at the package level and at the active substance level and exploit that the RP has been adjusted in some of the active substances but not in others in a difference-in-differences framework. At the product level, we find that a lower RP reduces prices for both brand-name drugs and generics, but leads to higher copayments, especially for brand-name drugs. At the aggregate level, we find that a lower RP leads to savings for the public health insurer since revenues decrease substantially for brand-name firms and, to a lesser extent, also for generic firms. Overall expenditures (payments by the health insurer and the patients) for brand-name drugs decrease in proportion to the decrease in the RP, while the adjustment does not significantly influence overall expenditures for generics.

10.1002/hec.4627.abstractZh: 本文评估了参考价格变动对非专利药品价格、共同支付费用以及整体支出的影响。在参考定价机制下，企业可以自由设定价格，而健康计划仅承担一定额度的费用。我们采用德国抗癫痫药物市场的季度数据，分别从药品包级和活性成分级进行分析。研究发现，部分活性成分的参考价格有所调整，而其他活性成分则未进行调整，这种差异通过差异-差异框架进行了分析。在产品层面，我们发现较低的参考价格会降低品牌药品和仿制药的价格，但会导致共同支付费用的增加，尤其是品牌药品。在总体层面，较低的参考价格有助于公共健康保险公司节省成本，因为品牌药品的收入大幅减少，而仿制药的收入减少幅度较小。品牌药品的整体支出（健康保险公司和患者的支付金额）随着参考价格的下降而相应减少，而仿制药的整体支出则未受到显著影响。

abstract.text: Health-care expenditures and the demand for caregiving are increasing concerns for policy makers. Although informal care to a certain extent may substitute for costly formal care, providing informal care may come at a cost to caregivers in terms of their own health. However, evidence of causal effects of care responsibilities on health is limited, especially for long-term outcomes. In this paper, we estimate short and long-term effects of a formal care expansion for the elderly on the health of their middle-aged daughters. We exploit a reform in the federal funding of formal care for Norwegian municipalities that caused a greater expansion of home care provision in municipalities that initially had lower coverage rates. We find that expanding formal care reduced sickness absence in the short run, primarily due to reduced absences related to musculoskeletal and psychological disorders. The reduction in sickness absence is concentrated among workers with little work flexibility (e.g., shift workers), whereas there are no effects for workers with more flexible jobs. We were unable to detect effects on long-term health and healthcare utilization outcomes. Our results imply that sickness absence uptake could be hiding a need for more flexibility around work for people with caregiving responsibilities.

10.1002/hec.4628.abstractZh: 医疗保健支出和对护理服务的需求日益成为政策制定者关注的焦点。虽然非正式护理在一定程度上可以替代昂贵的正式护理，但提供非正式护理可能会给护理人员自身的健康带来影响。然而，关于护理责任对健康影响的因果效应证据有限，尤其是针对长期结果而言。在本文中，我们估计了正式护理扩展对老年人中年女儿健康的短期和长期影响。我们利用联邦政府对挪威市政当局提供正式护理的资助改革，该改革导致最初覆盖率较低的市政当局家庭护理服务得到更大扩展。我们发现，扩展正式护理在短期内减少了因病缺勤的情况，主要是由于与肌肉骨骼疾病和心理疾病相关的缺勤减少。这种减少病假的情况主要集中在工作灵活性较低的工人中（例如轮班工人），而工作灵活性较高的工人则没有受到影响。我们未能发现对长期健康和医疗利用结果的影响。我们的结果表明，因病缺勤可能掩盖了有护理责任的人对更多工作灵活性需求的事实。

abstract.text: This paper uses novel micro-data on natural resources and administrative health data in Brazil to study how economic booms in minerals affect health at birth. By implementing a reduced-form estimation of shift-share research designs, the identification strategy relies on the exogeneity of global commodity prices to municipality-specific health outcomes. I find that, following changes in international prices, municipalities with historically more endowments have a higher number of premature births and births with low Appearance, Pulse, Grimace, Activity, Respiration scores. The impacts are primarily driven by metallic minerals. Instead, industrial minerals do not appear to have any effect on birth outcomes. Even though booms in metallic minerals generate benefits through resource windfalls-by increasing wealth and generating economic opportunities-the investigation of mechanisms reveals that they also result in costs-due to pollution-which seem to prevail. Hence, some metallic minerals remain a curse more than a blessing.

10.1002/hec.4629.abstractZh: 本文利用巴西关于自然资源和行政健康数据的新颖微观数据，研究矿产经济繁荣对出生健康的影响。通过采用变分共享研究设计的简化形式估计方法，本文的识别策略基于全球商品价格对特定市镇健康结果的外生性。研究发现，在国际价格发生变化后，历史上资源较为丰富的市镇出现更多的早产病例，以及出生体征评分较低的新生儿。这些影响主要由金属矿产引起，而工业矿产似乎对出生结果没有显著影响。尽管金属矿产的繁荣通过资源收益增加了财富和就业机会，但机制分析表明，这种繁荣也带来了污染等成本，这些成本似乎更为显著。因此，某些金属矿产更多地带来了负面影响，而非积极效应。

abstract.text: In this paper, we assess the effects of a national policy implemented in Brazil to avoid unnecessary cesareans. The policy has a supply-side component that prohibits elective c-sections before the 39th gestational week and a demand-side awareness component. Since the policy is not binding for cases with a strong medical c-section indication, we use births of breech- and transverse-positioned babies as a counterfactual for births of cephalic-positioned babies in a difference-in-differences framework. Our results reveal that the policy decreases the rate of c-sections by 1.6 percentage point, and slightly increases gestational time, birthweight, and first-minute APGAR scores. There is evidence that policy effectiveness is driven by its demand-side component.

10.1002/hec.4630.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们评估了巴西一项旨在避免不必要的剖宫产的国家政策的影响。该政策包含供应方面的措施，禁止在妊娠第39周之前进行选择性剖宫产，同时还包括需求方面的宣传措施。由于该政策对具有强烈医学指征需要进行剖宫产的情况并不具有约束力，我们采用臀位和横位婴儿的分娩情况作为反事实条件，在差异-差异框架中分析cephalic-positioned婴儿的分娩情况。研究结果表明，该政策使剖宫产率降低了1.6个百分点，同时略微延长了妊娠时间、婴儿出生体重以及新生儿APGAR评分的第一分钟指标。有证据表明，该政策的有效性主要源于其需求方面的措施。

abstract.text: Studies have shown that reducing out-of-pocket costs can lead to higher medication initiation rates in childhood. Whether the cost of such initiatives is inflated by moral hazard issues remains a question of concern. This paper looks to the implementation of a public drug insurance program in Québec, Canada, to investigate potential low-benefit consumption in children. Using a nationally representative longitudinal sample, we harness machine learning techniques to predict a child's risk of developing a mental health disorder. Using difference-in-differences analyses, we then assess the impact of the drug program on children's mental health medication uptake across the distribution of predicted mental health risk. Beyond showing that eliminating out-of-pocket costs led to a 3 percentage point increase in mental health drug uptake, we show that demand responses are concentrated in the top two deciles of risk for developing mental health disorders. These higher-risk children increase take-up of mental health drugs by 7-8 percentage points. We find even stronger effects for stimulants (8-11 percentage point increases among the highest risk children). Our results suggest that reductions in out-of-pocket costs could achieve better uptake of mental health medications, without inducing substantial low-benefit care among lower-risk children.

10.1002/hec.4631.abstractZh: 研究表明，降低自付费用可以提高儿童开始使用药物的几率。然而，此类措施的成本是否因道德风险问题而上升，仍是一个值得关注的问题。本文以加拿大魁北克省实施的公共药物保险计划为研究对象，探讨儿童可能出现的低效益消费情况。通过全国代表性的纵向样本数据，我们利用机器学习技术预测儿童患心理健康障碍的风险。随后，通过差异-差异分析，我们评估了该药物计划对预测有心理健康风险儿童使用心理健康药物行为的影响。研究发现，取消自付费用后，心理健康药物的使用率增加了3个百分点。同时，需求响应主要集中在有心理健康风险的前两个十分位区间。这些高风险儿童使心理健康药物的使用率增加了7-8个百分点。对于兴奋剂类药物，我们发现其使用率增加了8-11个百分点，且这一效应在最高风险儿童中更为显著。我们的研究结果表明，降低自付费用可以在不导致低风险儿童出现大量低效益护理情况的前提下，提高心理健康药物的使用率。

abstract.text: This paper estimates the effect of in utero exposure to adverse events on late life diabetes, cardiovascular disease risks and cognition deficiency. We merge data on the regional violence during the Cultural Revolution and the excessive death rates during the Chinese Great Famine with data from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study survey. Results show that female babies who were exposed in utero to the famine have higher diabetes risks, while male babies who were exposed to the Cultural Revolution are shown to have lower cognitive abilities.

10.1002/hec.4632.abstractZh: 本文估计了在子宫内暴露于不良事件对晚年糖尿病、心血管疾病风险以及认知缺陷的影响。我们将文化大革命期间的区域性暴力与中国大饥荒期间的过高死亡率的数据与中国健康和退休纵向研究的数据进行了整合。研究结果表明，在子宫内暴露于饥荒的女婴患糖尿病的风险更高，而在文化大革命期间暴露于该事件的男婴则表现出较低的认知能力。

abstract.text: This study uses a difference-in-differences design within an event-study framework to examine how state decisions to expand Medicaid following the passage of the Affordable Care Act (ACA) affected mental health treatment. The findings suggest that expansion states experienced increased admissions to mental health treatment facilities and Medicaid-reimbursed prescriptions for medications used to treat common forms of mental illness. The results also indicate an increase in admissions with trauma, anxiety, conduct, and depression disorders. There is also suggestive evidence of an increase in the number of mental health treatment facilities accepting Medicaid as a form of payment. Lastly, as with previous studies, I find weak evidence of a decrease in suicides in Medicaid expansion states. These findings highlight the vital role of the ACA in providing access to mental health treatment for low-income Americans.

10.1002/hec.4633.abstractZh: 本研究采用事件研究框架内的差异-差异设计，探讨《平价医疗法案》通过后各州扩大医疗补助计划的决定对心理健康治疗的影响。研究结果表明，扩大医疗补助计划的州出现了更多心理健康治疗设施的就诊记录，以及更多使用医疗补助报销的用于治疗常见精神疾病的药物。研究结果还显示，患有创伤、焦虑、行为问题和抑郁障碍的就诊人数也有所增加。此外，有迹象表明，接受医疗补助作为支付方式的心理健康治疗设施数量也有所增加。与以往的研究一样，本研究发现关于医疗补助扩大计划实施后自杀率下降的证据并不充分。这些发现凸显了《平价医疗法案》在为低收入美国人提供心理健康治疗方面的重要作用。

abstract.text: With the increase of aging population, long-term care insurance (LTCI) systems have become important for improving individuals' health. However, the effect of LTCI on health is unclear, especially in developing countries, owing to the lack of random policy shocks and comprehensive databases. This study investigates the Chinese LTCI pilot program, using four waves of the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study database (sample aged ≥45 years) from 2011 to 2018. The recent difference-in-differences approaches for staggered design, which are capable of dealing with the negative weights issue, are used to investigate changes in health status, measured by self-rated health (SRH), (instrumental) activities of daily living, self-rated depression, and cognition, in pilot and non-pilot cities before and after LTCI implementation. Long-term care insurance has a significant average effect on SRH improvement and a long-term positive effect on cognition for middle-aged and older populations. This study provides the first evaluation of LTCI policy on health outcomes using the recent difference-in-differences approaches. It provides evidence for the overall health improvement achieved through the LTCI and offers positive reinforcement and potential areas for improvement in establishing LTCI worldwide.

10.1002/hec.4634.abstractZh: 随着老龄化人口的增加，长期护理保险系统对于改善个人健康变得至关重要。然而，长期护理保险对健康的影響尚不清楚，尤其是在发展中国家，由于缺乏随机政策冲击和全面的数据库，这一影响更加难以评估。本研究利用2011至2018年中国健康与退休纵向研究数据库的四波数据，对中国长期护理保险试点项目进行了分析。研究采用了最新的差分进化方法，该方法能够处理负权重问题，以探讨在试点与非试点城市实施长期护理保险前后，通过自我评估健康状况、（工具性）日常生活活动、自我评估抑郁情绪以及认知能力等指标所反映的健康状况变化。研究结果表明，长期护理保险对中年及老年人群体的自我评估健康状况有显著改善作用，并对认知能力有长期的积极影响。本研究首次使用最新的差分进化方法对长期护理保险政策对健康结果的影响进行了评估，为长期护理保险带来的整体健康改善提供了证据，并为全球范围内建立长期护理保险制度提供了积极的参考和潜在的改进方向。

abstract.text: Several low- and middle-income countries are considering health financing system reforms to accelerate progress toward universal health coverage (UHC). However, empirical evidence of the effect of health financing systems on health system outcomes is scarce, partly because it is difficult to quantitatively capture the 'health financing system'. We assign country-year observations to one of three health financing systems (i.e., predominantly out-of-pocket, social health insurance (SHI) or government-financed), using clustering based on out-of-pocket, contributory SHI and non-contributory government expenditure, as a percentage of total health expenditures. We then estimate the effect of these different systems on health system outcomes, using fixed effects regressions. We find that transitions from OOP-dominant to government-financed systems improved most outcomes more than did transitions to SHI systems. Transitions to government financing increases life expectancy (+1.3 years, p < 0.05) and reduces under-5 mortality (-8.7%, p < 0.05) and catastrophic health expenditure incidence (-3.3 percentage points, p < 0.05). Results are robust to several sensitivity tests. It is more likely that increases in non-contributory government financing rather than SHI financing improve health system outcomes. Notable reasons include SHI's higher implementation costs and more limited coverage. These results may raise a warning for policymakers considering SHI reforms to reach UHC.

10.1002/hec.4635.abstractZh: 一些中低收入国家正在考虑对卫生融资体系进行改革，以加速实现全民健康覆盖的目标。然而，关于卫生融资体系对卫生系统成果影响的实证证据十分有限，部分原因是难以定量把握“卫生融资体系”的构成。我们通过基于个人自付费用、社会健康保险或非自付费用政府支出占总卫生支出比例进行聚类分析，将国家-年份数据分配到三种不同的卫生融资体系之一：以自付费用为主要方式的体系、社会健康保险体系或政府融资体系。随后，我们使用固定效应回归模型来估计这些不同体系对卫生系统成果的影响。研究发现，从以自付费用为主要方式的体系转变为政府融资体系对各项成果的改善效果最为显著。政府融资体系的转变使预期寿命增加1.3年（p < 0.05），5岁以下儿童死亡率降低8.7%（p < 0.05），灾难性卫生支出比例也降低了3.3个百分点（p < 0.05）。这些结果在多次敏感性检验中依然保持稳定。更有可能的是，非自付费用政府融资的增加而非社会健康保险融资的增加能够改善卫生系统成果。其中，社会健康保险的实施成本较高且覆盖范围有限是重要原因。这些结果提醒那些考虑实施社会健康保险改革以实现全民健康覆盖的政策制定者。

abstract.text: We investigate the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic and related policy responses on non-COVID-19 healthcare utilization (i.e., different types of outpatient care) up to October 2020 in China. Using an administrative database from a large prefecture-level city, we find that both direct exposure to the COVID-19 pandemic and the strict containment policy responses led to reductions in outpatient care utilization. The largest decline during the lockdown was observed in preventive care visits, which nevertheless recovered to pre-pandemic levels 2 months after the lockdown. The disruptions in prenatal care visits could not be offset by the recovery later on. Chronic care and emergency department visits had not returned to pre-pandemic levels as of October 2020, which may be driven by extended days' supply of prescription medication, increased use of telemedicine, and improved health-protective behaviors. In the reopening period, there were increases in visits for mental and sleep disorders, especially among children, and for medical abortion. Among health facilities at all levels, primary care facilities saw the least reductions in total outpatient visits. Our results emphasize the need for strategies to ensure access to urgent or essential care services when managing the current epidemiologic transition and future crises.

10.1002/hec.4636.abstractZh: 我们研究了COVID-19疫情及其相关政策应对措施对截至2020年10月中国非COVID-19医疗服务的利用情况的影响。通过某大型地级市的行政数据库分析发现，直接暴露于COVID-19疫情以及严格的疫情防控政策导致门诊服务利用减少。在封锁期间，预防性医疗服务的利用下降最为明显，但封锁结束后两个月，这一情况已恢复到疫情前的水平。产前医疗服务的利用未能在后期恢复至疫情前水平，这可能是由于处方药的供应时间延长、远程医疗的使用增加以及健康保护行为的改善所致。在重新开放期间，针对精神和睡眠障碍的医疗服务需求有所增加，尤其是儿童群体，同时医疗堕胎的就诊人数也有所上升。在所有级别的医疗机构中，基层医疗机构的门诊总人次减少幅度最小。我们的研究结果强调了在应对当前疫情过渡和未来危机时，需要制定策略以确保紧急或基本医疗服务的可及性。

abstract.text: The Affordable Care Act included a provision to gradually eliminate the Medicare prescription drug coverage gap between 2011 and 2020, which substantially lower medication costs in the gap. Using 2007-2016 Medicare claims data, we estimate how filling the gap affects individuals' out-of-pocket spending and medication use, separately for branded and generic drugs. One important difficulty in estimating the policy impact is that around the same time, many blockbuster drugs commonly used by the Medicare population experienced patent expiration and began to see generic entry. Because generic entries affected different therapeutic classes at different times, we run difference-in-differences models by therapeutic category at the beneficiary-month level to isolate the effect of the gap closure from that of generic entry. Overall, we find that filling the gap substantially reduced out-of-pocket spending and increased the use of branded drugs, which had larger discount rates during the analysis period. Beneficiaries reaching the gap, at older ages, or with comorbidities experienced larger reduction in out-of-pocket spending. We show that without accounting for generic entry, the effect of filling the coverage gap on medication use is underestimated for branded drugs and overestimated for generic drugs.

10.1002/hec.4637.abstractZh: 《平价医疗法案》包含一项条款，旨在在2011年至2020年间逐步消除医疗保险处方药物覆盖缺口，从而大幅降低该缺口期间的用药成本。利用2007-2016年的医疗保险索赔数据，我们估算了填补缺口对个人自付支出和用药习惯的影响，分别针对品牌药物和仿制药。在评估政策影响时存在一个重要难点：在相近的时间段内，许多被医疗保险人群广泛使用的重磅药物专利到期，仿制药开始进入市场。由于仿制药的进入时间不同，且影响的治疗类别也有所不同，我们按治疗类别构建差异-差异模型，以区分缺口关闭效应与仿制药进入效应。总体而言，我们发现填补缺口显著降低了自付支出，并增加了品牌药物的用药量，因为在分析期间，品牌药物的折扣率较高。那些处于高龄或伴有合并症的患者，自付支出的减少幅度更大。我们的研究表明，如果不考虑仿制药进入的影响，对品牌药物的用药影响会被低估，而对仿制药的影响则会被高估。

abstract.text: Both the human capital approach and the friction cost approach are frequently used to quantify the productivity costs associated with illness, disability or death in health economic evaluations. In this paper we argue that these approaches have one major, but common shortcoming: they only capture partial equilibrium (PE) effects and therefore underestimate the true potential productivity costs associated with health conditions. They neglect the sizable, indirect, ripple effects in the economy captured by general equilibrium (GE) models. To demonstrate our point, we compare a traditional PE with a GE approach for the application to nocturia, a condition characterized by the need to frequently wake up at night to urinate. Nocturia is associated with substantial impairment of daytime functioning and work productivity. We employ large-scale United Kingdom (UK) employer-employee survey data to estimate the prevalence and productivity loss. These estimates are then used as shared inputs to drive both approaches. We find that the traditional PE approach underestimates the annual productivity cost of clinically relevant nocturia by around 16%. We propose a generalized GE/PE multiplier to approximate the GE effect for other health conditions. Our findings stress the importance of accounting for sizable GE effects when conducting health economic evaluations.

10.1002/hec.4638.abstractZh: 在健康经济评估中，人力资本方法和摩擦成本方法常被用来量化与疾病、残疾或死亡相关的生产力成本。本文认为，这两种方法存在一个主要但共同的缺陷：它们仅捕捉到部分均衡效应，因此低估了与健康状况相关的真实潜在生产力成本。它们忽略了由一般均衡模型所捕捉的显著、间接的连锁效应。为了证明我们的观点，我们将传统部分均衡方法与一般均衡方法应用于夜尿症这一病症，夜尿症表现为夜间频繁需要起床排尿。夜尿症会导致日间功能和工作效率显著下降。我们利用了英国大规模雇主-雇员调查数据来估算其患病率和生产力损失。这些估算结果被用作共享输入，以驱动两种方法的应用。我们发现，传统部分均衡方法低估了临床相关的夜尿症的年度生产力成本约16%。我们提出了一种通用的GE/PE乘数，以近似其他健康状况的一般均衡效应。我们的研究结果强调了在进行健康经济评估时考虑显著的一般均衡效应的重要性。

abstract.text: We study exposure to grading bias and provide novel evidence of its impact on mental health. Grading bias, which we interpret as over-grading, is constructed as the residual of final upper secondary school grades having controlled for results in a standardized test, itself not subject to grading leniency. Grading bias is further isolated by considering only within-school variation in over-grading and controlling for prior grades and school production. Using Swedish individual-level register data for individuals graduating from upper secondary school in the years 2001-2004, we show that over-grading has substantial significant protective impacts on the mental health of young adults, but only among female students. That grades themselves, independent of knowledge, substantially impact the production of health highlights an important health production mechanism, and implies that any changes to the design of grading systems must consider these wider health implications.

10.1002/hec.4639.abstractZh: 我们研究了评分偏差的影响，并提供了关于其对心理健康影响的新的证据。我们将其解释为过度评分，定义为在控制了标准化测试结果后，高中毕业成绩中的剩余部分，而标准化测试本身并不受评分宽限的影响。通过仅考虑校内过度评分的变化，并控制之前的成绩和学校因素，我们进一步明确了评分偏差的影响。利用2001-2004年间瑞典高中毕业生个人登记数据，我们发现过度评分对年轻人的心理健康有显著的积极影响，但这一影响仅存在于女性学生中。这表明，与知识无关的成绩本身对健康的影响非常重要，这凸显了一个重要的健康机制，并意味着任何对评分系统设计的修改都必须考虑这些更广泛的健康影响。

abstract.text: Globally 800 women die every day from preventable causes related to pregnancy and childbirth. One of the major reasons for high maternal mortality ratios in many developing countries is the low proportion of births attended by Skilled Birth Attendants (SBA). To address the high number of maternal deaths, in 2008 the Government of Pakistan introduced the Community Midwives Program. Under the program, women from across the country were trained and deployed as Community Midwives. In this study, I use six rounds of Pakistan Social and Living Measurement Survey to estimate the impact of this program on maternal healthcare utilization. I find that women residing in districts with higher Community Midwives per capita were 9 percentage points more likely to be attended by a SBA at the time of delivery and were 8 percentage points more likely to give birth at a medical facility as opposed to birthing at home. I find no evidence of impact on take up of prenatal and post-natal check-ups. The use of Community Midwives may be a cost effective tool to reduce maternal deaths, especially for developing countries with low health budgets.

10.1002/hec.4640.abstractZh: 全球每天有800名女性因与妊娠和分娩相关的可预防原因而死亡。许多发展中国家孕产妇死亡率高的一个重要原因是专业助产人员参与分娩的比例较低。为了应对高数量的孕产妇死亡问题，巴基斯坦政府在2008年推出了社区助产员计划。根据该计划，来自全国各地的妇女接受了培训，并被部署为社区助产员。在这项研究中，我使用了六轮巴基斯坦社会和生活测量调查来估算该计划对孕产妇医疗保健利用的影响。我发现，居住在拥有更高比例社区助产员地区的妇女，在分娩时由专业助产人员协助的可能性高出9个百分点，并且在医疗机构分娩的可能性也高出8个百分点。然而，我没有发现该计划对产前和产后检查接受率产生影响的证据。对于预算有限的 developing 国家来说，使用社区助产员可能是降低孕产妇死亡的有效手段。

abstract.text: The prevalence of mental health disorders in young adults is increasing, yet there is limited empirical evidence on its economic consequences. We contribute to the literature by estimating the healthcare costs of psychological distress using panel data of young women (aged 18-23 years with a 5-year follow-up) from the Australian Longitudinal Study on Women's Health and linked administrative data from Medicare Australia. Our empirical strategy is based on the classical two-part model of healthcare costs with individual specific fixed-effects. We complement our analysis with a test for selection on unobservables to address potential concerns of endogeneity. We find that young women with psychological distress have 15% higher annual healthcare costs (excluding hospital costs) than women with no psychological distress. A large proportion of these costs is driven by the use of antidepressants and the services of psychiatrists and psychologists. We further find that women with psychological distress have higher out-of-pocket costs on these mental health related services compared to non-mental health specific services. Additionally, we show that the effect of psychological distress on healthcare costs is highest during the first 6 months of onset, which gradually decreases afterwards. The findings justify the importance of policy initiatives towards early prevention and treatment of psychological distress, especially among young women.

10.1002/hec.4641.abstractZh: 年轻成年人中心理健康障碍的患病率正在上升，但关于其经济后果的经验证据却十分有限。我们通过使用澳大利亚女性健康纵向研究中的年轻女性数据（年龄范围为18-23岁，随访时间为5年）以及澳大利亚医疗保险的行政数据，估算了心理困扰带来的医疗成本。我们的实证策略基于传统的医疗成本两部分模型，并考虑了个体特定的固定效应。为了应对潜在的内生性问题，我们还进行了关于不可观测变量的检验。研究发现，有心理困扰的年轻女性的年度医疗成本（不包括医院费用）比没有心理困扰的女性高出15%。这些成本中很大一部分是由抗抑郁药的使用以及精神科医生和心理学家服务的费用所驱动的。此外，我们发现有心理困扰的女性在这些与心理健康相关的服务上的自付费用高于非心理健康相关服务。我们还发现，心理困扰对医疗成本的影响在发病后的前6个月最为显著，之后逐渐下降。这些发现强调了针对年轻女性开展心理健康早期预防和治疗政策的重要性。

abstract.text: It is well known that malaria has serious adverse effects on humans. Yet, little is known as to how dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane (DDT), which is still used to control malaria, may affect human socioeconomic outcomes in the long run. Utilizing the large-scale indoor residual spraying of low-dose DDT in Taiwan in the 1950s, we estimated the long-term effects of low-dose DDT exposure in early childhood on education, marriage and employment in adulthood. Our identification hinges on the unexpected extension of DDT spraying after malaria had already been largely brought under control. We found that even at a very low dosage, DDT exposure still resulted in discernible negative effects on education and marriage. For employment, although no effect on the probability of working was detected, people exposed to more sprayings in childhood were more likely to work in the agricultural sector that typically requires less human capital.

10.1002/hec.4642.abstractZh: 众所周知，疟疾对人类有严重的负面影响。然而，关于仍被用于控制疟疾的二氯二苯三氯乙烷（DDT）在长期内可能对人类社会经济结果产生的影响，我们知之甚少。利用20世纪50年代台湾大规模室内残留喷洒低剂量DDT的数据，我们估算了儿童时期接触低剂量DDT对成年后的教育、婚姻和就业状况的长期影响。我们的研究基于一个意外发现：在疟疾已经得到较大程度控制之后，DDT喷洒仍持续进行。研究发现，即使使用非常低剂量的DDT，仍会对教育和婚姻产生明显的负面影响。在就业方面，虽然未检测到对就业概率的影响，但那些在儿童时期接受更多DDT喷洒的人更有可能从事农业部门的工作，因为农业部门通常对人力资本的要求较低。

abstract.text: This paper studies the effects of the enactment of birth registration laws, as the official universal and uniform method of recording births, across US states in the first decades of the 20th century on old-age longevity for children affected by these laws. We show that establishing birth registration laws has long-term benefits for old-age health. The benefits are primarily driven by states with an effective child labor policy, suggesting that registering births helps the enforcement of child labor laws which in turn operate as the mechanism channel to improve old-age longevity. A treatment-on-treated calculation suggests an increase of 0.6 years of longevity from not working during childhood due to the birth registration law.

10.1002/hec.4643.abstractZh: 本文研究了20世纪头几十年，美国各州实施出生登记法律这一官方、普遍且统一的出生记录方式，对受该法律影响的儿童老年健康寿命的影响。研究表明，建立出生登记法律对老年健康具有长期益处。这些益处主要源于那些实施有效童工政策的州，这表明登记出生有助于执行童工法律，而童工法律的执行又是提高老年健康寿命的机制。通过“处理对处理”的计算方法发现，由于出生登记法律的存在，儿童在童年时期不从事劳动，其健康寿命可延长0.6年。

abstract.text: In this paper, we analyze economic costs and consequences of local non-pharmaceutical interventions (NPIs) aimed at containing the Covid-19 pandemic. Using comprehensive data on municipal and regional policies in Norway, we implement a difference-in-differences framework identifying impacts of local NPIs from discontinuous differential shifts in outcomes following the implementation of new policies. In treated municipalities, local NPIs lead to persistent reductions in mobility, persistent increases in unemployment, and transient reductions in consumer spending. Analyses of spatial spillovers show that the implementation of local NPIs increases retail mobility in untreated neighboring municipalities. Overall, our findings suggest that local NPIs have economic consequences for local economies and induce residents to shift their consumption of goods and services to neighboring municipalities.

10.1002/hec.4644.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们分析了旨在控制新冠疫情的局部非药物干预措施所带来的经济成本和后果。通过利用挪威市政和区域政策的全面数据，我们采用了差异-差异框架，以识别新政策实施后结果的非连续变化所带来的影响。在受干预的市政当局中，局部非药物干预措施导致出行次数持续减少、失业率持续上升以及消费者支出短暂下降。空间溢出效应的分析表明，局部非药物干预措施的实施增加了未受干预的邻近市政当局的零售活动。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，局部非药物干预措施对当地经济产生了经济影响，并促使居民将商品和服务的消费转向邻近的市政当局。

abstract.text: Globally, Indigenous populations experience poorer health but use less primary healthcare than their non-Indigenous counterparts. In 2010, the Australian government introduced a targeted reform aimed at reducing these disparities. The reform reduced, or abolished prescription medicine co-payments and provided financial incentives for GPs to better manage chronic disease care for Indigenous peoples. Exploiting the framework of a natural experiment, we investigate how the reform affected these health disparities in primary and specialist healthcare utilization using longitudinal administrative data from 75,826 Australians, including 1896 Indigenous peoples, with cardiovascular disease. The differences-in-differences estimates indicate that the reform increased primary healthcare use among Indigenous peoples, including 12.9% more prescription medicines, 6.6% more GP services, and 34.0% more chronic disease services, but also reduced specialist attendances by 11.8%. Increases in primary care were larger for those who received the largest co-payment relief and lived in metropolitan regions, whereas the reduction in specialist attendances was concentrated among lower income Indigenous patients. Affirmative action can reduce inequalities in Indigenous use of primary healthcare, albeit careful design is required to ensure that benefits are equitable and do not lead to substitution away from valuable, or necessary, care.

10.1002/hec.4645.abstractZh: 在全球范围内，原住民的健康状况较差，但他们对初级医疗的使用频率低于非原住民人群。2010年，澳大利亚政府推出了旨在减少这些差异的针对性改革。该改革减少了或取消了处方药的自付费用，并为全科医生提供了激励措施，以更好地管理原住民的慢性病护理。我们利用自然实验的框架，通过75,826名澳大利亚人的纵向行政数据（其中包括1896名原住民患者，患有心血管疾病）来研究该改革对初级和专科医疗使用的影响。差异估计表明，该改革增加了原住民对初级医疗的使用，包括处方药使用增加了12.9%，全科医疗服务使用增加了6.6%，慢性病服务使用增加了34.0%。然而，专科就诊次数却减少了11.8%。对于获得最大自付费用减免且居住在大都市地区的人群来说，初级医疗的使用增加幅度更大，而专科就诊次数的减少则主要集中在低收入原住民患者中。积极的行动可以减少原住民在初级医疗使用上的不平等现象，但需要谨慎设计，以确保这种措施能够公平实施，并且不会导致对有价值或必要的医疗服务的替代。

abstract.text: We study the effects of changing Medicaid reimbursement rates for primary care services on behavioral health outcomes-defined here as mental illness and substance use disorders. Medicaid enrollees are at elevated risk for these, and other, chronic conditions and are likely to have unmet treatment needs. We apply two-way fixed-effects regressions to survey data specifically designed to measure behavioral health outcomes over the period 2010-2016. We find that higher primary care reimbursement rates reduce mental illness and substance use disorders among non-elderly adult Medicaid enrollees, although we interpret findings for substance use disorders with some caution as they may be vulnerable to differential pre-trends. Overall, our findings suggest positive spillovers from a policy designed to target primary care services to behavioral health outcomes.

10.1002/hec.4646.abstractZh: 我们研究了改变医疗补助对初级保健服务的报销费率对行为健康结果的影响，这里将行为健康结果定义为精神疾病和物质使用障碍。医疗补助参保者患这些及其他慢性疾病的风险较高，且可能存在未得到满足的治疗需求。我们采用双向固定效应回归方法，对2010-2016年期间专门设计用于衡量行为健康结果的调查数据进行了分析。研究发现，较高的初级保健报销费率能够降低非老年成人医疗补助参保者的精神疾病和物质使用障碍发生率，不过我们对物质使用障碍的研究结果持谨慎态度，因为这些状况可能容易受到不同前期趋势的影响。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，针对初级保健服务的政策对行为健康结果具有积极的溢出效应。

abstract.text: This paper addresses the substantial role of clan loyalty in promoting COVID-19 diffusion in China. Using a city-date panel dataset of observations from 183 cities (prefecture-level and above) in the period of the special long holiday of Chinese New Year in 2020 (January 24-March 1), we find that regions with higher clan loyalty have more COVID-19 cases than regions with lower clan loyalty. A one standard deviation increase in clan loyalty is associated with an 8.1% increase in COVID-19 cases. We further document that clan loyalty drives COVID-19 cases by promoting mass gatherings, exploiting a staggered difference-in-differences (DID) regression based on city community-management policy shocks. Our paper provides novel evidence of one negative public health consequence of clan loyalty, namely, its aggravation of COVID-19 cases.

10.1002/hec.4647.abstractZh: 本文探讨了宗族忠诚度在中国推动COVID-19传播中的重要作用。我们使用了2020年春节期间（1月24日至3月1日）183个市级及以上城市的数据面板数据集，发现宗族忠诚度较高的地区比宗族忠诚度较低的地区出现更多的COVID-19病例。宗族忠诚度增加一个标准差，与COVID-19病例增加8.1%相关。我们还发现，宗族忠诚度通过促进大规模聚会来推动COVID-19病例的增加，这一结论基于城市社区管理政策冲击的异方差差分回归分析得出。本文提供了关于宗族忠诚度对公共卫生的负面影响的新的证据，即其会加剧COVID-19病例的严重程度。

abstract.text: A number of studies have associated financial wealth changes with health-related outcomes arguing that the effect is due to psychological distress and is immediate. In this paper, I examine this relationship for cumulative shocks to the financial wealth of American retirees using the allostatic load model of pathways from stress to poor health. Wealth shocks are identified from Health and Retirement Study reports of stock ownership along with significant negative discontinuities in high-frequency S&P500 index data. I find that a one standard deviation increase in cumulative shocks over two years increases the probability of elevated blood pressure by 9.5%, increases waist circumference by 1.2% and the cholesterol ratio by 6.1% for those whose wealth is all in shares. My findings suggest that the combined effect of random shocks to financial wealth over time is salient for health outcomes. This is consistent with the allostatic load model in which repeated activation of stress responses leads to cumulative wear and tear on the body.

10.1002/hec.4648.abstractZh: 许多研究将财务财富的变化与健康相关的结果联系起来，认为这种影响是由于心理压力造成的，并且是即时发生的。在本文中，我使用“稳态负荷模型”来探讨美国退休人员财务财富累积冲击与健康之间的关系，该模型将压力与健康不良状况之间的因果关系进行了系统分析。通过“健康与退休研究”中关于股票持有情况的报告，以及标准普尔500指数高频数据中的显著负向突变，我识别出财务财富冲击。我发现，在两年内财务财富累积冲击每增加一个标准差，高血压的发生率就会增加9.5%，腰围会增加1.2%，而那些财务财富全部以股票形式持有的人的胆固醇比率则会增加6.1%。我的研究结果表明，随着时间的推移，财务财富随机冲击的综合效应对健康结果有着显著的影响。这与“稳态负荷模型”的观点一致，即反复的应激反应会导致身体的累积性损伤。

abstract.text: Extreme temperatures are known to cause adverse health outcomes. Yet knowledge on the magnitude of this effect in developing countries is limited due to data availability and reliability issues. Collecting data for 2872 counties in China, we estimate the effects of daily temperatures on the monthly mortality rate.
