The results indicate that an additional day for which the maximum temperature is 38°C or above on average increases the monthly mortality rate by about 1.7% relative to if that day's maximum temperature had been in the range 16-21°C. This is after deducting deaths harvested from the subsequent month. Higher gross domestic product per capita at the county level is associated with lower mortality effects of hot and cold days. Improved dwelling conditions are found to be associated with a lower mortality effect of hot days and improved local healthcare infrastructure to be associated with a lower mortality effect of cold days. In the absence of strong adaptation efforts, the estimates suggest net upward pressure on annual mortality rates over coming decades in many populous counties, especially under more extreme climate change scenarios.

10.1002/hec.4649.abstractZh: 已知极端温度会对健康造成不良影响。然而，由于数据获取和可靠性问题，关于这一影响在发展中国家的具体程度的知识十分有限。通过对中国2872个县的数据进行收集，我们估算了每日温度对月死亡率的影响。研究结果表明，如果某一天的最高温度达到38°C或更高，与最高温度在16-21°C之间的日子相比，月死亡率将增加约1.7%。这一结果是在扣除随后一个月的死亡人数后的数值。县级层面的人均国内生产总值越高，炎热和寒冷天气对死亡率的影响就越低。改善的居住条件与炎热天气的死亡率降低有关，而完善的当地医疗基础设施则与寒冷天气的死亡率降低相关。在没有强有力的适应措施的情况下，估计显示，在许多人口众多的县，特别是在更极端的气候变化情景下，未来几十年内年度死亡率将出现净上升趋势。

abstract.text: When drugs enter the market, physicians' prescribing behavior plays a crucial role in the diffusion process. Although regulations to foster economically efficient prescribing exist, physicians have some degree of freedom in choosing medication and are subject to various influencing factors. The aim of the present analysis is to investigate how interaction among patients and physicians affects the diffusion. We look at two different ways that patient pathways might influence physicians and examine these effects for Sacubitril/Valsartan (S/V), a new drug for patients with heart failure. Using administrative data from Germany, we identify physicians who prescribed S/V in the first 2 years of its availability. We apply survival models to estimate the impact of the patient-physician interaction on the physicians' adoption time. To this end, we determine whether individual physicians treated patients that had been prescribed S/V, and how many other physicians already prescribing S/V were connected in patient-sharing networks. Our main findings are that patients with a previous prescription seem to induce adoption by demanding repeat prescriptions. Moreover, patients establish connections between physicians that may lead to prescriptions for new patients. Our results therefore suggest that patient pathways play a significant role in the diffusion of a new drug.

10.1002/hec.4650.abstractZh: 当药物进入市场时，医生开药的行为在药物扩散过程中起着至关重要的作用。尽管有促进经济效率的处方规定，但医生在选择药物时仍有一定的自由，并且受到各种因素的影响。本研究的目的是探讨患者与医生之间的互动如何影响药物的扩散。我们分析了患者路径可能以两种不同方式影响医生的情况，并针对一种用于治疗心力衰竭的新药——沙库溴铵/缬沙坦，来检验这些影响。利用德国的行政数据，我们识别出在沙库溴铵/缬沙坦上市后的前两年中曾开过该药医生的名单。我们运用生存模型来估计患者与医生之间的互动对医生采用该药时间的影响。为此，我们确定了哪些医生曾治疗过曾开过沙库溴铵/缬沙坦的患者，以及有多少其他开过沙库溴铵/缬沙坦的医生在患者共享网络中建立了联系。我们的主要发现是，之前曾开过该药的患者似乎会通过要求重复处方来促使医生采用该药。此外，患者还建立了医生之间的联系，这些联系可能会促使医生为新的患者开药。因此，我们的结果表明，患者路径在新型药物的扩散过程中起着重要作用。

abstract.text: We assess the effects of socioeconomic inequity on healthcare utilization among individuals with cardiovascular diseases (CVDs) in India using the indirect standardization method with Erreygers' corrected concentration index. We analyze both horizontal and vertical inequities and linearly decompose the respective inequities to identify the major factors driving both kinds of inequities. Our findings show that actual healthcare utilization is highly concentrated among rich CVD individuals. After controlling for the confounding effects of health needs, horizontal inequity is found to be significantly pro-rich, and income and urban concentration are found to be the major factors driving this inequity. However, the direction and magnitude of vertical inequity vary, depending on the selection of the target group. When we use healthcare utilization of the richest 20 percent as the target, we find no significant vertical inequity among CVD individuals. However, when we take the richest 10 percent as the target, we observe a significant pro-rich differential effect of health needs on healthcare utilization between all individuals and the target group. Decomposition reveals an inappropriate differential effect of health needs and age in driving vertical inequity. Hence, the presence of vertical inequity may trigger further pro-rich socioeconomic inequity in healthcare utilization if not supported by any targeted healthcare coverage.

10.1002/hec.4651.abstractZh: 我们使用Erreygers修正的浓度指数通过间接标准化方法，评估了社会经济不平等对印度心血管疾病患者医疗利用的影响。我们分析了横向和纵向的不平等现象，并对其进行线性分解，以识别导致这两种不平等的主要因素。研究发现，实际的医疗利用高度集中在富裕的心血管疾病患者中。在控制了健康需求的混杂效应后，横向不平等明显有利于富人，而收入和城市集中度被认为是导致这种不平等的主要因素。然而，纵向不平等的方向和程度因目标群体的选择而异。当以最富有的20%人群作为目标时，我们没有发现显著的纵向不平等现象。但是，当以最富有的10%人群作为目标时，我们观察到健康需求对医疗利用的差别效应明显有利于富人。分解结果显示，健康需求和年龄的差别效应在导致纵向不平等方面存在不当之处。因此，如果没有针对性的医疗覆盖支持，纵向不平等可能会进一步加剧社会经济不平等，从而影响医疗利用。

abstract.text: Twenty-one U.S. states have passed recreational cannabis laws as of November 2022. Cannabis may be a substitute for prescription opioids in the treatment of chronic pain. Previous studies have assessed recreational cannabis laws' effects on opioid prescriptions financed by specific private or public payers or dispensed to a unique endpoint. Our study adds to the literature in three important ways: by (1) examining these laws' impacts on prescription opioid dispensing across all payers and endpoints, (2) adjusting for important opioid-related policies such as opioid prescribing limits, and (3) modeling opioids separately by type. We implement two-way fixed-effects regressions and leverage variation from eleven U.S. states that adopted a recreational cannabis law (RCL) between 2010 and 2019. We find that RCLs lead to a reduction in codeine dispensed at retail pharmacies. Among prescription opioids, codeine is particularly likely to be used non-medically. Thus, the finding that RCLs appear to reduce codeine dispensing is potentially promising from a public health perspective.

10.1002/hec.4652.abstractZh: 截至2022年11月，美国已有21个州通过了娱乐性大麻法律。大麻可能成为治疗慢性疼痛的处方阿片类药物的替代品。先前的研究已经评估了娱乐性大麻法律对由特定私人或公共支付机构资助的阿片类药物处方的影响，以及这些药物在何种特定情况下的使用。我们的研究从三个重要方面丰富了相关文献：（1）考察这些法律对所有支付机构和药物使用情况的冲击；（2）调整了与阿片类药物相关的政策，如阿片类药物处方限制等变量；（3）按类型单独对阿片类药物进行建模。我们采用了双向固定效应回归方法，并利用了2010至2019年间采用娱乐性大麻法律的11个美国州的数据。研究发现，娱乐性大麻法律导致零售药店中可待因的处方数量减少。在处方阿片类药物中，可待因尤其容易被用于非医疗目的。因此，娱乐性大麻法律似乎能够减少可待因的处方，这一发现从公共卫生的角度来看具有积极意义。

abstract.text: Do movies reduce stigma, increasing healthcare product choices offered by firms? We provide causal evidence on this question in the context of Indian pharmaceutical markets. For unpacking these effects, we use an exogenous shock to the market due to the release of a Bollywood blockbuster movie - My Name is Khan (MNIK) where the protagonist, superstar Shahrukh Khan, suffers from Asperger's Syndrome (AS). Using a difference-in-differences design, we find a positive and statistically significant effect of MNIK (between 14% and 22% increase in variety sold and prescribed) on product differentiation and choices in the market for antipsychotic medicines used to clinically treat AS. Results are consistent using alternative controls, a placebo treatment-based test and with a variety of other robustness checks. Our findings document likely for the first-time, supply side responses to edutainment and suggests potential associated welfare effects in healthcare markets characterized by sticky demand. Implications for global health and public policy given worldwide concerns around a mental wellness epidemic with Covid-19 are discussed.

10.1002/hec.4653.abstractZh: 电影是否可以减少污名，从而增加企业提供的医疗产品选择？我们在印度制药市场的背景下提供了关于这一问题的因果证据。为了分析这些效应，我们使用了一部宝莱坞大片《我的名字是汗》对市场造成的外生冲击——该片的主角超级巨星沙鲁克·汗患有阿斯伯格综合症。通过差异-差异设计，我们发现《我的名字是汗》对市场上用于治疗阿斯伯格综合症的抗精神病药物产品的多样性和选择产生了积极且显著的效应（销售和处方数量增加了14%至22%）。使用其他控制变量、基于安慰剂治疗的测试以及多种稳健性检验后，结果仍然一致。我们的发现首次记录了供给侧对教育娱乐内容的响应，并暗示了在具有粘性需求的医疗市场中可能产生的相关福利效应。同时，我们也讨论了在全球范围内关注心理健康问题的情况下，这对全球健康和公共政策的影响。

abstract.text: Policymakers in low and lower-middle income countries often face difficult trade-offs between saving lives and livelihoods, as exemplified by the COVID-19 pandemic. Yet, evidence regarding the preferences of the population is often lacking in such settings. In this paper, I estimate the value of an additional year of life expectancy in Tanzania using information on subjective well-being and population mortality. More specifically, I combine age-sex specific subnational estimates of remaining life expectancy with data from a representative household survey, which includes information on consumption expenditures and life satisfaction. This information is then carried forward into a life satisfaction regression to estimate the trade-off between consumption and an additional year of life expectancy. The results imply that a representative individual from the sample would be willing to trade off around 9% of their annual consumption expenditure to obtain an additional year of remaining life expectancy. The estimated values are close to those derived from calibrated models based on different elicitation methods, such as revealed preferences. This suggests that life satisfaction measures could be useful in deriving estimates of the value of longevity changes in environments where traditional methods, such as estimating compensating wage differentials, are difficult to apply.

10.1002/hec.4654.abstractZh: 低收入和较低中等收入国家的政策制定者在拯救生命与保障生计之间常常面临艰难的权衡，新冠疫情就是一个典型的例子。然而，在这种环境下，关于民众偏好的信息往往缺乏。在本文中，我利用关于主观幸福感和人口死亡率的信息，估算了坦桑尼亚额外一年预期寿命的价值。更具体地说，我结合了各地区的年龄-性别特定剩余预期寿命数据，以及来自代表性家庭调查的数据，其中包括消费支出和生活满意度信息。这些信息随后被用于生活满意度回归分析，以估算消费与额外一年预期寿命之间的权衡。结果表明，样本中的代表性个体愿意牺牲约9%的年度消费支出，以获得额外一年的预期寿命。估算出的数值与基于不同启发式方法（如揭示偏好法）的校准模型得出的数值相近。这表明，在生活满意度指标的应用下，可以较为准确地估算出在难以使用传统方法（如估算补偿工资差异）的环境中的寿命延长所带来的价值。

abstract.text: Elections permit the continuance of democracy and enable economic development, but may have unintended effects on health. By applying a two-part model with regression discontinuity design to administrative health care claims, we determine that elections increased health care use during legally specified campaign periods by as much as 19% for first-time voters. Contrary to earlier studies focusing on mental health, we find higher spending on the treatment of physical health conditions, such as acute respiratory infections, gastrointestinal conditions and injuries. Levels of medical spending during campaign periods were highest in rural areas and among low-to-middle-income men. Using data on campaign spending from local elections, we identify campaign rallies as one important mechanism for the transmission of disease. Our findings provide additional rationale for policies that limit campaign spending on the grounds that it is socially wasteful.

10.1002/hec.4655.abstractZh: 选举有助于维持民主并推动经济发展，但可能对健康产生意想不到的影响。通过应用一种包含回归不连续设计的双部分模型，我们发现选举在法律规定的竞选期间，首次投票者的医疗使用率增加了19%。与之前关注心理健康的研究不同，我们发现用于治疗身体健康状况的支出有所增加，例如急性呼吸道感染、胃肠道疾病和伤害。在竞选期间，医疗支出的水平在农村地区以及低至中等收入群体的男性中最高。利用地方选举中的竞选支出数据，我们认为竞选集会是疾病传播的一个重要途径。我们的研究结果为限制竞选支出的政策提供了额外的依据，认为这种支出在 socially 上是浪费的。

abstract.text: Healthcare systems around the world are responding with increasing urgency to rapidly evolving ecological crises, most notably climate change. This Perspective considers how health economics and health economists can best contribute to protecting health and building sustainable healthcare systems in the face of these challenges.

10.1002/hec.4656.abstractZh: 世界各地的医疗保健系统正以越来越紧迫的态度应对不断演变的生态危机，尤其是气候变化。本文探讨了健康经济学和健康经济学家如何为应对这些挑战、保护健康以及构建可持续的医疗保健系统做出最大贡献。

abstract.text: This article investigates the relationship between school openings and Covid-19 diffusion when school-age vaccination becomes available. The analysis relies on a unique geo-referenced high frequency database on age of vaccination, Covid-19 cases and hospitalization indicators from the Italian region of Sicily. The study focuses on the change of Covid-19 diffusion after school opening in a homogeneous geographical territory (i.e., with the same control measures and surveillance systems, centrally coordinated by the Regional Government). The identification of causal effects derives from a comparison of the change in cases before and after school opening in the school year 2020/21, when vaccination was not available, and in 2021/22, when the vaccination campaign targeted individuals of age 12-19 and above 19. Results indicate that, while school opening determined an increase in the growth rate of Covid-19 cases in 2020/2021, this effect has been substantially reduced by school-age vaccination in 2021/2022. In particular, we find that an increase of approximately 10% in the vaccination rate of school-age population reduces the growth rate of Covid-19 cases after school opening by approximately 1%.

10.1002/hec.4657.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在学龄儿童疫苗接种普及的情况下，学校开学时间与新冠病毒传播之间的关系。分析基于意大利西西里地区一个独特的地理参考高频数据库，该数据库包含了疫苗接种年龄、新冠病毒病例数和住院指标的数据。研究重点关注在地理上相对一致的地区（即实施相同的管控措施和监测体系，并由地方政府进行集中协调）中，学校开学后新冠病毒传播的变化情况。通过对比2020/21学年学校开学前后病例数的变化，以及2021/22学年疫苗接种针对12-19岁及以上人群的接种情况，本文确定了因果效应。研究结果表明，虽然2020/2021学年学校开学导致新冠病毒病例增长率上升，但在2021/2022学年，由于学龄儿童疫苗接种的普及，这一效应显著减弱。具体而言，学龄人口疫苗接种率增加约10%，能够使得学校开学后新冠病毒病例增长率降低约1%。

abstract.text: Concern has been expressed about including a cost attribute within discrete choice experiments (DCEs) when individuals do not have to pay at the point of consumption. We use eye tracking to investigate attention to cost when valuing publicly financed health care. One-hundred and four individuals completed a DCE concerned with preferences for UK general practitioner appointments: 51 responded to a DCE with cost included and 53 to the same DCE without cost. Eye-movements were tracked whilst respondents completed the DCE. We assessed if respondents pay attention to cost. We then compare fixation time (FT) on attributes, eye movement patterns and mental effort across the experimental groups. Results are encouraging for the inclusion of cost in DCEs valuing publicly provided healthcare. Most respondents gave visual attention to the cost attribute most of the time. Average FT on multi-attribute tasks increased by 44% in the cost DCE, with attention to non-monetary attributes increasing by 22%. Including cost led to more structured decision-making and did not increase mental effort. Acceptability of the cost attribute and difficulty of choice tasks were predictors of cost information processing, highlighting the importance of both motivating the cost attribute and considering difficulty of the tasks when developing DCEs.

10.1002/hec.4658.abstractZh: 有观点认为，在离散选择实验（DCEs）中纳入成本属性时，存在一些问题，尤其是在个体在消费时无需支付的情况下。我们使用眼动追踪技术来研究人们在评估公共资助的医疗保健时对成本的关注程度。共有104名参与者完成了这项关于英国全科医生预约偏好的DCE：51名参与者参与了包含成本的DCE，53名参与者参与了不包含成本的DCE。在参与者完成DCE的过程中，我们跟踪了他们的眼动情况。我们评估了参与者是否关注成本因素。随后，我们比较了不同实验组在属性固定时间、眼动模式以及心理努力方面的差异。结果表明，在评估公共提供的医疗保健时，将成本因素纳入DCE是可行的。大多数参与者在大部分时间都关注了成本属性。在包含成本的DCE中，多属性任务的平均固定时间增加了44%，而对非货币属性的关注度则增加了22%。将成本因素纳入DCE有助于更结构化的决策过程，并且不会增加心理负担。成本属性的可接受性和选择任务的难度是成本信息处理能力的预测因素，这强调了在开发DCE时，既要激发对成本属性的关注，也要考虑任务的难度。

abstract.text: This study examines the long-term effect of a pandemic on a crucial human capital decision, namely college major choice. Using China's 2008-2016 major-level National College Entrance Examination (Gaokao) entry grades, we find that the 2003 severe acute respiratory syndrome (SARS) had a substantial deterrent effect on the choice of majoring in medicine among high school graduates who experienced the pandemic in their childhood. In provinces with larger intensities of SARS impact, medical majors become less popular as the average Gaokao grades of enrolled students decline. Further evidence from a nationally representative survey shows that the intensity of the SARS impact significantly decreases children's aspirations to pursue medical occupations, but does not affect their parents' expectations for their children to enter the medical profession. Our discussion on the effect mechanism suggests that the adverse influence of SARS on the popularity of medical majors likely originates from students' childhood experiences.

10.1002/hec.4659.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了疫情对一项关键人力资本决策的长期影响，即大学专业选择。通过中国2008-2016年普通高等学校招生全国统一考试（Gaokao）的录取成绩数据，我们发现2003年的严重急性呼吸综合征（SARS）对童年时期经历过疫情的高中毕业生选择医学专业产生了显著的抑制作用。在SARS影响较为严重的省份，随着学生Gaokao成绩下降，医学专业的受欢迎程度也随之降低。一项全国代表性调查进一步表明，SARS的影响显著降低了儿童对医学职业的向往，但并未影响父母对孩子从事医学职业的期望。关于影响机制的分析表明，SARS对医学专业受欢迎程度的负面影响可能源于学生的童年经历。

abstract.text: This paper investigates how reopening hotels and ski facilities in Poland impacted tourism spending, mobility, and COVID-19 outcomes. We used administrative data from a government program that subsidizes travel to show that the policy increased the consumption of tourism services in ski resorts. By leveraging geolocation data from Facebook, we showed that ski resorts experienced a significant influx of tourists, increasing the number of local users by up to 50%. Furthermore, we confirmed an increase in the probability of meetings between pairs of users from distanced locations and users from tourist and non-tourist areas. As the policy impacted travel and gatherings, we then analyzed its effect on the diffusion of COVID-19. We found that counties with ski facilities experienced more infections after the reopening. Moreover, counties strongly connected to the ski resorts during the reopening had more subsequent cases than weakly connected counties.

10.1002/hec.4660.abstractZh: 本文研究了波兰酒店和滑雪设施重新开放对旅游消费、出行情况以及COVID-19疫情控制的影响。我们通过政府一项补贴旅游活动的政策的行政数据发现，该政策增加了滑雪度假区的旅游服务消费。利用Facebook的地理位置数据，我们发现滑雪度假区迎来了大量游客，当地用户数量增加了多达50%。此外，我们还发现来自远距离地区的用户与旅游区和非旅游区的用户之间会面的概率有所上升。由于该政策影响了出行和聚会活动，我们进一步分析了其对COVID-19传播的影响。研究发现，拥有滑雪设施的县在重新开放后感染人数更多。而且，在重新开放期间与滑雪度假区联系紧密的县，后续病例数量也多于联系不紧密的县。

abstract.text: Waiting times act as a non-price rationing mechanism to bring together the demand for and the supply of public healthcare services and ensure equal access independently of ability to pay. This study tests for the presence of socioeconomic inequalities in waiting times for ten publicly-funded planned and cancer surgeries in Catalonia (Spain) in 2015-2019. Socioeconomic status (SES), measured by four categories (very low, low, middle, high), is based on co-payment levels for medicines which depend on patient's income. Using administrative data, we estimate the association between SES and waiting times controlling for patient characteristics and hospital fixed effects. Compared to patients with low SES, patients with middle SES wait 2-6 fewer days for hip replacement, cataract surgery, and hysterectomy, and less than a day for breast cancer surgery. These inequalities arise within hospitals and are not explained by patient nor hospital characteristics. For some surgeries, the results also show that patients with higher SES are more likely to voluntarily exit the waiting list and have a lower probability of having a surgery canceled for medical reasons and dying while waiting.

10.1002/hec.4661.abstractZh: 等待时间作为一种非价格配给机制，能够协调公共医疗服务的需求和供应，确保无论支付能力如何，所有人都能平等获得医疗服务。本研究调查了2015-2019年间西班牙加泰罗尼亚地区十家公共资助的计划和癌症诊所的等待时间是否存在社会经济不平等现象。社会经济地位通过四个类别来衡量（极低、低、中、高），这一指标基于药品的共同支付水平，而该水平取决于患者的收入。利用行政数据，我们在控制患者特征和医院固定效应的基础上，评估了社会经济地位与等待时间之间的关联。与低社会经济地位的患者相比，中社会经济地位的患者在髋关节置换、白内障手术和子宫切除术方面的等待时间分别减少了2-6天，而乳腺癌手术的等待时间则缩短至不到一天。这些不平等现象存在于各个医院内部，且无法由患者或医院特征来解释。对于某些手术项目而言，研究还发现，高社会经济地位的患者更有可能主动退出等待名单，并且因医疗原因手术被取消或在等待期间死亡的概率也较低。

abstract.text: Can civic-minded individuals fight against a pandemic? In this paper, we show that civic capital plays an important role when assessing the level of compliance with COVID-19 vaccination recommendations. Analyzing data on a large sample of municipalities from the Italian region of Lombardy, we show that the share of vaccinated individuals is significantly higher in municipalities with higher pre-determined levels of civic capital. These findings are robust to the possibility of spatial spillovers across neighboring municipalities. Our findings contribute to the existing evidence highlighting the importance of individual contributions and civic capital as important behavioral determinants affecting the containment of infectious diseases.

10.1002/hec.4662.abstractZh: 具有公民意识的个体能否对抗疫情？本文指出，在评估人们对COVID-19疫苗接种建议的遵守程度时，公民资本起着重要作用。通过对意大利伦巴第大区大量市镇的数据进行分析，我们发现，在公民资本水平较高的市镇中，疫苗接种者的比例显著更高。这些发现不受邻近市镇之间空间溢出效应的影响。我们的研究结果进一步强调了个人贡献和公民资本作为影响传染病控制的重要行为因素的重要性。

abstract.text: We estimate the impact of temperature extremes on mortality in Vietnam, using daily data on temperatures and monthly data on mortality during the 2000-2018 period. We find that both cold and heat waves cause higher mortality, particularly among older people and those living in the hot regions in Southern Vietnam. This effect on mortality tends to be smaller in provinces with higher rates of air-conditioning and emigration, and provinces with higher public spending on health. Finally, we estimate economic cost of cold and heat waves using a framework of willingness to pay to avoid deaths, then project the cost to the year 2100 under different Representative Concentration Pathway scenarios.

10.1002/hec.4663.abstractZh: 我们利用2000至2018年期间的温度日数据和月度死亡数据，估算了极端温度对越南死亡率的影响。研究发现，无论是寒冷还是高温天气都导致更高的死亡率，尤其是老年人群体和居住在越南南部炎热地区的居民。在那些空调使用率较高、移民率较高的省份，以及公共健康支出较多的省份，这种死亡率的影响相对较小。最后，我们采用“为避免死亡而愿意支付的费用”这一框架，估算了寒冷和高温天气的经济成本，并预测了在不同代表性浓度路径情景下，到2100年的成本。

abstract.text: This study demonstrates how the linear constrained optimization approach can be used to design a health benefits package (HBP) which maximises the net disability adjusted life years (DALYs) averted given the health system constraints faced by a country, and how the approach can help assess the marginal value of relaxing health system constraints. In the analysis performed for Uganda, 45 interventions were included in the HBP in the base scenario, resulting in a total of 26.7 million net DALYs averted. When task shifting of pharmacists' and nutrition officers' tasks to nurses is allowed, 73 interventions were included in the HBP resulting in a total of 32 million net DALYs averted (a 20% increase). Further, investing only $58 towards hiring additional nutrition officers' time could avert one net DALY; this increased to $60 and $64 for pharmacists and nurses respectively, and $100,000 for expanding the consumable budget, since human resources present the main constraint to the system.

10.1002/hec.4664.abstractZh: 本研究展示了如何利用线性约束优化方法设计健康福利计划，以在考虑到国家面临的卫生系统限制的情况下，最大化避免的净伤残调整生命年数。在针对乌干达的分析中，基础情景下健康福利计划包含了45项干预措施，共避免了2660万净伤残调整生命年数。当允许将药剂师和营养官员的任务分配给护士时，健康福利计划中增加了73项干预措施，共避免了3200万净伤残调整生命年数（增加了20%）。此外，仅投资58美元用于增加营养官员的工作时间，就能避免1个净伤残调整生命年数；当投资增加到60美元和64美元时，分别能增加药剂师和护士的工作时间，而扩大消耗品预算则需要10万美元，因为人力资源是该系统的主要限制因素。

abstract.text: We study the impact of a temporary U.S. paid sick leave mandate that became effective April 1st, 2020 on self-quarantining, proxied by physical mobility behaviors gleaned from cellular devices. We study this policy using generalized difference-in-differences methods, leveraging pre-policy county-level heterogeneity in the share of workers likely eligible for paid sick leave benefits. We find that the policy leads to increased self-quarantining as proxied by staying home. We also find that COVID-19 confirmed cases decline post-policy.

10.1002/hec.4665.abstractZh: 我们研究了2020年4月1日生效的美国临时带薪病假政策对自我隔离行为的影响，该政策通过移动设备收集的数据来反映。我们使用广义差异估计方法研究这一政策，同时考虑到政策实施前各县有资格享受带薪病假福利的工人比例的差异。研究发现，该政策导致自我隔离行为增加，表现为居家时间延长。此外，我们还发现，政策实施后COVID-19确诊病例有所减少。

abstract.text: Labeled discrete choice experiments (DCEs) commonly present all alternatives using a full choice set design (FCSD), which could impose a high cognitive burden on respondents. In the setting of employment preferences, this study explored if a partial choice set design (PCSD) reduced cognitive burden whilst maintaining convergent validity compared with a FCSD. Respondents' preferences between the two designs were investigated. In the experimental design, labeled utility functions were rewritten into a single generic utility function using label dummy variables to generate an efficient PCSD with 3 alternatives shown in each choice task (out of 6). The DCE was embedded in a nationwide survey of 790 Australian pharmacy degree holders where respondents were presented with both a block of FCSD and PCSD tasks in random order. The PCSD's impact on error variances was investigated using a heteroscedastic conditional logit model. The convergent validity of PCSD was based on the equality of willingness-to-forgo-expected-salary estimates from Willingness-to-pay-space mixed logit models. A nested logit model was used combined with respondents' qualitative responses to understand respondents' design preferences. We show a promising future use of PCSD by providing evidence that PCSD can reduce cognitive burden while satisfying convergent validity compared to FCSD.

10.1002/hec.4666.abstractZh: 标记离散选择实验（DCEs）通常采用完整的选择集设计（FCSD），这可能会给受访者带来较高的认知负担。在就业偏好研究中，本研究探讨了部分选择集设计（PCSD）是否能在保持收敛效度的同时，减少认知负担。研究调查了受访者对两种设计的选择偏好。在实验设计中，标记效用函数被重新转换为单一的通用效用函数，使用标记虚拟变量来生成高效的PCSD，每个选择任务中显示3个选项（共6个）。该实验被纳入一项针对790名澳大利亚药学学位持有者的全国性调查中，受访者随机接受完整的FCSD和PCSD任务。使用异方差条件Logit模型研究了PCSD对误差方差的影响。PCSD的收敛效度基于Willingness-to-pay-space混合Logit模型中预期薪资放弃意愿估计值的相等性。结合受访者的定性反馈，使用嵌套Logit模型来理解他们的设计偏好。我们的研究表明，PCSD在未来具有广泛的应用前景，因为它能够在满足收敛效度的同时，减少认知负担。

abstract.text: This study investigates how exposure to riskier environments influences risky road behaviors, using the COVID-19 pandemic as a natural experiment. Utilizing administrative individual traffic violation records from Taipei, where neither mandatory lockdown nor mobility restrictions were imposed, we find that pandemic-induced risk decreased speeding violations and that the effect was transitory. However, no significant changes were observed concerning violations with a minimal risk of casualties, such as illegal parking. These findings suggest that experiencing a higher level of life-threatening risk discourages risky behaviors concerning human life but has little spillover effect on those concerning only financial costs.

10.1002/hec.4667.abstractZh: 本研究通过COVID-19疫情这一自然实验，探讨暴露于风险较高的环境如何影响道路上的危险行为。利用台北的行政个人交通违规记录数据，该地并未实施强制封锁或交通限制措施，我们发现疫情引发的风险降低了超速违规行为，且这种影响是暂时的。然而，对于涉及轻微人员伤亡风险的违规行为，如非法停车，并未观察到显著变化。这些发现表明，面对更高水平的生命威胁风险，人们会抑制涉及人类生命的风险行为，但对仅涉及经济成本的违规行为则几乎没有溢出效应。

abstract.text: We develop a flexible two-equation copula model to address endogeneity of medical expenditures in a distribution regression for health. The expenditure margin uses the compound gamma distribution, a special case of the Tweedie family of distributions, to account for a spike at zero and a highly skewed continuous part. An efficient estimation algorithm offers flexible choices of copulae and link functions, including logit, probit and cloglog for the health margin. Our empirical application revisits data from the Rand Health Insurance Experiment. In the joint model, using random insurance plan assignment as instrument for spending, a $1000 increase is estimated to reduce the probability of a low post-program mental health index by 1.9 percentage points. The effect is not statistically significant. Ignoring endogeneity leads to a spurious positive effect estimate.

10.1002/hec.4668.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个灵活的双方程copula模型，用于解决医疗支出在健康分布回归中的内生性问题。支出边际使用复合伽马分布作为模型基础，该分布是Tweedie分布族的一个特例，能够描述零点的尖峰现象以及高度偏态的连续部分。高效的估计算法提供了灵活的copula函数和链接函数选择，包括logit、probit和cloglog等模型。我们的实证分析采用了Rand健康保险实验的数据。在联合模型中，通过随机保险计划分配作为支出的工具变量，我们发现1000美元的支出增加可以将低后测心理健康指数的概率降低1.9个百分点。不过，这一效应在统计上并不显著。忽略内生性问题会导致一个虚假的积极效应估计。

abstract.text: We estimate the short-term effect of retirement on health in the US using the Health and Retirement Study survey. We use the nonparametric fuzzy regression discontinuity design to avoid assuming any functional form on the age-health profile and minimize potential bias in identifying the causal effect of retirement on health status in the short term. Estimates indicate an 8% decline in the cognitive functioning score of retirees and a 28% increase in the CESD depression scale. The likelihood of being in good health status declined by 16%. The transition from working to retirement has more significant negative impacts on males than females. In addition, retirement has more considerable adverse effects on less-educated individuals compared to high-educated individuals. The short-term effects of retirement on health are consistent and robust across different bandwidths, weighting kernel functions, and age-profile specifications. Moreover, the Treatment Effect Derivative test results highly support the external validity of the nonparametric estimates of the retirement effect on health.

10.1002/hec.4669.abstractZh: 我们使用“健康与退休研究”调查数据，估算了退休对美国人健康的短期影响。我们采用非参数模糊回归不连续设计方法，避免对年龄-健康状况关系假设任何函数形式，从而最大限度地减少识别退休对健康状况短期影响的潜在偏差。估计结果显示，退休人员的认知功能得分下降了8%，CESD抑郁量表上升了28%。处于良好健康状态的可能性下降了16%。从工作到退休的转变对男性的负面影响比女性更为显著。此外，与高教育水平的人相比，退休对低教育水平的人产生了更为显著的负面影响。退休对健康的短期影响在不同带宽、加权核函数以及年龄状况描述方式下都是一致且稳健的。此外，处理效应导数检验的结果高度支持了非参数方法对退休对健康影响的估计的外部有效性。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the effects of hospital volume on outcomes of patients undergoing percutaneous transluminal angioplasty (PTA) with stent implant in Slovakia between 2014 and 2019. The volume-outcome relationship is estimated jointly using a discrete factor approach, where choice of hospital is correlated with durations until readmission or death, accounting for observed and unobserved characteristics. The results reveal the importance of controlling for between-hospital differences and selectivity in patient referral. Estimates without hospital fixed effects overstate the positive effect of volume on outcomes, but the results remain statistically significant. Once selectivity is accounted for in the joint correlated model, the positive volume-outcome relationship is not different from zero. Overall, the main driver of the volume-outcome relationship for PTA procedures appears to be related to selective referral and differences in quality of health care providers.

10.1002/hec.4670.abstractZh: 本文分析了2014至2019年间斯洛伐克地区进行经皮腔内血管成形术（PTA）并植入支架的患者治疗效果与医院数量之间的关系。通过离散因子方法联合估计了数量与治疗效果之间的关系，其中医院选择与再次住院或死亡的时间长短相关联，同时考虑了已观测和未观测的特征。研究结果表明，控制医院间的差异以及患者转诊的选择性对于分析结果至关重要。在没有考虑医院固定效应的情况下，数量对治疗效果的正效应被高估了，但结果在统计上仍然显著。一旦在联合相关模型中考虑了选择性因素，数量与治疗效果之间的正关系便不再显著。总体而言，PTA手术数量与治疗效果之间的关系主要源于选择性转诊以及医疗服务提供者质量的差异。

abstract.text: The Community Mental Health Act of 1963 established Community Mental Health Centers (CMHCs) across the country with the goal of providing continuous, comprehensive, community-oriented care to people suffering from mental illness. Despite this program being considered a failure by most contemporary accounts, the World Health Organization advocates for a transition from the institutionalization of the mentally ill to a system of community-centered care. In this paper, we construct a novel dataset documenting the rollout of CMHCs from 1971 to 1981 to identify the effect of establishing a CMHC on county level mortality rates, focusing on causes of death related to mental illness. Though we find little evidence that access to a CMHC impacted mortality rates in the white population, we find large and robust effects for the non-white population, with CMHCs reducing suicide and homicide rates by 8% and 14%, respectively. CMHCs also reduced deaths from alcohol in the female non-white population by 18%. These results suggest the historical narrative surrounding the failure of this program does not represent the non-white experience and that community care can be effective at reducing mental health related mortality in populations with the least access to alternative treatment options.

10.1002/hec.4671.abstractZh: 1963年的《社区心理健康法》在全国范围内建立了社区心理健康中心，旨在为患有精神疾病的人们提供持续、全面、以社区为中心的护理服务。尽管大多数当代观点认为这一计划失败了，但世界卫生组织倡导从对精神疾病患者的机构化护理转向以社区为中心的护理体系。在本文中，我们构建了一个新的数据集，记录了1971年至1981年间社区心理健康中心的设立情况，以分析其对于县级死亡率的影响，重点关注与精神疾病相关的死亡原因。虽然我们发现几乎没有证据表明社区心理健康中心的设立对白人人口的死亡率产生了影响，但我们发现对非白人人口而言，这一计划产生了显著的效果：社区心理健康中心使自杀和凶杀率分别降低了8%和14%。此外，社区心理健康中心还使非白人女性人口的酒精相关死亡人数减少了18%。这些结果表明，关于该计划失败的历史叙述并不反映非白人群体的实际情况，而以社区为中心的护理方式确实能够在那些获得替代治疗机会较少的人群中有效降低与心理健康相关的死亡率。

abstract.text: Studying quasi-experimental data from French hospitals from 2010 to 2013, we test the effects of a substantial diagnosis-related group (DRG) tariff refinement that occurred in 2012, designed to reduce financial risks of French maternity wards. To estimate the resulting DRG incentives with regard to the choice between scheduled C-sections and other modes of child delivery, we predict, based on pre-admission patient characteristics, the probability of each possible child delivery outcome and calculate expected differences in associated tariffs. Using patient-level administrative data, we find that introducing additional severity levels and clinical factors into the reimbursement algorithm had no significant effect on the probability of a scheduled C-section being performed. The results are robust to multiple formulations of DRG financial incentives. Our paper is the first study that focuses on the consequences of a DRG refinement in obstetrics and develops a probabilistic approach suitable for measuring the expected effects of DRG fee incentives in the presence of multiple tariff groups.

10.1002/hec.4672.abstractZh: 本研究分析了2010至2013年间法国医院的准实验数据，旨在评估2012年实施的重大诊断相关分组（DRG）费率调整措施的影响。该调整旨在降低法国产科病房的经济风险。为了评估DRG费率调整对剖宫产与其他分娩方式选择的影响，我们根据入院前患者的特征预测了各种分娩结果的概率，并计算了相关费率的预期差异。通过患者层面的行政数据分析，我们发现将额外的严重程度等级和临床因素纳入报销算法，并未显著影响剖宫产手术实施的概率。这些结果在多种DRG财务激励方案下依然保持稳定。本文是首个关注DRG调整对产科影响的实证研究，并提出了一种适用于评估多种费率分组下DRG费用激励预期效果的概率分析方法。

abstract.text: Government investment in preparing for pandemics has never been more relevant. The COVID-19 pandemic has stimulated debate regarding the trade-offs societies are prepared to make between health and economic activity. What is not known is: (1) how much the public in different countries are prepared to pay in forgone GDP to avoid mortality from future pandemics; and (2) which health and economic policies the public in different countries want their government to invest in to prepare for and respond to the next pandemic. Using a future-focused, multi-national discrete choice experiment, we quantify these trade-offs and find that the tax-paying public is prepared to pay $3.92 million USD (Canada), $4.39 million USD (UK), $5.57 million USD (US) and $7.19 million USD (Australia) in forgone GDP per death avoided in the next pandemic. We find the health policies that taxpayers want to invest in before the next pandemic and the economic policies they want activated once the next pandemic hits are relatively consistent across the countries, with some exceptions. Such results can inform economic policy responses and government investment in health policies to reduce the adverse impacts of the next pandemic.

10.1002/hec.4673.abstractZh: 政府在应对大流行病方面的投资从未如此重要。COVID-19大流行引发了关于社会在健康与经济活动之间需要做出的权衡的辩论。目前尚不清楚的是：(1)不同国家的公众愿意为避免未来大流行病导致的死亡而牺牲多少GDP；(2)不同国家的公众希望政府投资于哪些健康和经济政策，以便为应对下一次大流行做好准备。通过一项以未来为导向的多国离散选择实验，我们量化了这些权衡，发现纳税公众愿意为在下次大流行中避免每例死亡而牺牲的GDP分别为：加拿大395万美元、英国439万美元、美国557万美元和澳大利亚719万美元。我们发现，纳税人在下一次大流行之前希望政府投资的健康政策，以及在大流行发生后希望实施的经济政策，在不同国家之间相对一致，但也有一些例外。这些结果可以为经济政策响应和政府在健康政策上的投资提供参考，以减少下一次大流行的负面影响。

abstract.text: This paper examines the significance of physician agency in medical providers' prescription choices. Physician agency is considered as medical providers' responses to the price and markup percentage of prescription drugs. Their preferences are allowed to be heterogeneous using a random coefficient logit model. Using a sample of anti-diabetic prescriptions with metformin from a population-based database in Taiwan, empirical results reveal that physician owners, privately-owned medical providers, small medical providers and the medical providers facing less competition are more likely to prescribe drugs with higher profit margins. The aggregate pharmaceutical demand is also found to increase with the markup, which is allowed to be endogenous in the estimation. Price elasticity estimates suggest medical providers are quite responsive to pharmaceutical price changes in Taiwan. Counterfactual analysis reveals the potential impact of physician agency is economically significant. Removing markups and lowering pharmaceutical prices are found to be more welfare enhancing than restricting physicians' dispensing services.

10.1002/hec.4674.abstractZh: 本文探讨了医生代理在医疗服务提供者处方选择中的重要性。医生代理被视为医疗服务提供者对处方药价格和加价百分比的响应。通过随机系数Logit模型，允许医生的偏好具有异质性。以台湾一个基于人口的数据库中包含二甲双胍的糖尿病处方样本为例，实证结果显示，拥有私人诊所的医疗服务提供者、小型医疗服务提供者以及竞争较小的医疗服务提供者更有可能开具利润更高的药物。此外，随着加价率的上升，整体药品需求也有所增加，且加价率在估计过程中被视作内生变量。价格弹性估计表明，在台湾，医疗服务提供者对药品价格变化反应迅速。反事实分析显示，医生代理的潜在影响在经济上具有重要意义。消除加价并降低药品价格，比限制医生的处方服务更能提升福利水平。

abstract.text: A large fraction of people in East Asia are incapable of digesting alcohol because of a genetic deficiency. This study examines whether the variation in alcohol tolerance contributes to inequality in the labor market. We conduct our original surveys in Japan, Taiwan, and Korea with the measurement of respondents' degree of alcohol tolerance by a bio-marker test. We find that alcohol-tolerant men consume significantly more alcohol, but their earnings and hours worked do not differ from those of alcohol-intolerant men. Despite a prevalent view that drinking alcohol is indispensable to establish good relationships with colleagues and business partners, our results suggest that there is no systematic impact of alcohol tolerance on labor market outcomes.

10.1002/hec.4675.abstractZh: 东亚地区有很大一部分人由于基因缺陷而无法消化酒精。本研究探讨了酒精耐受性的差异是否会导致劳动力市场的不平等。我们在日本、台湾和韩国进行了初步调查，通过生物标志物测试来测量受访者的酒精耐受程度。我们发现，能够耐受酒精的男性饮酒量明显更多，但他们的收入和工作时间与不能耐受酒精的男性并无差异。尽管普遍认为饮酒对于与同事和商业伙伴建立良好的关系至关重要，但我们的研究结果表明，酒精耐受性对劳动力市场结果并没有系统性影响。

abstract.text: This paper assesses whether Brazilian primary health care is worth it in the long-run by estimating the accumulated costs and benefits of its flagship, the Family Health Strategy program (ESF). We employ an alternative strategy centered on years of exposure to the program to incorporate its dynamics. We also account for the program's heterogeneity with respect to the remuneration of ESF health teams and the intensity of coverage across Brazilian municipalities, measure by the number of people assisted by each ESF team, on average. To address heterogeneity in professional earnings, this paper employs, for the first time, a dataset containing the remuneration of professionals allocated to all ESF teams nationwide. The benefits are measured by the avoided deaths and hospitalizations due to causes sensitive to primary care. Results suggest that the net monetary benefit of the program is positive on average, with an optimum time of exposure of approximately 16 years. Significant heterogeneities in cost-benefit results were found since costs outweigh benefits in localities where the coverage is low intensive. On the other hand, the benefits outweigh the costs by 22.5% on average in municipalities with high intensive coverage.

10.1002/hec.4676.abstractZh: 本文通过估算巴西初级卫生保健计划的累积成本和收益，来评估其长期价值。我们采用了一种基于项目实施年限的替代策略，以反映项目的动态变化。同时，我们还考虑了项目在报酬分配和覆盖强度方面的异质性，后者通过每个ESF团队平均服务的患者数量来衡量。为了解决专业报酬的异质性问题，本文首次使用了包含全国所有ESF团队专业报酬数据的数据集。收益通过避免因初级卫生保健相关原因导致的死亡和住院次数来衡量。研究结果表明，该项目的净货币收益平均为正，最佳实施年限约为16年。研究发现，在覆盖强度较低的地区，成本高于收益；而在覆盖强度较高的市镇，收益平均超过成本22.5%。

abstract.text: Most evidence on Performance Based Financing (PBF) in low-income settings has focused on services delivered by providers in targeted health administrations, with limited understanding of how effects on health and care vary within them. We evaluated the population effects of a program implemented in two provinces in Mozambique, focusing on child, maternal and HIV/AIDS care and knowledge. We used a difference-in-difference estimation strategy applied to data on mothers from the Demographic Health Surveys, linked to information on their closest health facility. The impact of PBF was limited. HIV testing during antenatal care increased, particularly for women who were wealthier, more educated, or residing in Gaza Province. Knowledge about transmission of HIV from mother-to-child, and its prevention, increased, particularly for women who were less wealthy, less educated, or residing in Nampula Province. Exploiting the roll-out by facility, we found that the effects were concentrated on less wealthy and less educated women, whose closest facility was in the referral network of a PBF facility. Results suggest that HIV testing and knowledge promotion increased in the whole district, as a strategy to boost referral for highly incentivized HIV services delivered in PBF facilities. However, demand-side constraints may prevent the use of those services.

10.1002/hec.4677.abstractZh: 关于基于绩效的融资在低收入地区的应用研究，大多集中在目标卫生行政机构提供的服务上，对于这些政策对健康和护理的影响在不同地区的具体表现了解有限。我们评估了在莫桑比克两个省份实施的一项计划对人口的影响，重点关注儿童、孕产妇以及HIV/AIDS相关护理和知识方面的变化。我们采用了差异估计方法，利用人口健康调查中的母亲数据，并结合她们最近的医疗设施信息进行分析。结果发现，基于绩效的融资的影响有限。在产前护理期间进行HIV检测的情况有所增加，尤其是在经济条件较好、教育水平较高或居住在加扎省的女性中。关于母亲向子女传播HIV及其预防的知识也有所增加，尤其是在经济条件较差、教育水平较低或居住在南普拉省的女性中。通过设施层面的分析，我们发现这些影响主要集中在经济条件较差、教育水平较低的女性身上，她们最近的医疗设施位于基于绩效的融资设施的服务网络内。研究结果表明，HIV检测知识和知识推广在整个地区都有所增加，这被视为促进在基于绩效的融资设施中提供的高度激励性HIV服务的策略。然而，需求方面的限制可能阻碍这些服务的使用。

abstract.text: Previous studies have found a link between economic conditions, such as recessions and unemployment, and cardiovascular disease as well as other health outcomes. More recent research argues that economic uncertainty-independently of unemployment-can affect health outcomes. Using data from England and Wales, we study the association between fluctuations in economic uncertainty and cardiovascular disease mortality in the short term for the period 2001-2019. Controlling for several economic indicators (including unemployment), we find that economic uncertainty alone is strongly associated with deaths attributed to diseases of the circulatory system, ischemic heart disease and cerebrovascular disease. Our findings highlight the short-term link between economic conditions and cardiovascular health and reveal yet another health outcome that is associated with uncertainty.

10.1002/hec.4678.abstractZh: 先前的研究发现，经济状况，如经济衰退和失业，与心血管疾病以及其他健康结果之间存在关联。最近的研究则认为，经济不确定性——无论是否伴随失业——都可能影响健康结果。我们利用英格兰和威尔士的数据，研究了2001-2019年期间经济不确定性波动与心血管疾病死亡率之间的短期关联。在控制了一些经济指标（包括失业）后，我们发现经济不确定性本身与循环系统疾病、缺血性心脏病和脑血管疾病导致的死亡之间存在强烈关联。我们的研究结果强调了经济状况与心血管健康之间的短期联系，并揭示了与经济不确定性相关的另一项健康结果。

abstract.text: Dementia prevalence is projected to rise steeply in coming decades, producing tremendous burdens on families, and health and social services. Motivated by the need for further robust evidence on modifiable risk factors, we investigate the relationship between cognitive activity at work and later-life dementia. Using data from the US Health and Retirement Study matched to the O*NET occupational database, we find that a one standard deviation increase in the cognitive activity associated with one's longest held occupation is associated with a 0.9 percentage point reduction in (predicted) dementia, or a 24% reduction relative to the mean. This relationship is consistently found across model specifications and robustness tests. When controlling for individual fixed-effects we find that the association between dementia and work cognitive activity increases with age. Overall, our results provide some evidence in support of the inclusion of cognitive activity at work as a recognized modifiable risk factor for dementia.

10.1002/hec.4679.abstractZh: 预计在未来几十年内，痴呆症的患病率将急剧上升，给家庭、医疗卫生和社会服务带来巨大负担。鉴于需要更多关于可改变风险因素的可靠证据，我们研究了工作期间的认知活动与晚年痴呆症之间的关系。通过美国健康与退休研究的数据与O*NET职业数据库进行匹配，我们发现，与最长工作年限相关的认知活动每增加一个标准差，痴呆症的预测发病率就会降低0.9个百分点，相对于平均水平而言，减少了24%。这种关系在多种模型设定和稳健性检验中均得到一致验证。在控制个体固定效应后，我们发现痴呆症与工作期间的认知活动之间的关联随年龄增长而增强。总体而言，我们的研究结果为将工作期间的认知活动视为痴呆症的可改变风险因素提供了一些支持。

abstract.text: Several Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development countries have constrained Disability Income Insurance (DI) eligibility and reassessed those on DI to encourage workforce participation. But these policies can also have unintended consequences. While receiving less income can directly worsen physical and mental health, the stress related to reassessment and the possibility of losing DI may also adversely affect mental health. This paper uses Australian population-wide administrative data to explore how a 2014 policy - where DI recipients under 35 were reassessed under stricter criteria - affected healthcare use. We exploit this age targeting using a difference-in-difference regression design and find that the policy increased nervous system drug prescriptions (which includes antidepressants). Our findings suggest that the reassessment of DI recipients, even without income loss, may have had a significant negative impact on their mental health. DI reassessment policies may have the unintended consequence of worsening mental health and this needs be considered when deciding if reassessment is worthwhile.

10.1002/hec.4680.abstractZh: 一些经济合作与发展组织国家限制了残疾收入保险（DI）的资格认定，并对符合条件的被保险人进行了重新评估，以鼓励劳动力参与。但这些政策也可能产生意想不到的后果。虽然减少收入可能会直接恶化身体和心理健康，但重新评估带来的压力以及失去残疾收入保险的可能性也可能对心理健康产生不利影响。本文利用澳大利亚全国性的行政数据，探讨了2014年的一项政策——即35岁以下的残疾收入保险受益人需按照更严格的标准进行重新评估——对医疗使用的影响。通过差异回归设计，我们发现该政策增加了神经系统药物的处方量（包括抗抑郁药）。我们的研究结果表明，即使没有收入损失，对残疾收入保险受益人的重新评估也可能对其心理健康产生显著的负面影响。残疾收入保险重新评估政策可能会无意中恶化心理健康状况，因此在决定是否值得进行重新评估时需要考虑到这一点。

abstract.text: To help health economic modelers respond to demands for greater use of complex systems models in public health. To propose identifiable features of such models and support researchers to plan public health modeling projects using these models. A working group of experts in complex systems modeling and economic evaluation was brought together to develop and jointly write guidance for the use of complex systems models for health economic analysis. The content of workshops was informed by a scoping review. A public health complex systems model for economic evaluation is defined as a quantitative, dynamic, non-linear model that incorporates feedback and interactions among model elements, in order to capture emergent outcomes and estimate health, economic and potentially other consequences to inform public policies. The guidance covers: when complex systems modeling is needed; principles for designing a complex systems model; and how to choose an appropriate modeling technique. This paper provides a definition to identify and characterize complex systems models for economic evaluations and proposes guidance on key aspects of the process for health economics analysis. This document will support the development of complex systems models, with impact on public health systems policy and decision making.

10.1002/hec.4681.abstractZh: 为了帮助健康经济模型构建者应对在公共卫生领域更广泛使用复杂系统模型的需求，本文提出了这类模型的可识别特征，并支持研究人员利用这些模型规划公共卫生建模项目。一个由复杂系统建模和经济评估领域的专家组成的工作组被召集起来，共同编写了关于在健康经济分析中使用复杂系统模型的指南。研讨会的内容基于一项范围审查。经济评估用的公共卫生复杂系统模型被定义为一种定量、动态、非线性的模型，它包含模型元素之间的反馈和相互作用，以捕捉出现的结果，并估算健康、经济及其他可能的后果，从而为公共政策提供信息。该指南涵盖了：何时需要复杂系统建模；设计复杂系统模型的原则；以及如何选择适当的建模技术。本文提供了识别和描述用于经济评估的复杂系统模型的定义，并提出了关于健康经济分析过程中关键方面的指导。该文件将支持复杂系统模型的发展，对公共卫生系统政策与决策制定产生积极影响。

abstract.text: Who enrolled in Medicaid as a consequence of the Affordable Care Act (ACA)? Using the 2010-2017 American Community Survey, I estimate how characteristics relating to work status and race/ethnicity affect the probability that an individual will be a complier, defined as those induced by the ACA Medicaid expansion to obtain Medicaid coverage. Across all states, I find that part-time workers, not non-workers, are the most likely to be compliers. This finding is not consistent with certain notions that Medicaid participants are the "undeserving poor" - a sentiment that may have hindered efforts to expand Medicaid in certain states. Additionally, I find that in non-expansion states, many of which have high Black populations, the probability of being a complier is higher for Blacks than for other racial/ethnic groups, suggesting that Black people in non-expansion states would be the largest beneficiaries of any new expansions. This paper not only identifies the types of individuals who were already impacted by the expansion but also identifies which populations would benefit the most from subsequent expansions.

10.1002/hec.4682.abstractZh: 根据《平价医疗法案》，哪些人加入了医疗补助计划？通过2010-2017年的美国社区调查，我估计了与工作状态和种族/族裔相关的特征如何影响个人成为医疗补助计划参与者的可能性。在所有州中，我发现非全职工作者比全职工作者更有可能成为医疗补助计划参与者。这一发现与某些观点不符，某些观点认为医疗补助计划参与者是“不值得的穷人”——这种观念可能阻碍了某些州扩大医疗补助计划的努力。此外，我发现在非扩展州，尤其是黑人人口较多的州，黑人成为医疗补助计划参与者的可能性高于其他种族/族裔群体，这表明非扩展州中的黑人将是任何新扩展计划的最大受益者。本文不仅指出了那些已经受到医疗补助计划影响的人群，还指出了哪些人群将从后续扩展计划中获益最多。

abstract.text: Non-communicable diseases (NCDs) disproportionately affect people in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), yet context-specific evidence on policies that impact NCD risk factors is lacking. We estimate the impact of a massive Indonesian primary school expansion program in the 1970s on NCD risk factors in later life using data from two surveys with very large sample sizes. We find that in non-Java regions of Indonesia, the program led to significant increases in the likelihood of overweight and high waist circumference among women, but not among men. The increase for women can be partly explained by increased consumption of high-calorie packaged and take-away meals. We find no meaningful impacts on high blood pressure for either sex. Despite the increase in body weight, the program had a negligible impact on diabetes and cardiovascular disease diagnosis. It led to an improvement in women's self-reported health outcomes in their early-40s, but these benefits largely disappeared once they reached their mid-40s.

10.1002/hec.4683.abstractZh: 非传染性疾病（NCDs）对低收入和中等收入国家的人们的影响尤为严重，然而关于影响NCD风险因素的政策的特定情境证据却十分缺乏。我们利用两项样本量非常大的调查数据，估算了20世纪70年代印度尼西亚大规模小学扩张计划对后期NCD风险因素的影响。研究发现，在印度尼西亚的非爪哇地区，该计划显著增加了女性超重和高腰围的可能性，而男性则没有出现类似情况。女性体重增加的这一现象部分可以归因于高热量包装食品和外卖食品的消费增加。我们发现，该计划对高血压的影响并不显著。尽管体重有所增加，但该计划对糖尿病和心血管疾病诊断的影响微乎其微。该计划使女性在40岁出头的时期自我报告的健康状况有所改善，但这些益处在她们达到40岁中期后基本消失。

abstract.text: The negative impact of health-related out-of-pocket (OOP) payments is a well-known problem in low and middle-income countries (LMICs). Cross-sectional analysis reveals that households use different coping mechanisms to mitigate or overcome the effect of OOP payments, but little is known from a longitudinal perspective. We explore this link using panel data for Colombia, Mexico, India, Malawi, Nigeria, Uganda, and Tanzania. Using a fixed-effect model, we computed the association between multidimensional poverty (MP) and facing catastrophic health payments (CHP) using a capacity-to-pay approach. We estimated different heterogeneous effects, including variables such as area of residence, facing CHP, being poor in the first wave, and facing CHP in period two. While using cross-sectional data, we found that the association between CHP and MP is present for six of the seven countries; it is not the case for the time variation in most of them. The results provide evidence that OOP induce a long-term impact on MP only in Colombia, India and Nigeria. In the last two countries, the levels of poverty and CHP were the highest of all seven, and the association between both situations was found by using different poverty cutoffs and thresholds to define CHP.

10.1002/hec.4684.abstractZh: 与健康相关的自付费用所带来的负面影响是低收入和中等收入国家普遍存在的问题。横断面分析显示，各家庭采用不同的应对机制来减轻或克服自付费用的影响，但从纵向角度来看，这方面的研究却很少。我们利用哥伦比亚、墨西哥、印度、马拉维、尼日利亚、乌干达和坦桑尼亚的面板数据来探讨这一关系。通过固定效应模型，我们计算了多维贫困与面临灾难性健康费用之间的关联，并采用了支付能力方法来分析。我们估计了不同的异质效应，包括居住地区、是否面临健康费用、是否处于贫困阶段以及在第二阶段是否面临健康费用等变量。虽然使用的是横断面数据，但我们发现在七个国家中，有六个国家的CHP与MP之间存在关联；而在大多数国家，这种关联并不随时间变化。研究结果表明，自付费用仅在哥伦比亚、印度和尼日利亚对MP产生长期影响。在最后两个国家，贫困程度和CHP的水平都是最高的，通过使用不同的贫困标准和阈值来定义CHP，我们发现了这两种情况之间的关联。

abstract.text: Discrete choice models are almost exclusively estimated assuming random utility maximization (RUM) is the decision rule applied by individuals. Recent studies indicate alternative behavioral assumptions may be more appropriate in health. Decision field theory (DFT) is a psychological theory of decision-making, which has shown promise in transport research. This study introduces DFT to health economics, empirically comparing it to RUM and random regret minimization (RRM) in risky health settings, namely tobacco and vaccine choices. Model fit, parameter ratios, choice shares, and elasticities are compared between RUM, RRM and DFT. Test statistics for model differences are derived using bootstrap methods. Decision rule heterogeneity is investigated using latent class models, including novel latent class DFT models. Tobacco and vaccine choice data are better explained with DFT than with RUM or RRM. Parameter ratios, choice shares and elasticities differ significantly between models. Mixed results are found for the presence of decision rule heterogeneity. We conclude that DFT shows promise as a behavioral assumption that underpins the estimation of discrete choice models in health economics. The significant differences demonstrate that care should be taken when choosing a decision rule, but further evidence is needed for generalizability beyond risky health choices.

10.1002/hec.4685.abstractZh: 离散选择模型几乎总是假设个体遵循随机效用最大化决策规则来进行估计。最近的研究表明，在健康领域，采用其他行为假设可能更为合适。决策领域理论是一种决策心理学理论，在交通研究方面已显示出潜力。本研究将决策领域理论引入健康经济学领域，通过实证比较其在风险性健康决策中的表现，例如烟草和疫苗选择。比较了随机效用最大化、随机后悔最小化以及决策领域理论在不同模型下的拟合度、参数比例、选择份额和弹性。使用自助法推导了模型差异的检验统计量。通过潜在类别模型研究了决策规则的非均匀性，包括新型潜在类别决策领域理论模型。与随机效用最大化或随机后悔最小化相比，决策领域理论在解释烟草和疫苗选择数据方面更为有效。不同模型之间的参数比例、选择份额和弹性存在显著差异。对于决策规则非均匀性的存在，研究结果具有混合性。我们得出结论，决策领域理论作为支撑健康经济学中离散选择模型估计的行为假设，具有很大的潜力。这些显著差异表明，在选择决策规则时需要谨慎，但还需要更多证据来验证其适用范围是否超出风险性健康决策领域。

abstract.text: Diagnosis-related group (DRG) hospital reimbursement systems differentiate cases into cost-homogenous groups based on patient characteristics. However, exogenous organizational and regional factors can influence hospital costs beyond case-mix differences. Therefore, most countries using DRG systems incorporate adjustments for such factors into their reimbursement structure. This study investigates structural hospital attributes that explain differences in average case-mix adjusted hospital costs in Switzerland. Using rich patient and hospital-level data containing 4 million cases from 120 hospitals across 3 years, we show that a regression model using only five variables (number of discharges, ratio of emergency/ambulance admissions, rate of DRGs to patients, expected loss potential based on DRG mix, and location in large agglomeration) can explain more than half of the variance in average case-mix adjusted hospital costs, capture all cost variations across commonly differentiated hospital types (e.g., academic teaching hospitals, children's hospitals, birth centers, etc.), and is robust in cross-validations across several years (despite differing hospital samples). Based on our findings, we propose a simple practical approach to differentiate legitimate from inefficiency-related or unexplainable cost differences across hospitals and discuss the potential of such an approach as a transparent way to incorporate structural hospital differences into cost benchmarking and payment schemes.

10.1002/hec.4686.abstractZh: 诊断相关分组（DRG）医院报销系统根据患者特征将病例划分为成本相近的组。然而，外部的组织和地区因素也可能影响医院成本，而这些因素并不受病例组合差异的影响。因此，大多数使用DRG系统的国家会在其报销结构中加入对这些因素的调整。本研究探讨了在瑞士，能够解释平均病例组合调整后医院成本差异的结构性医院属性。我们利用包含120家医院3年数据、共400万例病例的丰富患者和医院级数据，发现仅使用五个变量（出院数量、急诊/救护车入院比例、DRG与患者数量比、基于DRG组合的预期损失潜力以及所在大型聚集区位置）的回归模型可以解释平均病例组合调整后医院成本差异的一半以上，能够涵盖不同医院类型之间的所有成本差异（例如，学术教学医院、儿童医院、分娩中心等），并且在多个年份的跨验证中仍然具有稳健性（尽管医院样本有所不同）。基于我们的研究结果，我们提出了一种简单实用的方法，用于区分医院之间因效率低下或无法解释的原因而产生的成本差异，并讨论了这种方法作为将结构性医院差异纳入成本基准和支付方案的透明方式的潜力。

abstract.text: This study offers insights into lifetime earnings growth differences between individuals with and without childhood-onset disabilities (COD) defined as disabilities whose onset occurred before an individual's 16th birthday. We use a newly available database linking data from the 2017 Canadian Survey of Disability with individual income tax records covering a period of over 3 decades. We estimate the average earnings growth profiles of individuals with COD from the age when individuals generally enter the labor market to the age when most retire. The main finding of our study is that individuals with COD experience very little earnings growth when they are in their mid-30 and 40s while the earnings of those without COD grow steadily until they reach their late 40s and early 50s. The largest earnings growth differences between individuals with and without COD are observed for male university graduates.

10.1002/hec.4687.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了有童年期发病残疾（COD）与无此类残疾个体之间的终身收入增长差异。COD是指那些在16岁生日前发病的残疾。我们利用了2017年加拿大残疾调查数据的新数据库，该数据库包含了超过30年的个人收入税记录。我们估算了有COD的个体从一般进入劳动力市场到大多数退休的年龄期间的平均收入增长情况。研究的主要发现是，有COD的个体在30多岁和40多岁时收入增长非常缓慢，而无COD的个体的收入则稳步增长，直到40多岁末和50岁初。在有COD与无COD的个体之间，收入增长的最大差异出现在男性大学毕业生身上。

abstract.text: Using Swedish data on a cohort born in 1953, interviewed in 1966 (age 13), and followed with register data until 2018 (age 65), this study shows that one more year of schooling predicts a 17% lower risk of early mortality. Addressing concerns of potential selection bias, the mortality inequality by educational attainment persists when extensive controls are included in the regression. Adding information on background health, gender, socioeconomic variables, as well as adolescents' early educational plans, cognitive ability, and time preferences, only result in a 2-percentage point change in the mortality risk by years of education. Even when adolescents' applications to upper-secondary school and years 6 and 9 grades are controlled for, completion of upper-secondary and university education remain strong predictors of future health. Yet, the study also finds that the measure of future health matters for the stability of the results.

10.1002/hec.4688.abstractZh: 本研究利用瑞典的数据，对1953年出生、1966年（13岁）接受采访，并持续跟踪至2018年（65岁）的群体进行了分析。结果显示，多上一年教育年限可显著降低17%的早死风险。在纳入了广泛的控制变量后，教育程度与死亡率之间的不平等关系仍然存在。此外，若加入背景健康、性别、社会经济变量，以及青少年的早期教育计划、认知能力和时间偏好等变量，仅会导致教育年限与死亡率之间的风险差异增加2个百分点。即使控制了青少年升入高中及六年级和九年级的情况，高中毕业和大学教育完成情况仍是对未来健康的强有力预测因素。不过，研究也发现，未来健康的衡量方式对结果的稳定性具有重要影响。

abstract.text: We study how competition between physicians affects the provision of medical care. In our theoretical model, physicians are faced with a heterogeneous patient population, in which patients systematically vary with regard to both their responsiveness to the provided quality of care and their state of health. We test the behavioral predictions derived from this model in a controlled laboratory experiment. In line with the model, we observe that competition significantly improves patient benefits as long as patients are able to respond to the quality provided. For those patients, who are not able to choose a physician, competition even decreases the patient benefit compared to a situation without competition. This decrease is in contrast to our theoretical prediction implying no change in benefits for passive patients. Deviations from patient-optimal treatment are highest for passive patients in need of a low quantity of medical services. With repetition, both, the positive effects of competition for active patients as well as the negative effects of competition for passive patients become more pronounced. Our results imply that competition can not only improve but also worsen patient outcome and that patients' responsiveness to quality is decisive.

10.1002/hec.4689.abstractZh: 我们研究了医生之间的竞争如何影响医疗服务的提供。在我们的理论模型中，医生面对的是异质性的患者群体，这些患者在对医疗服务质量的响应能力以及健康状况方面都存在系统性差异。我们在一项受控实验室实验中验证了该模型所预测的行为结果。与模型预测一致，我们发现只要患者能够响应所提供的服务质量，竞争显著提升了患者的收益。对于那些无法选择医生的患者来说，竞争甚至会导致患者收益下降，这与我们的理论预测相反，后者认为被动患者收益不会发生变化。对于需要少量医疗服务的被动患者而言，治疗与最优情况的偏差最大。随着实验的重复进行，对于主动患者而言，竞争的积极效应会变得更加明显，而对于被动患者而言，竞争的负面效应则会更加突出。我们的研究结果表明，竞争不仅可能改善，也可能恶化患者的治疗效果，而患者对服务质量的反应能力是至关重要的。

abstract.text: SARS-CoV-2 vaccines give rise to positive externalities on population health, society and the economy in addition to protecting the health of vaccinated individuals. Hence, the social value of such a vaccine exceeds its market value. This paper estimates the willingness to pay (WTP) for a hypothetical SARS-CoV-2 vaccine (or shadow prices), in four countries, namely the United States (US), the United Kingdom, Spain and Italy during the first wave of the pandemic when COVID-19 vaccines were in development but not yet approved. WTP estimates are elicited using a payment card method to avoid "yea saying" biases, and we study the effect of protest responses, sample selection bias, as well as the influence of trust in government and risk exposure when estimating the WTP. Our estimates suggest evidence of an average value of a hypothetical vaccine of 100-200 US dollars once adjusted for purchasing power parity. Estimates are robust to a number of checks.

10.1002/hec.4690.abstractZh: SARS-CoV-2疫苗除了能够保护接种者的健康外，还对人群健康、社会和经济产生了积极的外部效应。因此，这种疫苗的社会价值超过了其市场价值。本文估算了在疫情第一波期间，即COVID-19疫苗正在研发但尚未获批时，四个国家——美国、英国、西班牙和意大利——人们对假设性SARS-CoV-2疫苗的支付意愿（WTP），以及相应的影子价格。估算过程中采用了支付卡方法，以避免“肯定回答”偏差，同时我们还研究了抗议反应、样本选择偏差，以及信任政府和风险暴露对支付意愿的影响。我们的估算结果显示，假设性疫苗的平均支付意愿为100-200美元，这一数值在调整了购买力平价后仍然保持稳定。这些估算结果在多种检验下均表现出稳健性。

abstract.text: The sudden and jumping interest rate in the early 1980s triggered a severe economic crisis in the US agriculture sector. To identify the effects of wealth losses on the health condition of cohorts born in the midst of the crisis, this paper constructs an instrumental variable for wealth by exploiting the geographic variation in crop production and the timing of the shock. This study finds that wealth losses generates long-lasting health impacts for these newborns. A one percent wealth loss leads to an approximately 0.008 and 0.003 percentage point increase in the low and very low birth weight rates, respectively. In addition, cohorts growing up in areas of greater impacts have worse self-reported health condition before age 17 than others. They also have more metabolic-syndrome issues and smoke more regularly than other cohorts in adulthood. Lower expenditures on food and prenatal care might explain the negative health effects on cohorts born during the crisis. The study shows that households in areas with greater wealth losses have more declining expenditures on food at home and prenatal-care doctor visits.

10.1002/hec.4691.abstractZh: 20世纪80年代初，利率的突然和剧烈波动引发了美国农业部门的严重经济危机。为了了解财富损失对危机期间出生的群体健康状况的影响，本文通过利用作物生产的地理差异以及冲击发生的时间，构建了一个关于财富的工具变量。研究发现，财富损失对这些新生儿的健康产生了长期影响。财富损失每增加1%，低出生体重率和极低出生体重率分别增加约0.008和0.003个百分点。此外，成长在受影响较大的地区的群体在17岁之前的自报健康状况比其他群体更差。他们在成年后还面临更多的代谢综合征问题，并且吸烟频率也高于其他群体。在危机期间出生的群体，较低的食品支出和产前护理支出可能解释了其负面的健康影响。研究表明，财富损失较大的家庭在食品支出和产前护理方面的支出下降幅度更大。

abstract.text: This study measures the differences in access to healthcare for female patients in France in three medical specialties (dentistry, gynecology and psychiatry) according to two criteria: the African ethnicity of the patient and the benefit of having means-tested health insurance coverage. To this purpose, we conducted a nationally representative field experiment on more than 1500 physicians. We do not find substantial discrimination against the patient of African origin. However, the results indicate that patients with means-tested health insurance coverage are less likely to get an appointment. Differentiating between two types of coverage, we show that the lesser-known coverage (ACS) is more penalized than the other (CMU-C) as poor knowledge of the program increases the physician's expectation of additional administrative tasks and is an important element to explain cream-skimming. We also find that, for physicians who are free to set their fees, the opportunity cost of accepting a means-tested patient increases the penalty. Finally, the results suggest that enrollment in OPTAM, the controlled pricing practice option that incentivizes physicians to accept means-tested patients, reduces cream-skimming.

10.1002/hec.4692.abstractZh: 本研究通过两个标准来衡量法国女性患者在三个医学专业领域（牙科、妇科和精神病学）中获得医疗服务的差异：患者的非洲裔身份以及是否拥有基于经济状况的医疗保险。为此，我们对1500多名医生进行了全国性的实地调查。我们发现，针对非洲裔患者的歧视并不明显。然而，研究结果表明，拥有基于经济状况的医疗保险的患者更难以预约就诊。在两种类型的医疗保险中，我们发现不太为人所知的医疗保险类型受到的惩罚更为严重，因为对这类保险的了解不足会增加医生对额外行政工作的预期，这也是导致“奶油抽取”现象的一个重要因素。此外，对于可以自由设定收费的医生来说，接受基于经济状况的患者的机会成本会进一步增加受到的惩罚。最后，研究结果表明，加入OPTAM这一鼓励医生接受基于经济状况的患者的控制定价计划，可以减少“奶油抽取”现象。

abstract.text: We here investigate the role of risk aversion in COVID-19 vaccine hesitancy. The theoretical effect is ambiguous, as both COVID-19 infection and vaccination side-effects involve probabilistic elements. In large-scale data covering five European countries, we find that vaccine hesitancy falls with risk aversion, so that COVID-19 infection is perceived as involving greater risk than is vaccination.

10.1002/hec.4693.abstractZh: 我们在这里研究了风险厌恶在COVID-19疫苗犹豫中的作用。从理论上讲，这种影响是模糊的，因为COVID-19感染和疫苗接种的副作用都涉及概率因素。在涵盖五个欧洲国家的大规模数据中，我们发现随着风险厌恶程度的降低，疫苗犹豫现象减少，这意味着人们认为COVID-19感染的风险比疫苗接种更高。

abstract.text: The Netherlands reformed its disability insurance (DI) scheme in 2006. Eligibility for DI became stricter, reintegration incentives became stronger, and DI benefits often became less generous. Based on administrative data on all individuals who reported sick shortly before and after the reform, difference-in-differences regressions show that the reform reduced DI receipt by 5.2 percentage points and increased labor participation and unemployment insurance (UI) receipt by 1.2 and 1.1 percentage points, respectively. It increased average monthly earnings and UI claims to overcompensate lost DI benefits. However, older individuals, women, individuals with temporary contracts, the unemployed, and low-wage earners did not compensate or compensated to a much smaller extent for the lost DI benefits. The effects are persistent during the 10 years after the reform.

10.1002/hec.4694.abstractZh: 荷兰在2006年对残疾保险制度进行了改革。残疾保险的申请资格变得更加严格，重新融入社会的激励措施也更为有力，而残疾保险福利的额度则普遍降低。基于所有在改革前后不久报告有健康问题的个人的行政数据，差异-差异回归分析显示，改革使残疾保险领取金额减少了5.2个百分点，同时劳动参与率和失业保险领取率分别增加了1.2个百分点和1.1个百分点。改革还提高了平均月收入，并增加了失业保险申请数量，以弥补失去的残疾保险福利。然而，年龄较大的个体、女性、临时合同工、失业者以及低薪劳动者并没有得到足够的补偿，补偿幅度也相对较小。这些影响在改革后的10年内仍然持续存在。

abstract.text: Social participation is defined as an individual's involvement in activities that provide connections with others in society. Past research has demonstrated links between social participation, improved health and well-being, and reduced social isolation, but has been restricted to older people and has not investigated heterogeneity. Using cross-sectional data from the UK's Community Life Survey (2013-2019; N = 50,006), we estimated returns to social participation in the adult population. We included availability of community assets as instruments in a marginal treatment effects model, which allows treatment effects to be heterogeneous and examines whether the effects vary by propensity to participate. Social participation was linked to reduced loneliness and improved health (-0.96 and 0.40 points respectively on 1-5 scales) and increased life satisfaction and happiness (2.17 and 2.03 points respectively on 0-10 scales). These effects were larger for those on low income, with lower education attainment, and who live alone or with no children. We also found negative selection, indicating those less likely to participate have higher health and well-being returns. Future interventions could focus on increasing community asset infrastructure and encouraging social participation for those with lower socio-economic status.

10.1002/hec.4695.abstractZh: 社会参与被定义为个人参与能够与他人建立联系的活动。以往的研究表明，社会参与与改善健康与福祉以及减少社会孤立之间存在关联，但这些研究主要局限于老年人，且未探讨其差异性。我们利用英国社区生活调查（2013-2019年；样本量50,006人）的横向数据，估算了成人社会参与的回报。我们将社区资源的可获得性作为工具变量，构建了一个边际处理效应模型，该模型允许处理效应存在差异，并考察这些效应是否因参与倾向的不同而有所差异。研究发现，社会参与与减少孤独感、改善健康状况（在1-5量表上分别降低0.96和0.40分）以及提高生活满意度和幸福感（在0-10量表上分别提高2.17和2.03分）有关。这些效应在低收入、教育水平较低、独居或没有子女的人群中更为显著。我们还发现了负选择现象，即那些不太可能参与社会活动的人，其健康和福祉的回报反而更高。未来的干预措施可以集中在增加社区资源基础设施上，并鼓励社会经济地位较低的人群参与社会活动。

abstract.text: The government of Peru amended its constitution to increase compulsory education from six to 11 years in 1993. This constitutional amendment provides a natural experiment to investigate the impact of maternal education on child mortality. Exploiting differences in the reform exposure by age, I find that mothers who were exposed to the reform were less likely to experience the death of a child. There is also evidence that the reform caused a decline in infant mortality. These results are not driven by the age difference between mothers who were treated by the reform and those who were not treated. Additional analyses reveal that the reform increased age at first birth, decreased desired fertility, reduced smoking, and improved economic opportunities for women. The results demonstrate that compulsory schooling may be a useful policy tool to improve women's education, which can, in turn, enhance the survival of their children.

10.1002/hec.4696.abstractZh: 秘鲁政府在1993年修改了宪法，将义务教育年限从6年延长至11年。这一宪法修正案为研究母亲教育水平对儿童死亡率的影响提供了一个自然实验平台。通过考察不同年龄段对改革政策的接受程度，我发现接受改革政策的母亲子女死亡的风险较低。此外，研究还发现该改革政策导致了婴儿死亡率的下降。这些结果并未受到接受改革政策的母亲与未接受改革政策的母亲之间年龄差异的影响。进一步分析表明，该改革政策提高了初育年龄，降低了生育意愿，减少了吸烟行为，并改善了女性的经济机会。这些结果表明，义务教育可能是提升女性教育水平的有效政策工具，而女性教育水平的提高又会提升其子女的存活率。

abstract.text: The monetary value of a reduction in mortality risk can be accurately characterized using the alternative concepts of value per statistical life (VSL), value per statistical life year (VSLY), and value per quality-adjusted life year (VQALY). Typically, each of these values depends on the age and other characteristics of the affected individual; at most one of the values can be independent of age. The common practice of valuing a transient or persistent risk reduction using a constant VSL, VSLY, or VQALY yields systematic differences in the calculated monetary value that depend on the age at which the risk reduction begins, its duration, time path, and whether future lives, life years, or quality-adjusted life years are discounted. Mutually consistent, age-dependent VSL, VSLY, and VQALY are derived and the large differences in valuation of illustrative transient and persistent risk reductions that can result from assuming age-independent values of each of the three concepts are illustrated.

10.1002/hec.4697.abstractZh: 降低死亡风险所带来的货币价值可以通过三种不同的价值概念来准确衡量：每统计生命价值（VSL）、每统计生命年价值（VSLY）以及每质量调整生命年价值（VQALY）。通常，这些数值都取决于受影响个体的年龄和其他特征；最多只有其中一个数值可以独立于年龄而变化。通常的做法是使用恒定的VSL、VSLY或VQALY来评估短暂性或持续性风险降低所带来的价值，但计算结果会因风险降低开始的年龄、持续时间、时间路径以及是否对未来的生命、生命年或质量调整生命年进行折现而有所不同。本文推导出了相互一致的、依赖于年龄的VSL、VSLY和VQALY，并说明了假设这三个概念的数值独立于年龄时，对示例性的短暂性和持续性风险降低所带来的估值差异。

abstract.text: Using officially registered weekly mortality data, we estimate a counterfactual death count in the absence of the pandemic and we calculate the number of excess deaths in England and Wales during 2020 after the pandemic onset. We also break down those figures by region, age, gender, place of death, and cause of death. Our results suggest that there were 82,428 (95% Confidence interval [CI]: 78,402 to 86,415) excess deaths, and 88.9% (95% CI: 84.8%-93.5%) of them was due to COVID-19, suggesting that non-COVID-19 excess mortality may have been slightly higher that what has been previously estimated. Regarding deaths not due to COVID-19, persons older than 45 years old who died at their homes, mainly from heart diseases and cancer, were the most affected group. Across all causes of death, there was increased excess mortality from dementia and Alzheimer's disease, diabetes, Parkinson's disease and heart-related disease, while at the same period there was a reduction in deaths from pneumonia and influenza, stroke as well as infectious diseases and accidents. Supported by regional panel event estimates, our results highlight how measures to mitigate the pandemic spread and ease the pressure on healthcare service systems may adversely affect out-of-hospital mortality from other causes.

10.1002/hec.4698.abstractZh: 我们利用官方注册的每周死亡数据，估算了在没有疫情的情况下死亡人数，并计算了2020年疫情开始后英格兰和威尔士的超额死亡人数。我们还按地区、年龄、性别、死亡地点和死因对这些数据进行细分。我们的结果显示，有82,428例超额死亡（95%置信区间：[78,402至86,415]），其中88.9%（95%置信区间：[84.8%-93.5]）是由COVID-19引起的，这表明非COVID-19导致的超额死亡可能比之前估计的略高。在非COVID-19导致的死亡中，45岁以上、主要在家中去世的人，主要是因心脏病和癌症而死亡的，是受影响最严重的群体。在所有死因中，痴呆症和阿尔茨海默病、糖尿病、帕金森病以及心脏相关疾病导致的超额死亡有所增加，而同期肺炎、流感、中风以及传染病和事故导致的死亡则有所减少。结合区域面板事件估计的结果，我们的研究强调了缓解疫情传播和减轻医疗系统压力的措施可能会对其他原因导致的院外死亡产生不利影响。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effects of a mandatory, universal prescription drug insurance policy on health behaviors and outcomes within a public health care system providing physician and hospital services free of charge. Using Canadian longitudinal data, we show that the reform improved individuals' general health while reducing body mass index and smoking. However, the program also increased drinking and had no significant impact on mental health, physical activity, or preventive care. We also examine the mechanisms through which these effects can play a role, as well as the heterogeneous effects. Estimates suggest that the policy decreased SES-based disparities in health.

10.1002/hec.4699.abstractZh: 本文研究了强制性、全民处方药保险政策对提供免费医生和医院服务的公共卫生体系中的健康行为和结果的影响。利用加拿大纵向数据，我们发现该改革改善了个人的整体健康状况，同时降低了体重指数和吸烟率。然而，该计划也增加了饮酒量，并且对心理健康、身体活动或预防性护理没有显著影响。我们还探讨了这些效应发挥作用的具体机制，以及其异质性效应。估计结果表明，该政策减少了基于社会经济地位的医疗差异。

abstract.text: We present evidence that Earvin "Magic" Johnson's announcement that he contracted HIV served as a public-health catalyst for rapidly correcting the public's understanding of who was at risk of infection. Using a novel identification strategy, we present evidence that there was a large but temporary increase in the number of AIDS diagnoses for heterosexual men following the announcement. This effect was concentrated in areas with greater prior exposure to Johnson. We show that these men were both more likely to have been diagnosed via a formal blood test and less likely to die within 1 decade of their initial diagnosis-suggesting that Johnson's announcement caused an intertemporal substitution in testing which prolonged patients' lifespans as a result of earlier access to medical care. We estimate that Johnson's announcement caused approximately 800 additional heterosexual males in the United States in metropolitan statistical areas with National Basketball Association franchises men to discover their underlying AIDS diagnosis and, of whom, were more likely to live at least 1 decade beyond their initial diagnosis date.

10.1002/hec.4712.abstractZh: 我们提供了证据，表明厄维因·“魔术师”·约翰逊宣布自己感染了HIV，这一消息成为推动公众迅速改变对感染风险人群认知的公共卫生催化剂。通过一种创新的识别策略，我们发现约翰逊宣布后，异性恋男性中艾滋病诊断数量出现了较大但短暂的增加。这种影响主要集中在那些此前与约翰逊有过较多接触的地区。我们发现，这些男性通过正式血液检测被诊断出艾滋病的可能性更高，并且在初次诊断后的十年内死亡的可能性更低——这表明约翰逊的宣布导致了检测方式的时空替代，使得患者因更早获得医疗服务而延长了寿命。我们估计，约翰逊的宣布使得美国有大约800名拥有NBA球队的大都市统计区内的异性恋男性发现了自己潜在的艾滋病诊断，其中这些男性在初次诊断后的十年内至少存活了一年。

abstract.text: Health systems around the world are aiming to improve the integration of health and social care services to deliver better care for patients. Existing evaluations have focused exclusively on the impact of care integration on health outcomes and found little effect. That suggests the need to take a step back and ask whether integrated care programmes actually lead to greater clinical integration of care and indeed whether greater integration is associated with improved health outcomes. We propose a mediation analysis approach to address these two fundamental questions when evaluating integrated care programmes. We illustrate our approach by re-examining the impact of an English integrated care program on clinical integration and assessing whether greater integration is causally associated with fewer admissions for ambulatory care sensitive conditions. We measure clinical integration using a concentration index of outpatient referrals at the general practice level. While we find that the scheme increased integration of primary and secondary care, clinical integration did not mediate a decrease in unplanned hospital admissions. Our analysis emphasizes the need to better understand the hypothesized causal impact of integration on health outcomes and demonstrates how mediation analysis can inform future evaluations and program design.

10.1002/hec.4713.abstractZh: 全球各地的卫生系统都在努力改善健康与社会护理服务的整合，以提供更好的患者护理。现有的评估仅关注护理整合对健康结果的影响，并发现效果甚微。这表明需要退一步思考，询问整合护理计划是否真的能带来更紧密的临床护理整合，以及更紧密的整合是否与更好的健康结果相关。我们提出了一种中介分析方法，用于评估整合护理计划时这两个基本问题。我们通过重新评估一项英国整合护理计划对临床整合的影响，并评估更紧密的整合是否与门诊护理敏感条件的住院次数减少有因果关系，来说明我们的方法。我们使用全科医生级别的门诊转诊集中度指数来衡量临床整合。虽然我们发现该计划增加了初级和二级护理的整合，但临床整合并未导致非计划性住院次数的减少。我们的分析强调了更好地理解整合对健康结果假设的因果影响的必要性，并展示了中介分析方法如何为未来的评估和项目设计提供指导。

abstract.text: In a multi-payer health care system, economic theory suggests that different payers can impose spillover effects on one another. This study aimed to evaluate the spillover effect of the Patient Driven Payment Model (PDPM) on Medicare Advantage (MA) enrollees, despite it being designed for Traditional Medicare (TM) beneficiaries. We applied a regression discontinuity approach by comparing therapy utilization before and after the implementation of PDPM in October 2019 focusing on patients newly admitted to skilled nursing facilities. The results showed that both TM and MA enrollees experienced a decrease in individual therapy minutes and an increase in non-individual therapy minutes. The estimated reduction in total therapy use was 9 min per day for TM enrollees and 3 min per day for MA enrollees. The effect of PDPM on MA beneficiaries varied depending on the level of MA penetration, with the smallest effect in facilities with the highest MA penetration quartile. In summary, the PDPM had directionally similar effects on therapy utilization for both TM and MA enrollees, but the magnitudes were smaller for MA beneficiaries. These results suggest that policy changes intended for TM beneficiaries may spillover to MA enrollees and should be assessed accordingly.

10.1002/hec.4714.abstractZh: 在多支付方医疗体系中，经济理论表明不同支付方之间可能存在溢出效应。本研究旨在评估患者驱动支付模式对医疗保险优势计划参保人的溢出效应，尽管该模式最初是为传统医疗保险受益人设计的。我们采用回归不连续方法，比较了2019年10月实施患者驱动支付模式前后在技能护理机构新入院患者的治疗使用情况。结果显示，传统医疗保险和医疗保险优势计划的参保人个体治疗分钟数均有所减少，而非个体治疗分钟数则有所增加。传统医疗保险参保人的总治疗使用时间每天减少了9分钟，而医疗保险优势计划的参保人则减少了3分钟。PDPM对医疗保险优势计划受益人的影响因医疗保险的普及程度而异，在医疗保险普及程度最高的机构中影响最小。总之，PDPM对传统医疗保险和医疗保险优势计划的参保人在治疗使用方面产生了类似的影响，但医疗保险优势计划的受益人所受的影响较小。这些结果表明，针对传统医疗保险受益人的政策变化可能会影响到医疗保险优势计划的参保人，因此应予以相应的评估。

abstract.text: We investigate how exogenous variation in daylight caused by Daylight Saving Time affects road safety as measured by the count of vehicle crashes. We use administrative daily data from Greece covering the universe of all types of recorded vehicle accidents during the 2006-2016 period. Our regression discontinuity estimates support an ambient light mechanism that reduces the counts of serious vehicle accidents during the Spring transition and increases the count of minor ones during the Fall transition. The effects are driven from the hour intervals that are mostly affected from seasonal clock changes. We then discuss the potential cost implications of those seasonal transitions. In light of the talks about abolishing seasonal clock changes in the European Union (EU), our findings are policy relevant and can inform the public debate as empirical evidence for the block is scarce.

10.1002/hec.4715.abstractZh: 我们研究了夏令时导致的日光变化对道路安全的影响，具体通过车辆事故数量来衡量。我们使用了希腊在2006-2016年期间所有类型车辆事故的行政日常数据。我们的回归不连续估计表明，环境光线的变化在春季转换期间减少了严重交通事故的数量，而在秋季转换期间则增加了轻微交通事故的数量。这些效应主要受到季节性时钟调整影响的小时区间的驱动。接着，我们讨论了这些季节性转换可能带来的成本影响。鉴于欧盟关于废除季节性时钟调整的讨论，我们的发现具有政策相关性，可以作为实证证据参与公众辩论，因为相关的研究数据较为稀缺。

abstract.text: Expanded access to health care often leads to new diagnoses for previously undetected conditions. New diagnoses make it difficult to identify the causal effect of expanding health insurance on individuals with particular diagnoses: the newly diagnosed in the treatment group are likely to differ in unobserved ways from the control group. This paper provides two methods for dealing with this problem depending on the data available to the researcher and diagnosis-specific knowledge. If there is no panel dimension to the data, then the causal effect for the subgroup of interest can be bounded from either above or below depending on the condition in question. If panel data are available, then the newly diagnosed can be identified, and their treated outcomes subtracted from the overall effect of interest. I apply these methods to find that the difference-in-discontinuities estimator underestimates the effect of Medicare prescription drug coverage on the uptake of insulin by first-time users by 20%.
