10.1002/hec.4718.abstractZh: 扩大医疗服务的获取往往会导致以前未被发现的疾病被重新诊断。新的诊断结果使得难以确定扩大医疗保险对特定疾病患者的影响：治疗组中的新诊断患者可能在一些未观察到的方面与对照组存在差异。本文提出了两种方法来处理这个问题，具体取决于研究人员可用的数据和关于疾病的特定知识。如果数据没有面板维度，那么对于感兴趣的子群体，因果效应可以从上方或下方进行界定，具体取决于所讨论的情况。如果拥有面板数据，那么可以识别出新诊断的患者，并将他们的治疗结果从整体效应中减去。我应用这些方法发现，差异不连续估计量低估了医疗保险处方药物覆盖对首次使用胰岛素者的影响，低估了20%。

abstract.text: Local instrumental variable (LIV) approaches use continuous/multi-valued instrumental variables (IV) to generate consistent estimates of average treatment effects (ATEs) and Conditional Average Treatment Effects (CATEs). There is little evidence on how LIV approaches perform according to the strength of the IV or with different sample sizes. Our simulation study examined the performance of an LIV method, and a two-stage least squares (2SLS) approach across different sample sizes and IV strengths. We considered four 'heterogeneity' scenarios: homogeneity, overt heterogeneity (over measured covariates), essential heterogeneity (unmeasured), and overt and essential heterogeneity combined. In all scenarios, LIV reported estimates with low bias even with the smallest sample size, provided that the instrument was strong. Compared to 2SLS, LIV provided estimates for ATE and CATE with lower levels of bias and Root Mean Squared Error. With smaller sample sizes, both approaches required stronger IVs to ensure low bias. We considered both methods in evaluating emergency surgery (ES) for three acute gastrointestinal conditions. Whereas 2SLS found no differences in the effectiveness of ES according to subgroup, LIV reported that frailer patients had worse outcomes following ES. In settings with continuous IVs of moderate strength, LIV approaches are better suited than 2SLS to estimate policy-relevant treatment effect parameters.

10.1002/hec.4719.abstractZh: 局部工具变量（LIV）方法使用连续/多值的工具变量来生成一致的平均处理效应（ATE）和条件平均处理效应（CATE）估计值。关于LIV方法在不同工具变量强度或不同样本量下的表现，现有证据较少。我们的模拟研究考察了LIV方法和两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）在不同样本量和工具变量强度下的表现。我们考虑了四种“异质性”情景：同质性、显性异质性（过度测量的协变量）、本质异质性（未测量的协变量）以及显性异质性和本质异质性同时存在的情景。在所有情景中，只要工具变量足够强，LIV方法即使在最小样本量下也能提供低偏差的估计值。与2SLS相比，LIV方法提供的ATE和CATE估计值偏差和均方根误差更低。在较小的样本量下，两种方法都需要更强工具变量以确保低偏差。我们在评估三种急性胃肠道疾病的紧急手术时，同时使用了这两种方法。2SLS发现不同亚组之间紧急手术的效果没有差异，而LIV方法则表明虚弱的患者在接受紧急手术后预后更差。在中等强度的连续工具变量情况下，LIV方法比2SLS更适合估计与政策相关的处理效应参数。

abstract.text: Based on a triple difference estimation, this paper shows that the impact of a universal cash transfer on child nutrition differs by household wealth. In 2011, Odisha state in India introduced a conditional maternal cash transfer named "Mamata Scheme". Using data from the National Family Health Survey, I find that the program reduced child wasting by 7 percentage points, a 39% reduction compared to the average prevalence of wasting in the pre-program period. The reduction in child wasting is driven by children from households in the top four of five national wealth quintiles, for whom the program reduced wasting by 13 percentage points or a reduction of about 80%. Children from households in the bottom wealth quintile were 13 percentage points more likely to suffer from wasting than their wealthier counterparts. Reduction in stunting is also limited to children from households in the top four wealth quintiles, with an average program effect of 12 percentage points, that is, a 40% reduction. The results suggest that access to universal cash benefit schemes is important for mothers and children from marginalized households to realize proportionate benefits.

10.1002/hec.4720.abstractZh: 基于三重差异估计，本文表明普遍现金转移对儿童营养的影响因家庭财富而异。2011年，印度奥里萨邦引入了名为“玛玛塔计划”的条件性母亲现金转移项目。根据全国家庭健康调查的数据，我发现该项目使儿童营养不良的发生率降低了7个百分点，相比项目实施前的平均发病率，减少了39%。儿童营养不良的减少主要发生在财富排名前四至五的家庭中，这些家庭中的儿童营养不良发生率降低了13个百分点，约减少了80%。而财富排名最底层的家庭中的儿童，营养不良的发生率则比富裕家庭中的儿童高出13个百分点。发育迟缓的减少也仅限于财富排名前四至五的家庭，平均项目效果为12个百分点，即减少了40%。研究结果表明，对于来自边缘化家庭的母亲和儿童来说，获得普遍现金福利计划的重要性在于能够享受到相应的利益。

abstract.text: Many studies which describe the relationship between obesity and economic preference rely on healthy, clinically-irrelevant populations. Instead, we study economic decision-making of a clinically-relevant population of 299 people with obesity who participated in a 6-months Randomized Controlled Trial in two Sydney-based hospitals to prevent diabetes onset. To elicit preferences, we use incentive-compatible experimental tasks that participants completed during their medical screening examination. In this population, we find that participants are risk averse, show no evidence of present bias, and have impatience levels comparable to healthy samples described in the international literature. Variations in present bias and impatience are not significantly associated with variations in markers of obesity. We find however a statistically significant negative association between risk tolerance and markers of obesity for women. Importantly, impatience moderates the link between risk tolerance and obesity, a finding which we are able to replicate in nationally-representative survey data. We discuss explanations for why our findings deviate markedly from the literature for this understudied but highly policy-relevant population. One explanation is that our specific population consists of forward-looking, well-educated individuals, who are willing to participate in an intensive health intervention. Hence, other factors may be at play for why these individuals live with obesity.

10.1002/hec.4721.abstractZh: 许多研究描述了肥胖与经济偏好之间的关系，但这些研究往往依赖于健康且临床无关的人群。相反，我们研究了299名肥胖患者在临床相关人群中的经济决策行为，这些患者参与了在悉尼两家医院进行的为期6个月的随机对照试验，旨在预防糖尿病的发生。为了获取偏好信息，我们使用了在医疗筛查过程中参与者完成的激励兼容实验任务。在这组人群中，我们发现参与者具有风险厌恶倾向，没有表现出当前偏差现象，其急躁程度与国际文献中描述的健康样本相当。当前偏差和急躁程度的变化与肥胖指标的变化无明显关联。然而，我们发现女性的风险容忍度与肥胖指标之间存在统计学上的显著负相关。重要的是，急躁程度调节了风险容忍度与肥胖之间的联系，这一发现在我们获得的全国代表性调查数据中得到了验证。我们探讨了为什么我们的研究结果与文献中的结果存在显著差异，尽管这一人群被严重忽视了，但对其研究具有重要意义。一种解释是，我们的研究对象是具有前瞻性思维、受过良好教育的人群，他们愿意参与密集的健康干预措施。因此，可能还有其他因素影响着这些个体为何会患有肥胖症。

abstract.text: Appropriate costing and economic modeling are major factors for the successful scale-up of health interventions. Various cost functions are currently being used to estimate costs of health interventions at scale in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs) potentially resulting in disparate cost projections. The aim of this study is to gain understanding of current methods used and provide guidance to inform the use of cost functions that is fit for purpose. We reviewed seven databases covering the economic and global health literature to identify studies reporting a quantitative analysis of costs informing the projected scale-up of a health intervention in LMICs between 2003 and 2019. Of the 8725 articles identified, 40 met the inclusion criteria. We classified studies according to the type of cost functions applied-accounting or econometric-and described the intended use of cost projections. Based on these findings, we developed new mathematical notations and cost function frameworks for the analysis of healthcare costs at scale in LMICs setting. These notations estimate variable returns to scale in cost projection methods, which is currently ignored in most studies. The frameworks help to balance simplicity versus accuracy and increase the overall transparency in reporting of methods.

10.1002/hec.4722.abstractZh: 恰当的成本核算和经济建模是成功扩大健康干预规模的关键因素。目前，在低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs），人们使用多种成本函数来估算大规模健康干预的成本，这可能导致不同的成本预测结果。本研究的目的是了解当前使用的各种方法，并为选择适合特定用途的成本函数提供指导。我们回顾了七个涵盖经济和全球健康领域的数据库，以识别2003年至2019年间关于LMICs中健康干预规模扩大成本分析的定量研究。在识别的8725篇文章中，有40篇符合纳入标准。我们根据所应用的成本函数类型——会计方法或计量经济学方法——对研究进行分类，并描述了成本预测的预期用途。基于这些发现，我们为分析LMICs中大规模医疗保健成本问题开发了新的数学符号和成本函数框架。这些符号能够估算成本预测中的规模报酬变量，而目前大多数研究都忽略了这一点。这些框架有助于在简单性与准确性之间取得平衡，并提高方法报告的整体透明度。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the effect of retirement on health behaviors using three nationally representative U.S. datasets. Findings show a decrease in drinking at the intensive margin, particularly for males. Individuals change their composition of exercise behaviors upon retirement, with varying effects of retirement depending on exercise intensity and gender. Dining patterns also change, with changes in eating out among men and more time spent on food preparation. Finally, although retirement increases time spent watching TV and movies as well as time spent sleeping, it reduces overall sedentary time.

10.1002/hec.4723.abstractZh: 本文利用三个具有全国代表性的美国数据集，分析了退休对健康行为的影响。研究结果表明，在饮酒方面，尤其是男性，退休后饮酒量有所减少。个体在退休后改变了运动行为的组合，退休对运动强度的不同影响以及性别的不同影响也各不相同。饮食模式也发生了变化，男性外出就餐的时间减少，而用于食物准备的时间增加。最后，尽管退休增加了看电视和看电影的时间以及睡眠时间，但总体上减少了久坐时间。

abstract.text: In this paper, we test whether the Affordable Care Act Medicaid expansions are associated with maternal morbidity. The ACA expansions may have affected maternal morbidity by increasing pre-conception access to health care, and by improving the quality of delivery care, through enhancing hospitals' financial positions. We use difference-in-difference models in conjunction with event studies. Data come from individual-level birth certificates and state-level hospital discharge data. The results show little evidence that the expansions are associated with overall maternal morbidity or indicators of specific adverse events including eclampsia, ruptured uterus, and unplanned hysterectomy. The results are consistent with prior research showing that the ACA Medicaid expansions are not statistically associated with pre-pregnancy health or maternal health during pregnancy. Our results add to this story and find little evidence of improvements in maternal health upon delivery.

10.1002/hec.4724.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们探讨了《平价医疗法案》的医疗补助扩展是否与孕产妇发病率有关。该法案的扩展可能通过增加孕前医疗保健的获取机会，以及通过改善医院的财务状况来提高分娩护理质量，从而影响了孕产妇的发病率。我们采用了差异-差异模型并结合事件研究进行分析。数据来源于个人层面的出生证明和州级医院出院数据。研究结果显示，这些扩展与总体孕产妇发病率或特定不良事件的指标（如子痫、子宫破裂和计划外子宫切除术）之间几乎没有关联。研究结果与先前的研究一致，即《平价医疗法案》的医疗补助扩展与孕前健康或孕期孕产妇健康之间没有统计学上的关联。我们的研究结果进一步证实了这一点，并发现分娩后孕产妇健康的改善迹象甚微。

abstract.text: China's rural elderly spend less on medical expenditures as they age despite declining health, raising welfare concerns. This paper investigates the role of intrahousehold bargaining power on health expenditures of the elderly by evaluating the impact of cash transfers from a new social pension program. The program provided windfall payments to those above age 60, making it possible to employ a regression discontinuity design based on age of eligibility to estimate causal effects. Using data from the 2011 and 2013 waves of the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study, we find that receiving pension payments increases both the utilization of outpatient care and outpatient expenditures by the elderly who experienced illness. This result is robust to controlling for total household expenditures per capita, ruling out income effects as the main channel. Consistent with pensions increasing elderly bargaining power, we find that pensions significantly increase medical expenditures only for those elderly who co-reside with children or grandchildren but have no effect on those who live independently.

10.1002/hec.4725.abstractZh: 尽管健康状况下降，中国农村老年人在年老时医疗支出减少，这引发了福利方面的担忧。本文通过评估一项新的社会养老金计划提供的现金转移对老年人医疗支出的影响，探讨了家庭内部议价能力对老年人医疗支出的作用。该计划向60岁以上的人群提供额外支付，从而可以基于资格年龄采用回归不连续设计来估计因果效应。利用2011年和2013年中国健康与退休纵向研究的数据，我们发现，接受养老金支付后，患病老年人的门诊护理利用率和门诊支出均有所增加。这一结果在控制人均家庭总支出后依然成立，表明收入效应并非主要渠道。与养老金提升老年人议价能力一致的是，我们发现养老金仅对与子女或孙辈同住且没有其他居住方式的老年人医疗支出产生显著影响。

abstract.text: Recreational marijuana laws (RMLs) continue to grow in popularity, but the effects on mental health treatment are unclear. This paper uses an event-study within a difference-in-differences framework to study the short-run impact of state RMLs on admissions into mental health treatment facilities. The results indicate that shortly after a state adopts an RML, they experience a decrease in the average number of mental health treatment admissions. The findings are driven by white, Black, and Medicaid-funded admissions and are consistent for both male and female admissions. The results are robust to alternative specifications and sensitivity analysis.

10.1002/hec.4726.abstractZh: 娱乐性大麻法律（RMLs）的受欢迎程度持续上升，但其对心理健康治疗的影响尚不明确。本文采用事件-研究与差异-差异框架相结合的方法，研究州级RMLs对心理健康治疗设施入院人数的短期影响。研究结果表明，在某一州实施RMLs后不久，该州的心理健康治疗设施入院人数会有所下降。这些发现主要涉及到白人、黑人以及由医疗补助资金资助的患者的入院情况，且这一趋势在男性和女性患者中均存在。研究结果在采用不同模型进行分析以及进行敏感性分析后依然保持稳定。

abstract.text: We study the link between department-wide surgeon supply and quality of care for two major elective medical procedures. Several countries have adopted policies to concentrate medical procedures in high-volume hospitals. While higher patient volumes might translate to higher quality, we provide evidence for a positive relationship between surgeon supply and hospital revision rates for hip and knee replacement surgery. Hence, hospital performance decreases with higher surgeon supply, and this finding holds conditional on patient volumes.

10.1002/hec.4727.abstractZh: 我们研究了科室范围内外科医生供应与两种主要选择性医疗手术护理质量之间的关系。一些国家采取了将医疗手术集中在高流量医院的政策。虽然更高的患者数量可能意味着更高的护理质量，但我们的研究证明了外科医生供应与髋关节和膝关节置换手术的医院翻修率之间存在正相关关系。因此，随着外科医生供应的增加，医院的表现会下降，这一发现是在考虑到患者数量的前提下得出的。

abstract.text: The consumption of tobacco is harmful to health and has huge social costs. "Tax to control tobacco" is a widely implemented tobacco control measure all over the world. In order to examine the achievements of two tobacco excise tax reforms in China in 2009 and 2015 on controlling tobacco consumption, we first establish an intertemporal consumption model for addictive goods, and then validate the effectiveness of the two tobacco excise tax reforms using a Continuous Difference-in-Differences Model based on the panel data from 294 cities in China from 2007 to 2018. The results show that the tobacco excise tax reform in 2015 considerably reduced tobacco consumption, while the reform in 2009 did not, providing empirical evidence on the importance of "price links to tax" for tobacco control. Additionally, the study discovers that the tax reform has a heterogeneous effect on the age of smokers, the price of cigarettes, and city size.

10.1002/hec.4728.abstractZh: 烟草消费对健康有害，且带来巨大的社会成本。“税收控制烟草”是全球广泛实施的烟草控制措施。为了评估2009年和2015年中国两次烟草消费税改革在控制烟草消费方面的成效，我们首先建立了一个关于成瘾商品的跨期消费模型，然后利用基于2007至2018年中国294个城市面板数据的连续差分进化模型，验证这两项烟草消费税改革的有效性。研究结果表明，2015年的烟草消费税改革显著降低了烟草消费，而2009年的改革则没有产生类似效果，这为“价格与税收的关联”在烟草控制中的重要性提供了实证依据。此外，研究还发现，税收改革对吸烟年龄、香烟价格以及城市规模的影响存在差异。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the long-run relationship between health care expenditures (HCE) and income using Canadian provincial data spanning a period of 40 years from 1981 to 2020. We study the non-stationary and cointegration properties of HCE and income and estimate the long-run income elasticities of HCE. Using heterogeneous panel models that incorporate cross-section dependence via unobserved common correlated factors to capture global shocks, we estimate long-run income elasticities that lie in the 0.11-0.16 range. Our results indicate that health care is a necessity good for Canada. These elasticity estimates are much smaller than those estimated in other studies for Canada. We find that HCE and income in Canada are cointegrated and that short-run changes in federal transfers significantly and positively affect HCE.

10.1002/hec.4730.abstractZh: 本文利用1981年至2020年40年的加拿大省级数据，研究了医疗保健支出与收入之间的长期关系。我们研究了医疗保健支出和收入的非平稳性和协整特性，并估算了医疗保健支出的长期收入弹性。通过采用异质面板模型，结合通过未观测的共同相关因素体现的截面依赖性，以捕捉全球冲击的影响，我们得出了0.11-0.16范围内的长期收入弹性。我们的研究结果表明，医疗保健对加拿大来说是一种必需品。这些弹性估计值比其他研究对加拿大得出的估计值要小得多。我们发现，加拿大的医疗保健支出和收入之间存在协整关系，而联邦转移支付在短期内的变化会对医疗保健支出产生显著且积极的影响。

abstract.text: The obesity epidemic is a growing concern in the United States. Aside from the detrimental health effects of obesity, previous work has also documented a negative relationship between obesity and various labor market outcomes. Given that the American adult obesity rate is roughly 40%, obesity affects a large portion of the US labor market. In this study, I analyze the impact of obesity on income and employment over business cycle fluctuations. I find that during economic downturns, obese workers experience larger declines in income and employment relative to their healthy weight peers. These effects exist for both genders and are concentrated amongst younger adults.

10.1002/hec.4731.abstractZh: 肥胖症在美国日益成为令人担忧的问题。除了肥胖对健康造成的负面影响外，先前的研究还发现肥胖与多种劳动力市场结果之间存在负相关关系。鉴于美国成年人的肥胖率约为40%，肥胖现象影响了美国很大一部分劳动力市场。在这项研究中，我分析了肥胖对收入和就业的影响，以及这些影响在经济周期波动中的变化。我发现，在经济衰退期间，肥胖工人的收入和就业水平下降幅度比体重健康的人更大。这种影响存在于所有性别中，并且主要集中在年轻人群中。

abstract.text: This paper examines the effects of the Safe Delivery Incentive Program in Nepal, a cash transfer program that reduced the costs of childbirth in healthcare facilities. Women giving birth for the first, second, or third time (below-cutoff) became eligible in 2005, and women giving birth for the fourth time or more (above-cutoff) became eligible two years later. Using a difference-in-differences design, I find that below-cutoff women in high Human Development Index (HDI) districts increased facility delivery by 8.8 percentage points. Despite larger cost reductions, below-cutoff women in low HDI districts did not increase facility delivery but increased home delivery with skilled personnel by 4.8 percentage points. The program had no impact on above-cutoff women, who become eligible 2 years into the program. I suggest that pre-existing barriers such as poor infrastructure of roads and facilities, customs, liquidity constraints, and lack of program awareness limited the program's effectiveness.

10.1002/hec.4732.abstractZh: 本文研究了尼泊尔“安全分娩激励计划”的影响。该现金转移计划降低了医疗机构中的分娩成本。2005年，首次、第二次或第三次分娩的女性（低于门槛）有资格享受该计划；而第四次及以后分娩的女性（高于门槛）则在两年后才有资格。通过差异-差异设计，我发现，在高人类发展指数地区，低于门槛的女性使医疗机构的分娩率提高了8.8个百分点。尽管成本降低幅度更大，但低人类发展指数地区的低于门槛女性并未增加医疗机构的分娩率，反而使有熟练人员参与的居家分娩率提高了4.8个百分点。该计划对高于门槛的女性没有影响，这些女性是在计划实施两年后才有资格享受该计划的。我推测，现有的障碍，如道路和设施基础设施不足、风俗习惯、流动性限制以及缺乏对该计划的认识，都限制了该计划的效果。

abstract.text: We examine the influence of the COVID-19 pandemic on medical occupation preference, focusing on Wuhan, China. We conducted a survey of 5686 respondents in China regarding the influence of the COVID-19 pandemic on medical occupation preference. We also conducted a complimentary survey in the UK with 1198 respondents, as well as a field experiment in Wuhan with 428 first and second-year medical students. We find a significant negative impact of the pandemic on the willingness to let a loved one choose a medical occupation. Individuals who were heavily influenced by the pandemic, that is, Wuhan residents, especially medical workers, express significantly lower medical occupation preference. Further analysis from Sobel-Goodman mediation tests reveals that around half of the total negative effect can be mediated by enhanced risk aversion and reduced altruism. The UK survey and the field experiment with medical students in Wuhan reinforce these findings. Our results suggest a shift in medical workers' risk- and altruistic-preferences has led to a reduced medical occupation preference. Non-medical workers and students who are more altruistic and risk-seeking are more likely to choose a medical occupation.

10.1002/hec.4733.abstractZh: 我们研究了COVID-19大流行对医疗职业偏好影响的研究，重点关注中国武汉地区。我们对中国5686名受访者进行了调查，了解COVID-19大流行对医疗职业偏好影响的情况。此外，我们在英国对1198名受访者进行了补充调查，并在武汉对428名一年级和二年级医学生进行了实地实验。我们发现，大流行对人们让亲人选择医疗职业的意愿产生了显著的负面影响。那些受到大流行严重影响的人群，即武汉居民，尤其是医疗工作者，表现出较低的医疗职业偏好。进一步的Sobel-Goodman中介测试分析表明，大约一半的负面效应可以通过增强的风险规避和降低的利他主义来解释。英国的调查和武汉医学生的实地实验都证实了这些发现。我们的研究结果表明，医疗工作者风险偏好和利他主义偏好的变化导致了医疗职业偏好的降低。而非医疗工作者以及更具利他主义和风险寻求倾向的学生则更有可能选择医疗职业。

abstract.text: Specialty hospitals tend to negotiate higher commercial insurance payments, even for relatively routine procedures with comparable clinical quality across hospital types. How specialty hospitals can maintain such a price premium remains an open question. In this paper, we examine a potential (horizontal) differentiation effect in which patients perceive specialty hospitals as sufficiently distinct from other hospitals, so that specialty hospitals effectively compete in a separate market from general acute care hospitals. We estimate this effect in the context of routine pediatric procedures offered by both specialty children's hospitals as well as general acute care hospitals, and we find strong empirical evidence of a differentiation effect in which specialty children's hospitals appear largely immune to competitive forces from non-children's hospitals.

10.1002/hec.4734.abstractZh: 专科医院往往能够协商出更高的商业保险费用，即使是那些临床质量相当、相对常规的手术也是如此。然而，专科医院如何维持这样的价格优势仍然是一个未解之谜。在本文中，我们探讨了一种潜在的（横向）差异化效应，即患者认为专科医院与其他医院存在显著差异，因此专科医院能够在与普通急性护理医院不同的市场中进行竞争。我们在儿科常规手术这一背景下进行了实证研究，发现专科医院在非儿科医院的竞争压力下表现出较强的差异化优势。

abstract.text: Long waiting times have been a persistent policy issue in the United Kingdom that the COVID-19 pandemic has exacerbated. This study analyses the causal effect of hospital spending on waiting times in England using a first-differences panel approach and an instrumental variable strategy to deal with residual concerns for endogeneity. We use data from 2014 to 2019 on waiting times from general practitioner referral to treatment (RTT) measured at the level of local purchasers (known as Clinical Commissioning Groups). We find that increases in hospital spending by local purchasers of 1% reduce median RTT waiting time for patients whose pathway ends with a hospital admission (admitted pathway) by 0.6 days but the effect is not statistically significant at 5% level (only at the 10% level). We also find that higher hospital spending does not affect the RTT waiting time for patients whose pathway ends with a specialist consultation (non-admitted pathway). Nor does higher spending have a statistically significant effect on the volume of elective activity for either pathway. Our findings suggest that higher spending is no guarantee of higher volumes and lower waiting times, and that additional mechanisms need to be put in place to ensure that increased spending benefits elective patients.

10.1002/hec.4735.abstractZh: 在英国，漫长的等待时间一直是一个持续存在的政策问题，而COVID-19大流行进一步加剧了这一问题。本研究采用首次差异面板方法和工具变量策略，分析医院支出对英格兰等待时间的影响，以解决内生性的剩余问题。我们使用了2014至2019年的数据，这些数据记录了全科医生转诊至治疗的时间（RTT），数据来源于地方采购方（即临床委托组）。研究发现，地方采购方的医院支出增加1%，会使以住院治疗为结局的患者的中位等待时间减少0.6天，但这一效应在5%的水平上并不显著（仅在10%的水平上显著）。此外，我们还发现，较高的医院支出并不会影响以专科咨询为结局的患者的中位等待时间。同样，较高的支出对两种途径的择期活动量也没有统计学上的显著影响。我们的研究结果表明，较高的支出并不能保证更高的活动量和更短的等待时间，因此需要采取额外的机制来确保增加的支出能够惠及择期患者。

abstract.text: Many health systems apply mixed remuneration schemes for general practitioners, but little is known about the effects on service provision of changing the relative mix of fee for services and capitation. We apply difference-in-differences analyses to evaluate a reform that effectively reversed the mix between fee for services and capitation from 80/20 to 20/80 for patients with type 2 diabetes. Our results show reductions in provision of both the contact services that became capitated and in other non-capitated (still-billable) services. Reduced provision also occurred for guideline-recommended process quality services. We find that the effects are mainly driven by patients with co-morbidities and by general practitioners with high income, relatively many diabetes patients, and solo practitioners. Thus, increasing capitation in a mixed remuneration schemes appears to reduce service provision for patients with type 2 diabetes monitored in general practice with a risk of unwanted quality effects.

10.1002/hec.4736.abstractZh: 许多医疗系统对全科医生采用混合薪酬制度，但关于改变服务收费与按人头付费的比例对服务提供的影响，目前了解甚少。我们采用差异-差异分析方法来评估一项改革措施的效果，该改革将2型糖尿病患者服务收费与按人头付费的比例从80/20调整为20/80。我们的结果显示，按人头付费的服务以及其他非按人头付费的服务都减少了。按照指南推荐的过程质量服务也出现了服务减少的情况。我们发现，这种影响主要来自于有合并症的患者、收入较高的全科医生、数量相对较多的糖尿病患者以及独立执业的医生。因此，在混合薪酬制度中增加按人头付费的比例，似乎会减少2型糖尿病患者在服务提供方面的需求，同时可能会带来不良的质量影响。

abstract.text: As a way of slowing COVID-19 transmission, many countries and U.S. states implemented shelter-in-place (SIP) policies. However, the effects of SIP policies on public health are a priori ambiguous. Using an event study approach and data from 43 countries and all U.S. states, we measure changes in excess deaths following the implementation of COVID-19 shelter-in-place (SIP) policies. We do not find that countries or U.S. states that implemented SIP policies earlier had lower excess deaths. We do not observe differences in excess deaths before and after the implementation of SIP policies, even when accounting for pre-SIP COVID-19 death rates.

10.1002/hec.4737.abstractZh: 为了减缓COVID-19的传播，许多国家和美国各州实施了居家隔离政策。然而，这些政策对公共健康的影响尚不确定。我们采用事件研究法，利用43个国家和美国所有州的数据，来测量实施COVID-19居家隔离政策后超额死亡人数的变化。我们发现，那些较早实施居家隔离政策的国家或州，其超额死亡人数并没有减少。即使考虑到实施居家隔离政策前的COVID-19死亡率，我们也未能观察到实施政策前后超额死亡人数的差异。

abstract.text: This study examines whether implementing Urban Residents Medical Insurance Scheme decreased an individual's risky lifestyle behavior before illness, termed ex-ante moral hazard. Ex-ante moral hazard is predicted by the classical economic theory suggesting that health insurance coverage reduces an individual's incentive to take preventive efforts to remain healthy. Studies have provided mixed evidence for this prediction. China's 2006 nationwide social experiment of implementing the Urban Residents Basic Medical Insurance Scheme offers an excellent opportunity for examining the effect of the transition from uninsured to insured on an individual's health behaviors. We exploit the longitudinal dimension of a representative survey data for 2007-2010 and employ the instrumental variable technique, thereby addressing the issue of self-selection into voluntary health insurance schemes. The results do not provide evidence for and contrast the prediction of the ex-ante moral hazard. Significant differences exist between insured and uninsured groups with respect to smoking, drinking habits, and being overweight. People with insurance care more about their health than people without insurance do. The main results still hold if we use alternative estimation methods and other robustness tests.

10.1002/hec.4738.abstractZh: 本研究探讨实施城市居民医疗保险计划是否减少了个体在患病前的冒险生活方式行为，这种现象被称为事前道德风险。根据经典经济理论，医疗保险的覆盖会降低个体保持健康所需的积极性。相关研究对于这一预测提供了不同的证据。中国2006年在全国范围内实施的城市居民基本医疗保险计划实验，为研究从无保险到有保险的转变对个体健康行为的影响提供了绝佳机会。我们利用2007-2010年的代表性调查数据，并采用工具变量技术，从而解决了自愿加入医疗保险计划中的自我选择问题。研究结果并未提供支持和对比事前道德风险预测的证据。有保险群体与无保险群体在吸烟、饮酒习惯以及超重程度上存在显著差异。有保险的人比无保险的人更关注自己的健康。如果我们使用其他估计方法和其他稳健性测试，主要结果仍然成立。

abstract.text: Dental caries is the most prevalent oral disease across the life course. This study modeled the population health and economic impact of a 20% sugar sweetened beverages tax (SSB) for preventing dental caries compared to no intervention (societal and healthcare perspective). A cost-effectiveness analysis according to quintiles of area-level socioeconomic disadvantage was performed for the 2020 Australian population (0-100 years old) using a closed cohort Markov model. A qualitative assessment of implementation considerations (e.g., acceptability, equity, sustainability) was undertaken. Health outcomes were modeled as decayed teeth prevented and disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) averted. The 10-year and lifetime scenarios were modeled with probabilistic sensitivity analysis (Monte Carlo simulation, 2000 cycles). The 10-year scenario from a societal perspective yielded cost-savings of AUD$63.5M, healthcare cost-savings of AUD$42.2M, 510,977 decayed teeth averted and 98.1 DALYs averted. The lifetime scenario resulted in societal cost savings of AUD$176.6M, healthcare cost-savings of AUD$122.5M, 1,309,211 decayed teeth averted and 254.9 DALYs averted. Modeling indicated 71.5% and 74.5% cost-effectiveness for the 10-year and lifetime scenarios, respectively. A three-fold health benefit for the least advantaged was found compared to the most advantaged. A 20% SSB tax in Australia is cost-effective and promotes health equity.

10.1002/hec.4739.abstractZh: 龋齿是贯穿整个生命历程中最常见的口腔疾病。本研究从社会和医疗的角度，模拟了征收20%的含糖饮料税对预防龋齿的群体健康和经济影响，与无干预措施的情况进行了比较。采用封闭队列马尔可夫模型，根据地区社会经济劣势的五分位数，对2020年澳大利亚人口（0-100岁）进行了成本效益分析。同时，还对实施该政策的考虑因素进行了定性评估，如可接受性、公平性、可持续性等。健康结果以预防的龋齿数量和避免的伤残调整生命年数来表示。通过概率敏感性分析（蒙特卡洛模拟，2000次循环），对10年情景和终身情景进行了建模。从社会角度来看，10年情景可节省成本6350万澳元，医疗成本节省4202万澳元，同时避免了510977颗龋齿和98.1个伤残调整生命年。终身情景则能节省1766万澳元的社会成本，1225万澳元的医疗成本，并避免1,309,211颗龋齿和254.9个伤残调整生命年。建模结果显示，10年情景和终身情景的性价比分别为71.5%和74.5%。与最富裕人群相比，最贫困人群获得了三倍的健康收益。在澳大利亚征收20%的含糖饮料税是具有成本效益的，并且有助于促进健康公平。

abstract.text: A school starting age policy may generate disparities in the age at which students enter school, and in the relative age for grade among children born in similar periods. I analyze the impacts of being young-for-grade on students' risky health behaviors. Using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design which exploits the school entry system in South Korea, I find that being younger in the class leads students to begin drinking alcohol earlier. In addition, it increases the likelihood of drinking over the past 30 days. Being young-for-grade also impacts the probability of having sexual intercourse during one's high school years. My main findings are driven by both girls and boys. The robustness of my results is supported by several alternative specifications.

10.1002/hec.4740.abstractZh: 学校入学年龄政策可能会导致学生入学年龄的差异，以及出生时间相近的儿童在年级上的相对年龄差异。我分析了与年级不符的年轻入学对学生在风险健康行为的影响。通过使用韩国学校入学制度设计的模糊回归离散模型，我发现班级中年龄较小的学生会更早开始饮酒，并且过去30天内饮酒的可能性也更高。与年级不符的年轻入学还会影响学生在高中时期发生性行为的概率。我的主要发现涉及女孩和男孩。我的研究结果得到了多种替代模型的支持，表明其结果的稳健性。

abstract.text: Tobacco tax increases, the most cost-effective measure in reducing consumption, remain underutilized in low and middle-income countries. This study estimates the health and economic burden of smoking in Argentina and forecasts the benefits of tobacco tax hikes, accounting for the potential effects of illicit trade. Using a probabilistic Markov microsimulation model, this study quantifies smoking-related deaths, health events, and societal costs. The model also estimates the health and economic benefits of different increases in the price of cigarettes through taxes. Annually, smoking causes 45,000 deaths and 221,000 health events in Argentina, costing USD 2782 million in direct medical expenses, USD 1470 million in labor productivity loss costs, and USD 1069 million in informal care costs-totaling 1.2% of the national gross domestic product. Even in a scenario that considers illicit trade of tobacco products, a 50% cigarette price increase through taxes could yield USD 8292 million in total economic benefits accumulated over a decade. Consequently, raising tobacco taxes could significantly reduce the health and economic burdens of smoking in Argentina while increasing fiscal revenue.

10.1002/hec.4741.abstractZh: 在低收入和中等收入国家，提高烟草税作为减少烟草消费的最具成本效益的措施，仍然没有得到充分利用。本研究估算了阿根廷吸烟对健康和经济的负担，并预测了提高烟草税所带来的益处，同时考虑了非法贸易的潜在影响。通过概率马尔可夫微观模拟模型，本研究量化了与吸烟相关的死亡人数、健康事件以及社会成本。该模型还估算了不同香烟价格通过税收提高所带来的健康和经济效益。每年，吸烟在阿根廷导致45,000人死亡，引发221,000起健康事件，直接医疗费用达27.82亿美元，劳动生产率损失达14.7亿美元，非正规护理费用达10.69亿美元——这些费用总计占国民生产总值的1.2%。即使考虑到烟草产品的非法贸易，通过税收将香烟价格提高50%，在十年内可带来82.92亿美元的总经济效益。因此，提高烟草税可以在增加财政收入的同时，显著减轻阿根廷吸烟带来的健康和经济负担。

abstract.text: This paper provides evidence on the lasting effects of the 1999 economic crisis in Ecuador on human capital formation. We show for children born during the crisis that the negative repercussions are still observable more than 10 years after macroeconomic recovery. Taking advantage of micro-level data collected in 2012 and 2014, we assess long-term impacts on health and education. After controlling for age-in-months and survey effects as well as a linear birth year-cohort trend that varies by region, we find that after 12-16 years, the cohorts born during the recession report height-for-age Z-scores that are 0.003 standard deviations (SDs) lower for each month of exposure and have 0.002 fewer years of schooling per month exposed compared to the cohorts born outside the recession years. Children exposed to the entire crisis are 0.063 SDs smaller and have 0.042 years less of schooling. Girls have lower health outcomes than boys. Concomitantly, we show that selective childbearing or excess infant mortality are unlikely to drive our results. The persistence of the negative effects points to the existence of a poverty trap suggesting that policy interventions in response to (economic) crizes should be extended beyond macroeconomic recovery to counteract long-term, micro-level consequences.

10.1002/hec.4742.abstractZh: 本文提供了关于1999年厄瓜多尔经济危机对人类资本形成长期影响的证据。我们观察到，在危机期间出生的儿童，其负面影响在宏观经济恢复超过10年后仍然可见。利用2012年和2014年收集的微层面数据，我们评估了健康和教育方面的长期影响。在控制了年龄、调查效应以及不同地区的线性出生年份-群体趋势后，我们发现，在危机期间出生的群体，其身高年龄的Z分数每暴露一个月就低0.003标准差，受教育年限每暴露一个月则减少0.002年。在整个危机期间暴露的儿童，其身高年龄的Z分数低0.063标准差，受教育年限少0.042年。女孩的健康状况比男孩更差。同时，我们指出，选择性生育或过高的婴儿死亡率不太可能是导致这些结果的因素。这些负面影响的持续存在表明，存在一种贫困陷阱，因此应对经济危机的政策干预应超越宏观经济恢复阶段，以抵消长期的微观层面后果。

abstract.text: Besides medical expenses, hospitalizations associated with air pollution will incur the welfare loss due to activity restrictions and the wage loss due to inability to work. We fill in the gap in the literature by examining the impact of air pollution on volume and intensity of hospitalizations, which allows us to incorporate the welfare loss and the wage loss. Using a data set that covers most of the inpatients in a major Chinese city during 2015-16, we find that worse air quality causes more hospital admissions, more total inpatient days, and higher total inpatient expenditure for various diseases, particularly diseases of the respiratory and circulatory systems. We also find that there would be an underestimate of the loss from air pollution if we had ignored the loss associated with activity restrictions and the wage loss during hospitalization.

10.1002/hec.4743.abstractZh: 除了医疗费用外，与空气污染相关的住院还会造成因活动限制而导致的福利损失，以及因无法工作而导致的工资损失。我们通过研究空气污染对住院次数和住院强度的影响，填补了相关文献的空白，从而能够将福利损失和工资损失纳入考量。利用2015-2016年期间中国某主要城市大部分住院患者的数据，我们发现空气质量恶化会导致更多的住院病例、更长的住院总天数，以及各类疾病的总住院费用增加，尤其是呼吸系统和循环系统的疾病。我们还发现，如果忽略与活动限制相关的损失以及住院期间的工资损失，对空气污染造成的损失的估计将会偏低。

abstract.text: An ongoing body of research documents that women empowerment is associated with improved outcomes for children. However, little is known about the long-run effects on health outcomes. This paper adds to this literature and studies the association between maternal exposure to suffrage reforms and children's old-age longevity. We utilize changes in suffrage laws across US states and over time as a source of incentivizing maternal investment in children's health and education. Using the universe of death records in the US over the years 1979-2020 and implementing a difference-in-difference econometric framework, we find that cohorts exposed to suffrage throughout their childhood live 0.6 years longer than unexposed cohorts. Furthermore, we show that these effects are not driven by preexisting trends in longevity, endogenous migration, selective fertility, and changes in the demographic composition of the sample. Additional analysis reveals that improvements in education and income are candidate mechanisms. Moreover, we find substantial improvements in early-adulthood socioeconomic standing, height, and height-for-age outcomes due to childhood exposure to suffrage movements. A series of state-level analyses suggest reductions in infant and child mortality following suffrage law change. We also find evidence that counties in states that passed the law experienced new openings of County Health Departments and increases in physicians per capita.

10.1002/hec.4744.abstractZh: 现有研究文献表明，女性赋权与儿童的健康状况改善有关。然而，关于其对长期健康影响的了解却很少。本文进一步探讨了母亲参与选举权改革与儿童老年寿命之间的关系。我们通过分析美国各州在选举权法律上的变化，将其作为激励母亲投资于儿童健康和教育的因素。利用1979年至2020年美国死亡记录数据，并采用差异分解计量经济学框架进行分析，我们发现，童年时期经历过选举权改革的群体比未经历过这一改革的群体多活0.6年。此外，我们发现这些效应并非由先前的寿命趋势、内生性迁移、选择性生育行为或样本人口结构的变化所驱动。进一步分析表明，教育和收入的改善可能是导致这种效应的机制。我们还发现，由于童年时期参与选举权运动，成年初期的社会经济地位、身高以及身高与年龄的比例都有所改善。一系列州级分析显示，选举权法律变更后，婴儿和儿童死亡率有所下降。此外，我们还发现，通过选举权的州内，县卫生部门的新设立以及人均医生数量的增加也与此相关。

abstract.text: Teenage fertility is a social problem because of its private and public costs in countries of different development levels. Reductions in adolescent birth rates do not necessarily follow drops in overall fertility due to the demographic transition model. This paper analyses the impact of a subdermal contraceptive program on repeat teenage motherhood. Using a regression discontinuity design, we find that the intervention reduced mothers' likelihood of having another child in the next 48 months by 10 percentage points. This reduction is not random, and we also identify small positive selection in subsequent births.

10.1002/hec.4745.abstractZh: 青少年生育问题是一个社会问题，因为它在不同发展水平的国家中涉及私人和公共成本。由于人口转型模型的影响，青少年出生率的下降并不一定伴随着总体生育率的下降。本文分析了一种皮下避孕计划对青少年再次成为母亲的影响。通过回归 discontinuity 设计，我们发现该干预措施使母亲在接下来的48个月内再次生育的概率降低了10个百分点。这种降低并非随机现象，我们还发现后续生育中存在小的正向选择效应。

abstract.text: Although Australia maintains relatively high standards of health and healthcare, there exists disparity in health outcomes and longevity among different segments of the population. Internationally, there is growing evidence that life expectancy gains are not being shared equally among the rich and the poor. In this paper we examine the evolution of mortality inequality in Australia between 2001 and 2018. Using a spatial inequality model and combining data from several administrative data sources, we document significant mortality inequality between the rich and the poor in Australia. For most age groups, mortality inequality has remained unchanged over the last 20 years. However, mortality inequality is increasing for middle-aged men and women. In part, this can be explained by improvements in longevity which favor urban over rural Australians. Another contributing factor we identify is differential access to healthcare in rich and poor regions. Although Australia's socioeconomic gradient of mortality is flatter than in the US, due to universal health coverage, the fact that mortality inequality is increasing for some groups accentuates the importance of safeguarding health care accessibility.

10.1002/hec.4746.abstractZh: 尽管澳大利亚在健康与医疗保健方面保持着相对较高的标准，但不同人群在健康结果和寿命方面仍存在差异。国际上有越来越多的证据表明，预期寿命的增长并没有在富人和穷人之间公平分配。本文研究了2001年至2018年间澳大利亚死亡率不平等的变化情况。通过运用空间不平等模型并结合多个行政数据来源，我们发现澳大利亚的贫富之间仍然存在显著的死亡率不平等。对于大多数年龄组来说，过去20年死亡率不平等状况并未发生变化。然而，中年男性和女性的死亡率不平等却在加剧。部分原因可以归因于寿命的延长，这有利于城市居民而非农村居民。另一个因素是贫富地区在医疗保健方面的差异。尽管澳大利亚的死亡率社会经济梯度比美国更为平缓，但由于全民健康覆盖政策的实施，某些群体的死亡率不平等现象仍在加剧，这凸显了保障医疗保健可及性的重要性。

abstract.text: A growing body of evidence indicates that poor health early in life can leave lasting scars on adult health and economic outcomes. While much of this literature focuses on childhood experiences, mechanisms generating these lasting effects-recurrence of illness and interruption of human capital accumulation-are not limited to childhood. In this study, we examine how an episode of depression experienced in early adulthood affects subsequent labor market outcomes. We find that, at age 50, people who had met diagnostic criteria for depression when surveyed at ages 27-35 earn 10% lower hourly wages (conditional on occupation), work 120-180 fewer hours annually, and earn 24% lower annual wage incomes. A portion of this income penalty (21%-39%) occurs because depression is often a chronic condition, recurring later in life. But a substantial share (25%-55%) occurs because depression in early adulthood disrupts human capital accumulation, by reducing work experience and by influencing selection into occupations with skill distributions that offer lower potential for wage growth. These lingering effects of early depression reinforce the importance of early and multifaceted intervention to address depression and its follow-on effects in the workplace.

10.1002/hec.4747.abstractZh: 越来越多的证据表明，生命早期的健康问题会对成年后的健康和经济状况产生持久的影响。虽然许多研究集中在童年经历上，但导致这些持久影响的机制——如疾病的反复出现以及人力资本积累的中断——并不仅限于童年时期。在这项研究中，我们探讨了成年早期经历的一次抑郁发作对后续劳动力市场结果的影响。研究发现，在50岁时，那些在27至35岁时被诊断为抑郁的人，其每小时工资会低10%（以职业为准），每年工作时间会减少120至180小时，年度工资收入也会降低24%。这部分收入损失的原因在于，抑郁通常是一种慢性疾病，会在以后的生活中反复出现。但还有相当一部分损失（25%至55%）是由于成年早期抑郁破坏了人力资本积累，通过减少工作经验以及影响职业选择，使得从事的职业的技能分布不利于工资增长。这些早期抑郁的持久影响凸显了早期进行多方面干预以解决抑郁及其对工作场所的影响的重要性。

abstract.text: Studies on health insurance coverage often rely on measures self-reported by respondents, but the accuracy of such measures has not been thoroughly validated. This paper is the first to use linked Australian National Health Survey and administrative population tax data to explore the accuracy of self-reported private health insurance (PHI) coverage in survey data. We find that 11.86% of individuals misreport their PHI coverage status, with 11.57% of true PHI holders reporting that they are uninsured and 12.37% of true non-insured persons self-identifying as insured. Our results show reporting errors are systematically correlated with individual and household characteristics. Our evidence on the determinants of errors is supportive of common reasons for misreporting. We directly investigate biases in the determinants of PHI enrollment using survey data. We find that, as compared to administrative data, survey data depict a quantitatively different picture of PHI enrollment determinants, especially those capturing age, gender, language proficiency, labor force status, disability status, number of children in the household, or household income. We also show that PHI coverage misreporting is subsequently associated with misreporting of reasons for purchasing PHI, type of cover and length of cover.

10.1002/hec.4748.abstractZh: 关于健康保险覆盖的研究通常依赖于受访者自我报告的指标，但这些指标的准确性尚未得到充分验证。本文首次利用澳大利亚国家健康调查的数据和行政人口税收数据，来探讨自我报告的私人健康保险覆盖情况的准确性。研究发现，有11.86%的人误报了自己的健康保险覆盖状态，其中11.57%的真实健康保险持有者表示自己没有保险，而12.37%的真实无保险者自认为是投保者。我们的结果显示，报告错误与个体和家庭特征存在系统性关联。关于错误发生原因的推论，我们的研究结果支持了常见的误报原因。我们直接使用调查数据来研究健康保险投保决定因素中的偏差。研究发现，与行政数据相比，调查数据对健康保险投保决定因素的描述有所不同，尤其是那些与年龄、性别、语言能力、劳动力状况、残疾状况、家庭子女数量或家庭收入相关的因素。我们还发现，健康保险覆盖的误报随后会伴随着购买健康保险原因的误报、保险类型以及保险期限的错误报告。

abstract.text: As retirement ages increase around the world, not all workers may be equally able to extend their working lives. In this article, we examine the health and labor market effects of an Italian pension reform that suddenly increased the normal retirement age up to 7 years for women and up to 2 years for men. To do this, we use linked labor and healthcare administrative data, jointly with survey data and difference-in-difference methods. Our results show that the reform was effective in postponing retirement among both genders, as pension claiming dropped substantially for older workers. However, there were also side effects as the reform significantly pushed previously employed men and women into unemployment and disability pension. Among women only, the reform also increased sick leave and hospitalizations related to mental health and injuries. These effects were driven by women with previously low health status, suggesting that undifferentiated and abrupt increases in pension age might harm more vulnerable workers. Coherently with the milder tightening of retirement age experienced by men, labor market responses were smaller in size, and they did not suffer any significant health effects.

10.1002/hec.4749.abstractZh: 随着全球退休年龄的上升，并非所有工人都能同样延长其工作寿命。在本文中，我们研究了意大利一项养老金改革的健康与劳动力市场影响。该改革突然将女性的正常退休年龄提高了7年，男性则提高了2年。为此，我们利用了关联的劳动力和医疗保健行政数据，并结合了调查数据和差异分解方法进行分析。研究结果表明，这项改革在推迟两性别的退休时间方面取得了成效，因为老年工人的养老金领取人数显著减少。然而，改革也带来了一些副作用，它使得之前就业中的男性和女性大量陷入失业和残疾养老金的困境。仅在女性中，改革还增加了与心理健康和受伤相关的病假和住院情况。这些影响主要出现在健康状况原本较低的女性身上，这表明不渐进且突然提高的退休年龄可能会伤害到更脆弱的工人。与男性经历的较为温和的退休年龄调整相比，劳动力市场的反应较小，且并未出现显著的健康影响。

abstract.text: Hardly any evidence exists on the effects of mental distress on refugee labor outcomes. We offer the first study on this topic in the context of Australia, one of the host countries with the largest number of refugees per capita in the world. Analyzing the Building a New Life in Australia longitudinal survey, we exploit the variations in traumatic experiences of refugees interacted with post-resettlement time periods to causally identify the impacts of refugee mental health. We find that worse mental health, as measured by a one-standard-deviation increase in the Kessler mental health score, reduces the probability of employment by 11.9% and labor income by 22.8%. These effects appear more pronounced for refugees that newly arrive or are without social networks, but they may be ameliorated with government support. These findings have significant implications for the development of health and labor policies, particularly regarding the integration of refugees within host countries.

10.1002/hec.4750.abstractZh: 关于精神困扰对难民劳动成果影响的证据几乎不存在。我们首次在澳大利亚这一全球人均难民数量最多的国家背景下，对这一主题进行了研究。通过分析“在澳大利亚建立新生活”的纵向调查数据，我们探讨了难民在重新安置后经历的各种创伤事件与心理健康状况之间的因果关系。研究发现，心理健康状况恶化，以Kessler心理健康评分标准差增加1为标准，会导致就业概率下降11.9%，劳动收入下降22.8%。对于新抵达的难民或缺乏社会网络的难民来说，这些影响更为明显，但政府支持可能有助于缓解这些影响。这些发现对卫生和劳动政策的发展具有重要意义，尤其是在难民融入东道国方面。

abstract.text: Many governments with dual public and private health systems offer subsidies for private health insurance (PHI) with the aim to ease the burden on the public system. Understanding how elderly individuals respond to these PHI subsidies is important because they typically have greater health care needs but often struggle with the affordability of PHI. However, prior studies provide little guidance on this issue because they have mainly focused on the responses to PHI incentives among the general population. This paper leverages a unique age-specific policy intervention in Australia that provided higher rebates for individuals over the age of 65. Using administrative tax data, we examine how this policy affected PHI take-up decisions of elderly individuals under an event study difference-in-differences framework. We find that higher rebates led to a modest increase in PHI take-up. The estimated price elasticities of PHI demand were in the -0.1 to -0.2 range in the first 2 years of the policy. Moreover, the demand responses were more elastic among those with low incomes. Our findings indicate that a more targeted subsidy program, specially tailored to low-income elders, would yield greater effectiveness in increasing PHI take-up.

10.1002/hec.4751.abstractZh: 许多拥有公共和私人双重医疗系统的政府都会提供私人健康保险补贴，以减轻公共医疗系统的负担。了解老年人对这些私人健康保险补贴的反应非常重要，因为他们的医疗需求通常更高，但往往难以负担私人健康保险。然而，先前的研究在这方面提供的指导很少，因为它们主要关注的是普通人群对私人健康保险激励措施的反应。本文利用了澳大利亚一项独特的针对特定年龄群体的政策干预措施，该措施为65岁以上的人群提供了更高的补贴。通过行政税收数据，我们研究了这一政策如何影响老年人选择私人健康保险的行为。研究发现，更高的补贴确实导致了私人健康保险使用率的适度增加。在政策实施的前两年，私人健康保险需求的弹性估计值在-0.1到-0.2之间。此外，低收入人群对私人健康保险的需求反应更为敏感。我们的研究结果表明，针对低收入老年人的更有针对性的补贴计划，将更有效地提高私人健康保险的使用率。

abstract.text: Based on comprehensive administrative health record data from Austria, this study examines how children's mental health responds to a severe parental health shock. To account for the endogeneity of a serious parental illness, our sample is restricted to children who experience the health shock of a parent at some point in time and we exploit the timing of shocks in a dynamic DID setting. We find a positive causal effect of parental health shocks on children's mental health care utilization. Affected children have higher medical attendance for the treatment of mental illnesses, consume more psychotropic drugs, and are more likely to be hospitalized with mental and behavioral disorders. A significant increase in the utilization of antidepressants, anxiolytics, and sedatives can be observed for older children, girls and children with a white-collar family background. Our findings have important policy implications for children's access to psychotherapies and mental health care after experiencing a traumatic household event.

10.1002/hec.4752.abstractZh: 基于奥地利全面的行政健康记录数据，本研究探讨了儿童心理健康如何对父母严重健康危机作出反应。为了考虑父母严重疾病的内生性，我们的样本仅限于那些在某一时期经历父母健康危机的儿童，并利用了动态 DID 模型中的危机时机分析。我们发现，父母健康危机对儿童心理健康护理的利用具有积极的因果效应。受影响的儿童更频繁地接受精神疾病治疗，消耗更多的精神药物，并且更有可能因精神行为障碍而住院。对于年龄较大的儿童、女孩以及来自白领家庭的儿童，抗抑郁药、抗焦虑药和镇静剂的利用显著增加。我们的研究结果对于儿童在经历家庭创伤事件后获得心理治疗和心理健康护理具有重要的政策意义。

abstract.text: None. Data sharing is not applicable to this article as no new data were created or analyzed in this study.

10.1002/hec.4753.abstractZh: 本文不涉及数据共享，因为本研究并未创建或分析任何新数据。

abstract.text: The effectiveness and cost of a public health intervention is dependent on complex human behaviors, yet health economic models typically make simplified assumptions about behavior, based on little theory or evidence. This paper reviews existing methods across disciplines for incorporating behavior within simulation models, to explore what methods could be used within health economic models and to highlight areas for further research. This may lead to better-informed model predictions. The most promising methods identified which could be used to improve modeling of the causal pathways of behavior-change interventions include econometric analyses, structural equation models, data mining and agent-based modeling; the latter of which has the advantage of being able to incorporate the non-linear, dynamic influences on behavior, including social and spatial networks. Twenty-two studies were identified which quantify behavioral theories within simulation models. These studies highlight the importance of combining individual decision making and interactions with the environment and demonstrate the importance of social norms in determining behavior. However, there are many theoretical and practical limitations of quantifying behavioral theory. Further research is needed about the use of agent-based models for health economic modeling, and the potential use of behavior maintenance theories and data mining.

10.1002/hec.4754.abstractZh: 公共卫生干预措施的有效性和成本取决于复杂的人类行为，然而，健康经济模型通常对行为做出简化的假设，而这些假设缺乏理论或证据支持。本文回顾了跨学科方法在将行为纳入模拟模型中的应用，探讨哪些方法可以在健康经济模型中得到应用，并指出了进一步研究的领域。这可能会带来更可靠的模型预测。被认定为能够改进行为改变干预措施因果路径建模的最有前景的方法包括计量经济分析、结构方程模型、数据挖掘和基于代理的建模；后者能够纳入对行为的非线性、动态影响，包括社会和空间网络的影响。共有22项研究在模拟模型中量化了行为理论。这些研究强调了将个体决策与环境和互动相结合的重要性，并证明了社会规范在行为决定中的作用。然而，量化行为理论存在许多理论和实践上的限制。需要进一步研究基于代理的模型在健康经济建模中的应用，以及行为维持理论和数据挖掘的潜在用途。

abstract.text: Opioid overdose has claimed the lives of over 340,000 Americans in the last decade. Over that same period, policymakers have taken steps to increase the availability of naloxone-an opioid antagonist used to rescue overdose victims-to people in the community. Previous studies, most of which have examined the effects of state laws designed to facilitate access to naloxone, have reached mixed conclusions about the effects of naloxone access on fatal and non-fatal overdoses. This paper exploits a unique policy experiment provided by two naloxone giveaways intended to increase naloxone possession among the general public in Pennsylvania to estimate the causal impact of naloxone distribution on fatal overdoses and opioid-related emergency department (ED) visits. Using a difference-in-differences design, I find evidence that opioid overdose deaths fell immediately following the first giveaway but increased following the second giveaway and discuss these apparently contradictory findings in the context of the changing composition of the opioid supply. I also find some evidence of a decline in opioid overdose-related ED visits following the giveaways. This study is the first to examine the effects of untargeted naloxone distribution and has implications for other novel, naloxone distribution efforts currently underway.

10.1002/hec.4755.abstractZh: 在过去十年中，阿片类药物过量导致超过340,000名美国人丧生。在同一时期，政策制定者采取了措施，增加naloxone的供应——这是一种用于解救过量用药者的阿片类拮抗剂。先前的研究大多探讨了旨在促进naloxone获取的州法律的效果，但这些研究对于naloxone获取对致命和非致命过量用药的影响得出了不同的结论。本文利用宾夕法尼亚州两项旨在增加公众持有naloxone的免费发放活动这一独特政策实验，来估计naloxone分发对致命过量用药和阿片类药物相关急诊就诊的影响。通过差异-差异设计，我发现第一次免费发放后阿片类药物过量死亡人数立即下降，而第二次免费发放后这一数字又有所增加。在阿片类药物供应结构变化的背景下，这些看似矛盾的研究结果需要进一步分析。此外，我还发现免费发放后阿片类药物过量相关急诊就诊人数有所减少。这项研究是首次探讨非目标性naloxone分发的影响，对于目前正在进行中的其他新型naloxone分发计划也具有启示意义。

abstract.text: This study examines the effects of early life and in utero exposure to cold weather shocks on the incidence of growth stunting for children under age five in Tanzania. We find that an increase of 10 percentage points in the proportion of days with temperatures below 15 degrees Celsius (one standard deviation below the long-term average) is associated with an increase in the probability of stunting and severe stunting by 2.0 and 1.4 percentage points (equivalent to 5.5 and 9.7 percent of the mean stunting and severe stunting), respectively. The results also show strong effects of in utero exposure during the second trimester of pregnancy on child stunting and wasting. In terms of the mechanisms, we find that the effects on disease environment, food insecurity, and reduced agricultural productivity are the possible channels driving the results.

10.1002/hec.4758.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了早年及子宫内暴露于寒冷天气对坦桑尼亚五岁以下儿童生长迟缓发生率的影响。研究发现，气温低于15摄氏度（低于长期平均温度一个标准差）的天数比例每增加10个百分点，儿童生长迟缓和严重生长迟缓的概率分别增加2.0个百分点和1.4个百分点（相当于平均生长迟缓和严重生长迟缓的5.5%和9.7%）。研究还显示，妊娠第二孕期子宫内暴露于寒冷天气对儿童生长迟缓和消瘦有显著影响。从机制上看，我们认为疾病环境、粮食不安全以及农业生产力下降可能是导致这些结果的关键因素。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Across OECD countries, integration between healthcare organisations has become an indispensable part of contemporary healthcare provision. In recent years, inter-organisational collaboration has increasingly been encouraged in health and competition policy at the expense of mergers. Yet, understanding of whether healthcare organisations make an active choice between merging and collaborating is lacking. Hence, this study systematically examines (i) healthcare executives' motives for integration, (ii) their potential trade-offs between collaborating or merging, and (iii) the barriers to collaborating perceived by them. METHODS: Early 2019, an online questionnaire was conducted among a nationwide panel of 714 healthcare executives in the Netherlands. Because of their strategic position within healthcare organisations as end-responsible managers, healthcare executives are especially suited to provide broad and in-depth knowledge on the internal and external processes and decisions. Three hundred thirty-seven Dutch healthcare executives completed the questionnaire (response rate 47%). This study sample was representative of the largest healthcare sectors in the Netherlands. In total, 137 mergers and 235 inter-organisational collaborations were reported. Both closed questions and open-ended questions were systematically analysed. RESULTS: Improving or broadening healthcare provision is the foremost motive for mergers as well as inter-organisational collaborations. When considering both types, reducing governance complexity is one of the decisive reasons to opt for a merger, whereas aversion towards a full merger and lack of support base within the own organisation convinced healthcare executives to choose for a collaboration. When comparing specific healthcare sectors, the overlap in pursued motives and sub-motives indicates that inter-organisational collaborations and mergers are used for comparable objectives. Only a small minority of the responding executives switched between both types of integration. Institutional barriers, such as laws, regulations and financing regimes, appear to be the most restricting for healthcare executives to engage in inter-organisational collaborations. CONCLUSIONS: Our integral approach and systematic comparison across sectors could serve policymakers, regulators and healthcare providers in aligning organisational objectives and societal objectives in decision-making on collaborations and mergers. Future research is recommended to study multiple collaboration and merger cases qualitatively for a detailed examination of decision-making by healthcare executives, and develop an integral assessment framework for balancing collaborations and mergers based on their effects in the medium to long term.

10.1002/hpm.3695.abstractZh:
背景：在 OECD 国家，医疗组织之间的整合已成为当代医疗服务的不可或缺的一部分。近年来，在健康与竞争政策方面，越来越多地鼓励组织间的合作，而非合并。然而，关于医疗组织是否会在合并与合作之间做出选择的问题，目前缺乏研究。因此，本研究系统地探讨了：(i) 医疗高管进行整合的动机；(ii) 他们在合作与合并之间的潜在权衡；以及(iii) 他们感知到的合作障碍。  
方法：2019年初，在荷兰的714名医疗高管中进行了在线问卷调查。由于医疗高管在医疗组织中的战略地位，他们特别适合提供关于内部和外部流程及决策的广泛而深入的信息。共有337名荷兰医疗高管参与了问卷调查，回复率为47%。该样本代表了荷兰最大的医疗行业。共记录了137次合并和235次组织间合作。对封闭式问题和开放式问题都进行了系统分析。  
结果：改善或扩大医疗服务是合并以及组织间合作的主要动机。在考虑这两种情况时，降低治理复杂性是选择合并的一个决定性因素，而厌恶完全合并以及缺乏组织内部的支持则促使医疗高管选择合作。在比较具体的医疗保健领域时，不同领域所追求的动机和子动机存在重叠现象，这表明跨组织间的合作与合并往往是为了实现相似的目标。只有少数高管在两种类型的整合之间进行了选择。制度性障碍，如法律法规和融资机制，似乎是对医疗保健高管进行跨组织合作的最大制约因素。结论：我们的整体方法和跨领域的系统比较可以为政策制定者、监管机构和医疗保健提供者提供有益的指导，帮助他们在对合作与合并的决策中平衡组织目标与社会目标。建议未来的研究能够定性地分析多个合作与合并案例，详细探讨医疗保健高管在决策过程中的行为，并开发一个综合评估框架，以基于中长期影响来平衡合作与合并的利弊。

abstract.text: Variation in assessor stringency in awarding benefits leaves applicants exposed to uninsured risk that could be systematic if discretion were exercised selectively. Using administrative data on disability insurance (DI) applications in the Netherlands, we show that even in one of the most rule‐based DI programs, there is still between assessor variation in awards, and there is systematic variation in assessment across applicants. Discretion is exercised in favor of lower‐wage applicants relatively more than it is used to benefit higher‐wage applicants. This is evident indirectly from downward discontinuities in pre‐disability wages just above benefit entitlement thresholds and directly from wage‐related differences in the extent to which assessors intervene in the semi‐automated calculation of earnings capacity. While lower‐wage applicants benefit on average, they are exposed to greater risk from between assessor variation in the exercise of discretion. Rule‐based disability evaluation can reduce, but not eliminate, between‐applicant variation in awards.

10.1002/pam.22560.abstractZh: 在评定福利时，评定人的严格程度存在差异，这使得申请人面临未投保的风险，如果评定权被选择性地行使，这种风险可能是系统性的。通过荷兰残疾保险申请数据的行政数据分析，我们发现即使在最遵循规则执行的残疾保险项目中，评定人之间的评定结果仍存在差异，而且不同申请人在评定过程中也表现出系统性差异。评定权更倾向于倾向于支持低工资申请的申请人，而不是高工资申请的申请人。这一点可以从残疾前工资的下降趋势间接看出，即工资在达到福利资格门槛后会出现下降；而工资相关的差异则直接体现在评定人对半自动化计算收入能力的干预程度上。虽然低工资申请的申请人平均而言受益更多，但他们因评定人行使评定权时的差异而面临更大的风险。基于规则的残疾评估虽然可以减少但无法完全消除申请者之间的评定结果差异。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVE: The Italian healthcare jurisdiction promotes patient mobility, which is a major determinant of practice variation, thus being related to the equity of access to health services. We aimed to explore how travel times, waiting times, and other efficiency- and quality-related hospital attributes influenced the hospital choice of women needing pelvic organ prolapse (POP) surgery in Tuscany, Italy. METHODS: We obtained the study population from Hospital Discharge Records. We duplicated individual observations (n = 2533) for the number of Tuscan hospitals that provided more than 30 POP interventions from 2017 to 2019 (n = 22) and merged them with the hospitals' list. We generated the dichotomous variable "hospital choice" assuming the value one when hospitals where patients underwent surgery coincided with one of the 22 hospitals. We performed mixed logit models to explore between-hospital patient choice, gradually adding the women's features as interactions. RESULTS: Patient choice was influenced by travel more than waiting times. A general preference for hospitals delivering higher volumes of interventions emerged. Interaction analyses showed that poorly educated women were less likely to choose distant hospitals and hospitals providing greater volumes of interventions compared to their counterpart. Women with multiple comorbidities more frequently chose hospitals with shorter average length of stay. CONCLUSION: Travel times were the main determinants of hospital choice. Other quality- and efficiency-related hospital attributes influenced hospital choice as well. However, the effect depended on the socioeconomic and clinical background of women. Managers and policymakers should consider these findings to understand how women behave in choosing providers and thus mitigate equity gaps.

10.1007/s10198-022-01563-6.abstractZh:
目的：意大利的医疗保健体系鼓励患者流动，这是实践差异的主要决定因素，因此与获得健康服务的公平性密切相关。本研究旨在探讨旅行时间、等待时间以及其他与效率和质量相关的医院属性如何影响意大利托斯卡纳地区需要盆腔器官脱垂手术的女性选择医院的行为。  
方法：我们从医院出院记录中获取了研究人群数据。我们将2017至2019年间提供超过30次盆腔器官脱垂手术服务的22家托斯卡纳医院中的个体观察数据复制为2533个，并将其与医院列表进行合并。我们创建了一个二元变量“医院选择”，当患者接受手术的医院与这22家医院中的某一家相同时，该变量的值为1。我们通过混合逻辑回归模型来探讨医院之间的患者选择行为，并逐步将女性的特征作为交互项纳入模型中。  
结果：相比等待时间，旅行时间对患者的选择影响更大。总体而言，患者更倾向于选择提供更多手术服务的医院。交互分析显示，教育程度较低的女性不太可能选择距离较远或提供较少手术服务的医院。同时，患有多种合并症的女性更常选择平均住院时间较短的医院。  
结论：旅行时间是决定医院选择的主要因素。其他与质量和效率相关的医院属性也对医院选择产生影响。然而，这种影响取决于女性的社会经济背景和临床状况。管理者和决策者应充分考虑这些发现，以了解女性在选择医疗服务提供者时的行为，从而缩小公平性差距。

abstract.text: All organizations need to allocate labor to production and administration. In many cases—particularly within the public sector—the optimal allocation is far from obvious. Indeed, vocal concerns have been raised about the administrative burden in several public services, not least in education. We investigate this issue using detailed registry data on all employees at Swedish universities and colleges from 2005 to 2019 and document three stylized facts. First, the group of highly educated administrators has grown rapidly, almost by a factor of seven compared with teachers and researchers. Second, the number of less-educated administrators has stayed flat. Third, the time that teachers and researchers spend on administrative tasks has been roughly constant over time. This indicates that resources have been diverted from teaching and research and raises fears of excessive administrative growth in Swedish higher education.

10.1007/s10602-023-09408-x.abstractZh: 所有组织都需要将劳动力分配到生产和行政工作中。在许多情况下——尤其是在公共部门——最优的分配方式并不明显。实际上，人们对一些公共服务的行政负担提出了担忧，尤其是在教育领域。我们通过使用2005年至2019年间瑞典各大学和学院所有员工的详细登记数据来研究这个问题，并发现了三个显著的事实。首先，受过高等教育的管理人员数量迅速增长，与教师和研究人员相比，其数量几乎增加了七倍。其次，受教育程度较低的管理人员数量保持不变。第三，教师和研究人员在行政任务上花费的时间大致保持不变。这表明资源从教学和研究领域转移出去，引发了人们对瑞典高等教育中行政负担过重的担忧。

abstract.text: The coronavirus infection COVID-19 killed millions of people around the world in 2019-2022. Hospitals were in the forefront in the battle against the pandemic. This paper proposes a novel approach to assess the effectiveness of hospitals in saving lives. We empirically estimate the production function of COVID-19 deaths among hospital inpatients, applying Heckman's two-stage approach to correct for the bias caused by a large number of zero-valued observations. We subsequently assess performance of hospitals based on regression residuals, incorporating contextual variables to convex quantile regression. Data of 187 hospitals in England over a 35-week period from April to December 2020 is divided in two sub-periods to compare the structural differences between the first and second waves of the pandemic. The results indicate significant performance improvement during the first wave, however, learning by doing was offset by the new mutated virus straits during the second wave. While the elderly patients were at significantly higher risk during the first wave, their expected mortality rate did not significantly differ from that of the general population during the second wave. Our most important empirical finding concerns large and systematic performance differences between individual hospitals: larger units proved more effective in saving lives, and hospitals in London had a lower mortality rate than the national average.

10.1007/s10729-023-09634-7.abstractZh: 2019-2022年间，冠状病毒感染COVID-19在全球范围内导致数百万人死亡。医院在抗击疫情的斗争中处于最前线。本文提出了一种评估医院在拯救生命方面的有效性的新方法。我们通过应用Heckman的两阶段方法，对医院内住院患者因COVID-19死亡的数量进行了实证估计，以纠正大量零值观测数据带来的偏差。随后，我们基于回归残差来评估医院的表现，并纳入了情境变量以进行凸分位数回归分析。数据来自2020年4月至12月35周期间英格兰的187家医院，将数据分为两个子时期，以比较疫情第一波和第二波之间的结构差异。结果表明，在疫情第一波期间，医院的表现有显著改善，然而在第二波疫情期间，由于新变异病毒的威胁，这种改进被抵消了。虽然在疫情第一波期间，老年患者的死亡风险明显更高，但在第二波疫情期间，他们的预期死亡率与普通人群没有显著差异。我们最重要的实证发现是，不同医院之间的表现存在较大且系统的差异：规模较大的医院在拯救生命方面更为有效，而伦敦的医院死亡率低于全国平均水平。

abstract.text: In the wake of hospital reforms introduced in 2011 in Turkey, public hospitals were grouped into associations with joint management and some shared operational and administrative functions, similar in some ways to hospital trusts in the English National Health Service. Reorganization of public hospitals effect hospital and market area characteristics and existence of hospitals. The objective of this study is to examine the effect of closure on competitive hospital performances. Using administrative data from Turkish Public Hospital Statistical Yearbooks for the years 2005 to 2007 and 2014 to 2017, we conducted a three-step efficiency analysis by incorporating data envelopment analysis (DEA) and propensity score matching techniques, followed by a difference-in-differences (DiD) regression. First, we used bootstrapped DEA to calculate the efficiency scores of hospitals that were located near hospitals that had been closed. Second, we used nearest neighbour propensity score matching to form control groups and ensure that any differences between these and the intervention groups could be attributed to being near a hospital that had closed rather than differences in hospital and market area characteristics. Lastly, we employed DiD regression analysis to explore whether being near a closed hospital had an impact on the efficiency of the surviving hospitals while considering the effect of the 2011 hospital reform policies. To shed light on a potential time lag between hospital closure and changes in efficiency, we used various periods for comparison. Our results suggest that the efficiency of public hospitals in Turkey increased in hospitals that were located near hospitals that closed in Turkey from 2011. Hospital closure improves the efficiency of competitive hospitals under hospital market reforms. Future studies may wish to examine the efficiency effects of government and private sector collaboration on competition in the hospital market.

10.1007/s10729-023-09661-4.abstractZh: 在2011年土耳其实施医院改革后，公立医院被划分为具有共同管理的协会，并共享一些运营和行政职能，这在某种程度上类似于英国国民健康服务系统中的医院信托机构。公立医院的重组影响了医院和市场区域的特征以及医院的存在状况。本研究的目的是探讨关闭医院对医院竞争力的影响。我们利用土耳其公立医院统计年鉴中的行政数据，对2005至2007年以及2014至2017年的数据进行了三步效率分析，包括数据包络分析（DEA）和倾向得分匹配技术，随后进行了差异-差异回归分析。首先，我们使用自举法DEA来计算那些位于已关闭医院附近的医院的效率得分。其次，我们使用最近邻倾向得分匹配法形成对照组，以确保这些对照组与干预组之间的任何差异都可以归因于靠近已关闭的医院，而不是医院和市场区域特征的差异。最后，我们采用差异-差异回归分析来探讨靠近已关闭医院是否会对幸存医院的效率产生影响，同时考虑2011年医院改革政策的影响。为了揭示医院关闭与效率变化之间的潜在时间滞后，我们使用了多个时期进行比较。我们的研究结果表明，自2011年以来，土耳其公立医院在那些位于已关闭医院附近的医院的效率有所提高。医院关闭确实提高了医院市场改革下竞争医院的效率。未来的研究可能会探讨政府和私营部门合作对医院市场竞争效率的影响。

abstract.text: Under Hungary's single payer health care system, hospitals face an annual budget cap on most of their diagnoses-related group based reimbursements. In July 2012, percutaneous coronary intervention (PCI) treatments of acute myocardial infarction were exempted from that hospital level budget cap. We use countrywide individual-level patient data from 2009 to 2015 to map the effect of such a quasi-experimental change in monetary incentives on health provider decisions and health outcomes. We find that direct admissions into PCI-capable hospitals increase, especially in central Hungary, where there are several hospitals which can compete for patients. The proportion of PCI treatments at PCI-capable hospitals, however, does not increase, and neither does the number of patient transfers from non-PCI hospitals to PCI-capable ones. We conclude that only patient pathways, plausibly influenced by hospital management, were affected by the shift in incentives, while physicians' treatment decisions were not. While average length of stay decreased, we do not find any effect on 30-day readmissions or in-hospital mortality.

10.1007/s10754-023-09349-w.abstractZh: 在匈牙利的单一支付者医疗体系中，医院在大多数与诊断相关的集体报销项目上面临年度预算上限。2012年7月，急性心肌梗塞的经皮冠状动脉介入治疗被免除这一医院级别的预算限制。我们利用2009至2015年的全国个体患者数据，来研究这种货币激励机制的准实验性变化对医疗服务提供者决策和健康结果的影响。研究发现，能够开展PCI治疗的医院的直接入院人数有所增加，尤其是在匈牙利中部地区，那里有几家医院能够竞争患者资源。然而，能够开展PCI治疗的医院中的PCI治疗比例并未增加，从非PCI医院到这些医院的转院数量也没有增加。我们得出结论，只有患者就诊路径受到了激励机制变化的影响，而医生的治疗决策并未受到影响。虽然平均住院时间有所减少，但我们并未发现其对30天再入院率或院内死亡率有任何影响。

abstract.text: I investigate the effect of competition on quality in the internet service provision industry: I examine both local competition within markets and multimarket contact among firms across markets. This industry offers an ideal setting, as quality is both objective and measurable. I use data from speedtest.net from 2008 to 2014 to estimate a reduced-form model of the effects of local competition and multimarket contact on realized consumer download speeds. I find that increased multimarket contact leads to decreased download speeds, which is consistent with the mutual forbearance hypothesis. I also find that duopolies lead to faster download speeds than do monopolies, but that further increases in the number of competitors decrease speeds.

10.1007/s11151-023-09928-8.abstractZh: 我研究了竞争对互联网服务行业质量的影响：我考察了市场内的局部竞争以及不同市场间企业的多市场联系。该行业提供了一个理想的实验环境，因为质量既是客观的，也是可测量的。我使用了2008至2014年来自speedtest.net的数据，来估计局部竞争和多市场联系对消费者实际下载速度的影响。我发现，多市场联系的增加会导致下载速度下降，这与相互克制假说一致。我还发现，双寡头结构下的下载速度比垄断结构下更快，但竞争者的数量进一步增加则会降低下载速度。

abstract.text: Since July 2021, Airbnb discloses whether listings in Paris hold a mandatory registration number to legally operate. Grounded on information asymmetries and moral hazard theories, this paper studies consumers' preferences for certifications of legality and minimum quality standards. We exploit the staggered disclosure of licences over time to evaluate the change in demand (reviews) compared to those that continue offering their properties without the licence. Event study and difference-in-differences estimates indicate that reviews for registered hosts increased by around 10 % relative to illegal operators. The effects are increasing over time as the licence becomes more salient to consumers. Our findings suggest that the disclosure of hosts' legal status is an effective mechanism to improve the enforcement of peer-to-peer markets regulation.

10.1016/j.annals.2023.103566.abstractZh: 自2021年7月以来，Airbnb开始披露巴黎的房源是否持有强制性的注册号码，以便合法运营。本文基于信息不对称性及道德风险理论，研究消费者对合法性认证和最低质量标准的偏好。我们通过分析许可证的逐步披露情况，评估了与持续提供无许可证房产的房源相比，注册房源的评论需求变化。事件研究和差异估计结果显示，注册房源的评论数量相对于非法房源增加了约10%。随着许可证对消费者的重要性日益凸显，这一影响将持续增强。我们的研究发现表明，披露房源的合法身份是改善点对点市场监管的有效机制。

abstract.text: Dialysis care in the United States is expensive and is mostly paid for by Medicare. To reduce the cost of providing dialysis services, the federal government has relied on a law that designates Medicare as a secondary payer in the first 30 months of dialysis. During this period, private health insurers are the primary payer and pay for the majority of dialysis-related costs. Private health insurers often pay substantially higher prices for dialysis care than does Medicare, possibly due to highly concentrated dialysis-provider markets. A perspective by Boumil and Curfmin in this journal discusses how a recent ruling by the US Supreme Court may limit Medicare's role as a secondary payer, potentially altering the economic relationship between dialysis providers and private insurers. Boumil and Curfmin discuss how these changes may ultimately promote competition in dialysis-provider markets and lower dialysis-related costs paid by private health insurers. We compare this viewpoint to responses and concerns voiced by other stakeholders in the kidney-care community and outline additional ways in which the Supreme Court's ruling may affect competition in dialysis markets and prices paid for dialysis by private insurers.

10.1016/j.clinthera.2023.01.015.abstractZh: 美国的透析护理费用高昂，主要由医疗保险承担。为了降低透析服务的成本，联邦政府依据一项法律，在透析的前30个月内将医疗保险作为次要支付方。在此期间，私人健康保险公司是主要支付方，承担大部分透析相关费用。私人健康保险公司通常支付比医疗保险更高的透析护理费用，这可能是由于透析服务提供者市场高度集中所致。Boumil和Curfmin在本期刊上发表的观点指出，美国最高法院最近的一项裁决可能会限制医疗保险作为次要支付方的角色，从而改变透析服务提供者与私人保险公司之间的经济关系。Boumil和Curfmin还讨论了这些变化如何最终促进透析服务提供者市场的竞争，并降低私人健康保险公司支付的透析相关费用。我们将这一观点与其他肾脏护理领域的利益相关者提出的反应和担忧进行了比较，并概述了最高法院的裁决可能以其他方式影响透析市场竞争以及私人保险公司支付的透析费用。

abstract.text: We examine whether quality affects the choice of practice by patients who are most likely to be well informed about quality: those who leave their practice and join another local practice without changing their address (non-movers). Using 2006/7–2010/11 data on 6766 English practices we estimate fixed effects panel count data models of the number of non-movers leaving a practice and of the number joining. Fewer non-movers leave a practice after increases in clinical quality, the proportion of patients satisfied with access, doctors per patient, and the proportion of doctors qualified in the UK. More join after increases in patient satisfaction with access and doctors per patient. A 10% increase in opening hours satisfaction is associated with a 5.75% reduction in non-movers leaving and a 2.9% increase in non-movers joining. Our results imply that improving information on quality will increase practice incentives to raise quality when competing for patients.

10.1016/j.econmod.2023.106395.abstractZh: 我们研究质量是否会影响那些对质量有充分了解的患者选择诊所的行为：那些离开现有诊所并加入另一家当地诊所但地址不变的患者（非迁移者）。利用2006/7至2010/11年的数据，对6766家英国诊所进行了研究，估计了非迁移者离开和加入诊所的数量的固定效应面板计数数据模型。临床质量提高后，离开诊所的非迁移者数量减少，而加入诊所的非迁移者数量增加。患者就医体验满意度提高以及每患者配备的医生数量增加后，加入诊所的非迁移者数量也增加。营业时间延长10%时，非迁移者离开诊所的数量减少5.75%，而加入诊所的非迁移者数量增加2.9%。我们的研究结果表明，提高关于质量的信息透明度将增加诊所在争夺患者时的质量提升动力。

abstract.text: Many governments have sought to enhance patient choice in hospital by intensifying competitive pressure on hospital administrations that is expected to improve efficiency, quality, and innovation. However, there is mixed evidence on whether patients travel past their local hospitals to seek better quality care and whether higher-income patients are those most sensitive to respond to competitive pressures. Using detailed data from 17 million inpatient stays admitted in France during 2019, this paper explores patients' choice of provider where for-profit, non-profit, research hospital and local hospitals are allowed to compete with each other. We estimate the extent to which deprivation gradient plays on patient's choice of provider. We found that, in general, patients travel for their care, with just one-quarter of them going to the nearest hospital. In fact, the most vulnerable patients (i.e., those socio-economically deprived, and very aged) are mostly treated in local public hospitals with the lowest quality service level, and with large variability in quality as well, while those with less socio-economic deprivation seek care at higher-quality for-profit hospitals. Our counterfactual simulations show that admission to university hospitals attenuates existing inequalities. However, whether it delays the healthcare access sought by this population remains an open question.

10.1016/j.ehb.2023.101282.abstractZh: 许多政府试图通过加大对医院管理层的竞争压力来提高患者的选择自由度，以期提升效率、质量和创新性。然而，关于患者是否会前往当地医院以外的地方寻求更好的医疗服务，以及收入较高的患者是否对竞争压力最为敏感，目前尚无明确证据。本文利用2019年法国1700万住院病例的详细数据，研究了患者在选择医疗服务提供者时的行为，其中营利性医院、非营利性医院、研究型医院和当地医院之间存在竞争关系。我们评估了贫困程度对病人选择医疗服务提供者的影响。研究发现，总体而言，患者会前往更好的医疗机构接受治疗，只有四分之一的患者选择最近的医院。实际上，最脆弱的患者（即社会经济地位较低且年龄较大者）大多在当地公立医院接受治疗，这些公立医院的医疗服务质量较低，且质量差异较大。而那些社会经济状况较好的患者则更倾向于选择质量更高的营利性医院。我们的反事实模拟结果显示，进入大学医院有助于缓解现有的不平等现象。然而，这种改变是否能够延迟这些人群寻求医疗服务的需求，仍是一个未解决的问题。

abstract.text: Introduction In response to intense market pressures, many hospitals have consolidated into systems. However, evidence suggests that consolidation has not led to the improvements in clinical quality promised by proponents of mergers. The challenges to delivering care within expanding health systems and the opportunities posed to surgical leaders remains largely unexplored. Methods Semistructured interviews with 30 surgical leaders at teaching hospitals affiliated with health systems from August-December 2019. Interviews were transcribed verbatim and coded in an iterative process using MaxQDA software. Attitudes and strategies toward redesigning health care delivery across expanding systems were analyzed using thematic analysis. Results Leaders reported challenges to redesigning care delivery across the system ranging from resource constraints (e.g. hospital beds and operating rooms) to evolving market demands (e.g., patient preferences to receive care close to home). However, participants also highlighted that system expansion provided multiple opportunities to increase access (e.g. decant low-complexity care to affiliated centers) and improve quality of care (e.g. standardize best practices) for diverse populations including the potential to leverage their health system to expand access and improve quality. Conclusions Though evidence suggests that hospital consolidation has not led to redesigned care delivery or improved clinical quality at a national level, leaders are pursuing varying sets of strategies aimed at leveraging system expansion in order to improve access and quality of care.

10.1016/j.hjdsi.2023.100722.abstractZh:
引言  
面对激烈的市场压力，许多医院纷纷进行合并，形成更大的医疗系统。然而，有证据表明，这种合并并未如支持合并的人士所承诺的那样，带来临床质量的提升。在不断扩大的医疗系统中提供医疗服务所面临的挑战，以及外科领域领导者所面临的机遇，目前仍缺乏深入的研究。  

方法  
2019年8月至12月期间，对30位隶属于医疗系统的教学医院的外科领域领导者进行了半结构化访谈。访谈记录被逐字转录，并借助MaxQDA软件进行编码分析。通过主题分析，研究了他们对在扩展的医疗系统中重新设计医疗服务方式的态度和策略。  

结果  
领导者们报告了在系统范围内重新设计医疗服务所面临的挑战，这些挑战包括资源限制（如医院床位和手术室数量不足）以及市场需求的变化（如患者希望获得离家较近的医疗服务）。然而，参与者也指出，系统扩展为提升医疗服务质量提供了多种机会，例如将低复杂度的医疗服务转移到附属中心，以及通过标准化最佳实践来提高不同群体的医疗服务质量。此外，他们还有可能利用自己的医疗系统来扩大服务范围并提升服务质量。  

结论  
尽管有证据表明，医院合并并未在国家级层面带来医疗服务的重新设计或临床质量的提升，但领导者们仍在探索各种策略，以利用系统扩展的优势，从而改善医疗服务质量和可及性。

abstract.text: We examine the negative child health impacts of soil zinc (Zn) deficiency in Nepal. Soil Zn deficiency limits both crop yields and the Zn concentration in food crops, leading many to speculate that it underlies human Zn deficiency and child stunting, globally and particularly in South Asia. We find strong evidence that soil Zn deficiency does have a causal impact on child stunting in Nepal's Tarai region, the breadbasket of the country. Using causal bounds, we find that a 1 part per million increase in plant-available soil Zn - achievable with application of Zn-enriched fertilizer - decreases child stunting by between 1 and 7.5 percentage points. Multiple statistical sensitivity tests indicate that this relationship is unlikely to be manufactured by omitted, relevant variables.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102691.abstractZh: 我们研究了土壤锌缺乏对尼泊尔儿童健康的负面影响。土壤锌缺乏会限制作物产量和粮食作物中的锌含量，许多人因此推测，这一现象在全球范围内，尤其是在南亚地区，是导致人类锌缺乏和儿童生长迟缓的重要原因。我们发现，土壤锌缺乏确实对尼泊尔塔莱地区的儿童生长迟缓有因果影响，该地区是尼泊尔的农业重地。通过因果界限分析，我们发现，当土壤中的植物可利用锌含量增加1百万分之一——这可以通过施用富含锌的肥料来实现——儿童生长迟缓的程度可以减少1到7.5个百分点。多项统计敏感性测试表明，这种关系不太可能是由遗漏的相关变量人为制造出来的。

abstract.text: Prior research has examined how late 1980s pregnancy-related Medicaid eligibility expansions influenced outcomes around the time of birth and, more recently, adult outcomes. We offer a close examination of early childhood effects to better understand the mechanism(s) underlying the improved longer-term outcomes. The restricted-access National Maternal and Infant Health Survey allows us to explore the effects of these expansions on maternal and child outcomes near the time of birth as well as three years post-birth. Our evidence suggests earlier connection with prenatal care and possible modest improvements in birthweight and gestational age. In our follow-up data, we also identify evidence of persistent effects as measured by child developmental scores. However, the most consistent finding is our strong evidence of reduced levels of maternal depression-both during the child's infancy and three years later. We conclude that the alleviation of maternal stress is one likely mechanism for the longer-term improvements in later-life outcomes identified in studies of children exposed to Medicaid in-utero and in early infancy.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102695.abstractZh: 先前的研究已经探讨了20世纪80年代后期与妊娠相关的医疗补助资格扩展对分娩时及成年后的结果产生的影响。我们进一步深入探讨了早期儿童阶段的影响，以更好地理解导致长期改善结果的机制。通过受限访问的全国母婴健康调查，我们能够探究这些扩展措施对分娩前后及产后三年的母婴结果的影响。我们的证据表明，更早接触产前护理可能有助于改善出生体重和胎龄。在后续数据中，我们还发现了儿童发育评分所反映的持续影响。然而，最一致的发现是，我们获得了强有力的证据，表明母亲在婴儿期和三年后抑郁水平有所降低。我们得出结论，减轻母亲的压力可能是导致在子宫内和婴儿早期接触医疗补助的儿童在后期生活中取得改善的一个可能机制。

abstract.text: This study finds that experiencing early childhood health shocks before primary school exerts negative externalities in the middle school classroom. Students randomly assigned to classrooms in which more classmates experienced early childhood health shocks are more likely to have worse social-emotional outcomes, including emotional distress, less engagement with school activities, and poor social acclimation with classmates. These effects operate by damaging inter-student relationships, and are unlikely to operate by affecting teachers' behaviors or preferences. Parents may mitigate negative peer effects by encouraging children to talk about their concerns or interactions at school. The effects on test scores are not statistically significant.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102698.abstractZh: 本研究发现，在小学阶段经历过健康冲击的学生，在中学课堂上会面临负面影响。被随机分配到那些有更多同学经历过健康冲击的班级的学生，其社会情感表现更差，包括情绪困扰、对学校活动的参与度降低以及与同学的社会适应能力较差。这些影响是通过破坏同学之间的关系来实现的，而不太可能通过影响教师的行为或偏好来产生。家长可以通过鼓励孩子谈论他们在学校中的担忧或互动情况，来减轻这些负面同伴效应。至于对考试成绩的影响，则没有统计学上的显著意义。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of local economic growth on infant mortality.
