We use geo-referenced data for non-migrating mothers from 46 developing countries and a total of 128 DHS survey rounds and combine it with nighttime luminosity data at a granular level. Using mother fixed effects we show that an increase in local economic activity significantly reduces the probability that the same mother loses a child before its first birthday.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102699.abstractZh: 我们估计了当地经济增长对婴儿死亡率的影响。我们使用了来自46个发展中国家的非迁移母亲的地缘数据，以及共计128轮人口与健康调查的数据，并将这些数据与详细的夜间光照数据相结合。通过引入母亲固定效应，我们发现当地经济活动的增加显著降低了同一母亲在婴儿未满一岁前失去孩子的概率。

abstract.text: We exploit shocks to US federal enforcement policy to assess how legal medical marijuana market size affects youth marijuana use and consequences for youth traffic-related fatalities. Using hand-collected data on state medical marijuana patient rates to develop a novel measure of market size, we find that legal market growth increases youth marijuana use. Likely mechanisms are lower prices and easier access. Youth die more frequently from alcohol-involved car accidents, suggesting complementarities for youths. The consequences of marijuana legalization for youth are not immediate, but depend on how supply-side regulations affect production and prices.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102700.abstractZh: 我们通过分析美国联邦执法政策的变动，来评估合法医用大麻市场规模对青少年大麻使用及与交通相关的青少年死亡事件的影响。利用手工收集的各州医用大麻患者比例数据，我们开发了一种新的市场规模衡量方法。研究发现，合法市场的增长确实增加了青少年的大麻使用量。可能的机制包括降低价格和增加获取便利性。青少年因酒精引发的车祸而死亡的情况更为常见，这表明大麻合法化对青少年具有互补性。大麻合法化的后果并非立竿见影，而是取决于供应方面的法规对生产和价格的影响。

abstract.text: Little is known about how patients dynamically respond to a forthcoming reduction in health care out-of-pocket prices. Using a kinked Donut Regression Discontinuity design with kinks entering and exiting the donut, we evaluate a Swedish cost-sharing policy, where primary care out-of-pocket prices were eliminated at age 85. We find evidence of forward-looking moral hazard with older adults delaying primary care visits up to four months before the out-of-pocket elimination and shifting these visits until shortly after. These health care delays are driven by non-urgent care: non-physician visits, planned visits and follow up visits. We find no evidence of severe negative health effects in the short-term as a result of the delay. Contrary to our finding of forward-looking behavior with respect to out-of-pocket prices, we do not find evidence of typical moral hazard, as we do not find a persistent increase in primary health care use after the copayment elimination.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102710.abstractZh: 关于患者如何动态应对即将降低的医疗保健自付费用，目前了解甚少。我们采用一种带有折点变化的甜甜圈回归不连续设计，评估了一项瑞典的成本分担政策，该政策规定85岁时取消初级保健的自付费用。我们发现，老年人在费用自付取消前甚至推迟至取消后不久才去接受初级保健服务，这种行为体现了前瞻性道德风险。这些延迟主要源于非紧急护理：非医生提供的检查、计划中的检查和随访。我们没有发现短期内这种延迟会对健康产生严重的负面影响。与我们对费用自付取消后出现的前瞻性行为的发现相反，我们没有发现典型的道德风险现象，因为我们在费用自付取消后并未观察到初级保健使用的持续增加。

abstract.text: We study the impact of financial incentives on the prescription behavior of physicians based on a recent reform in two large Swiss cities. The reform opened up an additional income channel for physician by allowing them to earn a markup on drugs they prescribe to their patients. We find that the reform leads to an increase in drug costs by about 4%-5% per patient translating to significantly higher physician earnings. The revenue increase can be decomposed into a substitution and rent-seeking component. Our analysis indicates that physicians engage in rent-seeking by substituting larger with smaller packages and by cherry-picking more profitable brands. Although patient health is not sacrificed, the rent-seeking behavior results in unnecessary costs for society.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102711.abstractZh: 我们基于瑞士两个大城市最近的一项改革，研究了财务激励对医生处方行为的影响。该改革为医生开辟了额外的收入渠道，使他们能够通过向患者开药获得额外利润。我们发现，这项改革导致每位患者的药物费用增加了约4%-5%，从而使医生的收入显著增加。收入的增加可以分解为替代效应和寻租效应。我们的分析表明，医生通过选择更小包装的药品或挑选更有利可图的品牌来进行寻租行为。尽管患者的健康没有受到影响，但这种寻租行为给社会带来了不必要的成本。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the consequences of the 2004 locust plague in Mali. We argue that in agricultural economies with a single harvest per year, this type of shock can affect households through two channels: first, a speculative/anticipatory effect that kicks in during the growing season, followed by a local crop failure effect after harvest. We document a substantial impact of the plague on crop price inflation before the harvest. Regarding health setbacks, children subject only to the speculative/anticipatory effect suffered as much as those exposed to the actual crop failure effect. The latter is more severe for children born in isolated areas.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102712.abstractZh: 本文研究了2004年蝗灾对马里农业经济的影響。我们认为，在每年只有一次收获的农业经济中，这种冲击可以通过两种途径影响家庭：首先是在生长季节产生的投机/预期效应，随后是在收获后出现的局部农作物歉收效应。我们观察到，在收获前，蝗灾对农作物价格通胀产生了显著的影响。在健康方面，仅受到投机/预期效应影响的儿童所遭受的损害与那些实际遭遇农作物歉收效应的儿童相当。对于出生在偏远地区的儿童来说，后者所受到的损害更为严重。

abstract.text: This paper analyzes the impact of retirement on informal care provision using nationally representative panel data from Australia. To establish causality, we exploit the gender and cohort specific eligibility age for the Australian Age Pension. We find no evidence of an impact of retirement (status or duration) on co-residential or extra-residential unpaid care provided by older individuals. The null effect of retirement on informal caregiving does not differ by the type of care recipient. Furthermore, we demonstrate that older people who postpone retirement reduce the amount of time they spend on other non-market activities to resolve the time conflict between unpaid care and extended employment. Our analysis indicates that the Australian Age Pension reform aimed at working career prolongation has not crowded out the supply of informal care.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102713.abstractZh: 本文利用澳大利亚具有全国代表性的面板数据，分析了退休对非正式照顾供给的影响。为了确立因果关系，我们利用了澳大利亚老年养老金的性别和年龄资格标准。研究发现，退休（状态或持续时间）并未对老年人提供的共同居住或非共同居住的无偿照顾产生显著影响。退休对非正式照顾的零效应在不同类型的照顾对象中并不存在差异。此外，我们还发现，推迟退休的老年人会将用于解决无偿照顾与延长工作时间之间时间冲突的时间用于其他非市场活动。我们的分析表明，旨在延长工作生涯的澳大利亚老年养老金改革并未挤占非正式照顾的供给。

abstract.text: We provide a unifying framework for the evaluation of population health. We formalize several axioms for social preferences over distributions of health. We show that a specific combination of those axioms characterizes a large class of population health evaluation functions combining concerns for quality of life, quantity of life and health shortfalls. We refer to the class as (unweighted) aggregations of health-adjusted life years (HALYs). Two focal (and somewhat polar) members of this family are the (unweighted) aggregations of quality-adjusted life years (QALYs), and of disability-adjusted life years (DALYs). We also provide new characterization results for these focal members that enable us to scrutinize their normative foundations and shed new light on their similarities and differences.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102714.abstractZh: 我们提供了一个统一的框架来评估人口健康。我们为对健康分布的社交偏好制定了若干公理。我们表明，这些公理的特定组合能够描述一大类人口健康评估函数，这些函数同时考虑了生活质量、生命数量以及健康不足问题。我们将这类函数称为“健康调整生命年”（HALYs）的（未加权）汇总。这一类别中的两个重点成员是“质量调整生命年”（QALYs）的（未加权）汇总，以及“残疾调整生命年”（DALYs）的（未加权）汇总。我们还为这些重点成员提供了新的特征描述结果，这些结果使我们能够深入探究它们的规范基础，并进一步了解它们之间的异同之处。

abstract.text: We analyse how payment systems for general practitioners (GPs) and hospital specialists affect inequalities in healthcare treatments, referrals, and patient health. We present a model of contracting with two providers, a GP and a hospital specialist, with patients differing in severity and socioeconomic status, and the GP only receiving an informative signal on severity. We investigate four health system configurations depending on whether the GP refers and the specialist treats only high-severity patients or patients with any severity. We show that an increase in the GP fee, which induces GPs to refer only high-severity patients, increases utilitarian welfare but also increases inequities in access to specialist visits. A reduction in the DRG reimbursement to hospital specialists, which induces specialists to treat only high-severity patients, increases utilitarian welfare but also increases inequities in access to specialist visits when the GP refers only high-severity patients.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102715.abstractZh: 我们分析了全科医生与医院专科医生之间的支付系统如何影响医疗治疗、转诊以及患者健康方面的不平等现象。我们构建了一个模型，其中涉及两位医疗服务提供者：全科医生和医院专科医生。患者之间的病情严重程度和社会经济地位各不相同，而全科医生仅接收关于病情严重程度的信息。我们研究了四种不同的医疗系统配置：一种是全科医生仅转诊病情严重的患者，另一种是专科医生仅治疗病情严重的患者；另一种则是全科医生与专科医生都治疗任何病情的患者。研究表明，提高全科医生的收费，促使他们只转诊病情严重的患者，虽然提升了功利性福利，但也加剧了患者获得专科就诊机会的不平等现象。相反，降低医院专科医生的DRG报销比例，促使他们只治疗病情严重的患者，虽然同样提升了功利性福利，但在全科医生仅转诊病情严重的患者的情况下，也加剧了患者获得专科就诊机会的不平等现象。

abstract.text: We study how patient-regarding altruism is formed by medical education. We elicit and structurally estimate altruistic preferences using experimental data from a large sample of medical students (N = 733) in Germany at different progress stages in their studies. The estimates reveal substantial heterogeneity in altruistic preferences of medical students. Patient-regarding altruism is highest for freshmen, significantly declines for students in the course of medical studies, and tends to increase again for last year students, who assist in clinical practice. Also, patient-regarding altruism is higher for females and positively associated to general altruism. Altruistic medical students have gained prior practical experience in healthcare, have lower income expectations, and are more likely to choose surgery and pediatrics as their preferred specialty.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102716.abstractZh: 我们研究了医学教育如何培养以患者为中心的利他主义。我们利用来自德国733名医学学生的实验数据，对利他主义偏好进行了实证分析。研究结果表明，医学学生的利他主义偏好存在显著的异质性。以患者为中心的利他主义在新生中最为明显，随着医学学习的深入而显著下降，而在实习期间的学生中则又有所上升。此外，女性学生的以患者为中心的利他主义水平较高，并且与一般的利他主义行为呈正相关。具有利他主义倾向的医学学生通常拥有更多的医疗实践经验，收入期望较低，并且更可能选择外科和儿科作为自己的专业方向。

abstract.text: We study the impact of health insurance expansion on medical spending, longevity and welfare in an OLG economy in which individuals purchase health care to lower mortality and medical progress is profit-driven. Three sectors are considered: final goods production; a health care sector, selling medical services to individuals; and an R&D sector, selling increasingly effective medical technology to the health care sector. We calibrate the model to the development of the US economy/health care system from 1965 to 2005 and study numerically the impact of the insurance expansion. We find that more extensive health insurance accounts for a large share of the rise in US health spending but also boosts the rate of medical progress. A welfare analysis shows that while the subsidization of health care through health insurance creates excessive health care spending, the gains in life expectancy brought about by induced medical progress more than compensate for this.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102717.abstractZh: 我们研究了健康保险扩展对医疗支出、寿命和福利的影响，研究背景设定在一个开放宏观逻辑（OLG）经济中，个体购买医疗保健以降低死亡率，而医学进步是由利润驱动的。我们考虑了三个部门：最终产品生产部门、向个人提供医疗服务的医疗保健部门，以及向医疗保健部门销售越来越有效的医疗技术的研发部门。我们将模型校准为1965年至2005年美国经济/医疗保健系统的发展情况，并通过数值模拟研究保险扩展的影响。我们发现，更广泛的健康保险占美国医疗支出增长的很大比例，但同时也促进了医学进步的速率。福利分析表明，虽然通过健康保险对医疗保健的补贴导致了过度的医疗支出，但由医学进步带来的预期寿命增加足以弥补这一损失。

abstract.text: We here address the causal relationship between the maternal genetic risk for depression and child human capital using UK birth-cohort data. We find that an increase of one standard deviation (SD) in the maternal polygenic risk score for depression reduces their children's cognitive and non-cognitive skill scores by 5 to 7% of a SD throughout adolescence. Our results are robust to a battery of sensitivity tests addressing, among others, concerns about pleiotropy and dynastic effects. Our Gelbach decomposition analysis suggests that the strongest mediator is genetic nurture (through maternal depression itself), with genetic inheritance playing only a marginal role.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102718.abstractZh: 本文探讨了母亲抑郁遗传风险与儿童人力资本之间的因果关系，使用了英国出生队列数据。研究发现，母亲抑郁多基因风险评分每增加一个标准差，其子女在青少年时期的认知和非认知技能得分就会降低5%至7%。我们的研究结果在一系列敏感性测试下依然保持稳定，这些测试涉及了多效性和世代传递等因素的考量。我们的Gelbach分解分析表明，最强的中介因素是遗传与后天环境的交互作用（即通过母亲抑郁本身），而遗传继承的作用则较为有限。

abstract.text: We study the effect of hospital admissions for specific conditions on wealth for the Dutch population aged 70-79. We consider 14 disease groups that affect mortality and disability to different extents. We apply a "difference-in-timing" design comparing individuals admitted in one year to similar individuals admitted later. Because the protection against income risks and medical spending is high, we can identify changes in saving behaviors driven by preferences for consumption, saving, and bequests, rather than by changes in budget constraints. Although the health shocks differ in mortality and disability, we find hardly any impact on wealth across conditions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102719.abstractZh: 我们研究了特定疾病导致的住院对荷兰70-79岁人群财富的影响。我们考虑了14个疾病组，这些疾病在不同程度上影响死亡率和残疾率。我们采用了“时间差异”设计，比较了一年内住院的个体与后来住院的类似个体。由于对收入风险和医疗支出的保护较高，我们可以识别出由消费、储蓄和遗产分配偏好驱动的储蓄行为变化，而非预算限制的变化。尽管这些健康冲击在死亡率和残疾率方面有所不同，但我们发现这些疾病对财富的影响几乎为零。

abstract.text: Over the past decade, rising youth use of e-cigarettes and other electronic nicotine delivery systems (ENDS) has contributed to aggressive regulation by state and local governments. Between 2010 and mid-2019, ten states and two large counties adopted ENDS taxes. We use two large national surveys (Monitoring the Future and the Youth Risk Behavior Surveillance System) to estimate the impact of ENDS taxes on youth tobacco use. We find that ENDS taxes reduce youth ENDS consumption, with estimated ENDS tax elasticities of -0.06 to -0.21. However, we estimate sizable positive cigarette cross-tax effects, suggesting economic substitution between cigarettes and ENDS for youth. These substitution effects are particularly large for frequent cigarette smoking. We conclude that the unintended effects of ENDS taxation may considerably undercut or even outweigh any public health gains.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102720.abstractZh: 在过去的十年中，青少年对电子香烟和其他电子尼古丁输送系统的使用日益增加，这促使州和地方政府采取严格的监管措施。从2010年到2019年中期，有十个州和两个大县实施了电子尼古丁输送系统税。我们利用两项全国性的调查数据（“未来监测”和“青少年风险行为监测系统”）来估算电子尼古丁输送系统税对青少年烟草使用的影响。研究发现，电子尼古丁输送系统税减少了青少年的电子尼古丁输送系统使用量，其弹性估计值为-0.06至-0.21。然而，我们估计了香烟与电子尼古丁输送系统之间的正向替代效应，这表明青少年在香烟和电子尼古丁输送系统之间进行了经济替代。这种替代效应在经常吸烟的青少年中尤为明显。我们得出结论，电子尼古丁输送系统税带来的意外影响可能会大大削弱甚至抵消任何公共卫生方面的收益。

abstract.text: We quantify the effect of statewide mask mandates in the United States in 2020. Our regression discontinuity design exploits county-level variation in COVID-19 outcomes across the border between states with and without mandates. State mask mandates reduced new weekly COVID-19 cases, hospital admissions, and deaths by 55, 11, and 0.7 per 100,000 inhabitants on average. The effect depends on political leaning with larger effects in Democratic-leaning counties. Our results imply that statewide mandates saved 87,000 lives through December 19, 2020, while a nationwide mandate could have saved 57,000 additional lives. This suggests that mask mandates can help counter pandemics, particularly if widely accepted.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102721.abstractZh: 我们量化了2020年美国全州口罩强制令的影响。我们的回归不连续设计利用了各州在COVID-19疫情结果上的差异，这些差异存在于有和没有强制令的州之间。全州范围的口罩强制令平均使每周的新增COVID-19病例、住院率和死亡人数分别减少了55例、11例和0.7例/10万人口。这一效果取决于政治倾向，在倾向于民主党的县中效果更为显著。我们的研究结果表明，截至2020年12月19日，全州范围的强制令挽救了87,000人的生命，而全国范围的强制令则可能再挽救57,000人的生命。这表明，口罩强制令有助于应对疫情，尤其是当这种措施被广泛接受时。

abstract.text: Exploiting high-frequency data from the Italian anti-violence helpline, police reports of domestic abuse and maltreatments, and a unique geolocalized dataset on killings of women, we show that the news coverage of a femicide triggers an increase in help-seeking behavior. The effect is detectable in the period following the news and in the province where the femicide has occurred. Additionally, help-seeking increases more when the general interest and news coverage are higher. These findings are consistent with a model in which femicide news increase expectations about future intimate partner violence in case no action is taken. Our results imply that recurrent information campaigns and public discussion can foster help-seeking from survivors of gender-based violence.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102722.abstractZh: 通过利用意大利反暴力热线的高频数据、警方关于家庭虐待和虐待行为的报告，以及关于女性被杀事件的独特地理定位数据集，我们发现关于女性被杀事件的媒体报道会引发寻求帮助的行为。这种效应在新闻发布后的时期以及女性被杀事件发生的省份都能被观察到。此外，当公众兴趣和媒体报道较高时，寻求帮助的行为会增加。这些发现与一种模型相符，该模型认为，如果未来没有采取行动，关于女性被杀事件的报道会增加人们对未来亲密伴侣暴力的预期。我们的研究结果表明，定期的信息宣传活动和公共讨论可以促进性别暴力幸存者的寻求帮助行为。

abstract.text: We examine the impact of the US drug crisis on children's living arrangements. Because factors that lead to drug use could also alter family structure, we instrument for the intensity of the drug crisis with cross-state exposure to marketing of the prescription opioid at the epicenter of the crisis. We find that the crisis increased the likelihood that a child lives away from a parent or in a household headed by a grandparent. Our results suggest that if drug use had remained at 1996 levels, 1.5 million fewer children aged 0-16 would have lived away from a parent in 2015.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2022.102723.abstractZh: 我们研究了美国毒品危机对儿童生活安排的影响。由于导致药物使用的因素也可能改变家庭结构，我们通过将州际范围内对处方阿片类药物营销的暴露程度作为工具变量，来反映毒品危机的强度。研究发现，毒品危机增加了儿童与父母分离或生活在由祖父母抚养的家庭中的可能性。我们的结果表明，如果药物使用保持在1996年的水平，那么到2015年，将有150万名0-16岁的儿童不再与父母同住。

abstract.text: Concerns about healthcare affordability have grown in France as physician additional fees have increased threefold in the last 20 years. In this paper, we develop an innovative structural spatial framework to provide new insights into free-billing physician pricing behavior. We empirically test a closed-form solution of a circular city model with heterogeneous physicians by using a unique geolocalized database that covers more than 4000 private practitioners in three specializations (ophthalmology, gynecology and pediatrics). We highlight a positive spatial dependence in prices for all specialties that increases with physician density. This result reflects markets in which both prices are strategic complements and incentives for quality competition are low. We also find evidence of potential noncompetitive behavior for two specialties for which price and competition measures are positively related. These findings in the context of a growing spatial concentration of free-billing physicians emphasize key mechanisms explaining the increasing of additional fees.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102724.abstractZh: 在法国，由于医生附加费用在过去20年中增加了三倍，人们对医疗保健可负担性的担忧日益增加。在本文中，我们开发了一个创新的结构性空间框架，以揭示免费计费医生定价行为的新见解。我们通过使用一个独特的地理定位数据库，对具有不同特征的医生构成的圆形城市模型进行了实证测试，该数据库涵盖了4000多名私人执业医生，涉及三个专业领域：眼科、妇科和儿科。我们发现，所有专业领域的价格都具有正的空间依赖性，并且这种依赖性随着医生密度的增加而增强。这一结果反映了市场中价格既是战略互补品，且质量竞争激励较低的情况。我们还发现，对于两个价格与竞争指标呈正相关的专业领域，存在潜在的非竞争性行为。在免费计费医生空间集中度不断增加的背景下，这些发现强调了解释附加费用增加的关键机制。

abstract.text: In this paper, I integrate a theory of body image, weight control, and addiction in a life cycle model with health deficit accumulation in order to explain the phenomenon of anorexia nervosa and its impact on health and longevity. Individuals consume normal goods and foods and can work off excess calories with physical exercise. There exists a healthy body mass index and deviations from it increasingly cause health deficits due to obesity or underweight. There exists also a subjective target weight and being heavier than target weight causes a loss of utility from body image. Anorexia is initiated in individuals who are particularly successful in weight control and prone to addiction. Addiction to weight control motivates anorexic individuals to perpetually adjust their target weight downwards and to eat less and exercise more. With declining weight, health deficits accumulate faster and mortality risk rises. I calibrate the model to an average American woman with bmi 28. Due to weight loss addiction, the bmi declines to a level of 15 and causes an expected loss of 15 years of life. I also discuss potential therapies and recovery from the disease.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102725.abstractZh: 在本文中，我将身体形象、体重控制与成瘾的理论整合到一个生命周期模型中，并考虑健康缺陷的累积，以解释神经性厌食症这一现象及其对健康和寿命的影响。个体会消费正常商品和食物，并通过体育锻炼消耗多余的卡路里。健康的体重指数如果偏离该范围，就会因肥胖或体重过轻而导致健康缺陷的累积。此外，还存在一个主观的目标体重，超过目标体重会导致身体形象带来的效用降低。神经性厌食症通常出现在那些在体重控制方面特别成功且容易成瘾的人群中。对体重控制的成瘾促使厌食症患者不断降低目标体重，并减少饮食、增加锻炼。随着体重的下降，健康缺陷会更快地累积，死亡风险也会上升。我将该模型校准到一位BMI为28的美国普通女性身上。由于体重控制的成瘾性，她的BMI下降到了15的水平，预计会导致15年的生命损失。我还讨论了潜在的疗法以及从这种疾病中恢复的可能性。

abstract.text: I study the effect of parental leave duration on maternal health in the short- to medium-run leveraging variation in parental leave duration induced by an Austrian policy reform in the year 2000. Using rich administrative data and a regression discontinuity framework, I find that long parental leave of 2.5 years instead of 1.5 years deteriorates maternal health. Worse mental health mainly drives this effect. Alternative channels such as differential fertility, long-term employment effects, a change in disposable income or alternative mode of childcare are unlikely to be of main importance. There is substantial heterogeneity with longer leave spells being less harmful for mothers with unhealthy babies proxied by low birth weight.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102726.abstractZh: 我研究了育儿假时长对母亲健康的影响，重点关注2000年奥地利政策改革所导致的育儿假时长的变化对母亲健康的短期至中期影响。通过丰富的行政数据及回归 discontinuity 框架的分析，我发现长达2.5年的育儿假比1.5年更会对母亲健康产生负面影响。这种影响主要由心理健康问题所驱动。其他因素，如生育率差异、长期就业效应、可支配收入的变化或替代的育儿方式，不太可能是主要影响因素。研究还发现，较长的育儿假时长对婴儿健康状况较差的母亲来说危害较小，这可以通过低出生体重来体现。

abstract.text: Many dynamic structural models that include health as a state variable use categorical self-reported health status (SRHS) as their sole empirical measure of health. Commonly, transition probabilities among discrete health states are calculated directly from one-wave-ahead transitions observed in panel data. The predicted dynamics of SRHS generated from these calculations rapidly deviate from empirical transitions more than one wave ahead, as the assumption of a Markovian process is not satisfied. Consequently, models that treat SRHS as a true representation of health are not well calibrated to accurately match the long term dynamics of individual health. This paper specifies a model in which SRHS is a noisy measure of a continuous latent health state. I estimate the model by maximum likelihood on several panel datasets, exploiting long sequences of SRHS rather than simple wave-to-wave transitions. By accounting for transitory reporting error, the latent health model is able to match both short-run and long-run SRHS transitions up to twenty years in the future, as well as other features of empirical SRHS dynamics. Moreover, the measure of latent health is at least as good at predicting other outcomes (including mortality, labor supply, and medical expenses) as SRHS itself. To aid structural modelers in replacing their representation of health, I provide simple software tools for generating a discretized latent health process, and for filtering observed sequences of SRHS into (a distribution of) latent health.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102727.abstractZh: 许多将健康作为状态变量的动态结构模型，仅使用分类自我报告健康状态作为衡量健康的唯一实证指标。通常，离散健康状态之间的转换概率是通过对面板数据中观察到的单波前转换直接计算得出的。然而，从这些计算得出的SRHS预测动态与实证转换相比，会提前超过一个波期的偏差，因为假设马尔可夫过程并不成立。因此，将SRHS视为健康真实表示的模型，无法准确匹配个体健康的长期动态。本文提出了一个模型，其中SRHS是连续潜在健康状态的噪声表示。我通过多个面板数据集的最大似然估计来构建该模型，利用长序列的SRHS数据，而不是简单的波与波之间的转换。通过考虑暂时性报告误差，潜在健康模型能够预测未来长达二十年的短期和长期SRHS转换，以及实证SRHS动态的其他特征。此外，潜在健康的度量在预测其他结果（包括死亡率、劳动力供应和医疗支出）方面，至少与SRHS本身一样有效。为了帮助结构模型构建者替换他们对健康的表示方法，我提供了简单的软件工具，用于生成离散化的潜在健康过程，并将观测到的SRHS序列过滤为潜在健康的状态分布。

abstract.text: Many states have legalized marijuana over the last two decades, initially for medical purposes and more recently for recreational consumption. Despite prior research, it remains unclear how these policies are related to rates of opioid-involved overdose deaths, which have trended rapidly upwards over time. We examine this question in two ways. First, we replicate and extend previous investigations to show that the prior empirical results are frequently fragile to the choice of specifications and time periods, and probably provide an overly optimistic assessment of the effects of marijuana legalization on opioid deaths. Second, we present new estimates suggesting that legal medical marijuana, particularly when available through retail dispensaries, is associated with higher opioid mortality. The results for recreational marijuana, while less reliable, also indicate that retail sales may be correlated with greater death rates relative to the counterfactual of no legal cannabis. A likely mechanism for these effects is the emergence of illicit fentanyl, which has increased the riskiness of even small positive effects of cannabis legalization on the consumption of opioids.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102728.abstractZh: 在过去的二十年里，许多州将大麻合法化，最初是为了医疗目的，后来则用于娱乐性消费。尽管已有相关研究，但这些政策与阿片类药物过量死亡的发生率之间的关系仍不清楚，后者的死亡率随时间呈快速上升趋势。我们从两个方面来探讨这个问题。首先，我们重复并扩展了之前的研究，发现先前的实证结果往往因所选的模型和时间段的不同而变得不稳定，可能过于乐观地评估了大麻合法化对阿片类药物死亡的影响。其次，我们提出了新的估计结果，表明合法销售的医用大麻，尤其是通过零售药房提供的医用大麻，与更高的阿片类药物死亡率相关。对于娱乐性大麻，虽然结果不太可靠，但也表明零售销售可能与更高的死亡率相关，这相对于没有大麻合法化的情景而言。这些效应的一个可能机制是非法芬太尼的出现，这增加了即使是大麻合法化带来的微小积极影响对阿片类药物消费的风险性。

abstract.text: Do wealthier individuals use more health care services than those less affluent? Our paper addresses this question by examining the relationship between housing wealth and health care utilization. Exploiting fluctuations in the U.S. housing market, we estimate the effect of unanticipated wealth shocks on older adults' health care utilization, using county-year variation in house prices to construct an instrumental variable. Using data from the 1996-2016 Health and Retirement Study, we find that an increase in wealth significantly increases numbers of doctor visits, prescription drugs, outpatient surgery, and dental services. Notably, an economic downturn like that in the Great Recession, when housing wealth declined by 16 percent on average, could reduce the utilization of prescription drugs by 0.4 percent, outpatient services by 0.5 percent, dental care by 0.6 percent, and numbers of doctor visits by 0.5 visits annually.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102737.abstractZh: 较富裕的人是否比较贫困的人使用更多的医疗保健服务？我们的论文通过研究住房财富与医疗保健使用之间的关系来探讨这个问题。利用美国住房市场的波动数据，我们估计了意外财富冲击对老年人医疗保健使用的影响，并采用县-年份房价变化作为工具变量。根据1996-2016年健康与退休研究的数据，我们发现财富的增加显著增加了医生就诊次数、处方药使用量、门诊手术和牙科服务的需求。值得注意的是，像大衰退这样的经济衰退期间，住房财富平均下降了16%，这可能导致处方药使用量减少0.4%，门诊服务使用量减少0.5%，牙科服务使用量减少0.6%，医生就诊次数每年减少0.5次。

abstract.text: Indoor tanning beds (ITBs) emit UV light at high intensity and have been classified as carcinogenic to humans by the World Health Organization since 2009. We are the first to study the role of state laws prohibiting youths from indoor tanning using a difference-in-differences research design. We find that youth ITB prohibitions reduced population search intensity for tanning-related information. Among white teen girls, ITB prohibitions reduced self-reported indoor tanning and increased sun protective behaviors. We also find that youth ITB prohibitions significantly reduced the size of the indoor tanning market by increasing tanning salon closures and reducing tanning salon sales.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102738.abstractZh: 室内晒黑床（ITB）会发出高强度紫外线，自2009年以来被世界卫生组织列为对人类有致癌风险的物质。我们首次采用差异-差异研究设计，探讨了州法律禁止青少年使用室内晒黑床的影响。研究发现，这类法律减少了青少年搜索与晒黑相关信息的频率。在白人少女中，室内晒黑床禁令减少了她们自我报告的室内晒黑行为，并增加了防晒行为。此外，我们还发现，这类法律通过增加晒黑沙龙的关闭次数和降低其销售额，显著缩小了室内晒黑市场的规模。

abstract.text: We investigate whether exposure to rainfall shocks affects the experience of physical intimate partner violence (P-IPV) among women in rural areas of the Peruvian Andes. Using data from the Demographic and Health Surveys over 2005-2014, we track changes in the probability that a woman experiences recent instances of P-IPV after being exposed to a rainfall shock during the last cropping season. Our results indicate that the probability that a woman experiences P-IPV increases by 8.5 percentage points (65 percent) after exposure to a dry, but not a wet, shock during the cropping season. We identify two complementary causal pathways of this effect: increased economic insecurity and poverty-related stress that deteriorates men's emotional well-being and mental health, and reduced female empowerment that affects women's ability to negotiate their preferences within the relationship.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102739.abstractZh: 我们研究了降雨冲击是否会影响秘鲁安第斯山区农村地区的女性所经历的身体亲密伴侣暴力。利用2005年至2014年的人口与健康调查数据，我们追踪了女性在最近一个种植季节遭遇降雨冲击后，经历近期身体亲密伴侣暴力事件的概率变化。研究结果表明，女性在种植季节遭遇干旱冲击后，经历身体亲密伴侣暴力事件的概率增加了8.5个百分点（65%）。我们认为这种影响存在两条互补的因果途径：经济不安全感的增加以及与贫困相关的压力，这些因素会恶化男性的情绪健康和心理健康；而女性赋权的降低则会影响女性在关系中表达自身意愿的能力。

abstract.text: This paper studies referral strategy and effort provision of a primary care physician and a specialist who are responsible for the treatment of chronically ill patients who can be in a mild or severe condition. Two organizational settings are compared, a team in which physicians cooperate and solo practices in which they do not. Team care is strictly superior to solo practice care if the difference in expected treatment costs between disease severities is relatively larger for the primary care physician. Otherwise, solo practice care is weakly superior to team care under reasonable assumptions.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102740.abstractZh: 本文研究了负责治疗慢性病的患者的初级保健医生和专科医生的转诊策略与努力投入情况，这些患者可能处于轻度或重度疾病状态。比较了两种组织模式：一种是医生们相互合作的团队模式，另一种则是医生独立执业的模式。如果初级保健医生对疾病严重程度的预期治疗成本差异较大，那么团队护理明显优于独立执业护理。在其他合理假设下，独立执业护理在某种程度上也优于团队护理。

abstract.text: We study how physicians' practice environments affect their treatment decisions and quality of care. Using clinical registry data from Sweden, we compare stent choices of cardiologists moving across hospitals over time. To disentangle changes in practice styles attributable to hospital- and peer group-specific factors, we exploit quasi-random variation on cardiologists working together on the same days. We find that migrating cardiologists' stent choices rapidly adapt to their new practice environment after relocation and are equally driven by the hospital and peer environments. In contrast, while decision errors increase, treatment costs and adverse clinical events remain largely unchanged despite the altered practice styles.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102741.abstractZh: 我们研究了医生的工作环境如何影响他们的治疗决策和护理质量。利用瑞典的临床登记数据，我们比较了在不同医院工作的心脏病专家在一段时间内的支架选择情况。为了区分由医院和同行群体特定因素导致的实践风格变化，我们利用了心脏病专家在同一天内共同工作的准随机变化。我们发现，迁移后的心脏病专家在适应新工作环境后，其支架选择迅速调整，并且这种调整同样受到医院和同行环境的影响。相比之下，尽管决策错误有所增加，但治疗成本和不良临床事件的发生率基本保持不变，尽管实践风格已经改变。

abstract.text: This paper tests for the presence of job lock and "health insurance plan lock" stemming from the health shock of a child family member. Using the onset of an acute, unanticipated health shock, I estimate a 7-14 percent decreased likelihood of all family members leaving their current health insurance network and health plan within one year of the emergency. This corresponds to a reduced one-year job mobility rate of approximately 13 percent for the health plan's primary policyholder. Furthermore, the non-portability of health insurance products may contribute to the observed job and health plan lock.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102749.abstractZh: 本文探讨了因子女家庭成员突发健康危机而导致的“工作锁定”和“健康保险计划锁定”现象。通过模拟一次突如其来的健康危机，我们估计在危机发生后的一年内，所有家庭成员离开当前健康保险网络和健康保险计划的可能性会降低7-14%。这意味着健康保险主要保单持有者的年度工作流动性会降低约13%。此外，健康保险产品的不可转移性也可能加剧上述工作锁定和健康保险计划锁定现象。

abstract.text: This study analyzes the relationship between conversion therapy and mental health and wellbeing of transgender youth in the U.S. We create a retrospective panel of transgender youth using the 2015 U.S. Transgender Survey to test how exposure to conversion therapy affects the likelihood of attempting suicide and running away from home. The empirical approach employs a difference-in-differences design. Results indicate that exposure to conversion therapy substantially increases the likelihood a transgender adolescent will attempt suicide and run away. The average treatment effect on treated (ATT) of conversion therapy on having attempted suicide is an increase of 17 percentage points, which amounts to a 55% increase in the risk of attempting suicide, and the ATT on the risk of running away is an increase of 7.8 percentage points, more than doubling the risk of running away. These effects are largest when exposure to conversion therapy occurs at a young age (11-14).

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102750.abstractZh: 本研究分析了转换疗法与美国跨性别青少年心理健康和福祉之间的关系。我们通过2015年美国跨性别调查的数据，对跨性别青少年进行了回顾性分析，以探讨接触转换疗法对自杀企图和离家出走行为的影响。研究采用了差异-差异设计的方法。结果表明，接触转换疗法显著增加了跨性别青少年自杀企图和离家出走的风险。转换疗法对自杀企图的影响平均增加了17个百分点，使自杀风险增加了55%；对离家出走风险的影响则增加了7.8个百分点，使离家出走的风险增加了一倍多。这些影响在接触转换疗法的年龄较小时最为明显（11-14岁）。

abstract.text: Child benefits are typically paid from birth. This paper asks whether starting universal child benefits in pregnancy leads to improvements in infant health. Leveraging administrative birth registry and hospital microdata from England and Wales, I study the effects of the Health in Pregnancy Grant, a universal conditional cash transfer equivalent to three months of child benefit (190 GBP) as a lump sum to pregnant mothers from 2009 to 2011. I exploit quasi-experimental variation in eligibility with a regression discontinuity design in the date of birth of the baby. I find that the policy increased birth weight by 8-12 grams on average, reduced low birth weight (<2500 g) by 3-6 percent and decreased prematurity by 9-11 percent. Younger mothers, particularly those living in deprived areas, benefit the most. I present evidence that the mechanisms are unlikely to be antenatal care, nutrition or smoking, with reductions in stress remaining a possible explanation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102751.abstractZh: 儿童福利通常从婴儿出生时就开始发放。本文探讨在孕期实施普遍性的儿童福利政策是否会对婴儿健康产生积极影响。通过利用英格兰和威尔士的行政出生登记数据以及医院微观数据，我研究了“孕期健康补助”政策的效果。该政策是一项普遍性的有条件现金转移措施，相当于三个月的儿童福利金额（190英镑），于2009年至2011年间向孕妇发放。我采用回归连续设计，利用资格认定的准实验性差异来研究政策效果。研究发现，该政策使婴儿出生体重平均增加了8-12克，低出生体重（<2500克）的比例减少了3-6%，早产率则下降了9-11%。其中，年轻母亲，尤其是生活在贫困地区的母亲，受益最大。证据表明，这些效果不太可能是由产前护理、营养或吸烟等因素带来的，而压力减轻可能是其中的一个解释因素。

abstract.text: With the passage of the American Recovery Plan Act of 2021, roughly 12 million Americans are eligible to purchase zero-premium Health Insurance Marketplace plans. Millions more are eligible for generously subsidized health plans with small, positive premiums. What difference does a premium of zero make, relative to a slightly positive premium? Using a regression discontinuity design and administrative data from Colorado, we find that zero-premium plans increase coverage, primarily by helping low-income households begin coverage sooner. The main mechanism is eliminating the transaction costs of having to make on-time payments to begin coverage. Transaction costs may be a meaningful barrier to subsidized insurance coverage take-up, particularly for low-income families.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102752.abstractZh: 随着2021年美国复苏计划的通过，大约有1200万美国人有资格购买零保费的健康保险市场计划。还有数百万人有资格获得补贴性强的、保费较低的健康计划。零保费与略高保费相比，究竟有何不同？通过回归不连续设计和科罗拉多州的行政数据，我们发现零保费计划通过帮助低收入家庭更早获得保险覆盖，从而增加了保险覆盖范围。其主要机制是消除了按时支付保费所需的交易成本。对于低收入家庭来说，交易成本可能是阻碍他们接受补贴性保险的一个重要障碍。

abstract.text: We ask how urgent care centers (UCCs) impact healthcare costs and utilization among nearby Medicare beneficiaries. When residents of a zip code are first served by a UCC, total Medicare spending rises while mortality remains flat. In the sixth year after entry, 4.2% of the Medicare beneficiaries in a zip code that is served use a UCC, and the average per-capita annual Medicare spending in the zip code increases by $268, implying an incremental spending increase of $6,335 for each new UCC user. UCC entry is also associated with a significant increase in hospital stays and increased hospital spending accounts for half of the total increase in annual spending. These results raise the possibility that, on balance, UCCs increase costs by steering patients to hospitals.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102753.abstractZh: 我们探讨了紧急护理中心对附近Medicare受益人的医疗成本和医疗使用的影响。当一个邮政编码区首次有紧急护理中心提供服务时，Medicare的总支出会增加，而死亡率则保持不变。在紧急护理中心设立后的第六年，使用该紧急护理中心的Medicare受益者比例为4.2%，该邮政编码区的平均每人年Medicare支出增加了268美元，这意味着每个新增紧急护理中心的用户会使支出增加6,335美元。紧急护理中心的设立还伴随着住院时间的显著增加，而住院费用的增加占年度支出总增长的半部分。这些结果表明，从整体来看，紧急护理中心通过将患者引导至医院，实际上增加了成本。

abstract.text: I study the impact of expanding the 340B Drug Pricing Program to include Critical Access Hospitals (CAH) on Medicare Part B drug utilization and spending. The 340B program entitles certain hospitals and clinics to discounts on most outpatient drugs. In 2010, the Affordable Care Act expanded 340B eligibility to CAHs - small rural hospitals that receive cost-based reimbursement from Medicare. Exploiting variation in the predicted exposure to the 340B expansion in a difference-in-differences method, I find that the 340B expansion reduced Part B drug spending but did not affect Part B drug utilization. This finding contrasts with existing evidence about 340B's impact on hospitals but is consistent with the prediction that cost-based reimbursement dampens the incentives created by the 340B discounts. I also find suggestive evidence that CAHs passed the cost savings from 340B on to patients. These results add new perspectives to the ongoing debate over 340B.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102754.abstractZh: 我研究了将340B药品定价计划扩展到关键接入医院对Medicare Part B药品使用及支出的影响。340B计划赋予某些医院和诊所对大多数门诊药品享受折扣优惠的权利。2010年，《平价医疗法案》将340B的适用范围扩展至关键接入医院——这些小型农村医院从Medicare获得基于成本的报销。通过差异-差异方法分析340B扩展对药品使用的影响，我发现该计划确实减少了Medicare Part B的药品支出，但并未影响药品的使用量。这一发现与现有关于340B对医院影响的证据有所不同，但与“基于成本的报销会削弱340B折扣带来的激励”这一预测一致。我还发现了一些暗示性的证据，表明关键接入医院将340B带来的成本节约转嫁给了患者。这些结果为关于340B的持续讨论提供了新的视角。

abstract.text: We integrate anticipatory utility and endogenous beliefs about future negative health shocks into a life-cycle model of physiological aging. Individuals care about their future utility derived from their health status and form endogenous beliefs about the probability of a negative health shock. We calibrate the model with data from gerontology and use the model to predict medical testing decisions of individuals. We find that anticipation in combination with endogenous beliefs provides a quantitatively strong motive to avoid medical testing for Huntington's disease, which explains the low testing rates found empirically. We also study the case of breast and ovarian cancer and provide an explanation for why testing rates depend on the individual's income when treatment is available.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102755.abstractZh: 我们将预期效用以及对未来健康负面冲击的内生信念纳入生理衰老的生命周期模型中。个体会关注其健康状况所带来的未来效用，并形成关于健康负面冲击发生概率的内生信念。我们通过老年学数据对模型进行校准，并利用该模型预测个体的医学检测决策。研究发现，预期与内生信念的结合为避免亨廷顿病的医学检测提供了强有力的动机，这解释了实证数据中较低的检测率。我们还研究了乳腺癌和卵巢癌的情况，并解释了在治疗方法可用的情况下，检测率为何取决于个体收入的原因。

abstract.text: Public health experts caution that legalization of recreational marijuana may normalize smoking and undermine the decades-long achievements of tobacco control policy. However, very little is known about the impact of recreational marijuana laws (RMLs) on adult tobacco use. Using newly available data from the Population Assessment of Tobacco and Health (PATH) and dynamic difference-in-differences and discrete-time hazard approaches, we find that RML adoption increases prior-month marijuana use among adults ages 18-and-older by 2-percentage-points, driven by an increase in marijuana initiation among prior non-users. However, this increase in adult marijuana use does not extend to tobacco use. Rather, we find that RML adoption is associated with a lagged reduction in electronic nicotine delivery systems (ENDS) use, consistent with the hypothesis that ENDS and marijuana are substitutes. Moreover, auxiliary analyses from the National Survey on Drug Use and Health (NSDUH) show that RML adoption is associated with a reduction in adult cigarette smoking. We conclude that RMLs may generate tobacco-related health benefits.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102756.abstractZh: 公共卫生专家警告称，将娱乐性大麻合法化可能会使吸烟行为常态化，并削弱数十年来烟草控制政策的成果。然而，关于娱乐性大麻法律对成人烟草使用的影响，我们知之甚少。利用《烟草与健康人口评估》的新数据以及动态差异-差异和离散时间风险分析方法，我们发现，采用娱乐性大麻法律后，18岁及以上成年人的大麻使用率增加了2个百分点，这一变化主要源于之前未使用大麻的群体开始使用大麻。然而，这种成人大麻使用量的增加并未转化为烟草使用的增加。相反，我们发现，采用娱乐性大麻法律后，电子尼古丁输送系统的使用量会有所减少，这与电子尼古丁输送系统和大麻是替代品这一假设相符。此外，来自《国家药物使用与健康调查》的辅助分析显示，采用娱乐性大麻法律后，成人香烟的吸烟量也有所减少。我们得出结论，娱乐性大麻法律可能会带来与烟草相关的健康益处。

abstract.text: This study reports the results of the first artefactual field experiment designed to measure the prevalence of aversion toward different components of social risks in a large and demographically representative sample. We identify social risk preferences for health and wealth for losses and gains, and decompose these attitudes into four different dimensions: individual risk, collective risk, ex-post inequality, and ex-ante inequality. The results of a non-parametric analysis suggest that aversion to risk and inequality is the mean preference for outcomes in health and wealth in the domain of gains and losses. A parametric decomposition of aversion to risk and inequality shows that respondents are averse to ex-post and ex-ante inequality in health and wealth for gains and losses. Likewise, respondents are averse to collective risk, but neutral to individual risk, which highlights the importance of considering different components of social risk preferences when managing social health and wealth risks.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102757.abstractZh: 本研究报告了首次进行的实验性实地实验的结果，该实验旨在测量在具有较大规模且人口统计特征具有代表性的样本中，人们对不同社会风险成分的厌恶程度。我们确定了人们对健康和财富损失及收益的社会风险偏好，并将这些态度分解为四个不同的维度：个体风险、集体风险、事后不平等和事前不平等。非参数分析的结果表明，人们对风险和不平等的厌恶是他们对健康和财富收益与损失领域结果的普遍偏好。参数化分析进一步显示，受访者对健康和财富收益与损失中的事后和事前不平等持厌恶态度。同样，受访者对集体风险持厌恶态度，但对个体风险则持中立态度，这凸显了在管理社会健康与财富风险时考虑不同社会风险偏好成分的重要性。

abstract.text: We investigate the impact of a large cash transfer on prescription utilization. Our identification strategy leverages the Alaksa Permanent Fund Dividend (PFD), which is distributed annually in October and comprises 6% of the average household's annual income. We study the impact of the PFD on the use of prescription medications using a within-Alaska comparison group and difference-in-differences design. Using the IBM MarketScan Commercial Claims and Encounters Prescription Drug Database, we observe prescriptions for 50,866 commercially-insured individuals who filled prescriptions between 2013 and 2019. We find no changes in prescription use overall and are able to rule out changes larger than 0.5% in the week of the PFD and 1.4% the week after. Subgroup analyses find no changes by patient characteristics, degree of cost sharing, or prescription type. We also conduct a synthetic control analysis using a non-Alaska comparison group and find no effects of the PFD on prescriptions. These findings are useful for understanding liquidity sensitivity for prescription medication and the effects of cash distributions among individuals with employer-based health insurance.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102758.abstractZh: 我们研究了大规模现金转移对处方药使用的影响。我们的识别策略利用了Alaksa永久基金股息，该股息每年十月分配，占平均家庭年收入的6%。我们通过使用阿拉斯加内部比较组和差异-差异设计来研究该基金对处方药使用的影响。利用IBM MarketScan商业索赔和处方药物数据库，我们观察了2013年至2019年间50,866名商业保险参保者的处方情况。我们发现整体上的处方药使用没有变化，并且能够排除在基金发放周和其后一周中超过0.5%的变化，以及1.4%的变化。子组分析发现，患者特征、费用分担程度或处方类型方面都没有变化。我们还使用非阿拉斯加比较组进行了合成控制分析，发现该基金对处方药物没有产生影响。这些发现有助于理解处方药对流动性的敏感性，以及现金分配对拥有雇主基础健康保险的个人的影响。

abstract.text: This study investigates the impact of long-term care insurance (LTCI) on the non-health consumption of elderly households. By exploiting a quasi-experiment on the public LTCI pilot program in China, we identify the effect of LTCI using a triple-difference approach. Using longitudinal data from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study, we find that LTCI has led to an increase in the non-health consumption of elderly households by 15.7%, mostly observed in households having no older members with need for long-term care (LTC). Further evidence suggests that the effects are stronger for households with higher expected LTC risks, less wealth or family insurance, and covered by more generous schemes. Finally, LTCI increases the expectation of using formal LTC when disabled and subjective longevity expectations for older adults having no need for LTC. Overall, these findings offer empirical support for the role of LTCI in mitigating precautionary savings against LTC risks.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102759.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了长期护理保险（LTCI）对老年家庭非健康消费的影响。通过利用中国公共LTCI试点项目的准实验数据，我们采用三重差分法来识别LTCI的影响。根据《中国健康与退休纵向研究》的纵向数据，我们发现LTCI使老年家庭的非健康消费增加了15.7%，这一现象主要出现在没有需要长期护理的老年成员的家庭中。进一步的证据表明，对于预期面临更高长期护理风险、财富较少或家庭保险不足、以及享受更优厚保险计划的家庭来说，LTCI的影响更为显著。最后，LTCI增加了老年人因残疾而使用正式长期护理服务的预期，以及那些不需要长期护理的老年人对寿命的主观预期。总体而言，这些发现为LTCI在减轻针对长期护理风险的预防性储蓄方面的作用提供了实证支持。

abstract.text: While a large body of evidence has examined hospital concentration, its effects on health care for low-income populations are less explored. We use comprehensive discharge data from New York State to measure the effects of changes in market concentration on hospital-level inpatient Medicaid volumes. Holding fixed hospital factors constant, a one percent increase in HHI leads to a 0.6% (s.e. = 0.28%) decrease in the number of Medicaid admissions for the average hospital. The strongest effects are on admissions for birth (-1.3%, s.e. = 0.58%). These average hospital-level decreases largely reflect redistribution of Medicaid patients across hospitals, rather than overall reductions in hospitalizations for Medicaid patients. In particular, hospital concentration leads to a redistribution of admissions from non-profit hospitals to public hospitals. We find evidence that for births, physicians serving high shares of Medicaid beneficiaries in particular experience reduced admissions as concentration increased. These reductions may reflect preferences among these physicians or reduced admitting privileges by hospitals as a means to screen out Medicaid patients.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102770.abstractZh: 虽然已有大量研究探讨了医院集中对低收入人群医疗保健的影响，但对其具体影响的研究却相对较少。我们利用纽约州的完整出院数据，来衡量市场集中程度变化对医院级住院医疗补助患者数量的影响。在固定医院因素不变的情况下，医院市场集中度增加1%会导致平均医院医疗补助患者入院数量减少0.6%（标准误差为0.28%）。其中，出生病例的入院数量减少最为明显，减少了1.3%（标准误差为0.58%）。这些平均水平的减少主要反映了医疗补助患者在不同医院之间的重新分配，而非医疗补助患者的总入院数量减少。具体而言，医院集中导致医疗补助患者从非营利医院重新分配到公立医院。我们发现，对于出生病例，那些服务大量医疗补助受益人的医生，随着医院集中程度的增加，其入院数量会减少。这种减少可能反映了这些医生之间的偏好差异，或者医院通过限制医疗补助患者的入院资格来进行筛选。

abstract.text: We describe the healthcare industry as a mixed oligopoly, where a public and two private providers compete, and examine the effects of a merger between the two private healthcare providers on prices, quality, and welfare. When the price and (eventually) quality of the public provider are regulated, the cost synergies required for the merger to increase consumer welfare are less significant than in a setting with only profit-maximizing providers. When, instead, the public provider can adjust its policy to the rivals' behavior and maximizes a weighted sum of profits and consumer surplus (i.e., it has 'semi-altruistic' preferences), the merger is consumer surplus increasing if the public provider is sufficiently altruist, in some cases even absent efficiencies. These results suggest that ignoring the role and objectives of the public sector in the healthcare industry may lead agencies to reject mergers that, while would decrease consumer welfare in fully privatized industries, would increase it in mixed oligopolies.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102771.abstractZh: 我们将医疗保健行业描述为一个混合寡头垄断市场，其中一家公共医疗服务提供者与两家私人医疗服务提供者竞争。我们研究了这两家私人医疗服务提供者合并对价格、质量和福利的影响。当公共医疗服务提供者的价格和（最终）质量受到监管时，合并所需的成本协同效应对提高消费者福利的作用不如只有利润最大化提供者的市场显著。而当公共医疗服务提供者能够根据竞争对手的行为调整政策，并最大化利润和消费者剩余的总和时（即它具有“半利他主义”偏好），如果公共医疗服务提供者足够利他主义，合并甚至会增加消费者剩余，在某些情况下甚至无需考虑效率提升。这些结果表明，忽视公共部门在医疗保健行业中的角色和目标可能会导致相关机构拒绝合并，而在完全私有化的行业中，合并可能会降低消费者福利，但在混合寡头垄断市场中，合并却可能提高消费者福利。

abstract.text: A significant concern in the policy landscape of the U.S. opioid crisis is whether supply-side controls can reduce opioid prescribing without harmful substitution. We consider an unstudied policy: the federal Controlled Substance Act (CSA) restrictions placed in August 2014 on tramadol, the second most popular opioid medication. This was followed seven weeks later by CSA restrictions for hydrocodone combination products, the leading opioids on the market. Using regression discontinuity design (RDD) models, based on the timing of the (up-)scheduling changes, to explore spillover effects, we find that tightening prescribing restrictions on one opioid reduces its use, but increases prescribing of close competitors, leading to no reduction in total opioid prescriptions.This suggests that supply restrictions are not effective in reducing opioid prescribing the presence of close substitutes that remain unrestricted.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102772.abstractZh: 在美国阿片类药物危机的政策背景下，一个重要的问题是：供应方面的限制措施是否能够在减少阿片类药物处方数量的同时，避免产生有害的替代效应。我们研究了一个尚未被充分探讨的政策措施：2014年8月，联邦《管制物质法》对第二常用的阿片类药物——曲马多实施了限制。七周后，联邦《管制物质法》又对市场上最受欢迎的阿片类药物——氢可酮组合产品实施了限制。通过回归不连续设计模型，基于这些限制措施实施的时间点，我们发现，对一种阿片类药物的处方限制会减少其使用量，但会增加与其竞争关系密切的另一种阿片类药物的处方量，从而总体上不会减少阿片类药物的处方总量。这表明，在存在不受限制的竞争替代品的情况下，供应限制措施在减少阿片类药物处方数量方面并不有效。

abstract.text: We study the appeal of basic preference conditions that underpin health inequality indices, including the widely used concentration index. We did a lab experiment in which 349 respondents had to choose repeatedly between two policies that generated a distribution of income and health among five groups in society. We found stronger support for preference conditions that focus on inequality in the marginal distribution of health (and income) than for preference conditions that favor reduced correlation between both dimensions. Respondents' choices were more in line with the principle of income related health transfers when policies did not affect the ranking of groups in terms of health. Respondents also expressed more concern about the correlation between income and health when health was expressed as a shortfall rather than an attainment. Support for the preference conditions was unaffected when all groups in society experienced the same absolute or relative health change.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102773.abstractZh: 我们研究了支撑健康不平等指数基本偏好条件的吸引力，其中包括广泛使用的集中指数。我们进行了一项实验室实验，其中349名受访者需要反复选择两种政策，这两种政策产生了社会五个群体之间的收入和健康分布。我们发现，那些关注健康（和收入）边际分布不平等的偏好条件，比那些倾向于减少两个维度之间相关性的偏好条件得到了更强的支持。当政策不影响各群体在健康方面的排名时，受访者的选择更符合收入相关健康转移的原则。当健康被表示为不足而非成就时，受访者对收入和健康之间相关性的担忧也更为强烈。当社会中的所有群体都经历相同的绝对或相对健康变化时，对偏好条件的支持并未受到影响。

abstract.text: There is evidence that physicians disproportionately suffer from substance use disorder and mental health problems. It is not clear, however, whether these phenomena are causal. We use data on Dutch medical school applicants to examine the effects of becoming a physician on prescription drug use and the receipt of treatment from a mental health facility. Leveraging variation from lottery outcomes that determine admission into medical schools, we find that becoming a physician increases the use of antidepressants, anxiolytics, opioids, and sedatives. Increases in the use of antidepressants, anxiolytics, and sedatives are larger among female physicians than among their male counterparts.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102774.abstractZh: 有证据表明，医生群体中患有物质使用障碍和心理健康问题的比例较高。然而，目前尚不清楚这些现象之间是否存在因果关系。我们利用荷兰医学院申请者的数据，研究了成为医生对处方药使用以及接受心理健康治疗的影响。通过对比决定医学院录取结果的随机结果，我们发现成为医生会增加抗抑郁药、抗焦虑药、阿片类药物和镇静剂的使用。女性医生在抗抑郁药、抗焦虑药和镇静剂的使用上增加的幅度比男性医生更大。

abstract.text: We analyze the introduction of prescription-free access to morning-after pills-emergency contraceptives that aim to prevent unintended pregnancy and subsequent abortion after unprotected sexual intercourse. Exploiting a staggered difference-in-differences setting for Europe combined with randomization inference, we find sharp increases in sales and manufacturers' revenues of more than 90%. However, whilst not reducing abortions significantly, the policy triggers an unexpected increase in fertility of 4%, particularly among women aged 25-34. We elaborate on mechanisms by looking at within-country evidence from several EU countries, which suggests that fertility is driven by decreasing use of birth control pills in response to easier access to morning-after pills.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102775.abstractZh: 我们分析了无处方购买事后避孕药政策的引入情况——这些紧急避孕药旨在预防无保护性行为后意外怀孕及随后的堕胎。通过利用欧洲地区的分阶段差异-差异模型，并结合随机化推断方法，我们发现这些避孕药的销量和制造商收入分别增加了90%以上。然而，尽管该政策并未显著减少堕胎数量，但它却意外地导致生育率上升了4%，尤其是在25-34岁的女性中。我们通过分析几个欧盟国家的国内数据，进一步探讨了这一现象的机制，结果表明，生育率的上升是由于人们更容易获得事后避孕药，从而减少了避孕药的使用。

abstract.text: Resource allocation generally involves a tension between efficiency and equity, particularly in health care. The growth in exclusive physician arrangements using non-linear prices is leading to consumer segmentation with theoretically ambiguous welfare implications. We study concierge medicine, in which physicians only provide care to patients paying a retainer fee. We find limited evidence of selection based on health and stronger evidence of selection based on income. Using a matching strategy that leverages the staggered adoption of concierge medicine, we find large spending increases and no average mortality effects for patients impacted by the switch to concierge medicine.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102776.abstractZh: 资源分配通常涉及到效率与公平之间的权衡，尤其是在医疗保健领域。采用非线性价格的独家医生服务模式的增长导致了消费者分化，这在理论上对福利的影响尚不明确。我们研究了“顾问式医疗”模式，即医生仅向支付固定费用的患者提供医疗服务。我们发现，基于健康状况的选择效应有限，而基于收入的选择效应则更为明显。通过利用“顾问式医疗”模式逐步推广的策略，我们发现受影响的患者在支出上出现了显著增长，但平均死亡率并未出现变化。

abstract.text: Since the start of the century, many countries in Sub-Saharan Africa have experienced large gains in life expectancy and average consumption levels. Around the same time, an unprecedented international effort has taken place to combat HIV/AIDS mortality with the expansion of anti-retroviral therapy (ART) across many of the hardest hit countries. In this paper, I estimate the impact of ART on average welfare over time in 42 countries using the equivalent consumption approach. I decompose the change in welfare to isolate the relative contribution of ART-driven improvements in life expectancy and consumption. The results indicate that ART has accounted for around 12% of total welfare growth in SSA between 2000 and 2017. In those countries most affected by HIV/AIDS, this figure rises to around 40%. Moreover, the estimates suggest that welfare in some of the worst-hit countries would have declined over time without the ART expansion.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102777.abstractZh: 自本世纪初以来，撒哈拉以南非洲的许多国家经历了预期寿命和平均消费水平的大幅提升。与此同时，国际社会为抗击艾滋病死亡率做出了前所未有的努力，许多受疫情严重影响的国家开始实施抗逆转录病毒疗法。本文采用等效消费方法，对42个国家中抗逆转录病毒疗法对平均福利随时间的影响进行了估算。通过分解福利变化，我们分离出抗逆转录病毒疗法对预期寿命和消费改善的相对贡献。研究结果表明，在2000年至2017年间，抗逆转录病毒疗法对撒哈拉以南非洲国家总福利增长的贡献约为12%。在受艾滋病影响最严重的国家，这一比例上升至约40%。此外，估计数据显示，如果没有抗逆转录病毒疗法的推广，一些受疫情严重影响国家的福利状况可能会随时间恶化。

abstract.text: Health systems around world are increasingly adopting cost-effectiveness (CE) analysis to inform decisions about access and reimbursement. We study how CE thresholds imposed by a health plan for granting reimbursement affect drug producers' pricing incentives and patients' access to new drugs. Analysing a sequential pricing game between an incumbent drug producer and a potential entrant with a new drug, we show that CE thresholds may have adverse effects for payers and patients. A stricter CE threshold may induce the incumbent to switch pricing strategy from entry accommodation to entry deterrence, limiting patients' access to the new drug. Otherwise, irrespective of whether entry is deterred or accommodated, a stricter CE threshold is never pro-competitive and may in fact facilitate a collusive outcome with higher prices of both drugs. Compared to a laissez-faire policy, the use of CE thresholds when an incumbent monopolist is challenged by therapeutic substitutes can only increase the surplus of a health plan if it leads to entry deterrence. In this case the price reduction by the incumbent necessary to deter entry outweighs the health loss to patients who do not get access to the new drug.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102778.abstractZh: 全球各地的卫生系统越来越多地采用成本效益分析来指导关于药品获取和报销的决策。我们研究了由医疗计划设定的成本效益阈值对药品生产商定价激励以及患者获取新药品机会的影响。通过对现有药品生产商与潜在新药品进入者之间的定价博弈进行分析，我们发现成本效益阈值可能对支付者和患者产生不利影响。更严格的成本效益阈值可能会促使现有生产商从进入许可转向进入威慑策略，从而限制患者获取新药品的机会。否则，无论新进入者是被阻止还是被允许进入，更严格的成本效益阈值都不会促进竞争，反而可能促成双方合谋，导致药品价格上升。与放任政策相比，当现有垄断企业受到治疗替代品挑战时，使用成本效益阈值只有在导致进入威慑的情况下，才能增加医疗计划的收益。在这种情况下，现有企业为阻止新进入者而降低价格所带来的收益，超过了患者无法获得新药品所带来的健康损失。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the effect of scientific information from randomized controlled clinical trials (RCTs) on the demand for off-label uses of cancer drugs. This is a unique setting where demand for a drug for a specific use is observable both before and after the first RCT results are released. Using variation in the timing of RCTs across off-label uses of drugs, I find that demand responds asymmetrically to the trial results based on the statistical significance of the clinically relevant endpoint. When this endpoint is statistically significant, there is a large and immediate increase in demand. When this end point is not statistically significant, physicians are relatively slow to abandon use of the drug.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102779.abstractZh: 本文研究了随机对照临床试验中的科学信息对癌症药物非标签用途需求的影响。这是一个独特的情境，可以在首次临床试验结果公布前后观察到药物在特定用途下的需求。通过对比药物非标签用途临床试验的时间差异，我发现需求对试验结果的反应是不对称的，这取决于临床相关终点的统计显著性。当该终点具有统计学显著性时，需求会迅速增加；而当该终点不具有统计学显著性时，医生则相对较慢地放弃使用该药物。

abstract.text: We estimate the effect of adopting a digital device for performing medical exams at home during telehealth visits. We match visits of adopters and non-adopters who used the same virtual care clinic but without the device and compare healthcare utilization after the matched visits. We find that device adoption, partially offset by decreased use of other primary care modalities, results in a 12% higher utilization rate of primary care and increased use of antibiotics. But - particularly among adults - adoption lowers the use of urgent care, the emergency room, and hospital care, resulting in no increase in total cost.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102780.abstractZh: 我们评估了在远程医疗访问中使用数字设备进行家庭医疗检查的效果。我们对比了使用同一虚拟护理诊所但不使用该设备的采用者和未采用者的访问情况，并比较了匹配访问后的医疗利用情况。研究发现，设备的采用在一定程度上抵消了其他初级医疗方式的减少，使得初级医疗的利用率提高了12%，并且抗生素的使用也增加了。但是——尤其是在成年人中——设备的采用降低了紧急护理、急诊室和医院护理的使用，从而没有增加总成本。

abstract.text: We examine how long-term care insurance (LTCI) affects informal care use and expectations among the insured individuals and co-residence and labor market outcomes of their adult children. We address the endogeneity of LTCI coverage by instrumenting for LTCI with changes in state tax treatment of LTCI insurance policies. We do not find evidence of reductions in informal care use over a horizon of approximately eight years. However, we find that LTCI coverage reduces parents' perceptions of the willingness of their children to care for them in the future and that the behavior of adult children changes, with LTCI resulting in lower likelihoods of adult children co-residing and stronger labor market attachment. These findings provide empirical support for the presence of spillovers of LTCI on the economic behaviors of family members.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102781.abstractZh: 我们研究了长期护理保险（LTCI）如何影响被保险个体对非正式护理的使用和预期，以及其成年子女的家庭居住和劳动力市场状况。我们通过用州对LTCI保险政策的税收处理变化来模拟LTCI，从而解决LTCI覆盖范围的内生性问题。我们发现，在大约八年的时间内，非正式护理的使用并没有减少。然而，我们发现LTCI的覆盖减少了父母对子女未来愿意照顾他们的预期，同时成年子女的行为也发生了变化，LTCI使得成年子女较少选择与父母同住，并且他们在劳动力市场中的依附性更强。这些发现为LTCI对家庭成员经济行为的溢出效应提供了实证支持。

abstract.text: An important condition for optimal health insurance is that the level of health care coverage is inversely related to the elasticity of demand. We show that this condition is not satisfied for voluntary deductibles in the Netherlands, which are optional deductibles on top of the mandatory deductible introduced by the Dutch government. We find that low-risk types, that mainly choose voluntary deductibles, have a lower elasticity of demand than high-risk types. Moreover, we show that voluntary deductibles introduce equity problems as it results in non-trivial cross subsidies from high-risk to low-risk types. Capping the level of voluntary deductibles (imposing minimum generosity) is likely to be welfare enhancing in the Netherlands.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102782.abstractZh: 最优健康保险的一个重要条件是，医疗保健覆盖水平与需求弹性成反比。我们发现，在荷兰，自愿免赔额并不满足这一条件。荷兰政府引入的强制免赔额之外，还有可选的自愿免赔额。我们发现，主要选择自愿免赔额的低风险人群，其需求弹性低于高风险人群。此外，自愿免赔额还会引发公平问题，因为它会导致高风险人群向低风险人群提供非平凡的交叉补贴。在荷兰，限制自愿免赔额的水平（设定最低慷慨度）可能会提升福利水平。

abstract.text: Lead exposure still threatens children's health despite policies aiming to identify lead exposure sources. Some US states require de jure universal screening while others target screening, but little research examines the relative benefits of these approaches. We link lead tests for children born in Illinois between 2010 and 2014 to geocoded birth records and potential exposure sources. We train a random forest regression model that predicts children's blood lead levels (BLLs) to estimate the geographic distribution of undetected lead poisoning. We use these estimates to compare de jure universal screening against targeted screening. Because no policy achieves perfect compliance, we analyze different incremental screening expansions. We estimate that 5,819 untested children had a BLL ≥5μg/dL, in addition to the 18,101 detected cases. 80% of these undetected cases should have been screened under the current policy. Model-based targeted screening can improve upon both the status quo and expanded universal screening.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102783.abstractZh: 尽管有旨在识别铅暴露源的政策，铅暴露仍然威胁着儿童的健康。一些美国州要求进行法律上的普遍筛查，而其他州则针对特定群体进行筛查，但关于这两种方法的相对效益的研究很少。我们将2010年至2014年间在伊利诺伊州出生的儿童的铅检测结果与地理编码的出生记录及潜在的暴露源进行了关联。我们训练了一个随机森林回归模型，以预测儿童血液中的铅含量，从而估算未被发现的铅中毒的地理分布。利用这些估计值，我们将法律上的普遍筛查与针对特定群体的筛查进行了比较。由于没有任何政策能够完全实现合规，我们分析了不同的渐进式筛查方案。据估计，除了18,101例被发现的病例外，还有5,819名未接受检测的儿童的血铅含量≥5μg/dL。根据现行政策，这些未被发现的病例中有80%本应接受筛查。基于模型的针对性筛查可以改进现状，并提升普遍筛查的效果。

abstract.text: The Special Supplemental Nutrition Program for Women, Infants, and Children (WIC) is a widely used program. Previous research shows that WIC improves birth outcomes, but evidence about impacts on older children and their families is limited. We use a regression discontinuity leveraging a loss of benefits at age five when children become ineligible for WIC and examine nutritional and laboratory outcomes for adults and children. We find little impact on children who aged out of the program. But caloric intake falls and food insecurity increases among adult women, suggesting that mothers protect children by consuming less themselves. We find no effect on others in the household.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102784.abstractZh: 妇女、婴儿和儿童特殊补充营养计划（WIC）是一个被广泛使用的项目。先前的研究表明，WIC能够改善出生结果，但关于其对较大儿童及其家庭影响的证据有限。我们采用回归不连续法，通过模拟儿童在五岁时失去福利资格的情况，来研究对成人和儿童的营养和实验室指标的影响。研究发现，对于退出该计划的儿童来说，影响很小。然而，成年女性的热量摄入下降，食物不安全状况增加，这表明母亲通过减少自己的饮食来保护孩子。我们发现，这一计划对家庭中的其他成员没有显著影响。

abstract.text: I compare two pricing regulations that protect those with health conditions-"community rating," which requires insurers to charge uniform premiums, and "guaranteed renewal," which requires insurers to increase future premiums uniformly. Using individual-level Medigap data from 2006-2010, I compare individuals within 25 miles of borders between 3 community rating and 6 guaranteed renewal states. Relative to guaranteed renewal, community rating (with guaranteed issue) leads to a decrease in Medigap enrollment of 9.70 pp (29.7%), or 26.8-33.7% for low-spending conditions (diabetes, heart disease) and 21.9-29.9% for high-spending conditions (cancer, kidney disease); an increase in annual Medigap premiums of $276 (10.1%); a decrease in the likelihood of an earlier purchase of 7.99 pp (50.3%); and an increase in purchase delay of 1.08 years (17.0%).

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102785.abstractZh: 我比较了两种保护有健康问题的人的定价规定：“社区费率”，要求保险公司收取统一的保费；以及“保证续保”，要求保险公司未来逐步提高保费。利用2006-2010年的个人Medigap数据，我比较了位于3个实行社区费率制和6个实行保证续保州的边界25英里范围内的个体。与保证续保相比，实行社区费率制（包含保证发行）导致Medigap的注册人数减少了9.70个百分点（29.7%），其中低支出情况（糖尿病、心脏病）减少了26.8%-33.7%，高支出情况（癌症、肾脏疾病）减少了21.9%-29.9%；年度Medigap保费增加了276美元（10.1%）；提前购买的可能性降低了7.99个百分点（50.3%）；购买延迟的时间增加了1.08年（17.0%）。

abstract.text: We derive the optimal funding mechanism to incentivize development and production of vaccines against diseases with epidemic potential. In the model, suppliers' costs are private information and investments are noncontractible, precluding cost-reimbursement contracts, requiring fixed-price contracts conditioned on delivery of a successful product. The high failure risk for individual vaccines calls for incentivizing multiple entrants, accomplished by the optimal mechanism, a (w+1)-price reverse Vickrey auction with reserve, where w is the number of selected entrants. Our analysis determines the optimal number of entrants and required funding level. Based on a distribution of supplier costs estimated from survey data, we simulate the optimal mechanism's performance in scenarios ranging from a small outbreak, causing harm in the millions of dollars, to the Covid-19 pandemic, causing harm in the trillions. We assess which mechanism features contribute most to its optimality.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102795.abstractZh: 我们推导出了激励疫苗开发和生产的最佳融资机制，以应对具有流行风险的疾病。在模型中，供应商的成本是私人信息，且投资不可协商，这排除了成本补偿合同的可能性，需要基于成功产品交付的固定价格合同。由于个别疫苗的高失败风险，需要激励多个参与者，而这一机制是通过一个带有储备的(w+1)价格反向Vickrey拍卖来实现的，其中w是选定的参与者的数量。我们的分析确定了最优参与者数量和所需的资金水平。基于从调查数据中估算出的供应商成本分布，我们模拟了该机制在从小规模疫情（造成数百万美元的损失）到新冠疫情（造成数万亿美元的损失）等各种情景下的表现。我们评估了哪些机制特征对其最优性贡献最大。

abstract.text: Much of the increase in the prevalence of overweight and obesity has been in developing countries with a history of famines and malnutrition. This paper is the first to examine overweight among adult grandsons of grandfathers exposed to starvation during developmental ages. I study grandsons born to grandfathers who served in the Union Army during the US Civil War (1861-5) where some grandfathers experienced severe net malnutrition because they suffered a harsh POW experience. I find that male-line but not female-line grandsons of grandfathers who survived a severe captivity during their growing years faced a 21% increase in mean overweight and a 2% increase in mean BMI compared to grandsons of non-POWs. Male-line grandsons descended from grandfathers who experienced a harsh captivity faced a 22%-28% greater risk of dying every year after age 45 relative to grandsons descended from non-POWs, with overweight accounting for 9%-14% of the excess risk.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102796.abstractZh: 超重和肥胖的患病率增加主要发生在那些有饥荒和营养不良历史的发展中国家。本文首次研究了在成长时期经历过饥饿的祖父的成年孙子们的超重情况。我研究了在美南北战争期间（1861-1855年）在联邦军队服役的祖父所生的孙子们，其中一些祖父因遭受残酷的战俘经历而经历了严重的净营养不良。我发现，经历过严重囚禁的祖父所生的男性孙子们的平均超重率比非战俘祖父所生的孙子们高出21%，平均BMI高出2%。经历过严重囚禁的祖父所生的男性孙子们在45岁以后每年死亡的风险比非战俘祖父所生的孙子们高出22%-28%，而超重则占这一额外风险的9%-14%。

abstract.text: We use data from a large sample of low- and middle-income countries to study the association (or "gradient") between child height and maternal education. We show that the gap in height between high- and low-SES children is small at birth, rises throughout childhood, and declines in adolescence as girls and boys go through puberty. This inverted U-shaped pattern is consistent with a degree of catch-up in linear height among children of low- relative to high-SES families, in partial contrast to the argument that height deficits cannot be overcome after the early years of life. This finding appears to be explained by the association between SES and the timing of puberty and therefore of the adolescent growth spurt: low-SES children start their adolescent growth spurt later and stop growing at later ages as well.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102797.abstractZh: 我们采用来自大量低收入和中等收入国家的数据，研究儿童身高与母亲教育水平之间的关联（或“梯度”）。研究表明，高收入和低收入家庭儿童在出生时的身高差距较小，这一差距在儿童时期逐渐增大，并在青春期随着女孩和男孩的青春期发育而减小。这种倒U形的模式与低收入家庭儿童在线性身高上的追赶现象一致，这与“身高缺陷在生命早期阶段无法克服”的观点形成对比。这一发现似乎可以解释为社会经济地位与青春期发育时间之间的关联，因此低收入家庭儿童的青春期生长突增开始得更晚，停止生长的年龄也较晚。

abstract.text: This paper evaluates the causal effect of drug decriminalization on unintentional drug overdose deaths in a context with relatively poor access to drug treatment services. Using the synthetic control method, I find that when Oregon decriminalized small amounts of drugs in February 2021, it caused 182 additional unintentional drug overdose deaths to occur in Oregon in 2021. This represents a 23% increase over the number of unintentional drug overdose deaths predicted if Oregon had not decriminalized drugs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102798.abstractZh: 本文评估了在药物治疗服务相对匮乏的背景下，药物非刑事化对非故意药物过量死亡的影响。通过合成控制法分析发现，当俄勒冈州在2021年2月将少量药物非刑事化后，2021年俄勒冈州新增了182例非故意药物过量死亡事件。这一数字比俄勒冈州未实施药物非刑事化时预测的非故意药物过量死亡数量增加了23%。

abstract.text: The increasing demand for electricity worldwide has caused a corresponding rise in the consumption of coal, leading to an increase in sulfur dioxide (SO 2 ) pollution levels. Despite the severity of the issue, there is a lack of conclusive evidence establishing a causal link between SO 2 pollution and health, particularly in developing countries. We leverage a large national environmental regulation policy, implemented in China to reduce SO 2 emissions, to estimate the impacts of SO 2 pollution on mortality. We find that 1-μg/m 3 reduction in SO 2 concentrations leads to 18 fewer cardiovascular deaths per 100,000 people aged 60 years and above (0.9% decrease) and 2 fewer deaths per 100,000 children under the age of 5 (1.5% decrease) annually. A back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests that the total health benefits of the environmental policy outweigh its economic costs. The results are consistent across various robustness checks.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102799.abstractZh: 全球对电力需求的增加导致了煤炭消费量的相应上升，进而使得二氧化硫（SO₂）污染水平上升。尽管这一问题十分严重，但缺乏确凿证据来证实二氧化硫污染与健康之间的因果关系，尤其是在发展中国家。我们利用中国实施的一项大规模国家环境监管政策来估算二氧化硫污染对死亡率的影响。研究发现，每降低1微克/立方米的二氧化硫浓度，每年会导致60岁及以上人群的心血管死亡人数减少18人（下降0.9%），5岁以下儿童死亡人数减少2人（下降1.5%）。粗略计算表明，该环境政策带来的总健康效益超过了其经济成本。这些结果在多种稳健性检验中均保持一致。

abstract.text: Extreme heat negatively impacts cognition, learning, and task performance. With increasing global temperatures, workers may therefore be at increased risk of work-related injuries and illness. This study estimates the effects of temperature on worker health using records spanning 1985-2020 from an Australian mandatory insurance scheme. High temperatures are found to cause significantly more claims, particularly among manual workers in outdoor-based industries. These adverse effects have not diminished across time, with the largest effect observed for the 2015-2020 period, indicating increasing vulnerability to heat. Within occupations, the workers most adversely affected by heat are female, older-aged and higher-earning. Finally, results from firm-level panel analyses show that the percentage increase in claims on hot days is largest at "safer" firms.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102800.abstractZh: 极端高温会对认知、学习和任务表现产生负面影响。随着全球气温的上升，工人面临的工作相关伤害和疾病风险也可能增加。本研究利用澳大利亚一项强制性保险计划1985年至2020年的数据，估算了温度对工人健康的影响。研究发现，高温会导致更多的索赔，尤其是在户外行业的手工工人中。这些不利影响随着时间的推移并未减弱，2015年至2020年期间的影响最为显著，表明工人对高温的脆弱性在增加。在职业类别中，受高温影响最严重的群体是女性、年龄较大者和收入较高者。最后，企业层面面板分析的结果显示，在“较安全”的企业中，高温天气下索赔比例的增加幅度最大。

abstract.text: Healthcare firms regularly seek outside capital; yet, we have an incomplete understanding of external investor influence on provider behavior. We investigate the effects of private equity investment, divestment, and an initial public offering (IPO) on ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs). Throughput is unchanged while charges grow by up to 50% for the same service mix. Affected ASCs witness declines in privately insured cases and rely more on Medicare business. Private equity increases physician ASC ownership stakes, and both simultaneously divest when the ASC is sold. Our findings appear more consistent with private equity influencing the financing of ASCs, rather than treatment approaches.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102801.abstractZh: 医疗公司经常寻求外部资本支持，然而，我们对外部投资者对医疗服务提供者行为的影响了解并不充分。我们研究了私募股权投资、资产剥离以及首次公开募股对门诊手术中心的影响。在相同的服务组合下，门诊手术中心的运营效率保持不变，但收费却增加了高达50%。受影响的门诊手术中心在私人保险业务中的份额下降，并且更加依赖医疗保险业务。私募股权投资增加了医生在门诊手术中心的持股比例，而在门诊手术中心被出售时，这两种情况会同时发生资产剥离。我们的研究结果似乎表明，私募股权投资更多地影响了门诊手术中心的融资方式，而非治疗方式。

abstract.text: We examine the relationship between cognitive ability and prompt COVID-19 vaccination using individual-level data on more than 700,000 individuals in Sweden. We find a strong positive association between cognitive ability and swift vaccination, which remains even after controlling for confounding variables with a twin-design. The results suggest that the complexity of the vaccination decision may make it difficult for individuals with lower cognitive abilities to understand the benefits of vaccination. Consistent with this, we show that simplifying the vaccination decision through pre-booked vaccination appointments alleviates almost all of the inequality in vaccination behavior.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102802.abstractZh: 我们研究了认知能力与快速接种COVID-19疫苗之间的关系，使用了瑞典超过70万人的个体级数据进行分析。研究发现，认知能力与快速接种之间存在强烈的正相关关系，即使在控制了混杂变量后，这一关系依然显著。结果表明，疫苗接种决策的复杂性可能导致认知能力较低的个体难以理解接种疫苗的好处。与此观点一致的是，我们指出，通过预先预约接种时间来简化疫苗接种决策，几乎可以消除疫苗接种行为中的不平等现象。

abstract.text: We link data on regional Organized Screening Programs (OSPs) throughout Europe with survey data and population-based cancer registries to estimate effects of OSPs on breast cancer screening (mammography), incidence, and mortality. Identification is from regional variation in the existence and timing of OSPs, and in their age-eligibility criteria. We estimate that OSPs, on average, increase mammography by 25 percentage points, increase breast cancer incidence by 16% five years after the OSPs implementation, and reduce breast cancer mortality by about 10% ten years after.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102803.abstractZh: 我们将欧洲各地的有组织筛查项目的数据与调查数据以及基于人口统计的癌症登记数据相结合，以评估这些项目对乳腺癌筛查（乳腺X线摄影）、发病率和死亡率的影响。研究中的差异主要源于各地区的有组织筛查项目的存在和实施时间，以及其年龄资格标准的不同。我们估计，这些项目平均使乳腺X线摄影的覆盖率增加了25个百分点，乳腺癌发病率在项目实施五年后增加了16%，而在十年后则减少了约10%。

abstract.text: Although mental health conditions are known to be associated with socioeconomic hardships, their causal effects remain largely unexplored. Using a sample of low-income families in the National Health Interview Survey (NHIS), we assess causal effects of serious mental illness (SMI) and related mental health conditions on family food security. We apply partial identification methods to account for fundamental endogeneity and measurement identification problems in a unified framework. To implement these methods, we combine a proxy measure of SMI in the NHIS with an estimate of the true rate of SMI from the Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration. We also develop an innovative approach to approximate true prevalence rates when only self-reported prevalence rates are available. Applying relatively weak monotonicity assumptions on latent food security outcomes, we find that alleviating SMI would improve the food security rate by at least 9.5 percentage points, or 15 %. JEL codes: C21, I10, I38.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102804.abstractZh: 尽管已知心理健康问题与社会经济困难有关，但其因果关系仍未被充分研究。本研究以全国健康访谈调查中的低收入家庭样本为对象，评估严重精神疾病及相关心理健康问题对家庭粮食安全的影响。我们采用部分识别方法，在统一框架内解决基本的内生性和测量识别问题。为实施这些方法，我们将NHIS中严重精神疾病的代理指标与物质滥用与心理健康服务管理局提供的真实患病率估计值相结合。此外，我们还提出了一种创新方法，在仅有自我报告的患病率数据时，估算真实患病率。基于相对较弱的单调性假设，我们发现缓解严重精神疾病可将家庭粮食安全率提高至少9.5个百分点，即15%。JEL代码：C21、I10、I38。

abstract.text: As health is increasingly recognized as a key component of human welfare, a new line of research on intergenerational mobility has emerged that focuses on broad measures of health. We extend this research to consider two key components of health: physical health and mental health. We use rich survey data from the United Kingdom linking the health of adult children at around age 30 to their parents. We estimate that the rank-rank slope in health is 0.17 and the intergenerational health association is 0.19 suggesting relatively rapid mobility compared to other outcomes such as income. We find that while both mental and physical health have a similar degree of intergenerational persistence, parents' mental health is much more strongly associated with broad measures of adult children's health than parents' physical health. We also show that the primacy of parent mental health over physical health on children's health appears to emerge during early adolescence. Finally, we construct a comprehensive measure of welfare by combining income and health and estimate a rank-rank association of 0.27. This is considerably lower than the comparable estimate of 0.43 from the US suggesting that there is greater mobility in welfare in the UK than in the US.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102805.abstractZh: 随着健康越来越被認为是人类福利的关键组成部分，一项关于代际流动性的新研究应运而生，该研究关注健康的广泛指标。我们将这一研究扩展到考虑健康的两个关键组成部分：身体健康和心理健康。我们利用了来自英国的丰富调查数据，将大约30岁的成年子女的健康状况与其父母的健康状况联系起来进行分析。我们估计，健康方面的代际关联系数为0.17，而心理健康方面的代际关联系数为0.19，这表明与其他指标如收入相比，健康状况的代际流动性相对较快。我们发现，虽然心理健康和身体健康在代际持续性方面具有相似程度，但父母心理健康与子女健康的广泛指标之间的关联要强于父母身体健康与子女健康的关联。我们还发现，父母心理健康对子女健康的首要影响似乎出现在青少年早期。最后，我们通过结合收入和健康数据，构建了一个全面的福利衡量指标，并估计其代际关联系数为0.27。这一数值明显低于美国的相关估计值0.43，表明英国的福利流动性比美国更强。

abstract.text: We examine how patients' medical expertise influences adherence to clinical guidelines for a treatment that is common, costly, and rationed by the clinical guidelines. Using administrative data on prenatal diagnostic testing (PDT), we compare the testing rates of medically trained patients (experts) and non-medically trained patients (non-experts) on the margin of eligibility thresholds in clinical guidelines. We find that experts are 9 percentage points more likely to receive PDT than non-experts when they are not eligible for testing and that more than 80% of the difference can be attributed to medical expertise. Our results suggest that the design of clinical guidelines is important for adherence and that having medical expertise as a patient affects treatment, when there is room for a deviation from the guideline.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102806.abstractZh: 我们研究了患者的医学专业知识如何影响对一种常见、昂贵且受临床指南限制的治疗的遵守情况。利用关于产前诊断测试的行政数据，我们比较了具有医学培训的患者（专家）和没有医学培训的患者（非专家）在符合临床指南的资格门槛时的测试率。我们发现，当非专家不符合测试条件时，专家比非专家更有可能接受产前诊断测试，且超过80%的差异可以归因于医学专业知识。我们的研究结果表明，临床指南的设计对患者的遵守情况至关重要，而作为患者拥有医学专业知识会影响治疗，尤其是在有偏离指南的空间时。

abstract.text: During the late 19 th and early 20 th century, several states mandated midwifery licensing requirements to improve midwives' knowledge, education, and quality. Previous studies point to the health benefits of midwifery quality improvements for maternal and infant health outcomes. This paper exploits the staggered adoption of midwifery laws across states using event-study and difference-in-difference frameworks. We use the universe of death records in the US over the years 1979-2020 and find that exposure to a midwifery licensing law at birth is associated with a 2.5 percent reduction in cumulative mortality rates and an increase of 0.6 months in longevity during adulthood and old age. The effects are concentrated on deaths due to infectious diseases, neoplasm diseases, and suicide mortality. We also show that the impacts are confined among blacks and are slightly larger among males. Additional analyses using alternative data sources suggest small but significant increases in educational attainments, income, measures of socioeconomic status, employment, and measures of height as potential mechanism channels. We provide a discussion on the economic magnitude and policy implication of the results.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102807.abstractZh: 在19世纪末至20世纪初，多个州实施了助产士执照制度，以提高助产士的知识水平、教育程度和质量。先前的研究指出，助产士质量的提升对孕产妇和婴儿的健康状况有积极影响。本文利用事件研究和差异-差异框架，分析了各州在助产士法律实施上的差异。我们使用了1979年至2020年美国死亡记录数据，发现出生时的助产士执照制度与累计死亡率降低2.5%，以及成年和老年时期的寿命延长0.6个月有关。这些影响主要集中在因传染病、肿瘤疾病和自杀导致的死亡上。我们还发现，这些影响在黑人群体中更为明显，在男性中则稍大一些。使用其他数据来源进行的额外分析表明，教育水平、收入、社会经济地位指标、就业情况以及身高等指标也有小幅但显著的增加，这些可能是影响助产士质量提升的机制途径。我们对这些结果的经济影响和政策意义进行了讨论。

abstract.text: This paper studies how altruistic preferences are changed by markets and incentives. We conduct a laboratory experiment with a within-subject design. Subjects are asked to choose health care qualities for hypothetical patients in monopoly, duopoly, and quadropoly. Prices, costs, and patient benefits are experimental incentive parameters. In monopoly, subjects choose quality by trading off between profits and altruistic patient benefits. In duopoly and quadropoly, subjects play a simultaneous-move game. Uncertain about an opponent's altruism, each subject competes for patients by choosing qualities. Bayes-Nash equilibria describe subjects' quality decisions as functions of altruism. Using a nonparametric method, we estimate the population altruism distributions from Bayes-Nash equilibrium qualities in different markets and incentive configurations. Competition tends to reduce altruism, but duopoly and quadropoly equilibrium qualities are much higher than monopoly. Although markets crowd out altruism, the disciplinary powers of market competition are stronger. Counterfactuals confirm markets change preferences.
