10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102808.abstractZh: 本文研究市场与激励因素如何改变利他主义偏好。我们进行了一项实验性研究，采用被试内设计。参与者被要求为假设中的患者选择医疗保健质量，研究情境包括垄断、双头垄断和四头垄断三种情况。价格、成本以及患者收益被作为实验性激励参数。在垄断情境下，参与者需要在利润与患者的利他主义利益之间进行权衡以选择质量。而在双头垄断和四头垄断情境中，参与者则处于同时行动的游戏状态。由于不确定对手的利他主义行为，每个参与者都通过选择不同的质量来争夺患者。贝叶斯-纳什均衡描述了参与者基于利他主义做出的质量决策。通过非参数方法，我们估计了不同市场与激励配置下的人群利他主义分布。竞争倾向于降低利他主义，但双头垄断和四头垄断下的均衡质量远高于垄断状态。尽管市场会抑制利他主义，但市场竞争的纪律性更强。反事实分析证实市场确实会改变人们的偏好。

abstract.text: This paper investigates how office-based physicians respond to Medicare reimbursement changes. Using variation from an Affordable Care Act policy that increased reimbursements for office-based care in four states, we use a triple difference analysis, comparing physicians with higher and lower reimbursement changes in treated states to similar physicians in untreated states. We find two mechanisms through which physicians respond. First, the reimbursement change affected integration-physicians with larger increases in office-based reimbursement were less likely to vertically integrate with hospitals and more likely to continue providing office-based care than physicians with smaller reimbursement increases. Second, we find some evidence that physicians who continued practicing in an office setting increased the volume of services provided.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102816.abstractZh: 本文研究了办公室执业医生对医疗保险报销政策变化的反应。通过对比四个州根据《平价医疗法案》实施的报销政策变化，我们采用了三重差异分析的方法，比较了在受政策影响的州中报销金额增加幅度较大的医生与减少幅度较大的医生，以及未受政策影响的州中类似医生的反应。我们发现医生反应存在两种机制。首先，报销金额的变化影响了医生的整合程度——报销金额增加幅度较大的医生，与报销金额增加幅度较小的医生相比，更不愿意与医院进行垂直整合，反而更有可能继续提供办公室执业服务。其次，我们发现继续在办公室执业的医生提供的服务量有所增加。

abstract.text: Full practice authority grants non-physician providers the ability to manage patient care without physician oversight or direct collaboration. In this study, we consider whether full practice authority for certified nurse-midwives (CNMs/CMs) leads to changes in health outcomes or CNM/CM use. Using U.S. birth certificate and death certificate records over 2008-2019, we show that CNM/CM full practice authority led to little change in obstetric outcomes, maternal mortality, or neonatal mortality. Instead, full practice authority increases (reported) CNM/CM-attended deliveries by one percentage point while decreasing (reported) physician-attended births. We then explore the mechanisms behind the increase in CNM/CM-attended deliveries, demonstrating that the rise in CNM/CM-attended deliveries represents higher use of existing CNM/CMs and is not fully explainable by improved reporting of CNM/CM deliveries or changes in CNM/CM labor supply.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102817.abstractZh: 完全执业权赋予非医师从业者管理患者护理的能力，无需医师监督或直接协作。本研究探讨了获得认证护士助产士（CNMs/CMs）完全执业权是否会导致健康结果的变化或助产士的使用情况发生变化。通过对比2008-2019年美国出生和死亡登记数据，我们发现完全执业权对产科结果、孕产妇死亡率和新生儿死亡率的影响很小。相反，完全执业权使助产士接生的分娩次数增加了1个百分点，而由医师接生的分娩次数则减少了。我们进一步探讨了助产士接生次数增加背后的机制，发现助产士接生次数的增加反映了现有助产士的使用率上升，而这一变化并不能完全归因于助产士分娩报告的改进或助产士劳动力供应的变化。

abstract.text: Tobacco 21 (T-21) laws raise the minimum legal purchasing age for all tobacco products to 21. This study is the first to examine the impact of statewide T21 laws on teenage and young adult cigarette and electronic cigarette (e-cigarette) use. Using survey data from the Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS) and a difference-in-differences approach, we find that statewide adoption of a T-21 law is associated with a 2-to-4 percentage-point decline in smoking participation among 18-to-20-year-olds. Supplemental analyses using the State Youth Risk Behavior Surveys (YRBS) show that frequent e-cigarette use among 18-year-olds also fell following the adoption of T21 laws, though this effect was partially because teens turned to informal social sources to obtain e-cigarettes (i.e., borrowing or bumming). Finally, we find that T-21 laws generate spillover effects, including (2) reductions in cigarette use among 16-to-17-year-olds, a group that relies heavily on informal social markets in high school, and (2) reductions in marijuana use and days of alcohol use among some teens.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102818.abstractZh: Tobacco 21（T-21）法律将所有烟草产品的法定购买年龄提高到21岁。本研究首次探讨了全州范围内T-21法律对青少年和年轻成年人使用香烟和电子香烟的影响。通过利用行为风险因素监测系统（BRFSS）的调查数据以及差异-差异分析法，我们发现全州范围内实施T-21法律后，18至20岁人群的吸烟参与率下降了2到4个百分点。进一步使用州青少年风险行为调查数据进行的分析表明，在T-21法律实施后，18岁青少年频繁使用电子香烟的情况也有所减少，不过这一效果部分是由于青少年转向非正式的社会渠道获取电子香烟（如借用或盗用）。最后，我们发现T-21法律还产生了溢出效应，包括：（2）16至17岁青少年在高中时期严重依赖非正式社会市场，从而减少了香烟使用量；（2）一些青少年减少了大麻使用以及饮酒天数。

abstract.text: Shortages and rationing are common in health care, yet we know little about the consequences. We examine an 18-month shortage of the pediatric Haemophilus Influenzae Type B (Hib) vaccine. Using insurance claims data and variation in shortage exposure across birth cohorts, we find that the shortage reduced uptake of high-value primary doses by 4 percentage points and low-value booster doses by 26 percentage points. This suggests providers largely complied with rationing recommendations. In the long-run, catch-up vaccination occurred but was incomplete: shortage-exposed cohorts were 4 percentage points less likely to have received the ir booster dose years later. We also find that the shortage and rationing caused provider switches, extra provider visits, and negative spillovers to other care.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102819.abstractZh: 在医疗保健领域，短缺和配给制度很常见，但我们对其后果知之甚少。我们研究了为期18个月的B型流感嗜血杆菌疫苗短缺事件。通过保险索赔数据以及不同出生队列中短缺暴露程度的变化，我们发现该短缺事件使高价值的基础疫苗接种率降低了4个百分点，而低价值的加强疫苗接种率则降低了26个百分点。这表明医疗服务提供者基本上遵循了配给建议。从长远来看，补种疫苗的工作虽然进行了，但效果并不完全：在短缺事件暴露的队列中，几年后接受加强疫苗的比例降低了4个百分点。我们还发现，短缺和配给制度导致了医疗服务提供者的更换、额外的就诊次数，以及对其他护理服务的负面影响。

abstract.text: We study the relationship of wealth with the "quality" of longevity as measured by years after age 65 containing disability or work. By comparing cohorts turning 65 in 1996 and 2006, we observe strong within-cohort gradients of wealth in which the more wealthy live more years disability-free and work more years, yet also experience more work-free years. We document that these gradients steepened over the decade we study. We explore robustness using education as an alternative indicator for socioeconomic status, and rule out certain explanations for these trends by analyzing the effect of health shocks on wealth accumulation.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102820.abstractZh: 我们研究了财富与“长寿质量”之间的关系，长寿质量是通过65岁后是否患有残疾或继续工作的年限来衡量的。通过比较1996年和2006年达到65岁的人群，我们发现财富在群体内部存在明显的梯度变化：越富裕的人能够享受更多的无残疾生活年限，并且工作年限也更长，但同时也有更多的无工作生活年限。我们发现，在研究的十年间，这些梯度变化变得更加明显。我们还通过以教育作为社会经济地位的替代指标来探讨这种变化的稳健性，并通过分析健康冲击对财富积累的影响，排除了某些解释这些趋势的可能性。

abstract.text: This paper assesses the impacts of physician-patient race-match, especially Black patients paired with Black physicians, on patient mortality. We draw on administrative data from Florida, linking hospital encounters from mid-2011 through 2014 to information from the Florida Physician Workforce Survey. Focusing on uninsured patients experiencing unscheduled hospital admissions who are conditionally randomly assigned to physicians, we find that physician-patient race-match for Black patients reduces the likelihood of within-hospital mortality by 0.28 percentage points, a 27 % reduction relative to the overall mortality rate. An alternative identification strategy relying on instrumental variables provides a similar finding.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102821.abstractZh: 本文评估了医患种族匹配的影响，特别是黑人患者与黑人医生配对对患者死亡率的影响。我们基于佛罗里达州的行政数据，将2011年中期至2014年的医院就诊记录与佛罗里达州医生劳动力调查的信息进行关联。研究重点关注未投保且因意外住院而需要住院治疗的患者，这些患者被随机分配到不同的医生处。研究发现，对于黑人患者而言，医患种族匹配可以将院内死亡的可能性降低0.28个百分点，相对于整体死亡率而言，这一降低幅度达到了27%。采用工具变量方法的另一种识别策略也得出了类似的结果。

abstract.text: I estimate the impact of an information campaign on long-term care planning behaviors. I identify this effect using the staggered timing of the federal-state "Own Your Future" campaign, which urged individuals to plan ahead for long-term care needs and reached 26 states over five years. I find the campaign increased long-term care insurance coverage for individuals in the top quintile of the asset distribution by four percentage points, or seventeen percent. A back-of-the-envelope calculation indicates Medicaid savings of $483 million in present value.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102822.abstractZh: 我评估了信息宣传活动对长期护理规划行为的影响。我通过联邦与州政府联合开展的“Own Your Future”活动的分阶段实施来识别这一效应，该活动鼓励个人提前规划长期护理需求，并在五年时间内覆盖了26个州。我发现，该活动使资产分布处于最高五分位的人群的长期护理保险覆盖率增加了四个百分点，即17%。粗略计算表明， Medicaid的节省金额以现值计算为4.83亿美元。

abstract.text: Nursing homes serve both long-term care and post-acute care (PAC) patients, two groups with distinct financing mechanisms and requirements for care. We examine empirically the effect of nursing home specialization in PAC using 2011-2018 data for Medicare patients admitted to nursing homes following a hospital stay. To address patient selection into specialized nursing homes, we use an instrumental variables approach that exploits variation over time in the distance from the patient's residential ZIP code to the closest nursing home with different levels of PAC specialization. We find that patients admitted to nursing homes more specialized in PAC have lower hospital readmissions and mortality, longer nursing home stays, and higher Medicare spending for the episode of care, suggesting that specialization improves patient outcomes but at higher costs.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102823.abstractZh: 养老院为长期护理和急性后期护理患者提供服务，这两类患者的融资机制和护理要求各不相同。我们通过2011-2018年的数据，对养老院在急性后期护理方面的专业化程度对患者的影响进行了实证研究。为了分析患者选择进入专业化养老院的原因，我们采用了工具变量方法，该方法利用了患者居住区邮政编码与最近的具有不同急性后期护理专业化水平的养老院之间的距离随时间的变化情况。研究发现，被送入专业化养老院的患者，医院再入院率和死亡率较低，在养老院停留的时间较长，且该护理期间的医疗保险支出也较高。这表明专业化确实改善了患者的治疗效果，但代价也更高。

abstract.text: Drawing on a panel dataset-the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Survey (CHARLS)-and other city- and individual-level datasets, this study examines the causal impact of pollution information disclosure on individual outdoor activities and the health status of the middle-aged and elderly. Using city-level variations in disclosure timing, we found that the adoption of pollution information disclosure (PID) significantly reduces the probability of outdoor exercise, especially for those living in more polluted cities. This occurs mainly through enhanced awareness of environmental pollution, particularly for those who are more educated. However, the adoption of PID does not lead to an improvement in health status.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102824.abstractZh: 本研究基于中国健康与退休纵向调查（CHARLS）的面板数据集以及其他城市和个体层面的数据集，探讨了污染信息公开对个人户外活动和中老年人健康状况的因果影响。通过考察城市层面信息公开时间的差异，我们发现污染信息公开的实施显著降低了户外锻炼的概率，尤其是在污染较为严重的城市。这一现象主要源于对环境污染意识的增强，尤其是受教育程度较高的人群。然而，污染信息公开并未带来健康状况的改善。

abstract.text: Employers may respond to minimum wage increases by adjusting their health benefits. We examine the impact of state minimum wage increases on employer health benefit offerings using the 2002-2020 Medical Expenditure Panel Survey - Insurance/Employer Component data. Our primary regression specifications are difference-in-differences models that estimate the relationship between within-state changes in employer-sponsored insurance and minimum wage laws over time. We find that a $1 increase in minimum wages is associated with a 0.92 percentage point (p.p.) decrease in the percentage of employers offering health insurance, largely driven by small employers and employers with a greater share of low-wage employees. A $1 increase is also associated with a 1.83 p.p. increase in the prevalence of plans with a deductible requirement, but we do not find consistent evidence that other benefit characteristics are affected. We find no consequent change in uninsurance, likely explained by an increase in Medicaid enrollment.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102825.abstractZh: 雇主可能会通过调整其健康福利来应对最低工资的提高。我们利用2002-2020年医疗支出调查中的保险/雇主部分数据，研究了州最低工资提高对雇主提供健康福利的影响。我们的主要回归模型是差异-差异模型，用于估计州内雇主赞助保险的变化与最低工资法律随时间变化之间的关系。我们发现，最低工资每提高1美元，提供健康保险的雇主比例就会下降0.92个百分点，这一影响主要受到小型雇主和雇佣低薪员工比例较高的雇主的影响。同时，最低工资每提高1美元，需要自付费用的保险计划的普及率也会上升1.83个百分点，但我们没有发现其他福利特征受到影响的一致证据。我们没有发现无保险现象随之发生的变化，这可能是由于医疗补助参保人数的增加所解释的。

abstract.text: Mandated minimum nurse-to-patient ratios have been the subject of active debate in the U.S. for over twenty years and are under legislative consideration today in several states and at the federal level. This paper uses the 1999 California nurse staffing mandate as an empirical setting to estimate the causal effects of minimum ratios on hospitals. Minimum ratios led to a 58 min increase in nursing time per patient day and 9 percent increase in the wage bill per patient day in the general medical/surgical acute care unit among treated hospitals. Hospitals responded on several margins: increased use of lower-licensed and younger nurses, reduced capacity by 16 beds (14 percent), and increased bed utilization rates by 0.045 points (8 percent). Using administrative data on discharges for acute myocardial infarction (AMI), I find a significant reduction in length of stay (5 percent) and no effect on the 30-day all-cause readmission rate. The null effect on readmissions suggests that length of stay declined not because hospitals were discharging AMI patients "quicker and sicker", rather, AMI patients recovered more quickly due to an improvement in care quality per day.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102826.abstractZh: 美国关于护士与患者之间最低比例的规定已经进行了二十多年的热烈讨论，目前多个州和联邦层面也在审议相关立法。本文以1999年加利福尼亚州关于护士配备的规定为实证案例，研究最低比例对医院的影响。研究发现，在受影响的医院中，最低比例规定导致每患者日的护理时间增加了58分钟，每患者日的工资支出增加了9%。医院对此的反应各不相同：一些医院增加了使用资质较低和较年轻的护士，同时减少了16张床位的使用（减少了14%），而另一些医院则提高了床位利用率0.045个百分点（8%）。通过对急性心肌梗死患者出院数据的分析，我发现住院时间显著减少5%，但30天内的全因再入院率没有变化。这种对再入院率的零影响表明，住院时间的减少并非因为医院过早或治疗不当，而是由于护理质量的提高，使得急性心肌梗死患者能够更快康复。

abstract.text: This paper uses a large UK cohort to investigate the impact of early-life pollution exposure on individuals' human capital and health outcomes in older age. We compare individuals who were exposed to the London smog in December 1952 whilst in utero or in infancy to those born after the smog and those born at the same time but in unaffected areas. We find that those exposed to the smog have substantially lower fluid intelligence and worse respiratory health, with some evidence of a reduction in years of schooling.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102827.abstractZh: 本文采用英国的大规模队列研究，探讨早期生活污染暴露对个体人力资本和老年健康结果的影响。我们对比了在1952年12月伦敦烟雾期间在子宫内或婴儿期暴露于该烟雾的个体，与那些在烟雾过后出生的个体以及在同一时期但在未受污染地区出生的个体。研究发现，暴露于烟雾的个体在流体智力方面明显较低，呼吸系统健康状况也较差，并且有证据表明他们的受教育年限有所减少。

abstract.text: We show that the first nationwide mass vaccination campaign against measles increased educational attainment in the United States. Our empirical strategy exploits variation in exposure to the childhood disease across states right before the Measles Eradication Campaign of 1967-68, which reduced reported measles incidence by 90 percent within two years. Our results suggest that mass vaccination against measles increased the years of education on average by about 0.1 years in the affected cohorts. We also find tentative evidence that the college graduation rate of men increased.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102828.abstractZh: 我们表明，美国首次全国性的麻疹大规模疫苗接种运动提高了教育水平。我们的实证分析利用了1967-68年麻疹根除运动前各州儿童患病情况的差异，该运动在两年内使报告的麻疹发病率降低了90%。我们的研究结果表明，麻疹大规模疫苗接种使受影响人群的平均教育年限增加了约0.1年。我们还发现了一些初步证据，表明男性的大学毕业率也有所提高。

abstract.text: We use Nielsen Homescan data to examine whether the incidence of cigarette taxes on menthol products varies with race. We find that taxes are shifted at significantly lower rates to Black smokers of menthol cigarettes than any other smokers. One possible explanation is that the industry targets price promotions to Black menthol smokers because they tend to be more responsive to cigarette prices relative to other smokers. We find evidence that Black smokers receive significantly more price discounts for menthol products than white menthol smokers. Our findings indicate that increasing cigarette taxes would effectively reduce menthol smoking among Black Americans because tax pass-through rate for Black menthol smokers is still substantially above zero.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102829.abstractZh: 我们使用Nielsen Homescan的数据来研究薄荷烟产品上的香烟税征收情况是否因种族而异。我们发现，薄荷烟的黑人吸烟者所承担的税收比例明显低于其他吸烟者。一种可能的解释是，该行业针对黑人薄荷烟消费者进行价格促销，因为相对于其他吸烟者，他们更敏感于香烟价格的变化。我们的研究还发现，黑人薄荷烟消费者在薄荷烟产品上获得的折扣明显多于白人消费者。因此，提高香烟税实际上会减少美国黑人中的薄荷烟消费，因为黑人薄荷烟消费者的税收分摊率仍然远高于零。

abstract.text: We assess whether informal care receipt affects the probability of transitioning to a nursing home. Available evidence derives from the US, where nursing home stays are often temporary. Exploiting linked survey and administrative data from the Netherlands, we use the gender mix of children to retrieve exogenous variation in informal care receipt. We find that informal care increases the chance of an admission within a three-year period for individuals with severe functional limitations, and increases the costs incurred on formal home care. For individuals with mild limitations, informal care substantially decreases total care costs, whereas its effect on nursing home admission is unclear. Further, informal care results in lower post-acute care use and hospital care costs, and does not increase mortality. Promoting informal care cannot be expected to systematically result in lower institutionalization rate and care costs, but it may nonetheless induce health benefits for its recipients.

10.1016/j.jhealeco.2023.102831.abstractZh: 我们评估了接受非正式护理是否会影响入住养老院的概率。现有证据主要来自美国，那里的养老院入住通常是临时性的。利用荷兰的关联调查和行政数据，我们通过儿童性别组合来捕捉非正式护理接受情况的外生变化。我们发现，对于功能严重受限的个体来说，非正式护理增加了入住养老院的可能性，并增加了正式家庭护理的成本。对于功能轻度受限的个体而言，非正式护理显著降低了总护理成本，但其对养老院入住的影响尚不明确。此外，非正式护理还降低了急性后的护理使用率和医院护理成本，并不会增加死亡率。虽然不能期望促进非正式护理会系统性地降低机构化率和护理成本，但它仍可能为接受者带来健康益处。

abstract.text: The paper examines how politics relates to public sector absenteeism, a chronic and intractable public service delivery problem in many developing countries. In Punjab, Pakistan, we document that political interference routinely protects doctors from bureaucratic sanction, while personal connections between doctors and politicians and a lack of political competition are associated with more doctor absence. We then examine how politics impacts the success of an at-scale policy reform to combat absenteeism. We find that the reform was more effective at increasing doctor attendance in politically competitive constituencies, both through increased monitoring and through senior health officials being able to respond more effectively to the data gathered on poor performing clinics. Our results demonstrate that politics can block the success of reform; instead of lifting poor performers up, the reform only improved places that had already been performing better. The evidence collectively points to the fundamental importance of accounting for political incentives in policy design and implementation.

10.1016/j.jpubeco.2022.104787.abstractZh: 本文探讨了政治与公共部门缺勤之间的关系，这是许多发展中国家普遍存在且难以解决的公共服务提供问题。在巴基斯坦的旁遮普省，我们发现政治干预经常保护医生免受官僚制裁，而医生与政治家之间的个人关系以及缺乏政治竞争则会导致更多的医生缺勤。接着，我们研究了政治如何影响大规模政策改革以打击缺勤现象的效果。研究发现，在政治竞争激烈的选区，通过加强监督以及让高级卫生官员更有效地处理关于表现不佳诊所的数据，政策改革在提高医生出勤率方面更为有效。我们的研究结果表明，政治可能会阻碍改革的成功；改革不仅未能提升表现不佳的诊所，反而只改善了那些原本表现就较好的诊所。这些证据共同表明，在政策设计和实施过程中考虑政治激励因素至关重要。

abstract.text: Surveys are widely used to assess hospital management with the aim of understanding differences in management practices. However, survey measures with prior notice can make hospitals change their routine practices and are unable to reflect the actual hospital management level. The World Management Survey (WMS) methodology has been developed to ameliorate these issues. It uses a double-blinded method and open-ended question design. The Chinese Hospital Management Survey (CHMS) project is the first to adapt the WMS methodology in China, which it uses to measure hospital management level in 510 hospitals. This paper provides an instrument to better measure actual management practices, which makes it possible to compare the management level of hospitals in China and other countries.

10.1016/j.mex.2023.102066.abstractZh: 调查被广泛用于评估医院管理，目的是了解不同管理实践之间的差异。然而，事先通知的调查措施可能会促使医院改变常规做法，无法反映实际的医院管理水平。世界管理调查（WMS）方法应运而生，旨在解决这些问题。该方法采用双盲设计和开放式问题设计。中国医院管理调查（CHMS）项目是首个在中国应用WMS方法的研究，该调查用于评估510家医院的管理水平。本文提供了一种更好的测量实际管理实践的工具，使得比较中国与其他国家医院的管理水平成为可能。

abstract.text: This chapter focuses on the interplay of health policy and politics at a national level, and: explores the process by which health policy is created and the context in which it is developed and influenced; considers the interplay between policy and its implementation; and offers a narrative of the evolution of national health policy and politics in England over the last 30 years.

10.1017/9781009378260.020.abstractZh: 本章重点关注国家层面上的健康政策与政治之间的相互作用，包括：探讨健康政策制定的过程及其所处的环境；考虑政策与实施之间的相互作用；并叙述过去30年来英格兰国家健康政策与政治的演变过程。

abstract.text: Do the choices of city leaders matter for local economic conditions? While existing literature focuses on how the preferences of local officials influence city policy, we argue that the managerial skill of local leaders should condition their ability to achieve their goals. We conduct an original phone survey of over 300 mayors and city managers across the USA to learn about their management practices. Using a two-way fixed effects design that holds fixed a rich battery of individual and city-level characteristics, we examine how changes in leadership affect economic growth, a common goal for local officials. We find that when local leaders employ the “best practices” of organizational management, their cities grow across a range of indicators. These results are strongest for the subset of leaders who mention a growth-related goal for their time in office, suggesting that managerial skill allows local leaders to more effectively achieve their objectives.

10.1017/psrm.2023.17.abstractZh: 城市领导者的选择是否对当地经济状况有影响？现有文献主要关注地方官员的偏好如何影响城市政策，而我们认为，地方领导者的管理技能应影响其实现目标的能力。我们对美国各地的300多名市长和城市管理者进行了电话调查，以了解他们的管理实践。通过采用双向固定效应设计，我们控制了大量个体和城市层面的特征，研究领导方式的变化如何影响经济增长——这是地方官员的共同目标。我们发现，当地方领导者采用“最佳管理实践”时，他们的城市在多个指标上都有所增长。这一结果在那些提到在任期间有增长目标的领导者中最为明显，这表明管理技能使地方领导者能够更有效地实现其目标。

abstract.text: The extremely complex and dynamic digital environments of universities make them highly vulnerable to the risk of data breaches. This study empirically investigated the factors influencing data breach risks in the context of higher education, according to crime opportunity theory and routine activity theory. The data consisted of university samples from China and were collected mainly from the Chinese Education Industry Vulnerability Reporting Platform. After applying Poisson regression for the estimation, increased public disclosure of vulnerabilities was found to escalate the frequency of data breaches, whereas cross-border data flow decreased the number of data breaches. Furthermore, the mechanism by which academic strength affects data breaches was examined through the two mediators of cross-border data flow and vulnerability disclosure. In addition, cloud adoption reduced data breaches, and public clouds were determined to be relatively more secure than private clouds. Cloud adoption also acted as a moderator between the negative impact of vulnerabilities and the positive impact of cross-border data flow on data breaches. The estimation and robustness findings revealed the underlying mechanisms that impacted university data security, clarifying the understanding of data breaches and suggesting practical implications for universities and other institutes to improve information security. The findings of this study provide insights and directions for future research.

10.1057/s41599-023-01757-0.abstractZh: 大学中极其复杂且动态的数字环境使其极易面临数据泄露的风险。本研究基于犯罪机会理论和日常活动理论，实证分析了影响高等教育领域数据泄露风险的因素。数据来源于中国的大学样本，主要收集自中国教育行业脆弱性报告平台。通过泊松回归模型进行估计后发现，公开披露的脆弱性会增加数据泄露的频率，而跨境数据流动则能降低数据泄露的数量。此外，通过跨境数据流动和脆弱性披露这两个中介变量，探讨了学术实力如何影响数据泄露的机制。此外，采用云计算方式可以降低数据泄露的风险，且公共云被认为比私有云更为安全。云计算还起到了缓解脆弱性负面影响与跨境数据流动正面影响之间矛盾的作用。研究中的估计结果和稳健性分析揭示了影响大学数据安全的潜在机制，有助于更好地理解数据泄露现象，并为大学及其他机构改善信息安全提供了实际建议。本研究的结果为未来的研究提供了重要的见解和方向。

abstract.text: Does higher medical spending improve quality of care? We estimate the effect of changes in regulated reimbursement prices for hospitals on multiple dimensions of hospital quality, including mortality outcomes, surgical complications, process quality and patient satisfaction. We exploit an exogenous variation in reimbursement prices between the years 2006 and 2010 based on a reform of hospital financing in Germany. We find that changes in reimbursement prices do not affect quality of care. This effect is precisely estimated, and we can rule out effect sizes that are large relative to the overall variation in quality indicators across hospitals.

10.1080/00036846.2023.2271695.abstractZh: 更高的医疗支出是否能提升护理质量？我们研究了医院受监管报销价格变化对医院质量多个维度的影响，包括死亡率、手术并发症、流程质量以及患者满意度。我们利用了2006年至2010年间德国医院融资改革导致的报销价格变化这一外生变量。研究发现，报销价格的变化并未影响护理质量。这一影响被精确估计，并且我们能够排除那些相对于医院间整体质量指标变化而言较大的影响大小。

abstract.text: In most developed countries, patients have been encouraged to elect their preferred choice of health care provider. However, this is different for specialized care, where the patient’s referral could be defined as a two-stage decision process and their options are pre-selected by their general practitioner (GP). In this study, we estimate patient preferences while controlling for the pre-selection procedure, and we investigate whether patients are actively choosing their provider for cancer care. The French national hospital discharge database (Programme de Médicalisation des Systèmes d’Information, PMSI – MCO 2017) has been used for investigation. We estimated a multinomial choice model when choice sets are in fact unobserved, which is assumed to identify patient preferences, in a revealed preferences framework. Our findings provide evidence that patients consider factors other than distance to select their provider. The patient – hospital distance as well as the specialization profile of providers appears to be internalized in the pre-selection process, while patients rather consider waiting times, hospital quality, and other provider attributes to make their final choice. We also found that patients would be treated in higher-quality hospitals if they had the opportunity to choose among all available providers.

10.1080/00036846.2023.2288041.abstractZh: 在大多数发达国家，患者被鼓励选择自己偏好的医疗服务提供者。然而，对于专科医疗服务来说情况有所不同，患者的选择过程可以被视为一个两阶段决策过程，其选项通常由全科医生预先选定。本研究在控制预先选择程序的情况下，估计了患者的偏好，并探讨了患者是否主动选择癌症治疗的医疗服务提供者。研究采用了法国国家医院出院数据库（信息系统医疗化计划，PMSI – MCO 2017）作为数据来源。当选择集实际上无法观察到时，我们采用了多项式选择模型进行估计，该模型在揭示偏好框架内假设能够识别患者的偏好。研究结果表明，患者在选择医疗服务提供者时考虑的因素不仅仅是距离。患者与医院的距离以及服务提供者的专业背景似乎在预先选择过程中被内部化了，而患者更倾向于考虑等待时间、医院质量以及其他服务提供者的属性来做出最终选择。我们还发现，如果患者有机会在所有可用的医疗服务提供者中进行选择，他们更可能选择在质量更高的医院接受治疗。

abstract.text: This article proposes a new approach to obtain uniformly valid inference for linear functionals or scalar subvectors of a partially identified parameter defined by linear moment inequalities. The procedure amounts to bootstrapping the value functions of randomly perturbed linear programming problems, and does not require the researcher to grid over the parameter space. The low-level conditions for uniform validity rely on genericity results for linear programs. The unconventional perturbation approach produces a confidence set with a coverage probability of 1 over the identified set, but obtains exact coverage on an outer set, is valid under weak assumptions, and is computationally simple to implement.

10.1080/07350015.2023.2203768.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种新方法，用于获得对由线性矩不等式定义的局部识别参数的线性泛函或标量子向量的统一有效推断。该过程相当于对随机扰动的线性规划问题的价值函数进行自举处理，且无需研究人员对参数空间进行网格划分。统一有效性的低阶条件依赖于线性规划的通用性结果。这种非传统的扰动方法能够生成一个覆盖概率为1的置信集，该置信集覆盖了已识别集，并且在外部集上获得精确覆盖；该方法在弱假设下是有效的，且实施起来计算简单。

abstract.text: We provide sufficient conditions for semi-nonparametric point identification of a mixture model of decision making under risk, when agents make choices in multiple lines of insurance coverage (contexts) by purchasing a bundle. As a first departure from the related literature, the model allows for two preference types. In the first one, agents behave according to standard expected utility theory with CARA Bernoulli utility function, with an agent-specific coefficient of absolute risk aversion whose distribution is left completely unspecified. In the other, agents behave according to the dual theory of choice under risk combined with a one-parameter family distortion function, where the parameter is agent-specific and is drawn from a distribution that is left completely unspecified. Within each preference type, the model allows for unobserved heterogeneity in consideration sets, where the latter form at the bundle level—a second departure from the related literature. Our point identification result rests on observing sufficient variation in covariates across contexts, without requiring any independent variation across alternatives within a single context. We estimate the model on data on households’ deductible choices in two lines of property insurance, and use the results to assess the welfare implications of a hypothetical market intervention where the two lines of insurance are combined into a single one. We study the role of limited consideration in mediating the welfare effects of such intervention.

10.1080/07350015.2023.2239949.abstractZh: 我们为在风险下做出决策的混合模型提供了半非参数点识别的充分条件，当代理人通过购买组合来在多个保险覆盖范围内做出选择时。作为相关文献的首次突破，该模型允许两种偏好类型。在第一种偏好类型中，代理人遵循标准期望效用理论，采用CARA伯努利效用函数，并且存在一个与代理人特定的绝对风险厌恶系数，其分布完全未指定。在另一种偏好类型中，代理人遵循风险下的双重选择理论，并结合了一个参数化的扭曲函数，该参数取决于代理人，并且其分布也完全未指定。在每种偏好类型中，模型允许在考虑集中存在未观察到的异质性，这种异质性以组合级别的形式出现——这是相关文献的第二次突破。我们的点识别结果基于在多个情境下观察到协变量的充分变化，而不需要单个情境内各选项之间存在独立变化。我们基于关于家庭在两种财产保险选择中的免赔额数据来估计模型，并利用结果来评估将两种保险合并为单一保险的市场干预对福利的影响。我们研究了有限考虑在中介这种干预的福利效应中的作用。

abstract.text: In the United States, small residential care homes provide affordable community-based care for disabled older adults. Also called adult foster care homes, residential care facilities, group homes, or board and care homes, small residential care homes are typically private, small businesses operating in single-family dwellings that provide round-the-clock care in a home-like setting in residential neighborhoods. While most states license small residential care homes they also exist, legally and illegally, as unlicensed and unregulated operations. The quality of care in some unlicensed and unregulated small residential care homes can be questionable. Disabled older adults are targeted and victimized by unethical small residential care home operators for financial gain. This commentary highlights the need for whole system disruption to end victimization in unethical unlicensed and unregulated small residential care homes through case studies of the abuse and neglect of residents living in unethical unlicensed operations and recommends ambitious goals centered on reducing secondary financial gains and medically neglectful practices. These recommendations are at federal, state, and local levels, and include creating a federal definition of small residential care homes, increasing and coupling government incomes with state registration and employee misconduct registry checks, increasing oversight and assessment, improving temporary guardianship processes, providing avenues for reporting abuse, and developing older adult fatality review teams.

10.1080/08959420.2023.2195788.abstractZh: 在美国，小型住宅护理院为残疾老年人提供经济实惠的社区式护理服务。这些机构也被称为成人寄养护理院、住宅护理设施、集体护理院或寄宿护理院。小型住宅护理院通常是私人小型企业，设在单户住宅内，为居民提供全天候的居家式护理服务。虽然大多数州对小型住宅护理院进行许可管理，但仍有不少未经许可且缺乏监管的运营存在。一些未经许可且缺乏监管的小型住宅护理院所提供的护理质量可能令人质疑。残疾老年人常常成为这些不道德运营者的目标，他们为了经济利益而对其进行虐待和忽视。本文通过案例研究，强调了需要全面改革现有体系，以终结这些不道德、未经许可且缺乏监管的小型住宅护理院对老年人的虐待行为。建议从减少次级经济利益损失和医疗疏忽行为入手，这些建议适用于联邦、州和地方层面，包括制定联邦层面的小型住宅护理院定义、加强政府监管并配合州级注册和员工行为记录检查、增加监管和评估力度、改进临时监护程序、提供报告虐待行为的渠道，以及建立老年人死亡事故审查小组。

abstract.text: This study analyses whether higher efficiency performance of Ecuadorian hospitals attracts larger inflows of interregional patients to a given hospital and assesses the existence of spatial dependence in the patient migration network. We develop an innovative two-stage approach. In the first stage, we use conditional order-m estimations to obtain robust hospital efficiency. In the second stage, we apply a spatial Durbin interaction model to estimate the effect of hospital efficiency on patient migration flows and disentangle the spillover effects. We identify the positive effect of specialized hospitals’ efficiency in attracting patients from other regions alongside spillover effects in the migration dyad.

10.1080/17421772.2023.2204122.abstractZh: 本研究分析厄瓜多尔医院更高的效率表现是否吸引了更多来自其他地区的患者，并评估患者迁移网络中是否存在空间依赖性。我们采用了一种创新的两阶段方法：在第一阶段，我们使用条件序估计来获得可靠的医院效率数据；在第二阶段，我们应用空间Durbin交互模型来估计医院效率对患者迁移流的影响，并分离出溢出效应。我们发现，专科医院的效率在吸引来自其他地区的患者方面具有积极作用，同时这种效应也在患者迁移关系中产生了溢出效应。

abstract.text: We study the welfare implications of personalized pricing implemented with machine learning. We use data from a randomized controlled pricing field experiment to construct personalized prices and validate these in the field. We find that unexercised market power increases profit by 55%. Personalization improves expected profits by an additional 19% and by 86% relative to the nonoptimized price. While total consumer surplus declines under personalized pricing, over 60% of consumers benefit from personalization. Under some inequity-averse welfare functions, consumer welfare may even increase. Simulations reveal a nonmonotonic relationship between the granularity of data and consumer surplus under personalization.

10.1086/720793.abstractZh: 我们研究了采用机器学习技术实施个性化定价的福利影响。我们利用了一项随机对照定价实地实验的数据来构建个性化价格，并在实地进行了验证。研究发现，未充分利用的市场力量可使利润增加55%。个性化定价使预期利润额外提高了19%，相对于未优化的价格，提高了86%。虽然个性化定价下总消费者剩余有所减少，但仍有超过60%的消费者从中受益。在某些不偏好不公平性的福利函数下，消费者福利甚至可能增加。模拟结果显示，在个性化定价下，数据的粒度与消费者剩余之间存在非单调关系。

abstract.text: How should countries cooperate in setting fiscal and trade policies when government expenditures must be financed with distorting taxes? We show that even if countries cannot make explicit transfers to each other, every point on the Pareto frontier is production efficient, so that international trade and capital flows should be effectively free. Trade agreements must be supplemented with fiscal policy agreements. Residence-based income tax systems have advantages over source-based systems. Taxing all household asset income at a country-specific uniform rate and setting the corporate income tax to zero yield efficient outcomes. Value-added taxes should be adjusted at the border.

10.1086/720889.abstractZh: 当政府支出必须通过扭曲性的税收来融资时，各国应该如何合作制定财政和贸易政策？研究表明，即使各国无法进行明确的转移支付，帕累托前沿上的每个点都是生产高效的，因此国际贸易和资本流动应该实际上是自由的。贸易协定必须辅以财政政策协议。基于居住地的所得税制度比基于来源地的制度具有优势。以国家特定的统一税率对家庭资产收入征税，并将企业所得税设定为零，可以取得高效的结果。增值税应在边境进行调整。

abstract.text: Although there are many competing explanations for the Industrial Revolution, there has been no effort to evaluate them econometrically. This paper analyzes how the very different patterns of growth across the counties of England between the 1760s and 1830s can be explained by a wide range of potential variables. We find that industrialization occurred in areas that began with low wages but high mechanical skills, whereas other variables, such as literacy, banks, and proximity to coal, have little explanatory power. Against the view that living standards were stagnant during the Industrial Revolution, we find that real wages rose sharply in the industrializing north and declined in the previously prosperous south.

10.1086/720890.abstractZh: 尽管对于工业革命有许多不同的解释，但至今尚未有人尝试用计量经济学的方法对这些解释进行评估。本文分析了1760年代至1830年代英格兰各郡之间截然不同的增长模式，并试图用多种潜在变量来解释这一现象。研究发现，工业化发生在那些初始工资较低但机械技能较高的地区，而诸如识字率、银行设施以及距离煤炭资源的距离等变量，对解释这一现象的说服力较弱。与“工业革命期间生活水平停滞不前”的观点相反，我们发现，在工业化的北部地区，实际工资显著上升，而在此前繁荣的南部地区，实际工资则有所下降。

abstract.text: I propose a methodology for constructing counterfactuals with respect to changes in policy rules that does not require fully specifying a particular model yet is not subject to Lucas critique. It applies to a class of dynamic stochastic models whose equilibria are well approximated by a linear representation. It rests on the insight that many such models satisfy a principle of counterfactual equivalence: they are observationally equivalent under a benchmark policy and yield an identical counterfactual equilibrium under an alternative one.

10.1086/720982.abstractZh: 我提出了一种构建与政策规则变化相关的反事实的方法论，该方法不需要完全指定特定的模型，同时也不受卢卡斯批判的约束。该方法适用于一类动态随机模型，这些模型的均衡可以通过线性表示来很好地近似。其基础是这样一个见解：许多此类模型都满足反事实等价性原理：在基准政策下，这些模型在观测上是等价的，而在另一种政策下，它们会产生相同的反事实均衡。

abstract.text: We consider a model of oligopolistic competition in a market with search frictions, in which competing firms with products of unknown quality advertise how much information a consumer’s visit will glean. In the unique symmetric equilibrium of this game, the countervailing incentives of attraction and persuasion yield a payoff function for each firm that is linear in the firm’s realized effective value. If the expected quality of the products is sufficiently high (or competition is sufficiently fierce), this corresponds to full information: firms provide the first-best level of information. If not, this corresponds to information dispersion: firms randomize over signals.

10.1086/720984.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个存在搜索摩擦的市场中的寡头竞争模型，在该市场中，竞争企业会宣传消费者访问其网站所能获得的信息量。在这个博弈的独特对称均衡中，吸引和说服的相反激励使得每家企业的收益函数与企业的实际有效价值成线性关系。如果产品的预期质量足够高（或竞争足够激烈），则相当于完全信息：企业提供最优级别的信息。否则，则相当于信息分散：企业随机选择信号。

abstract.text: We develop a theory of collective brand reputation for markets in which product quality is jointly determined by local and global players. In a repeated game of imperfect public monitoring, we model collective branding as an aggregation of quality signals generated in different markets. Such aggregation yields a beneficial informativeness effect for incentivizing the global player. It however also induces harmful free-riding by local, market-specific players. The resulting trade-off yields a theory of optimal brand size and revenue sharing that applies to platform markets, franchising, licensing, umbrella branding, and firms with team production.

10.1086/720986.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种关于集体品牌声誉的理论，适用于那些产品质量由本地和全球参与者共同决定的市场。在存在不完全公共监控的重复博弈中，我们将集体品牌塑造视为不同市场中产生的质量信号的聚合。这种聚合能够带来有益的信息效应，从而激励全球参与者。然而，它也会引发本地市场特定参与者的有害搭便车行为。由此产生的权衡为最优品牌规模和收益分配提供了理论依据，该理论适用于平台市场、特许经营、许可制度、伞形品牌以及采用团队生产方式的公司。

abstract.text: We develop a new class of two-stage mechanisms, which fully implement any social choice function under initial rationalizability in complete information environments. We show theoretically that our simultaneous report (SR) mechanisms are robust to small amounts of incomplete information about the state of nature. We also highlight the robustness of the mechanisms to a wide variety of reasoning processes and behavioral assumptions. We show experimentally that an SR mechanism performs well in inducing truth telling in both complete and incomplete information environments and that it can induce efficient investment in a two-sided holdup problem with ex ante investment.

10.1086/721153.abstractZh: 我们开发了一类新的两阶段机制，这些机制能够在完全信息环境下，充分实现任何社会选择函数，前提是初始条件是可理性化的。我们从理论上证明，我们的同时报告机制能够很好地应对关于自然状态的不完全信息。我们还强调了这些机制对多种推理过程和行为假设的鲁棒性。实验表明，同时报告机制在完全信息和不完全信息环境下都能有效引导人们说出真相，并且能够在存在事前投资的两面博弈问题中引导人们进行高效的投资。

abstract.text: We use a unique combination of register and survey data from Amsterdam to investigate the performance of school assignment mechanisms in practice. We find that deferred acceptance (DA) results in higher mean welfare than the adaptive Boston mechanism. This is due to students making strategic mistakes. The welfare gain of a switch from actual Boston to DA is over 90% of the welfare difference between actual Boston and optimal (proxy) Boston. Disadvantaged and lower-ability students would benefit most from such a switch.

10.1086/721230.abstractZh: 我们结合使用阿姆斯特丹的语体数据调查和统计数据，来研究学校作业机制在实际中的表现。研究发现，延期接受机制所带来的平均福利高于自适应波士顿机制。这一结果是由于学生会做出策略性错误。从实际波士顿机制切换到延期接受机制所带来的福利增益，超过了实际波士顿机制与最优（代理）波士顿机制之间福利差异的90%。弱势学生和能力较低的学生将从中获得最大的收益。

abstract.text: A principal has to take a binary decision. She relies on information privately held by an agent who prefers the same action regardless of his type. The principal cannot incentivize with transfers but can learn the agent’s type at a cost. Additionally, the principal privately observes a signal correlated with the agent’s type. Transparent mechanisms are optimal: the principal’s payoff is the same as if her signal was public. A simple cutoff form is optimal: favorable signals ensure the agent’s preferred action. Signals below this cutoff lead to the nonpreferred action unless the agent appeals. An appeal always triggers type verification.

10.1086/721618.abstractZh: 委托人必须做出二元决策。她依赖于一个代理人私有的信息，该代理人无论其类型如何，都偏好相同的行动。委托人无法通过转移来激励代理人，但可以以一定的成本了解代理人的类型。此外，委托人还私下观察一个与代理人类型相关的信号。透明机制是最优的：委托人的收益与她的信号公开时相同。简单的截止形式也是最优的：有利的信号可以确保代理人采取其偏好的行动。低于此截止值的信号会导致代理人采取非偏好行动，除非代理人提出申诉。申诉总是会触发类型验证。

abstract.text: The economic consequences of large-scale government investments in education depend on general equilibrium effects in both the labor market and the education sector. I develop a general equilibrium model capturing the consequences of massive countrywide schooling initiatives. I provide unbiased estimates of the model’s elasticities, using a regression discontinuity derived from Indian government policy. The earnings returns to a year of education are 13.4%, and the general equilibrium labor market effects substantially depress returns, by 6.6 percentage points. These general equilibrium effects have distributional consequences across cohorts and skill groups, whereby unskilled workers are better off and skilled workers worse off.

10.1086/721619.abstractZh: 政府大规模投资教育的经济后果取决于劳动力市场和教育领域的整体均衡效应。我构建了一个整体均衡模型，用以分析全国性大规模教育计划所带来的后果。通过印度政府政策得出的回归不连续方法，我对模型的弹性系数进行了无偏估计。接受一年教育所带来的收益回报为13.4%，而整体均衡效应则使劳动力市场的回报降低了6.6个百分点。这些整体均衡效应会对不同年龄组和技能群体产生分配性影响，其中非技术工人的状况有所改善，而技术工人的状况则有所恶化。

abstract.text: This paper investigates the sources of wage growth over the life cycle, determined by sectoral and firm mobility, unobserved ability, the accumulation of cognitive-abstract or routine-manual skills, and whether workers enroll in vocational training at the start of their career. Our analysis uses longitudinal administrative data over three decades and shows that routine-manual skills drive early wage growth, while cognitive-abstract skills become more important later. Moreover, job amenities are an important determinant of mobility decisions. Vocational training has long-term effects on career outcomes through various channels and generates returns for both the individual and society.

10.1086/721657.abstractZh: 本文研究了工资增长在整个生命周期中的来源，这些因素包括行业和企业流动性的影响、未观察到的能力、认知抽象或常规手工技能的积累，以及劳动者在职业生涯初期是否参加职业培训。我们的分析使用了长达三十年的纵向行政数据，结果显示常规手工技能在初期推动工资增长，而认知抽象技能则在后期变得更加重要。此外，工作便利性是决定人员流动决策的重要因素。职业培训通过多种途径对职业成果产生长期影响，并为个人和社会带来收益。

abstract.text: Recent research concludes that the rise in consumption inequality mirrors, or even exceeds, the rise in income inequality. We revisit this finding, constructing improved measures of consumption, focusing on its well-measured components that are reported at a high and stable rate relative to national accounts. While overall income inequality rose over the past 5 decades, the rise in overall consumption inequality was small. The declining quality of income data likely contributes to these differences for the bottom of the distribution. Asset price changes likely account for some of the differences in recent years for the top of the distribution.

10.1086/721702.abstractZh: 近期的研究表明，消费不平等的加剧与收入不平等的加剧呈同步甚至更严重的趋势。我们重新审视了这一发现，构建了更精确的消费衡量指标，重点关注那些相对于国民经济账户而言能够稳定且高频率报告的、易于测量的消费组成部分。虽然过去50年间整体收入不平等有所上升，但整体消费不平等的上升幅度却较小。收入数据质量的下降可能是导致收入分配底层差异的原因之一。近年来，资产价格的变化可能解释了收入分配顶层的一些差异。

abstract.text: We introduce a flexible framework to study probabilistic choice that accommodates heterogeneous types and bounded rationality. We provide a novel progressive structure for the heterogeneous types to capture heterogeneity due to varying levels of a behavioral trait. Given an order of alternatives, our progressive structure sorts the types by the extent to which they align with this order. Unlike the random-utility model, our model uniquely identifies the heterogeneity, allowing policy makers to perform an improved welfare analysis. As a showcase, we provide characterization of a well-studied type of bounded rationality: “less-is-more.” In addition, we provide conditions for unique identification of the underlying order for the less-is-more structure.

10.1086/721732.abstractZh: 我们引入了一个灵活的框架来研究概率选择问题，该框架能够适应不同类型的个体以及有限理性问题。我们为这些不同类型的个体提供了一个新颖的渐进结构，以捕捉由于行为特征水平差异而产生的异质性。给定一系列备选方案，我们的渐进结构会根据这些方案与某种顺序的契合程度对个体进行分类。与随机效用模型不同，我们的模型能够唯一地识别这种异质性，从而使政策制定者能够进行更精确的福利分析。作为示例，我们描述了一种被广泛研究的有限理性类型：“少即是多”。此外，我们还提出了用于唯一识别“少即是多”结构所依据的顺序的条件。

abstract.text: Mixture choice data consist of the joint distribution of choices of a group of agents from a collection of menus, comprising the implied stochastic choice function plus any cross-menu correlations. When agents are heterogeneous with respect to both preferences and other aspects of cognition, we show that these two determinants of behavior are identified simultaneously by suitable mixture choice data. We also demonstrate how this finding can be extended to allow for specialized assumptions about cognition, focusing on models of random satisficing thresholds and “quantal Fechnerian” choice.

10.1086/721734.abstractZh: 混合选择数据包含一组代理人从一系列菜单中做出选择的联合分布，其中包括隐含的随机选择函数以及任何跨菜单的相关性。当代理人在偏好和其他认知方面存在异质性时，我们表明这两个行为决定因素可以通过适当的混合选择数据同时被识别。我们还展示了如何将这一发现扩展到允许对认知进行专门的假设，重点关注随机满足阈值和“量子费希纳式”选择的模型。

abstract.text: Employee referral programs (ERPs) are randomly introduced in a grocery chain. On direct effects, larger referral bonuses increase referral quantity but decrease quality, though the increase in referrals from ERPs is modest. However, the overall effect of having an ERP is substantial, reducing attrition by 15% and significantly decreasing labor costs. This occurs, partly, because referrals stay longer than nonreferrals, but, mainly, from indirect effects: nonreferrals stay longer in treated than in control stores. The most supported mechanism for these indirect effects is workers value being involved in hiring. Attrition impacts are larger in higher performing stores and better local labor markets.

10.1086/721735.abstractZh: 员工推荐计划（ERP）在一家杂货连锁店中被随机引入。从直接效果来看，更高的推荐奖励会增加推荐数量，但会降低推荐质量，尽管ERP带来的推荐数量增长幅度不大。然而，实施ERP的整体效果显著，使员工流失率降低了15%，并显著降低了劳动力成本。这种情况的发生部分是因为推荐员工在店内的停留时间比非推荐员工更长，但主要还是由于间接效应：非推荐员工在实验组的店铺中停留的时间比对照组更长。这些间接效应最被认可的机制是员工认为参与招聘是一种价值。在业绩较好的店铺以及当地劳动力市场较好的情况下，员工流失的影响更为显著。

abstract.text: Parents make important choices for their children in many areas of life, yet the empirical literature on this topic is scarce. We study parents’ competitiveness choices for their children by combining two large-scale artifactual field experiments with high-quality longitudinal administrative data. We document three main sets of findings. First, parents choose more competition for their sons than daughters. Second, this gender difference can largely be explained by parents’ beliefs about their children’s competitiveness preferences. Third, parents’ choices predict children’s later-in-life educational outcomes. Taken together, these findings provide novel evidence on the role of parents in shaping children’s long-term outcomes.

10.1086/721801.abstractZh: 父母在生活的许多领域都为孩子做出重要选择，但关于这一主题的实证研究却很少。我们通过结合两项大规模实地实验和高质量的纵向行政数据，研究了父母为孩子选择竞争性的行为。我们发现了三个主要发现：首先，父母为儿子选择的竞争性比女儿更高；其次，这种性别差异在很大程度上可以由父母对孩子竞争性偏好的看法来解释；第三，父母的选择能够预测孩子日后在教育方面的表现。综合这些发现，为父母在塑造孩子长期发展中的作用提供了新的证据。

abstract.text: Financial crises typically occur because firms and financial institutions are highly exposed to aggregate shocks. We propose a theory to explain these exposures. We study a model where entrepreneurs can issue state-contingent claims to consumers. Even though entrepreneurs can use these instruments to hedge negative shocks, they do not necessarily do so because insuring against these shocks is expensive, as consumers are also harmed by them. This effect is self-reinforcing because riskier balance sheets for entrepreneurs imply higher income volatility for the consumers, making insurance more costly in equilibrium. We show that this feedback is quantitatively important and leads to inefficiently high risk exposure for entrepreneurs.

10.1086/722088.abstractZh: 金融危机通常发生是因为企业和金融机构对整体经济冲击高度敏感。我们提出了一个理论来解释这种风险暴露现象。我们研究了一个模型，在这个模型中，企业家可以向消费者发行与状态相关的索赔。尽管企业家可以使用这些工具来对冲负面冲击，但他们并不一定这样做，因为为这些冲击投保的成本很高，因为消费者也会因此受到损失。这种效应具有自我强化性质，因为企业家风险更高的资产负债表意味着消费者的收入波动性更高，从而在均衡状态下使保险成本更高。我们表明，这种反馈效应在数量上非常重要，并导致企业家面临过高的风险暴露。

abstract.text: We consider a mechanism design setting in which agents can acquire costly information on their preferences as well as others’. A mechanism is informationally simple if agents have no incentive to learn about others’ preferences. This property is of interest for two reasons. First, it is a necessary condition for the existence of dominant-strategy equilibria in the extended game. Second, this endogenizes an “independent-private-value” property of the interim information structure. We show that, generically, a mechanism is informationally simple if and only if it satisfies a separability condition that rules out most economically meaningful mechanisms.

10.1086/722089.abstractZh: 我们考虑了一种机制设计情境，在这种情境下，代理人可以获取关于自身偏好以及其他人偏好的昂贵信息。如果代理人没有动机去了解他人的偏好，那么这个机制在信息层面是简单的。这一特性具有两个重要意义。首先，这是扩展游戏中存在占优策略均衡的必要条件。其次，这一特性内生了中期信息结构的“独立-私人价值”属性。我们证明，一般来说，一个机制在信息层面是简单的，当且仅当它满足一个可分离性条件，该条件排除了大多数在经济上具有意义的机制。

abstract.text: We point-identify and estimate linear social network models without observing any network links. The required data consist of many small networks of individuals, such as classrooms or villages, with individuals who are each observed only once. We apply our estimator to data from Tennessee’s Project STAR (Student-Teacher Achievement Ratio). Without observing the latent network in each classroom, we identify and estimate peer and contextual effects on students’ performance in mathematics. We find that peer effects tend to be larger in bigger classes and that increasing peer effects would significantly improve students’ average test scores in some classes.

10.1086/722090.abstractZh: 我们无需观察任何网络链接，就能对线性社会网络模型进行点识别与估计。所需数据由许多小型个体网络组成，例如教室或村庄，每个个体仅被观察一次。我们将我们的估计器应用于田纳西州STAR项目的数据。在不观察每个教室中潜在网络结构的情况下，我们能够识别并估计同伴效应以及情境因素对学生数学成绩的影响。研究发现，同伴效应在较大的班级中更为显著，增加同伴效应能够显著提高某些班级学生的平均测试成绩。

abstract.text: The Voting Rights Act of 1965 redefined race relations in the United States. Yet evidence on its effect on Black office holding remains scant. Using novel data on Black elected officials between 1962 and 1980, we assess the impact of the Voting Rights Act on the racial makeup of local governments in the Deep South. Exploiting predetermined differential exposure of Southern counties to the mandated federal intervention, we show that the latter fostered local Black office holding, particularly in the powerful county commissions, controlling local public finances. In the presence of election by district, covered counties experienced Black representation gains and faster capital spending growth.

10.1086/722092.abstractZh: 1965年的《投票权法案》重新定义了美国的种族关系。然而，关于该法案对黑人担任公职影响的证据仍然十分有限。我们利用1962年至1980年间关于黑人当选官员的新数据，评估《投票权法案》对南方地方政府种族构成的影响。通过利用预先确定的南方各郡对联邦干预的差异化反应，我们发现该法案促进了黑人担任公职的情况，尤其是在控制地方公共财政的强大郡委员会中。在实行选区选举的情况下，被覆盖的郡出现了黑人代表增加的趋势，并且资本支出增长也更为迅速。

abstract.text: Names can convey information about race or ethnicity and therefore can be used to discriminate against protected groups; many researchers have demonstrated as much through audit studies. Yet few studies link life outcomes with names using observational data. We use administrative data from over 3 million Black students to ask whether those with more statistically Black names have differential educational outcomes. We find that while test scores, college enrollment, and college completion are negatively correlated with Black names net of background characteristics, this relationship is absent when we compare across siblings within households.

10.1086/722093.abstractZh: 名字可以传达有关种族或民族的信息，因此可能被用来歧视受保护群体；许多研究者通过审计研究证明了这一点。然而，很少有研究利用观察数据将生活结果与名字联系起来。我们利用超过300万黑人学生的行政数据，探讨那些名字在统计上更偏向黑人的人群是否在教育成果上存在差异。研究发现，虽然考试成绩、大学入学率和毕业率与黑人名字的净特征呈负相关，但在同一家庭内的兄弟姐妹之间，这种关系并不存在。

abstract.text: We construct a model of an exchange economy in which agents trade assets contingent on an observable signal, the probability of which depends on public opinion. The agents in our model are replaced occasionally, and each person updates beliefs in response to observed outcomes. We show that the distribution of the observed signal is described by a quasi-nonergodic process and that people continue to disagree with each other forever. These disagreements generate large wealth inequalities that arise from the multiplicative nature of wealth dynamics, which makes successful bold bets highly profitable.

10.1086/722214.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个交换经济模型，其中代理人根据一个可观测的信号进行交易，该信号的概率取决于公众意见。模型中的代理人会定期更换，每个人都会根据观察到的结果更新自己的信念。我们证明，观测到的信号分布由一个准非遍历过程描述，并且人们会永远存在分歧。这些分歧导致了巨大的财富不平等，这种不平等源于财富动态的乘法性质，使得大胆的冒险行为极具盈利潜力。

abstract.text: In an overlapping-generations economy, the consumption growth of a given cohort member (the “marginal agent”) differs from the aggregate consumption growth. A cohort member is faced with long-run consumption uncertainty even in the absence of aggregate (and within-cohort) consumption risk. This uncertainty allows the model to account for several stylized asset-pricing facts (high market price of risk and volatility, return predictability, low and nonvolatile interest rate) despite deterministic macroeconomic aggregates and inequality measures that are contemporaneously uncorrelated with asset returns. We devise and implement a methodology to measure the marginal agent’s consumption growth and evaluate the model’s quantitative implications.

10.1086/722224.abstractZh: 在一个重叠世代的经济体系中，某一特定群体成员的消费增长与整体消费增长存在差异。即使在没有整体（以及群体内部）消费风险的情况下，群体成员仍面临长期的消费不确定性。这种不确定性使得模型能够解释一些典型的资产定价现象（如风险与波动性的高市场价值、回报的可预测性、低且稳定的利率），尽管确定性的宏观经济总量和不平等指标与资产回报 contemporaneously 不相关。我们设计并实施了一种方法来衡量边际个体的消费增长，并评估模型的定量含义。

abstract.text: Many economists assume that safer assets are more liquid, and some have practically used “safe” and “liquid” as synonyms. But these terms are not synonyms, and mixing them up can lead to confusion and wrong policy recommendations. We build a multiasset model where an asset’s safety and liquidity are well defined and distinct, and we examine their relationship in general equilibrium. We show that the common belief that “safety implies liquidity” is generally justified but also identify conditions under which this relationship can be reversed. We use our model to rationalize, qualitatively and quantitatively, a prominent safety-liquidity reversal observed in the data.

10.1086/722225.abstractZh: 许多经济学家认为，更安全的资产具有更高的流动性，有些人甚至将“安全”和“流动性”视为同义词。但实际上，这两个概念并非同义词，将它们混淆可能会导致混乱，并影响政策建议的准确性。我们构建了一个多资产模型，其中资产的“安全性”和“流动性”被明确区分，并研究了它们在一般均衡状态下的关系。研究表明，普遍认为“安全性意味着流动性”的观点在大多数情况下是合理的，但同时也指出了这种关系可能逆转的条件。我们利用该模型从定性和定量两个方面，对数据中观察到的显著的安全性与流动性逆转现象进行了解释。

abstract.text: Test score measures of teacher quality may not fully capture teachers’ impact on students. We use test score and non–test score measures of student achievement and behavior to estimate multiple dimensions of teacher quality. We find that these two measures of teacher quality are only weakly correlated and that both affect students’ high school performance. A teacher removal simulation that uses both measures improves most long-term student outcomes by over 50%, compared to a policy that uses test scores alone. Our results also show that for high school outcomes the effects of teachers in later grades are larger than those in earlier grades and that performance in core elementary school subjects matters more than that in other subjects.

10.1086/722227.abstractZh: 教师质量的测试分数衡量可能无法完全反映教师对学生的影响。我们使用测试分数和非测试分数来衡量学生的学业成绩和行为表现，以估算教师质量的多个维度。我们发现这两种衡量教师质量的方法只有弱相关性，并且两者都影响着学生的高中表现。使用这两种衡量方法的教师移除模拟方案，与仅使用测试分数的方案相比，能显著改善学生的长期表现，改善幅度超过50%。我们的结果还表明，对于高中表现而言，教师在后期年级的影响比早期年级更大，而在核心小学科目上的表现比其他科目更为重要。

abstract.text: This study measures spending power inequality within age cohorts and estimates fiscal progressivity via lifetime net tax rates. We find, first, that inequality in income and especially wealth dramatically overstates inequality in spending power. Second, inequality in current spending power differs from that in lifetime spending power because of credit constraints, in-kind government benefits, and other factors. Third, the US fiscal system is highly progressive once cohorts are old enough to have highly dispersed human wealth. Fourth, households’ rankings based on current income can differ substantially from their rankings based on lifetime resources. Fifth, current-year net tax rates substantially understate fiscal progressivity.

10.1086/722394.abstractZh: 本研究通过生命周期净税率来衡量不同年龄群体之间的消费能力不平等程度，并估算财政的累进性。研究发现，首先，收入不平等，尤其是财富不平等，会严重高估消费能力的不平等程度。其次，当前消费能力的不平等与生命周期消费能力的不平等存在差异，这主要是由于信贷限制、政府提供的实物福利以及其他因素造成的。第三，一旦群体年龄足够大，拥有分散的人类财富，美国的财政体系就会表现出高度的累进性。第四，基于当前收入的家庭排名与基于生命周期资源的排名可能存在显著差异。第五，当年净税率严重低估了财政的累进性。

abstract.text: We present a mechanism based on managerial incentives through which common ownership affects product market outcomes. Firm-level variation in common ownership causes variation in managerial incentives and productivity across firms, which leads to intraindustry and intrafirm cross-market variation in prices, output, markups, and market shares that is consistent with empirical evidence. The organizational structure of multiproduct firms and the passivity of common owners determine whether higher prices under common ownership result from higher costs or from higher markups. Using panel regressions and a difference-in-differences design, we document that managerial incentives are less performance sensitive in firms with more common ownership.

10.1086/722414.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种基于管理激励的机制，通过这种机制，共同所有权会影响产品市场的成果。企业层面在共同所有权方面的差异会导致管理激励和生产力在不同企业之间的变化，这进而导致行业内以及企业内部的跨市场价格、产量、加价率和市场份额的变化，这与实证研究结果一致。多产品企业的组织结构以及共同所有者的被动性决定了在共同所有权下较高的价格是由较高的成本还是较高的加价率造成的。通过面板回归和差异-差异设计，我们发现，在共同所有权较多的企业中，管理激励对绩效的敏感度较低。

abstract.text: We study partial identification of the preference parameters in the one-to-one matching model with perfectly transferable utilities. We do so without imposing parametric distributional assumptions on the unobserved heterogeneity and with data on one large market. We provide a tractable characterization of the identified set under various classes of nonparametric distributional assumptions on the unobserved heterogeneity. We reexamine some of the relevant questions in the empirical literature on the marriage market, which have been previously studied under the logit assumption. Our results reveal that many findings in the aforementioned literature are primarily driven by such parametric restrictions.

10.1086/722415.abstractZh: 我们研究了在具有完全可转移效用的单对匹配模型中，偏好参数的部分识别问题。我们并未对未观察到的异质性施加参数化分布假设，而是基于一个大型市场的数据来进行研究。我们针对各种非参数化分布假设，对识别集合进行了可处理的表征。我们重新审视了关于婚姻市场的一些相关实证问题，这些问题在Logit假设下已有研究。我们的结果表明，上述文献中的许多发现主要受到此类参数化限制的驱动。

abstract.text: This paper develops a micro-founded general equilibrium model of payments to study the impact of a central bank digital currency (CBDC) on intermediation of private banks. If banks have market power in the deposit market, a CBDC can enhance competition, raising the deposit rate, expanding intermediation, and increasing output. A calibration to the US economy suggests that a CBDC can raise bank lending by 1.57% and output by 0.19%. These crowding-in effects remain robust, albeit with smaller magnitudes, after taking into account endogenous bank entry. We also assess the role of a non-interest-bearing CBDC as the use of cash declines.

10.1086/722517.abstractZh: 本文构建了一个基于微观基础的通用均衡支付模型，以研究中央银行数字货币对私人银行中介活动的影响。如果银行在存款市场具有市场力量，中央银行数字货币能够增强竞争，提高存款利率，扩大中介业务，并增加产出。对美国经济情况的校准表明，中央银行数字货币可使银行贷款增加1.57%，产出增加0.19%。这些促进作用在考虑到银行进入市场后的内生变化后仍然显著，尽管其影响程度有所减弱。我们还评估了在现金使用减少的情况下，无息中央银行数字货币的作用。

abstract.text: Most social preference theories are based on observations of nonvoluntary interactions. Nonselfish behavior may take fundamentally different forms in voluntary interactions, such as market transactions. We investigate the “Principle of Mutual Benefit”—an injunctive norm requiring individuals who enter interactions voluntarily to conform to common expectations about behavior within them. This norm induces patterns of behavior inconsistent with existing social preference theories and allows extrinsic incentives to crowd in trustworthiness. We embed this norm in a model consistent with evidence about promise keeping, gift exchange, and “avoiding the ask.” We present new experimental evidence that people adhere to it.

10.1086/722930.abstractZh: 大多数社会偏好理论都是基于对非自愿互动的观察而建立的。在自愿互动中，例如市场交易中，非自私行为可能呈现出截然不同的形式。我们研究了“互惠原则”——这是一种命令性规范，要求自愿参与互动的个体遵循关于互动中行为的共同期望。这一规范引导出的行为模式与现有的社会偏好理论不符，并且使得外在激励能够增强可信度。我们将这一规范纳入一个与关于承诺履行、礼物交换以及“避免请求”的实证数据一致的模型中。我们提供了新的实验证据，表明人们确实遵循这一规范。

abstract.text: We investigate whether a market served by a multiproduct monopolistic seller can be segmented in a way that benefits all consumers and the seller. The seller can offer a different product menu in each market segment, combining second- and third-degree price discrimination. We show that markets for which profit maximization leads to inefficiency can, generically, be segmented into two market segments in a way that increases the surplus of all consumers weakly and of some consumers and the seller strictly. Our constructive proof is based on deriving implications of binding incentive compatibility constraints when profit maximization implies inefficiency.

10.1086/722932.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个由多产品垄断卖方服务的市场是否可以通过一种方式被分割，从而让所有消费者和卖方都受益。卖方可以在每个市场细分中提供不同的产品菜单，结合二级和三级价格歧视。我们表明，那些导致效率低下的最大化利润市场，通常可以通过将市场分割为两个市场细分的方式，在弱程度上增加所有消费者的剩余，在强程度上增加某些消费者和卖方的剩余。我们的建设性证明基于在最大化利润意味着效率低下时，约束激励相容性约束的含义推导而来。

abstract.text: Karl Marx’s high academic stature outside of economics diverges sharply from his peripheral influence within the discipline, particularly after nineteenth-century developments rendered the labor theory of value obsolete. We hypothesize that the 1917 Russian Revolution is responsible for elevating Marx into the academic mainstream. Using the synthetic control method, we construct a counterfactual for Marx’s citation patterns in Google Ngram data. This allows us to predict how often Marx would have been cited if the Russian Revolution had not happened. We find a significant treatment effect, meaning that Marx’s academic stature today owes a substantial debt to political happenstance.

10.1086/722933.abstractZh: 卡尔·马克思在经济学领域之外的学术地位与其在经济学学科内的边缘影响形成了鲜明对比，尤其是在19世纪的发展使得劳动价值论变得过时之后。我们假设1917年的俄国革命使得马克思进入了学术主流。通过合成控制方法，我们构建了马克思在谷歌Ngram数据中引用模式的反事实情景。这使我们能够预测如果俄国革命没有发生，马克思会被引用多少次。我们发现了一个显著的处理效应，这意味着今天马克思的学术地位在很大程度上归功于政治上的偶然性。

abstract.text: We document that countries partially default often and with varying intensity, resulting in lengthy episodes and hump-shaped patterns for partial default and debt. Default episodes lead to haircuts for lenders but not to reductions in debt, because the defaulted debt accumulates and borrowing continues. We present a theory of partial default rationalizing these patterns and the heterogeneity of partial default, and partial default’s comovements with spreads, debt, and output that are absent in standard sovereign default theory. We include policy counterfactuals in the form of pari passu and no-dilution clauses and debt-relief policies, and their welfare implications.

10.1086/722934.abstractZh: 我们记录了各国经常发生部分违约的情况，且违约的强度和持续时间各不相同，导致部分违约和债务问题呈现出长期化和驼峰状的模式。违约事件会导致债权人遭受损失，但并不会减少债务规模，因为违约的债务会不断累积，借款活动也会持续进行。我们提出了一种关于部分违约的理论，以解释这些模式以及部分违约的异质性，并解释了部分违约与利率差、债务和产出之间的关联，这些关联在标准的主权违约理论中是不存在的。我们在模型中考虑了政策反事实因素，如平等条款、不稀释条款以及债务减免政策，并分析了这些因素对福利的影响。

abstract.text: We show that with indivisible goods, the existence of competitive equilibrium fundamentally depends on agents’ substitution effects, not their income effects. Our equilibrium existence duality allows us to transport results on the existence of competitive equilibrium from settings with transferable utility to settings with income effects. One consequence is that net substitutability—which is a strictly weaker condition than gross substitutability—is sufficient for the existence of competitive equilibrium. Further applications give new existence results beyond the case of (net) substitutes. Our results have implications for auction design.

10.1086/722935.abstractZh: 我们表明，在不可分割的商品情况下，竞争均衡的存在从根本上取决于代理人的替代效应，而非收入效应。我们的均衡存在对偶性原理使我们能够将关于竞争均衡存在性的研究结果从具有可转移效用的情境推广到具有收入效应的情境。其中一个结果是，净替代性——这一条件比总替代性更为宽松——足以保证竞争均衡的存在。进一步的应用表明，除了（净）替代品的情况之外，还有其他新的存在性结果。我们的研究结果对拍卖设计具有启示意义。

abstract.text: This paper demonstrates the long-term intragenerational and intergenerational benefits of the HighScope Perry Preschool Project, which targeted disadvantaged African-American children. We use newly collected data on the original participants through late middle age and on their children into their mid-twenties. We document long-lasting improvements in the original participants' skills, marriage stability, earnings, criminal behavior, and health. Beneficial program impacts through the childrearing years translate into better family environments for their children leading to intergenerational gains. Children of the original participants have higher levels of education and employment, lower levels of criminal activity, and better health than children of the controls.

10.1086/722936.abstractZh: 本文阐述了HighScope Perry学前教育项目对弱势非洲裔美国儿童产生的长期代内及代际收益。我们利用了新收集的数据，涵盖了项目最初参与者的中年后期状况以及他们的子女在二十多岁的状况。研究发现，项目参与者在技能、婚姻稳定性、收入、犯罪行为和健康状况方面都取得了持久的改善。在儿童成长阶段获得的益处转化为更良好的家庭环境，从而带来代际收益。项目参与者的子女在教育水平和就业率方面更高，犯罪活动较少，健康状况也更好。

abstract.text: We consider a dynamic monetary economy where agents gradually learn about the holding cost of a new asset and coordinate to adopt it as money or abandon it. We provide closed-form solutions for state-contingent asset prices and agents’ adoption decision. The transactional benefits of using money are endogenous and can convexify or concavify the payoff structure. Thus, the arrival of new information can raise or reduce the asset’s price, which is in sharp contrast to standard insights in experimentation models. Full disclosure of the asset type and an increase in the learning speed improve information but have different welfare implications.

10.1086/722983.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个动态货币经济模型，其中各主体逐渐了解新资产的持有成本，并协调一致地将其作为货币使用或放弃。我们为状态依赖的资产价格以及主体的采用决策提供了封闭形式的解。使用货币所带来的交易收益是内生的，并且可以使收益结构呈现凸形或凹形。因此，新信息的出现可能会提高或降低资产的价格，这与实验模型中的标准见解截然不同。完全披露资产类型以及提高学习速度都能改善信息状况，但会对福利产生不同的影响。

abstract.text: We consider a dynamic model of Bayesian persuasion in which information takes time and is costly for the sender to generate and for the receiver to process, and neither player can commit to their future actions. Persuasion may totally collapse in a Markov perfect equilibrium of this game. However, for persuasion costs sufficiently small, a version of a folk theorem holds: outcomes that approximate Kamenica and Gentzkow’s sender-optimal persuasion as well as full revelation and everything in between are obtained in Markov perfect equilibrium as the cost vanishes.

10.1086/722985.abstractZh: 我们考虑一个动态贝叶斯说服模型，其中信息的获取需要时间，且对于发送者和接收者来说，信息的生成和处理都是成本高昂的。双方都无法承诺未来的行动。在这种游戏中，说服可能会完全崩溃在马尔可夫完美均衡中。然而，当说服成本足够低时，一个民间定理的版本成立：在马尔可夫完美均衡中，接近Kamenica和Gentzkow提出的发送者最优说服结果，以及完全揭露信息的结果，都可以得到，因为成本消失了。

abstract.text: We study the welfare costs of markups in a dynamic model with heterogeneous firms and endogenous markups. We provide aggregation results summarizing the macro implications of micro-level markup heterogeneity. We calibrate our model to US Census of Manufactures data and find that the costs of markups can be large. We decompose the costs into three channels: an aggregate markup that acts like a uniform output tax, misallocation of factors of production, and inefficient entry. We find that the aggregate-markup and misallocation channels account for most of the costs of markups and that the entry channel is much less important.

10.1086/722986.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个具有异质企业和内生加价的动态模型中的福利成本问题。我们提供了汇总结果，总结了微观层面加价异质性对宏观层面的影响。我们根据美国制造业普查数据对模型进行了校准，发现加价的成本可能相当高。我们将这些成本分解为三个渠道：一种像统一产出税一样的整体加价、生产要素的错配以及低效的进入机制。我们发现，整体加价和错配渠道承担了加价成本的大部分，而进入渠道的重要性则相对较低。

abstract.text: As Romer and Weitzman emphasized in the 1990s, new ideas are often combinations of existing ideas, an insight absent from recent models. In Kortum's research around the same time, ideas are draws from a probability distribution, and Pareto distributions play a crucial role. Why are combinations missing, and do we really need such strong distributional assumptions to get exponential growth? This paper demonstrates that combinatorially growing draws from standard thin-tailed distributions lead to exponential growth; Pareto is not required. More generally, it presents a theorem linking the max extreme value to the number of draws and the shape of the upper tail for probability distributions.

10.1086/723631.abstractZh: 正如罗默和魏茨曼在20世纪90年代所强调的，新想法往往是现有想法的组合，这一见解在最近的模型中并不明显。在科图姆同期的研究中，想法是从概率分布中选取的，而帕累托分布起着至关重要的作用。为什么缺少组合性的选取，我们真的需要如此强的概率分布假设来获得指数增长？本文证明，从标准的小尾分布中组合性地选取数据可以带来指数增长；无需使用帕累托分布。更一般地，本文提出了一个定理，将最大极值与概率分布中的抽取次数以及上尾部的形状联系起来。

abstract.text: This paper studies the optimal determination of deposit insurance when bank runs are possible. We show that the welfare impact of changes in the level of deposit insurance coverage can be generally expressed in terms of a small number of sufficient statistics, which include the level of losses in specific scenarios and the probability of bank failure. We characterize the wedges that determine the optimal ex ante regulation, which map to asset- and liability-side regulation. We demonstrate how to employ our framework in an application to the most recent change in coverage in the United States, which took place in 2008.

10.1086/723633.abstractZh: 本文研究了在银行挤兑可能发生时，存款保险最优确定的问题。我们指出，存款保险覆盖率变化对福利的影响通常可以用少量足够的统计量来表示，这些统计量包括特定情景下的损失水平以及银行倒闭的概率。我们描述了决定最优事前监管的权衡因素，这些权衡因素对应于资产和负债方面的监管。我们展示了如何将我们的框架应用于美国最近一次覆盖率调整的情况，该调整发生在2008年。

abstract.text: Our understanding of monetary policy is complicated by an indeterminacy problem: the same path for the nominal interest rate is consistent with multiple equilibrium paths for inflation and output. We offer a potential resolution by showing that small frictions in social memory and intertemporal coordination can remove this indeterminacy. Under our perturbations, the unique equilibrium is the same as that selected by the Taylor principle, but it no more relies on it; monetary policy is left to play only a stabilization role; and fiscal policy needs to be Ricardian even when monetary policy is passive.

10.1086/723634.abstractZh: 我们对货币政策的理解因一个不确定性问题而变得复杂：相同的名义利率路径与多种通货膨胀和产出均衡路径是相容的。我们提出了一个可能的解决方案，即社会记忆和跨时协调中的微小摩擦可以消除这种不确定性。在我们的扰动下，唯一的均衡与泰勒原则所选择的均衡相同，但不再依赖于它；货币政策仅起到稳定作用；而财政政策即使在货币政策被动的情况下也需要遵循李嘉图原则。

abstract.text: We study optimal Pareto-improving factor taxation when agents are heterogeneous in their labor productivity and wealth and markets are complete. Pareto-improving policies require a gradual reform: labor taxes should be cut, and capital taxes should remain high for a long time before reaching the limit. This policy redistributes wealth in favor of workers, promotes growth, and causes early deficits and government debt in the long run. We address several technical issues, such as sufficiency of Lagrangian solutions in a Ramsey problem, their relation to welfare functions, and solution algorithms. We also provide a proof that long-run capital taxes are zero.

10.1086/723635.abstractZh: 我们研究了在代理人劳动生产率和财富存在异质性且市场是完备的情况下，最优的帕累托改进性要素征税问题。帕累托改进性政策需要逐步实施：劳动税应逐步降低，而资本税则应长期保持较高水平，直至达到极限。这一政策会重新分配财富，使工人受益，促进经济增长，但从长期来看会导致早期赤字和政府债务。我们还解决了一些技术问题，例如拉格朗日解在Ramsey问题中的充分性、它们与福利函数之间的关系，以及求解算法。此外，我们还证明了长期资本税为零。

abstract.text: We measure how patent publication affects innovation by exploiting the American Inventor’s Protection Act of 1999 (AIPA), which accelerated public disclosure of US patents by about 1.5 years. We obtain causal estimates by comparing US patents subject to AIPA with “twin” European patents that were not. Post-AIPA, US patents receive more and faster follow-on citations, indicating greater technology diffusion. Technological overlap increases between distant but related patents and decreases between highly similar patents, and patent applications are less likely to be abandoned, suggesting less duplicative R&D. Publicly listed firms exposed to 1 standard deviation longer patent grant delays increased R&D by 4% post-AIPA.

10.1086/723636.abstractZh: 我们通过利用1999年《美国发明者保护法案》来衡量专利公开对创新的影响，该法案使美国专利的公开时间缩短了约1.5年。我们通过比较受AIPA影响的美国专利与未受影响的“双胞胎”欧洲专利，来获得因果估计。AIPA实施之后，美国专利获得了更多且更快的后续引用，这表明技术扩散程度更高。不同但相关的专利之间的技术重叠程度增加，而高度相似的专利之间的重叠程度则减少，同时专利申请被放弃的可能性降低，这表明重复性的研发活动减少。在专利授权延迟1个标准差的情况下，公开上市的公司其研发活动在AIPA实施后增加了4%。

abstract.text: Every government that controls an exhaustible resource must decide whether to exploit it or conserve it and thereby let the subsequent government decide whether to exploit or conserve. This paper develops a positive theory of this situation and shows when a small change in parameter values has a multiplier effect on exploitation. The multiplier strengthens the influence of a lobby paying for exploitation and of a donor compensating for conservation. A successful donor pays every period for each unit; a successful lobby pays once. This asymmetry causes inefficient exploitation. A normative analysis uncovers when compensations are optimally offered to the party in power, to the general public, or to the lobby.

10.1086/723637.abstractZh: 任何控制着有限资源的政府都必须决定是开发该资源还是加以保护，并让后续政府来决定是否继续开发或保护。本文对这一情况提出了一种积极的理论分析，并揭示了参数值的小幅变化如何对开发行为产生乘数效应。这种乘数效应增强了为开发行为付费的游说团体以及为保护行为提供补偿的捐助者的影响力。成功的捐助者会在每个时期为每一单位资源支付费用；而成功的游说团体则只需支付一次费用。这种不对称现象导致了低效的开发行为。本文还进行了规范分析，探讨了何时向执政方、公众或游说团体提供最优的补偿措施。

abstract.text: We propose a model with local spatial markets and heterogeneous agents to understand and evaluate the geographic expansion of bank branches after banking deregulation in Thailand. The model features heterogeneity in financial frictions across regions, with the costs of accessing credit and deposits depending on the distance from the nearest branch. Disciplined by micro estimates of the effects of branch openings, the model reproduces salient regional and aggregate patterns concerning occupational choice, financial access, and inequality. We apply the model to study two counterfactual financial sector policies in distant markets, one subsidizing branches and the other subsidizing household deposits.

10.1086/724112.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个包含局部空间市场与异质代理人的模型，以理解和评估泰国银行放松管制后银行分支的地理扩张情况。该模型体现了不同地区在金融摩擦方面的异质性，获取信贷和存款的成本取决于距离最近的分支机构的距离。通过微观层面的估计来研究分支机构开设的影响，该模型能够再现关于职业选择、金融获取以及不平等问题的显著区域性和总体性特征。我们将该模型应用于研究两个反事实性的金融部门政策在遥远市场中的影响，其中一个政策是补贴分支机构，另一个政策是补贴家庭存款。

abstract.text: Using a general equilibrium heterogeneous agent model featuring health production, we quantify the contribution of health price in explaining cross-country differences in health expenditures and health status. Considering other country-specific explanatory factors, US health prices are estimated to be 33% higher than those of European countries. This price differential explains more than 60% of the difference in health expenditures and more than half of the difference in health status between Europe and the United States. Despite its large impact at the aggregate level, these price differences increase the lifetime cost of living of Americans by 2 percentage points.

10.1086/724113.abstractZh: 我们采用一个具有健康生产特征的通用均衡异质代理人模型，来量化健康价格在解释各国健康支出和健康状况差异中的作用。考虑到其他特定于国家的解释因素，美国的健康价格估计比欧洲国家高出33%。这一价格差异解释了欧洲与美国之间60%以上的健康支出差异，以及一半以上的健康状况差异。尽管这些价格差异在总体层面上具有较大影响，但它们使美国人的终身生活成本增加了2个百分点。

abstract.text: This paper examines a commonly used measure of persuasion whose precise interpretation has been obscure in the literature. By using the potential outcome framework, we define the causal persuasion rate by a proper conditional probability of taking the action of interest with a persuasive message conditional on not taking the action without the message. We then formally study identification under empirically relevant data scenarios and show that the commonly adopted measure generally does not estimate—but often overstates—the causal rate of persuasion. We discuss several new parameters of interest and provide practical methods for causal inference.

10.1086/724114.abstractZh: 本文探讨了一种常用的说服力衡量方法，其在文献中的确切解释一直存在模糊性。通过采用潜在结果框架，我们定义了因果说服率，即在没有说服性信息的情况下不采取某种行动的概率，以及在接收到说服性信息后采取该行动的概率。随后，我们基于实际相关的数据场景，对识别问题进行了正式研究，并发现通常采用的衡量方法往往无法准确估计——反而常常高估——因果说服率。我们还讨论了几个新的相关参数，并提供了因果推断的实用方法。

abstract.text: We attempt to understand potential common forces behind rising market concentration and a slowdown in business dynamism in the US economy, through a micro-founded general equilibrium model of endogenous firm dynamics. The model captures the strategic behavior between competing firms, its effect on their innovation decisions, and the resulting “best-versus-the-rest” dynamics. We consider multiple potential mechanisms that can drive the observed changes and use the calibrated model to assess their relative importance, with particular attention to the implied transitional dynamics. Our results highlight the dominant role of a decline in the intensity of knowledge diffusion from frontier firms to laggard ones. We present new evidence that corroborates a declining knowledge diffusion in the economy.

10.1086/724289.abstractZh: 我们试图通过一种微观基础的一般均衡模型，来理解美国经济中市场集中度上升和商业活力放缓背后的潜在共同因素。该模型捕捉了竞争企业之间的战略行为、这些行为对其创新决策的影响，以及由此产生的“最佳对抗其余”的动态。我们考虑了多种可能驱动这些变化的机制，并利用校准后的模型来评估它们的相对重要性，特别关注由此产生的过渡动态。我们的研究结果强调了从前沿企业向落后企业知识扩散强度下降的主导作用。我们提出了新的证据，证实了经济中知识扩散的减少。

abstract.text: We measure the contribution of firm-embedded productivity to cross-country income differences. By firm-embedded productivity we refer to firm-specific components of productivity, such as blueprints, management practices, and other intangible capital. Using micro-level data for multinational enterprises (MNEs), we compare market shares of the same MNE in different countries and document that they are systematically larger in less developed countries. This indicates that MNEs face less competition and that firm-embedded productivity is scarce in these countries. We implement a measure of firm-embedded productivity based on this observation. Differences in firm-embedded productivity account for one-third of the cross-country variance in output per worker in our sample.

10.1086/724314.abstractZh: 我们衡量了企业内生产率对跨国收入差异的贡献。所谓企业内生产率，指的是企业特有的生产率组成部分，如蓝图、管理实践以及其他无形资产。通过跨国企业的微观数据，我们比较了同一跨国企业在不同国家的市场份额，发现它们在欠发达国家中的市场份额系统性地更高。这表明跨国企业面临的竞争较少，而企业内生产率在这些国家较为稀缺。基于这一观察，我们提出了一种衡量企业内生产率的方法。在我们的样本中，企业内生产率的差异解释了跨国范围内每工人产出差异的三分之一。

abstract.text: We study agency frictions in the US Congress. We examine the long-standing hypothesis that political elites engage in conflict because they fail to internalize the associated costs. We compare the voting behavior of legislators with draft age sons versus draft age daughters during the conscription-era wars of the twentieth century. We estimate that having a draft age son reduces proconscription voting by 7–11 percentage points. Support for conscription recovers when a legislator’s son ages out of eligibility. We establish that agency problems contribute to political conflict and that politicians are influenced by private incentives orthogonal to political concerns or ideological preferences.

10.1086/724316.abstractZh: 我们研究了美国国会的代理摩擦问题。我们检验了这样一个长期存在的假设：政治精英之所以发生冲突，是因为他们未能内化相关成本。我们对比了20世纪征兵时期战争期间，有征兵年龄儿子的立法者与有征兵年龄女儿的立法者的投票行为。我们的估计表明，有征兵年龄的儿子会使支持征兵的投票率降低7-11个百分点。当立法者的儿子达到征兵年龄资格时，对征兵的支持又会恢复。我们证实，代理问题导致了政治冲突，而政治家们受到与政治关切或意识形态偏好无关的私人激励的影响。

abstract.text: What is the optimal fiscal policy response to a recession when the government is subject to sovereign risk? We study this question in a model of endogenous sovereign default with nominal rigidities. Increasing spending in a recession reduces unemployment, but it exposes the government to a debt crisis. We quantitatively analyze this trade-off between stimulus and austerity and find that expanding government spending may be undesirable, even in the presence of sizable Keynesian stabilization gains and inequality concerns. Consistent with these findings, we show that sovereign risk is a key driver of the fiscal procyclicality observed worldwide.

10.1086/724317.abstractZh: 在政府面临主权风险的情况下，对于经济衰退，最优的财政政策反应是什么？我们在一个包含名义刚性且存在内生主权违约的模型中研究了这个问题。在经济衰退期间增加支出可以减少失业，但也会使政府面临债务危机。我们对刺激政策与紧缩政策之间的权衡进行了定量分析，发现即使在凯恩斯主义稳定效应的显著以及不平等问题存在的情况下，扩大政府支出也可能是不可取的。与这些发现一致的是，我们发现主权风险是全球范围内观察到的财政顺周期性问题的关键驱动因素。
