abstract.text: The stakeholder (or responsible) firm maximizes the (weighted or unweighted) sum of the surpluses of its customers and suppliers (including workers). Although this objective is hard to empirically measure, it can be pursued by simple management rules that rely on constrained profit maximization. Unconstrained profit maximization gives a competitive edge to ordinary firms, but stakeholder firms are better for social welfare and internalize several important effects of their activities on society. Long-term entry decisions should rely on profit modified by Pigouvian pricing of externalities, and this result provides a novel justification for the polluter-pays principle.

10.1086/724318.abstractZh: 利益相关者（或责任方）企业旨在最大化其客户和供应商（包括员工）的盈余之和（无论是否加权）。尽管这一目标难以通过实证数据进行衡量，但可以通过依赖约束性利润最大化原则的简单管理规则来实现。无约束性利润最大化能为普通企业带来竞争优势，但利益相关者企业更能促进社会福利，并能将企业活动对社会产生的若干重要影响内部化。长期进入决策应基于利润加上庇古式外部性定价的调整，这一结果为“污染者付费原则”提供了新的理论依据。

abstract.text: We examine the contribution of trade to the rise of modern agriculture, taking into account interactions between trade, input requirements, and technology adoption. We develop and estimate a new multicountry general equilibrium model that incorporates producers’ choices of which crops to produce and with which technologies at the level of grid cells covering the earth’s surface. We find that trade cost reductions in agricultural inputs and the international transmission of productivity growth in the agricultural input sector since the 1980s induced large shifts from traditional, labor-intensive technologies to modern, input-intensive ones, with important global and distributional implications for productivity and welfare.

10.1086/724319.abstractZh: 我们研究了贸易对现代农业发展的推动作用，同时考虑了贸易、投入需求和技术采纳之间的相互作用。我们开发并估计了一个新的多国一般均衡模型，该模型涵盖了生产者选择种植哪些作物以及采用哪些技术的决策，这些决策是在覆盖地球表面的网格单元层面进行的。我们发现，自20世纪80年代以来，农业投入品的贸易成本降低以及农业投入部门生产力的国际传播，促使人们从传统的劳动密集型技术转向现代的投入密集型技术，这对全球和分配层面的生产力和福利产生了重要影响。

abstract.text: We estimate productivity gains of 13.5% from workplace soft skills training among Indian garment workers. Productivity gains are greater when trainees work on joint operations alongside other coworkers, consistent with gains being driven by improved teamwork and collaboration. Furthermore, untreated coworkers on the treated production lines also show increased productivity. These improvements in the teamwork substitute for managerial attention. Despite productivity gains and higher promotion probabilities among treated workers, there are no effects on wages or retention, consistent with frictions in this labor market. Consequently, the net return to the firm was large: 256% 8 months after program completion.

10.1086/724320.abstractZh: 我们估计，印度服装工人的工作场所软技能培训使生产率提高了13.5%。当受训者与其他同事共同进行联合操作时，生产率提升更为显著，这与团队合作和协作能力的提高有关。此外，接受培训的生产线上未受培训的同僚的生产率也有所提升。这些团队合作的改善可以替代管理层的关注。尽管受训工人的生产率有所提高，晋升机会也增加，但工资和员工保留率并未受到影响，这与该劳动力市场的摩擦现象相符。因此，该项目的净收益巨大：项目完成后8个月，收益达到了256%。

abstract.text: We introduce a framework for studying collective search by teams. Discoveries are correlated over time and governed by a Brownian path, where search speed is jointly controlled. Agents individually choose when to cease search and implement their best discovery. We characterize equilibrium and optimal policies. Search speeds are constant within active alliances and depend on complementarities between members. A drawdown stopping boundary governs each agent’s search termination. The consequent exit waves, whereby possibly heterogeneous agents cease search simultaneously, exhibit deterministic sequencing but stochastic timing. We highlight environments with lower than optimal equilibrium speeds and search durations, and different exit waves.

10.1086/724321.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个研究团队集体搜索的框架。发现结果随时间相关联，并受到布朗路径的支配，搜索速度则被共同控制。各代理人自行决定何时停止搜索，并实施其最佳发现策略。我们描述了均衡状态与最优策略。在活跃联盟内部，搜索速度保持恒定，并取决于成员之间的互补性。一个下降停止边界决定了每个代理人的搜索终止时机。由此产生的退出波现象表明，可能由不同代理人同时停止搜索，但退出顺序具有确定性，时间分布则具有随机性。我们强调了那些均衡速度与搜索持续时间低于最优水平的环境，以及不同的退出波现象。

abstract.text: A policymaker selects a minipublic—a group of citizens from a demographically diverse citizenry with access to local evidence about the impact of a policy. Citizens face uncertainty about the policymaker’s eventual policy bias, which is shown to discourage the most marginally informative minipublic citizens from discovering their evidence. We fully characterize the optimal minipublic composition. Relative to the most demographically representative minipublic, the optimal minipublic overrepresents demographics at the margins of the citizenry while underrepresenting those around the median citizen. The representativeness of the optimal minipublic varies nonmonotonically with uncertainty. Our findings bear practical implications for minipublic design.

10.1086/724322.abstractZh: 政策制定者选择了一个“迷你公共群体”——由来自人口结构多样化的公民组成，这些公民能够获取关于政策影响的本地证据。公民面临着对政策制定者最终政策偏好的不确定性，而这种不确定性会阻碍那些信息最有限的迷你公共群体成员去发现相关证据。我们详细描述了最优迷你公共群体的构成方式。与人口结构最具有代表性的迷你公共群体相比，最优迷你公共群体在人口边缘群体的代表性更高，而在中位数附近的群体则代表性较低。最优迷你公共群体的代表性随着不确定性的变化而呈现出非单调的变化。我们的发现对迷你公共群体的设计具有实际意义。

abstract.text: We study an impatient, risk-neutral government that cannot commit to a particular debt path, financed by competitive lenders. In equilibrium, debt adjusts slowly toward a debt-to-income target, exacerbating booms and busts. Strikingly, gains from trade dissipate when trading is continuous, leaving the government no better off than in financial autarky, owing to a sovereign “debt ratchet effect.” Moreover, citizens who are more patient than their government are strictly harmed. We characterize equilibrium debt dynamics, ergodics, and comparative statics when income follows a geometric Brownian motion and analyze devices that allow the sovereign to recapture gains from trade.

10.1086/724571.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个缺乏耐心且风险中性的政府，该政府无法承诺特定的债务路径，而是由竞争性贷款机构提供资金。在均衡状态下，债务会缓慢调整至债务与收入的目标水平，从而加剧经济周期的波动。值得注意的是，当交易是连续进行的时，贸易带来的收益会消散，导致政府在财政上并不比处于金融自给自足状态时更好，这是由于“债务棘轮效应”造成的。此外，比政府更有耐心的公民会受到严重损害。我们描述了均衡债务动态、 ergodic性质以及当收入遵循几何布朗运动时的比较静态情况，并分析了能够让主权政府重新获得贸易收益的方法。

abstract.text: Edgeworth’s paradox of taxation occurs when an increase in the unit cost of a product causes a multiproduct monopolist to reduce prices. We give simple illustrations of the paradox and a general analysis of the case of linear marginal cost and demand conditions, and we characterize which matrices of cost pass-through terms are consistent with profit maximization. When the firm supplies at least one pair of substitute products, we show how Edgeworth’s paradox always occurs with a suitable choice of cost function. We then establish a connection between Ramsey pricing and the paradox in a form relating to consumer surplus.

10.1086/724573.abstractZh: Edgeworth的税收悖论发生在产品的单位成本增加导致多产品垄断者降低价格时。我们简单说明了这一悖论，并对线性边际成本和需求条件的情况进行了一般分析，并确定了哪些成本传递矩阵与利润最大化相一致。当企业至少供应一对替代产品时，我们展示了如何通过合适的成本函数选择来始终出现Edgeworth的悖论。然后，我们建立了Ramsey定价与这一悖论之间的联系，这种联系与消费者剩余有关。

abstract.text: We analyze premarital investments in human capital and housing when individuals are unable to make binding commitments to share their labor income with a prospective spouse. Investments are distorted if there are gender differences in bargaining power over own labor income or marriage market imbalances. Distortions are magnified when ex ante bargaining power favors one sex (e.g., women in China) and ex post bargaining power favors the other (e.g., men in China), since parents of boys will increase housing investments in order to credibly commit to share more resources with the boy’s potential wife, possibly crowding out human capital investments.

10.1086/724574.abstractZh: 我们分析了在个人无法做出承诺与潜在配偶分享劳动收入的情况下，婚前对人力资本和住房的投资情况。如果女性在获取自身劳动收入方面的议价能力存在差异，或者婚姻市场存在不平衡，那么这些投资就会受到扭曲。当事前议价能力偏向某一性别（例如，中国的女性）而事后议价能力偏向另一性别（例如，中国的男性）时，这种扭曲会更加明显，因为男孩的父母会增加住房投资，以可信地承诺与男孩的潜在妻子分享更多资源，这可能会挤占人力资本投资。

abstract.text: We analyze efficiency and nonfundamental volatility in a class of generalized beauty-contest economies with endogenous information. As in models of rational-expectations equilibria, agents learn about exogenous states and endogenous aggregate actions. As in models of rational inattention, agents choose their information structures subject to a cost. We identify conditions on information costs that guarantee the existence of efficient or inefficient equilibria; we further identify conditions that guarantee the existence or nonexistence of equilibria with zero nonfundamental volatility. Mutual information, the cost typically assumed in rational-inattention models, guarantees the existence of an efficient equilibrium with zero nonfundamental volatility.

10.1086/724575.abstractZh: 我们分析了一类具有内生信息的广义美丽竞赛经济中的效率与非基本波动性。与理性预期均衡模型类似，代理人会了解外生状态和内生总行为。与理性忽视模型类似，代理人会在成本约束下选择自己的信息结构。我们确定了信息成本的条件，这些条件保证了有效或无效均衡的存在；我们还确定了保证零非基本波动性均衡存在与否的条件。相互信息，通常在理性忽视模型中被假设为成本，保证了具有零非基本波动性的有效均衡的存在。

abstract.text: I characterize the dynamics of incentives in an optimal contract with investment delegation, moral hazard, and uncertainty about the agent’s productivity. The principal increases the agent’s incentives after good performance in order to delegate more capital to an agent with higher perceived productivity, thus implementing a convex pay-for-performance scheme. Moreover, the principal commits to reduce the agent’s future incentives in order to mitigate ex ante investment distortions. Methodologically, I provide a duality-based strategy to overcome technical challenges common to continuous-time contracting models with state variables. I also derive a sufficient condition to verify the validity of the first-order approach.

10.1086/724576.abstractZh: 我描述了在包含投资委托、道德风险以及代理人生产力不确定性的最优契约中，激励机制的动态变化。当代理人表现良好时，委托人会增强其激励，以便将更多资本委托给被认为生产力更高的代理人，从而实现一种凸形绩效支付方案。此外，委托人还承诺在未来减少代理人的激励，以缓解事前投资中的扭曲现象。在方法论上，我提出了一种基于对偶性的策略，以克服连续时间契约模型中常见的技术挑战，这些模型包含状态变量。我还推导出一个充分条件，用于验证一阶方法的有效性。

abstract.text: We study informed persuasion, whereby a privately informed designer without ex ante commitment power chooses disclosure mechanisms to influence agents’ actions. We characterize the subset of Bayes-correlated equilibria yielding every designer type a payoff higher than what they could get from any disclosure mechanism with credible beliefs. This set of interim-optimal mechanisms is nonempty and tractable, and all its elements are perfect Bayesian equilibrium mechanisms of the informed-designer game. Interim-optimal mechanisms are characterized via belief-based approaches in pure persuasion settings. We identify single- and multiagent interactive environments in which ex ante–optimal mechanisms are interim optimal.

10.1086/724843.abstractZh: 我们研究信息驱动的说服行为，即一个拥有私人信息的设计者在没有事前决策权的情况下，选择披露机制来影响其他参与者的行为。我们描述了那些能使每种设计者类型获得的收益高于任何具有可信信念的披露机制所提供收益的贝叶斯相关均衡子集。这组临时最优机制是非空的，并且是可处理的，其所有元素都是信息驱动设计者游戏中的完美贝叶斯均衡机制。在纯说服情境下，通过基于信念的方法对这些临时最优机制进行了描述。我们确定了单代理和多代理交互环境中的情况，在这些环境中，事前最优机制实际上是临时最优的。

abstract.text: We provide evidence on the importance of coordination frictions in technology adoption, using data from a large provider of electronic wallets during the Indian demonetization. Exploiting geographical variation in exposure to the demonetization, we show that adoption of the wallet increased persistently in response to the large but temporary cash contraction, consistent with the predictions of a technology adoption model with complementarities. Model estimates indicate that adoption would have been 45% lower without complementarities. Our results illustrate how large but temporary interventions can help overcome coordination frictions, though we caution that such interventions may also exacerbate initial differences in adoption.

10.1086/724847.abstractZh: 我们提供了关于技术采纳中协调摩擦重要性的证据，这些数据来自印度货币废止期间一家大型电子钱包供应商。通过考察货币废止对各地区的影响差异，我们发现电子钱包的采用率因现金短缺而持续上升，这与具有互补性技术的采纳模型预测一致。模型估计表明，如果没有互补性，采用率将降低45%。我们的研究结果表明，虽然这些大规模且暂时的干预措施有助于克服协调摩擦，但我们也提醒，此类干预措施可能会加剧初始的采用差异。

abstract.text: We analyze the implications of priority service (PS) on customers’ welfare. In monopoly markets, PS can often decrease consumer surplus and can even yield a loss of welfare to all consumers. This happens despite its efficiency gains, as monopolists levy in revenue more than the total efficiency gains. PS can increase consumer surplus if it expands the consumption coverage—that is, if it introduces new customers who would not purchase the service otherwise. In duopoly markets, the price competition over PS can be severely eroded. Under homogeneity, firms act as if they were monopolists serving half of the market.

10.1086/724850.abstractZh: 我们分析了优先服务对消费者福利的影响。在垄断市场中，优先服务往往会降低消费者剩余，甚至会对所有消费者造成福利损失。尽管优先服务能带来效率提升，但由于垄断者征收的税收超过了总效率提升带来的收益，因此优先服务仍会导致消费者福利的减少。如果优先服务能够扩大消费范围，即吸引原本不会购买该服务的消费者，那么它可以增加消费者剩余。在双头垄断市场中，对优先服务的价格竞争可能会受到严重削弱。在同质化条件下，企业的行为就像垄断者垄断了市场的一半份额一样。

abstract.text: No region of the United States fared worse over the postwar period than the Rust Belt. This paper analyzes how much of its decline can be accounted for by the persistent labor market conflict that characterized Rust Belt union-management relations. We develop a multisector, multiregion, dynamic general equilibrium model in which labor market conflict leads to strikes, wage premia, lower investment, and lower productivity growth. These lead to shrinking Rust Belt industries and to workers moving out of the Rust Belt. Labor conflict accounts for half of the decline in the region’s share of manufacturing employment. Foreign competition plays a smaller role, and its effects are concentrated after most of the region’s decline had already occurred.

10.1086/724852.abstractZh: 在战后时期，美国的任何地区都没有像 Rust Belt 那样遭受更严重的冲击。本文分析了 Rust Belt 的衰退在很大程度上是由工会与管理层之间持续存在的劳动市场冲突所导致的。我们建立了一个多部门、多地区的动态一般均衡模型，在该模型中，劳动市场冲突会导致罢工、工资溢价、投资减少以及生产率增长放缓。这些因素导致 Rust Belt 的工业规模缩小，工人也纷纷离开该地区。劳动冲突解释了该地区制造业就业份额下降的一半原因。外国竞争的作用较小，其影响主要集中在该地区衰退之后。

abstract.text: We formulate a reputational model in which the type of government is time varying and private information. Agents adjust their beliefs about the government’s type (i.e., reputation) using noisy signals about its policies. We consider a debt repayment setting in which reputation influences the market’s perceived probability of default, which affects sovereign spreads. We focus on the 2007–12 Argentine episode of inflation misreport to quantify how markets price reputation. We find that the misreports significantly increased Argentina’s sovereign spreads. We use those estimates to discipline our model and show that reputation can have long-lasting effects on a government’s borrowing costs.

10.1086/724855.abstractZh: 我们构建了一个声誉模型，其中政府的类型随时间变化，且存在私人信息。代理人根据政府政策的噪音信号来调整他们对政府类型的认知（即声誉）。我们考虑了一个债务偿还情境，其中声誉会影响市场对于政府违约概率的感知，进而影响主权债券息差。我们重点关注2007-12年阿根廷的通胀误报事件，以量化市场如何对声誉进行定价。研究发现，这些误报显著增加了阿根廷的主权债券息差。我们利用这些估计来检验我们的模型，并表明声誉会对政府的借贷成本产生长期影响。

abstract.text: How should mediators communicate with bargainers? When can they improve outcomes? Can arbitrators that impose outcomes do better? I provide answers in wars of attrition with flexible and commitment types, consistent with reputational bargaining. I characterize the unique mediated equilibrium, which maximizes flexible types’ payoffs. The mediator immediately elicits private information but waits to suggest agreements. She front-loads agreements between flexible types, while initially delaying any involving commitment types. This improves on unmediated outcomes only if commitment probabilities are less than agents’ payoff share in their preferred agreement. Arbitrators do strictly better but sometimes impose disagreement, which may be hard to enforce.

10.1086/724858.abstractZh: 调解人与谈判者应该如何沟通？他们何时能够改善结果？强制执行结果的仲裁员能否表现得更好？我在耗竭式战争中提供了答案，这些战争涉及灵活型和承诺型两种类型，与声誉谈判理论相一致。我描述了独特的调解均衡，这种均衡能够最大化灵活型类型的收益。调解人会立即获取私人信息，但会等待时机再提出协议建议。调解人优先促成灵活型类型之间的协议，同时最初会延迟涉及承诺型类型的协议。只有当承诺概率低于代理人在其首选协议中的收益份额时，这种方式才能改善未经调解的结果。仲裁员确实表现得更好，但有时也会导致分歧，而这种分歧可能难以执行。

abstract.text: We extend a standard model of parental investment and intergenerational mobility to include a fully specified genetic analysis of skill transmission. The model’s predictions differ substantially from the standard model’s. The coefficient of intergenerational income elasticity (IGE) may be larger than that in the standard model and depends on the distribution of the genotype. The distribution of genetic endowments may be stratified according to income. The model is tested on data, including genetic information, of twins and their parents, estimating how IGE is affected by genetic factors and how environment and genes interact. The effect of intelligence is substantially stronger than that of other traits.

10.1086/724860.abstractZh: 我们扩展了一个标准的父母投资与代际流动模型，以包含对技能传递的完全指定的遗传分析。该模型的预测与标准模型有显著不同。代际收入弹性系数可能大于标准模型中的数值，并且取决于基因型的分布。遗传禀赋的分布可能根据收入进行分层。该模型通过双胞胎及其父母的数据进行测试，包括遗传信息，以评估遗传因素如何影响代际收入弹性，以及环境与基因之间的相互作用。智力的影响比其他特征的影响更为显著。

abstract.text: I study a model of the financial sector in which intermediation among debt-financed banks gives rise to an endogenous core-periphery network. Endogenous intermediation generates excessive systemic risk in the financial network. Financial institutions have incentives to capture intermediation spreads through strategic borrowing and lending decisions. By doing so, they tilt the division of surplus along an intermediation chain in their favor, while at the same time reducing aggregate surplus. The network is inefficient relative to a constrained-efficient benchmark, since banks that make risky investments “overconnect,” exposing themselves to excessive counterparty risk, while banks that mainly provide funding end up with too few connections.

10.1086/725168.abstractZh: 我研究了一个金融部门的模型，在该模型中，债务融资的银行之间的中介行为形成了一个内生性的核心-边缘网络。这种内生性的中介行为会在金融网络中产生过度的系统性风险。金融机构有动机通过战略性借贷决策来获取中介机会。这样做会使它们能够调整剩余财富的分配，使其有利于自身，同时减少整体财富。与受限效率的基准相比，该网络是低效的，因为进行高风险投资的银行会过度连接，从而面临过度的交易对手风险，而主要提供融资的银行则连接过少。

abstract.text: We study optimal policy in an economy where interest rates are low because public debt serves as collateral or buffer stock. Issuing more public debt raises welfare by easing the underlying friction but also reduces the private valuation of this service, raising interest rates. This trade-off shapes the optimal quantity of public debt in the long run, justifies a departure from tax smoothing in the short run, and calls for larger deficits during financial crises. Our analysis illustrates the possible robustness of these insights to different microfoundations and helps clarify when exactly low interest rates represent an opportunity for cheap government borrowing.

10.1086/725170.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个利率较低的经济体系中的最优政策，因为公共债务被用作抵押品或缓冲库存。发行更多的公共债务可以通过缓解潜在的摩擦来提高福利，但也会降低私人对这种服务的估值，从而提高利率。这种权衡决定了长期内公共债务的最优数量，解释了在短期内偏离税收平滑政策的必要性，并要求在金融危机期间实施更大的赤字。我们的分析表明，这些见解对不同微观基础具有鲁棒性，并有助于明确在何时低利率实际上代表了廉价政府借款的机会。

abstract.text: Which information structures are more effective at eliminating first- and higher-order uncertainty and hence at facilitating efficient play in coordination games? We consider a learning setting where players observe many private signals about the state. First, we characterize multiagent learning efficiency, that is, the rate at which players approximate common knowledge. We find that this coincides with the rate at which first-order uncertainty disappears, as higher-order uncertainty vanishes faster than first-order uncertainty. Second, we show that with enough signal draws, information structures with higher learning efficiency induce higher equilibrium welfare. We highlight information design implications for games in data-rich environments.

10.1086/725171.abstractZh: 哪些信息结构在消除一阶及更高阶的不确定性方面更为有效，从而有助于协调博弈中的高效合作？我们考虑了一个学习环境，其中参与者可以观察到许多关于状态的私人信号。首先，我们描述了多智能体学习的效率，即参与者逼近共同知识的速率。我们发现，这一速率与一阶不确定性消失的速率一致，因为更高阶的不确定性消失得比一阶不确定性更快。其次，我们表明，在足够的信号采集下，具有更高学习效率的信息结构能够带来更高的均衡福利。我们强调了信息设计对于数据丰富环境下博弈的重要性。

abstract.text: We show that higher payments from US Social Security Disability Insurance (DI) reduce mortality. Using administrative data on new DI beneficiaries, we exploit discontinuities in the benefit formula through a regression kink design. We estimate that $1,000 more in annual DI payments decreases the annual mortality rate of lower-income beneficiaries by approximately 0.18–0.35 percentage points, implying an elasticity of mortality with respect to DI income of around −0.6 to −1.0. We find no robust evidence of an effect of DI income on the mortality of higher-income beneficiaries.

10.1086/725172.abstractZh: 我们表明，美国社会保障残疾保险提供的更高支付金额能够降低死亡率。通过利用关于新获得残疾保险福利的受益人的行政数据，我们采用回归拐点设计来研究福利公式中的不连续性。我们的估计显示，每年增加1,000美元的残疾保险支付金额，可以将低收入受益人的年死亡率降低约0.18至0.35个百分点，这意味着死亡率与残疾保险收入之间的弹性约为-0.6至-1.0。我们没有发现残疾保险收入对高收入受益人的死亡率有显著影响。

abstract.text: Little is known about optimal policy in the face of global supply chain disruptions. Should governments promote resilience by subsidizing backup sources of input supply in multiple countries? Should they encourage firms to source from safer domestic suppliers? We address these questions in a model of production with a critical input and exogenous risks of supply disturbances. With constant elasticity of substitution preferences, a subsidy for diversification achieves the constrained social optimum. When the demand elasticity rises with price, private investments in resilience may be socially excessive and the social planner may wish to discourage diversification while favoring sourcing from abroad.

10.1086/725173.abstractZh: 关于全球供应链中断情况下的最优政策，目前所知甚少。政府是否应该通过补贴多个国家的备用供应来源来提升企业的韧性？或者，政府是否应该鼓励企业从更安全的国内供应商处采购物资？我们在一个包含关键投入要素和供应中断外生风险的生产模型中探讨了这些问题。在替代偏好具有恒定弹性的情况下，对多元化的补贴能够实现社会最优配置。然而，当需求弹性随价格上升时，私人对韧性的投资可能会超出社会可接受的范围，此时社会规划者可能希望抑制多元化，而更倾向于从国外采购物资。

abstract.text: We use laboratory experiments to test models of rational inattention, in which people acquire information to maximize utility net of information costs. We show that subjects adjust their attention in response to changes in incentives, in line with the rational inattention model. However, our results are qualitatively inconsistent with information costs that are linear in Shannon entropy, as is often assumed in applied work. Our data are best fit by a generalization of the Shannon model, which allows for a more flexible response to incentives and for some states of the world to be harder to distinguish than others.

10.1086/725174.abstractZh: 我们通过实验室实验来测试理性忽视模型，即人们获取信息以在信息成本的基础上最大化效用。我们发现，实验对象会根据激励变化调整自己的注意力，这与理性忽视模型相符。然而，我们的研究结果与信息成本与香农熵成线性关系的假设不一致，而后者通常被认为是应用研究中的常见假设。我们的数据最适合用香农模型的推广形式来描述，该模型能够更灵活地应对激励变化，并且某些状态比其他状态更难区分。

abstract.text: In traditional over-the-counter markets, investors trade bilaterally through intermediaries. We assess whether and how to shift trades on a centralized platform with trade-level data on the Canadian government bond market. We document that intermediaries charge a markup when trading with investors and specify a model to quantify price and welfare effects from market centralization. We find that many investors would not use the platform, even if they could, because it is costly, competition for investors is low, and investors value relationships with intermediaries. Market centralization can even decrease welfare, unless competition is sufficiently strong.

10.1086/725361.abstractZh: 在传统的场外市场中，投资者通过中介进行双边交易。我们评估是否以及如何在集中化平台上转移交易行为，并利用加拿大政府债券市场的交易级数据进行分析。我们发现，中介在与投资者交易时会收取溢价，并且我们提出了一个模型来量化市场集中化对价格和福利的影响。研究发现，即使能够使用平台，许多投资者也不会选择使用它，因为使用平台的成本较高，投资者的竞争程度较低，而且投资者更重视与中介的关系。除非竞争足够激烈，否则市场集中化甚至可能会降低福利。

abstract.text: We analyze sorting in a frictional labor market when workers and jobs have multidimensional characteristics. We say that matching is positive assortative in dimension (j, k) if workers with higher endowment in skill k are matched to a job distribution with higher values of attribute j in the first-order stochastic dominance sense. Crucial for sorting is a single-crossing property of technology. Sorting is positive between worker-job attributes with strong complementarities but negative in other dimensions. Finally, sorting is based on comparative advantage: workers sort into jobs that suit their skill mix rather than their overall skill level.

10.1086/725362.abstractZh: 我们分析了在具有多维特征的劳动者和职位之间的摩擦性劳动力市场中排序现象。如果具有较高技能k禀赋的劳动者被匹配到具有较高属性j值的职位分布中，我们认为这种匹配在维度(j, k)上是正同配的。对排序现象而言，技术的单交叉特性至关重要。在具有强互补性的劳动者-职位属性之间，排序是正向的；而在其他维度上，排序则是负向的。最后，排序现象基于比较优势：劳动者会选择与其技能组合相匹配的职位，而非其整体技能水平。

abstract.text: We present the results of a large field experiment on setting reserve prices in auctions for online advertisements, guided by the theory of optimal auction design suitably adapted to the sponsored search setting. Consistent with the theory, revenues increased substantially after the new reserve prices were introduced.

10.1086/725702.abstractZh: 我们展示了一项关于在线广告拍卖中设定保留价格的大规模实地实验结果，该实验基于最优拍卖设计理论，并适当调整以适应赞助搜索环境。与理论预测一致，引入新的保留价格后，收入显著增加。

abstract.text: ‘CEOs’ of public schools in many countries have authority and responsibilities that can greatly affect the quality of schooling. This paper estimates the impact of CEOs on student outcomes in Israeli elementary schools. We estimate CEO quality in two ways—once using schools that do not switch CEOs and once using schools that do. We show that switches are exogenous and are not correlated with potential outcomes. CEO quality positively affects students’ test scores and behavioural outcomes, with pronounced effects for disadvantaged schools. Potential mechanisms show that high-quality CEOs lead to improvements in school priorities, working procedures and violence reduction.

10.1093/ej/uead026.abstractZh: 许多国家公立学校的校长拥有权力和责任，这些权力和责任会极大地影响学校的教育质量。本文估计了校长对以色列小学学生学业成绩的影响。我们通过两种方式来评估校长的质量——一种是使用不更换校长的学校，另一种是使用更换校长的学校。我们发现，校长的更换是外生因素，并且与潜在结果无关。校长的质量对学生的考试成绩和行为表现有积极影响，对于处于不利地位的学校来说这种影响更为显著。潜在的机制表明，高质量的校长能够改善学校的优先事项、工作程序以及减少暴力行为。

abstract.text: We study the implications of transparency policies on decentralised public good provision by the non-profit sector. We present a model where imperfect monitoring of the use of funds interacts with the competitive structure of the non-profit sector under alternative informational regimes. Increasing transparency regarding the use of funds may have ambiguous effects on total public good provision and on donors’ welfare. On the one hand, transparency encourages all non-profit firms to engage more actively in curbing fund diversion. On the other hand, it tilts the playing field against non-profits facing higher monitoring costs, pressing them to give up on their missions. This effect on the extensive margin implies that transparency policies lead to a reduction in the diversity of social missions addressed by the non-profit sector. We show that the negative impact of transparency on social mission variety and on donors’ welfare is highest for intermediate levels of asymmetry in monitoring costs.

10.1093/ej/uead036.abstractZh: 我们研究了透明度政策对非营利部门提供分散式公共物品的影响。我们提出了一个模型，其中对资金使用的不完美监控与非营利部门的竞争结构在不同的信息制度下相互作用。提高资金使用的透明度可能对公共物品的总提供量和捐赠者的福利产生双重影响。一方面，透明度促使所有非营利组织更积极地采取措施防止资金被挪用；另一方面，它使得面临更高监控成本的非营利组织不得不放弃其使命。这种对广泛边际的影响意味着透明度政策会导致非营利部门所承担的社会使命的多样性减少。我们的研究表明，透明度对社会使命多样性以及捐赠者福利的负面影响在监控成本不对称程度较高时最为显著。

abstract.text: We measure the adoption of management practices in over 220 private for-profit and non-profit health facilities in 64 districts across Tanzania and link these data to process quality-of-care metrics, assessed using undercover standardised patients and clinical observations. We find that better managed health facilities are more likely to provide correct treatment in accordance with national treatment guidelines, adhere to a checklist of essential questions and examinations, and comply with infection prevention and control practices. Moving from the 10th to the 90th percentile in the management practice score is associated with a 48% increase in correct treatment. We then leverage a large-scale field experiment of an internationally recognised management support intervention in which health facilities are assessed against comprehensive standards, given an individually tailored quality improvement plan and supported through training and mentoring visits. We find zero to small effects on management scores, suggesting that improving management practices in this setting may be challenging.

10.1093/ej/uead075.abstractZh: 我们测量了坦桑尼亚64个地区超过220家私营营利性和非营利性医疗机构的管理实践采纳情况，并将这些数据与通过隐蔽标准化患者和临床观察评估的护理质量指标联系起来。我们发现，管理更完善的医疗机构更有可能按照国家治疗指南提供正确的治疗，遵守必要问题和检查清单，并遵守感染预防和控制措施。在管理实践得分上从第10百分位上升到第90百分位，正确治疗的比例增加了48%。随后，我们采用了一项国际公认的管理支持干预措施的大规模实地实验，该实验要求医疗机构根据全面标准进行评估，并制定个性化的质量改进计划，同时获得培训和指导访问的支持。我们发现，这种干预措施对管理评分的影响很小或几乎没有，这表明在这种环境下改善管理实践可能具有挑战性。

abstract.text: Hospital quality ratings are widely available to help Medicare beneficiaries make an informed choice about where to receive care. However, how beneficiaries' trade-off between different quality domains (clinical outcomes, patient experience, safety, efficiency) and other considerations (out-of-pocket cost, travel distance) is not well understood. We sought to study how beneficiaries make trade-offs when choosing a hypothetical hospital. We administered an online survey that included a discrete choice experiment to a nationally representative sample of 1025 Medicare beneficiaries. On average, beneficiaries were willing to pay $1698 more for a hospital with a 1-star higher rating on clinical outcomes. This was over twice the value of the patient experience ($691) and safety ($615) domains and nearly 8 times the value of the efficiency domain ($218). We also found that the value of a 1-star improvement depends not only on the quality domain but also the baseline level of performance of the hospital. Generally, it is more valuable for low-performing hospitals to achieve average performance than for average hospitals to achieve excellence.

10.1093/haschl/qxad085.abstractZh: 医院质量评级信息广泛可用，有助于医疗保险受益人做出明智的选择，决定在何处接受治疗。然而，受益人如何在不同的质量领域（临床结果、患者体验、安全性、效率）以及其他考虑因素（自付费用、旅行距离）之间进行权衡，目前尚未得到充分理解。我们旨在研究受益人在选择假设医院时如何权衡这些因素。我们对1025名具有全国代表性的医疗保险受益人进行了在线调查，并包含了一个离散选择实验。平均而言，受益人愿意为临床结果评分更高的1星医院支付1698美元。这一金额是患者体验（691美元）和安全（615美元）领域的两倍多，几乎是效率领域（218美元）的8倍。我们还发现，1星的提升价值不仅取决于质量领域，还取决于医院的基线表现水平。总体而言，对于表现较低的医院来说，达到平均水平比对于表现一般的医院来说，达到卓越水平更有价值。

abstract.text: Despite recent attention to the role of competition in determining health outcomes in developed nations, little is known about how market power impedes access to quality care in lower-income countries. This paper studies the effects of policy changes that stopped collusion among firms supplying insulin to one of Mexico’s largest health care providers. I document increased insulin utilization and decreased diabetes complications and mortality following the sudden drop in insulin prices caused by the cartel’s collapse. These adverse health outcomes expand the assessment of damages caused by the cartel. The findings highlight the importance of market design policies in health markets, particularly for low- and middle-income countries.

10.1093/jeea/jvad005.abstractZh: 尽管最近人们关注竞争在发达国家中对健康结果的影响，但对于市场力量如何阻碍低收入国家获得优质医疗服务的情况却知之甚少。本文研究了政策变化对墨西哥最大一家医疗服务提供商的胰岛素供应商之间勾结行为的影响。我记录了由于卡特尔瓦解导致胰岛素价格骤降后，胰岛素使用量的增加以及糖尿病并发症和死亡率的下降。这些不良健康后果进一步扩大了人们对卡特尔造成的损害评估。研究结果强调了市场设计政策在健康市场中的重要性，尤其是在低收入和中等收入国家。

abstract.text: Millions of women continue to die during and soon after childbirth, even where the knowledge and resources to avoid this are available. We posit that raising the share of women in parliament can trigger action. Leveraging the timing of gender quota legislation across developing countries, we identify sharp sustained reductions of 7%–12% in maternal mortality. Investigating mechanisms, we find that gender quotas lead to increases in percentage points of 5–8 in skilled birth attendance and 4–8 in prenatal care utilization, alongside a decline in fertility of 6%–7% and an increase in the schooling of young women of about 0.5 years. The results are robust to numerous robustness checks. They suggest a new policy tool for tackling maternal mortality.

10.1093/jeea/jvad012.abstractZh: 数以百万计的女性在分娩期间及之后不久仍然死亡，即便有避免这种情况的知识和资源可用。我们认为，提高女性在议会中的比例可以促使相关行动的发生。通过利用发展中国家性别配额立法的时机，我们发现孕产妇死亡率显著下降了7%至12%。通过研究相关机制，我们发现性别配额使得熟练分娩人员的比例增加了5至8个百分点，产前护理利用率增加了4至8个百分点，同时生育率下降了6%至7%，年轻女性的受教育程度也提高了约0.5年。这些结果经过多次验证，表明这是解决孕产妇死亡问题的一个新政策工具。

abstract.text: Why doesn’t healthcare get better and cheaper? The evolution of the cell phones that we carry in our pockets demonstrates that quality can increase while prices fall. Why not in healthcare? The answer suggested in this book is that the health sector generates the wrong kinds of innovation. It is too easy to profit from low-value innovations and too difficult to profit from innovations that reduce care costs. The result is a healthcare economy that is profusely innovative yet remarkably ineffective in discovering and implementing new technologies and business models that deliver increased value at lower cost. The consequences of this failure to innovate accumulate over time and make society poorer and less healthy than it ought to be. As Why Not Better and Cheaper? shows, the root causes of this innovation problem are the incentives, social norms, and competitive environment prevailing in the health sector. We can point innovation in a better direction by improving incentives, mobilizing professional norms and narratives, and altering the regulatory and competitive environment. Our analysis and proposals are of interest to clinicians, educators, managers, and policymakers.

10.1093/oso/9780197603109.001.0001.abstractZh: 为什么医疗保健不能变得更优质且价格更低？我们口袋中携带的手机的发展历程表明，质量可以提高，而价格却可能下降。那么，医疗保健领域为何不能实现这一点呢？本书提出的答案是，医疗行业产生的创新类型存在偏差。从低价值创新中获利太过容易，而从能够降低医疗成本的创新中获利则极为困难。结果就是，医疗行业虽然不断创新，但在发现和实施能够以更低成本提供更高价值的新技术和商业模式方面却表现得非常低效。这种创新失败所带来的后果随着时间的推移，使得社会变得更贫穷、健康状况也变得更差。正如《为什么不能更优质且价格更低？》一书所揭示的那样，这一创新问题的根源在于医疗行业中的激励机制、社会规范以及竞争环境。我们可以通过改善激励机制、推动专业规范和叙事的发展，以及改变监管和竞争环境，来引导创新朝着更好的方向发展。我们的分析和建议对于临床医生、教育工作者、管理者以及政策制定者来说都具有参考价值。

abstract.text: Innovation in the health sector suffers from a value-creation problem and a related but distinct cost-reduction problem. The value-creation problem arises because drugs, devices, and other interventions with low economic value can find a ready market while interventions with high economic value may not. The cost-reduction problem reflects that it is difficult for innovators and implementers to reap the benefits of innovations that lower the cost of care. These problems are caused by weak financial incentives for value creation and cost reduction, professional and social norms that slow or deter innovation, and poorly functioning healthcare markets in which dominant firms can be sluggish innovators without fear of disruption from innovative new entrants.

10.1093/oso/9780197603109.003.0001.abstractZh: 健康领域的创新面临着价值创造问题和与之相关但不同的成本降低问题。价值创造问题的产生是因为经济价值较低的药品、设备和其他干预措施能够找到市场，而经济价值较高的干预措施则可能难以找到市场。成本降低问题的存在表明，创新者和实施者难以从降低医疗成本的创新中获益。这些问题是由于价值创造和成本降低的财务激励不足、阻碍创新的职业和社会规范，以及功能不佳的医疗保健市场所导致的，在这些市场中，主导企业可能会因担心被创新新进入者颠覆而缺乏创新动力。

abstract.text: This chapter considers incentives for innovation in the health sector, which all too often do not align with the creation of economic value. Consequently, valuable innovations, such as new classes of antibiotics and vaccines for infectious diseases, are underdeveloped while innovations of dubious value find a market. The chapter shows how this issue results in part from patents and their attendant pricing and timing distortions. These distortions skew innovation toward lower value targets. It goes on to discuss how these problems are accentuated in a reimbursement and policy environment that imposes no obligation or incentive on providers or regulators to consider economic value in their decisions.

10.1093/oso/9780197603109.003.0002.abstractZh: 本章探讨了健康领域创新的激励机制，这些机制往往与创造经济价值并不一致。因此，诸如新型抗生素和传染病疫苗等具有价值的创新成果未能得到充分发展，而一些价值存疑的创新则找到了市场。本章指出，这一问题部分源于专利制度及其带来的定价和时机上的扭曲。这些扭曲使得创新倾向于针对低价值目标。此外，本章还讨论了在报销和政策环境下，这些问题如何变得更加严重，因为这些环境并未对医疗服务提供者或监管机构施加任何义务或激励，以在决策中考虑经济价值。

abstract.text: In healthcare, innovations that reduce costs often “go missing.” New processes, business models, or managerial practices that lower the cost of care fail to take root and spread across the health sector. This chapter finds evidence for missing innovation in seven areas: pervasive fee-for-service payment contracts; regional practice styles; the long slow decline of small, single-specialty medical practices; adoption of information technologies; alternatives to insurance claims payment; slightly worse but much cheaper interventions; and investment in research investigating the relative benefits and costs of treatments. This list is by no means exhaustive, but it illustrates a pattern. Time and again, the healthcare sector overlooks cost-reducing opportunities lying in plain sight. The failure to exploit such opportunities influences the overall direction of innovation. If there is not a ready market for cost reduction, innovators will work on other problems.

10.1093/oso/9780197603109.003.0003.abstractZh: 在医疗保健领域，那些能够降低成本的创新往往“被忽视了”。那些能够降低护理成本的新流程、商业模式或管理实践未能在医疗行业中得到广泛推广。本章从七个方面发现了创新被忽视的现象：普遍存在的按服务收费支付合同；地区性的医疗实践风格；小型单一专科医疗诊所的缓慢衰落；信息技术的采用；替代保险索赔支付的方案；虽然效果稍差但成本更低的干预措施；以及对研究治疗方法的相对效益和成本进行投资。这份清单并不全面，但它揭示了一个现象：医疗行业一次又一次地忽视了显而易见的成本降低机会。未能利用这些机会会影响创新的整体方向。如果缺乏降低成本的潜在市场，创新者就会转向其他问题。

abstract.text: Most costs in healthcare are paid by third-party payers. However, providers and patients decide about the tests, drugs, and procedures that drive costs, and they do not consider the costs their decisions impose on payers. As the chapter shows, cost reduction, therefore, hinges on a challenging principal-agent relationship. Payers are the principal in this relationship. Providers are the agents who can further the payers’ interests by devoting effort and attention to finding ways to reduce costs. Agreements that reward providers for reducing costs—shared savings contracts—align the interests of both parties. The chapter goes on to show that shared savings contracts in healthcare suffer from three limitations that reduce their prevalence and power: common agency, capturing future returns, and free riding. As a result of these limitations, financial incentives for innovations that reduce healthcare costs are weak and sometimes non-existent.

10.1093/oso/9780197603109.003.0004.abstractZh: 在医疗保健领域，大部分费用由第三方支付机构承担。然而，决定哪些检查、药物和手术项目会推高费用的是医疗服务提供者和患者，他们并未考虑这些决策对支付机构造成的负担。正如本章所展示的，降低费用的关键在于一种具有挑战性的委托-代理关系。支付机构是这一关系中的委托人，而医疗服务提供者则是能够通过将努力和注意力投入到寻找降低费用的方法中来促进支付机构利益的代理人。那些为降低费用提供奖励的协议——即共享节约合同——能够平衡双方的利益。不过，本章还指出，医疗保健领域的共享节约合同存在三个限制因素，这些因素降低了其应用范围和效力：共同的代理问题、对未来收益的攫取以及搭便车行为。由于这些限制，用于推动降低医疗费用的创新的财务激励措施往往较弱，甚至有时根本不存在。

abstract.text: This chapter reviews professional and social norms, which together are a powerful force in healthcare. They influence behavior by introducing ethical duties and obligations into decision-making. These duties and obligations are enshrined in reinforcing social comparisons and narratives. It shows how cost-reducing innovations are most readily adopted when aligned with ethical commitments and implemented by organizations that prioritize healing over financial interests. Otherwise, cost reduction may be regarded as a morally repugnant exercise coming at the expense of the vulnerable and ill. This perception finds fertile ground in the United States because, as a society, we have yet to agree on the nature of healthcare. The chapter poses the question: Is healthcare a social good to which all are entitled, or is it a conventional private good? Without agreement on this question, the ethical duty to wisely manage limited healthcare resources is uncertain. Providers, patients, and the general public may greet cost-reducing innovations with indifference or contempt.

10.1093/oso/9780197603109.003.0005.abstractZh: 本章探讨了专业规范和社会规范在医疗保健领域所发挥的强大作用。这些规范通过将伦理责任和义务纳入决策过程来影响行为。这些责任和义务通过强化社会比较和叙事得以体现。研究表明，当成本降低的创新措施与伦理承诺相一致，并且由那些将患者康复置于经济利益之上的组织实施时，这些措施更容易被采纳。否则，成本降低可能会被视为一种道德上不可接受的行为，甚至会损害弱势群体的利益。这种观念在美国尤为普遍，因为作为一个社会，我们尚未就医疗保健的本质达成一致。本章提出了一个问题：医疗保健是一种所有人都应享有的社会福利，还是一种传统的私人商品？如果没有对这一问题的共识，那么合理管理有限的医疗资源的伦理责任就会变得不确定。医疗服务提供者、患者以及普通民众可能会对成本降低的创新措施持冷漠或鄙视的态度。

abstract.text: This chapter considers the diffusion of valuable innovations, which is often slow in healthcare. Even innovations recognized as potentially lifesaving can take many years until they are in general use. Competition often fails to force laggards to accelerate adoption. The chapter argues that dominant firms with market power are reluctant to innovate if transitioning to the new way of doing business is disruptive to ongoing operations. These switchover disruptions are endemic in healthcare. New entrants are blocked from upstaging slow-moving incumbents by high barriers to entry to healthcare markets. The result is a type of stagnation: innovations are welcomed only if they fit nicely with how incumbent firms already operate. It goes on to suggest that increasing demand for value-enhancing and cost-reducing innovations requires reducing the market power of incumbent firms and reducing switchover disruptions.

10.1093/oso/9780197603109.003.0006.abstractZh: 本章探讨了有价值创新的扩散过程，在医疗保健领域这种扩散通常较为缓慢。即便被认为是可能挽救生命的创新，也需要多年时间才能被广泛采用。竞争往往无法迫使落后者加快采用速度。本章指出，拥有市场力量的主导企业如果向新的商业模式转型会破坏现有运营，因此他们不愿进行创新。这种转型中断在医疗保健领域尤为普遍。由于进入壁垒过高，新进入者难以超越行动缓慢的现有企业。结果就是一种停滞状态：只有那些与现有企业现有运作方式相契合的创新才会受到欢迎。文章进一步指出，要增加对提升价值、降低成本的创新的需求，就需要减少现有企业的市场力量，并减少转型中断带来的阻碍。

abstract.text: This chapter considers healthcare innovation, which is too often disconnected from value creation and cost reduction. The reasons for this disconnect run deep, and its consequences for our society loom ever larger as healthcare expenditures take up a rising share of our national income. Connecting innovation to value creation and cost-reduction requires acting on multiple fronts. Incentives for value creation and cost reduction must be strengthened, while investments are made in a data infrastructure adequate to support innovators and implementers. The market power of entrenched incumbents must be reduced, through making markets more competitive. Finally, professional and social norms must be mobilized so that stewardship of scarce healthcare resources is seen as a way to heal patients and society.

10.1093/oso/9780197603109.003.0007.abstractZh: 本章探讨了医疗创新问题，而医疗创新往往与价值创造和成本降低脱节。这种脱节的原因根深蒂固，随着医疗支出在国民收入中的比例不断上升，其对社会的负面影响也日益严重。要将创新与价值创造和成本降低联系起来，需要从多个方面入手。必须加强促进价值创造和成本降低的激励机制，同时投资于能够支持创新者和实施者的数据基础设施。通过提高市场的竞争力，可以减少现有企业所拥有的市场力量。最后，必须动员专业和社会规范，使对稀缺医疗资源的合理管理被视为治愈患者和社会的一种方式。

abstract.text: We develop a novel bounded rationality model of imperfect reasoning as the interaction between automatic (System 1) and analytical (System 2) thinking. In doing so, we formalize the empirical consensus of cognitive psychology using a structural, constrained-optimal economic framework of mental information acquisition about the unknown optimal policy function. A key result is that agents reason less (more) when facing usual (unusual) states of the world, producing state- and history-dependent behavior. Our application is an otherwise standard incomplete-markets model with no a priori behavioral biases. The ergodic distribution of actions and beliefs is characterized by endogenous learning traps, where locally stable state dynamics generate familiar regions of the state space within which behavior appears to follow memory-based heuristics. This results in endogenous behavioral biases that have many empirically desirable properties: the marginal propensity to consume is high even for unconstrained agents, hand-to-mouth status is more frequent and persistent, and there is more wealth inequality than in the standard model.

10.1093/qje/qjac027.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个新颖的有界理性模型，用于描述不完美推理的过程，该模型将自动思维（系统1）与分析性思维（系统2）之间的互动进行了研究。通过这一模型，我们运用结构化的、约束最优的经济学框架，将认知心理学的实证共识形式化，从而对未知的最优策略函数进行心理信息获取。一个关键结论是：当面对常规或异常的世界状态时，代理人的推理行为会相应减少或增加，从而产生依赖于状态和历史的行为。我们的模型应用了一个标准的非完全市场模型，该模型没有先验的行为偏见。行动和信念的遍历分布具有内生学习陷阱的特征，局部稳定的状态动态会在状态空间中形成熟悉的区域，在这些区域内，行为似乎遵循基于记忆的启发式规则。这导致了内生行为偏见的产生，而这些偏见具有许多实际上的理想特性：即使对于不受约束的代理人来说，消费倾向仍然很高；手口状态更频繁且持久；财富不平等程度也比标准模型更高。

abstract.text: We demonstrate an important complementarity between patriotism and public-good provision. After 1933, the New Deal led to an unprecedented expansion of the U.S. federal government’s role. Those who benefited from social spending were markedly more patriotic during World War II: they bought more war bonds, volunteered more, and, as soldiers, won more medals. This pattern was new—World War I volunteering did not show the same geography of patriotism. We match military service records with the 1940 census to show that this pattern holds at the individual level. Using geographical variation, we exploit two instruments to suggest that the effect is causal: droughts and congressional committee representation predict more New Deal agricultural support, as well as bond buying, volunteering, and medals.

10.1093/qje/qjac028.abstractZh: 我们证明了爱国主义与公共物品供给之间存在着重要的互补性。1933年之后，新政导致美国联邦政府的角色出现了前所未有的扩张。在第二次世界大战期间，从社会支出中受益的人表现出更为强烈的爱国主义情感：他们购买更多的战争债券，参与更多的志愿活动，并且作为士兵赢得了更多的勋章。这种模式是新的——第一次世界大战时期的志愿活动并未表现出类似的爱国主义地理分布特征。我们将军事服务记录与1940年的人口普查数据进行匹配，发现这种模式在个体层面同样成立。通过利用地理差异，我们运用两种工具表明这种效应是因果关系：干旱情况以及国会委员会的代表性程度与新政提供的农业支持、债券购买、志愿活动以及勋章数量之间存在正相关关系。

abstract.text: We experimentally test several approaches to increasing the demand for workers with a criminal record on a nationwide staffing platform by addressing potential downside risk and productivity concerns. The staffing platform asked hiring managers to make a series of hypothetical hiring decisions that affected whether workers with a criminal record could accept their jobs in the future. We find that 39% of businesses in our sample are willing to work with individuals with a criminal record at baseline, which rises to over 50% when businesses are offered crime and safety insurance, a single performance review, or a limited background check covering just the past year. Wage subsidies can achieve similar increases but at a substantially higher cost. Based on our findings, the staffing platform relaxed the criminal background check requirement and offered crime and safety insurance to interested businesses.

10.1093/qje/qjac029.abstractZh: 我们通过实验测试了几种增加有犯罪记录工人需求的方法，这些测试在一个全国性的招聘平台上进行，同时考虑到了潜在的负面风险和生产力问题。该招聘平台要求招聘经理进行一系列假设性招聘决策，以评估有犯罪记录的人是否愿意接受未来的工作。我们发现，在我们样本中的企业中，有39%愿意在有犯罪记录的人参与招聘，而当企业获得犯罪和安全保险、一次绩效评估或仅涵盖过去一年的有限背景调查时，这一比例上升到50%以上。工资补贴也可以实现类似的增加，但成本要高得多。基于我们的研究结果，该招聘平台放宽了犯罪背景调查的要求，并为感兴趣的企业提供了犯罪和安全保险。

abstract.text: We develop a new data set to study asset specificity among nonfinancial firms. Our data cover the liquidation values of each category of assets on firms’ balance sheets and provides information across major industries. First, we find that nonfinancial firms have high asset specificity. For example, the liquidation value of fixed assets is 35% of the net book value in the average industry. Second, we analyze the determinants of asset specificity and document that assets’ physical attributes (e.g., mobility, durability, and customization) play a crucial role. Third, we investigate several implications. Consistent with theories of investment irreversibility, high asset specificity is associated with less disinvestment and stronger effects of uncertainty on investment activities. We also find that the increasing prevalence of intangible assets has not significantly reduced firms’ liquidation values.

10.1093/qje/qjac030.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个新的数据集，用于研究非金融企业的资产特定性。我们的数据涵盖了企业资产负债表上各类资产的清算价值，并提供了主要行业的信息。首先，我们发现非金融企业的资产特定性较高。例如，在平均行业中，固定资产的清算价值占其账面价值的35%。其次，我们分析了资产特定性的决定因素，并发现资产的物理属性（如移动性、耐用性和定制化）起着关键作用。第三，我们探讨了几个相关现象。与投资不可逆性的理论一致，高资产特定性与较少的投资撤回以及不确定性对投资活动的更强影响相关。我们还发现，无形资产的日益普及并没有显著降低企业的清算价值。

abstract.text: In many economic decisions, people estimate probabilities, such as the likelihood that a risk materializes or that a job applicant will be a productive employee, by retrieving experiences from memory. We model this process based on two established regularities of selective recall: similarity and interference. We show that the similarity structure of a hypothesis and the way it is described (not just its objective probability) shape the recall of experiences and thus probability assessments. The model accounts for and reconciles a variety of empirical findings, such as overestimation of unlikely events when these are cued versus neglect of noncued ones, the availability heuristic, the representativeness heuristic, conjunction and disjunction fallacies, and over- versus underreaction to information in different situations. The model yields several new predictions, for which we find strong experimental support.

10.1093/qje/qjac031.abstractZh: 在许多经济决策中，人们通过回忆过去的经历来估计概率，例如风险发生的可能性或求职者成为高效员工的可能性。我们基于选择性回忆的两个既定规律——相似性和干扰效应——来建模这一过程。我们发现，假设的结构以及其描述方式（而不仅仅是其客观概率）会影响对经历的回忆，从而影响概率的评估。该模型能够解释并调和多种实证发现，例如当某些不太可能发生的事件被提示时，人们会高估这些事件的概率，而忽略那些未被提示的事件；同时，该模型还解释了可用性启发式、代表性启发式、合取与析取谬误，以及在不同情况下对信息的过度或不足反应。该模型还提出了一些新的预测，并且我们发现了强有力的实验支持。

abstract.text: This article presents a new methodology to detect corruption in customs and applies it to Madagascar’s main port. Manipulation of assignment of import declarations to inspectors is identified by measuring deviations from random assignment prescribed by official rules. Deviant declarations are more at risk of tax evasion, yet less likely to be deemed fraudulent by inspectors, who also clear them faster. An intervention in which inspector assignment was delegated to a third party validates our approach, but also triggered a novel manifestation of manipulation that rejuvenated systemic corruption. Tax revenue losses associated with the corruption scheme are approximately 3% of total taxes collected and are highly concentrated among a select few inspectors and brokers.

10.1093/qje/qjac032.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种检测海关腐败的新方法，并将其应用于马达加斯加的主要港口。通过测量与官方规定随机分配规则的偏差，可以识别出将进口申报表分配给检查员的操纵行为。存在异常的申报表更容易引发逃税行为，但检查员不太可能认为它们是欺诈行为，同时检查员也能更快地处理这些申报表。将检查员分配任务委托给第三方的方法验证了我们的方法，但同时也引发了新的操纵行为，进一步加剧了系统性腐败。与腐败行为相关的税收损失约占总税收的3%，且主要集中在少数几个检查员和经纪人手中。

abstract.text: This article uses administrative tax data to estimate top wealth in the United States. We assemble new data that link people to their sources of capital income and develop new methods to estimate the degree of return heterogeneity within asset classes. Disaggregated fixed-income data reveal that rich individuals earn much more of their interest income in higher-yielding forms and have much greater exposure to credit risk. Consequently, in recent years, the interest rate on fixed income at the top is approximately 3.5 times higher than the average. We value the population of U.S. firms using firm-level characteristics and apportion this wealth using firm-owner links. We combine this new data on fixed income and pass-through business returns with refined estimates of C-corporation equity, housing, and pension wealth to deliver new capitalized wealth estimates that build upon the methods of Saez and Zucman (2016a). From 1989 to 2016, the top 1%, 0.1%, and 0.01% wealth shares increased by 6.6, 4.6, and 2.9 percentage points, respectively, to 33.7%, 15.7%, and 7.1%. Overall, although we estimate a large degree of return heterogeneity, accounting for this heterogeneity does not change the fundamental story for top wealth shares and their growth—wealth inequality is high and has risen substantially over recent decades.

10.1093/qje/qjac033.abstractZh: 本文利用行政税务数据来估算美国的顶级财富状况。我们收集了将人们与其资本收入来源联系起来的新数据，并开发了新的方法来计算不同资产类别内部的回报异质性。分解后的固定收益数据显示，富裕人士的利息收入主要以高收益形式获得，且面临更高的信用风险。因此，近年来，顶级人群的固定收益利率大约是平均水平的3.5倍。我们通过企业级特征来评估美国企业的财富，并通过企业所有者之间的联系来分配这些财富。我们将这些关于固定收益和间接商业回报的新数据与对C类公司股权、房地产和养老金财富的精细估算相结合，从而得出新的资本化财富估算结果，这些估算结果建立在Saez和Zucman（2016a）的方法基础上。从1989年到2016年，最顶层的1%、0.1%和0.01%的财富份额分别增加了6.6个百分点、4.6个百分点和2.9个百分点，分别达到了33.7%、15.7%和7.1%。总体而言，尽管我们估计了较高的回报异质性，但考虑这种异质性并不会改变顶级财富份额及其增长的基本趋势——财富不平等程度很高，并且在过去几十年中显著上升。

abstract.text: We evaluate the impact of a training program aimed at improving the relational atmosphere in the workplace. The program encourages prosocial behavior and the use of professional language, focusing primarily on leaders’ behavior and leader-subordinate interactions. We implement this program using a clustered randomized design involving over 3,000 headquarters employees of 20 large corporations in Turkey. We evaluate the program with respect to employee separation, pro- and antisocial behavior, the prevalence of support networks, and perceived workplace climate. We find that treated firms have a lower likelihood of employee separation at the leadership level, fewer employees lacking professional and personal help, and denser, less segregated support networks. We also find that employees in treated corporations are less inclined to engage in toxic competition, exhibit higher reciprocity toward each other, and report higher workplace satisfaction and a more collegial environment. The program’s success in improving leader-subordinate relationships emerges as a likely mechanism to explain these results. Treated subordinates report higher professionalism and empathy in their leaders and are more likely to consider their leaders as professional support providers.

10.1093/qje/qjac034.abstractZh: 我们评估了一项旨在改善职场关系氛围的培训计划的影响。该计划鼓励亲社会行为和使用专业语言，主要聚焦于领导者的行为以及领导者与下属之间的互动。我们采用集群随机设计对土耳其20家大型企业的3000多名总部员工实施了该计划。我们通过员工离职率、亲社会与反社会行为、支持网络的普及程度以及感知的职场氛围来评估该计划的效果。研究发现，接受该计划的公司中，领导层离职的可能性较低，缺乏专业和个人帮助的员工数量较少，支持网络更为密集且较少出现隔离现象。此外，接受该计划的员工较少参与恶性竞争，彼此之间的互惠程度更高，并且报告称工作满意度更高，职场氛围更为和谐。该计划在改善领导者与下属关系方面的成功，被认为是解释这些结果的一个可能机制。接受该计划的下属认为他们的领导者更具专业性和同理心，并且更有可能将领导者视为专业支持提供者。

abstract.text: The economic analysis of racial discrimination in public accommodations is remarkably limited. To study this issue, we construct a national data set of nondiscriminatory establishments from the Negro Motorist Green Books, a travel guide published from 1936 to 1966 to aid Black Americans in finding nondiscriminatory retail and service establishments. We document patterns in the geographic spread and evolution of Green Book establishments, as well as the correlates of Green Book presence. We find that economic and social measures, as well as state laws relating to racial discrimination and antidiscrimination, were correlated with the provision of nondiscriminatory services. We then use the Green Book data to test whether market conditions and white consumer discrimination led businesses to bar Black customers prior to the Civil Rights Act of 1964. We use plausibly exogenous variation from white World War II casualties and Black migration patterns to isolate the effect of a change in the racial composition of consumers on the growth of nondiscriminatory businesses. We find that the share of nondiscriminatory establishments grew faster in locations with larger increases in the share of the Black population, but the magnitudes were small. These results highlight the importance of federal legislation in ending racial discrimination in public accommodations.

10.1093/qje/qjac035.abstractZh: 关于公共场合种族歧视的经济分析非常有限。为了研究这一问题，我们构建了一个全国性的数据集，该数据集包含了《黑人司机指南》中列出的非歧视性商业场所。该指南是1936年至1966年间出版的旅行指南，旨在帮助美国黑人找到非歧视性的零售和服务场所。我们记录了《黑人司机指南》中商业场所在地理分布上的变化，以及其存在的关联因素。我们发现，经济和社会指标，以及与种族歧视和反歧视相关的州法律，与非歧视性服务的提供之间存在相关性。接着，我们利用《黑人司机指南》的数据来测试市场条件和白人消费者的歧视是否导致企业在1964年民权法案之前拒绝接纳黑人顾客。我们通过人为设定的变化，比如白人二战伤亡人数和黑人迁移模式，来研究消费者种族构成的变化对非歧视性商业场所增长的影响。我们发现，在黑人人口比例增加的地区，非歧视性商业场所的增长速度更快，但增幅较小。这些结果凸显了联邦立法在消除公共场合种族歧视方面的重要性。

abstract.text: We use admissions lotteries to estimate the effects of large-scale public preschool in Boston on college-going, college preparation, standardized test scores, and behavioral outcomes. Preschool enrollment boosts college attendance as well as SAT test taking and high school graduation. Preschool also decreases high school disciplinary measures including juvenile incarceration, but has no detectable effect on state achievement test scores. An analysis of subgroups shows that effects on college enrollment, SAT-taking, and disciplinary outcomes are larger for boys than for girls. Our findings illustrate possibilities for large-scale modern, public preschool and highlight the importance of measuring long-term and non–test score outcomes in evaluating the effectiveness of education programs.

10.1093/qje/qjac036.abstractZh: 我们使用入学抽签法来估计波士顿大规模公共学前教育对大学生入学率、大学准备程度、标准化考试成绩以及行为结果的影响。学前教育有助于提高大学生入学率、SAT考试参与率以及高中毕业率。此外，学前教育还能减少高中期间的纪律处分，但并未对州级学业测试成绩产生显著影响。对子群体的分析表明，对大学生入学率、SAT考试参与率以及纪律结果的影响在男孩中比女孩更为显著。我们的研究结果揭示了大规模现代公共学前教育的可能性，并强调了在评估教育项目的有效性时，衡量长期和非考试成绩结果的重要性。

abstract.text: Can political rallies affect the behavior of law enforcement officers toward racial minorities? Using data from 35 million traffic stops, we show that the probability that a stopped driver is Black increases by 5.74% after a Trump rally during his 2015–2016 campaign. The effect is immediate, specific to Black drivers, lasts for up to 60 days after the rally, and is not justified by changes in driver behavior. The effects are significantly larger among law enforcement officers whose estimated racial bias is higher at baseline, in areas that score higher on present-day measures of racial resentment, those that experienced more racial violence during the Jim Crow era, and in former slave-holding counties. Mentions of racial issues in Trump speeches, whether explicit or implicit, exacerbate the effect of a Trump rally among officers with higher estimated racial bias.

10.1093/qje/qjac037.abstractZh: 政治集会是否会影响执法人员对少数族裔的行为？通过3500万次交通拦截的数据分析，我们发现，在特朗普2015-2016年竞选期间举行集会后，被拦截的司机中，是黑人的概率增加了5.74%。这种影响是立即发生的，仅针对黑人司机，并且在集会结束后持续长达60天，且并未因司机行为的改变而减弱。在那些执法人员的种族偏见基线较高、当前种族怨恨程度较高的地区、在吉姆·克劳时代经历过更多种族暴力的地区，以及在前奴隶制县，这种影响更为显著。特朗普演讲中提及种族问题，无论是明示还是暗示，都会加剧具有较高种族偏见执法人员的这种影响。

abstract.text: Clustered standard errors, with clusters defined by factors such as geography, are widespread in empirical research in economics and many other disciplines. Formally, clustered standard errors adjust for the correlations induced by sampling the outcome variable from a data-generating process with unobserved cluster-level components. However, the standard econometric framework for clustering leaves important questions unanswered: (i) Why do we adjust standard errors for clustering in some ways but not others, for example, by state but not by gender, and in observational studies but not in completely randomized experiments? (ii) Is the clustered variance estimator valid if we observe a large fraction of the clusters in the population? (iii) In what settings does the choice of whether and how to cluster make a difference? We address these and other questions using a novel framework for clustered inference on average treatment effects. In addition to the common sampling component, the new framework incorporates a design component that accounts for the variability induced on the estimator by the treatment assignment mechanism. We show that, when the number of clusters in the sample is a nonnegligible fraction of the number of clusters in the population, conventional clustered standard errors can be severely inflated, and propose new variance estimators that correct for this bias.

10.1093/qje/qjac038.abstractZh: 在经济学及许多其他学科的实证研究中，基于地理等因素定义的聚类标准误差非常常见。从形式上讲，聚类标准误差旨在调整因从具有未观测聚类级成分的数据生成过程中抽取结果变量而产生的相关性。然而，标准的计量经济学框架在聚类问题上仍留下重要问题未解答：(i) 为什么我们在某些情况下调整标准误差以考虑聚类，而在其他情况下则不予考虑？例如，是否应该按州而非性别进行调整，在观察性研究中是否应该如此，而在完全随机化实验中则不然？(ii) 如果我们观察到人群中很大一部分聚类，那么聚类方差估计器是否有效？(iii) 在什么情况下，选择是否以及如何进行聚类会产生影响？我们采用一种新颖的框架来解决这些问题，该框架用于聚类推断平均处理效应。除了常见的抽样成分外，新框架还包含了一个设计成分，用于解释处理分配机制对估计器产生的变异影响。我们表明，当样本中的聚类数量占人群中的聚类总数的相当大比例时，传统的聚类标准误差可能会严重膨胀，并提出了新的方差估计器来纠正这种偏差。

abstract.text: This article studies how innovation reacts to climate change and shapes its economic impacts, focusing on U.S. agriculture. We show in a model that directed innovation can either mitigate or exacerbate climate change’s potential economic damage depending on the substitutability between new technology and favorable climatic conditions. To empirically investigate the technological response to climate change, we measure crop-specific exposure to damaging extreme temperatures and crop-specific innovation embodied in new variety releases and patents. We find that innovation has redirected since the mid-twentieth century toward crops with increasing exposure to extreme temperatures. Moreover, this effect is driven by types of agricultural technology most related to environmental adaptation. We next show that U.S. counties’ exposure to induced innovation significantly dampens the local economic damage from extreme temperatures. Combining these estimates with the model, we find that directed innovation has offset 20% of potential losses in U.S. agricultural land value due to damaging climate trends since 1960 and that innovation could offset 13% of projected damage by 2100. These findings highlight the vital importance, but incomplete effectiveness, of endogenous technological change as a source of adaptation to climate change.

10.1093/qje/qjac039.abstractZh: 本文研究了创新如何应对气候变化并影响其经济影响，重点关注美国农业领域。我们的模型表明，有导向性的创新可能会减轻或加剧气候变化带来的潜在经济损害，这取决于新技术与有利气候条件之间的替代性。为了实证研究技术对气候变化的响应，我们测量了特定作物对极端温度的暴露程度，以及体现在新品种发布和专利中的创新成果。我们发现，自20世纪中叶以来，创新方向逐渐转向那些面临更高极端温度风险的作物。此外，这种效应主要由与环境适应性最相关的农业技术类型所驱动。我们进一步发现，美国各县的创新活动显著减轻了极端温度对当地经济的损害。结合模型分析，我们发现有导向性的创新自1960年以来已抵消了因气候恶化而导致的美国农业土地价值损失中的20%，并且到2100年，创新可能再抵消13%的潜在损失。这些发现凸显了内生性技术变革作为适应气候变化手段的重要性，同时也揭示了其效果的不完全性。

abstract.text: There are three prevailing theories of mortgage default: strategic default (driven by negative equity), cash flow default (driven by negative life events), and double-trigger default (where both negative triggers are necessary). It has been difficult to compare these theories in part because negative life events are measured with error. We address this measurement error using a comparison group of borrowers with no strategic-default motive. Our central finding is that only 6% of underwater defaults are caused exclusively by negative equity, an order of magnitude lower than previously thought. We then analyze the remaining defaults. We find that 70% are driven solely by negative life events (i.e., cash flow defaults), while 24% are driven by the interaction between negative life events and negative equity (i.e., double-trigger defaults). Together, the results provide a full decomposition of the theories underlying borrower default and suggest that negative life events play a central role.

10.1093/qje/qjac040.abstractZh: 目前有三种关于抵押贷款违约的理论：战略性违约（由负资产驱动）、现金流违约（由负面生活事件驱动）以及双重触发违约（需要同时出现负面触发因素）。由于负面生活事件的测量存在误差，这些理论之间的比较一直比较困难。我们通过使用没有战略性违约动机的借款者作为对照组来解决这一测量误差问题。我们的核心发现是，只有6%的负资产违约完全是由负资产引起的，这一比例远低于之前的估计。然后，我们分析了剩余的违约情况。我们发现，70%的违约仅由负面生活事件引起（即现金流违约），而24%的违约则是负面生活事件与负资产相互作用的结果（即双重触发违约）。总的来说，这些结果全面揭示了借款者违约背后的理论机制，并表明负面生活事件在违约中起着核心作用。

abstract.text: Scholars have argued that powerful individuals can exert influence on the path of a nation’s development. Yet the process through which people can have an effect on macro-level political economy outcomes remains unclear. This study uses the deadliest civil war in modern history, the Taiping Rebellion (1850–1864), to elucidate how one person—Zeng Guofan—used his personal elite networks to organize an army to suppress the rebellion, and how these networks would affect the nation’s power distribution. Two findings stand out: (i) counties that already had more prewar elites in Zeng’s networks experienced an increase in soldier deaths after he took power; and (ii) postwar political power shifted significantly toward the home counties of these elites, creating a less balanced national-level power distribution. Our findings highlight how micro-level elite networks can influence national politics and societal power distribution, shedding new light on the relationship between elites, war, and the state.

10.1093/qje/qjac041.abstractZh: 学者们认为，有权势的个人能够影响一个国家的发展路径。然而，人们如何对宏观层面的政治经济结果产生影响的过程仍不清楚。本研究以现代历史上最致命的内战——太平天国起义（1850-1864年）为案例，探讨了一个人——曾国藩——如何利用他的精英网络组织军队镇压起义，以及这些网络如何影响了国家的权力分配。有两个发现尤为突出：(i) 在曾国藩掌权后，那些在战前已有更多精英的县，士兵死亡人数有所增加；(ii) 战后政治权力显著地向这些精英的家乡县转移，导致国家层面的权力分配更加不平衡。我们的研究揭示了微观层面的精英网络如何影响国家政治和社会权力分配，为精英、战争与国家之间的关系提供了新的见解。

abstract.text: We present a unified treatment of how welfare responds to changes in budget sets or technologies with taste shocks and nonhomothetic preferences. We propose a welfare metric that ranks production possibility frontiers that differs from one that ranks budget sets and characterize it using a general equilibrium generalization of Hicksian demand. This extends Hulten’s theorem, the basis for constructing aggregate quantity indices, to environments with nonhomothetic and unstable preferences. We illustrate our results using both long- and short-run applications. In the long run, we show that if structural transformation is caused by income effects or changes in tastes, rather than substitution effects, then Baumol’s cost disease is twice as important for our preferred measure of welfare. In the short run, we show that standard chain-weighted deflators understate welfare-relevant inflation for current tastes. Finally, using the COVID-19 recession, we illustrate that chain-weighted real consumption and real GDP are unreliable metrics for measuring welfare or production when there are taste shocks.

10.1093/qje/qjac042.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种统一的方法，用于分析福利如何响应预算集或技术的变化，同时考虑口味冲击和非齐次偏好。我们提出了一种福利度量标准，该标准对生产可能性边界进行排名，这与传统的预算集排名方式不同。我们采用霍克西需求的一般均衡概念来描述这一度量标准。这扩展了Hulten定理的应用范围，该定理是构建总量指标的基础，适用于非齐次且不稳定的偏好环境。我们通过长期和短期的案例来说明我们的研究结果。在长期分析中，我们发现，如果结构转变是由收入效应或口味变化引起的，而不是替代效应，那么Baumol的成本病理论对于我们的福利度量标准来说更为重要。在短期分析中，我们发现标准链加权通货膨胀指标对于反映当前口味需求的福利指标来说有所低估。最后，通过COVID-19经济衰退的案例，我们表明，在存在口味冲击的情况下，链加权实际消费和实际GDP并不能可靠地衡量福利或生产情况。

abstract.text: We argue that modeling trade imbalances is crucial for understanding transitional dynamics in response to globalization shocks. We build and estimate a general equilibrium, multicountry, multisector model of trade with two key ingredients: (i) endogenous trade imbalances arising from households’ consumption and saving decisions; (ii) labor market frictions across and within sectors. We use our model to perform several empirical exercises. We find that the “China shock” accounted for 28% of the decline in U.S. manufacturing between 2000 and 2014—1.65 times the magnitude predicted from a model imposing balanced trade. A concurrent rise in U.S. service employment led to a negligible aggregate unemployment response. We benchmark our model’s predictions for the gains from trade against the popular ACR sufficient-statistics approach. We find that our predictions for the long-run gains from trade and consumption dynamics significantly diverge.

10.1093/qje/qjac043.abstractZh: 我们认为，对贸易失衡进行建模对于理解全球化冲击下的转型动态至关重要。我们构建并估计了一个通用均衡的多国多部门贸易模型，该模型包含两个关键要素：(i) 由家庭消费和储蓄决策引起的内生性贸易失衡；(ii) 不同部门之间及部门内部的劳动力市场摩擦。我们使用该模型进行了多项实证分析。研究发现，“中国冲击”导致了2000年至2014年间美国制造业的下降，这一影响占整体下降幅度的28%，是假设贸易平衡模型的预测值的1.65倍。与此同时，美国服务行业的就业增长导致总体失业率几乎没有变化。我们将该模型的预测结果与流行的ACR充分统计量方法进行了对比。研究发现，我们对贸易和消费动态带来的长期收益的预测与现有方法存在显著差异。

abstract.text: We study time-consistent bank resolution mechanisms. The key constraint is that governments cannot avoid bailouts that are ex post efficient. Contrary to common wisdom, we show that the government may still avoid moral hazard and implement the first-best allocation by using the distribution of bailouts across banks to provide incentives. We analyze properties of credible tournament mechanisms that provide support to the best-performing banks and resolve the worst-performing ones. We extend our mechanism and show that it continues to perform well when banks are imperfect substitutes, when they are differentially interconnected as long as bailout funds can be earmarked, and when their risk-taking is driven by overoptimism instead of moral hazard.

10.1093/qje/qjac044.abstractZh: 我们研究了时间一致的银行解决方案机制。关键的限制是，政府无法避免那些事后有效的救助措施。与普遍观点相反，我们表明政府仍然可以通过利用救助资金在银行之间分配来避免道德风险，并实现最优分配。我们分析了可信的锦标赛机制的特性，这些机制能够支持表现最好的银行，并解决表现最差的银行问题。我们进一步扩展了我们的机制，并表明当银行是 imperfect 替代品、当它们之间存在差异性联系、以及当救助资金可以专门指定时，该机制仍然能够表现良好。此外，当银行的风险承担是由过度乐观而非道德风险驱动时，该机制同样能够表现良好。

abstract.text: We study learning via shared news. Each period agents receive the same quantity and quality of firsthand information and can share it with friends. Some friends (possibly few) share selectively, generating heterogeneous news diets across agents. Agents are aware of selective sharing and update beliefs by Bayes’s rule. Contrary to standard learning results, we show that beliefs can diverge in this environment, leading to polarization. This requires that (i) agents hold misperceptions (even minor) about friends’ sharing and (ii) information quality is sufficiently low. Polarization can worsen when agents’ friend networks expand. When the quantity of firsthand information becomes large, agents can hold opposite extreme beliefs, resulting in severe polarization. We find that news aggregators can curb polarization caused by news sharing. Our results hold without media bias or fake news, so eliminating these is not sufficient to reduce polarization. When fake news is included, it can lead to polarization but only through misperceived selective sharing. We apply our theory to shed light on the polarization of public opinion about climate change in the United States.

10.1093/qje/qjac045.abstractZh: 我们研究了通过共享新闻进行学习的过程。每个时期，代理人都会接收到相同数量和质量的第一手信息，并可以将其分享给朋友。部分朋友（可能只有少数）会选择性地分享信息，导致代理人之间的新闻信息分布出现差异。代理人了解这种选择性分享行为，并通过贝叶斯规则更新自己的信念。与标准学习结果不同，我们发现在这种环境下，信念可能会出现分歧，从而导致两极分化。这需要满足两个条件：(i) 代理人对朋友的分享行为存在误解（即使是很小的误解）；(ii) 信息质量足够低。当代理人的朋友网络扩大时，两极分化可能会加剧。当第一手信息的数量增加时，代理人可能会持有完全相反的极端信念，从而导致严重的两极分化。我们发现，新闻聚合器可以抑制由新闻分享引起的两极分化。我们的研究结果不受媒体偏见或假新闻的影响，因此消除这些因素并不能有效减少两极分化。当包含假新闻时，假新闻可能会导致两极分化，但仅限于由于误解的选择性分享而产生的两极分化。我们将我们的理论应用于分析美国公众对气候变化观点的两极分化现象。

abstract.text: This article studies how federal funding affects the innovation outputs of university researchers. We link person-level research grants from 22 universities to patents, publications, and career outcomes from the U.S. Census Bureau. We focus on the effects of large, idiosyncratic, and temporary cuts to federal funding in a researcher’s preexisting narrow field of study. Using an event study design, we document that these negative federal funding shocks reduce high-tech entrepreneurship and publications but increase patenting. The lost publications tend to be higher quality and more basic, whereas the additional patents tend to be lower quality, less general, and more often privately assigned. These federal funding cuts lead to an increase in private funding, which partially compensates for the decline in federal funding. Together with evidence from industry-university contracts, the results suggest that federal funding cuts shift university research funding from federal to private sources and lead to innovation outputs that are less openly accessible and more often appropriated by corporate funders.

10.1093/qje/qjac046.abstractZh: 本文研究联邦资金对大学研究人员创新成果的影响。我们将22所大学的研究人员个人级研究资助与专利、出版物以及美国人口普查局的职业成果进行了关联分析。研究重点关注在研究人员现有狭窄研究领域内，由于联邦资金大幅、特殊且临时性的削减所产生的影响。通过事件研究设计，我们发现这些负面的联邦资金冲击会降低高科技创业活动和出版物数量，但会增加专利申请数量。被损失的出版物往往质量更高、基础更扎实，而新增的专利则质量较低、适用范围较窄，且更常由私人机构持有。这些联邦资金削减导致私人资金的增加，部分弥补了联邦资金的减少。结合行业与大学合作合同的证据，研究结果表明，联邦资金削减使得大学的研究资金从联邦转向私人来源，从而导致创新成果更难被公开获取，且更常被企业资助者所占用。

abstract.text: How does wealth taxation differ from capital income taxation? When the return on investment is equal across individuals, a well-known result is that the two tax systems are equivalent. Motivated by recent empirical evidence documenting persistent return heterogeneity, we revisit this question. With heterogeneity, the two tax systems typically have opposite implications for efficiency and inequality. Under capital income taxation, entrepreneurs who are more productive and therefore generate more income pay higher taxes. Under wealth taxation, entrepreneurs who have similar wealth levels pay similar taxes regardless of their productivity, which expands the tax base, shifts the tax burden toward unproductive entrepreneurs, and raises the savings rate of productive ones. This reallocation increases aggregate productivity and output. In the simulated model parameterized to match the U.S. data, replacing the capital income tax with a wealth tax in a revenue-neutral way delivers a significantly higher average welfare. Turning to optimal taxation, the optimal wealth tax (OWT) is positive and yields large welfare gains by raising efficiency and lowering inequality. In contrast, the optimal capital income tax (OKIT) is negative—a subsidy—and delivers lower welfare gains than OWT, owing to the welfare losses from higher inequality. Furthermore, when the transition path is considered, the gains from OKIT turn into significant welfare losses for existing cohorts, whereas OWT continues to deliver robust welfare gains. These results suggest that moderate wealth taxation may be a more appealing alternative than capital income taxation, which can be significantly more distorting under return heterogeneity than under the equal-returns assumption.

10.1093/qje/qjac047.abstractZh: 财富税与资本收入税有何不同？当个体之间的投资回报相等时，一个众所周知的结果是这两种税收制度是等效的。鉴于近期实证证据显示投资回报存在持续性差异，我们重新审视了这个问题。在回报存在差异的情况下，这两种税收制度通常对效率和不平等的影响方向相反。在资本收入税制度下，生产力更高的企业家会支付更高的税款，因为他们创造了更多的收入。而在财富税制度下，无论生产力如何，财富水平相似的企业家都会支付相同的税款，这扩大了税收基础，将税收负担转移到非生产性企业家身上，同时提高了生产性企业家的储蓄率。这种重新分配增加了总体生产力和产出。在模拟模型中，通过以收入中性方式用财富税替代资本收入税，可以显著提升平均福利水平。从最优税收的角度来看，最优财富税具有正效应，通过提高效率和降低不平等来带来较大的福利增益。相比之下，最优资本收入税则具有负效应——实际上是一种补贴——由于不平等加剧带来的福利损失，其福利增益低于最优财富税。此外，当考虑过渡路径时，资本收入税的增益对于现有群体来说会变成显著的福利损失，而最优财富税则继续带来显著的福利增益。这些结果表明，适度的财富税可能比资本收入税更具吸引力，因为在回报存在差异的情况下，资本收入税可能比在平等回报假设下产生更大的扭曲效应。

abstract.text: We estimate the push and pull factors involved in the outmigration of Jews facing persecution in Nazi Germany from 1933 to 1941. Our empirical investigation makes use of a unique individual-level data set that records the migration history of the Jewish community in Germany over the period. Our analysis highlights new channels, specific to violent contexts, through which social networks affect the decision to flee. We estimate a structural model of migration where individuals base their migration decision on the observation of persecution and migration among their peers. Identification rests on exogenous variations in local push and pull factors across peers who live in different cities of residence. Then we perform various experiments of counterfactual history to quantify how migration restrictions in destination countries affected the fate of Jews. For example, removing work restrictions for refugees in the recipient countries after the Nuremberg Laws (1935) would have led to an increase in Jewish migration out of Germany in the range of 12% to 20% and a reduction in mortality due to prevented deportations in the range of 6% to 10%.

10.1093/qje/qjad001.abstractZh: 我们估算了1933年至1941年间，在纳粹德国面临迫害的犹太人向外迁移所涉及的推动因素和拉力因素。我们的实证研究使用了独特的个体级数据集，该数据集记录了德国犹太社区在该时期的迁移历史。我们的分析指出了在暴力背景下，社会网络影响人们逃离决策的新途径。我们建立了一个迁移结构模型，其中个体根据同龄人中的迫害和迁移情况来决定迁移决策。识别过程基于不同居住城市中的同龄人之间当地推动因素和拉力因素的外部差异。随后，我们进行了各种反事实历史实验，以量化目的地国家的迁移限制对犹太人命运的影响。例如，在《纽伦堡法案》（1935年）之后，如果取消接收国对难民的工作限制，将导致犹太人从德国的迁移数量增加12%至20%，并且因防止驱逐而导致的死亡人数减少6%至10%。

abstract.text: We use two-round survey data from 62 elections in 10 countries since 1952 to study the formation of vote choice, beliefs, and policy preferences and assess how televised debates contribute to this process. Our data include 253,000 observations. We compare the consistency between vote intention and vote choice of respondents surveyed at different points before, and then again after, the election, and show that 17% to 29% of voters make up their mind during the final two months of campaigns. Changes in vote choice are concomitant to shifts in issues voters find most important and in beliefs about candidates, and they generate sizable swings in vote shares. In contrast, policy preferences remain remarkably stable throughout the campaign. Finally, we use an event study to estimate the impact of TV debates, in which candidates themselves communicate with voters, and of shocks such as natural and technological disasters which, by contrast, occur independently from the campaign. We do not find any effect of either type of event on vote choice formation, suggesting that information received throughout the campaign from other sources such as the media, political activists, and other citizens is more impactful.

10.1093/qje/qjad002.abstractZh: 我们使用了1952年以来10个国家62场选举的两轮调查数据，来研究选民选择、信念和政策偏好的形成过程，并评估电视辩论对这一过程的影响。我们的数据包含253,000个观察记录。我们比较了不同时间点受访者的投票意向与投票选择的一致性，发现在竞选的最后两个月内，有17%到29%的选民做出了决定。选民选择的变化与他们认为最重要的问题以及他们对候选人的看法有关，这些变化会导致投票份额出现显著波动。相比之下，政策偏好在整个竞选过程中保持相对稳定。最后，我们通过事件研究来估计电视辩论的影响，即候选人直接与选民交流的情况，以及诸如自然灾害和技术灾难等突发事件的影响。我们发现这两种事件对选民选择的形成都没有显著影响，这表明在整个竞选过程中，来自媒体、政治活动人士和其他公民的信息对选民选择的影响更为显著。

abstract.text: Patterns of state formation have crucial implications for comparative economic development. Diamond (1997) famously argued that “fractured land” was responsible for China’s tendency toward political unification and Europe’s protracted polycentrism. We build a dynamic model with granular geographical information in terms of topographical features and the location of productive agricultural land to quantitatively gauge the effects of fractured land on state formation in Eurasia. We find that topography alone is sufficient but not necessary to explain polycentrism in Europe and unification in China. Differences in land productivity, in particular the existence of a core region of high land productivity in northern China, deliver the same result. We discuss how our results map into observed historical outcomes, assess how robust our findings are, and analyze the differences between theory and data in Africa and the Americas.

10.1093/qje/qjad003.abstractZh: 国家形成的模式对比较经济发展具有至关重要的影响。戴蒙德（1997）提出，“破碎的土地”是中国走向政治统一的原因，而欧洲的长期多中心化现象则源于同样的原因。我们构建了一个动态模型，该模型包含详细的地理信息，包括地形特征以及农业生产用地的位置，以定量评估破碎土地对欧亚地区国家形成的影响。研究发现，仅地形因素就足以解释欧洲的多元中心化现象以及中国的政治统一，但这是必要条件而非充分条件。土地生产率的差异，尤其是中国北方存在一个高生产率的核心区域，同样能够解释这些现象。我们探讨了这些结果如何与历史现实相吻合，评估了研究结果的稳健性，并分析了非洲和美洲在理论与数据之间的差异。

abstract.text: Market power of intermediaries contributes to the low incomes of farmers in India. I study the role of spatial competition between intermediaries in determining the prices that farmers receive in India by focusing on a law that restricts farmers to selling their goods to intermediaries in their own state. I show that the discontinuities in market power generated by the law translate into discontinuities in prices. Increasing spatial competition by one standard deviation causes prices received by farmers to increase by 6.4%. I propose and estimate a quantitative spatial model of bargaining and trade to shed light on spatial and aggregate implications. Estimates from the structural model suggest that removing the interstate trade restriction in India would increase competition between intermediaries. Thereby average farmer prices and their output would increase by at least 11% and 7%, respectively. The value of the national crop output would increase by at least 18%. However, there are distributional consequences as well, as some farmers stand to lose due to increased local production.

10.1093/qje/qjad004.abstractZh: 中间商的市场力量导致印度农民的收入较低。我研究了中间商之间的空间竞争在决定农民收入中的作用，重点关注一项限制农民只能在本州内向中间商销售产品的法律。研究表明，该法律产生的市场力量不稳定性会转化为价格的不稳定性。空间竞争增加一个标准差会导致农民获得的收入增加6.4%。我提出并估计了一个关于谈判和贸易的定量空间模型，以揭示空间和总体层面的影响。结构模型的估计表明，取消印度的州际贸易限制将增加中间商之间的竞争。因此，农民的平均价格和产量将分别增加至少11%和7%。全国农作物产量也将增加至少18%。然而，这也带来了分配上的后果，因为一些农民可能会因本地生产的增加而遭受损失。

abstract.text: Communities across the United States are reconsidering the public safety benefits of prosecuting nonviolent misdemeanor offenses, yet there is little empirical evidence to inform policy in this area. We report the first estimates of the causal effects of misdemeanor prosecution on defendants’ subsequent criminal justice involvement. We leverage the as-if random assignment of nonviolent misdemeanor cases to assistant district attorneys (ADAs) who decide whether a case should be prosecuted in the Suffolk County District Attorney’s Office in Massachusetts. These ADAs vary in the average leniency of their prosecution decisions. We find that for the marginal defendant, nonprosecution of a nonviolent misdemeanor offense leads to a 53% reduction in the likelihood of a new criminal complaint and a 60% reduction in the number of new criminal complaints over the next two years. These local average treatment effects are largest for defendants without prior criminal records, suggesting that averting criminal record acquisition is an important mechanism driving our findings. We also present evidence that a recent policy change in Suffolk County imposing a presumption of nonprosecution for nonviolent misdemeanor offenses had similar beneficial effects, decreasing the likelihood of subsequent criminal justice involvement.
