10.1093/qje/qjad005.abstractZh: 美国各地的社区正在重新考虑对非暴力轻罪行为进行起诉对公共安全的益处，然而，在这一领域几乎没有实证证据来指导政策。我们首次估算了轻罪起诉对被告后续刑事司法参与行为的因果效应。我们利用了非暴力轻罪案件被随机分配给助理地方检察官的试验设计，这些助理地方检察官负责决定在马萨诸塞州萨福克县地方检察官办公室是否应起诉某一案件。这些助理地方检察官在起诉决策上的平均宽容程度有所不同。我们发现，对于边际被告而言，不起诉非暴力轻罪行为会使在未来两年内新的刑事投诉发生的可能性降低53%，新的刑事投诉数量也减少60%。这些局部的平均处理效应在没有犯罪记录的被告中最为显著，这表明避免获得犯罪记录是驱动我们研究结果的一个重要机制。我们还提供了证据，表明萨福克县最近的一项政策变化——对非暴力轻罪行为实行不起诉的推定——也产生了类似的积极效果，降低了后续刑事司法参与的可能性。

abstract.text: Reducing the emissions of greenhouse gases may be almost impossible without a green transition—a substantial transformation of consumption and production patterns. To study such transitions, we propose a dynamic model, which differs from the common approach in economics in two ways. First, consumption patterns reflect not just changing prices and taxes, but changing values. Transitions of values and technologies create a dynamic complementarity that can help or hinder a green transition. Second, and unlike fictitious social planners, policy makers in democratic societies cannot commit to future policy paths, as they are subject to regular elections. We show that market failures and government failures can interact to prevent a welfare-increasing green transition from materializing or make an ongoing green transition too slow.

10.1093/qje/qjad006.abstractZh: 如果不进行绿色转型——即对消费和生产模式进行重大变革，那么减少温室气体排放几乎是不可能的。为了研究这种转型，我们提出了一个动态模型，该模型在两个方面不同于经济学中的常见方法。首先，消费模式不仅反映了价格和税收的变化，还反映了价值观的变化。价值观和技术的转变会产生一种动态互补性，这种互补性可能有助于或阻碍绿色转型的实现。其次，与虚构的社会规划者不同，民主社会中的政策制定者由于受到定期选举的影响，无法承诺未来的政策路径。我们指出，市场失灵和政府失灵可能会相互作用，导致能够提升福利的绿色转型无法实现，或者使正在进行的绿色转型进展过于缓慢。

abstract.text: Dissent plays an important role in any society, but dissenters are often silenced through social sanctions. Beyond their persuasive effects, rationales providing arguments supporting dissenters’ causes can increase the public expression of dissent by providing a “social cover” for voicing otherwise stigmatized positions. Motivated by a simple theoretical framework, we experimentally show that liberals are more willing to post a tweet opposing the movement to defund the police, are seen as less prejudiced, and face lower social sanctions when their tweet implies they had first read credible scientific evidence supporting their position. Analogous experiments with conservatives demonstrate that the same mechanisms facilitate anti-immigrant expression. Our findings highlight both the power of rationales and their limitations in enabling dissent and shed light on phenomena such as social movements, political correctness, propaganda, and antiminority behavior.

10.1093/qje/qjad007.abstractZh: 异议在任何社会中都扮演着重要角色，但持异议者往往因社会制裁而被压制。除了具有说服力之外，为支持异议者立场而提出的理由还能增加公众表达异议的机会，为表达其他可能被污名化的观点提供了“社会掩护”。基于一个简单的理论框架，我们通过实验发现，自由派更愿意发布反对削减警察经费的推文，他们被认为没有那么偏执，并且当他们的推文暗示他们先阅读了支持其立场的可信科学证据时，他们面临的社会制裁也会降低。对保守派进行的类似实验表明，同样的机制有助于促进反移民言论。我们的研究结果既揭示了理由在促进异议方面的力量，也揭示了其局限性，并为理解社会运动、政治正确、宣传以及反少数族裔行为等现象提供了启示。

abstract.text: We investigate biases in expectations across different settings through a large-scale randomized experiment where participants forecast stable stochastic processes. The experiment allows us to control forecasters’ information sets as well as the data-generating process, so we can cleanly measure biases in beliefs. We report three facts. First, forecasts display significant overreaction to the most recent observation. Second, overreaction is stronger for less persistent processes. Third, overreaction is also stronger for longer forecast horizons. We develop a tractable model of expectations formation with costly processing of past information, which closely fits the empirical facts. We also perform additional experiments to test the mechanism of the model.

10.1093/qje/qjad009.abstractZh: 我们通过一项大规模随机实验来研究不同情境下预期偏差的问题，参与者需要预测稳定的随机过程。该实验使我们能够控制预测者的信息集以及数据生成过程，从而能够清晰地测量信念中的偏差。我们发现了三个事实：首先，预测结果对最新观测数据的反应显著；其次，对于不太持久的过程，过度反应更为明显；第三，对于更长的预测范围，过度反应同样更为显著。我们建立了一个可行的预期形成模型，该模型考虑了过去信息的 costly 处理，这一模型与实证事实非常吻合。我们还进行了额外的实验来测试该模型的机制。

abstract.text: Unemployment rates differ widely across local labor markets. I offer new empirical evidence that high local unemployment emerges because of elevated local job-losing rates. Local employers, rather than local workers or location-specific factors, account for most of the spatial gaps in job stability. I propose a theory in which spatial differences in job loss emerge in equilibrium because of systematic differences between employers across local labor markets. The spatial sorting decisions of employers in turn shape heterogeneity across locations. Labor market frictions induce productive employers to overvalue locating close to each other. The optimal policy incentivizes them to relocate toward areas with high job-losing rates, providing a rationale for commonly used place-based policies. I estimate the model using French administrative data. The estimated model accounts for over three-quarters of the cross-sectional dispersion in unemployment rates and for the respective contributions of job-losing and job-finding rates. Inefficient location choices by employers amplify spatial unemployment differentials fivefold. Both real-world and optimal place-based policies can yield sizable local and aggregate welfare gains.

10.1093/qje/qjad010.abstractZh: 各地劳动力市场的失业率存在显著差异。我提供了新的实证证据，表明高失业率的出现是由于当地失业率的上升。造成就业稳定性空间差异的主要因素是当地雇主，而非当地工人或特定地点的因素。我提出了一个理论模型，认为就业流失的空间差异在均衡状态下是由于不同地方雇主之间的系统性差异所导致的。雇主的空间选址决策反过来又影响了不同地点的差异。劳动力市场中的摩擦使得有生产力的雇主更倾向于选择彼此靠近的地点。最优政策会激励他们向失业率较高的地区迁移，这为常用的基于地点的政策提供了依据。我使用法国行政数据对模型进行了估计。估计模型能够解释超过四分之三的失业率横截面差异，以及失业率和就业率各自的贡献。雇主的低效选址行为会使空间失业差异扩大五倍。无论是现实世界中的政策还是最优的基于地点的政策，都能带来显著的本地和整体福利收益。

abstract.text: Despite the widespread use of graphs in empirical research, little is known about readers’ ability to process the statistical information they are meant to convey (“visual inference”). We study visual inference in the context of regression discontinuity (RD) designs by measuring how accurately readers identify discontinuities in graphs produced from data-generating processes calibrated on 11 published papers from leading economics journals. First, we assess the effects of different graphical representation methods on visual inference using randomized experiments. We find that bin widths and fit lines have the largest effects on whether participants correctly perceive the presence or absence of a discontinuity. Our experimental results allow us to make evidence-based recommendations to practitioners, and we suggest using small bins with no fit lines as a starting point to construct RD graphs. Second, we compare visual inference on graphs constructed using our preferred method with widely used econometric inference procedures. We find that visual inference achieves similar or lower type I error (false positive) rates and complements econometric inference.

10.1093/qje/qjad011.abstractZh: 尽管图表在实证研究中被广泛使用，但关于读者处理图表所传达的统计信息的能力，我们知之甚少。我们研究了在回归不连续设计中的视觉推断问题，通过测量读者识别由11篇知名经济学期刊论文中的数据生成过程产生的图表中不连续性的准确性。首先，我们通过随机实验评估不同图形表示方法对视觉推断的影响。我们发现，区间宽度和拟合线对参与者正确识别不连续性的存在或缺失有最大的影响。我们的实验结果为实践者提供了基于证据的建议，我们建议以没有拟合线的小区间作为构建回归不连续图的起点。其次，我们比较了使用我们推荐的方法构建的图表与广泛使用的计量经济学推断方法在视觉推断方面的表现。我们发现，视觉推断的I型错误率（假阳性率）与计量经济学推断相似或更低，并且可以补充计量经济学推断的效果。

abstract.text: Recent scholarship has suggested that artificial intelligence (AI) technology and autocratic regimes may be mutually reinforcing. We test for a mutually reinforcing relationship in the context of facial-recognition AI in China. To do so, we gather comprehensive data on AI firms and government procurement contracts, as well as on social unrest across China since the early 2010s. We first show that autocrats benefit from AI: local unrest leads to greater government procurement of facial-recognition AI as a new technology of political control, and increased AI procurement indeed suppresses subsequent unrest. We show that AI innovation benefits from autocrats’ suppression of unrest: the contracted AI firms innovate more both for the government and commercial markets and are more likely to export their products; noncontracted AI firms do not experience detectable negative spillovers. Taken together, these results suggest the possibility of sustained AI innovation under the Chinese regime: AI innovation entrenches the regime, and the regime’s investment in AI for political control stimulates further frontier innovation.

10.1093/qje/qjad012.abstractZh: 近期的研究表明，人工智能技术与专制政权之间可能存在相互强化的关系。我们在中国的面部识别人工智能领域对这一关系进行了测试。为此，我们收集了关于人工智能公司、政府采购合同以及自2010年代初以来中国社会动荡的综合性数据。首先，我们发现专制统治者从人工智能中获益：当地的社会动荡导致政府更加倾向于采购面部识别人工智能技术，作为政治控制的新型工具；而增加的AI采购实际上抑制了后续的社会动荡。其次，我们发现人工智能创新受益于专制统治者对动荡的压制：与合同相关的AI公司为了政府和商业市场进行更多的创新，并且更有可能出口其产品；而非合同相关的AI公司则没有经历可检测的负面溢出效应。综合这些结果，这表明在中国政权下，人工智能创新有可能持续进行：人工智能创新巩固了政权，而政权对人工智能的政治控制投资又促进了进一步的创新。

abstract.text: This article studies the macroeconomic implications of imperfect risk sharing implied by a class of New Keynesian models with heterogeneous agents. The models in this class can be equivalently represented as a representative-agent economy with wedges. These wedges are functions of households’ consumption shares and relative wages, and they identify the key cross-sectional moments that govern the impact of households’ heterogeneity on aggregate variables. We measure the wedges using U.S. household-level data and combine them with a representative-agent economy to perform counterfactuals. We find that deviations from perfect risk sharing implied by this class of models account for only 7% of output volatility on average but can have sizable output effects when nominal interest rates reach their lower bound.

10.1093/qje/qjad013.abstractZh: 本文研究了一类具有异质代理人的新凯恩斯模型所蕴含的不完美风险共享的宏观经济影响。这类模型可以等价地表示为带有楔形结构的代表性代理人经济模型。这些楔形结构是家庭消费份额和相对工资的函数，它们揭示了控制家庭异质性对总体变量影响的关键横截面特征。我们利用美国家庭层面的数据来测量这些楔形结构，并将其与代表性代理人经济模型相结合进行反事实分析。研究发现，这类模型所蕴含的不完美风险共享仅平均占产出波动性的7%，但在名义利率达到下限时，可能会产生显著的产出效应。

abstract.text: This article shows how the migration of millions of Southern whites in the twentieth century shaped the cultural and political landscape across the United States. Racially and religiously conservative, Southern white migrants created new electoral possibilities for a broad-based coalition with economic conservatives. With their considerable geographic scope, these migrants hastened partisan realignment and helped catalyze and bolster a New Right movement with national influence over the long run. More than just augmenting the conservative voter base outside the South, they influenced non-Southerners by building evangelical churches, diffusing right-wing media, and mixing through intermarriage and residential integration. Tracking non-Southern households, we show that exposure to Southern white neighbors increased adoption of conservative religious norms. Overall, our findings suggest that this mass migration blurred the North–South cultural divide and reshaped the geography of conservatism in the United States.

10.1093/qje/qjad014.abstractZh: 本文揭示了二十世纪数百万南方白人移民如何塑造了美国的文化和政治格局。这些在种族和宗教上较为保守的南方白人移民为经济保守派创建了一个广泛的选举联盟提供了新的可能性。凭借其广泛的地理覆盖范围，这些移民加速了党派重组，并帮助推动了具有全国影响力的新右翼运动的兴起。他们不仅增强了南方以外的保守派选民基础，还通过建立福音派教会、传播右翼媒体以及通过通婚和居住融合，对非南方人产生了影响。通过对非南方家庭的研究，我们发现与南方白人邻居接触会增加人们采纳保守宗教规范的可能性。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，这种大规模移民模糊了南北之间的文化差异，并重新塑造了美国保守主义的地理分布。

abstract.text: This article examines the relationship between ethnic-based gender norms and conflict-related sexual violence. We generate a novel dyadic data set that contains information on the ethnic identity of all the actors involved in ethnic civil conflicts around the world between 1989 and 2019 and their use of sexual violence. We exploit ethnographic information to construct a new male dominance index at the ethnicity level that captures deep-rooted gender norms. First, we find that male-dominant armed actors are more likely to be perpetrators of sexual violence. Second, we consider the cultural distance in gender norms between the combatants and show that sexual violence is driven by a specific clash of conceptions on the appropriate role of men and women in society: sexual violence increases when the perpetrator is more male dominant than the victim. Additional analyses suggest that gender norms influence both the strategic use of sexual violence for military purposes and the expressive use of sexual violence for private motivations. These patterns are specific to sexual violence and do not explain general violence in a conflict. Differences in other cultural dimensions unrelated to gender are not associated with conflict-related sexual violence.

10.1093/qje/qjad015.abstractZh: 本文探讨了基于种族的性别规范与冲突相关的性暴力之间的关系。我们构建了一个新颖的双变量数据集，该数据集包含了1989年至2019年间全球所有种族民事冲突中涉及者的种族身份信息以及他们使用性暴力的情况。我们利用民族志资料，在种族层面构建了一个新的男性主导指数，以反映根深蒂固的性别规范。首先，我们发现以男性为主的武装参与者更有可能成为性暴力的实施者。其次，我们考察了战斗双方性别规范之间的文化差异，发现性暴力是由关于男女在社会中适当角色的特定观念冲突所驱动的：当施暴者比受害者更以男性为主导时，性暴力会加剧。进一步的分析表明，性别规范既影响性暴力作为军事策略的使用，也影响性暴力作为私人动机的表达方式。这些模式是性暴力特有的，并不能解释冲突中的普遍暴力行为。与性别无关的其他文化维度差异与冲突相关的性暴力并无关联。

abstract.text: The world has 1.4 billion passenger vehicles. How should governments regulate their air pollution emissions? A Pigouvian tax is technologically infeasible. Most countries instead rely on exhaust standards that limit air pollution emissions per mile for new vehicles. We assess the effectiveness and efficiency of these standards, which are the centerpiece of U.S. Clean Air Act regulation of transportation, and counterfactual policies. We show that the air pollution emissions per mile of new U.S. vehicles has fallen spectacularly, by over 99%, since standards began in 1967. Several research designs with a half century of data suggest that exhaust standards have caused most of this decline. Yet exhaust standards are not cost-effective in part because they fail to encourage scrap of older vehicles, which account for the majority of emissions. To study counterfactual policies, we develop an analytical and a quantitative model of the vehicle fleet. Analysis of these models suggests that tighter exhaust standards increase social welfare and increasing registration fees on dirty vehicles yields even larger gains by accelerating scrap, although both reforms have complex effects on inequality.

10.1093/qje/qjad016.abstractZh: 全球拥有14亿辆乘用车。政府应该如何规范这些车辆的空气污染排放？采用庇古税进行监管在技术上不可行。大多数国家转而采用尾气排放标准，以限制新车的每英里空气污染排放。我们评估了这些标准的有效性和效率，这些标准是美国《清洁空气法》对交通领域监管的核心内容，同时我们也研究了反事实政策。研究表明，自1967年标准实施以来，美国新车的每英里空气污染排放量显著下降，降幅超过99%。基于半个世纪的数据，多项研究设计表明，尾气排放标准是导致这一下降的主要原因。然而，尾气排放标准并不具有成本效益，部分原因是它们未能鼓励报废老旧车辆，而老旧车辆才是大部分排放源。为了研究反事实政策，我们开发了一个分析模型和一个量化模型来研究车辆车队的情况。分析表明，更严格的尾气排放标准能够提升社会福祉，而对脏车征收更高的注册费则能通过加速报废车辆来带来更大的收益，尽管这两种改革都会对不平等产生复杂的影响。

abstract.text: This article investigates gender differences in the job search process in the field and lab. Our analysis is based on rich information on initial job offers and acceptances from undergraduates of Boston University’s Questrom School of Business. We find (i) a clear gender difference in the timing of job offer acceptance, with women accepting jobs substantially earlier than men, and (ii) a sizable gender earnings gap in accepted offers, which narrows in favor of women over the course of the job search period. To understand these patterns, we develop a job search model that incorporates gender differences in risk aversion and overoptimism about prospective offers. We validate the model’s assumptions and predictions using the survey data and present empirical evidence that the job search patterns in the field can be partly explained by the greater risk aversion displayed by women and the higher levels of overoptimism displayed by men. We replicate these findings in a laboratory experiment that features sequential job search and provide direct evidence on the purported mechanisms. Our findings highlight the importance of risk preferences and beliefs for gender differences in job-finding behavior and, consequently, early-career wage gaps among the highly educated.

10.1093/qje/qjad017.abstractZh: 本文探讨了女性在职场和实验室领域求职过程中的性别差异。我们的分析基于波士顿大学Questrom商学院本科生初次求职申请及接受情况的大量数据。研究发现：(i) 女性在接受求职机会的时间上明显早于男性，存在明显的性别差异；(ii) 接受求职机会后的收入差距较大，但在整个求职过程中这一差距逐渐缩小，女性处于有利地位。为了理解这些现象，我们构建了一个求职模型，该模型考虑了性别在风险规避和对未来机会的过度乐观态度上的差异。我们通过调查数据验证了模型的假设和预测，并提供了实证证据，表明女性在求职过程中表现出的更大风险规避意识和男性更高的过度乐观态度，可以部分解释职场中的求职模式。我们在一项实验室实验中进一步验证了这些发现，该实验涉及连续的求职过程，并直接证明了相关机制。我们的研究结果强调了风险偏好和信念在性别差异导致的求职行为中的重要性，以及这在高教育水平人群中早期职业收入差距形成中的作用。

abstract.text: Close-kin marriage, by sustaining tightly knit family structures, may impede development. We find support for this hypothesis using U.S. state bans on cousin marriage. Our measure of cousin marriage comes from the excess frequency of same-surname marriages, a method borrowed from population genetics that we apply to millions of marriage records from the eighteenth to the twentieth century. Using census data, we first show that married cousins are more rural and have lower-paying occupations. We then turn to an event study analysis to understand how cousin marriage bans affected outcomes for treated birth cohorts. We find that these bans led individuals from families with high rates of cousin marriage to migrate off farms and into urban areas. They also gradually shift to higher-paying occupations. We observe increased dispersion, with individuals from these families living in a wider range of locations and adopting more diverse occupations. Our findings suggest that these changes were driven by the social and cultural effects of dispersed family ties rather than genetics. Notably, the bans also caused more people to live in institutional settings for the elderly, infirm, or destitute, suggesting weaker support from kin.

10.1093/qje/qjad018.abstractZh: 近亲婚姻通过维持紧密的家庭结构，可能会阻碍发展。我们通过美国各州对表亲婚姻的禁令来支持这一假设。我们对表亲婚姻的衡量方法是基于同姓婚姻的异常频率，这是一种借鉴自人口遗传学的分析方法，我们将其应用于18世纪至20世纪数百万份婚姻记录。利用人口普查数据，我们首先发现已婚表亲通常居住在农村地区，并且从事低薪职业。随后，我们通过事件研究分析来了解表亲婚姻禁令对受干预的出生队列的影响。我们发现，这些禁令导致那些表亲婚姻率较高的家庭中的个体离开农场，迁移到城市地区，并逐渐转向高薪职业。我们还观察到，这些家庭的个体居住范围变得更加广泛，职业也变得更加多样化。我们的研究结果表明，这些变化是由分散的家庭关系带来的社会和文化影响所驱动的，而非遗传因素。值得注意的是，这些禁令还导致更多人居住在为老年人、体弱者或贫困者设立的机构中，这表明亲属间的支持程度有所减弱。

abstract.text: We provide new evidence on how labor market dynamics vary with development. We build a new data set consisting of harmonized microdata from rotating panel labor force surveys covering 80 million people from 49 countries. Labor market flows, such as the job-finding or employment exit rate, are higher in developing economies. These higher flows largely reflect a slippery job ladder: workers transition frequently to and from marginal employment without climbing to or persisting in better-paying jobs. Subsistence self-employment and different patterns of selection for wage workers each play a role in our findings and are useful avenues for future theories of labor market frictions.

10.1093/qje/qjad019.abstractZh: 我们提供了关于劳动力市场动态如何随经济发展而变化的新的证据。我们构建了一个新的数据集，该数据集包含了来自49个国家的8000万人的旋转面板劳动力调查中的统一微观数据。在发展中经济体中，如求职或离职率等劳动力市场流动情况更为频繁。这些较高的流动情况主要反映了一种不稳定的就业阶梯：工人频繁地在边缘性就业和更好的就业之间转换，而不会持续留在更好的岗位上。自给自足的自主创业以及工资工人的不同选择模式都在我们的研究结果中起到了作用，这些都为未来关于劳动力市场摩擦的理论提供了有用的研究方向。

abstract.text: We provide evidence for a bias that we call “representative signal distortion” (RSD), which is particularly relevant to settings of statistical discrimination. Experimental subjects distort their evaluation of new evidence on individual group members and interpret such information to be more representative of the group to which the individual belongs (relative to a reference group) than it really is. This produces a discriminatory gap in the evaluation of members of the two groups. Because it is driven by representativeness, the bias (and the discriminatory gap) disappears when subjects are prevented from contrasting different groups; because it is a bias in the interpretation of information, it disappears when subjects receive information before learning of the individual’s group. We show that this bias can be easily estimated from appropriately constructed data sets and can be distinguished from previously documented inferential biases in the literature. Importantly, we document how removing the bias produces a kind of free lunch in reducing discrimination, making it possible to significantly reduce discrimination without lowering accuracy of inferences.

10.1093/qje/qjad020.abstractZh: 我们提供了一种被称为“代表性信号失真”（RSD）的偏见证据，这种偏见在统计歧视的情境中尤为显著。实验对象在评估关于个体成员的新信息时，会将这些信息解读为更能代表该个体所属的群体（相对于参考群体），而实际上情况并非如此。这导致两个群体成员在评估时的差异扩大。由于这种偏见是由代表性驱动的，因此当受试者无法对比不同群体时，这种偏见就会消失；又因为这是一种对信息的解读偏差，当受试者在学习到个体所属群体之前就接收到信息时，这种偏见也会消失。我们证明，这种偏见可以通过适当构建的数据集来轻松估计，并且可以与文献中先前记录的推理偏差区分开来。重要的是，我们发现消除这种偏见可以在减少歧视的同时，不降低推理的准确性，从而实现显著的歧视减少效果。

abstract.text: Children’s indirect exposure to the justice system through biological parents or coresident adults is both a marker of their own vulnerability and a measure of the justice system’s expansive reach in society. Estimating the size of this population for the United States has historically been hampered by inadequate data resources, including the inability to observe nonincarceration events, follow children throughout their childhood, and measure adult nonbiological parent cohabitants. To overcome these challenges, we leverage billions of restricted administrative and survey records linked with Criminal Justice Administrative Records System data and find substantially larger exposure rates than previously reported: prison, 9% of children born between 1999–2005; felony conviction, 18%; and any criminal charge, 39%. Charge exposure rates exceed 60% for Black, American Indian, and low-income children. While broader definitions reach a more expansive population, strong and consistently negative correlations with childhood well-being suggest that these remain valuable predictors of vulnerability. Finally, we document substantial geographic variation in exposure, which we leverage in a movers design to estimate the effect of living in a high-exposure county during childhood. We find that children moving into high-exposure counties are more likely to experience postmove exposure events and exhibit significantly worse outcomes by age 26 on multiple dimensions (earnings, criminal activity, teen parenthood, mortality); effects are strongest for those who moved at earlier ages.

10.1093/qje/qjad021.abstractZh: 儿童通过生物学父母或同住成年人间接接触司法系统的行为，既是他们自身脆弱性的标志，也是司法系统在社会中广泛影响的体现。历史上，由于数据资源不足，包括无法观察到非监禁事件、无法全程跟踪儿童成长过程以及无法测量非生物学父母的同居情况，因此很难估算美国这一群体的规模。为了克服这些挑战，我们利用数十亿条与刑事司法行政记录系统数据相关联的行政和调查记录，发现实际暴露率远高于先前报告的数据：监狱服刑率为1999-2005年间出生的儿童的9%；重罪定罪率为18%；任何刑事指控的暴露率为39%。对于黑人、美洲原住民和低收入儿童来说，相关指控的暴露率超过60%。虽然更广泛的定义能够涵盖更多人群，但与儿童福祉之间的强烈且持续的负相关关系表明，这些因素仍然是预测脆弱性的重要指标。最后，我们发现了暴露率的显著地理差异，并利用这一差异通过移动设计来估算童年时期居住在高暴露地区的影响。研究发现，搬入高暴露地区的儿童更有可能经历迁移后的暴露事件，并且在26岁时在多个维度上表现出显著较差的结果（如收入、犯罪活动、青少年生育、死亡率）；对于在较年轻年龄搬入高暴露地区的儿童来说，这种影响最为明显。

abstract.text: We explore efficiency and optimal policy in decentralized transport markets, such as taxis, trucks, and bulk shipping. We show that in these markets, search frictions distort the transportation network and the dynamic allocation of carriers over space. We derive explicit and intuitive conditions for efficiency and show how they translate into efficient pricing rules, or optimal taxes and subsidies for the planner who cannot set prices directly. The results imply that destination-based pricing is essential to attain efficiency. Then, using data from dry bulk shipping, we demonstrate that search frictions lead to a sizable social loss and substantial misallocation of ships over space. Optimal policy can eliminate about half of the welfare loss. Can a centralizing platform, often arising as a market-based solution to search frictions, do better? Interestingly, the answer is no; although the platform eradicates frictions, it exerts market power, thus eroding the welfare gains. Finally, we use two recent interventions in the industry (China’s Belt and Road Initiative and the environmental initiative IMO 2020) to demonstrate that taking into account the efficiency properties of transport markets is germane to any proposed policy.

10.1093/qje/qjad023.abstractZh: 我们探讨了分散式运输市场中的效率与最优政策问题，这些市场包括出租车、卡车和散货运输等。我们发现，在这些市场中，搜索摩擦会扭曲运输网络以及运输工具的动态分配。我们推导出了效率的明确且直观的条件，并展示了这些条件如何转化为有效的定价规则，或者为无法直接设定价格的规划者提供最优的税收和补贴方案。研究结果表明，基于目的地的定价对于实现效率至关重要。接着，通过散货运输的数据分析，我们发现搜索摩擦会导致巨大的社会损失，并造成运输工具的严重错配。最优政策可以消除大约一半的福利损失。那么，作为解决搜索摩擦的基于市场的解决方案，集中式平台能否表现得更好呢？有趣的是，答案是否定的；尽管该平台消除了摩擦，但它却行使了市场力量，从而侵蚀了福利收益。最后，我们通过该行业最近的两项干预措施——中国的“一带一路”倡议和IMO 2020环境倡议——来证明，考虑运输市场的效率特性对于任何拟议的政策都是至关重要的。

abstract.text: We develop a model in which specialized bond investors must absorb shocks to the supply and demand for long-term bonds in two currencies. Since long-term bonds and foreign exchange are both exposed to unexpected movements in short-term interest rates, a shift in the supply of long-term bonds in one currency influences the foreign exchange rate between the two currencies, as well as bond term premia in both currencies. Our model matches several important empirical patterns, including the comovement between exchange rates and term premia, and the finding that central banks’ quantitative easing policies affect exchange rates. An extension of our model links spot exchange rates to the persistent deviations from covered interest rate parity that have emerged since 2008.

10.1093/qje/qjad024.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个模型，该模型表明，专业债券投资者必须应对两种货币中长期债券供需的波动。由于长期债券和外汇都容易受到短期利率的意外变动影响，一种货币中长期债券的供应变化会进而影响两种货币之间的汇率，以及两种货币中的债券期限溢价。我们的模型与多个重要的实证现象相符，包括汇率与期限溢价之间的联动性，以及中央银行量化宽松政策对汇率的影响。我们模型的扩展部分将即期汇率与自2008年以来出现的覆盖利率平价偏离现象联系起来。

abstract.text: This article documents the economic relevance of measuring cognitive uncertainty: people’s subjective uncertainty over their ex ante utility-maximizing decision. In a series of experiments on choice under risk, the formation of beliefs, and forecasts of economic variables, we show that cognitive uncertainty predicts various systematic biases in economic decisions. When people are cognitively uncertain—either endogenously or because the problem is designed to be complex—their decisions are heavily attenuated functions of objective probabilities, which gives rise to average behavior that is regressive to an intermediate option. This insight ties together a wide range of empirical regularities in behavioral economics that are typically viewed as distinct phenomena or even as reflecting preferences, including the probability weighting function in choice under risk; base rate insensitivity, conservatism, and sample size effects in belief updating; and predictable overoptimism and -pessimism in forecasts of economic variables. Our results offer a blueprint for how a simple measurement of cognitive uncertainty generates novel insights about what people find complex and how they respond to it.

10.1093/qje/qjad025.abstractZh: 本文探讨了衡量认知不确定性在经济中的重要性：人们对其事前效用最大化决策的主观不确定性。通过一系列关于风险下的选择、信念形成以及经济变量预测的实验，我们发现认知不确定性能够预测经济决策中的各种系统性偏差。当人们处于认知不确定状态——无论是由于自身因素还是因为问题设计得过于复杂——他们的决策会严重受到客观概率的影响，从而导致平均行为趋向于中间选项。这一发现将行为经济学中一系列通常被视为独立现象甚至反映偏好的经验规律联系起来，包括风险下选择中的概率加权函数；信念更新中的基础率不敏感性、保守主义以及样本大小效应；以及对经济变量预测中的过度乐观与悲观情绪。我们的研究结果提供了一种简单的认知不确定性测量方法，能够揭示人们如何感知复杂事物以及他们如何应对这些复杂性的新见解。

abstract.text: We study differences in markups earned by Bangladeshi garment exporters across buyers with different sourcing strategies and make three contributions. First, we distinguish buyers with a relational versus a spot sourcing strategy and show that a buyer’s sourcing strategy is correlated across products and origins. Buyer fixed effects explain most of the variation in sourcing strategies, suggesting that these depend on organizational capabilities. Second, we use novel data that match quantities and prices of the two main variable inputs in the production of garments (fabric and labor on sewing lines) to specific export orders. We derive conditions under which these data allow measurement of within exporter-product-time differences in markups across orders produced for different buyers. Third, we show that exporters earn higher markups on otherwise identical orders produced for relational, as opposed to spot, buyers. A sourcing model with imperfect contract enforcement, idiosyncratic shocks to exporters, and buyers that adopt different sourcing strategies trading off higher prices and reliable supply rationalizes this and other observed facts in the industry. We discuss alternative explanations and policy implications.

10.1093/qje/qjad026.abstractZh: 我们研究了孟加拉国服装出口商在不同采购策略的买家那里获得的加价差异，并提出了三项贡献。首先，我们区分了采用关系采购策略和现货采购策略的买家，并发现买家的采购策略在不同产品和来源地之间存在相关性。买家固定效应解释了采购策略的大部分差异，这表明这些策略取决于组织能力。其次，我们使用新颖的数据，这些数据记录了服装生产中的两个主要变量输入——面料和缝线工人的劳动成本，以及具体的出口订单。我们推导出在这些数据支持下，可以测量不同买家订单之间加价差异的条件。第三，我们发现，对于采用关系采购策略的买家，出口商在同样条件下获得的加价更高。一个存在不完全合同执行、出口商面临特殊冲击以及买家采用不同采购策略并权衡较高价格和可靠供应的采购模型，可以解释这一行业中的其他现象。我们还讨论了其他可能的解释和政策含义。

abstract.text: We develop a new class of general-equilibrium models with partially unfunded debt to propose a fiscal theory of persistent inflation. In response to business cycle shocks, the monetary authority controls inflation and the fiscal authority stabilizes debt. However, the central bank accommodates unfunded fiscal shocks, causing persistent movements in inflation, output, and real interest rates. In an estimated quantitative model, fiscal inflation accounts for the bulk of inflation dynamics. In the aftermath of the pandemic, unfunded fiscal shocks sustain the recovery but also cause a persistent increase in inflation. The model is able to predict the inflationary effects of the American Rescue Plan Act fiscal stimulus out of sample and with real-time data.

10.1093/qje/qjad027.abstractZh: 我们开发了一类新的一般均衡模型，该模型包含部分未融资债务，以此提出一种持续性通货膨胀的财政理论。面对商业周期冲击，货币当局控制通货膨胀，而财政当局则稳定债务水平。然而，中央银行需要应对未融资的财政冲击，这导致通货膨胀、产出和实际利率持续波动。在估算的定量模型中，财政因素占据了通货膨胀动态的主要部分。在疫情之后，未融资的财政冲击不仅支撑了经济复苏，还导致了通货膨胀的持续上升。该模型能够利用样本数据和实时数据预测《美国救援计划法案》财政刺激措施带来的通货膨胀效应。

abstract.text: Books shape how children learn about society and norms, in part through representation of different characters. We use computational tools to characterize representation in children’s books widely read in homes, classrooms, and libraries over the past century and describe economic forces that may contribute to these patterns. We introduce new artificial intelligence methods for systematically converting images into data. We apply these tools, alongside text analysis methods, to measure skin color, race, gender, and age in the content of these books, documenting what has changed and what has endured over time. We find underrepresentation of Black and Latinx people in the most influential books, relative to their population shares, though representation of Black individuals increases over time. Females are also increasingly present but appear less often in text than in images, suggesting greater symbolic inclusion in pictures than substantive inclusion in stories. Characters in these influential books have lighter average skin color than in other books, even after conditioning on race, and children are depicted with lighter skin color than adults on average. We present empirical analysis of related economic behavior to better understand the representation we find in these books. On the demand side, we show that people consume books that center their own identities and that the types of children’s books purchased correlate with local political beliefs. On the supply side, we document higher prices for books that center nondominant social identities and fewer copies of these books in libraries that serve predominantly White communities.

10.1093/qje/qjad028.abstractZh: 书籍塑造了儿童对社会和规范的认知，部分是通过不同角色的呈现来实现的。我们使用计算工具来分析过去一个世纪在家庭、教室和图书馆广泛阅读的儿童书籍中的角色呈现方式，并探讨可能促成这些模式的经济因素。我们引入了新的人工智能方法，将图像系统地转化为数据。结合文本分析方法，我们利用这些工具来测量这些书籍内容中的肤色、种族、性别和年龄信息，记录随时间变化的内容与不变的内容。我们发现，在最具影响力的书籍中，黑人和拉丁裔的呈现比例相对较低，尽管随着时间的推移，黑人的形象呈现频率有所上升。女性角色的出现频率也在增加，但在文本中的出现频率似乎低于图像，这表明在故事中，符号层面的包容程度高于实质层面的包容。这些具有影响力的书籍中的角色平均肤色较其他书籍更浅，即使考虑到种族因素也是如此。我们还通过实证分析相关经济行为，以更好地理解这些书籍中的角色呈现方式。在需求方面，我们发现人们购买的是以自身身份为中心的书籍，而儿童书籍的购买类型与当地的政治信仰相关。在供给方面，我们发现以非主流社会身份为中心的书籍价格更高，而在以白人社区为主的图书馆中，这类书籍的库存较少。

abstract.text: By constraining an individual’s choice during a search, housing discrimination distorts sorting decisions away from true preferences and results in a ceteris paribus reduction in welfare. This study combines a large-scale field experiment with a residential sorting model to derive utility-theoretic measures of renter welfare loss associated with the constraints imposed by discrimination in the rental housing market. Results from experiments conducted in five cities show that key neighborhood amenities are associated with higher levels of discrimination. Counterfactual simulations based on the sorting model suggest that discrimination imposes damages equivalent to 4.4% and 3.5% of the annual incomes for African American and Hispanic/Latinx renters, respectively. Damages are increasing in income for African American renters, such that effects become stronger for economically mobile households. Renters of color must make substantial investments in additional search to mitigate the costs of these constraints. We find that a naive model ignoring discrimination constraints yields biased estimates of willingness to pay for key neighborhood amenities.

10.1093/qje/qjad029.abstractZh: 通过限制个人的搜索选择，住房歧视会扭曲排序决策，使其偏离真实偏好，从而导致在其他条件不变的情况下福利下降。本研究结合大规模实地实验和住宅排序模型，提出了与租赁市场中的歧视限制相关的租赁者福利损失的效用理论度量。在五个城市进行的实验结果显示，关键的社区设施与更高的歧视程度相关。基于排序模型的反事实模拟表明，歧视对非洲裔美国人和西班牙裔/拉丁裔租赁者的年度收入造成了相当于4.4%和3.5%的损失。对于非洲裔美国租赁者而言，损失随着收入的增加而加剧，因此对于经济流动性较高的家庭来说，这种影响更为显著。有色人种租赁者必须投入大量精力进行额外的搜索，以缓解这些限制带来的成本。我们发现，忽略歧视限制的简单模型会得出对关键社区设施支付意愿的偏差估计。

abstract.text: Does immigration change support for redistribution? We design and conduct large-scale surveys and experiments in six countries to investigate how people perceive immigrants and how these perceptions influence their support for redistribution. We find striking misperceptions about the number and characteristics of immigrants. In all countries, respondents greatly overestimate the total number of immigrants, think immigrants are culturally and religiously more distant from them, and economically weaker—less educated, more unemployed, and more reliant on and favoured by government transfers—than they actually are. In the experimental part of our article, we show that simply making respondents think about immigration before asking questions about redistribution makes them support less redistribution, including actual donations to charities. The perception that immigrants are economically weaker and more likely to take advantage of the welfare system is strongly correlated with lower support for redistribution, much more so than the perceived cultural distance or the perceived share of immigrants. These findings are confirmed by further experimental evidence. Information about the true shares and origins of immigrants does not change support for redistribution. An anecdote about a “hard-working” immigrant has somewhat stronger effects but is unable to counteract the negative priming effect of making people think about immigration. Our results further suggest that narratives shape people’s views on immigration more deeply than hard facts.

10.1093/restud/rdac011.abstractZh: 移民是否会改变人们对再分配的支持态度？我们在六个国家设计并进行了大规模的调查和实验，以研究人们如何看待移民，以及这些看法如何影响他们对再分配的支持程度。我们发现，人们对移民的数量和特征存在严重的误解。在所有国家中，受访者都大大高估了移民的总数，认为移民在文化和宗教上与他们相距甚远，在经济上也较为弱小——受教育程度较低、失业率较高，且更依赖政府的转移支付。在文章的实验部分，我们发现，在询问再分配问题时先让受访者思考移民问题，会使他们减少对再分配的支持，包括对慈善机构的实际捐款。认为移民在经济上较弱且更可能利用福利制度的观点，与对再分配的支持程度呈负相关，这种相关性远高于文化距离或移民比例的感知。进一步的实验证据也证实了这些发现。关于移民的真实比例和来源的信息并不会改变人们对再分配的支持态度。关于“勤奋的”移民的轶事虽然有一定效果，但无法抵消让人们思考移民问题的负面影响。我们的研究结果进一步表明，叙事对人们关于移民的看法的影响比事实本身更为深刻。

abstract.text: Cartels participating in procurement auctions frequently use bid rotation or prioritize incumbents to allocate contracts. However, establishing a link between observed allocation patterns and firm conduct has been difficult: there are cost-based competitive explanations for such patterns. We show that by focusing on auctions in which the winning and losing bids are very close, it is possible to distinguish allocation patterns reflecting cost differences across firms from patterns reflecting non-competitive environments. We apply our tests to two datasets: the sample of Ohio milk auctions studied in Porter and Zona (1999, “Ohio School Milk Markets: An Analysis of Bidding”, RAND Journal of Economics, 30, 263–288), and a sample of municipal procurement auctions from Japan.

10.1093/restud/rdac013.abstractZh: 参与采购拍卖的卡特尔经常采用投标轮换或优先考虑现有企业来分配合同。然而，将观察到的分配模式与公司行为联系起来一直很困难：对于这种模式，存在基于成本的竞争性解释。我们发现，通过关注那些中标和落标价格非常接近的拍卖，可以区分出反映企业间成本差异的分配模式与反映非竞争环境的分配模式。我们将这些测试应用于两个数据集：Porter和Zona在1999年发表的《俄亥俄州学校牛奶市场：投标分析》一文中研究的俄亥俄州牛奶拍卖样本，以及日本的一些市政采购拍卖样本。

abstract.text: We study a model of over-the-counter trading in which ex ante identical traders invest in a contact technology and participate in bilateral trade. We show that a rich market structure emerges both in equilibrium and in an optimal allocation. There is continuous heterogeneity in market access under weak regularity conditions. If the cost per contact is constant, heterogeneity is governed by a power law and there are middlemen, market participants with unboundedly high contact rates who account for a positive fraction of meetings. Externalities lead to overinvestment in equilibrium, and policies that reduce investment in the contact technology can improve welfare. We relate our findings to important features of real-world trading networks.

10.1093/restud/rdac014.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个场外交易模型，在该模型中，事先相同的交易者投资于接触技术并参与双边交易。我们表明，在均衡状态和最优分配状态下，都会出现丰富的市场结构。在弱正则性条件下，市场接入存在持续的异质性。如果每次接触的成本是恒定的，异质性将遵循幂律分布，并且会存在中间商，即那些拥有无限高接触率的市场参与者，他们占据了会议中的大部分时间。外部性会导致均衡状态下的过度投资，而减少接触技术投资的政策可以提高福利。我们将我们的发现与现实世界交易网络的重要特征联系起来。

abstract.text: We propose a simple test for moment inequalities that has exact size in normal models with known variance and has uniformly asymptotically exact size under asymptotic normality. The test compares the quasi-likelihood ratio statistic to a chi-squared critical value, where the degree of freedom is the rank of the inequalities that are active in finite samples. The test requires no simulation and thus is computationally fast and especially suitable for constructing confidence sets for parameters by test inversion. It uses no tuning parameter for moment selection and yet still adapts to the slackness of the moment inequalities. Furthermore, we show how the test can be easily adapted to inference on subvectors in the common empirical setting of conditional moment inequalities with nuisance parameters entering linearly. User-friendly Matlab code to implement the test is provided.

10.1093/restud/rdac015.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种简单的矩不等式检验方法，该检验在已知方差的正常模型中具有精确的大小，并且在渐近正态性条件下具有均匀渐近精确的大小。该检验将准似然比统计量与一个卡方临界值进行比较，其中自由度是有限样本中活跃的矩不等式的秩。该检验无需模拟，因此计算速度快，特别适用于通过检验反演来构建参数的置信集。该检验在矩选择过程中不需要调整参数，同时仍能适应矩不等式的松弛性。此外，我们展示了如何将该检验轻松应用于在具有线性输入的干扰参数的条件矩不等式常见经验设置中对子向量的推断。我们提供了用户友好的Matlab代码来实现该检验。

abstract.text: This article aims to measure and understand the role of inheritances in shaping wealth inequality. We use a quasi-experimental design and Swedish administrative data to document that the average heir depletes her inheritance within a decade while the inheritances of wealthy heirs remain intact. These different depletion rates are not due to different consumption or labour supply responses but due to different rates of return on inherited wealth. Upon their receipt, inheritances reduce relative measures of wealth inequality, such as top shares or percentile ratios. Theoretically, this reduction in inequality could be due to either a compressed inheritance distribution or similar chances of having wealthy parents (high intergenerational mobility). Empirically, the first force is more significant in Sweden. Within a decade, however, the effect is reversed: inheritances increase wealth inequality since the different depletion rates widen the inequality in inherited wealth over time. This implies that inheritance taxation can reduce long run wealth inequality only through the taxation of wealthy heirs.

10.1093/restud/rdac016.abstractZh: 本文旨在衡量并理解遗产在塑造财富不平等中的作用。我们采用准实验设计，并利用瑞典的行政数据发现，平均继承人会在十年内耗尽其遗产，而富人的遗产则保持完好。这种不同的消耗速率并非由于消费或劳动力供给的不同，而是由于继承财富的回报率不同所致。在继承遗产后，遗产会缩小财富不平等的相对指标，如最高份额或百分位数比率。理论上，这种不平等的缩小可能是由于遗产分配更为集中，或者拥有富裕父母的机会相似（即代际流动性较高）。从经验上看，在瑞典，第一种因素更为显著。然而，在十年内，这种效应会逆转：遗产增加了财富不平等，因为不同的消耗速率随着时间的推移扩大了继承财富的不平等。这意味着，遗产税只能通过对富人征税来减少长期的财富不平等。

abstract.text: We study how introducing a central bank digital currency affects equilibrium allocations and welfare in an environment where both currency and bank deposits are used in exchange. We highlight an important policy tradeoff: while a digital currency tends to improve efficiency in exchange, it may also crowd out bank deposits, raise banks’ funding costs, and decrease investment. We derive conditions under which targeted digital currencies, which compete only with physical currency or only with bank deposits, raise welfare. If such targeted currencies are infeasible, we illustrate the policy tradeoffs that arise when issuing a single, universal digital currency.

10.1093/restud/rdac017.abstractZh: 我们研究了在同时使用货币和银行存款的环境中，引入中央银行数字货币如何影响均衡分配和福利。我们指出了一个重要的政策权衡：虽然数字货币有助于提高交换效率，但它也可能挤占银行存款，增加银行的融资成本，并降低投资。我们推导出了只有在与实物货币或仅与银行存款竞争的情况下，有针对性的数字货币才能提升福利的条件。如果这种有针对性的数字货币不可行，我们则展示了在发行单一通用数字货币时会出现的政策权衡。

abstract.text: In the US, both taxes and old-age social security benefits depend on one’s marital status and tend to reduce the labour supply of the secondary earner. To what extent are these provisions holding back the female labour supply? We estimate a rich dynamic life-cycle model of labour supply and savings for couples and singles using the Method of Simulated Moments for the 1945 and 1955 birth cohorts. Our model matches well the life-cycle profiles of labour market participation, hours, and savings for married and single people, and generates plausible elasticities of labour supply. It implies that eliminating these marriage-related provisions would drastically increase the participation of married women over their entire life cycle, reduce the participation of married men after age 60, and increase savings. If the resulting government surplus were used to lower income taxation, there would be large welfare gains for the vast majority of the population. These results hold for both cohorts, including the later one, which has participation similar to that of more recent generations.

10.1093/restud/rdac018.abstractZh: 在美国，税收和老年社会保障福利都取决于个人的婚姻状况，这些规定往往会减少第二配偶的劳动力供给。这些规定在多大程度上限制了女性劳动力供给？我们采用模拟矩方法，为1945年和1955年出生的人群建立了一个包含丰富动态生命周期特征的劳动力供给与储蓄模型。该模型能够很好地匹配已婚和单身人群在劳动力市场参与、工作时间以及储蓄方面的生命周期特征，并得出合理的劳动力供给弹性。模型表明，取消这些与婚姻相关的规定将显著提高已婚女性在整个生命周期中的参与率，减少60岁以上已婚男性的参与率，并增加储蓄。如果政府因此获得的盈余被用于降低所得税，那么对绝大多数人口来说都将带来巨大的福利收益。这些结果适用于两个出生队列，包括后一个队列，后一个队列的参与率与较现代世代相似。

abstract.text: We use new, comprehensive micro data on oil fields to build and estimate a structural model of the oil industry embedded in a general equilibrium model of the world economy. In the model, firms that belong to Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries (OPEC) act as a cartel. The remaining firms are a competitive fringe. We use the model to study the macroeconomic impact of the advent of fracking. Fracking weakens the OPEC cartel, leading to a large long-run decline in oil prices. Fracking also reduces the volatility of oil prices in the long run because fracking firms can respond more quickly to changes in oil demand.

10.1093/restud/rdac019.abstractZh: 我们利用新的、全面的油田微观数据，构建并估计了一个嵌入于世界经济一般均衡模型中的石油行业结构模型。在该模型中，属于石油输出国组织（OPEC）的企業作为卡特尔进行行为，而其余企业则处于竞争边缘。我们利用该模型研究水力压裂技术的出现对宏观经济的影响。水力压裂削弱了OPEC卡特尔的力量，导致石油价格在长期内大幅下降。此外，水力压裂技术还降低了石油价格在长期内的波动性，因为水力压裂企业能够更快速地对石油需求的变化作出反应。

abstract.text: We develop a multi-sector gravity model with heterogeneous workers to quantify the aggregate and group-level welfare effects of trade. The model generalizes the specific-factors intuition to a setting with labour reallocation, leads to a parsimonious formula for the group-level welfare effects from trade, and nests the aggregate results in Arkolakis, Costinot and Rodríguez-Clare (2012, “New Trade Models, Same Old Gains?”, American Economic Review, 102, 94–130). We estimate the model using the structural relationship between China-shock driven changes in manufacturing employment and average earnings across US groups defined as commuting zones. We find that the China shock increases average welfare but some groups experience losses as high as four times the average gain. However, adjusting for plausible measures of inequality aversion barely affects the welfare gains. We also develop and estimate an extension of the model that endogenizes labour force participation and unemployment, finding similar welfare effects from the China shock.

10.1093/restud/rdac020.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个多部门重力模型，该模型考虑了异质工人的情况，用于量化贸易对总体和群体层面的福利影响。该模型将特定因素的直觉推广到劳动力重新分配的环境，得出了一个简洁的公式，用于计算贸易对群体层面的福利影响，并将总体结果纳入Arkolakis、Costinot和Rodríguez-Clare（2012年，《新贸易模型，同样的收益？》，美国经济评论，102卷，94-130页）的研究框架中。我们使用中国冲击导致的制造业就业变化与美国各群体平均收入之间的结构关系来估计该模型。研究发现，中国冲击提高了总体福利，但某些群体的收益损失高达平均收益的四倍。然而，调整不平等厌恶的衡量指标后，对福利收益的影响几乎不变。我们还开发并估计了该模型的扩展版本，该版本考虑了劳动力参与率和失业情况，发现其福利效应与之前的研究结果相似。

abstract.text: We study a model of innovation with a large number of firms that create new technologies by combining several discrete ideas. These ideas are created via private investment and spread between firms. Firms face a choice between secrecy, which protects existing intellectual property, and openness, which facilitates learning from others. Their decisions determine interaction rates between firms, and these interaction rates enter our model as link probabilities in a learning network. Higher interaction rates impose both positive and negative externalities, as there is more learning but also more competition. We show that the equilibrium learning network is at a critical threshold between sparse and dense networks. At equilibrium, the positive externality from interaction dominates: the innovation rate and welfare would be dramatically higher if the network were denser. So there are large returns to increasing interaction rates above the critical threshold. Nevertheless, several natural types of interventions fail to move the equilibrium away from criticality. One effective policy solution is to introduce informational intermediaries, such as public innovators who do not have incentives to be secretive. These intermediaries can facilitate a high-innovation equilibrium by transmitting ideas from one private firm to another.

10.1093/restud/rdac021.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个包含大量企业的创新模型，这些企业通过结合多个独立想法来创造新技术。这些想法是通过私人投资产生的，并在企业之间传播。企业面临一个选择：是保持秘密以保护现有的知识产权，还是选择开放以从他人那里学习。它们的决策决定了企业之间的互动频率，而这些互动频率作为学习网络中的链接概率进入我们的模型。较高的互动频率会产生正面和负面的外部性，因为虽然学习机会增多，但竞争也会加剧。我们指出，均衡学习网络处于稀疏网络和密集网络之间的临界阈值。在均衡状态下，互动带来的正面外部性占主导地位：如果网络更密集，创新率和福利都会显著提高。因此，在临界阈值以上，增加互动频率会带来巨大的回报。然而，几种自然的干预措施无法使均衡状态偏离临界状态。一种有效的政策解决方案是引入信息中介，比如那些没有保密动机的公共创新者。这些中介可以通过将想法从一个私人企业传递到另一个私人企业，来促进高创新均衡。

abstract.text: Mammography guidelines have weakened in response to evidence that mammograms diagnose breast cancers that would never eventually cause symptoms, a phenomenon called "overdiagnosis." Given concerns about overdiagnosis, instead of recommending mammograms, US guidelines encourage women aged 40-49 to get them as they see fit. To assess whether these guidelines target women effectively, I propose an approach that examines mammography behavior within an influential clinical trial that followed participants long enough to find overdiagnosis. I find that women who are more likely to receive mammograms are healthier and have higher socioeconomic status. More importantly, I find that the 20-year level of overdiagnosis is at least 3.5 times higher among women who are most likely to receive mammograms. At least 36% of their cancers are overdiagnosed. These findings imply that US guidelines encourage mammograms among healthier women who are more likely to be overdiagnosed by them. Guidelines in other countries do not.

10.1093/restud/rdac022.abstractZh: 根据证据显示，乳腺X光检查能够诊断出最终不会引发症状的乳腺癌，这种现象被称为“过度诊断”。鉴于对过度诊断的担忧，美国的指南建议40-49岁的女性可以根据自身情况决定是否进行乳腺X光检查。为了评估这些指南是否能够有效针对女性，我提出了一个方法，通过一项长期跟踪参与者的临床试验来研究乳腺X光检查的行为。我发现，更有可能接受乳腺X光检查的女性通常健康状况更好，且社会经济地位较高。更重要的是，我发现，在最有可能接受乳腺X光检查的女性中，20年的过度诊断率至少高出3.5倍。至少有36%的乳腺癌被过度诊断。这些发现表明，美国的指南鼓励那些健康状况较好且更容易被过度诊断的女性进行乳腺X光检查，而其他国家则没有这样的指南。

abstract.text: We derive bounds on the causal effect of belief-dependent preferences (reciprocity and guilt aversion) on choices in sequential two-player games without data on the (higher-order) beliefs of players. We show how informative bounds can be derived by exploiting a specific invariance property common to those preferences. We illustrate our approach by analysing data from an experiment conducted in Denmark. Our approach produces tight bounds on the causal effect of reciprocity in the games we consider. These bounds suggest there exists significant reciprocity in our population—a result also substantiated by the participants’ answers to a post-experimental questionnaire. On the other hand, our approach yields high implausible estimates of guilt aversion—participants would be willing, in some games, to pay at least three Danish crowns (DKK) to avoid letting others down by one DKK. We contrast our estimated bounds with point estimates obtained using data on stated higher-order beliefs, keeping all other aspects of the model unchanged. We find that point estimates fall within our estimated bounds, suggesting that elicited higher-order belief data in our experiment is weakly (if at all) affected by various reporting biases.

10.1093/restud/rdac023.abstractZh: 我们推导了基于信念的偏好（互惠和愧疚厌恶）对序贯双人游戏中选择的因果效应的界限，而无需获取玩家（更高阶）信念的数据。我们通过利用这些偏好共有的特定不变性质，展示了如何推导出有信息量的界限。我们通过分析在丹麦进行的一项实验的数据来说明我们的方法。我们的方法得出了关于互惠在我们考虑的游戏中因果效应的精确界限。这些界限表明，在我们的样本中存在着显著的互惠行为——这一结果也得到了参与者在实验后问卷回答的证实。另一方面，我们的方法得出了愧疚厌恶的高不现实估计值——在某些游戏中，参与者愿意支付至少三丹麦克朗，以避免让别人失望一丹麦克朗。我们将我们估计的界限与使用陈述性高阶信念数据获得的点估计值进行了对比，同时保持模型的其他所有方面不变。我们发现，点估计值落在我们估计的界限之内，这表明实验中获得的高阶信念数据受到各种报告偏差的轻微影响（如果有的话）。

abstract.text: Housing affordability is the main policy challenge for most large cities in the world. Zoning changes, rent control, housing vouchers, and tax credits are the main levers employed by policymakers. How effective are they at combatting the affordability crisis? We build a dynamic stochastic spatial equilibrium model to evaluate the effect of these policies on the well-being of its citizens. The model endogenizes house prices, rents, construction, labour supply, output, income, and wealth inequality, the location decisions of households within the city as well as inter-city migration. Its main novel features are risk, risk aversion, and incomplete risk-sharing. We calibrate the model to the New York metropolitan statistical area. Housing affordability policies carry substantial insurance value but affect aggregate housing and labour supply and cause misallocation in labour and housing markets. Housing affordability policies that enhance access to this insurance especially for the neediest households create substantial net welfare gains.

10.1093/restud/rdac024.abstractZh: 住房可负担性是世界上大多数大城市的首要政策挑战。分区调整、租金管制、住房券和税收抵免是政策制定者常用的手段。这些措施在应对可负担性危机方面的效果如何？我们构建了一个动态随机空间均衡模型，以评估这些政策对市民福祉的影响。该模型内生了房价、租金、建筑、劳动力供应、产出、收入与财富不平等，以及家庭在城市内的位置选择以及城市间迁移。模型的主要创新点包括风险、风险厌恶和不完全风险分担。我们将模型校准到纽约大都会统计区。住房可负担性政策具有显著的保险价值，但会影响整体住房与劳动力供应，并导致劳动市场和住房市场的错配。对于那些最需要帮助的家庭来说，能够增强他们获得这种保险能力的住房可负担性政策，能够带来显著的净福利收益。

abstract.text: To explore whether schools’ causal impacts on test scores measure their overall impact on students, we exploit plausibly exogenous school assignments and data from Trinidad and Tobago to estimate the causal impacts of individual schools on several outcomes. Schools’ impacts on high-stakes tests are weakly related to impacts on important outcomes such as arrests, dropout, teen motherhood, and formal labour market participation. To examine if parents’ school preferences are related to these causal impacts, we link them to parents’ ranked lists of schools and employ discrete-choice models to infer preferences for schools. Parents choose schools that improve high-stakes tests even conditional on peer quality and average outcomes. Parents also choose schools that reduce criminality and teen motherhood and increase labour market participation. School choices among parents of low-achieving students are relatively more strongly related to schools’ impacts on non-test-score outcomes, while the opposite is true for parents of high-achieving students. These results suggest that evaluations based solely on test scores may be misleading about the benefits of school choice (particularly for low-achieving students), and education interventions more broadly.

10.1093/restud/rdac025.abstractZh: 为了探讨学校对考试成绩的因果影响是否也反映了它们对学生整体影响的程度，我们利用特立尼达和多巴哥的数据，通过合理的外部因素来估计单个学校对多个结果的因果影响。学校对高风险考试的影响与对诸如逮捕率、辍学率、青少年母亲比例以及正式劳动力市场参与率等重要结果的影响之间关联性较弱。为了检验家长对学校的偏好是否与这些因果影响相关，我们将家长对学校的排名与他们的偏好联系起来，并采用离散选择模型来推断他们的偏好。家长选择那些即使考虑到同龄人的质量和平均结果也能提高高风险考试成绩的学校。此外，家长还倾向于选择能够减少犯罪率和青少年母亲比例、并增加劳动力市场参与率的学校。对于成绩较低的学生家长来说，学校选择与非考试成绩相关的结果之间的关联性相对较强，而对于成绩较高的学生家长来说则相反。这些结果表明，仅基于考试成绩来评估学校选择的好处可能是误导性的（尤其是对于成绩较低的学生），同时也暗示了教育干预的更广泛意义。

abstract.text: Between 1940 and 1970, more than 4 million African Americans moved from the South to the North of the US, during the Second Great Migration. This same period witnessed the struggle and eventual success of the civil rights movement in ending institutionalized racial discrimination. This article shows that the Great Migration and support for civil rights are causally linked. Predicting Black inflows with a shift-share instrument, we find that the Great Migration raised support for the Democratic Party, increased Congress members’ propensity to promote civil rights legislation, and encouraged pro-civil rights activism outside the US South. We provide different pieces of evidence that support for civil rights was not confined to the Black electorate but was also shared by segments of the white population.

10.1093/restud/rdac026.abstractZh: 在1940年至1970年间，超过400万非裔美国人随着第二次大迁移从美国南部迁往北部。同一时期，民权运动也经历了艰难的奋斗，并最终取得了成功，终结了制度化的种族歧视。本文表明，大迁移与民权运动支持之间存在因果关系。通过转移份额工具预测黑人人口流动情况，我们发现大迁移提升了民主党党的支持率，增加了国会议员推动民权立法的意愿，并促进了美国南部以外地区的民权活动。我们有多种证据表明，民权运动支持不仅限于黑人选民，白人人群中也存在类似的支持态度。

abstract.text: We incorporate the lumpy nature of firm-level investment into the study of how tax policy affects investment behaviour. We show that tax policies can directly impact the lumpiness of investment. Extensive-margin responses to tax policy are key to understanding the effects of different tax reforms and to designing effective stimulus policies. We illustrate these results by studying China’s 2009 VAT reform, which lowered the tax cost of investment and reduced partial irreversibility—the price gap between new and used capital. Using comprehensive tax survey data and a difference-in-differences design, we estimate a 36$\%$ relative investment increase that is driven by investment spikes. Using a dynamic investment model that fits the reduced-form effects of the reform, we show that policies that directly reduce the likelihood of firm inaction are more effective at stimulating investment.

10.1093/restud/rdac027.abstractZh: 我们将企业层面投资的波动性因素纳入了研究范畴，以探讨税收政策如何影响投资行为。研究表明，税收政策可以直接影响投资的波动性。了解对不同税收改革措施的反应，以及设计有效的刺激政策，是理解这些影响的关键。我们通过研究中国2009年的增值税改革来说明这些结果，该改革降低了投资的税收成本，并减少了部分不可逆性——即新资本与旧资本之间的价格差距。利用全面的税收调查数据和差异-差异设计，我们估计了因投资激增而导致的36%的相对投资增加。通过运用符合改革简化效应的动态投资模型，我们发现，那些直接减少企业不采取行动可能性的政策，在刺激投资方面更为有效。

abstract.text: Can massive online retailers such as Amazon and Alibaba issue digital tokens that potentially compete with bank debit accounts? There is a long history of trading stamps and loyalty points, but new technologies are poised to sharply raise the significance of redeemable assets as a store of value. Here, we develop a simple stylized model of redeemable tokens that can be used to study sales and pricing strategies for issuing tokens, including ICOs. Our central finding is that platforms can potentially earn higher revenues by making tokens non-tradable unless they can generate a sufficiently high outside-platform convenience yield.

10.1093/restud/rdac028.abstractZh: 像亚马逊和阿里巴巴这样的大型在线零售商能否发行数字代币，从而与银行借记账户竞争？虽然交易邮票和积分的历史悠久，但新技术使得可兑换资产作为价值储存手段的重要性显著提升。在这里，我们建立了一个简单的可兑换代币模型，用于研究发行代币的销售额和定价策略，包括首次代币发行。我们的核心发现是，平台可以通过使代币不可交易来赚取更高的收入，除非它们能够产生足够高的外部平台便利收益。

abstract.text: This article examines the optimal accumulation of capital and the effects of government debt in neoclassical growth models in which firms have market power and therefore charge prices above marginal cost. In this environment, the real interest rate earned by savers is less than the net marginal product of capital. We establish a new method for evaluating dynamic efficiency that can be applied in such economies. A plausible calibration suggests that the wedge between the real interest rate and the marginal product of capital is about 4 percentage points and that the US economy is dynamically efficient. In addition, government Ponzi schemes can have different implications for welfare than they do under competition. Even if the government can sustain a perpetual rollover of debt and accumulating interest, the policy may nonetheless reduce welfare by depressing steady-state capital and aggregate consumption. These findings suggest that even with low interest rates, as have been observed recently, fiscal policymakers should still be concerned about the crowding-out effects of government debt.

10.1093/restud/rdac029.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在新古典增长模型中，当企业具有市场力量并因此收取高于边际成本的价格时，资本的最优积累以及政府债务的影响。在这种环境下，储蓄者获得的实际利率低于资本的净边际产品。我们提出了一种评估动态效率的新方法，该方法可以应用于此类经济体。合理的校准表明，实际利率与资本边际产品之间的差距约为4个百分点，而美国经济在动态效率方面表现良好。此外，政府庞氏骗局对福利的影响可能与竞争情况不同。即使政府能够持续进行债务滚动和利息积累，该政策仍可能通过降低稳态资本和总消费来减少福利。这些发现表明，即使利率较低，正如最近所观察到的那样，财政政策制定者仍应关注政府债务的挤出效应。

abstract.text: Motivated by the prevalence of simultaneous bidding across a wide range of auction markets, we develop and estimate a model of strategic interaction in simultaneous first-price auctions when objects are heterogeneous and bidders have non-additive preferences over combinations. We establish non-parametric identification of primitives in this model under standard exclusion restrictions, providing a basis for both estimation and testing of preferences over combinations. We then apply our model to data on Michigan Department of Transportation (MDOT) highway procurement auctions, quantifying the magnitude of cost synergies and evaluating the performance of the simultaneous first-price mechanism in the MDOT marketplace.

10.1093/restud/rdac030.abstractZh: 鉴于各种拍卖市场中普遍存在的同时出价现象，我们开发并估计了一个关于同时首次出价拍卖中战略互动的模型。该模型适用于物品具有异质性且竞买者对组合有非加性偏好的情况。在标准的排除限制下，我们建立了该模型中原型的非参数识别方法，为对组合偏好的估计和测试提供了基础。随后，我们将该模型应用于密歇根州交通部公路采购拍卖的数据，量化了成本协同效应的规模，并评估了同时首次出价机制在密歇根州交通部市场中的表现。

abstract.text: We study optimal fiscal policy in a standard incomplete-markets model with uninsurable idiosyncratic income risk, where a Ramsey planner chooses time-varying paths of proportional capital and labour income taxes, lump-sum transfers (or taxes), and government debt. We find that (1) short-run capital income taxes are effective in providing redistribution since the tax base is relatively unequal and inelastic; (2) an increasing pattern of labour income taxes over time mitigates intertemporal distortions from capital income taxes; (3) the optimal policy increases overall transfers, calibrated initially to the US welfare system, by roughly $50\%$; (4) two-thirds of the welfare gains come from redistribution and the remaining third come mostly from insurance; and (5) redistribution also leads to a more efficient allocation of labour via wealth effects on labour supply—lower productivity households can afford to work relatively less.

10.1093/restud/rdac031.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个标准的不完全市场模型中的最优财政政策，该模型中存在不可保险的特殊收入风险。在这种模型中，拉姆齐规划者会选择比例资本税和劳动所得税、一次性转移支付（或税收）以及政府债务的时间变化路径。我们发现：(1)短期内，资本所得税在提供再分配方面是有效的，因为税基相对不平等且弹性较低；(2)随着时间推移，劳动所得税的增加可以缓解资本所得税带来的时间扭曲；(3)最优政策使总体转移支付增加了大约50%，这一结果最初是根据美国福利体系进行校准的；(4)三分之二的福利收益来自再分配，其余三分之一主要来自保险机制；(5)再分配还通过财富对劳动力供应的影响，促进了劳动力的更有效分配——生产力较低的家庭可以负担较少的工作时间。

abstract.text: We incorporate externalities into the stable matching theory of two-sided markets. Extending the classical substitutes condition to markets with externalities, we establish that stable matchings exist when agent choices satisfy substitutability. We show that substitutability is a necessary condition for the existence of a stable matching in a maximal-domain sense and provide a characterization of substitutable choice functions. In addition, we extend the standard insights of matching theory, like the existence of side-optimal stable matchings and the deferred acceptance algorithm, to settings with externalities even though the standard fixed-point techniques do not apply.

10.1093/restud/rdac032.abstractZh: 我们将外部性因素纳入双边市场的稳定匹配理论中。通过将经典的替代品条件扩展到包含外部性的市场，我们证明了当代理人的选择满足可替代性时，稳定匹配是存在的。我们指出，可替代性是存在稳定匹配的必要条件，并且给出了可替代选择函数的一种描述。此外，我们将匹配理论中的标准见解，如存在侧最优稳定匹配和延迟接受算法等，扩展到包含外部性的情境，尽管标准的不动点技术并不适用于这种情况。

abstract.text: Firms have ever-increasing access to consumer data, which they use to personalize their advertising and to price discriminate. This raises privacy concerns. Policymakers have argued in response that consumers should be given control over their data, able to choose what to share and when. Since firms learn about a consumer’s preferences both from what they do and do not disclose, the equilibrium implications of consumer control are unclear. We study whether such measures improve consumer welfare in monopolistic and in competitive markets. We find that consumer control can improve consumer welfare relative to both perfect price discrimination and uniform pricing. First, consumers can use disclosure to amplify competitive forces. Second, consumers can disclose information to induce even a monopolist to lower prices. Whether consumer control improves welfare depends on the disclosure technology and market competitiveness. Simple disclosure technologies suffice in competitive markets. When facing a monopolist, a consumer needs partial disclosure possibilities to obtain any welfare gains.

10.1093/restud/rdac033.abstractZh: 企业越来越能够获取消费者数据，这些数据被用于个性化广告和价格歧视。这引发了隐私方面的担忧。政策制定者认为，消费者应该拥有对自己数据的控制权，能够选择分享什么信息以及何时分享。由于企业通过消费者是否披露信息来了解消费者的偏好，因此消费者控制所带来的均衡影响尚不明确。我们研究了这种措施是否能在垄断市场和竞争市场中改善消费者福利。研究发现，与完全价格歧视和统一定价相比，消费者控制能够提升消费者福利。首先，消费者可以通过披露信息来增强竞争力量。其次，消费者可以披露信息，促使即使是垄断者也降低价格。消费者控制是否能够提高福利取决于披露技术和市场竞争力。在竞争市场中，简单的披露技术就足够了。面对垄断者时，消费者需要部分披露信息才能获得任何福利收益。

abstract.text: We study how an organization should dynamically screen an agent of uncertain loyalty whom it suspects of committing damaging acts of undermining. The organization controls the stakes of the relationship, while the agent strategically times undermining, which can occur repeatedly and is detected only stochastically. The optimal commitment stakes policy exhibits both discreteness and gradualism, with distinct “untrusted” and “trusted” phases featuring gradually rising stakes during the untrusted phase and a discrete gap in stakes between phases. This policy is also the equilibrium outcome when the organization cannot commit, and the agent’s equilibrium undermining policy exhibits variable, non-monotonic intensity.

10.1093/restud/rdac034.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个组织应如何动态地筛选那些忠诚度不确定的代理人，这些代理人可能被怀疑会实施破坏性的行为。组织控制着这种关系的利益得失，而代理人则会在战略上选择时机进行破坏行为，这种行为可能会反复发生，并且只有随机性才能被检测到。最优的承诺利益政策具有离散性和渐进性，在“不信任”阶段和“信任”阶段之间，利益水平会逐渐上升，并且两个阶段之间存在着明显的利益差距。当组织无法做出承诺时，这种政策也是均衡结果；而代理人的均衡破坏行为则表现出变化的、非单调的强度。

abstract.text: We study the interaction between tax advantages for municipal bonds and the market structure of auctions for these bonds. We show that this interaction can limit a bidder’s ability to extract information rents and is a crucial determinant of state and local governments’ borrowing costs. Reduced-form estimates show that increasing the tax advantage by 3 pp lowers mean borrowing costs by 9–10$\%$. We estimate a structural auction model to measure markups and to illustrate and quantify how the interaction between tax policy and bidder strategic behaviour determines the impact of tax advantages on municipal borrowing costs. We use the estimated model to evaluate the efficiency of Obama and Trump administration policies that limit the tax advantage for municipal bonds. Because reductions in the tax advantage inflate bidder markups and depress competition, the resulting increase in municipal borrowing costs more than offsets the tax savings to the government. Finally, we use the model to analyse a recent non-tax regulation that affects entry into municipal bond auctions.

10.1093/restud/rdac035.abstractZh: 我们研究了市政债券的税收优惠与这些债券拍卖市场结构之间的相互作用。研究表明，这种相互作用会限制投标者获取信息租金的能力，并且是州和地方政府借贷成本的重要决定因素。简化形式的估计表明，将税收优惠提高3个百分点，可使平均借贷成本降低9-10%。我们通过构建一个结构性拍卖模型来测量价格操纵现象，并量化税收政策与投标者策略行为之间的相互作用对市政债券借贷成本的影响。我们使用该模型来评估奥巴马和特朗普政府限制市政债券税收优惠政策的效率。由于税收优惠的减少会导致投标者操纵价格并提高价格操纵幅度，从而降低竞争程度，因此市政债券的借贷成本增加幅度超过了政府因税收减免而获得的节省。最后，我们使用该模型分析了一项最近影响市政债券拍卖进入门槛的非税收法规。

abstract.text: This article studies the decentralized adoption of a technology standard when network effects are present. If the new standard is incompatible with the current installed base, adoption may be inefficiently delayed. I quantify the magnitude of “excess inertia” in the switch of the movie distribution and exhibition industries from 35 mm film to digital. I specify and estimate a dynamic game of digital hardware adoption by theatres and digital movies supply by distributors. Counterfactual simulations establish that excess inertia reduces surplus by $16\%$ relative to the first-best adoption path; network externalities explain $41\%$ of the surplus loss. Targeted adoption subsidies or a mandate on digital distribution help bridge this welfare gap.

10.1093/restud/rdac036.abstractZh: 本文研究了在存在网络效应的情况下，技术标准的分散式采纳情况。如果新标准与现有的安装基础不兼容，采纳过程可能会效率低下地延迟。本文量化了电影发行和放映行业从35毫米胶片转向数字技术的“额外惯性”程度。我们具体描述了并估算了影院对数字硬件的采纳动态博弈以及发行商对数字电影供应的动态博弈。反事实模拟表明，与最优采纳路径相比，额外惯性导致剩余收益减少了16%；网络外部性解释了剩余损失中的41%。有针对性的采纳补贴或对数字发行的强制要求有助于弥补这一福利差距。

abstract.text: We study the politicians and voters of the Sweden Democrats, a major populist radical-right party. Based on detailed administrative data, we present the first comprehensive account of which politicians are selected into such a party. Surveys show that politicians and voters of the Sweden Democrats share strong anti-establishment and anti-immigration attitudes that drastically set them apart from Sweden’s other parties. Searching for individual traits that link naturally to these attitudes, we classify the universe of Swedish politicians and voters by social and economic marginalization and exposure to immigration. Politicians from the Sweden Democrats over-represent marginalized groups without strong attachments to the labour market or to traditional nuclear families, which instead are under-represented among politicians in all other parties. Among voters, the Sweden Democrats have higher electoral support in precincts with higher shares of the same marginalized groups. We see the mobilization of the marginalized as an important driver of the party’s success. Finally, we uncover that Sweden-Democrat politicians score lower on a number of valence traits than other-party politicians. In sum, the rise of the Sweden Democrats raised political representation for marginalized groups, but this came at a valence cost.

10.1093/restud/rdac037.abstractZh: 我们研究了瑞典民主党这样的主要民粹主义激进右翼政党的政治家和选民。基于详细的行政数据，我们首次全面分析了哪些政治家被选入该政党。调查显示，瑞典民主党政治家和选民具有强烈的反建制和反移民态度，这使他们与其他瑞典政党截然不同。为了寻找与这些态度密切相关的个人特征，我们根据社会和经济边缘化程度以及移民接触情况对瑞典政治家和选民进行分类。瑞典民主党政治家更代表边缘化群体，这些群体与劳动力市场或传统核心家庭缺乏紧密联系，而这类群体在所有其他政党中的政治家中则代表性不足。在选民中，瑞典民主党在那些同样有较多边缘化群体的选区获得了更高的支持率。我们认为，边缘化群体的动员是该政党成功的重要驱动力。最后，我们发现瑞典民主党政治家在多项价值特征上的得分低于其他政党政治家。总之，瑞典民主党的崛起为边缘化群体提供了政治代表，但这是以价值成本为代价的。

abstract.text: We develop a novel, risk-based theory of the effects of exchange rate stabilization. In our model, the choice of exchange rate regime allows policymakers to make their currency, and by extension, the firms in their country, a safer investment for international investors. Policies that induce a country’s currency to appreciate when the marginal utility of international investors is high lower the required rate of return on the country’s currency and increase the world-market value of domestic firms. Applying this logic to exchange rate stabilizations, we find a small economy stabilizing its bilateral exchange rate relative to a larger economy can increase domestic capital accumulation, domestic wages, and even its share in world wealth. In the absence of policy coordination, small countries optimally choose to stabilize their exchange rates relative to the currency of the largest economy in the world, which endogenously emerges as the world’s “anchor currency”, Larger economies instead optimally choose to float their exchange rates. The model therefore predicts an equilibrium pattern of exchange rate arrangements that is remarkably similar to the one in the data.

10.1093/restud/rdac038.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种基于风险的新汇率稳定效应理论。在我们的模型中，选择不同的汇率制度使得政策制定者能够使其货币，以及本国企业，成为国际投资者更安全的投资对象。当国际投资者的边际效用较高时，促使本国货币升值的政策会降低本国货币所需的回报率，并提高国内企业的世界市场价值。将这一逻辑应用于汇率稳定化，我们发现，一个小型经济体相对于一个大型经济体稳定其双边汇率，可以增加国内资本积累、国内工资水平，甚至提升其在世界财富中的份额。在缺乏政策协调的情况下，小型国家最优选择以世界最大经济体的货币为基准来稳定其汇率，而后者会自然成为世界的“锚定货币”。相比之下，大型经济体则最优选择浮动其汇率。因此，该模型预测出的汇率安排模式与实际数据中的模式非常相似。

abstract.text: We examine the ability of the government to impact mortgage refinancing activity and spur consumption by focusing on the Home Affordable Refinance Program (HARP) that relaxed housing equity constraints by extending government credit guarantee on insufficiently collateralized refinanced mortgages. Difference-in-difference tests based on program eligibility criteria reveal a significant increase in refinancing activity by HARP. More than three million eligible borrowers with primarily fixed-rate mortgages refinanced under HARP, receiving an average reduction of 1.45$\%$ in interest rate ($3,000 in annual savings). Durable spending by borrowers increased significantly after refinancing. Regions more exposed to the program saw a relative increase in non-durable and durable consumer spending, a decline in foreclosure rates, and faster recovery in house prices. Competitive frictions in the refinancing market hampered the program’s impact: the take-up rate and annual savings among those who refinanced were reduced by 10–20$\%$, with amplified effects for the most indebted borrowers.

10.1093/restud/rdac039.abstractZh: 我们研究了政府通过实施“居家可负担再融资计划”（HARP）来影响抵押贷款再融资活动并刺激消费的能力。该计划通过延长对抵押品不足的可再融资抵押贷款的政府信用担保，放宽了住房资产限制。基于计划资格标准的差异检验显示，HARP的实施显著增加了再融资活动。超过三百万符合条件的借款人通过HARP进行了再融资，平均利率降低了1.45%，每年可节省3000美元。再融资后，借款人的耐用消费支出显著增加。更受该计划影响的地区，非耐用和耐用消费支出相对增加，止赎率下降，房价恢复速度加快。然而，再融资市场中的竞争摩擦削弱了该计划的效果：参与再融资的借款人的接受率和年度节省金额减少了10-20%，对于负债最重的借款人来说，这种影响更为显著。

abstract.text: We present an approach to analyse learning outcomes in a broad class of misspecified environments, spanning both single-agent and social learning. We introduce a novel “prediction accuracy” order over subjective models and observe that this makes it possible to partially restore standard martingale convergence arguments that apply under correctly specified learning. Based on this, we derive general conditions to determine when beliefs in a given environment converge to some long-run belief either locally or globally (i.e. from some or all initial beliefs). We show that these conditions can be applied, first, to unify and generalize various convergence results in previously studied settings. Second, they enable us to analyse environments where learning is “slow”, such as costly information acquisition and sequential social learning. In such environments, we illustrate that even if agents learn the truth when they are correctly specified, vanishingly small amounts of misspecification can generate extreme failures of learning.

10.1093/restud/rdac040.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种分析多种错误设定环境下学习成果的方法，这些环境包括单代理环境和社会学习环境。我们引入了一种新的“预测准确性”排序方式，用于评价主观模型，并发现这种方法能够部分恢复在正确设定学习条件下适用的标准鞅收敛性论证。基于这一发现，我们推导出一般条件，以确定在特定环境下，信念何时会局部或全局地收敛到某种长期信念（即从某些或所有初始信念出发）。我们表明，这些条件可以首先用于统一和推广先前研究中的各种收敛性结果。其次，它们使我们能够分析那些学习过程“缓慢”的环境，例如信息获取成本高昂和顺序社会学习的情况。在这些环境中，我们证明即使代理在正确设定的情况下能够学习到真相，极小的错误设定量仍可能导致极严重的学习失败。

abstract.text: To determine the welfare implications of price changes in demand data, we introduce a revealed preference relation over prices. We show that the absence of cycles in this relation characterizes a consumer who trades off the utility of consumption against the disutility of expenditure. Our model can be applied whenever a consumer’s demand over a strict subset of all available goods is being analysed; it can also be extended to settings with discrete goods and non-linear prices. To illustrate its use, we apply our model to a single-agent data set and to a data set with repeated cross-sections. We develop a novel test of linear hypotheses on partially identified parameters to estimate the proportion of the population who are revealed better off due to a price change in the latter application. This new technique can be used for non-parametric counterfactual analysis more broadly.

10.1093/restud/rdac041.abstractZh: 为了确定需求数据价格变化对福利的影响，我们引入了一个关于价格的显示偏好关系。我们指出，这种关系中不存在循环现象，这表明消费者在消费效用与支出负效用之间进行权衡。我们的模型可以应用于分析消费者对所有可用商品中的严格子集的需求；它还可以扩展到具有离散商品和非线性价格的情况。为了说明其应用，我们将模型应用于单代理数据集以及包含重复横截面的数据集。我们开发了一种新的方法来检验部分识别参数的线性假设，以估计在后者应用中，由于价格变化而显得更富裕的人口比例。这种新技术可以更广泛地用于非参数反事实分析。

abstract.text: Do the long work hours required by many high-paying professions inhibit the entry of women? I investigate this question by studying a 2003 policy that capped the average workweek for medical residents at 80 hours. Using data on the universe of US medical school graduates, I find that when a specialty reduces its weekly hours, more women enter the specialty, whereas there is little change in men’s entry. I provide evidence that the increase in women is due to changes in labour supply, rather than labour demand. At the residency program level, I document that baseline female representation predicts female entry after the reform. A back-of-the-envelope calculation suggests that the reallocation of women among medical specialties due to the hours reduction can close the physician gender wage gap by 11$\%$.

10.1093/restud/rdac042.abstractZh: 许多高薪职业所需的长时间工作是否阻碍了女性的进入？我通过研究2003年的一项政策来解决这个问题，该政策将医学住院医师的平均工作周限制为80小时。利用美国医学院毕业生的数据，我发现当某个专业减少每周的工作时间时，更多的女性会进入该专业，而男性进入该专业的比例几乎没有变化。我有证据表明，女性数量的增加是由于劳动力供应的变化，而非劳动力需求的变化。在住院医师项目层面，我发现，改革后女性代表的基线比例能够预测女性进入该专业的数量。粗略计算表明，由于工作时间减少，女性在医学专业之间的重新分配可以将医生性别工资差距缩小11%。

abstract.text: Entrepreneurs and venture capitalists are concerned about investors’ beliefs in asset markets because these beliefs shape the value of a potential IPO and the possibility to expand. Investors’ beliefs, on the other hand, can be influenced by start-up activity insofar as the latter contains valuable information about eventual profitability. This two-way feedback is shown to generate excessive, non-fundamental, waves in start-up activity, IPOs, and asset prices. Policies that “lean against the wind” can improve welfare, without requiring an informational advantage by the government.

10.1093/restud/rdac043.abstractZh: 企业家和风险投资者非常关注投资者对资产市场的看法，因为这些看法会影响潜在IPO的价值以及扩张的可能性。另一方面，投资者的看法会受到初创企业活动的影响，因为后者包含了关于未来盈利能力的宝贵信息。这种双向反馈会导致初创企业活动、IPO和资产价格出现过度、非基本的波动。采取“逆风而行”的政策可以在不要求政府拥有信息优势的情况下改善福利。

abstract.text: We study dynamic matching in exchange markets with easy- and hard-to-match agents. A greedy policy, which attempts to match agents upon arrival, ignores the positive externality that waiting agents provide by facilitating future matchings. We prove that the trade-off between a “thicker” market and faster matching vanishes in large markets; the greedy policy leads to shorter waiting times and more agents matched than any other policy. We empirically confirm these findings in data from the National Kidney Registry. Greedy matching achieves as many transplants as commonly used policies (1.8$\%$ more than monthly batching) and shorter waiting times (16 days faster than monthly batching).

10.1093/restud/rdac044.abstractZh: 我们研究了具有易匹配和难匹配代理的交换市场中的动态匹配问题。一种贪婪的策略在代理到达时尝试进行匹配，却忽视了等待代理通过促进未来匹配所提供的积极外部性。我们证明，在大型市场中，“更厚”的市场结构和更快的匹配效果之间的权衡消失了；贪婪策略能够缩短等待时间，并使更多代理得到匹配，优于任何其他策略。我们通过国家肾脏登记处的数据证实了这些发现。贪婪匹配方式所实现的移植数量与常用策略相当（比按月批量处理多1.8%），并且等待时间也更短（比按月批量处理快16天）。

abstract.text: We present a test of Coasean theories of efficient separations. We study a cohort of jobs from the introduction through the repeal of a large age- and region-specific unemployment benefit extension in Austria. In the treatment group, 18.5$\%$ fewer jobs survive the program period. According to the Coasean view, the destroyed marginal jobs had low joint surplus. Hence, after the repeal, the treatment survivors should be more resilient than the ineligible control group survivors. Strikingly, the two groups instead exhibit identical post-repeal separation behaviour. We provide, and find suggestive evidence consistent with, an alternative model in which wage rigidity drives the inefficient separation dynamics.

10.1093/restud/rdac045.abstractZh: 我们测试了科斯关于有效分离的理论。我们研究了一组在奥地利实施并废除大规模针对年龄和地区的失业救济金扩展政策后，相关工作的变化情况。在实验组中，有18.5%的工作在政策实施期间消失。根据科斯的观点，被取消的边际工作其联合剩余较低。因此，废除政策后，实验组中的幸存者应该比不符合条件的对照组幸存者有更强的韧性。令人惊讶的是，两组在废除政策后的分离行为却完全相同。我们提供了一些与另一种模型一致的、具有启发性的证据，该模型认为工资刚性导致了无效的分离现象。

abstract.text: We provide two characterizations, one axiomatic and the other neuro-computational, of the dependence of choice probabilities on deadlines, within the widely used softmax representation $$\begin{align*} p_{t}\left( a,A\right) =\dfrac{e^{\frac{u\left( a\right) }{\lambda\left( t\right) }+\alpha\left( a\right) }}{\sum_{b\in A}e^{\frac{u\left( b\right) }{\lambda\left( t\right) }+\alpha\left( b\right) }}, \end{align*}$$ where $p_{t}\left( a,A\right)$ is the probability that alternative $a$ is selected from the set $A$ of feasible alternatives if $t$ is the time available to decide, $\lambda$ is a time-dependent noise parameter measuring the unit cost of information, $u$ is a time-independent utility function, and $\alpha$ is an alternative-specific bias that determines the initial choice probabilities (reflecting prior information and memory anchoring). Our axiomatic analysis provides a behavioural foundation of softmax (also known as Multinomial Logit Model when $\alpha$ is constant). Our neuro-computational derivation provides a biologically inspired algorithm that may explain the emergence of softmax in choice behaviour. Jointly, the two approaches provide a thorough understanding of softmaximization in terms of internal causes (neuro-physiological mechanisms) and external effects (testable implications).

10.1093/restud/rdac046.abstractZh: 我们提供了两种对选择概率与截止时间依赖性的描述，一种是基于公理的，另一种则是基于神经计算的。在广泛使用的softmax表示中，选择概率可以表示为：$$\begin{align*} p_{t}\left( a,A\right) =\dfrac{e^{\frac{u\left( a\right) }{\lambda\left( t\right) }+\alpha\left( a\right) }}{\sum_{b\in A}e^{\frac{u\left( b\right) }{\lambda\left( t\right) }+\alpha\left( b\right) }}, \end{align*}$$其中，$p_{t}\left( a,A\right)$表示在可用时间为$t$时，从可行方案集合$A$中选择方案$a$的概率。$\lambda$是一个随时间变化的噪声参数，用于衡量获取信息的单位成本；$u$是一个与时间无关的效用函数；$\alpha$则是特定方案的偏好因子，它决定了初始选择概率（反映了先前的信息和记忆锚定）。我们的公理分析为softmax模型提供了行为基础（当$\alpha$为常数时，也称为多项逻辑模型）。而基于神经计算的推导则提供了一种受生物学启发的算法，可以解释softmax模型在选择行为中的出现。这两种方法共同为我们提供了对softmax模型内部原因（神经生理机制）和外部影响（可验证的推论）的全面理解。

abstract.text: This article develops a discrete choice model of demand with optimal sequential consumer search. Consumers first choose a product to search; then, once they learn the utility they get from the searched product, they choose whether to buy it or to keep searching. We characterize the search problem as a standard discrete choice problem and propose a parametric search cost distribution that generates closed-form expressions for the probability of purchasing a product. We propose a method to estimate the model that supplements aggregate product data with individual-specific data which allows for the separate identification of search costs and preferences. We estimate the model using data from the automobile industry and find that search costs have non-trivial implications for elasticities and markups. We study the effects of exclusive dealing regulation and find that firms benefit at the expense of consumers, who face higher search costs and higher prices than would be the case if multi-brand dealerships were used.
