10.1093/restud/rdac047.abstractZh: 本文发展了一个离散选择模型，用于描述具有最优顺序消费者搜索的需求行为。消费者首先选择一个产品进行搜索；一旦他们了解从该产品获得的效用后，就会决定是购买该产品还是继续搜索。我们将搜索问题视为一个标准的离散选择问题，并提出了一种参数化的搜索成本分布模型，该模型能够给出购买产品概率的封闭形式表达式。我们提出了一种方法来估计模型，该方法结合了总体产品数据与个体数据，从而能够分别识别搜索成本和偏好。我们使用汽车行业的数据对模型进行了估计，发现搜索成本对弹性和价格加成有着重要的影响。我们还研究了独家交易法规的影响，发现企业通过牺牲消费者的利益来获益，消费者面临的搜索成本更高，价格也高于使用多品牌经销商的情况。

abstract.text: Recent work has demonstrated that existing solutions of the unemployment volatility puzzle are at odds with the procylicality of the opportunity cost of employment, the cyclicality of wages, and the volatility of risk-free rates. We propose a model of business cycles that is immune to these critiques by incorporating two key features. First, we allow for preferences that generate time-varying risk over the business cycle to account for observed fluctuations in asset prices. Second, we introduce human capital acquisition, as is consistent with the evidence on how wages grow with experience in the labor market. Our model reproduces the observed fluctuations in unemployment because hiring a worker is a risky investment with long-duration returns. As in the data, the price of risk in our model sharply increases in recessions. The benefit from hiring new workers therefore greatly declines, leading to a large decrease in job vacancies and an increase in unemployment of the same magnitude as in the data. We show that our results extend to versions of the model that include physical capital, a life cycle for workers, and alternative preference structures common in the asset-pricing literature.

10.1093/restud/rdac048.abstractZh: 近期的研究表明，现有的失业波动问题解决方案与就业机会成本的周期性、工资的周期性以及无风险利率的波动性相矛盾。我们提出了一个商业周期模型，该模型通过引入两个关键特征来抵御这些批评。首先，我们允许偏好随时间变化，以解释资产价格中的波动现象。其次，我们引入了人力资本积累的概念，这与劳动力市场中关于工资随经验增长的相关证据是一致的。我们的模型能够再现失业的波动现象，因为雇佣工人是一项具有长期回报的风险投资。与数据一致，在我们的模型中，风险的价格在经济衰退期间急剧上升。因此，雇佣新工人的收益大幅下降，导致职位空缺大幅减少，失业率也出现与数据相同的增幅。我们表明，我们的结果同样适用于包含实物资本、工人的生命周期以及资产定价文献中常见的其他偏好结构的模型版本。

abstract.text: By exploiting new macroeconomic data known as foreign affiliates statistics, we show that affiliates of foreign multinational firms are an order of magnitude more profitable than local firms in a number of low-tax countries. Leveraging this differential profitability, we estimate that 36$\%$ of multinational profits are shifted to tax havens globally. US multinationals shift twice as much profit as other multinationals relative to the size of their foreign earnings. We analyse how the location of corporate profits would change if shifted profits were reallocated to their source countries. Domestic profits would increase by about 20$\%$ in high-tax European Union countries, 10$\%$ in the US, and 5$\%$ in developing countries, while they would fall by 55$\%$ in tax havens. We provide a new international database of GDP, trade balances, and factor shares corrected for profit shifting. In contrast to the picture painted by official statistics, our results suggest that the corporate capital share has increased not only in North America but also in high-tax European countries. Capital is making a comeback globally, but its rise is obscured by the tax avoidance strategies of multinational companies.

10.1093/restud/rdac049.abstractZh: 通过利用被称为“外国子公司统计数据”的新宏观经济数据，我们发现，在许多低税国家中，外国跨国公司的子公司比本地企业高出数个数量级的盈利能力。利用这种差异化的盈利能力，我们估计全球有36%的跨国企业利润被转移到了避税天堂。与美国跨国企业相比，其他跨国企业在其海外收入中所占的利润比例要高出两倍。我们分析了如果利润被重新分配到其来源国，企业利润的分布将会如何变化。在高税的欧盟国家，国内利润将增加约20%，在美国增加10%，在发展中国家增加5%，而在避税天堂则下降55%。我们提供了一个新的国际数据库，包含经过利润转移修正后的GDP、贸易平衡和要素份额数据。与官方统计数据所描绘的情况不同，我们的结果表明，不仅北美地区的企业资本份额有所上升，高税欧洲国家的企业资本份额也有所增加。资本在全球范围内正在重新崛起，但其增长被跨国公司的避税策略所掩盖。

abstract.text: We study the impact of changing choice set size on the quality of choices in health insurance markets. Using novel data on enrolment and medical claims for school district employees in the state of Oregon, we document that the average employee could save $600 by switching to a lower cost plan. Structural modelling reveals large “choice inconsistencies” such as non-equalization of the dollar spent on premiums and out of pocket, and a novel form of “approximate inertia” where enrolees are excessively likely to switch to other plans that are close to the current plan on the plan design spreadsheet. Variation in the number of plan choices across districts and over time shows that enrolees make lower-cost choices when the choice set is smaller. We show that a curated restriction of choice set size improves choices more than the best available information intervention, partly because approximate inertia lowers gains from new information. We explicitly test and reject the assumption that this is because individuals choose worse from larger choice sets, or “choice overload”. Rather, we show that this feature arises from the fact that larger choice sets feature worse choices on average that are not offset by individual re-optimization.

10.1093/restud/rdac050.abstractZh: 我们研究了选择集大小变化对医疗保险市场选择质量的影响。利用俄勒冈州学区员工注册和医疗索赔的新数据，我们发现平均每位员工通过选择成本较低的计划可以节省600美元。结构模型显示存在严重的“选择不一致性”，例如保费支出和自付费用的不均衡分配，以及一种新型的“近似惯性”现象，即参与者极有可能选择与当前计划在设计表格上相近的其他计划。不同地区以及随时间变化的计划选择数量差异表明，当选择集较小时，参与者会做出成本较低的选择。我们指出，对选择集大小进行限制比提供最佳信息更能改善选择质量，部分原因是近似惯性降低了新信息的收益。我们明确测试并否定了这种现象是因为个体在更大的选择集中选择了更差的选择，即“选择过载”的假设。相反，我们发现这一特征源于更大的选择集平均而言包含更差的选择，而这些选择并未被个体的重新优化所抵消。

abstract.text: In the US, the federal government grants colleges access to a student’s Free Application for Federal Student Aid (FAFSA) which facilitates substantial price discrimination. This article is the first to estimate the consequences of allowing colleges to use the FAFSA in their pricing decisions. I build and estimate a structural model of college pricing and simulate counterfactuals wherein some or all of the FAFSA information is restricted. I find that if FAFSA information were restricted, 13$\%$ of students attending elite colleges would be inefficiently priced out of the elite market. Nevertheless, student welfare would rise as colleges charged the majority of students lower prices. Colleges do use the FAFSA to transfer resources from high- to low-income students on average, but this redistribution is highly imprecise: allowing colleges to use the FAFSA harms one-third of low-income students while one in seven high-income students actually benefit.

10.1093/restud/rdac051.abstractZh: 在美国，联邦政府允许大学获取学生的联邦学生援助申请文件（FAFSA），从而进行实质性的价格歧视。本文首次估算了允许大学在定价决策中使用FAFSA所带来的后果。我构建并估计了一个大学定价的结构模型，并模拟了在限制部分或全部FAFSA信息的情况下的情况。研究发现，如果限制使用FAFSA信息，13%就读于精英大学的学生将被不公平地排除在精英市场之外。然而，随着大学向大多数学生收取较低的价格，学生的福利反而会提高。大学确实会利用FAFSA将资源从高收入学生转移到低收入学生身上，但这种再分配的效果并不精确：允许大学使用FAFSA会使三分之一的低收入学生受损，而七分之一的高收入学生实际上会受益。

abstract.text: A patient seller interacts with a sequence of myopic consumers. Each period, the seller chooses the quality of his product, and a consumer decides whether to trust the seller after she observes the seller’s actions in the last $K$ periods (limited memory) and at least one previous consumer’s action (observational learning). However, the consumer cannot observe the seller’s action in the current period. With positive probability, the seller is a commitment type who plays his Stackelberg action in every period. I show that under limited memory and observational learning, consumers are concerned that the seller will not play his Stackelberg action when he has a positive reputation and will play his Stackelberg action after he has lost his reputation. Such a concern leads to equilibria where the seller receives a low payoff from building a reputation. I also show that my reputation failure result hinges on consumers’ observational learning.

10.1093/restud/rdac052.abstractZh: 一个表现良好的销售者与一系列目光短浅的消费者互动。每个时期，销售者都会选择产品的质量，而消费者则根据过去$K$个时期的销售行为（受限于记忆能力）以及至少一位前消费者的行为来决定是否信任销售者（基于观察学习）。然而，消费者无法观察到销售者当前时期的行动。有正概率的情况下，销售者属于承诺型行为者，会在每个时期都采取他的斯塔克伯格策略。我证明了在有限记忆和观察学习的情况下，消费者会担心销售者在拥有良好声誉时不会采取斯塔克伯格策略，而在声誉受损后会采取该策略。这种担忧导致了销售者在建立声誉时获得的收益较低。我还表明，销售者声誉受损的结果取决于消费者的观察学习。

abstract.text: We estimate the dynamic causal effects of consumer sentiment shocks in the US. We identify autonomous changes in survey evidence on consumer confidence using fatalities in mass shootings as an instrument. We find the instrument to be significant for an aggregate index of consumer expectations and also back up the identification scheme with micro evidence that exploits the geographical variation in mass shootings. Sentiment shocks have real macroeconomic effects. A negative sentiment shock is recessionary: It sets off a persistent decline in consumer confidence and induces a contraction in industrial production, private sector consumption and in the labour market, while having less evident nominal effects. Finally, sentiment shocks explain a non-negligible part of the cyclical fluctuations in consumer confidence and real macroeconomic aggregates.

10.1093/restud/rdac053.abstractZh: 我们估算了美国消费者情绪冲击的动态因果效应。我们通过将大规模枪击事件作为工具变量，来识别消费者信心调查中出现的自主变化。我们发现该工具变量对消费者预期的整体指数具有显著影响，并且通过利用大规模枪击事件在地理上的差异，进一步验证了这一识别方案的有效性。情绪冲击具有实际的宏观经济效应。负面的情绪冲击会引发经济衰退：它会导致消费者信心的持续下降，并促使工业生产、私营部门消费以及劳动力市场的收缩，而其名义效应则较为不明显。最后，情绪冲击解释了消费者信心和实际宏观经济总量波动中不可忽视的部分。

abstract.text: We introduce a portfolio friction in a two-country DSGE model where investors face a constant probability to make new portfolio decisions. The friction leads to a more gradual portfolio adjustment to shocks and a weaker portfolio response to changes in expected excess returns. We apply the model to monthly data for the US and the rest of the world for equity portfolios. We show that the model is consistent with a broad set of evidence related to portfolios, equity prices, and excess returns for an intermediate level of friction. The evidence includes portfolio inertia, limited sensitivity to expected excess returns, a significant impact of financial shocks, excess return predictability, and asset price momentum and reversal.

10.1093/restud/rdac054.abstractZh: 我们在一个双国DSGE模型中引入了一种投资组合摩擦，投资者面临持续进行新投资组合决策的概率。这种摩擦导致投资组合对冲击的响应更加缓慢，对预期超额回报变化的反应也更为迟钝。我们将该模型应用于美国和全球其他地区的月度股票投资组合数据，结果表明该模型与一系列与投资组合、股票价格和超额回报相关的证据一致，尤其是在中等程度的摩擦作用下。这些证据包括投资组合的惯性、对预期超额回报的有限敏感性、金融冲击的显著影响、超额回报的可预测性以及资产价格的趋势和反转。

abstract.text: We examine how 17 behavioural biases relate to each other, to three standard measures of risk and time preferences, to cognitive skills, personality, and demographics, and to outcomes in household finance, well-being, and health. Most consumers in our nationally representative panel data exhibit multiple biases, with substantial cross-person heterogeneity. Biases are positively correlated within person, especially after adjusting for measurement error. From that correlation structure, we reduce our 20 bias and standard preference measures to four behavioural common factors. Each BCF reflects a group of related biases regarding beliefs, decision quality, discounting, or risk/uncertainty attitudes. The first two BCFs also strongly correlate with each other (positively) and cognitive skills (negatively). The first three BCFs and cognitive skills strongly correlate with various outcomes in the expected directions. Our results support processing-based models where basic limitations in cognition and/or attention produce multiple biases, and they have several other implications for theory and practice.

10.1093/restud/rdac055.abstractZh: 我们研究了17种行为偏差之间是如何相互关联的，以及它们与三种标准的风险衡量方式、时间偏好、认知技能、人格特征以及人口统计特征之间的关系，同时还考察了这些偏差对家庭金融、福祉和健康等方面的影响。我们全国代表性样本数据中的大多数消费者表现出多种行为偏差，且个体间的差异相当显著。这些偏差在个体内部呈正相关，尤其是在调整了测量误差之后。基于这种相关性结构，我们将20种偏差和标准偏好衡量方式简化为四个行为共同因素。每个行为共同因素都反映了一组与信念、决策质量、折现或风险/不确定性态度相关的偏差。前两个行为共同因素之间也呈正相关，并且与认知技能呈负相关。前三个行为共同因素以及认知技能与各种结果之间存在强烈的关联。我们的研究结果支持了基于处理过程的模型，即认知和/或注意力的基本限制导致了多种行为偏差的产生，这些结果对理论和实践也有重要意义。

abstract.text: Developing artificial intelligence (AI) technology requires data. In many domains, government data far exceed in magnitude and scope data collected by the private sector, and AI firms often gain access to such data when providing services to the state. We argue that such access can stimulate commercial AI innovation in part because data and trained algorithms are shareable across government and commercial uses. We gather comprehensive information on firms and public security procurement contracts in China’s facial recognition AI industry. We quantify the data accessible through contracts by measuring public security agencies’ capacity to collect surveillance video. Using a triple-differences strategy, we find that data-rich contracts, compared to data-scarce ones, lead recipient firms to develop significantly and substantially more commercial AI software. Our analysis suggests a contribution of government data to the rise of China’s facial recognition AI firms, and that states’ data collection and provision policies could shape AI innovation.

10.1093/restud/rdac056.abstractZh: 发展人工智能技术需要数据。在许多领域，政府收集的数据在规模和范围上远远超过私营部门收集的数据，而人工智能公司通常在为政府提供服务时能够获得这些数据。我们认为，这种获取途径能够在一定程度上促进商业人工智能的创新，因为数据和训练好的算法可以在政府和商业用途之间共享。我们收集了关于中国面部识别人工智能行业中的企业和公共安全采购合同的全面信息。我们通过衡量公共安全机构收集监控视频的能力来量化通过合同可获取的数据。利用三重差分策略，我们发现，与数据匮乏的合同相比，数据丰富的合同能够促使接收企业开发出更多且更先进的商业人工智能软件。我们的分析表明，政府数据对中国面部识别人工智能企业的崛起起到了推动作用，而各州的数据收集与提供政策也可能影响人工智能的创新。

abstract.text: This article develops a model to explore how favour exchange influences wealth dynamics. We identify a key obstacle to wealth accumulation: wealth crowds out favour exchange. Therefore, households must choose between growing their wealth and accessing favour exchange. We show that low-wealth households rely on favour exchange at the cost of having tightly limited long-term wealth. As a result, initial wealth disparities persist and can even grow worse. We then explore how communities and policymakers can overcome this obstacle. Using simulations, we show that community benefits and place-based policies can stimulate both saving and favour exchange, and in some cases, can even transform favour exchange into a force that accelerates wealth accumulation.

10.1093/restud/rdac057.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个模型，以探讨财富交换如何影响财富动态。我们发现了一个阻碍财富积累的关键障碍：财富会抑制财富交换。因此，家庭必须在增加财富和获取财富交换之间做出选择。研究表明，财富较低的家庭往往依赖财富交换，而长期财富增长受到限制。结果，初始的财富差距会持续存在，甚至可能会加剧。接下来，我们探讨了社区和政策制定者如何克服这一障碍。通过模拟实验，我们发现社区福利和基于地点的政策可以刺激储蓄和财富交换，在某些情况下，甚至可以将财富交换转化为加速财富积累的力量。

abstract.text: We propose a method to estimate static discrete games with weak assumptions on the information available to players. We do not fully specify the information structure of the game but allow instead for all information structures consistent with players knowing their own payoffs. To make this approach tractable, we adopt as a solution concept Bayes correlated equilibrium (BCE). We characterize the sharp identified set under BCE and unrestricted equilibrium selection, and find that in simple games with limited variation in covariates identified sets are informative. In an application, we estimate a model of entry in the Italian supermarket industry and quantify the effect of large malls on local supermarkets. Estimates and predictions differ from those obtained under more restrictive assumptions.

10.1093/restud/rdac058.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种方法，用于在对玩家可用信息的假设较为宽松的情况下，估计静态离散博弈。我们并未完全明确博弈的信息结构，而是允许所有与玩家了解自身收益相一致的信息结构。为了使这种方法可行，我们采用了贝叶斯相关均衡作为解决方案概念。我们描述了在贝叶斯相关均衡和无限制均衡选择下的精确识别集合，并发现，在协变量变化有限的简单博弈中，识别集合具有信息价值。在一个应用中，我们估计了意大利超市行业的进入模型，并量化了大型商场对本地超市的影响。得到的估计值和预测值与在更严格的假设下得到的结果有所不同。

abstract.text: The historical transition to a low fertility regime was central for long-run growth, but what caused it? Existing economic explanations largely focus on the economic incentives to limit fertility. This article presents new evidence highlighting the importance of cultural forces as a complementary driver of the fertility transition. We leverage a sharp change in fertility in Britain in 1877 and document large synchronized declines in fertility among culturally British households residing outside of Britain, in Canada, the US, and South Africa, relative to their non-British neighbours. We propose a plausible catalyst for the change: the famous Bradlaugh–Besant trial of 1877.

10.1093/restud/rdac059.abstractZh: 向低生育率制度的历史转变对长期增长至关重要，但究竟是什么导致了这一转变呢？现有的经济解释大多集中在限制生育的经济激励因素上。本文提出了新的证据，强调文化因素作为生育转变的辅助驱动因素的重要性。我们利用了1877年英国生育率发生的显著变化，并记录了居住在英国以外地区、加拿大、美国和南非的具有英国文化特征的家庭，与其非英国邻居相比，生育率出现了大规模同步下降。我们认为，1877年的布拉德劳-贝桑审判可能是这一变化的合理催化剂。

abstract.text: We quantify intergenerational and assortative processes by comparing different degrees of kinship within the same generation. This “horizontal” approach yields more, and more distant kinship moments than traditional methods, which allows us to account for the transmission of latent advantages in a detailed intergenerational model. Using Swedish registers, we find strong persistence in the latent determinants of status, and a striking degree of sorting—to explain the similarity of distant kins, assortative matching must be much stronger than previously thought. Latent genetic influences explain little of the variance in educational attainment, and sorting occurs primarily in non-genetic factors.

10.1093/restud/rdac060.abstractZh: 我们通过比较同一代内不同亲缘关系的程度，来量化代际间和选择性匹配的过程。这种“横向”方法能够获取比传统方法更多、更遥远的亲缘关系信息，从而让我们能够在详细的代际模型中考虑潜在优势的传递。利用瑞典的登记数据，我们发现地位的潜在决定因素具有强烈的持久性，并且存在显著的排序现象——要解释远距离亲属之间的相似性，选择性匹配的作用必须比之前认为的更为显著。遗传因素的影响在教育成就的变异中作用较小，而排序现象主要发生在非遗传因素上。

abstract.text: We present a new class of methods for identification and inference in dynamic models with serially correlated unobservables, which typically imply that state variables are econometrically endogenous. In the context of Industrial Organization, these state variables often reflect econometrically endogenous market structure. We propose the use of Generalized Instrument Variables methods to identify those dynamic policy functions that are consistent with instrumental variable (IV) restrictions. Extending popular “two-step” methods, these policy functions then identify a set of structural parameters that are consistent with the dynamic model, the IV restrictions and the data. We provide computed illustrations to both single-agent and oligopoly examples. We also present a simple empirical analysis that, among other things, supports the counterfactual study of an environmental policy entailing an increase in sunk costs.

10.1093/restud/rdac061.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的方法，用于识别和推断具有序列相关不可观测变量的动态模型中的参数，这些变量通常意味着状态变量是经济计量学上的内生变量。在产业组织的背景下，这些状态变量往往反映了经济计量学上的市场结构。我们建议使用广义工具变量方法来识别与工具变量约束一致的动态政策函数。通过扩展流行的“两步法”，这些政策函数能够识别一组与动态模型、工具变量约束和数据一致的结构参数。我们提供了计算示例，用于单个代理和寡头垄断案例的分析。我们还进行了一项简单的实证分析，该分析支持了关于环境政策导致沉没成本增加的反事实研究。

abstract.text: Do productivity and managerial quality vary within the firm? If so which managerial traits and practices matter most for team productivity? Combining granular garment production data with survey data on managers across 120 production lines in India, we document substantial productivity dispersion both across teams producing overlapping products and within team over the course of production runs, and structurally link this variation to a comprehensive assessment of supervisor quality. We find that factors related to managerial attention and control are the most important for enabling line productivity, both more impactful than traditionally emphasized dimensions like cognitive skills and tenure. We document that one mechanism by which specific managerial practices contribute to productivity is by way of enabling faster learning-by-doing. In-sample pay patterns suggest potential net gains from screening for or training in less readily measured dimensions of managerial quality, as pass-through of productivity contributions to pay is incomplete.

10.1093/restud/rdac062.abstractZh: 公司的内部生产力和管理质量是否存在差异？如果存在，哪些管理特质和做法对团队生产力最为重要？我们结合了对印度120条生产线中管理人员的调查数据以及详细的服装生产数据，发现无论是在生产重叠产品的团队之间，还是在同一团队内，生产力都存在显著的差异。我们将这种差异与对主管质量的全面评估联系起来。我们发现，与管理和控制相关的因素对于提高生产线生产力最为重要，其影响甚至超过了传统上认为的诸如认知技能和任期等维度。我们还发现，某些管理实践通过促进更快的“边做边学”来提高生产力。样本中的薪酬模式表明，通过筛选或培训那些不易衡量的管理质量维度，可能会带来潜在的净收益，因为生产力对薪酬的传递并不完全。

abstract.text: This article presents a model of quantitative easing (QE) at the zero lower bound (ZLB) on the short-term nominal interest rate. QE, which reduces the maturity of government debt, is effective at the ZLB because it generates expectations of future monetary expansion in a time-consistent equilibrium. Numerical experiments show that this effect can be substantial.

10.1093/restud/rdac063.abstractZh: 本文提出了一个在零下限条件下对短期名义利率实施量化宽松的模型。量化宽松通过延长政府债务的期限，在零下限条件下具有有效性，因为它能在时间一致的均衡状态下引发对未来货币扩张的预期。数值实验表明，这种效应可能是显著的。

abstract.text: This article sets out a data-driven approach for targeting environmental policies optimally in order to combat deforestation. We focus on the Amazon, the world’s most extensive rainforest, where Brazil’s federal government issued a “Priority List” of municipalities in 2008—a blacklist to be targeted with more intense environmental monitoring and enforcement. First, we estimate the causal impact of the Priority List on deforestation (along with other relevant treatment effects) using “changes-in-changes” due to Athey and Imbens (2006), finding that it reduced deforestation by 43$\%$ and cut emissions by almost 50 million tons of carbon. Second, we develop a novel framework for computing targeted optimal blacklists that draws on our treatment effect estimates, assigning municipalities to a counterfactual list that minimizes total deforestation subject to realistic resource constraints. We show that the ex post optimal list would result in carbon emissions over 10$\%$ lower than the actual list, amounting to savings of more than $ \$ $1.2 billion (34$\%$ of the total value of the Priority List), with emissions over 23$\%$ lower on average than a randomly selected list. The approach we propose is relevant both for assessing targeted counterfactual policies to reduce deforestation and for quantifying the impacts of policy targeting more generally.

10.1093/restud/rdac064.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种基于数据的优化环境政策的方法，以有效应对森林砍伐问题。我们重点关注亚马逊雨林，这是世界上最大的热带雨林。2008年，巴西联邦政府发布了一份“优先清单”，将某些市镇列入黑名单，以便对这些市镇实施更严格的环保监管。首先，我们利用Athey和Imbens（2006年）提出的“变化-变化”方法，估算了该优先清单对森林砍伐的因果影响，以及其他相关处理效应。结果显示，该清单使森林砍伐减少了43%，碳排放减少了近5000万吨。其次，我们开发了一种新的框架，用于计算有针对性的最优黑名单。该框架基于我们的处理效应估计结果，将市镇分配到一个反事实清单中，以在现实资源限制下最小化总森林砍伐量。研究表明，实际的最优清单将使碳排放比实际清单降低10%以上，节省资金超过12亿美元（占优先清单总价值的34%），平均碳排放比随机选择的清单低23%以上。我们提出的方法不仅适用于评估旨在减少森林砍伐的针对性反事实政策，也适用于更一般性地量化政策目标的影响。

abstract.text: The rise of opinion programs has transformed television news. Because they present anchors’ subjective commentary and analysis, opinion programs often convey conflicting narratives about reality. We experimentally document that people across the ideological spectrum turn to opinion programs over “straight news”, even when provided large incentives to learn objective facts. We then examine the consequences of diverging narratives between opinion programs in a high-stakes setting: the early stages of the COVID-19 pandemic in the US. We find stark differences in the adoption of preventative behaviours among viewers of the two most popular opinion programs, both on the same network, which adopted opposing narratives about the threat posed by the COVID-19 pandemic. We then show that areas with greater relative viewership of the program downplaying the threat experienced a greater number of COVID-19 cases and deaths. Our evidence suggests that opinion programs may distort important beliefs and behaviours.

10.1093/restud/rdac065.abstractZh: 意见节目的兴起已经改变了电视新闻的形式。由于这些节目呈现的是主播的主观评论和分析，因此往往传达出关于现实的相互矛盾的观点。我们通过实验发现，即使提供大量获取客观事实的激励措施，不同意识形态的人群仍然更倾向于观看意见节目。接着，我们研究了在高风险环境下，不同意见节目之间不同的叙事所带来的后果——即美国COVID-19疫情初期的情况。我们发现，在同一网络平台上，两个最受欢迎的意见节目观众在采取预防行为方面存在显著差异，这两个节目对COVID-19疫情带来的威胁有着截然不同的描述。进一步分析发现，那些观看了淡化疫情威胁的节目的地区，COVID-19病例和死亡人数更多。我们的证据表明，意见节目可能会扭曲人们的重要信念和行为。

abstract.text: Throughout the Western world, people’s policy views are correlated across domains in a strikingly similar fashion. This article proposes that what partly explains the structure of ideology is moral universalism: the extent to which people exhibit the same level of altruism and trust towards strangers as towards in-group members. In new large-scale multinational surveys, heterogeneity in universalism descriptively explains why some people support redistribution, health care, environmental protection, affirmative action, and foreign aid, while others advocate for spending on the military, law enforcement, and border protection. Universalism is a substantially stronger predictor of policy views and ideological constraints than variables such as income, wealth, education, religiosity, or beliefs about government efficiency. Consistent with the idea that universalism shapes policy views, we further document that the left–right divide on redistribution, environmental protection, or foreign aid strongly attenuates or even reverses when people evaluate less universalist implementations of these policies.

10.1093/restud/rdac066.abstractZh: 在西方世界，人们的政策观点在不同领域之间呈现出极为相似的模式。本文提出，意识形态结构的部分原因在于道德上的普遍主义：即人们表现出与对待内部群体成员相同的利他主义和信任程度。在新的大规模跨国调查中，普遍主义的差异解释了为什么有些人支持再分配、医疗保健、环境保护、平权行动和对外援助，而另一些人则主张将资金用于军事、执法和边境保护。普遍主义作为政策观点和意识形态约束的显著预测因素，其重要性远超收入、财富、教育、宗教倾向或政府效率信念等变量。与普遍主义塑造政策观点的观点一致，我们还发现，当人们认为这些政策的实施缺乏普遍主义时，左右翼在再分配、环境保护或对外援助问题上的分歧会显著减弱，甚至逆转。

abstract.text: This article studies career spillovers across workers, which arise in firms with limited promotion opportunities. We exploit a 2011 Italian pension reform that unexpectedly tightened eligibility criteria for the public pension, leading to sudden, substantial, and heterogeneous retirement delays. Using administrative data on Italian private-sector workers, the analysis leverages cross-firm variation to isolate the effect of retirement delays among soon-to-retire workers on the wage growth and promotions of their colleagues. We find evidence of spillover patterns consistent with older workers blocking the careers of their younger colleagues, but only in firms with limited promotion opportunities.

10.1093/restud/rdac067.abstractZh: 本文研究了在晋升机会有限的企业中，员工之间存在的职业溢出效应。我们利用了2011年意大利养老金改革带来的意外变化——该改革突然收紧了公共养老金的资格标准，导致退休时间出现突然、显著且异质性的延迟。通过利用意大利私营部门员工的行政数据，我们分析了企业间的差异，以分离出退休延迟对同事工资增长和晋升的影响。我们发现，这种溢出效应与年长员工阻碍年轻同事职业发展的情况一致，但这种现象仅发生在晋升机会有限的企业中。

abstract.text: This article studies the optimal design of corporate taxes when firms have private information about future investment opportunities and face financial constraints. A government whose goal is to efficiently raise a given amount of revenue from its corporate sector should attempt to tax unconstrained firms, which value resources inside the firm less than financially constrained firms. We show that a corporate payout tax (a tax on dividends and share repurchases) can both separate constrained and unconstrained firms and raise revenue and is therefore optimal. Our quantitative analysis implies that a revenue-neutral switch from profit taxation to payout taxation would increase the overall value of existing firms and new entrants by $7\%$. This switch could be implemented in the current US tax system by making retained earnings fully deductible.

10.1093/restud/rdac068.abstractZh: 本文研究了在企业拥有关于未来投资机会的私人信息且面临财务约束的情况下，企业税的最优设计问题。一个旨在有效从企业部门征收一定数额税收的政府，应该对资源价值低于财务约束企业的企业征税。我们证明，对企业分红和股票回购征税可以同时区分约束企业和无约束企业，并增加税收收入，因此这是最优的。我们的定量分析表明，将税收从利润税转换为分红税，可以在不增加税收负担的情况下，使现有企业和新进入者的整体价值增加7%。这一转变可以通过在当前的美国税收体系中允许留存收益完全抵税来实施。

abstract.text: Short-time work (STW) policies provide subsidies for hour reductions to workers in firms experiencing temporary shocks. They are the main policy tool used to support labour hoarding during downturns and were aggressively used during the coronavirus disease 2019 (COVID-19) pandemic. Yet, very little is known about their employment and welfare consequences. This article leverages unique administrative social security data from Italy and quasi-experimental variation in STW policy rules to offer evidence on the effects of STW on firms’ and workers’ outcomes during the Great Recession. Our results show large and significant negative effects of STW treatment on hours, but large and positive effects on headcount employment. We then analyse whether these positive employment effects are welfare enhancing, distinguishing between temporary and more persistent shocks. We first provide evidence that liquidity constraints and rigidities in wages and hours may make labour hoarding inefficiently low without STW. Then, we show that adverse selection of low productivity firms into STW reduces the long-run insurance value of the program and creates significant negative reallocation effects when the shock is persistent.

10.1093/restud/rdac069.abstractZh: 短时工作政策为遭遇临时冲击的企业的工人提供减时补贴。这是在经济衰退期间支持劳动力囤积的主要政策工具，在2019年冠状病毒病疫情期间得到了积极运用。然而，关于这些政策对就业和福利的影响，我们知之甚少。本文利用意大利独特的行政社会保障数据以及短时工作政策规则的准实验变化，来探讨短时工作政策在大衰退期间对企业及工人结果的影响。我们的研究结果显示，短时工作政策对工时有显著且负面的影响，但对员工人数的就业率则有显著的正面影响。接着，我们分析了这些正面就业效应是否提升了福利，并区分了临时冲击和持续性冲击的情况。首先，我们证明了流动性限制以及工资和工时的刚性可能导致没有短时工作政策的情况下，劳动力囤积效率低下。然后，我们发现，将低生产力企业纳入短时工作政策会导致该政策的长期保险价值降低，并且在冲击持续的情况下，会造成显著的负面重新分配效应。

abstract.text: We study a decision-framing design problem: a principal faces an agent with frame-dependent preferences and designs an extensive form with a frame at each stage. This allows the principal to circumvent incentive compatibility constraints by inducing dynamically inconsistent choices of the sophisticated agent. We show that a vector of contracts can be implemented if and only if it can be implemented using a canonical extensive form, which has a simple high–low–high structure using only three stages and the two highest frames, and employs unchosen decoy contracts to deter deviations. We then turn to the study of optimal contracts in the context of the classic monopolistic screening problem and establish the existence of a canonical optimal mechanism, even though our implementability result does not directly apply. In the presence of naive types, the principal can perfectly screen by cognitive type and extract full surplus from naifs.

10.1093/restud/rdac070.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个决策框架设计问题：一个主体面对一个具有框架依赖偏好的代理人，并设计了一个在每个阶段都有框架的扩展形式。这允许主体通过诱导代理人做出动态不一致的选择来规避激励相容性约束。我们证明，如果合同向量能够使用一种规范性的扩展形式来实施，那么这种合同向量就能被实施。这种规范性扩展形式具有简单的高-低-高结构，仅包含三个阶段和两个最高层次的框架，并且采用未选择的诱饵合同来阻止偏离。接着，我们研究了经典垄断筛选问题中的最优合同，并证明了即使我们的实施性结果并不直接适用，也存在一个规范性的最优机制。在存在天真类型的情况下，主体可以通过认知类型来完美筛选，并从天真类型中获取全部收益。

abstract.text: We study the susceptibility of committee governance (e.g. by boards of directors), modelled as the collective determination of a ranking of a set of alternatives, to manipulation of the order in which pairs of alternatives are voted on—agenda-manipulation. We exhibit an agenda strategy called insertion sort that allows a self-interested committee chair with no knowledge of how votes will be cast to do as well as if she had complete knowledge. Strategies with this “regret-freeness” property are characterized by their efficiency, and by their avoidance of two intuitive errors. What distinguishes regret-free strategies from each other is how they prioritize among alternatives; insertion sort prioritizes lexicographically.

10.1093/restud/rdac071.abstractZh: 我们研究了委员会治理（例如由董事会进行）的易受影响性，将其模型化为对一组备选方案进行排序的集体决策过程，以及这种排序顺序在投票时对备选方案对的操控——即议程操控。我们提出了一种称为“插入排序”的议程策略，该策略允许一个不了解投票方式的自私性委员会主席表现得与完全了解情况的人一样好。具有这种“无遗憾性”特性的策略以其效率著称，并且避免了两个直观的错误。使无遗憾策略彼此区分开来的是它们在备选方案之间的优先级排序方式；插入排序按照字典顺序进行优先级排序。

abstract.text: We find strong empirical evidence that the liquidity yield on government bonds in combination with standard economic fundamentals can well account for nominal exchange rate movements. We find impressive evidence that changes in the liquidity yield are significant in explaining exchange rate changes for all the G10 countries, and we stress that the US dollar is not special in this relationship. We show how these relationships arise out of a canonical two-country New Keynesian model with liquidity returns. Additionally, we find a role for sovereign default risk and currency swap market frictions.

10.1093/restud/rdac072.abstractZh: 我们发现有强有力的实证证据表明，政府债券的流动性收益率结合标准经济基本因素，能够很好地解释名义汇率的变动。我们发现，流动性收益率的变化在解释所有G10国家的汇率变动方面具有显著作用，并且我们强调美元在这种关系中并不特殊。我们还展示了这些关系是如何从具有流动性回报的规范型双国新凯恩斯模型中产生的。此外，我们发现主权违约风险和货币互换市场摩擦也在其中起到了作用。

abstract.text: We study list price competition when firms can individually target consumer discounts (at a cost) afterwards, and we address recent privacy regulation (like the GDPR) allowing consumers to choose whether to opt-in to targeting. Targeted consumers receive poaching and retention discount offers. Equilibrium discount offers are in mixed strategies, but only two firms vie for each contested consumer and final profits on them are Bertrand-like. When targeting is unrestricted, firm list pricing resembles monopoly. For plausible demand conditions and if targeting costs are not too low, firms and consumers are worse off with unrestricted targeting than banning it. However, targeting induces higher (lower) list prices if demand is convex (concave), and either side of the market can benefit if list prices shift enough in its favour. Given the choice, consumers opt in only when expected discounts exceed privacy costs. Under empirically plausible conditions, opt-in choice makes all consumers better off.

10.1093/restud/rdac073.abstractZh: 我们研究了在企业可以事后单独针对消费者进行折扣定价时的价格竞争情况。同时，我们也关注了近期的一些隐私法规（如GDPR），这些法规允许消费者选择是否同意被定向营销。接受定向营销的消费者会收到吸引和保留客户的折扣优惠。在均衡状态下，各企业采取混合策略，但每家企业只与两家企业竞争，最终的利润遵循伯特兰竞争模型。当定向营销不受限制时，企业的定价方式类似于垄断。在合理的需求条件下，如果定向营销的成本不是太低，那么不受限制的定向营销反而会让企业和消费者处于更不利的地位。然而，如果需求是凸函数或凹函数，定向营销会导致更高的（更低的）定价。市场的任何一方都可以从中受益，只要定价足够向有利于自己的方向变动。在权衡利弊之后，消费者只有在预期折扣超过隐私成本时才会选择同意定向营销。在符合实际条件的假设下，同意定向营销会使所有消费者的状况得到改善。

abstract.text: We obtain optimal dynamic contests for environments where the designer monitors effort through coarse, binary signals—Poisson successes—and aims to elicit maximum effort, ideally in the least amount of time possible, given a fixed prize. The designer has a vast set of contests to choose from, featuring termination and prize-allocation rules together with real-time feedback for the contestants. Every effort-maximizing contest (which also maximizes total expected successes) has a history-dependent termination rule, a feedback policy that keeps agents fully apprised of their own success, and a prize-allocation rule that grants them, in expectation, a time-invariant share of the prize if they succeed. Any contest that achieves this effort in the shortest possible time must in addition be what we call second chance: once a pre-specified number of successes arrive, the contest enters a countdown phase where contestants are given one last chance to succeed.

10.1093/restud/rdac074.abstractZh: 我们为那些设计者通过粗略的二进制信号（即泊松成功）来监控努力程度的环境，设计了最优的动态竞赛机制。设计者的目标是在给定的固定奖金下，尽可能在最短的时间内激发出最大的努力。设计者拥有丰富的竞赛选项可供选择，这些选项包括终止规则、奖金分配规则以及实时反馈机制，以便让参赛者了解自己的表现。每一个能够最大化努力的竞赛（同时也最大化了总预期成功次数）都包含一个依赖于历史数据的终止规则、能够让参与者充分了解自身成功的反馈机制，以及一种奖金分配规则，该规则在预期中为成功者提供了时间不变的奖金份额。任何能够在最短时间内实现这一目标的竞赛，还必须具备我们所说的“第二次机会”机制：一旦达到预先指定的成功次数，竞赛将进入倒计时阶段，为参与者提供最后一次成功的机会。

abstract.text: We use administrative and survey-based micro data to study the relationship between cognitive abilities (IQ), the formation of inflation expectations, and the consumption plans of a representative male population. High-IQ men display 50 $\%$ lower forecast errors for inflation than other men. High-IQ men, but not others, have consistent inflation expectations and perceptions over time. In terms of choice, only high-IQ men increase their consumption propensity when expecting higher inflation as the consumer Euler equation prescribes. Education levels, income, other expectations, and socio-economic status, although important, do not explain the variation in expectations and choice by IQ. Recent modelling attempts to incorporate boundedly rational agents into macro models do not fully capture all the facts we document. We discuss which dimensions of expectations formation and choice are important for heterogeneous-agents models of household consumption and for the transmission of fiscal and monetary policy.

10.1093/restud/rdac075.abstractZh: 我们利用行政数据和调查数据来研究认知能力（智商）、通胀预期的形成以及代表性男性人口的消费计划之间的关系。智商较高的男性在通胀预测方面的误差比其他男性低50%。智商较高的男性，而非其他男性，其通胀预期和认知随时间保持稳定。在选择方面，只有智商较高的男性在预期通胀上升时会增加消费倾向，正如消费者欧拉方程所预测的那样。教育水平、收入、其他预期以及社会经济地位虽然重要，但无法解释不同智商水平下预期和选择的差异。最近将有限理性代理纳入宏观经济模型的尝试并未完全捕捉到我们所记录的所有事实。我们讨论了预期形成和选择中的哪些维度对于异质代理模型中的家庭消费以及财政和货币政策的传导至关重要。

abstract.text: Technological change, from the advent of robots to expanded trade opportunities, creates winners and losers. How should government policy respond? We provide a general theory of optimal technology regulation in a second-best world, with rich heterogeneity across households, linear taxes on the subset of firms affected by technological change, and a non-linear tax on labour income. Our first set of results consists of optimal tax formulas, with minimal structural assumptions, involving sufficient statistics that can be implemented using evidence on the distributional impact of new technologies, such as robots and trade. Our final results are comparative static exercises illustrating, among other things, that while distributional concerns create a rationale for non-zero taxes on robots and trade, the magnitude of these taxes may decrease as the process of automation and globalization deepens and inequality increases.

10.1093/restud/rdac076.abstractZh: 技术变革，从机器人的出现到贸易机会的扩大，都会产生赢家和输家。政府政策应该如何应对？我们提出了一个关于次优世界中最优技术监管的一般理论，该理论考虑了家庭之间的丰富异质性、对受技术变革影响的企业子集的线性税收，以及对劳动收入的非线性税收。我们的首批结果包括最优税收公式，这些公式在结构假设最小的情况下，涉及可以使用关于新技术（如机器人和技术变革带来的贸易）的分配影响的证据来实施的充分统计量。我们的最终结果是通过比较静态分析得出的结论，这些结论表明，虽然分配问题为对机器人和贸易征收非零税收提供了理由，但随着自动化和全球化进程的深入以及不平等的加剧，这些税收的幅度可能会降低。

abstract.text: Agents learn about a changing state using private signals and their neighbours’ past estimates of the state. We present a model in which Bayesian agents in equilibrium use neighbours’ estimates simply by taking weighted sums with time-invariant weights. The dynamics thus parallel those of the tractable DeGroot model of learning in networks, but arise as an equilibrium outcome rather than a behavioural assumption. We examine whether information aggregation is nearly optimal as neighbourhoods grow large. A key condition for this is signal diversity: each individual’s neighbours have private signals that not only contain independent information, but also have sufficiently different distributions. Without signal diversity—e.g. if private signals are i.i.d.—learning is suboptimal in all networks and highly inefficient in some. Turning to social influence, we find it is much more sensitive to one’s signal quality than to one’s number of neighbours, in contrast to standard models with exogenous updating rules.

10.1093/restud/rdac077.abstractZh: 代理通过使用私人信号以及邻居对状态的过去估计来了解状态的变化。我们提出了一个模型，其中处于均衡状态的贝叶斯代理只需通过加权求和的方式使用邻居的估计值，而加权权重是时间不变的。因此，这种动态与可处理的DeGroot网络学习模型类似，但它是作为均衡结果出现的，而不是作为行为假设。我们研究了随着邻域规模扩大，信息聚合是否接近最优。这一条件的一个关键因素是信号多样性：每个个体的邻居拥有不仅包含独立信息，而且分布差异足够大的私人信号。如果没有信号多样性——例如，如果私人信号是独立同分布的——那么在所有网络中学习都是次优的，在某些网络中甚至效率极低。关于社会影响，我们发现它对于信号质量的敏感度远高于邻居数量，这与具有外部更新规则的标准模型不同。

abstract.text: We study whether long-term cumulative exposure to airborne small particulate matter (PM2.5) affects the probability that an individual receives a new diagnosis of Alzheimer's disease or related dementias. We track the health, residential location, and PM2.5 exposures of Americans aged sixty-five and above from 2001 through 2013. The expansion of Clean Air Act regulations led to quasi-random variation in individuals’ subsequent exposures to PM2.5. We leverage these regulations to construct instrumental variables for individual-level decadal PM2.5 that we use within flexible probit models that also account for any potential sample selection based on survival. We find that a 1 µg/m3 increase in decadal PM2.5 increases the probability of a new dementia diagnosis by an average of 2.15 percentage points (pp). All else equal, we find larger effects for women, older people, and people with more clinical risk factors for dementia. These effects persist below current regulatory thresholds.

10.1093/restud/rdac078.abstractZh: 我们研究了长期累积暴露于空气中微小颗粒物（PM2.5）是否会影响个体被诊断出阿尔茨海默病或相关痴呆症的概率。我们跟踪了2001年至2013年间65岁及以上美国人的健康状况、居住地点以及PM2.5暴露情况。清洁空气法案规定的扩展导致个体随后暴露于PM2.5的情况出现准随机变化。我们利用这些法规构建了个体级别的十年PM2.5指标变量，并将其用于灵活Probit模型中，同时考虑了基于生存分析的潜在样本选择问题。研究发现，十年PM2.5浓度每增加1微克/立方米，新诊断出痴呆症的概率平均增加2.15个百分点。在其他条件相同的情况下，我们发现女性、老年人以及具有更多痴呆症临床风险因素的人群受到的影响更大。这些效应在当前的监管阈值以下仍然持续存在。

abstract.text: Financial sector wages have increased extraordinarily over the last decades. We address two potential explanations for this increase: (1) rising demand for talent and (2) firms sharing rents with their employees. Matching administrative data of Swedish workers, which include unique measures of individual talent, with financial information on their employers, we find no evidence that talent in finance improved, neither on average nor at the top. The increase in relative finance wages is present across talent and education levels, which together can explain at most 20% of it. In contrast, rising financial sector profits that are shared with employees account for up to half of the relative wage increase. The limited labour supply response may partly be explained by the importance of early-career entry and social connections in finance. Our findings alleviate concerns about “brain drain” into finance but suggest that finance workers have captured rising rents over time.

10.1093/restud/rdac079.abstractZh: 过去几十年里，金融行业的工资水平出现了异常增长。我们提出了两种可能的解释：(1)对人才需求的上升；(2)企业与员工之间分享租金的现象。通过对比瑞典工人的行政数据（其中包含个人才能的独特衡量指标）与他们的雇主的金融信息，我们发现金融领域的才能水平并未提升，无论是在平均水平还是顶尖人才层面都是如此。相对金融行业工资的上升存在于不同才能和教育水平的人群中，但这可能只能解释其中20%的薪资增长。相比之下，与员工共享的金融行业利润的增长则占到了相对工资增长的一半。有限的劳动力供应反应可能部分是由于职业生涯早期进入金融行业的重要性以及社交关系在金融行业中的重要性。我们的研究结果缓解了对人才流失到金融行业的担忧，但表明金融行业的员工随着时间的推移逐渐获得了更高的租金。

abstract.text: I study unemployment insurance (UI) in general equilibrium with incomplete markets, search frictions, and nominal rigidities. An increase in generosity raises the aggregate demand for consumption if the unemployed have a higher marginal propensity to consume than the employed or if agents precautionary save in light of future income risk. This raises output and employment unless monetary policy raises the nominal interest rate. In an analysis of the U.S. economy over 2008–2014, UI benefit extensions had a contemporaneous output multiplier around 1. The unemployment rate would have been as much as 0.4 pp higher absent these extensions.

10.1093/restud/rdac080.abstractZh: 我研究在不完全市场、搜索摩擦和名义刚性条件下的一般均衡下失业保险的作用。如果失业者的消费边际倾向高于就业者，或者由于对未来收入的风险而采取预防性储蓄，那么提高失业保险的慷慨程度会提升消费总需求。这会增加产出和就业，除非货币政策导致名义利率上升。在2008至2014年美国经济分析中发现，失业保险福利的扩展使产出乘数约为1。如果没有这些扩展，失业率将高出0.4个百分点。

abstract.text: How do housing and family shape the savings, spending, and inter-generational transfer behaviour of the elderly? Using the Health and Retirement Study, we document that inter-generational transfers to children are substantially backloaded, that homeowners dis-save much more slowly than renters but often sell their houses when entering a nursing home, and that care by children slows down nursing home entry and is linked to larger bequests, particularly of housing. To rationalise these facts, we develop a dynamic, non-cooperative model of the family with an indivisible housing asset and joint bargaining between elderly parents and their children over the housing and care arrangements of the parents. The model generates realistic savings and care choices and matches the timing of transfers and home liquidations. A key novelty is the housing-as-commitment channel: In the absence of long-run family contracts, housing provides a commitment device for more efficient savings. We find that this channel increases homeownership in old age by one-third and families’ willingness to pay for houses by 5–10%. This mechanism also facilitates informal care, slows down spending, and leads to larger bequests, implications that we support empirically.

10.1093/restud/rdac081.abstractZh: 住房和家庭如何塑造老年人的储蓄、消费以及代际转移行为？通过“健康与退休研究”，我们发现，对子女的代际转移往往被推迟，房主比租户更缓慢地减少储蓄，但在进入养老院时往往会出售房屋。子女提供的照顾行为会减缓进入养老院的时间，并与更大的遗产相关，尤其是住房方面的遗产。为了解释这些现象，我们建立了一个动态的非合作家庭模型，其中家庭拥有不可分割的住房资产，老年父母与子女在住房及照顾安排上通过共同协商来解决问题。该模型能够生成现实的储蓄和照顾选择，并匹配转移和房屋清算的时间。一个关键的新颖之处在于“住房作为承诺机制”：在没有长期家庭契约的情况下，住房提供了一种更有效的储蓄承诺手段。我们发现，这一机制使老年时期拥有住房的可能性增加了三分之一，家庭支付房屋费用的意愿也提高了5-10%。这一机制还促进了非正式的照顾行为，减缓了消费，并导致更大的遗产，这些结论得到了我们的实证支持。

abstract.text: Firms arguably price at ninety-nine-ending prices because of left-digit bias—the tendency of consumers to perceive a $4.99 as much lower than a $5.00. Analysis of retail scanner data on 3500 products sold by twenty-five U.S. chains provides robust support for this explanation. I structurally estimate the magnitude of left-digit bias and find that consumers respond to a one-cent increase from a ninety-nine-ending price as if it were more than a twenty-cent increase. Next, I solve a portable model of optimal pricing given left-digit biased demand. I use this model and other pricing procedures to estimate the level of left-digit bias retailers perceive when making their pricing decisions. While all retailers respond to left-digit bias by using ninety-nine-ending prices, their behaviour is consistently at odds with the demand they face. Firms price as if the bias were much smaller than it is, and their pricing is more consistent with heuristics and rule-of-thumb than with optimization given the structure of demand. I calculate that retailers forgo 1–4% of potential gross profits due to this coarse response to left-digit bias.

10.1093/restud/rdac082.abstractZh: 企业之所以会定价为以99结尾的价格，是因为“左位数字偏见”——即消费者倾向于认为4.99美元的价格比5.00美元的价格要低得多。对25家美国连锁店销售的3500种产品的零售扫描数据进行分析，为这一解释提供了有力的支持。我系统地估算了左位数字偏见的程度，发现消费者对于从99结尾的价格中增加1美分的反应，就像增加20美分一样强烈。接下来，我建立了一个考虑左位数字偏见需求的最优定价模型。利用该模型和其他定价方法，我估算了零售商在做出定价决策时感知到的左位数字偏见的程度。虽然所有零售商都会因左位数字偏见而采用99结尾的价格，但他们的行为始终与他们面临的需求相矛盾。企业定价时认为这种偏见要小得多，而他们的定价方式更接近于经验法则和直觉判断，而不是基于需求结构的优化决策。我计算出，由于这种对左位数字偏见的粗略反应，零售商放弃了1%到4%的潜在总利润。

abstract.text: This paper proposes an adaptive randomisation procedure for two-stage randomised controlled trials. The method uses data from a first-wave experiment in order to determine how to stratify in a second wave of the experiment, where the objective is to minimise the variance of an estimator for the average treatment effect. We consider selection from a class of stratified randomisation procedures which we call stratification trees: these are procedures whose strata can be represented as decision trees, with differing treatment assignment probabilities across strata. By using the first wave to estimate a stratification tree, we simultaneously select which covariates to use for stratification, how to stratify over these covariates, and the assignment probabilities within these strata. Our main result shows that using this randomisation procedure with an appropriate estimator results in an asymptotic variance which is minimal in the class of stratification trees. Moreover, our results are able to accommodate a large class of assignment mechanisms within strata, including stratified block randomisation. In a simulation study, we find that our method, paired with an appropriate cross-validation procedure, can improve on ad-hoc choices of stratification. We conclude by applying our method to the study in Karlan and Wood (2017, Journal of Behavioral and Experimental Economics, vol. 66, 1–8), where we estimate stratification trees using the first wave of their experiment.

10.1093/restud/rdac083.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种适用于两阶段随机对照试验的自适应随机化程序。该方法利用第一波实验的数据来确定在第二波实验中的分层方式，其目的是最小化平均处理效应估计量的方差。我们考虑了从一类分层随机化程序中选择一种方法，我们称之为分层树：这类程序中的分层可以表示为决策树，不同层级的处理分配概率各不相同。通过利用第一波实验的数据来估计分层树，我们可以同时确定用于分层的协变量、分层方式以及各层级内的分配概率。我们的主要结果表明，使用这种随机化程序并结合适当的估计量，可以使得在分层树类别中，渐近方差达到最小。此外，我们的结果能够适应多种层级分配机制，包括分层块随机化。在模拟研究中，我们发现该方法结合适当的交叉验证程序，可以改进传统的分层选择方法。最后，我们将该方法应用于Karlan和Wood在2017年发表于《行为与实验经济学杂志》上的研究，在该研究中，我们使用第一波实验数据来估计分层树。

abstract.text: We study robust mechanism design in environments in which agents commonly believe that others’ types are identically distributed, but we do not assume that the actual distribution is common knowledge, nor that it is known to the designer. First, we characterize all incentive compatible transfers under these assumptions. Second, we characterize the conditions under which full implementation is possible via direct mechanisms, that only elicit payoff relevant information, and the transfer schemes which achieve it whenever possible. The full implementation results obtain from showing that the problem can be transformed into one of designing a network of strategic externalities, subject to suitable constraints which are dictated by the incentive compatibility requirements.

10.1093/restud/rdac084.abstractZh: 我们研究了在这样一种环境下的稳健机制设计：代理人通常认为其他人的类型分布是均匀分布的，但我们并不假设实际的分布是普遍已知的，也不假设设计者知道这一分布。首先，我们描述了在这些假设下所有激励相容的转移方式。其次，我们描述了通过直接机制实现完全实施的条件，这些机制仅引出与收益相关的信息，以及尽可能实现这种转移方案的条件。完全实施的结果是通过证明该问题可以转化为设计一个战略外部性网络的问题而获得的，前提是满足激励相容性要求所设定的适当约束。

abstract.text: Under the production approach to markup estimation, any flexible input should recover the markup. I test this implication using manufacturing datasets from Chile, Colombia, India, Indonesia, the U.S., and Southern Europe, as well as store-level data from a major U.S. retailer, and overwhelmingly reject that markups estimated using labour and materials have the same distribution. For every dataset, markups estimated using labour are negatively correlated with markups estimated using materials, exhibit greater dispersion, and have opposite time trends. I continue to find stark differences in markups estimated using energy and non-energy raw materials. Non-neutral productivity differences across firms can explain these findings.

10.1093/restud/rdad002.abstractZh: 在基于生产方法的加价估算中，任何灵活的投入都应该能够反映加价情况。我使用来自智利、哥伦比亚、印度、印度尼西亚、美国和南欧的制造业数据集，以及一家美国大型零售商的门店级数据来检验这一结论。结果表明，使用劳动力和材料估算的加价分布并不相同。对于每一个数据集，使用劳动力估算的加价与使用材料估算的加价呈负相关，且后者具有更大的离散度，同时两者的时间趋势也相反。我进一步发现，使用能源和非能源原材料估算的加价也存在显著差异。企业间非中立的生产率差异可以解释这些现象。

abstract.text: Safe asset shortages can expose an economy to liquidity traps. The nature of these traps is determined by the cyclicality of the bond premium. A counter-cyclical bond premium opens the possibility of expectations-driven liquidity traps in which small issuances of government debt crowd out private debt and reduce output. In contrast, when the bond premium is pro-cyclical and the economy is in a liquidity trap, government debt is expansionary. In the data, we find evidence of a counter-cyclical bond premium. Large interventions can prevent the emergence of self-fulfilling traps, but they require sufficient fiscal capacity. In a quantitative model calibrated to the Great Recession, a promise to increase the government debt-to-GDP ratio by 20 percentage points precludes the possibility of self-fulfilling traps.

10.1093/restud/rdad003.abstractZh: 安全资产短缺可能会使经济陷入流动性陷阱。这些陷阱的性质取决于债券溢价的周期性特征。反周期性的债券溢价可能导致由预期驱动的流动性陷阱，在这种情况下，政府债务的少量发行会挤占私人债务，从而降低产出。相反，当债券溢价具有顺周期性，且经济处于流动性陷阱时，政府债务会起到扩张性作用。在数据中，我们发现存在反周期性的债券溢价。大规模的干预可以防止自我实现的陷阱的出现，但这需要足够的财政能力。在一个针对大衰退进行校准的定量模型中，承诺将政府债务与GDP的比例提高20个百分点，可以排除自我实现陷阱的可能性。

abstract.text: We show that moment inequalities in a wide variety of economic applications have a particular linear conditional structure. We use this structure to construct uniformly valid confidence sets that remain computationally tractable even in settings with nuisance parameters. We first introduce least-favorable critical values which deliver non-conservative tests if all moments are binding. Next, we introduce a novel conditional inference approach which ensures a strong form of insensitivity to slack moments. Our recommended approach is a hybrid technique which combines desirable aspects of the least favorable and conditional methods. The hybrid approach performs well in simulations calibrated to Wollmann (2018, American Economic Review, 108, 1364–1406), with favorable power and computational time comparisons relative to existing alternatives.

10.1093/restud/rdad004.abstractZh: 我们证明了在多种经济应用中，矩不等式具有特定的线性条件结构。我们利用这一结构构建了一致的置信集，这些置信集即使在存在干扰参数的情况下也能保持计算上的可行性。首先，我们介绍了最不利的临界值，这些临界值在所有矩都起约束作用时，能够提供非保守的检验。接下来，我们提出了一种新颖的条件推断方法，该方法能够确保对松弛矩的强不敏感性。我们推荐的方法是混合技术，结合了最不利条件和条件方法的优点。在针对Wollmann（2018年，《美国经济评论》，108卷，1364-1406页）的模拟中，这种混合方法表现良好，其检验功效和计算时间都比现有替代方法更有优势。

abstract.text: Multiproduct firms constitute a considerable share of firms and account for an even greater share of production. Nevertheless, the vast majority of production function estimates are based on the assumption that firms are single-product manufacturers. This assumption is due to a lack of data on how firms allocate their inputs across their various product lines. I provide a strategy for estimating product-specific input allocations and production functions of multiproduct firms involved in monopolistic competition. The strategy is based on using firms’ product prices and output demand in solving for product-level input allocations.

10.1093/restud/rdad005.abstractZh: 多产品企业占企业总数的相当大比例，其生产量也占据更大的份额。然而，绝大多数关于生产函数的估计都是基于企业是单一产品制造商这一假设。这一假设源于缺乏关于企业如何将其投入分配到不同产品线上的数据。我提出了一种估算参与垄断竞争的多产品企业的特定产品投入分配和生产函数的策略。该策略基于使用企业的产品价格和产出需求来求解产品级别的投入分配。

abstract.text: We use regional variation in the American Recovery and Reinvestment Act (2009–12) to analyse the effect of government spending on consumer spending. Our consumption data come from household-level retail purchases in the Nielsen scanner data and auto purchases from Equifax credit balances. We estimate that a $1 increase in county-level government spending increases local non-durable consumer spending by $0.29 and local auto spending by $0.09. We translate the regional consumption responses to an aggregate fiscal multiplier using a multi-region, new Keynesian model with heterogeneous agents, incomplete markets, and trade linkages. Our model is consistent with the estimated positive local multiplier, a result that distinguishes our incomplete markets model from models with complete markets. At the zero lower bound, the aggregate consumption multiplier is twice as large as the local multiplier because trade linkages propagate the effect of government spending across regions.

10.1093/restud/rdad007.abstractZh: 我们利用《美国复苏与再投资法案》（2009–12年）中的地区差异来分析政府支出对消费支出的影响。我们的消费数据来自Nielsen扫描数据中的家庭级零售购买，以及Equifax信用余额中的汽车购买数据。我们估计，县级政府支出每增加1美元，当地非耐用品消费支出将增加0.29美元，当地汽车支出将增加0.09美元。我们将地区消费反应转化为总体财政乘数，使用了一个多地区、新凯恩斯主义模型，该模型包含异质代理人、不完全市场以及贸易联系。我们的模型与估计出的正向当地乘数一致，这一结果将我们的不完全市场模型与完全市场模型区分开来。在零下限条件下，总体消费乘数是当地乘数的两倍，因为贸易联系将政府支出的影响传播到各个地区。

abstract.text: I study how geography shaped city formation and aggregate development in the U.S. prior to the Civil War. To guide my analysis, I present a conjecture that cities’ farm hinterlands fostered both city development and aggregate growth: the hinterland hypothesis. The hinterland hypothesis has rich implications on how various elements of U.S. geography—railroads, changes in U.S. political borders, and international trade—affected city formation and U.S. growth. To evaluate the hinterland hypothesis and its implications, I assemble a novel historical dataset on population, trading routes, and agricultural productivity at a high spatial resolution. I combine the data with a dynamic quantitative model of economic geography that yields the hinterland hypothesis as a prediction. I find evidence for the hinterland hypothesis by showing that the model can replicate the key patterns of U.S. urbanization and city formation. Finally, I conduct a series of counterfactuals in the model to quantify the effect of geography on cities and growth, guided by the implications of the hinterland hypothesis. Results indicate that railroads were responsible for 1.8% of urban population in 1860 and for 25% of real GDP growth between 1830 and 1860. The effect of international trade was similar in magnitude, while the effect of political border changes was small during the period.

10.1093/restud/rdad008.abstractZh: 我研究的是在南北战争之前，地理因素如何塑造了美国的城市形成和整体发展。为了指导我的分析，我提出了一个假设：城市的农业腹地促进了城市的发展和整体增长。这一假设对美国地理的各种因素——如铁路、美国政治边界的变化以及国际贸易——如何影响城市形成和美国的发展具有重要意义。为了验证这一假设及其影响，我收集了一个关于人口、贸易路线和农业生产力的高空间分辨率的历史数据集。我将这些数据与一个动态的经济地理定量模型相结合，从而验证了这一假设。通过模型，我发现该模型能够再现美国城市化和城市形成的关键模式，从而证明了这一假设的正确性。最后，我在模型中进行了一系列反事实分析，以量化地理因素对城市和增长的影响。结果表明，铁路在1860年时占城市人口的1.8%，在1830年至1860年间则贡献了25%的实际GDP增长。国际贸易的影响幅度与此类似，而政治边界变化的影响则相对较小。

abstract.text: We assess the impact of a rapid rise in Japanese import competition on the growth in racial earnings and employment gaps during the 1970s and 80s. Using commuting zone level variation in exposure, we find Japanese competition led to a decrease in manufacturing employment and labour force participation for blacks. This was driven by a shift in demand for skill in manufacturing. The difference in effects between the 10th percentile most and least exposed commuting zone was equivalent to 36–46% of the relative rise in black non-labour force participation, and 78–96% of the relative decline in black median male earnings.

10.1093/restud/rdad009.abstractZh: 我们评估了1970年代和80年代日本进口竞争迅速加剧对种族收入增长和就业差距的影响。通过考察通勤区域之间的暴露程度差异，我们发现日本竞争导致制造业就业和黑人劳动力参与率的下降。这一变化是由制造业对技能需求的变化所驱动的。在通勤区域暴露程度最高的第10百分位数与最低的第10百分位数之间，黑人非劳动力参与率相对增长的幅度相当于36%至46%，而黑人男性中位数收入相对下降的幅度则相当于78%至96%。

abstract.text: We study the effects of central bank balance sheet policies—namely, quantitative easing and foreign exchange interventions—in a model where people form expectations through an iterative level-k thinking process. We emphasize two main theoretical results. First, under a broad set of conditions, central bank interventions are effective under level-k thinking, while they are neutral in the rational expectations equilibrium. Second, when preferences exhibit constant relative risk aversion, asset purchases increase aggregate output if they target assets with pro-cyclical returns but reduce it if asset returns are counter-cyclical. Finally, we empirically show that forecast errors about future asset prices are predictable by balance sheet interventions, a property that differentiates our channel from popular alternatives, such as portfolio-balance and signaling channels.

10.1093/restud/rdad010.abstractZh: 我们研究了中央银行资产负债表政策——即量化宽松和外汇干预——在人们通过迭代的层次k思维过程形成预期的情况下所产生的影响。我们强调了两个主要理论成果。首先，在一系列条件下，中央银行干预在层次k思维下是有效的，而在理性预期均衡中则保持中性。其次，当偏好表现出恒定的相对风险厌恶时，如果资产购买目标是具有顺周期回报的资产，则会增加总产出；如果资产回报是逆周期性的，则会减少总产出。最后，我们通过实证研究表明，关于未来资产价格的预测误差可以通过资产负债表干预来预测，这一特性使得我们的分析渠道与流行的替代方案，如投资组合平衡和信号传递渠道有所不同。

abstract.text: This paper documents an externality from the agricultural use of the most widely applied herbicide in the world—glyphosate—on birth outcomes of surrounding populations. We focus on the subclinical effects of water contamination in areas distant from the original locations of application. Our identification relies on: (i) the regulation allowing the introduction of genetically modified seeds in Brazil; (ii) the potential gain in municipality-level productivity from adoption of genetically modified soybean seeds and the strong complementary between these seeds and glyphosate; and (iii) the direction of water flow within water basins. We document a significant deterioration in birth outcomes for populations downstream from locations that are likely to have increased relatively more the use of glyphosate. According to our preferred specification, the average increase in glyphosate use in the sample during 2000–10 period led to an increase of 5% of the average in infant mortality rate.

10.1093/restud/rdad011.abstractZh: 本文记录了全球应用最广泛的除草剂——草甘膦——在农业领域的使用对周边人口出生结果的影响。我们重点关注远离施用地点的地区中，水污染对健康的亚临床影响。我们的研究基于以下因素：(i) 巴西允许引入转基因种子的法规；(ii) 采用转基因大豆种子可能带来的市级生产力提升，以及这些种子与草甘膦之间的强互补性；(iii) 流域内的水流方向。我们发现，在那些草甘膦使用量相对增加较多的地区，下游人口的出生结果显著恶化。根据我们的分析，2000至2010年间，草甘膦使用量的平均增加导致婴儿死亡率平均上升了5%。

abstract.text: We combine matched employer–employee data with firms’ financial records to study a 2001 Italian reform that lifted constraints on the employment of temporary contract workers while maintaining rigid employment protection regulations for employees hired under permanent contracts. Exploiting the staggered implementation of the reform across different collective bargaining agreements, we find that this policy change led to an increase in the share of temporary contracts but failed to raise employment. The reform had both winners and losers. Firms are the main winners as the reform was successful in decreasing labor costs, leading to higher profits. By contrast, young workers are the main losers since their earnings were substantially depressed following the policy change. Rent-sharing estimates show that temporary workers receive only two-thirds of the rents shared by firms with permanent workers, helping explain most of the labor costs and earnings reductions caused by the reform.

10.1093/restud/rdad012.abstractZh: 我们结合雇主与员工的数据以及企业的财务记录，研究2001年意大利的一项改革。该改革取消了临时合同员工的就业限制，同时保留了针对长期合同员工的严格就业保护规定。通过对比不同集体谈判协议中改革的实施时间，我们发现这一政策变化虽然增加了临时合同的比例，但并未提升就业人数。这项改革既有受益者也有受损者。企业是主要的受益者，因为改革成功降低了劳动力成本，从而提高了利润。相比之下，年轻工人则是主要的受损群体，因为他们的收入在政策变化后大幅下降。租金共享的估计表明，临时员工的租金仅相当于企业长期合同员工租金的三分之二，这解释了改革导致的大部分劳动力成本和收入减少的原因。

abstract.text: We provide a novel explanation for the empirical failure of the capital asset pricing model (CAPM) despite its widespread practical use. In a rational-expectations economy in which information is dispersed, variation in expected returns over time and across investors creates an informational gap between investors and the empiricist. The CAPM holds for investors, but the securities market line appears flat to the empiricist. Variation in expected returns across investors accounts for the larger part of this distortion, which is empirically substantial; it offers a new interpretation of why “betting against beta” (BAB) works: BAB really bets on true beta. The empiricist retrieves a stronger CAPM on days when public information reduces disagreement among investors.

10.1093/restud/rdad013.abstractZh: 我们为资本资产定价模型（CAPM）在实践中的失败提供了一个新的解释，尽管该模型被广泛使用。在一个信息分散的理性预期经济中，不同投资者之间的预期回报变化造成了投资者与实证分析者之间的信息差距。CAPM对投资者来说适用，但对实证分析者而言，证券市场线似乎并不明显。不同投资者之间的预期回报差异是这种扭曲的主要原因，这种扭曲在实证上非常显著；这为我们理解“逆贝塔策略”（BAB）为何有效提供了新的解释：BAB实际上是在赌真正的贝塔值。当公开信息减少了投资者之间的分歧时，实证分析者会得出更强的CAPM结论。

abstract.text: Left-digit bias (or 99-cent pricing) has been discussed extensively in economics, psychology, and marketing. Despite this, we show that the rideshare company, Lyft, was not using a 99-cent pricing strategy prior to our study. Based on observational data from over 600 million Lyft sessions followed by a field experiment conducted with 21 million Lyft passengers, we provide evidence of large discontinuities in demand at dollar values. Approximately half of the downward slope of the demand curve occurs discontinuously as the price of a ride drops below a dollar value (e.g. $14.00 to $13.99). If our short-run estimates persist in the longer run, we calculate that Lyft could increase its profits by roughly $160M per year by employing a left-digit bias pricing strategy. Our results showcase the robustness of an important behavioral bias for a large, modern company and its persistence in a highly competitive market.

10.1093/restud/rdad014.abstractZh: 左位数字偏好（或99美分定价）在经济学、心理学和市场营销领域已有广泛讨论。然而，我们发现拼车公司Lyft在研究中之前并未采用99美分定价策略。基于超过6亿次Lyft行程的观测数据，以及针对2100万乘客进行的实地实验，我们发现了需求在美元价值上存在显著的不连续性。需求曲线下降过程中，大约一半的下降幅度发生在价格降至1美元以下时（例如，从14美元降至13.99美元）。如果我们的短期估计在长期内仍然成立，那么Lyft通过采用左位数字偏好定价策略，每年可以增加约1.6亿美元的利润。我们的研究结果展示了这种重要行为偏好的稳健性，以及它在高度竞争市场中的持久性。

abstract.text: We assess the welfare consequences of occupational licensing for workers and consumers. We estimate a model of labour market equilibrium in which licensing restricts labour supply but also affects labour demand via worker quality and selection. On the margin of occupations licensed differently between U.S. states, we find that licensing raises wages and hours but reduces employment. We estimate an average welfare loss of 12% of occupational surplus. Workers and consumers respectively bear 70% and 30% of the incidence. Higher willingness to pay offsets 80% of higher prices for consumers, and higher wages compensate workers for 60% of the cost of mandated investment in occupation-specific human capital. Welfare effects appear more favourable in occupations in which licensing is more common.

10.1093/restud/rdad015.abstractZh: 我们评估了职业许可对劳动者和消费者的福利影响。我们构建了一个劳动力市场均衡模型，其中许可制度限制了劳动力供给，同时也通过劳动者质量和选择影响劳动力需求。在美国各州职业许可存在差异的情况下，我们发现许可制度提高了工资和工时，但减少了就业人数。我们估计平均福利损失为职业剩余量的12%。劳动者和消费者分别承担70%和30%的福利损失。较高的支付意愿可以抵消消费者因价格上涨而增加的支出，而较高的工资则补偿了劳动者因职业特定人力资本投资而增加的成本。在许可制度较为普遍的职业中，福利效应似乎更为有利。

abstract.text: Growth has fallen in the U.S. amid a rise in firm concentration. Market share has shifted to low labour share firms, while within-firm labour shares have actually risen. We propose a theory linking these trends in which the driving force is falling overhead costs of spanning multiple products or a rising efficiency advantage of large firms. In response, the most efficient firms (with higher markups) spread into new product lines, thereby increasing concentration and generating a temporary burst of growth. Eventually, due to greater competition from efficient firms, within-firm markups and incentives to innovate fall. Thus our simple model can generate qualitative patterns in line with the observed trends.

10.1093/restud/rdad016.abstractZh: 在美国，随着企业集中度的增加，经济增长出现了下降。市场份额逐渐转移到了那些劳动力成本较低的企业手中，而企业内部劳动力成本实际上却有所上升。我们提出了一个理论来解释这些趋势，认为推动这些变化的因素是跨产品运营的成本下降，或是大型企业的效率提升。作为回应，效率最高的企业（拥有更高的加价率）会扩展到新的产品领域，从而加剧企业间的集中程度，并带来一段短暂的增长期。最终，由于来自高效企业的竞争加剧，企业内部加价率和创新激励都会下降。因此，我们的简单模型能够呈现出与观察到的趋势一致的定性模式。

abstract.text: This paper studies a competitive model of insurance markets in which consumers are privately informed about their risk and risk preferences. We provide a characterization of the equilibria, which depend non-trivially on consumers’ type distribution, a desirable feature for policy analysis. The use of consumer characteristics for risk classification is modeled as the disclosure of a public informative signal. A novel property of signals, monotonicity, is shown to be necessary and sufficient for their release to be welfare improving for almost all consumer types. We also study the effect of changes to the risk distribution in the population as the result of demographic changes or policy interventions. We show that an increase in the risk distribution, according to the monotone likelihood ratio ordering of distribution, leads to lower utility for almost all consumer types. In contrast, the effect is ambiguous when considering the first-order stochastic dominance ordering.

10.1093/restud/rdad017.abstractZh: 本文研究了一个竞争性的保险市场模型，其中消费者对其风险及其风险偏好具有私人信息。我们描述了均衡状态，这些均衡状态与消费者的类型分布有非平凡的关系，这对于政策分析来说是一个理想的特征。消费者特征在风险分类中的应用被建模为公开信息信号的披露。我们证明了信号的单调性这一新颖性质是信号释放能够改善福利的充要条件，几乎适用于所有消费者类型。我们还研究了由于人口变化或政策干预导致人群风险分布变化的影响。研究表明，根据分布的单调似然比排序，风险分布的增加会导致几乎所有消费者类型的效用降低。相比之下，当考虑一阶随机优势排序时，这种影响则具有不确定性。

abstract.text: This paper proposes tools for robust inference in difference-in-differences and event-study designs where the parallel trends assumption may be violated. Instead of requiring that parallel trends holds exactly, we impose restrictions on how different the post-treatment violations of parallel trends can be from the pre-treatment differences in trends (“pre-trends”). The causal parameter of interest is partially identified under these restrictions. We introduce two approaches that guarantee uniformly valid inference under the imposed restrictions, and we derive novel results showing that they have desirable power properties in our context. We illustrate how economic knowledge can inform the restrictions on the possible violations of parallel trends in two economic applications. We also highlight how our approach can be used to conduct sensitivity analyses showing what causal conclusions can be drawn under various restrictions on the possible violations of the parallel trends assumption.

10.1093/restud/rdad018.abstractZh: 本文提出了在差异-差异设计和事件研究设计中用于稳健推断的工具，这些设计可能违反平行趋势假设。我们不再要求平行趋势假设完全成立，而是对治疗后平行趋势的偏差与处理前趋势差异的偏差之间的允许范围施加限制。在这些限制下，感兴趣的因果参数部分被识别出来。我们提出了两种方法，这些方法在施加的限制下能够确保推断的均匀有效性，并且我们得出了新的结果，表明这些方法在我们的情境中具有理想的统计功效。我们通过两个经济应用实例说明了经济知识如何为平行趋势假设可能的偏差提供限制条件，同时强调了我们的方法如何用于进行敏感性分析，以了解在不同平行趋势假设偏差限制下可以得出的因果结论。

abstract.text: We link survey data on Danish people’s perceived income positions and fairness views on inequality within various reference groups to administrative records on their reference groups, income histories, and life events. People are, on average, well-informed about the income levels of their reference groups. Yet, lower-ranked respondents in all groups tend to overestimate their own position among others because they believe others’ incomes are lower than they actually are, whereas the opposite holds true for higher-ranked respondents. Misperceptions of positions in reference groups relate to proximity to other individuals, transparency norms, and visible signals of income. People view inequalities within their co-workers and education groups as significantly more unfair than overall inequality, yet underestimate inequality the most exactly within these groups. Views on the fairness of inequalities are strongly correlated with an individual’s current position, move with shocks like unemployment or promotions, and change when experimentally informing people about their actual positions. However, the higher perceived unfairness of income differences within co-workers and education groups stays unchanged. The theoretical framework shows that this can have important implications for redistribution policy.

10.1093/restud/rdad019.abstractZh: 我们将关于丹麦人对其所属群体中的收入地位和不平等感知的调查数据与他们的行政记录、收入历史以及生活事件联系起来。平均而言，人们对所属群体的收入水平有较为充分的了解。然而，所有群体中的排名较低的受访者往往高估了自己在他人中的位置，因为他们认为他人的收入实际上比他们想象的要低，而排名较高的受访者则相反。对所属群体中位置的误解与个体与其他个体的距离、透明度规范以及收入的可见信号有关。人们认为同事和教育群体中的不平等比整体不平等更为不公平，但在这些群体内部，人们对不平等的低估最为明显。对不平等公平性的看法与个人的当前位置、遭遇失业或晋升等冲击后的变化以及通过实验方式告知人们实际位置后的变化密切相关。然而，对于同事和教育群体内部收入差异的不公平感知程度却保持不变。理论框架表明，这一现象对再分配政策具有重要的启示意义。

abstract.text: Borrowers obtain liquidity by issuing securities backed by the current period payoff and resale price of a long-lived collateral asset, and they are privately informed about the payoff distribution. Asset price can be self-fulfilling: a higher asset price lowers adverse selection and allows borrowers to raise greater funding, which makes the asset more valuable, leading to multiple equilibria. Optimal security design eliminates multiple equilibria, improves welfare, and can be implemented as a repo contract. Persistent adverse selection lowers debt funding, generates volatility in asset prices, and exacerbates credit crunches. The theory demonstrates the role of asset-backed securities on stability of market-based financial systems.

10.1093/restud/rdad022.abstractZh: 借款人通过发行由长期抵押资产的当期收益和转售价格作为支撑的证券来获得流动性，并且他们可以私下了解收益分配情况。资产价格可以自我实现：较高的资产价格可以降低逆向选择问题，使借款人能够筹集更多的资金，从而使资产变得更加有价值，从而形成多个均衡状态。最优的证券设计可以消除多个均衡状态，提高福利水平，并且可以作为一种回购合同来实施。持续存在的逆向选择会降低债务融资能力，导致资产价格波动，并加剧信贷危机。该理论展示了资产支持证券在基于市场的金融系统稳定性中的作用。

abstract.text: We study the potential for asset collateralization to expand access to credit in rural Kenya. Increasing the share of a loan for a durable agricultural asset that is collateralized by the physical asset itself (from 0 to 96%) while reducing the share backed by financial assets increases loan take-up considerably, with only a very limited impact on repayment behavior and the lender's profitability. A Karlan–Zinman test finds evidence of small and marginally significant selection effects in some specifications but no evidence of moral hazard. We find no evidence that joint versus individual liability affects take-up or repayment. Loans had real impacts on investment, milk sales, and girls’ school enrollment. The lender, a savings and credit cooperative, responded to the study results by offering 80% asset-collateralized loans.

10.1093/restud/rdad026.abstractZh: 我们研究了资产抵押在肯尼亚农村地区扩大信贷渠道的潜力。将贷款中用于耐用农业资产的份额由无抵押改为有实物资产抵押（从0%增加到96%），同时减少由金融资产支持的贷款份额，可以显著增加贷款的接受度，但对还款行为和贷款机构的盈利能力的影响非常有限。Karlan–Zinman检验结果显示，在某些参数设定下存在较小且边际显著的选择效应，但并未发现道德风险现象。我们未发现连带责任与个人责任对贷款接受度和还款行为的影响。这些贷款对投资、牛奶销售以及女孩的入学率产生了实际影响。作为储蓄和信贷合作社的贷款机构，该机构根据研究结果提供了80%的实物资产抵押贷款。

abstract.text: Amid an aging population and a growing role for private equity (PE) in the care of older adults, this paper studies how PE ownership affects U.S. nursing homes using patient-level Medicare data. We show that PE ownership leads to a patient cohort with lower health risk. However, after instrumenting for the patient-nursing home match, we find that PE ownership increases mortality by 11%. Declines in measures of patient well-being, nurse staffing, and compliance with care standards help to explain the mortality effect. Overall, we conclude that PE has nuanced effects with adverse outcomes for a subset of patients.

10.1093/rfs/hhad082.abstractZh: 在人口老龄化以及私募股权在老年人护理中扮演越来越重要角色的背景下，本文研究了私募股权持有情况如何影响美国的养老院患者状况，使用了患者层面的医疗保险数据。我们发现，私募股权的持有使得患者群体的健康风险降低。然而，在考虑了患者与养老院之间的匹配因素后，我们发现私募股权的持有会导致患者死亡率增加11%。患者福祉指标、护士人员配置以及护理标准的遵守情况的下降有助于解释这一死亡率增加的现象。总体而言，我们得出结论：私募股权对部分患者有细微的影响，但也会带来一些负面后果。

abstract.text: This study explores whether hospitals with higher increases in obesity levels have higher cesarean section (CS) rates and the consequential effects on maternal and newborn health in Mexico for 2008–2015. It models how changes in the obesity level of hospitals’ patient pools may affect the quantity and quality of care by focusing on the use of CS and the potential returns to specialization. And it creates a measure of hospital-level obesity, based on the fraction of obesity-related discharges for women of childbearing age. Exploiting temporal and hospital variation of this measure, results show that higher hospital-level obesity increases a woman’s probability of having a CS. Also, delivery-related birth outcomes improve: maternal mortality, birth injuries, and birth trauma decrease. The evidence is consistent with hospital-level specialization in CS leading to better birth outcomes.

10.1093/wber/lhad022.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了在2008至2015年间，肥胖水平上升幅度较大的医院是否会有更高的剖宫产率，以及这对墨西哥孕产妇和新生儿健康的影响。研究通过模型分析，探讨了医院患者群体中肥胖水平的变化如何影响护理的数量和质量，重点关注剖宫产的使用情况以及专业化带来的潜在收益。同时，研究还基于育龄妇女因肥胖相关原因而住院的比例，提出了一种衡量医院层面肥胖程度的指标。研究结果显示，医院层面的肥胖程度越高，女性接受剖宫产的概率就越大。此外，与分娩相关的出生结果也有所改善：孕产妇死亡率、出生损伤和出生创伤均有所降低。这些证据表明，医院在剖宫产方面的专业化发展确实能够带来更好的出生结果。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Indiana provides intergovernmental transfers-based supplemental payment to nursing homes owned/operated by the nonstate governmental organization (NSGO) but NSGOs may divert substantial supplemental payments away from participating nursing homes. OBJECTIVE: The aim of this study was to estimate the effect of participation in the intergovernmental transfers-based Medicaid supplemental payment program on nursing home revenue and expenditures. RESEARCH DESIGN: Difference-in-differences regressions using Callaway and Sant'Anna method accounting for treatment effect heterogeneity across groups and over time. SUBJECTS: All 410 Medicare and Medicaid-certified nursing homes in Indiana from 2009 to 2017 with nonmissing data (N=3170). MEASURES: The key independent variable is a binary variable indicating NSGO ownership. Outcome variables include total revenue, total operating, clinical, hotel, and administrative expenses as well as profit margins extracted from Medicare Cost Report. Control variables include facility and resident characteristics from Nursing Home Compare and LTCfocus data. RESULTS: Supplemental payments increased nursing home revenues by about $0.58 million on average but payments were larger in later years. On a per-person per day basis, nursing home revenue increased by $21.9 dollars with an increase in administrative ($11.3), and hotel ($6.9) expenses but a decrease in clinical ($4.67) expenses. CONCLUSIONS: NSGO-owned/operated nursing homes received only a fraction of the total supplemental payments on average, but we observed increased payments to nursing homes in later years. Participating nursing homes did not increase clinical expenses. Our findings raise questions on the transparency of the financing arrangements between NSGOs and nursing homes and the need to link supplemental payments to clinical expenses.

10.1097/mlr.0000000000001875.abstractZh: 背景：印第安纳州通过政府间转移支付向由非州政府组织（NSGO）拥有或运营的养老院提供补充支付，但NSGO可能会将大量补充支付从参与计划的养老院中转移出去。目的：本研究旨在评估参与政府间转移支付Medicaid补充支付计划对养老院收入和支出的影响。研究设计：采用Callaway和Sant'Anna方法进行差异回归分析，同时考虑不同群体和不同时间段的处理效应异质性。研究对象：2009年至2017年间印第安纳州所有410家获得Medicare和Medicaid认证的养老院，且数据未缺失（样本量N=3170）。测量指标：主要独立变量是一个二元变量，表示养老院是否由NSGO拥有。结果变量包括总收入、总运营费用、临床费用、酒店费用以及从Medicare成本报告中提取的利润率。控制变量包括来自Nursing Home Compare和LTCfocus数据的设施和居民特征。结果：补充支付使养老院的平均收入增加了约58万美元，但支付金额在后期更大。按每人每天计算，养老院收入增加了21.9美元，其中管理费用增加了11.3美元，酒店费用增加了6.9美元，而临床费用减少了4.67美元。结论：由NSGO拥有或运营的养老院平均只获得了总补充支付的一小部分，但我们观察到后期对养老院的支付有所增加。参与计划的养老院并未增加临床费用。我们的研究发现，关于NSGOs与护理院之间的融资安排透明度问题，以及将补充支付与临床费用联系起来的必要性，引发了疑问。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Racial-ethnic disparities are pervasive in health care. One mechanism that may underlie disparities is variation in shared decision-making (SDM), which encompasses high-quality clinician-patient communication, including deliberative discussions about treatment options. OBJECTIVES: To determine whether SDM has causal effects on outcomes and whether these effects are stronger within racial-ethnic concordant clinician-patient relationships. RESEARCH DESIGN: We use instrumental variables to estimate the causal effect of SDM on outcomes. SUBJECTS: A total of 60,584 patients from the 2003-2017 Integrated Public Use Microdata Series Medical Expenditure Panel Survey. Years 2018 and 2019 were excluded due to changes in the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey that omitted essential parts of the SDM index. MEASURES: Our key variable of interest is the SDM index. Outcomes included total, outpatient, and drug expenditures; physical and mental health; and the utilization of inpatient and emergency services. RESULTS: SDM lowers annual total health expenditures for all racial-ethnic groups, but this effect is only moderated among Black patients seen by Black clinicians, more than doubling in size relative to Whites. A similar SDM moderation effect also occurs for both Black patients seen by Black clinicians and Hispanic patients seen by Hispanic clinicians with regard to annual outpatient expenditures. There was no significant effect of SDM on self-reported physical or mental health. CONCLUSIONS: High-quality SDM can reduce health expenditures without negatively impacting overall physical or mental health, supporting a business case for health care organizations and systems to improve racial-ethnic clinician-patient concordance for Black and Hispanic patients.

10.1097/mlr.0000000000001881.abstractZh: 背景：种族-民族差异在医疗保健领域普遍存在。导致这些差异的一个机制是共享决策的差异，这包括高质量的临床医生与患者之间的沟通，包括关于治疗方案的慎重讨论。目的：确定共享决策对结果是否有因果影响，以及这些影响在种族-民族一致的临床医生与患者关系中是否更为显著。研究设计：我们使用工具变量来估计共享决策对结果的因果效应。研究对象：2003-2017年综合公共使用微观数据系列医疗支出面板调查中的60,584名患者。由于医疗支出面板调查的变化，2018年和2019年的数据被排除在外，这些变化省略了共享决策指标的重要部分。测量指标：我们的主要变量是共享决策指数。结果包括总支出、门诊支出和药物支出；身体和心理健康；以及住院和紧急服务的使用情况。结果：共享决策降低了所有种族-民族群体的年度总健康支出，但这种效应仅在由黑人临床医生治疗的黑人患者中得到缓解，相对于白人患者，这种效应增加了两倍以上。对于由黑人临床医生治疗的黑人患者和由西班牙裔临床医生治疗的西班牙裔患者，共享决策对年度门诊支出的影响也有类似的缓解效应。共享决策对自我报告的身体或心理健康没有显著影响。结论：高质量的共享决策可以减少健康支出，而不会对整体身体或心理健康产生负面影响，这为医疗保健组织和系统提供了改善黑人及西班牙裔患者的种族-民族临床医生与患者一致性的商业理由。

abstract.text: Purpose The purpose of this study is to investigate how two types of drivers, namely, executive compensation and market competition, can affect hospital quality in the USA. Recently, patients, insurers and regulators have increasingly focused on hospital quality. Understanding the interplay of incentives in this industry is important because in 2019, hospital treatment contributed $1.161bn to health-care costs in the USA. This study answers the call for more studies in the so-called “mixed” industry, where ownership differences can affect organizational objectives and operating constraints. Design/methodology/approach This study explores the roles of hospital executive compensation and industry competition as determinants of health-care quality. Specifically, the study probes the heterogeneity in the factors that influence quality across hospital types in the USA. Findings Using California hospital data from 2006 through 2020, the findings show that the effects of compensation and competition on hospital quality differ by ownership type. Executive compensation is positively associated with quality in for-profit hospitals but is not associated with that of nonprofit hospitals, suggesting for-profit hospitals are more likely to use higher levels of compensation to attract managers with higher ability, whereas the utility function for nonprofit managers may be multidimensional.
