Within the nonprofit hospital group, competition is more positively associated with quality for religious nonprofits relative to secular nonprofits, suggesting that competition provides more monitoring for religious hospitals. Originality/value Taken together, the findings provide evidence that the drivers of quality vary across hospitals in ways consistent with differences in constraints and objectives across ownership types. The findings are important for regulators seeking to incentivize higher quality. For example, Medicare in the USA has incorporated quality measures into its new hospital reimbursement scheme (value-based purchasing) to incentivize quality. This study proposes that regulators should consider differences across ownership types when evaluating the best ways to incentivize hospital quality.

10.1108/raf-06-2022-0166.abstractZh:
研究目的  本研究的目的是探讨两种驱动因素——高管薪酬与市场竞争——如何影响美国的医院质量。近年来，患者、保险公司和监管机构越来越关注医院质量。理解这一行业中的激励机制相互作用非常重要，因为2019年，医院治疗在美国的医疗保健成本中占到了11.61亿美元。本研究回应了对于所谓“混合”行业更多研究的需求，因为所有权差异可能会影响组织目标和运营限制。  

研究方法  本研究探讨了医院高管薪酬和行业竞争作为医疗保健质量决定因素的作用。具体而言，研究调查了影响美国不同类型医院质量的因素差异。  

研究结果  利用2006年至2020年的加州医院数据，研究发现，薪酬和竞争对医院质量的影响因所有权类型而异。高管薪酬与营利性医院的质量呈正相关，但与非营利性医院的质量无关，这表明营利性医院更可能使用更高水平的薪酬来吸引能力更强的管理者；而非营利性医院的管理者可能具有多维度的效用函数。在非营利性医院中，与世俗非营利性医院相比，宗教非营利性医院的质量更受市场竞争的积极影响，这表明市场竞争为宗教医院提供了更多的监督。  

研究意义  综合来看，研究结果表明，质量的驱动因素在不同类型的医院之间存在差异，这与所有权类型之间的限制和目标差异是一致的。这些发现对于寻求激励提高质量的监管机构来说非常重要。例如，美国的医疗保险部门已经在新的医院报销制度中纳入了质量指标（基于价值的采购），以此来激励医院提高质量。本研究建议，监管机构在评估激励医院质量的最佳方式时，应考虑不同所有权类型之间的差异。

abstract.text: Emergency Medical Services (EMS), also known as prehospital care, is a time-sensitive and integral public service [1]. In this paper, we present a usually overlooked, but nonetheless crucial, set of factors that predicts the EMS response time for a community—its geographic socio-economic conditions. EMS response time is an essential factor in the success of prehospital care [2] which is the time from the notification of an occurrence (by dispatch) to the arrival of a response unit at the scene of an emergency. In life-threatening incidents that require getting the patient to care where medical professionals can perform vital procedures, shorter out-of-hospital EMS time intervals are vital for survival. A variety of factors influence EMS response time, such as the unavailability of ambulances at centers closest to a call, triage process, call location, and the distance from the scene to the nearest hospital [3]. Although other factors have been investigated more frequently, research on the environmental and socio-demographic factors that affect EMS response time remains limited. The effective and timely provision of emergency services is an issue that all countries struggle with, and variations across socio-demographic differences (such as poverty level) can contribute to the continued social inequities within the United States.

10.1109/csit61576.2023.10324143.abstractZh: 紧急医疗服务（EMS），也被称为院前护理，是一项时间敏感且不可或缺的公共服务[1]。本文探讨了其中一个常被忽视但至关重要的因素——一个社区的地理社会经济状况，这些因素会影响紧急医疗服务的响应时间。紧急医疗服务的响应时间是院前护理成功的关键[2]，即从事件被通知到救援队伍到达事故现场所需的时间。在需要医疗专业人员实施关键手术的生命威胁性事件中，缩短院外紧急医疗服务的时间对于患者的生存至关重要。影响紧急医疗服务响应时间的因素有很多，比如距离呼叫中心最近的救护车是否可用、分诊过程、呼叫地点以及从事故现场到最近医院的距离[3]。虽然其他因素的影响因素已被更频繁地研究，但关于影响紧急医疗服务响应时间的环境和社会人口因素的研究仍然有限。有效且及时的紧急服务提供是所有国家都面临的挑战，而不同社会人口特征之间的差异（如贫困水平）可能会加剧美国内部的社会不平等。

abstract.text: Policy Points Public reporting is associated with both mitigating and exacerbating inequities in high-quality home health agency use for marginalized groups. Ensuring equitable access to home health requires taking a closer look at potentially inequitable policies to ensure that these policies are not inadvertently exacerbating disparities as home health public reporting potentially does. Targeted federal, state, and local interventions should focus on raising awareness about the five-star quality ratings among marginalized populations for whom inequities have been exacerbated. CONTEXT: Literature suggests that public reporting of quality may have the unintended consequence of exacerbating disparities in access to high-quality, long-term care for older adults. The objective of this study is to evaluate the impact of the home health five-star ratings on changes in high-quality home health agency use by race, ethnicity, income status, and place-based factors. METHODS: We use data from the Outcome and Assessment Information Set, Medicare Enrollment Files, Care Compare, and American Community Survey to estimate differential access to high-quality home health agencies between July 2014 and June 2017. To estimate the impact of the home health five-star rating introduction on the use of high-quality home health agencies, we use a longitudinal observational pretest-posttest design. FINDINGS: After the introduction of the home health five-star ratings in 2016, we found that adjusted rates of high-quality home health agency use increased for all home health patients, except for Hispanic/Latine and Asian American/Pacific Islander patients. Additionally, we found that the disparity in high-quality home health agency use between low-income and higher-income home health patients was exacerbated after the introduction of the five-star quality ratings. We also observed that patients within predominantly Hispanic/Latine neighborhoods had a significant decrease in their use of high-quality home health agencies, whereas patients in predominantly White and integrated neighborhoods had a significant increase in high-quality home health agency use. Other neighborhoods experience a nonsignificant change in high-quality home health agency use. CONCLUSIONS: Policymakers should be aware of the potential unintended consequences for implementing home health public reporting, specifically for Hispanic/Latine, Asian American/Pacific Islander, and low-income home health patients, as well as patients residing in predominantly Hispanic/Latine neighborhoods. Targeted interventions should focus on raising awareness around the five-star ratings.

10.1111/1468-0009.12616.abstractZh:
政策要点：公开报告与边缘化群体在高质量家庭健康服务使用中的不平等现象既有缓解作用，也可能加剧这种不平等。要确保公平获取家庭健康服务，需要仔细审视可能存在的不平等政策，避免这些政策无意中加剧差异，因为公开报告可能会起到这样的作用。联邦、州和地方层面的针对性干预应重点提高边缘化人群对五星质量评级的认识，尤其是那些已经面临不平等问题的群体。

背景：文献表明，公开报告质量可能无意中加剧老年人获得高质量长期护理服务的机会不平等。本研究的目的是评估家庭健康五星评级对按种族、民族、收入状况及地理位置因素划分的高质量家庭健康服务使用情况的影响。

方法：我们利用 Outcome and Assessment Information Set、Medicare Enrollment Files、Care Compare和American Community Survey的数据，在2014年7月至2017年6月期间，估算不同人群在高质量家庭健康服务使用上的差异。为了评估家庭健康五星评级引入对高质量家庭健康服务使用的影响，我们采用了纵向观察性前后测设计。

研究结果：在2016年引入家庭健康五星评级后，我们发现，除西班牙裔/拉丁裔和亚裔美国/太平洋岛民患者外，所有家庭健康患者使用高质量家庭健康服务的比例都有所增加。此外，我们发现，在引入五星质量评级后，低收入和高收入家庭健康患者在使用高质量家庭健康服务方面的差异进一步加剧。我们还观察到，主要居住于西班牙裔/拉丁裔社区的患者的高质量家庭健康服务使用量显著下降，而主要居住于白人及融合社区的患者则显著增加了对高质量家庭健康服务的使用。其他社区的高质量家庭健康服务使用量则没有显著变化。结论：政策制定者应当意识到实施家庭健康服务公开报告可能带来的意外后果，尤其是对西班牙裔/拉丁裔、亚裔美国/太平洋岛民以及低收入家庭健康患者，以及主要居住于西班牙裔/拉丁裔社区的患者的潜在影响。有针对性的干预措施应集中在提高人们对五星评级的认识上。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVE: The aim was to quantify changes in the market structure of primary care physicians and examine its relationship with access to care. DATA SOURCES AND STUDY SETTING: We created measures of market structure from a 5% sample of Medicare fee-for-service claims and examined access to care using nationally representative data from the Medical Expenditure Panel Survey (MEPS). Our study spanned from 2008 to 2019. STUDY DESIGN: We used a linear probability model to estimate the relationship between access to care and two measures of market structure: concentration, measured by the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI), and vertical integration, measured by the market share of multispecialty firms. Our model controlled for year and ZIP code fixed effects, respondents' demographics and health status, and other measures of market structure. DATA COLLECTION/EXTRACTION METHODS: All adult respondents in the MEPS were included. PRINCIPAL FINDINGS: The percentage of people living in concentrated ZIP codes (HHI above 1500) increased from 37% in 2008 to 53% in 2019. During the same period, the median market share of multispecialty firms rose from 30% to 48%. Respondents in highly concentrated ZIP codes (HHI over 2500) were 5.9 percentage points (95% CI: -1.4 to -10.4) less likely to report having access to immediate care than respondents in unconcentrated ZIP codes. The association was largest among Medicaid beneficiaries, a 17.3 percentage point reduction (95% CI: -5.1 to -29.4). When we applied a model that was robust to biases from treatments with staggered timing, the estimated association remained negative but was not statistically significant. We found no association between HHI and indicators for having a usual source of care and annual checkups. The multispecialty market share was negatively associated with checkups, but not other measures of access. CONCLUSIONS: Increases in concentration may reduce some types of access to healthcare. These effects appear most pronounced among Medicaid beneficiaries.

10.1111/1475-6773.14228.abstractZh:
目的：本研究旨在量化初级保健医生市场结构的变化，并探讨其与就医机会之间的关系。  
数据来源与研究背景：我们从5%的医疗保险按服务收费索赔样本中构建了市场结构指标，并利用《医疗支出调查》中的全国代表性数据来研究就医机会。研究时间跨度为2008年至2019年。  
研究设计：我们使用线性概率模型来估计就医机会与两个市场结构指标之间的关系：通过赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数衡量的市场集中度，以及通过多专科企业市场份额衡量的垂直整合程度。我们的模型考虑了年份和邮政编码的固定效应、受访者的人口统计信息和健康状况，以及其他市场结构指标。  
数据收集/提取方法：所有参与《医疗支出调查》的成年受访者都被纳入研究范围。  
主要发现：居住在集中度较高的邮政编码区（赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数超过1500）的人口比例从2008年的37%上升到2019年的53%。同期，多专科企业的市场份额中位数从30%上升到48%。居住在集中度极高的邮政编码区（赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数超过2500）的受访者，报告能够立即获得就医服务的可能性比居住在非集中区受访者低5.9个百分点（95%置信区间：-1.4至-10.4）。这种关联在医疗补助受益人中最为明显，减少了17.3个百分点（95%置信区间：-5.1至-29.4）。当我们使用一种能够克服治疗时间错开带来的偏差的模型进行分析时，估计的关联仍然为负，但并未达到统计学上的显著水平。我们未发现赫芬达尔-赫希曼指数与常规就医来源和年度体检指标之间存在关联。多专科市场的份额与体检次数呈负相关，但与其他获取途径的测量指标无关。结论：企业集中度的增加可能会减少某些类型的医疗获取途径。这些影响在Medicaid受益人中最为明显。

abstract.text: I examine the effects of the U.S. Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Reporting Program, which requires thousands of industrial facilities to measure and report their GHG emissions. I show that facilities reduce their GHG emissions by 7.9% following the disclosure of emissions data. The evidence indicates that benchmarking—whereby facilities use the disclosures of their peers to assess their own relative GHG performance—spurs emission reductions. Firms' concerns about future legislation appear to motivate this behavior and measurement alone (without disclosure) seems not to reduce emissions. My study highlights how mandatory GHG disclosure can create real effects for peers.

10.1111/1475-679x.12473.abstractZh: 我研究了美国温室气体报告计划的影响，该计划要求数千家工业设施测量并报告其温室气体排放情况。研究表明，在排放数据公开后，这些设施的温室气体排放量减少了7.9%。证据表明，通过参考同行披露的信息来评估自身温室气体排放情况，有助于促进排放量的减少。企业对于未来法规的担忧似乎推动了这种行为，而仅进行测量（不包括披露）似乎并不能减少排放。我的研究强调了强制性温室气体披露如何对同行产生实际影响。

abstract.text: Bloom and Van Reenen (2007) have suggested an index of best management practices capturing three broad areas: monitoring, targets and incentives. However, it is an open question whether the functioning of these practices depends on contextual factors. From a theoretical viewpoint, the management practices involve both productive and dysfunctional effects. We hypothesize that the relative strength of these effects depends on the industrial relations climate. Works councils help management practices live up to their potential by building long‐term employer‐employee cooperation. Our empirical analysis uses panel data from the German Management and Organizational Practices survey to examine this hypothesis. Applying a reformulated version of the Mundlak estimator, we disentangle short‐term and sustaining productivity effects of the management practices. Our results show that the incidence of a works council specifically strengthens the sustaining productivity effect of the practices.

10.1111/1748-8583.12526.abstractZh: Bloom和Van Reenen在2007年提出了一个衡量最佳管理实践的指标，该指标涵盖了三个主要领域：监控、目标和激励措施。然而，这些实践是否受具体情境因素的影响仍是一个悬而未决的问题。从理论角度来看，管理实践既可能产生积极效果，也可能带来负面影响。我们假设这些效果的强弱取决于工业关系氛围。职工代表委员会通过促进雇主与员工之间的长期合作，有助于管理实践发挥其潜力。我们的实证分析采用了德国管理和组织实践调查中的面板数据来验证这一假设。通过应用重新设计的Mundlak估计方法，我们区分了管理实践的短期效应和长期效应。研究结果表明，职工代表委员会的存在显著增强了这些实践的长期效应。

abstract.text: This paper uses a patient discharge dataset from China to study whether and how medical expenses increase for those patients who have better insurance coverage. It uncovers consistent increases in total medical expenses and across each of the three broad categories of expenses (prescription drug expenses, diagnostic test expenses, and other service expenses), no improvement in the quality of care delivered. These increases in expenses can be attributed to patients, physicians, or both. The study provides evidence that physicians' financial incentives play an important role in inducing the increase in medical expenses and that physicians' workload level affects the role of their financial incentives.

10.1111/ecot.12365.abstractZh: 本文利用中国的一份患者出院数据集，研究那些拥有更好保险覆盖的患者，其医疗费用是否以及如何增加。研究发现，总医疗费用在三个主要费用类别中均出现持续增加，包括处方药费用、诊断测试费用以及其他服务费用。然而，所提供的护理质量并未得到改善。这些费用的增加可能归因于患者、医生或两者的共同作用。研究提供了证据，表明医生的经济激励在导致医疗费用增加方面起着重要作用，同时医生的工作负荷水平也影响着其经济激励的作用。

abstract.text: Starting around 2006, the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) progressively reduced Medicare Fee-for-Service (M-FFS) payments for the principal noninvasive cardiac tests, when performed in a cardiologist office (Office), yet kept payments flat to increasing for the same tests, performed in the hospital-based outpatient (HBO) setting. This produced a growing gap between HBO and Office payments for the same tests, and thus an incentive for hospitals to acquire cardiology practices in order to move cardiac tests to the HBO location and capture the HBO/Office payment differential. We use difference-in-differences analysis, in which we compare national M-FFS trends in cardiac test location to those for a control group of several large, integrated Medicare Advantage (M-Adv) health systems over 2005-2015, which were not affected by these reimbursement changes, and provide evidence that these reimbursement changes led to a large shift in testing from Office to HBO. This shift was concurrent with a sharp rise in hospital-cardiologist integration. The rise in integration and the proportion of testing in HBO varied greatly across states. Independent practice remains viable in very large states, but is endangered in many states, and is all but extinct in a growing number of states.

10.1111/jels.12359.abstractZh: 大约在2006年左右，医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心（CMS）逐步减少了在心脏病专家诊所进行的非侵入性心脏检查的费用支付，而相同检查在医院门诊部门进行的费用则保持不变。这导致医院门诊部门和诊所之间在检查费用上的差距越来越大，从而促使医院收购心脏病专科诊所，以便将心脏检查转移到门诊部门，从而获取门诊和诊所之间的费用差异。我们采用了差异对差异分析的方法，比较了全国范围内心脏检查地点与2005年至2015年间几个大型、综合的医疗保险优势计划健康系统的费用趋势。这些健康系统并未受到这些报销政策变化的影响。研究结果表明，这些报销政策变化导致了心脏检查地点从诊所向门诊部门的重大转移。这一转移与医院与心脏病专家诊所整合程度的急剧上升同时发生。各州的医院与心脏病专家诊所的整合程度以及门诊部门进行的检查比例存在很大差异。在非常大的州，独立执业仍然可行，但在许多州这种模式正面临威胁，而在越来越多的州，独立执业几乎已经消失。

abstract.text: While the Royal Commission into Aged Care Quality and Safety has clearly identified the issues with our Australian residential aged care system, its recommendations-so far-have not been translated into policies that will ensure a framework in which nursing home operators and care staff are empowered to focus on what matters-ensuring vulnerable residents receive care that meets their needs and preserves their dignity. For this to be achievable the system requires measures that in the first instance reflect the system's purpose, and that all stakeholders can use to improve care. Such measures need to be easy to understand and implement, and most importantly reduce bureaucratic burden.

10.1111/jep.13943.abstractZh: 虽然皇家老年护理质量与安全委员会已经明确指出了澳大利亚老年护理体系存在的问题，但其建议至今尚未转化为实际政策。这些政策应建立一个框架，使养老院运营者和护理人员能够专注于真正重要的事情——确保弱势居民获得符合其需求的护理，并维护他们的尊严。要实现这一目标，该体系需要采取一些措施，这些措施首先应反映体系的目的，并且所有利益相关者都能使用这些措施来提升护理质量。这些措施需要易于理解和实施，最重要的是，要减少官僚负担。

abstract.text: Many industries consist of large firms that compete in multiple geographic markets. Such overlap, defined as multimarket contact (MMC), may facilitate tacit collusion and soften competition. We examine the effects of MMC on health insurance prices and quality using comprehensive data on the Medicare Advantage (MA) market from 2008 through 2015. Our identification strategy exploits two plausibly exogenous changes to MMC: (1) out‐of‐market mergers; and (2) policy‐driven changes in the benchmark rates of other markets. Our results consistently support the mutual forbearance hypothesis, where we find that prices are significantly higher and high‐quality plans less pervasive as MMC increases.

10.1111/joie.12318.abstractZh: 许多行业由在多个地理市场进行竞争的大型企业组成。这种重叠现象被称为多市场接触，可能会促进默契勾结并削弱竞争。我们利用2008年至2015年医疗保险优势市场的相关数据，研究多市场接触对医疗保险价格和质量的影响。我们的识别策略利用了两个可能由外部因素引起的多市场接触变化：(1) 市场外的合并；(2) 政策驱动的其他市场基准费率的变化。我们的研究结果一致支持相互克制假说，即随着多市场接触的增加，价格显著上升，高质量计划也变得不那么普遍。

abstract.text: In vertical markets, eliminating double marginalization with a two‐part tariff may not be possible due to risk aversion. Under uncertain demand, contracts with large fixed fees expose the downstream firm to more risk than contracts that are more reliant on variable fees. In equilibrium, contracts may thus rely on variable fees, giving rise to double marginalization. Counterintuitively, however, we show that increased demand risk or risk aversion can actually mitigate double marginalization. We also characterize several sufficient conditions under which increased risk or risk aversion is guaranteed to exacerbate double marginalization. We conclude by discussing potential applications and extensions.

10.1111/joie.12369.abstractZh: 在垂直市场中，由于风险厌恶，采用两部分关税来消除双重边际化可能并不可行。在需求不确定的情况下，采用固定费用较高的合同会使下游企业面临更大的风险，而依赖可变费用的合同则风险较小。因此，在均衡状态下，合同可能会依赖于可变费用，从而导致双重边际化。然而，与直觉相反，我们表明，需求风险的增加或风险厌恶实际上可以减轻双重边际化。我们还描述了几种充分条件，在这些条件下，风险或风险厌恶的增加肯定会加剧双重边际化。最后，我们讨论了潜在的应用和扩展方向。

abstract.text: We propose an identification strategy for diversion based on win/loss data. First, we show that win/loss data from the merging firms and market shares in two periods for all firms are sufficient to identify the diversion ratios between the merging partners. Second, we show that win/loss data from the merging firms alone are sufficient for partial identification, and we construct a lower bound that provides a good approximation to the diversion ratio when switching costs are high. We demonstrate the performance of our method with numerical simulations and with an application to the Anthem/Cigna merger.

10.1111/joie.12371.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种基于胜/负数据的转移识别策略。首先，我们证明了来自合并企业以及所有企业在两个时期内的胜/负数据和市场份额数据足以识别合并双方之间的转移比例。其次，我们证明了仅使用合并企业的胜/负数据就足以进行部分识别，并且我们构建了一个下限，当转移成本较高时，该下限能够很好地近似转移比例。我们通过数值模拟以及Anthem/Cigna合并案例的应用，证明了我们方法的性能。

abstract.text: Risk‐adjustment policies, which transfer money from insurers with healthy consumers to those with sick consumers, are an important tool to contend with adverse selection in health insurance markets. While the steady‐state properties of risk‐adjustment have been studied extensively, there is less evidence on the transition phase of policy implementation. We study the introduction and removal of risk‐adjustment at California Public Employees' Retirement System and show that these changes meaningfully impact premiums via plan differences in enrollee health status. Despite these premium differences, there is limited consumer resorting due to consumer inertia, though new active enrollees respond more fluidly. We show that, with inertial consumers, risk‐adjustment changes have substantial distributional consequences, leading to worse outcomes for sicker consumers when removed and vice‐versa when implemented. We estimate a model of plan choice with premium sensitivity, brand preferences, and inertia and use these estimates to study the interaction between risk‐adjustment policies and the strength of inertia.

10.1111/jori.12417.abstractZh: 风险调整政策通过将资金从消费者健康的保险公司转移给消费者病重的保险公司，成为应对健康保险市场不良选择的重要工具。虽然风险调整的稳定状态特性已被广泛研究，但关于政策实施过渡阶段的证据却相对较少。我们研究了加州公共雇员退休系统引入和取消风险调整政策的情况，发现这些变化通过计划参与者的健康状况差异显著影响了保费。尽管存在保费差异，但由于消费者的惯性，选择取消风险调整政策的消费者数量有限，而新加入的活跃参与者则反应更为灵活。我们指出，对于具有惯性的消费者而言，风险调整政策的变更会带来显著的分配后果，当取消风险调整政策时，病重消费者的状况会恶化；反之，当实施风险调整政策时，病重消费者的状况会改善。我们建立了一个包含保费敏感性、品牌偏好和惯性的计划选择模型，并利用这些估计值来研究风险调整政策与惯性强度之间的相互作用。

abstract.text: We theorize that employees use the performance feedback they receive to reassess their beliefs about the marginal benefit of their effort, which may lead them to increase or reduce their effort. To test our model, we conduct a field experiment at the distribution center of a Fortune 500 firm where employees receive individual performance pay, and we study two types of feedback, individual and relative. The results show that employees react to feedback content in a way that is consistent with the model: They increase their effort if the information provided implies that the marginal benefit of increasing effort is high and decrease it if they learn that it is low. Moreover, performance feedback has a greater impact on the lower quantiles of the distribution of productivity.

10.1111/poms.13827.abstractZh: 我们提出理论假设，认为员工会利用收到的绩效反馈来重新评估他们对自身努力边际效益的认知，这可能会导致他们增加或减少自己的努力程度。为了验证我们的模型，我们在一家福布斯500强企业的配送中心进行了一项实地实验，该企业的员工会收到个人绩效奖励。我们研究了两种类型的反馈：个人反馈和相对反馈。实验结果表明，员工对反馈内容的反应与模型预测一致：如果反馈信息表明增加努力的边际效益较高，员工会加大努力；反之，如果反馈信息表明边际效益较低，员工则会减少努力。此外，绩效反馈对生产力分布较低的分位数影响更大。

abstract.text: Using data from professional football leagues in four countries, we assess the effects on team performances following head coach turnover, distinguishing between voluntary and involuntary exits. We use entropy balancing to deal with the endogeneity of coach departures, by reweighting pre‐departure covariates to obtain a comparable control group. Results reveal little, if any, positive effect from either type of turnover, though some longer‐term benefits are possible if teams experience no subsequent turnover. We discuss how these findings fit with previous literature and theory, and discuss the wider practical implications.

10.1111/sjpe.12369.abstractZh: 我们基于四个国家职业足球联赛的数据，评估了主教练更换对球队表现的影响，并区分了自愿和被迫的更换情况。我们通过熵平衡方法来处理教练离职的内生性问题，通过重新加权离职前的协变量来创建一个可比的对照组。结果表明，无论是自愿还是被迫的更换，都没有产生明显的积极影响，不过如果球队在之后没有发生更换，可能会有一些长期的好处。我们讨论了这些发现与以往文献和理论的契合之处，并探讨了其更广泛的实践意义。

abstract.text: We study how different types of import competition affect firm productivity using firm‐product data from German manufacturing (2000–2014). Competition from high‐income countries causes affected domestic firms to increase their productivity and lower their prices. Oppositely, import competition from low‐wage countries does not lead to firm productivity gains. Instead, domestic firms' sales and input usage decline. Our findings confirm the intuition of ladder models that the effect of competition depends on the “closeness” of competitors. They are in line with widespread X‐inefficiencies throughout the economy, which firms reduce in response to competition from high‐income countries.

10.1111/twec.13409.abstractZh: 我们研究了不同类型进口竞争如何影响企业生产力，使用了德国制造业2000至2014年的企业产品数据。来自高收入国家的竞争促使受影响的国内企业提高生产力并降低价格。相反，来自低工资国家的进口竞争并未带来企业生产力的提升，反而导致国内企业的销售额和投入减少。我们的研究结果证实了阶梯模型的直觉，即竞争的效果取决于竞争对手的“接近程度”。这些发现与整个经济中普遍存在的X型效率低下现象一致，企业为了应对来自高收入国家的竞争，会减少这种低效现象。

abstract.text: OBJECTIVES: The medical reform in 2009 stimulated the growth of private healthcare organisations in China, but there is still room for their further development in the healthcare market. The objectives of the study were to provide more information about the healthcare market in China and to explore the challenges private healthcare organisations faced. DESIGN: Qualitative descriptive study using a web-based open-ended questionnaire and thematic content analysis. Data were collected between 12 February and 20 February 2020. SETTING: This study was conducted in China. PARTICIPANTS: 124 respondents from private healthcare organisations across 20 provinces in China. RESULTS: Our content analysis identified three themes: (1) functioning and positioning of the healthcare institutions: current private healthcare organisations generally serve as a supplement to public hospitals and focus more on specialised medical and high-end services; (2) institutions' advantages: private healthcare organisations can flexibly respond to market demands, formulate effective strategies, introduce advanced management concepts and methods, provide personalised and diversified services, and introduce new technologies which can stimulate market vitality and promote healthy competition; and (3) institutions' challenges: private healthcare organisations face difficulties in professional development and talent cultivation, branding and establishing a reputation, and the policies for institution establishment, tax and medical insurance pose drawbacks to their development. CONCLUSION: This study illustrates that private healthcare organisations need more government support for further development, such as providing a fairer insurance strategy and taxation policy, affording ground for a more equitable scientific research environment and promotion opportunities, and evaluating reputation score for healthcare institutions.

10.1136/bmjopen-2022-069381.abstractZh:
研究目的：2009年的医疗改革促进了中国私人医疗组织的增长，但这些组织在医疗市场仍有进一步发展的空间。本研究旨在提供更多关于中国医疗市场的信息，并探讨私人医疗组织面临的挑战。  
研究设计：采用基于网络的开放式问卷和主题内容分析进行定性描述研究。数据收集时间为2020年2月12日至2月20日。  
研究地点：本研究在中国进行。  
参与者：来自中国20个省份的124名私人医疗组织的受访者。  
研究结果：内容分析识别出三个主题：(1)医疗机构的功能与定位：目前，私人医疗组织通常作为公立医院的补充，更注重专业医疗和高端服务；(2)机构的优势：私人医疗组织能够灵活应对市场需求，制定有效策略，引入先进的管理理念和方法，提供个性化、多样化的服务，并引入新技术，从而激发市场活力并促进健康竞争；(3)机构的挑战：私人医疗组织在专业发展和人才培养、品牌建设和声誉建立方面面临困难，此外，机构设立政策、税收和医疗保险政策也对其发展造成了阻碍。结论：本研究表明，私人医疗机构需要更多的政府支持以实现进一步发展，例如制定更公平的保险政策和税收政策，为更公平的科学研究环境及推广机会提供条件，并对医疗机构的声誉进行评估。

abstract.text: Este estudo visa verificar se o resultado de saúde dos pacientes submetidos a Artroplastia de Quadril são melhores à medida que o hospital realiza mais desse procedimento (efeito volume-resultado). As evidências apontaram a existência desse efeito no setor hospitalar brasileiro. Explorando a distribuição geográfica das residências dos pacientes e dos hospitais como fonte de variação exógena para o volume, foi identificado que o efeito é resultado da hipótese de practice-makes-perfect, ocorrendo através de ganhos estáticos de escala. Esse resultado sugere que uma política que visa um volume mínimo por estabelecimento hospitalar pode conduzir a melhores resultados de saúde.

10.11606/1980-5330/ea192619.abstractZh: 本研究旨在验证：随着医院进行更多的髋关节置换手术，接受该手术的患者健康结果是否会有所改善（即“数量与效果”效应）。现有证据表明，在巴西的医疗机构中确实存在这种效应。通过对患者住所和医院的地理分布进行分析，发现这种效应源于“实践造就完美”的假设，即随着手术规模的扩大，患者健康结果会获得静态的提升。这一结果表明，实施旨在确保每个医疗机构手术数量达到最低限度的政策，可能会带来更好的健康效果。

abstract.text: Insurance markets often feature consumer sorting along both an extensive margin (whether to buy) and an intensive margin (which plan to buy). We present a new graphical theoretical framework that extends a workhorse model to incorporate both selection margins simultaneously. A key insight from our framework is that policies aimed at addressing one margin of selection often involve an economically meaningful trade-off on the other margin in terms of prices, enrollment, and welfare. Using data from Massachusetts, we illustrate these trade-offs in an empirical sufficient statistics approach that is tightly linked to the graphical framework we develop.

10.1162/rest_a_01070.abstractZh: 保险市场通常呈现出消费者在广泛边际（是否购买）和密集边际（选择哪种计划）上的选择行为。我们提出了一个新的图形理论框架，该框架扩展了传统模型，同时考虑了这两种选择边际。我们框架的一个关键见解是，旨在解决某一选择边际问题的政策，往往会在价格、参保率和福利方面带来经济上的权衡。我们基于马萨诸塞州的数据，通过一种与我们所开发的图形框架紧密相连的实证充分统计量方法，展示了这些权衡。

abstract.text: There is substantial waste in U.S. healthcare but little consensus on how to combat it. We identify one source of waste: long-term care hospitals (LTCHs). Using the entry of LTCHs into hospital markets in an event study design, we find that most LTCH patients would have counterfactually received care at Skilled Nursing Facilities—facilities that provide medically similar care but are paid significantly less—and that substitution to LTCHs leaves patients unaffected or worse off on all dimensions we can objectively measure. Our results imply Medicare could save about $4.6 billion per year by not allowing discharge to LTCHs.

10.1162/rest_a_01092.abstractZh: 美国的医疗保健存在大量浪费，但关于如何解决这一问题尚无共识。我们发现了一个浪费的来源：长期护理医院。通过事件研究设计，我们发现大多数长期护理医院的患者在实际情况下会选择前往技能护理设施接受护理——这些设施提供的医疗服务与长期护理医院类似，但收费却低得多。将患者转至技能护理设施后，患者在我们能够客观衡量的所有方面都会受到不利影响。我们的研究结果表明，如果Medicare不允许患者从长期护理医院出院，每年可以节省约46亿美元。

abstract.text: Hospital advertising has grown more than five-fold in the past two decades. However, unlike detailing and advertising for prescription drugs, the topic of hospital advertising has been understudied. This research introduces a customer-centric view to this market by investigating the role of advertising in patients’ choice of high-tech medical procedures, with a focus on robotic surgery. The authors analyze approximately 140,000 individual patient records and television advertising data from Florida during 2011–2015 to investigate how hospital advertising of robotic surgery affects patients’ choice of robotic surgery over more conventional laparoscopic and open surgeries. Using a variation of a designated market area border identification strategy, the authors find that this advertising leads to more robotic surgery choices. The advertising effect is especially strong for Medicaid patients, whose socioeconomic status tends to be lower. While robotic surgery is associated with a short-term health benefit (i.e., reduced length of hospital stay), it does not affect long-term health benefits and comes at a higher cost than other forms of surgery. Thus, understanding the effect of advertising robotic surgery has significant health, cost, and marketing implications for different stakeholders in the health care industry, such as patients, health care providers, surgical robot manufacturers, insurance providers, and policy makers.

10.1177/00222429221151058.abstractZh: 在过去二十年里，医院广告的规模增长了五倍多。然而，与处方药广告不同，医院广告这一领域一直缺乏深入研究。本研究通过探讨广告在患者选择高科技医疗程序中的作用，为这一市场带来了以客户为中心的观点，重点关注机器人手术。作者分析了约140,000份个体患者记录以及2011至2015年间佛罗里达州的电视广告数据，以研究医院对机器人手术的广告宣传如何影响患者选择机器人手术，而非传统的腹腔镜手术或开放手术。利用一种特定的市场区域边界识别策略，作者发现这种广告宣传确实增加了机器人手术的选择。对于社会经济地位较低的美洲医疗补助患者来说，这种广告宣传的效果尤为显著。虽然机器人手术在短期内能带来健康效益（如缩短住院时间），但它并不会影响长期的健康效益，并且其成本也高于其他类型的手术。因此，了解广告对机器人手术的影响对于医疗行业的各个利益相关方具有重要意义，包括患者、医疗服务提供者、手术机器人制造商、保险公司以及政策制定者。

abstract.text: Specialize? Diversify? Do patients care? The authors investigate the demand-side effects of a hospital's portfolio strategy, which entails decisions about the depth and breadth of its service offerings. Positing that both depth (focus) and breadth (related focus) signal expertise, the authors use both archival and experimental evidence to examine these effects. The archival study is based on Florida's State Inpatient Databases for 2006–2015 and spans all major departments in health care delivery. The empirical analysis exploits plausible exogenous variation from other health care markets and reveals that patient choice is positively influenced by a hospital's depth (focus) and breadth (related focus) of expertise in a department. Complementing the archival evidence, the authors also conducted online experiments to examine the signaling effects of hospital portfolio strategy on patient choice behavior. The results provide support for the idea that hospital portfolio strategy influences patients’ perceptions of hospital expertise in focal and related areas and, subsequently, their choice behavior. The authors also highlight potential synergistic effects between focus and related focus and heterogeneity in the effects across departments, payer types, and hospital profit status. These findings underscore the need for managers to adopt a targeted approach to portfolio decisions in health care.

10.1177/00222429231204247.abstractZh: 专攻还是多元化？患者是否关心？作者研究了医院投资组合策略的需求侧效应，这一策略涉及对服务提供的深度和广度的决策。作者认为，深度（专注）和广度（相关专注）都体现了医院的专长。他们利用档案数据和实验数据来研究这些效应。档案研究基于2006至2015年佛罗里达州住院患者数据库，涵盖了所有主要的医疗保健部门。实证分析利用其他医疗保健市场中的合理外部变量，发现患者的选择受到医院在某一部门内的专长深度和广度积极影响。除了档案数据外，作者还进行了在线实验，以研究医院投资组合策略对患者选择行为的影响。研究结果支持这样的观点：医院的投资组合策略会影响患者对医院在相关领域的专长的认知，进而影响其选择行为。作者还强调了专注与相关专注之间的潜在协同效应，以及不同部门、支付类型和国家医院盈利状况下效应的异质性。这些发现强调了管理者在医疗保健领域采取针对性投资组合决策的重要性。

abstract.text: This study asks: Does the empirical evidence support the conclusion that for-profit (FP) hospitals are more productive or efficient than private not-for-profit (NFP) hospitals or non-federal public (PUB) hospitals? Alternative theories of NFP behavior are described. Our review of individual empirical hospital studies of quality, service mix, community benefit, and cost/efficiency in the United States published since 2000 indicates that no systematic difference exists in cost/efficiency, provision of uncompensated care, and quality of care. But FPs are more likely to provide profitable services, higher service intensity, have lower shares of uninsured and Medicaid patients, and are more responsive to external financial incentives. That FP hospitals are not more efficient runs counter to property rights theory, but their relative responsiveness to financial incentives supports it. There is little evidence that FP market presence changes NFP behaviors. Observed differences between FP and NFP hospitals are mostly a "little deal."

10.1177/10775587221142268.abstractZh: 本研究提出以下问题：实证证据是否支持这样的结论，即营利性医院比非营利性医院或非联邦公立医院更具效率或生产力？文中还介绍了关于非营利性医院行为的其他理论。我们对2000年以来在美国发表的关于医院质量、服务组合、社区效益以及成本/效率的个别实证研究进行了回顾，发现成本/效率、无偿护理的提供以及护理质量方面并不存在系统性差异。然而，营利性医院更有可能提供盈利性服务，服务强度更高，无保险和医疗补助患者的比例更低，并且对外部财务激励的反应更为积极。营利性医院并不更有效率，这与财产权利理论相悖，但它们对财务激励的相对响应性则支持了这一理论。几乎没有证据表明营利性医院的市场存在会改变非营利性医院的行为。营利性医院与非营利性医院之间观察到的差异大多只是“细微差别”。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: In 2013, the Shanghai Hospital Development Center issued a policy to advocate public hospitals to report their information about costs on diseases. The objective was to evaluate the impact of interhospital disclosure of costs on diseases on medical costs and compare costs per case following information disclosure between hospitals of different rankings. METHODS: The study uses the hospital-level performance report issued by Shanghai Hospital Development Center in the fourth quarter of 2013, which covers quarterly aggregated hospital-level discharge data from 14 tertiary public hospitals participating in thyroid malignant tumors and colorectal malignant tumors information disclosure from the first quarter of 2012 to the third quarter of 2020. An interrupted time series model with segmented regression analysis is employed to examine changes in quarterly trends with respect to costs per case and length of stay before and after information disclosure. We identified high- and low-cost hospitals by ranking them on a costs per case basis per disease group. RESULTS: This research identified significant differences in cost changes for thyroid malignant tumors and colorectal malignant tumors between hospitals after disclosing information. A hospital's discharge costs per case for thyroid malignant tumors increased significantly among top-cost hospitals (1629.251 RMB, P = 0.019), while decreased for thyroid and colorectal malignant tumors among low-cost hospitals (-1504.189 RMB, P = 0.003; -6511.650 RMB, P = 0.024, respectively). CONCLUSION: Our findings indicate that information disclosure of costs on diseases results in changes in discharge costs per case. And low-cost hospitals continued to maintain their leading edge, whereas the high-cost hospitals changed their position in the industry by reducing discharge costs per case after information disclosure.

10.1186/s12913-023-09510-8.abstractZh:
背景：2013年，上海医院发展中心发布了一项政策，鼓励公立医院公开疾病治疗成本信息。该政策的目的是评估医院间疾病治疗成本信息公开对医疗成本的影响，并比较不同排名的医院在信息公开后每例病例的成本差异。  
方法：本研究使用了上海医院发展中心在2013年第四季度发布的医院级绩效报告，该报告包含了2012年第一季度至2020年第三季度期间14家参与甲状腺恶性肿瘤和结直肠癌恶性肿瘤信息公开的三级公立医院 quarterly 汇总的数据。采用分段回归分析的时间序列模型，来研究信息公开前后每例病例成本和住院时间的变化。我们根据每例病例的成本差异对医院进行排名，从而识别出高成本医院和低成本医院。  
结果：研究发现，信息公开后，甲状腺恶性肿瘤和结直肠癌恶性肿瘤的治疗成本在医院之间存在显著差异。在甲状腺恶性肿瘤方面，高成本医院的每例病例出院成本显著上升（1629.251元人民币，P=0.019），而低成本医院的相应成本则有所下降（-1504.189元人民币，P=0.003；-6511.650元人民币，P=0.024）。  
结论：我们的研究结果表明，疾病治疗成本信息公开会导致每例病例的出院成本发生变化。低成本医院继续保持领先地位，而高成本医院则通过降低每例病例的出院费用来改变其在行业中的地位。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: During the last decade, planning concentration policies have been applied in healthcare systems. Among them, attention has been given to guiding patients towards high-volume hospitals that perform better, acccording to the volume-outcome association. This paper analyses which factors drive patients to choose big or small hospitals (with respect to the international standards of volumes of activity). METHODS: We examined colon cancer surgeries performed in Piedmont (Italy) between 2004 and 2018. We categorised the patient choice of the hospital as big/small, and we used this outcome as main dependent variable of descriptive statistics, tests and logistic regression models. As independent variables, we included (i) patient characteristics, (ii) characteristics of the closest big hospital (which should be perceived as the most immediate to be chosen), and (iii) territorial characteristics (i.e., characteristics of the set of hospitals among which the patient can choose). We also considered interactions among variables to examine which factors influence all or a subset of patients. RESULTS: Our results confirm that patient personal characteristics (such as age) and hospital characteristics (such as distance) play a primary role in the patient decision process. The findings seem to support the importance of closing small hospitals when they are close to big hospitals, although differences emerge between rural and urban areas. Other interesting insights are provided by examining the interactions between factors, e.g., patients affected by comorbidities are more responsive to hospital quality even though they are distant. CONCLUSIONS: Reorganising healthcare services to concentrate them in high-volume hospitals emerged as a crucial issue more than forty years ago. Evidence suggests that concentration strategies guarantee better clinical performance. However, in healthcare systems in which patients are free to choose where to be treated, understanding patients' behaviour and what drives them towards the most effective choice is of paramount importance. Our study builds on previous research that has already analysed factors influencing patients' choices, and takes a step further to enlighten which factors drive patients to choose between a small or a big hospital (in terms of volume). The results could be used by decision makers to design the best concentration strategy.

10.1186/s12913-023-10229-9.abstractZh:
背景：在过去的十年中，规划性集中政策被应用于医疗系统。其中，重点放在根据工作量与治疗效果的关联，引导患者选择那些表现更好的大型医院。本文分析了哪些因素促使患者选择大型或小型医院（以国际上的活动量标准为准）。  
方法：我们研究了2004年至2018年间在意大利皮埃蒙特地区进行的结肠癌手术案例。我们将患者选择的医院分为大型/小型两类，并将这一结果作为描述性统计、测试和逻辑回归模型的主要因变量。作为自变量，我们包括了（i）患者特征，（ii）最近的大型医院的特征（应被视为最易选择的目标医院），以及（iii）地区特征（即患者可以选择的医院集合的特征）。我们还考虑了变量之间的交互作用，以研究哪些因素会影响所有或部分患者。  
结果：我们的研究证实，患者个人特征（如年龄）和医院特征（如距离）在患者决策过程中起着重要作用。研究结果似乎支持了在小型医院靠近大型医院时将其合并的重要性，尽管农村和城市地区之间存在差异。通过研究因素之间的交互作用，我们还发现，患有合并症的患者即使面临距离问题，也更倾向于选择医院质量较高的医院。  
结论：四十多年前，将医疗服务重新组织以集中到大型医院就成为一个至关重要的问题。有证据表明，集中化策略能够确保更好的临床效果。然而，在患者可以自由选择治疗地点的医疗系统中，了解患者的行为以及促使他们做出最佳选择的驱动因素至关重要。我们的研究基于之前已经分析过影响患者选择因素的研究，进一步探讨了哪些因素促使患者选择小型或大型医院。这些结果可以被决策者用来设计最佳的集合化策略。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Private hospitals expanded rapidly in China since 2009 following its national health reform encouraging private investment in the hospital sector. Despite long-standing debates over the performance of different types of hospitals, empirical evidence under the context of developing countries remains scant. We investigated the disparities in health care quality and medical expenses among public, private not-for-profit, and private for-profit hospitals. METHODS: A total of 64,171 inpatients (51,933 for pneumonia (PNA), 9,022 for heart failure (HF) and 3,216 for acute myocardial infarction (AMI)) who were admitted to 528 secondary hospitals in Sichuan province, China, during the fourth quarters of 2016, 2017, and 2018 were selected for this study. Multilevel logistic regressions and multilevel linear regressions were utilized to assess the relationship between hospital ownership types and in-hospital mortality, as well as medical expenses for PNA, HF, and AMI, after adjusting for relevant hospital and patient characteristics, respectively. RESULTS: The private not-for-profit (adjusted OR, 1.69; 95% CI, 1.08, 2.64) and for-profit (adjusted OR, 1.67; 95% CI, 1.06, 2.62) hospitals showed higher in-hospital mortality than the public ones for PNA, but not for AMI and HF. No significant differences were found in medical expenses across hospital ownership types for AMI, but the private not-for-profit was associated with 9% higher medical expenses for treating HF, while private not-for-profit and for-profit hospitals were associated with 10% and 11% higher medical expenses for treating PNA than the public hospitals. No differences were found between the private not-for-profit and private for-profit hospitals both in in-hospital mortality and medical expenses across the three conditions. CONCLUSION: The public hospitals had at least equal or even higher healthcare quality and lower medical expenses than the private ones in China, while private not-for-profit and for-profit hospitals had similar performances in these aspects. Our results added evidences on hospitals' performances among different ownership types under China's context, which has great potential to inform the optimization of healthcare systems implemented among developing countries confronted with similar challenges.

10.1186/s13690-023-01029-y.abstractZh:
背景：自2009年以来，随着中国国家医疗改革的推进，鼓励私人投资医院行业，私立医院在中国迅速扩张。尽管关于不同类型医院绩效的争论由来已久，但在发展中国家背景下，相关的实证证据仍然十分有限。本研究调查了公立医院、非营利性私立医院以及营利性私立医院在医疗质量和医疗费用方面的差异。

方法：本研究选取了2016年、2017年和2018年第四季度在中国四川省528家二级医院中收治的64,171名住院患者（其中肺炎51,933例，心力衰竭9,022例，急性心肌梗死3,216例）。通过多层逻辑回归和多层线性回归分析，分别调整了医院和患者的相关特征，评估医院所有权类型与住院死亡率以及肺炎、心力衰竭和急性心肌梗死的医疗费用之间的关系。

结果：非营利性私立医院和营利性私立医院在肺炎治疗中的住院死亡率高于公立医院，但在心力衰竭和急性心肌梗死方面没有显著差异。在急性心肌梗死的医疗费用方面，不同所有权类型的医院之间没有显著差异，但非营利性私立医院治疗心力衰竭的医疗费用高出9%，而非营利性私立医院和营利性私立医院治疗肺炎的医疗费用分别高出10%和11%。在住院死亡率和医疗费用方面，非营利性私立医院和营利性私立医院之间也没有显著差异。结论：在中国，公立医院在医疗质量、医疗费用方面至少与私立医院相当，甚至更优，而私立非营利性和营利性医院在这些方面的表现也相似。我们的研究结果为不同所有制类型的医院在中国情境下的表现提供了证据，这些结果对于面临类似挑战的发展中国家优化医疗体系具有很大的参考价值。

abstract.text: Credit markets, including the market for bank loans, are characterized by imperfect and asymmetric information. These informational frictions can interact with other economic forces to produce periods of credit-market stress, in which intermediation is unusually costly and households and businesses have difficulty obtaining credit. A high level of credit-market stress, as in a severe financial crisis, may in turn produce a deep and prolonged recession. I present evidence that financial distress and disrupted credit markets were important sources of the Great Depression of the 1930s and the Great Recession of 2007–2009. Changes in the state of credit markets also play a role in “ garden-variety” business cycles and in the transmission of monetary policy to the economy. (JEL D82, E32, E44, E52, G21, N22)

10.1257/aer.113.5.1143.abstractZh: 信贷市场，包括银行贷款市场，其特点是信息的不完全性和不对称性。这些信息障碍可能会与其他经济力量相互作用，导致信贷市场出现紧张状况，此时中介成本异常高，家庭和企业在获得信贷方面面临困难。严重的信贷市场紧张，如严重的金融危机，可能会引发深度且持续的经济衰退。我有证据表明，金融困境和信贷市场的混乱是20世纪30年代大萧条以及2007-2009年大衰退的重要诱因。信贷市场状况的变化也在“普通”商业周期以及货币政策向经济的传导过程中起到重要作用。（JEL D82, E32, E44, E52, G21, N22）

abstract.text: The narrative approach to macroeconomic identification uses qualitative sources, such as newspapers or government records, to provide information that can help establish causal relationships. This paper discusses the requirements for rigorous narrative analysis using fresh research on the impact of monetary policy as the focal application. We read the historical Minutes and Transcripts of Federal Reserve policymaking meetings to identify significant contractionary and expansionary changes in monetary policy not taken in response to current or prospective developments in real activity for the period 1946 to 2016. We find that such monetary shocks have large and significant effects on unemployment, output, and inflation in the expected directions. Analysis of available policy records suggests that a contractionary monetary shock likely occurred in 2022. Based on the empirical estimates of the effect of previous shocks, one would expect substantial negative impacts on real GDP and inflation in 2023 and 2024. (JEL E31, E52, E58, E65, N12)

10.1257/aer.113.6.1395.abstractZh: 宏观经济识别的叙事方法利用报纸或政府记录等定性资料，以提供有助于建立因果关系的线索。本文讨论了使用最新研究来严格进行叙事分析的要求，重点关注货币政策的影响。我们阅读了联邦储备银行政策制定会议的历史记录，以识别在1946年至2016年期间，由于当前或预期的实体经济发展情况而未被采纳的货币政策的紧缩和扩张性变化。我们发现，此类货币冲击对失业、产出和通货膨胀有显著且预期中的影响。对现有政策记录的分析表明，2022年很可能发生了一次紧缩性货币冲击。根据对以往冲击影响的实证估计，预计2023年和2024年实际GDP和通货膨胀将受到重大负面影响。（JEL E31, E52, E58, E65, N12）

abstract.text: We analyze the consequences of noisy information aggregation for investment. Market imperfections create endogenous rents that cause overinvestment in upside risks and underinvestment in downside risks. In partial equilibrium, these inefficiencies are particularly severe if upside risks are coupled with easy scalability of investment. In general equilibrium, the shareholders’ collective attempts to boost value of individual firms leads to a novel externality operating through price that amplifies investment distortions with downside risks but offsets distortions with upside risks. (JEL D21, D25, D83, G14, G32, G41)

10.1257/aer.20170725.abstractZh: 我们分析了噪声信息聚合对投资的影响。市场缺陷会产生内生租金，导致对上行风险的投资过度，而对下行风险的投资不足。在局部均衡中，如果这些上行风险伴随着投资的易扩展性，这些效率低下问题尤为严重。在一般均衡中，股东们试图提升单个公司的价值，这导致了一种新的外部性通过价格发挥作用，这种外部性放大了下行风险的投资扭曲，但抵消了上行风险的扭曲影响。（JEL D21, D25, D83, G14, G32, G41）

abstract.text: We experimentally examine the efficacy of a novel pre-play institution in a well-known coordination game—the minimum-effort game—in which coordination failures are robust and persistent phenomena. This new institution allows agents to communicate while incrementally committing to their words, leading to a distinct theoretical prediction: the efficient outcome is uniquely selected in the extended coordination game. We find that commitment-enhanced communication significantly increases subjects’ payoffs and achieves higher efficiency levels than various nonbinding forms of communication. We further identify the key ingredients of the institution that are central to achieving such gains. (JEL C73, C92, D83)

10.1257/aer.20171014.abstractZh: 我们通过实验研究了一种新颖的预博弈机制在著名的协调博弈——最小努力博弈中的有效性。在这种博弈中，协调失败是一种普遍且持久的现象。这种新机制允许参与者在逐步履行承诺的同时进行沟通，从而得出了一个重要的理论预测：在扩展的协调博弈中，有效的结果会以一种独特的方式被选择出来。我们发现，通过承诺来增强的沟通方式显著提高了参与者的收益，并且其效率高于各种非强制性的沟通方式。我们还确定了实现这种收益的关键机制要素。（JEL C73, C92, D83）

abstract.text: Homeownership is widely stimulated by policy, yet its economic effects are poorly understood. We exploit quasi-random variation in homeownership generated by privatization decisions of municipally owned buildings and use granular data on demographics, income, housing, financial wealth, and debt that allow us to construct high-quality measures of spending. Homeownership causes wealth accumulation via house price appreciation, increases consumption, and improves consumption smoothing across time and states of the world. It increases mobility for young households, who move up the property ladder, and amplifies wealth accumulation for older households, who take more risk in their financial portfolio. (JEL D15, E21, G51, R21, R23, R31, R38)

10.1257/aer.20171449.abstractZh: 房屋所有权受到政策的广泛激励，但其经济效应却尚未被充分理解。我们通过市政拥有的建筑 privatization 决策产生的房屋所有权准随机变化，并利用关于人口统计、收入、住房、金融财富和债务等详细数据，构建了高质量的消费衡量指标。房屋所有权通过房价升值促进财富积累，增加消费，并改善消费在不同时间和不同情境下的平滑性。它提高了年轻家庭的流动性，使他们能够逐步提升财产水平；同时，它放大了老年家庭的财富积累，因为老年家庭在金融投资组合中承担更多风险。（JEL D15, E21, G51, R21, R23, R31, R38）

abstract.text: We examine whether people have an intrinsic preference for negatively skewed or positively skewed information structures and how these preferences relate to intrinsic preferences for informativeness. The results from lab experiments show a strong intrinsic preference for positively skewed information and suggest that providing such information can improve information uptake. Evidence from field studies in decision- and ego-relevant contexts replicates these findings. We discuss our findings through the lens of existing theories and the potential trade-offs in information provision policies. (JEL C91, C93, D12, D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20171474.abstractZh: 我们研究人们是否对负偏态或正偏态的信息结构有内在偏好，以及这些偏好如何与对信息性的内在偏好相关。实验室实验的结果表明，人们存在对正偏态信息的强烈内在偏好，并提示提供此类信息可以提高信息接受度。在决策相关和自我相关的情境中的实地研究也证实了这些发现。我们通过现有理论的角度以及信息提供政策中可能存在的权衡来讨论我们的研究结果。（JEL C91, C93, D12, D82, D83）

abstract.text: We develop a methodology to estimate robust city-level vehicular speed indices, exactly decomposable into uncongested speed and congestion. We apply it to 180 Indian cities using 57 million simulated trips measured by a web mapping service. We verify the reliability of our simulated trips using a number of alternative data sources, including data on actual trips. We find wide variation in speed across cities that is driven more by differences in uncongested speed than congestion. Denser and more populated cities are slower, only in part because of congestion. Urban economic development is correlated with faster speed despite worse congestion. (JEL O15, O18, R23, R41)

10.1257/aer.20181662.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种方法，用于估算城市级别的车辆速度指数，该指数可以精确分解为无拥堵速度和拥堵速度。我们将该方法应用于180个印度城市，使用了由网络地图服务测量的5700万次模拟出行数据。我们通过多种替代数据来源来验证这些模拟出行的可靠性，包括实际出行数据。我们发现，不同城市之间的速度存在很大差异，这种差异更多是由无拥堵速度的差异所驱动，而非拥堵问题。人口更密集、城市规模更大的城市速度较慢，但这只是部分由于拥堵因素造成的。尽管拥堵情况更糟糕，但城市经济发展与更快的速度呈正相关。（JEL O15, O18, R23, R41）

abstract.text: We provide evidence that banks distort the composition of credit supply in order to comply with ratio-based capital requirements in times of economic distress. An unexpected intervention by the European Banking Authority provides a natural experiment to study how banks respond to falling below minimum required capital ratios during an economic downturn. We show that affected banks respond by cutting lending but also by reallocating credit to distressed firms with underreported loan losses. We develop a method to detect underreported losses using loan-level data. The credit reallocation leads to a reallocation of inputs across firms. We calculate that the resulting increase in input misallocation accounts for about 22 percent of the decline in productivity in Portugal in 2012. (JEL E23, E32, G21, G28, G32, G38)

10.1257/aer.20190149.abstractZh: 我们提供了证据，表明银行在经济困难时期为了符合基于比率的资本要求，会扭曲信贷供应的构成。欧洲银行管理局的意外干预为我们提供了一个自然实验，以研究银行在经济衰退期间如何应对资本比率低于最低要求的情况。我们发现，受影响的银行会通过减少贷款来应对，同时也会将信贷重新分配给那些贷款损失被低估的困难企业。我们开发了一种利用贷款数据来检测低估损失的方法。信贷的重新分配导致了企业之间投入资源的重新分配。我们计算出，这种投入资源的重新分配在2012年葡萄牙的生产力下降中占据了约22%的原因。（JEL E23, E32, G21, G28, G32, G38）

abstract.text: The reversal interest rate is the rate at which accommodative monetary policy reverses and becomes contractionary for lending. We theoretically demonstrate its existence in a macroeconomic model featuring imperfectly competitive banks that face financial frictions. When interest rates are cut too low, further monetary stimulus cuts into banks’ profit margins, depressing their net worth and curtailing their credit supply. Similarly, when interest rates are low for too long, the persistent drag on bank profitability eventually outweighs banks’ initial capital gains, also stifling credit supply. We quantify the importance of this mechanism within a calibrated New Keynesian model. (JEL E12, E32, E43, E44, E52, G21, L25)

10.1257/aer.20190150.abstractZh: 逆转利率是指宽松的货币政策在转为紧缩性货币政策时的利率变化。我们在一个具有不完全竞争银行且面临金融摩擦的宏观经济模型中，理论性地证明了这一现象的存在。当利率降得过低时，进一步的货币刺激会进一步压缩银行的利润空间，降低其净资产，并限制信贷供应。同样，当利率长期处于较低水平时，对银行盈利能力的持续负面影响最终会超过银行最初的资本收益，从而抑制信贷供应。我们在一个校准后的新凯恩斯主义模型中量化了这一机制的重要性。（JEL E12, E32, E43, E44, E52, G21, L25）

abstract.text: We develop an axiomatic theory of information acquisition that captures the idea of constant marginal costs in information production: the cost of generating two independent signals is the sum of their costs, and generating a signal with probability half costs half its original cost. Together with Blackwell monotonicity and a continuity condition, these axioms determine the cost of a signal up to a vector of parameters. These parameters have a clear economic interpretation and determine the difficulty of distinguishing states. (JEL D82, D83)

10.1257/aer.20190185.abstractZh: 我们发展了一个关于信息获取的公理理论，该理论体现了信息生产中边际成本恒定的概念：生成两个独立信号的成本等于这两个信号成本之和，而生成某个信号的成本是其原始成本的一半。结合Blackwell单调性条件以及连续性条件，这些公理能够确定信号的成本，直至一个参数向量。这些参数具有明确的经济学含义，并且决定了区分不同状态所需的难度程度。（JEL D82, D83）

abstract.text: We propose a method to estimate the effect of firm policies (e.g., bankruptcy laws) on allocative efficiency using (quasi-)experimental evidence. Our approach takes general equilibrium effects into account and requires neither a structural estimation nor a precise assumption on how the experiment affects firms. Our aggregation formula relies on treatment effects of the policy on the distribution of output-to-capital ratios, which are easily estimated. We show this method is valid for a large class of commonly used models in macrofinance. We apply it to the French banking deregulation episode of the mid- 1980s and find an increase in aggregate TFP of 5 percent. (JEL G21, G24, G28, G31, G32, H25)

10.1257/aer.20190609.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种方法，利用（准）实验证据来估计企业政策（如破产法）对资源配置效率的影响。我们的方法考虑了一般均衡效应，无需进行结构估计，也无需对实验如何影响企业做出精确假设。我们的汇总公式依赖于政策对产出与资本比率分布的处理效应，这些效应很容易估计。我们证明这种方法适用于宏观金融领域常用的多种模型。我们将该方法应用于20世纪80年代中期法国的银行放松管制时期，发现总技术效率增加了5%。（JEL G21, G24, G28, G31, G32, H25）

abstract.text: We develop a trade model with correlation in productivity across countries. The model spans the full class of generalized extreme value import demand systems and implies that countries with relatively dissimilar technology gain more from trade. In the context of a multisector trade model, we provide a tractable and flexible estimation procedure for correlation based on compressing highly disaggregate sectoral data into a few latent factors related to technology classes. We estimate significant heterogeneity in correlation across sectors and countries, which leads to quantitative predictions that are significantly different from estimates of models assuming independent productivity across sectors or countries. (JEL C38, F11, F13, F14, L16, O30)

10.1257/aer.20190781.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个具有国家间生产力相关性的贸易模型。该模型涵盖了所有广义极值进口需求系统，并表明技术相对不同的国家可以从贸易中获得更多收益。在多部门贸易模型的背景下，我们提供了一种基于将高度分散的部门数据压缩为几个与技术类别相关的潜在因素的可行且灵活的相关性估计方法。我们观察到不同部门和国家之间的相关性存在显著的异质性，这导致得出的定量预测结果与假设各部门或国家生产力独立的模型估计结果有显著不同。（JEL C38, F11, F13, F14, L16, O30）

abstract.text: We document variation in working conditions in the United States, present estimates of how workers value these conditions, and assess the impact of working conditions on estimates of wage inequality. We conduct a series of stated-preference experiments to estimate workers’ willingness to pay for a broad set of working conditions, which we validate with actual job choices. We find that working conditions vary substantially, play a significant role in job choice, and are central components of the compensation received by workers. We find that accounting for differences in preferences for working conditions often exacerbates wage differentials and intensifies measures of wage inequality. (JEL J22, J28, J31, J81)

10.1257/aer.20190846.abstractZh: 我们记录了美国工作条件的差异，提出了对工人对这些条件价值的估算，并评估了工作条件对工资不平等程度的影响。我们通过一系列陈述偏好实验来估算工人愿意为一系列工作条件支付的价格，并通过实际的工作选择来验证这些估算。我们发现，工作条件的差异很大，对职业选择起着重要作用，也是工人所获得的报酬的核心组成部分。我们发现，考虑对工作环境的不同偏好往往会加剧工资差异，并强化工资不平等的衡量标准。（JEL J22, J28, J31, J81）

abstract.text: This paper compares outcomes from informally negotiated oil and gas leases to those awarded via centralized auction. We focus on Texas, where legislative decisions in the early twentieth century assigned thousands of proximate parcels to different mineral allocation mechanisms. We show that during the fracking boom, which began unexpectedly decades later, auctioned leases generated at least 55 percent larger up-front payments and 40 percent more output than negotiated leases did. These results suggest large potential gains from employing centralized, formal mechanisms in markets that traditionally allocate in an unstructured fashion, including the broader $3 trillion market for privately owned minerals. (JEL D44, L71, Q35)

10.1257/aer.20191594.abstractZh: 本文比较了非正式谈判的石油和天然气租约与通过集中拍卖方式获得的租约的结果。我们重点关注德克萨斯州，该州在20世纪初的立法决策将数千个相邻区块分配给了不同的矿产分配机制。研究表明，在 fracking 热潮期间，这一热潮在数十年后才突然兴起，通过拍卖方式获得的租约所支付的预付款至少比通过谈判获得的租约多出55%，而产出则多出40%。这些结果表明，在那些传统上以非结构化方式分配资源的市场中，采用集中、正式的机制可以带来巨大的潜在收益，包括价值3万亿美元的私人矿产市场。（JEL D44, L71, Q35）

abstract.text: Bureaucrats implement policy. How important are they for a state’s productivity? And do the trade-offs between policies depend on their effectiveness? Using data on 16 million public purchases in Russia, we show that 39 percent of the variation in prices paid for narrowly defined items is due to the individual bureaucrats and organizations who manage procurement. Low-price buyers also display higher spending quality. Theory suggests that such differences in effectiveness can be pivotal for policy design. To illustrate, we show that a common one—bid preferences for domestic suppliers—substantially improves procurement performance, but only when implemented by ineffective bureaucrats. (JEL D73, H57, H83, L14, P26)

10.1257/aer.20191598.abstractZh: 官僚们负责政策的实施。他们对一个国家的生产力有多重要？政策之间的权衡是否取决于官僚们的效率？通过研究俄罗斯1600万笔公共采购的数据，我们发现，对于定义明确的物品，39%的价格差异是由负责采购的个别官僚和组织造成的。低价采购者也表现出更高的支出质量。理论表明，这种效率上的差异对政策设计至关重要。例如，我们发现，对国内供应商的竞标偏好这一常见做法，只有在由效率较低的官僚实施时，才能显著提升采购绩效。（JEL D73, H57, H83, L14, P26）

abstract.text: Does armed conflict reduce trade, even in noncombat areas, through the destruction of intergroup social capital? We analyze Ukrainian trade transactions before and after the 2014 Russia-Ukraine conflict. In a difference-in-differences framework, we find that Ukrainian firms from districts with fewer ethnic Russians experienced a deeper decline in trade with Russia. This decline is economically signifi-cant, persistent, and can be explained by erosion of intergroup trust. Affected Ukrainian firms suffered a decrease in performance and diverted trade to other countries. Our results suggest that, through social effects, conflict can be economically damaging even away from combat areas. (JEL D74, F14, F51, J15, P31, P33, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20191701.abstractZh: 武装冲突是否会通过破坏群体间社会资本来减少贸易，即使在非战斗区域也是如此？我们分析了2014年俄罗斯与乌克兰冲突前后乌克兰的贸易交易情况。在差异-差异框架中，我们发现来自少数民族聚居区的乌克兰企业与俄罗斯的贸易下降幅度更大。这种下降在经济上具有重要意义，且具有持续性，可以通过群体间信任的侵蚀来解释。受影响的乌克兰企业业绩下降，并将贸易转向其他国家。我们的研究结果表明，冲突通过社会效应，即使在非战斗区域也能造成经济损失。（JEL D74, F14, F51, J15, P31, P33, Z13）

abstract.text: This paper presents a puzzle in the behavior of experimental subjects in what we call common-probability auctions. In common-value auctions, uncertainty is defined over values, while in common-probability auctions, uncertainty is defined over probabilities. We find that in contrast to the substantial overbidding found in common-value auctions, bidding in strategically equivalent common-probability auctions is consistent with Nash equilibrium. To explain our results, we run treatments to identify whether this difference stems from the way subjects estimate the good’s value in a competitive environment rather than the way they bid conditional on these valuations. We conclude it is the former. (JEL C70, C90, D44, D81)

10.1257/aer.20191927.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在所谓“共同概率拍卖”中实验对象行为的一个谜题。在共同价值拍卖中，不确定性是围绕价值来定义的；而在共同概率拍卖中，不确定性则是围绕概率来定义的。我们发现，与共同价值拍卖中出现的过度出价现象不同，在策略上等效的共同概率拍卖中的出价行为与纳什均衡是一致的。为了解释我们的研究结果，我们进行了实验分析，以确定这种差异是否源于实验对象在竞争环境中对商品价值的估计方式，而非基于这些估值进行的出价行为。我们的结论是，差异确实源于前者。（JEL C70, C90, D44, D81）

abstract.text: This project links administrative census microdata to spatially continuous measures of particulate pollution (PM2.5) to first document and then decompose the key drivers of convergence in black-white pollution exposure differences. We use quantile regression to show that a significant portion of the convergence in Black-White exposure is attributable to differential impacts of the Clean Air Act (CAA) in Black and White communities. Areas with larger Black populations saw greater CAA-related declines in PM2.5. We show that the CAA can account for over 60 percent of the racial convergence in PM2.5 pollution exposure in the United States since 2000. (JEL J15, K32, Q51, Q53, Q58)

10.1257/aer.20191957.abstractZh: 本项目将行政人口普查微观数据与空间连续的颗粒物污染（PM2.5）数据相结合，首先记录并分解了黑人与白人污染暴露差异的主要驱动因素。我们通过分位数回归分析发现，黑人与白人暴露差异的显著部分可归因于《清洁空气法》对黑人和白人社区的不同影响。黑人群体较多的地区，PM2.5浓度因《清洁空气法》而下降的幅度更大。研究表明，自2000年以来，美国PM2.5污染暴露的种族差异中，有超过60%可以归因于《清洁空气法》的影响。（JEL J15, K32, Q51, Q53, Q58）

abstract.text: This paper uses the universe of cellphone records from a Chinese telecommunication provider for a northern Chinese city to examine the role of information exchange in urban labor markets. We provide the first direct evidence of increased communication among referral pairs around job changes. Information provided by social contacts mitigates information asymmetry and improves labor market performance. (JEL D82, J62, O18, P23, P25, R23, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20200187.abstractZh: 本文利用中国某北方城市电信供应商的手机记录数据，研究信息交换在城市劳动力市场中的作用。我们首次直接证明了在职业变动期间，推荐对象之间的交流会增加。社交关系提供的信息能够缓解信息不对称问题，从而提高劳动力市场的绩效。（JEL D82, J62, O18, P23, P25, R23, Z13）

abstract.text: We study optimal monetary policy in an analytically tractable heterogeneous agent New Keynesian model with rich cross-sectional heterogeneity. Optimal policy differs from a representative agent benchmark because monetary policy can affect consumption inequality, by stabilizing consumption risk arising from both idiosyncratic shocks and unequal exposures to aggregate shocks. The trade-off between consumption inequality, productive efficiency, and price stability is summarized in a simple linear-quadratic problem yielding interpretable target criteria. Stabilizing consumption inequality requires putting some weight on stabilizing the level of output, and correspondingly reducing the weights on the output gap and price level relative to the representative agent benchmark. (JEL E12, E23, E31, E32, E52, E62)

10.1257/aer.20200239.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个分析上可处理的异质代理人新凯恩斯模型中的最优货币政策问题，该模型具有丰富的横截面异质性。最优政策与代表性代理人的基准策略不同，因为货币政策可以通过稳定由特异性冲击和总体冲击的不平等影响引起的消费风险来影响消费不平等。消费不平等、生产效率与价格稳定之间的权衡可以表述为一个简单的线性-二次问题，从而得出可解释的目标标准。稳定消费不平等需要重视产出水平的稳定，相应地减少与代表性代理人基准相比对产出缺口和价格水平的重视程度。（JEL E12, E23, E31, E32, E52, E62）

abstract.text: We document the sources behind the costs of job loss over the business cycle using administrative data from Germany. Losses in annual earnings after displacement are large, persistent, and highly cyclical, nearly doubling in size during downturns. A large part of the long-term earnings losses and their cyclicality is driven by declines in wages. Key to these long-lasting wage declines and their cyclicality are changes in employer characteristics, as displaced workers switch to lower-paying firms. These losses increase with duration of nonemployment. Changes in characteristics of displaced workers or displacing firms, and other post-job loss career outcomes explain little of the cyclicality. (JEL E24, E32, J31, J63, J64, J65)

10.1257/aer.20200252.abstractZh: 我们利用德国的行政数据，记录了经济周期中失业成本背后的成因。因失业导致的年收入损失巨大、持续时间长且具有高度周期性，在经济衰退期间损失幅度几乎翻倍。长期收入损失及其周期性变化在很大程度上是由工资下降所驱动的。这些长期存在的工资下降及其周期性变化，主要源于雇主特征的变化，即失业工人转向薪酬较低的企业。这些损失随着失业时间的延长而加剧。失业工人或导致失业的企业特征的变化，以及其他失业后的职业结果，对周期性变化的解释作用有限。（JEL E24, E32, J31, J63, J64, J65）

abstract.text: A large body of evidence finds that relative mobility in the US has declined over the past 150 years. However, long-run mobility estimates are usually based on White samples and therefore do not account for the limited opportunities available for nonwhite families. Moreover, historical data measure the father’s status with error, which biases estimates toward greater mobility. Using linked census data from 1850 to 1940, I show that accounting for race and measurement error can double estimates of intergenerational persistence. Updated estimates imply that there is greater equality of opportunity today than in the past, mostly because opportunity was never that equal. (JEL J15, J62, N31, N32)

10.1257/aer.20200292.abstractZh: 大量证据表明，过去150年间，美国的相对流动性有所下降。然而，长期流动性估计通常基于白人样本，因此未能考虑到非白人家庭所面临的有限机会。此外，历史数据在衡量父亲的社会地位时存在误差，这导致估计结果倾向于高估流动性。通过利用1850年至1940年的关联人口普查数据，我发现考虑种族因素和测量误差后，代际持续性的估计结果会翻倍。最新的估计表明，今天的机会平等程度比过去更高，主要是因为机会从来就没有真正平等过。（JEL J15, J62, N31, N32）

abstract.text: Empirical evidence shows that most international prices are sticky in dollars. This paper studies the policy implications of this fact in the context of an open economy model with general preferences, technologies, asset markets, nominal rigidities, and a rich set of shocks. We show that although monetary policy is less efficient and cannot implement the flexible-price allocation, inflation targeting and a floating exchange rate remain robustly optimal in non-US economies. The capital controls cannot unilaterally improve the allocation and are useful only when coordinated across countries. International cooperation benefits other economies, but is not in the self-interest of the United States. (JEL E31, E52, F14, F31, F38, F41)

10.1257/aer.20200636.abstractZh: 实证证据表明，大多数国际价格在美元层面具有粘性。本文研究了这一事实在开放经济模型中的政策含义，该模型包含一般偏好、技术、资产市场、名义刚性以及多种冲击因素。我们指出，尽管货币政策效率较低，无法实现灵活的价格分配，但在非美国经济体中，通胀目标制和浮动汇率仍然保持稳健的最优性。资本管制无法单方面改善资源配置，只有在各国之间协调实施时才有用。国际合作对其他经济体有益，但不符合美国的自身利益。（JEL E31, E52, F14, F31, F38, F41）

abstract.text: We examine international regulatory agreements that are negotiated under lobbying pressures from producer groups. The way in which lobbying influences the cooperative setting of regulatory policies, as well as the welfare impacts of international agreements, depend crucially on whether the interests of producers in different countries are aligned or in conflict. The former situation tends to occur for product standards, while the latter tends to occur for process standards. We find that, if producer lobbies are strong enough, agreements on product standards lead to excessive deregulation and decrease welfare, while agreements on process standards tighten regulations and enhance welfare. (JEL F13, F14, F15, L15, L51)

10.1257/aer.20200780.abstractZh: 我们研究了在生产者团体的游说压力下谈判达成的国际监管协议。游说如何影响监管政策的合作制定，以及国际协议的福利影响，在很大程度上取决于不同国家的生产者利益是否一致或冲突。在产品标准方面，这种情况往往发生；而在工艺标准方面，则往往出现相反的情况。我们发现，如果生产者游说团体足够强大，关于产品标准的协议会导致过度放松监管并降低福利，而关于工艺标准的协议则会加强监管并提高福利。（JEL F13, F14, F15, L15, L51）

abstract.text: Counselors are a common school resource for students navigating complicated and consequential education choices. I estimate counselors’ causal effects using quasi-random assignment policies in Massachusetts. Counselors vary substantially in their effectiveness at increasing high school graduation and college attendance, selectivity, and persistence. Counselor effects on educational attainment are similar in magnitude to teacher effects, but they flow through improved information and assistance more than cognitive or noncognitive skill development. Counselor effectiveness is most important for low-income and low-achieving students, so improving access to effective counseling may be a promising way to increase educational attainment and close socioeconomic gaps in education. (JEL H75, I21, I24, I28)

10.1257/aer.20200847.abstractZh: 辅导员是帮助学生做出复杂且重要教育选择的常见学校资源。我利用马萨诸塞州的准随机分配政策来估算辅导员的因果效应。辅导员在提高高中毕业率和大学入学率、选拔性和持续性方面的效果存在显著差异。辅导员对教育成就的影响与教师的影响相当，但这些影响主要通过改善信息和帮助来实现，而非通过认知或非认知技能的发展来实现。对于低收入和成绩较低的学生来说，辅导员的效力最为重要，因此改善有效辅导的获取机会可能是提高教育成就并缩小教育中的社会经济差距的一种有效方法。（JEL H75, I21, I24, I28）

abstract.text: Regressions of private-sector macroeconomic forecast revisions on monetary policy surprises often produce coefficients with signs opposite to standard macroeconomic models. The “Fed information effect” argues these puzzling results are due to monetary policy surprises revealing Fed private information. We show they are also consistent with a “Fed response to news” channel, where both the Fed and professional forecasters respond to incoming economic news. We present new evidence challenging the Fed information effect and supporting the Fed response to news channel, including: regressions that control for economic news, our own survey of professional forecasters, and financial market responses to FOMC announcements. (JEL D82, E23, E27, E43, E44, E52, E58)

10.1257/aer.20201220.abstractZh: 私人部门宏观经济预测修正对货币政策意外反应的回归结果，往往产生与标准宏观经济模型相反的符号系数。所谓的“美联储信息效应”认为，这些令人困惑的结果是由于货币政策意外反应揭示了美联储的私人信息所致。我们表明，这些结果也与“美联储对新闻的反应”机制一致，即美联储和专业预测者都会对即将发布的经济新闻作出反应。我们提供了新的证据，挑战“美联储信息效应”理论，并支持“美联储对新闻的反应”机制，这些证据包括：控制经济新闻影响的回归分析、我们对专业预测者的调查，以及金融市场对FOMC公告的反应。（JEL D82, E23, E27, E43, E44, E52, E58）

abstract.text: This paper explores the intergenerational consequences of social exclusion on prosociality. A lab-in-the-field approach in the historical region of Colombia’s leper colony reveals that descendants of socially excluded individuals are locally altruistic and extend such altruism to outsiders who have undergone similar circumstances. These individuals also display mistrust toward those who have, historically, been exclusionary—in this case, doctors. The content of historical narratives shared by ancestors who were excluded, which emphasize the endured mistreatment and doctors’ historical misinformation, is one mechanism that partially explains the intergenerational patterns. (JEL D64, H51, I12, I18, N36, N96, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20201332.abstractZh: 本文探讨了社会排斥对代际行为影响的后果。在哥伦比亚麻风病聚居区进行的一项实地研究揭示，那些曾遭受社会排斥的人的后代在本地表现出利他行为，并将这种利他行为扩展到经历过类似境遇的他人。这些个体还表现出对历史上曾进行排斥行为的人——在本例中为医生——的不信任。被排斥的祖先所分享的历史叙事中，强调了所遭受的虐待以及医生的历史性错误信息，这是部分解释这种代际行为模式的一个机制。（JEL D64, H51, I12, I18, N36, N96, Z13）

abstract.text: Moral behavior is more prevalent when individuals cannot easily distort their beliefs self-servingly. Do individuals seek to limit or enable their ability to distort beliefs? How do these choices affect behavior? Experiments with over 9,000 participants show preferences are heterogeneous—30 percent of participants prefer to limit belief distortion, while over 40 percent prefer to enable it, even if costly. A random assignment mechanism reveals that being assigned to the preferred environment is necessary for curbing or enabling self-serving behavior. Third parties can anticipate these effects, suggesting some sophistication about the cognitive constraints to belief distortion. (JEL C91, D82, D83, D91)

10.1257/aer.20201333.abstractZh: 当个体难以轻易地为了自身利益而扭曲信念时，道德行为更为普遍。个体是倾向于限制还是促进其扭曲信念的能力？这些选择如何影响行为？针对超过9,000名参与者的实验表明，人们的偏好存在差异——30%的参与者倾向于限制信念扭曲，而超过40%的参与者则倾向于促进这种扭曲，即使这会带来成本。随机分配机制显示，被分配到偏好环境中对于抑制或促进自我服务行为是必要的。第三方可以预测这些效应，这表明人们对信念扭曲的认知约束有一定的理解。（JEL C91, D82, D83, D91）

abstract.text: This paper develops and applies a method to value water trading on a river network. The framework relies on regulatory variation in diversion caps to identify production functions for irrigated farms, then uses the estimated shadow values to assess the market’s reallocation. I apply this framework to the largest water market in human history, located in southeastern Australia. Observed water trading increased output by 4–6 percent from 2007 to 2015, equivalent to avoiding an 8–12 percent uniform decline in water resources. Reallocation and average surplus both increase substantially during drought, implying that water markets can be most valuable when climatic variability is most severe. (JEL D23, D24, Q12, Q15, Q25, Q54)

10.1257/aer.20201434.abstractZh: 本文开发并应用了一种方法，用于评估河流网络中的水资源交易价值。该框架基于调水上限的调控差异，来识别灌溉农场的生产函数，然后利用估算出的影子价值来评估市场的重新分配情况。我将这一框架应用于人类历史上最大的水资源市场——位于澳大利亚东南部的市场。观察发现，从2007年到2015年，水资源交易使产量增加了4-6%，相当于避免了8-12%的水资源均匀减少。在干旱期间，重新分配和平均剩余量都会显著增加，这表明在气候变异性最严重的时候，水资源市场具有最大的价值。（JEL D23, D24, Q12, Q15, Q25, Q54）

abstract.text: We provide theory and evidence on the relationship between globalization and pandemics. Business travel facilitates trade and travel leads to human interactions that transmit disease. Trade-motivated travel generates an epidemiological externality across countries. If infections lead to deaths, or reduce individual labor supply, we establish a general equilibrium social distancing effect, whereby increases in relative prices in unhealthy countries reduce travel to those countries. If agents internalize the threat of infection, we show that their behavioral responses lead to a reduction in travel that is larger for higher-trade-cost locations, which initially reduces the ratio of trade to output. (JEL D91, F14, F60, I12, N30, N70, Z31)

10.1257/aer.20201479.abstractZh: 我们提供了关于全球化与流行病之间关系的理论和证据。商务旅行促进了贸易，而旅行又导致了疾病传播的人际互动。以贸易为动机的旅行会在国家之间产生流行病学外部性。如果感染导致死亡或减少个人劳动力供给，我们将建立一个一般均衡的社会距离效应，即不健康国家相对价格的上升会减少前往这些国家的旅行。如果个体将感染威胁内部化，我们表明他们的行为反应会导致旅行减少，对于贸易成本较高的地区来说，这种减少更为显著，这最初会降低贸易与产出之比。（JEL D91, F14, F60, I12, N30, N70, Z31）

abstract.text: We propose a nonparametric test for the exclusion and monotonicity assumptions invoked in instrumental variable (IV) designs based on the random assignment of cases to judges. We show its asymptotic validity and demonstrate its finite-sample performance in simulations. We apply our test in an empirical setting from the literature examining the effects of pretrial detention on defendant outcomes in New York. When the assumptions are not satisfied, we propose weaker versions of the usual exclusion and monotonicity restrictions under which the IV estimator still converges to a proper weighted average of treatment effects. (JEL H76, K41)

10.1257/aer.20201860.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种非参数检验方法，用于检验工具变量设计中提出的排除假设和单调性假设，该检验基于案例随机分配到法官的情况。我们证明了该检验的渐近有效性，并在模拟实验中展示了其有限样本下的表现。我们在一项来自文献的实证研究中应用了该检验，该研究考察了预拘留对纽约地区被告结果的影响。当这些假设不满足时，我们提出了较弱版本的排除假设和单调性限制，在这些限制下，工具变量估计量仍然能够收敛到处理效应的适当加权平均值。（JEL H76, K41）

abstract.text: This paper documents the impact of popular media on racial hate by examining the first American blockbuster: 1915’s The Birth of a Nation, a fictional portrayal of the KKK’s founding rife with racist stereotypes. Exploiting the film’s five-year “road show,” I find a sharp spike in lynchings and race riots coinciding with its arrival in a county. Instrumenting for road show destinations using the location of theaters prior to the movie’s release, I show that the film significantly increased local Klan support in the 1920s. Road show counties continue to experience higher rates of hate crimes and hate groups a century later. (JEL J15, K42, L82, N31, N32, N41, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20201867.abstractZh: 本文通过研究美国首部大片《国家诞生》（1915年）对种族仇恨的影响，来探讨大众媒体对种族仇恨的推动作用。这部电影以虚构的方式描绘了三K党的成立过程，其中充斥着种族主义刻板印象。通过对该电影在影院放映期间所到之地的分析，我发现随着电影在某一地区的上映，私刑和种族骚乱的发生率显著上升。利用电影上映前影院的位置信息，我发现这部电影在20世纪20年代显著增加了当地三K党的支持率。一个世纪后，这些地区仍然面临着较高的仇恨犯罪率和仇恨团体活动。（JEL J15, K42, L82, N31, N32, N41, Z13）

abstract.text: We test between cooperative and extractive theories of the origins of government. We use river shifts in southern Iraq as a natural experiment, in a new archeological panel dataset. A shift away creates a local demand for a government to coordinate because private river irrigation needs to be replaced with public canals. It disincentivizes local extraction as land is no longer productive without irrigation. Consistent with a cooperative theory of government, a river shift away led to state formation, canal construction, and the payment of tribute. We argue that the first governments coordinated between extended households which implemented public good provision. (JEL D72, H11, H41, N45, N55, Q15)

10.1257/aer.20201919.abstractZh: 我们对比了合作主义与剥削主义关于政府起源的理论，并通过伊拉克南部的河流变迁这一自然实验，利用新的考古面板数据集进行了研究。河流变迁导致当地产生了对政府协调的需求，因为私人河流灌溉系统需要被公共运河取代。这使得当地对资源的剥削行为变得不那么有吸引力，因为没有灌溉系统，土地不再具有生产力。与合作主义理论相符的是，河流变迁促进了国家的形成、运河的建设以及贡品的支付。我们认为，最初的政府是由扩展的家庭群体共同组成的，他们共同负责提供公共物品。（JEL D72, H11, H41, N45, N55, Q15）

abstract.text: We study crises characterized by large adjustments of aggregate consumption through their microlevel patterns. We document the cross-sectional patterns of consumption adjustment across the income distribution and find large adjustments for top-income households, who exhibit consumption-income elasticities similar to or larger than the average. We construct a heterogeneous-agent open economy model of consumption under income fluctuations and show that the data patterns are largely consistent with theories that attribute the dynamics of aggregate consumption to changes in aggregate permanent income. We also discuss our findings’ implications for theories based on the tightening of households’ borrowing constraints and analyze policy implications. (JEL D31, E21, E32, F33, G51, O11, O12)

10.1257/aer.20201931.abstractZh: 我们研究了以微观层面调整为特征的危机现象，这些调整涉及总体消费的大幅变动。我们记录了消费调整在收入分布中的横向分布特征，发现高收入家庭的消费调整幅度较大，其消费与收入之间的弹性与平均水平相当或更高。我们构建了一个异质代理人开放经济模型，用于研究收入波动下的消费行为，并发现数据模式与那些将总体消费动态归因于总体永久收入变化的理论大体一致。我们还讨论了我们的发现对基于收紧家庭借贷限制的理论的影响，并分析了政策含义。（JEL D31, E21, E32, F33, G51, O11, O12）

abstract.text: This paper quantifies the contribution of technology gaps to international income inequality. I develop an endogenous growth model where cross-country differences in R&D efficiency and cross-industry differences in innovation and adoption opportunities together determine equilibrium technology gaps, trade patterns, and income inequality. Countries with higher R&D efficiency are richer and have comparative advantage in more innovation-dependent industries. I calibrate R&D efficiency by country and innovation dependence by industry using R&D, patent, and bilateral trade data. Counterfactual analysis implies technology gaps account for one-quarter to one-third of nominal wage variation within the OECD. (JEL D21, D24, D31, F14, O31, O33, O47)

10.1257/aer.20201940.abstractZh: 本文量化了技术差距对国际收入不平等的影响。我建立了一个内生增长模型，其中跨国间的研发效率差异以及不同行业在创新与采纳机会上的差异共同决定了均衡技术差距、贸易模式以及收入不平等。研发效率较高的国家更富裕，并在更多依赖创新的行业中具有比较优势。我通过研发、专利和双边贸易数据来校准各国的研发效率以及各行业的创新依赖性。反事实分析表明，技术差距占经合组织内部名义工资差异的四分之一到三分之一。（JEL D21, D24, D31, F14, O31, O33, O47）

abstract.text: Populism at the country level is at an all-time high, with more than 25 percent of nations currently governed by populists. How do economies perform under populist leaders? We build a new long-run cross-country database to study the macroeconomic history of populism. We identify 51 populist presidents and prime ministers from 1900 to 2020 and show that the economic cost of populism is high. After 15 years, GDP per capita is 10 percent lower compared to a plausible nonpopulist counterfactual. Economic disintegration, decreasing macroeconomic stability, and the erosion of institutions typically go hand in hand with populist rule. (JEL D72, E23, N10, N40, O43)

10.1257/aer.20202045.abstractZh: 国家层面的民粹主义达到了历史最高水平，目前有超过25%的国家由民粹主义领导人治理。在民粹主义领导人的领导下，经济表现如何？我们建立了一个新的长期跨国数据库，以研究民粹主义的宏观经济历史。我们确定了1900年至2020年间51位民粹主义总统和总理，并发现民粹主义的经济成本很高。15年后，人均GDP比没有民粹主义的合理反事实情况低10%。经济解体、宏观经济稳定性的下降以及制度的侵蚀通常与民粹主义统治相伴而生。（JEL D72, E23, N10, N40, O43）

abstract.text: We show in two natural experiments that default rules in Medicare Part D have large, persistent effects on enrollment and drug utilization of low-income beneficiaries. The implications of this phenomenon for welfare and optimal policy depend on the sensitivity of passivity to the value of the default option. Using random assignment to default options, we show that beneficiary passivity is extremely insensitive, even when enrolling in the default option would result in substantial drug consumption losses. A third natural experiment suggests that variation in active choice is driven by random transitory shocks rather than the inherent attentiveness of some beneficiaries.

10.1257/aer.20210013.abstractZh: 我们通过两个自然实验表明，Medicare Part D中的默认规则对低收入受益人的参保率和药物使用有显著且持久的影响。这一现象对福利和最优政策的意义取决于被动性对默认选项价值的敏感度。通过随机分配默认选项，我们发现受益人的被动性几乎不敏感，即使选择默认选项会导致大量药物使用损失。第三个自然实验表明，主动选择的差异是由随机的短暂冲击引起的，而非某些受益人的固有注意力所致。

abstract.text: Current refugee resettlement processes account for neither the preferences of refugees nor the priorities of hosting communities. We introduce a new framework for matching with multidimensional knapsack constraints that captures the (possibly multidimensional) sizes of refugee families and the capacities of communities. We propose four refugee resettlement mechanisms and two solution concepts that can be used in refugee resettlement matching under various institutional and informational constraints. Our theoretical results and simulations using refugee resettlement data suggest that preference-based matching mechanisms can improve match efficiency, respect priorities of communities, and incentivize refugees to report where they would prefer to settle. (JEL C78, D82, J15, J18)
