10.1257/aer.20210096.abstractZh: 当前的难民安置流程并未充分考虑难民的偏好以及接收社区的优先事项。我们提出了一种新的框架，用于匹配具有多维约束条件的背包问题，该框架能够涵盖难民家庭的多维规模以及社区的能力。我们提出了四种难民安置机制以及两种解决方案，这些机制可以在各种制度和信息限制条件下用于难民安置匹配。我们的理论结果以及使用难民安置数据的模拟表明，基于偏好的匹配机制可以提高匹配效率，尊重社区的优先事项，并激励难民报告他们更愿意定居的地方。（JEL C78, D82, J15, J18）

abstract.text: We present a framework that can be used to assess the equilibrium impact of regulation on endogenous innovation with heterogeneous firms. We implement this model using French firm-level panel data, where there is a sharp increase in the burden of labor regulations on companies with 50 or more employees. Consistent with the model’s qualitative predictions, we find a fall in the fraction of innovating firms just to the left of the regulatory threshold. Furthermore, we find a reduction in the innovation response of firms to demand shocks just below the threshold. Regulation reduces aggregate innovation by 5.7 percent. (JEL D22, K31, L11, L25, L51, O31, O34)

10.1257/aer.20210107.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个框架，可用于评估监管对具有异质性企业的内生创新的影响。我们使用法国企业层面的面板数据来实施这一模型，发现对于拥有50名或更多员工的公司来说，劳动监管的负担显著增加。与模型的定性预测一致，我们发现处于监管阈值左侧的创新企业比例有所下降。此外，我们发现企业在需求冲击下的创新反应也低于阈值水平。监管导致总体创新减少了5.7%。（JEL D22, K31, L11, L25, L51, O31, O34）

abstract.text: Information sets, expectations, and preferences of politicians are fundamental, but unobserved determinants of their policy choices. Employing repeated votes in the US House of Representatives on China’s normal trade relations (NTR) status during the two decades straddling China’s World Trade Organization (WTO) accession, we apply a moment inequality approach designed to deliver consistent estimates under weak informational assumptions on the information sets of members of Congress. This methodology offers a robust way to test hypotheses about what information politicians have at the time of their decision and to estimate the weight that constituents, ideology, and other factors have in policy making and voting. (JEL D72, D78, D83, D84, F14, P33)

10.1257/aer.20210140.abstractZh: 政治家的信息集、预期和偏好是基本的因素，但他们的政策选择还受到许多未观察到的因素的影响。通过研究美国众议院在二十年间关于中国加入世界贸易组织后的正常贸易关系地位的反复投票行为，我们采用了一种基于矩不等式的方法，该方法能够在国会成员信息集信息不足的情况下，仍然得出一致的估计结果。这种方法为检验政治家在决策时所掌握的信息，以及选民、意识形态和其他因素在政策制定与投票中的影响提供了有效的手段。（JEL D72, D78, D83, D84, F14, P33）

abstract.text: Partisanship of state governors affects the efficacy of US federal fiscal policy. Using close election data, we find partisan differences in the marginal propensity to spend federal intergovernmental transfers: Republican governors spend less than Democratic governors. Correspondingly, Republican-led states have lower debt, (delayed) lower taxes, and initially lower economic activity. A New Keynesian model of partisan states in a monetary union implies sizable aggregate effects: The intergovernmental transfer impact multiplier rises by 0.58 if Republican governors spend like Democratic governors, but due to delayed tax cuts, the long-run multiplier is higher with more Republican governors, generating an intertemporal policy trade-off. (JEL D72, E12, E62, H71, H72, H74, H77)

10.1257/aer.20210147.abstractZh: 州长的党派立场会影响美国联邦财政政策的效力。通过紧密选举数据，我们发现共和党州长与民主党州长在支出联邦政府转移支付方面的倾向存在差异：共和党州长比民主党州长支出更少。相应地，由共和党人领导的州债务较低、（延迟的）税收较低，经济活动也较低。一个关于货币联盟中党派州长的新凯恩斯主义模型表明，这种差异会产生显著的总体效应：如果共和党州长的支出行为与民主党州长相似，那么政府转移支付的影响乘数将增加0.58；但由于税收削减的延迟效应，长期来看，共和党州长越多，乘数会更高，这就产生了一个跨时期政策权衡的问题。（JEL D72, E12, E62, H71, H72, H74, H77）

abstract.text: We study a problem in which policymakers need to screen self-selected individuals by unobserved heterogeneity in social welfare gains from a policy intervention. In our framework, the marginal treatment effects and marginal treatment responses arise as key statistics to characterize social welfare. We apply this framework to a randomized field experiment on electricity plan choice. Consumers were offered welfare-improving dynamic pricing with randomly assigned take-up incentives. We find that price-elastic consumers—who generate larger welfare gains—are more likely to self-select. Our counterfactual simulations quantify the optimal take-up incentives that exploit observed and unobserved heterogeneity in selection and welfare gains. (JEL C93, D12, L11, L94, L98)

10.1257/aer.20210150.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个问题，即政策制定者需要通过未观察到的社会福利收益差异来筛选自我选择的个体。在我们的框架中，边际处理效应和边际处理反应成为描述社会福利的关键统计量。我们将这一框架应用于一项关于电力计划选择的随机实地实验。消费者被提供了具有福利改善功能的动态定价方案，同时随机分配了接受激励的方式。我们发现，对价格有弹性的消费者——他们能够产生更大的福利收益——更有可能进行自我筛选。我们的反事实模拟量化了能够利用观察到的和未观察到的选择及福利收益差异的最佳接受激励方式。（JEL C93, D12, L11, L94, L98）

abstract.text: We examine the role of technological change in explaining the large and persistent decline in earnings following job loss. Using detailed skill requirements from the near universe of online vacancies, we estimate technological change by occupation and find that technological change accounts for 45 percent of the decline in earnings after job loss. Technological change lowers earnings after job loss by requiring workers to have new skills to perform newly created jobs in their prior occupation. When workers lack the required skills, they move to occupations where their skills are still employable but are paid a lower wage. (JEL J24, J31, J63, O33)

10.1257/aer.20210182.abstractZh: 我们研究了技术变革在解释失业后收入大幅且持续下降中的作用。通过详细分析大量在线职位的信息，我们按职业对技术变革进行了估算，发现技术变革在失业后收入下降中占45%的成因。技术变革导致失业后的收入下降，因为工人需要掌握新的技能才能胜任之前职业中新增的工作岗位。当工人缺乏所需技能时，他们就会转向那些技能仍然可用但工资较低的职业。（JEL J24, J31, J63, O33）

abstract.text: We study health-care provider agency and optimal payments, considering an expensive medication for dialysis patients. Using Medicare claims data we estimate a structural model of treatment decisions, in which providers differ in their altruism and marginal costs, and this heterogeneity is unobservable to the government. In a novel application of nonlinear pricing methods, we empirically characterize the optimal contracts in this environment. The optimal contracts eliminate medically excessive dosages and reduce expenditures, resulting in approximately $300 million in annual gains from better contracting. This approach could be applied to a broad class of problems in health-care payment policy. (JEL D64, D86, H51, I11, I13, J33, L21)

10.1257/aer.20210208.abstractZh: 我们研究了医疗保健提供者的代理行为及最优支付机制，以透析患者所需昂贵的药物为例。利用Medicare索赔数据，我们构建了一个治疗决策的结构模型，其中提供者在利他主义和边际成本方面存在差异，而这种差异对政府来说是不可观测的。通过非线性定价方法的新应用，我们实证分析了这一环境下的最优合同安排。最优合同能够消除医疗上的过度用药现象，并减少支出，从而每年带来约3亿美元的经济效益。这种方法可以应用于医疗保健支付政策中的多种问题。（JEL D64, D86, H51, I11, I13, J33, L21）

abstract.text: When countries change most favored nation (MFN) tariffs, partners that trade on MFN terms experience plausibly exogenous tariff changes. Using this variation, we estimate the trade elasticity at short and long horizons with local projections. We find that the elasticity of tariff-exclusive trade flows is −0.76 in the short run, and approximately −2 in the long run. Our long-run estimates are smaller than typical in the literature, and it takes 7 to10 years to converge to the long run, implying that (i) the welfare gains from trade are high and (ii) there are substantial convexities in the costs of adjusting exports. (JEL C51, F13, F14)

10.1257/aer.20210225.abstractZh: 当各国改变最惠国关税时，以最惠国条款进行贸易的伙伴国会经历看似由外部因素引起的关税变化。利用这种差异，我们通过局部预测方法估计了短期和长期内的贸易弹性。研究发现，在短期内，仅限关税的贸易流动的弹性为-0.76，而在长期内则约为-2。我们的长期估计值比文献中常见的要小，并且需要7到10年的时间才能收敛到长期水平，这表明：(i) 贸易带来的福利收益很高；(ii) 调整出口成本存在显著的凸性。(JEL C51, F13, F14)

abstract.text: This paper shows that the unequal incidence of recessions in the labor market amplifies aggregate shocks. Using administrative data from the United States, I document a positive covariance between workers' marginal propensities to consume (MPCs) and their elasticities of earnings to GDP, which is a key moment for a new class of heterogeneous-agent models. I define the matching multiplier as the increase in the multiplier stemming from this matching of high MPC workers to more cyclical jobs. I show that this covariance is large enough to increase the aggregate MPC by 20 percent over an equal exposure benchmark. (JEL E21, E23, E24, E32)

10.1257/aer.20210254.abstractZh: 本文指出，劳动力市场中经济衰退的不平等分布会放大整体冲击效应。通过美国行政数据，我发现工人的边际消费倾向与收入对GDP的弹性之间存在正相关性，这一发现对于新型异质主体模型至关重要。我将匹配乘数定义为由于高边际消费倾向工人与更具周期性工作的匹配而导致的乘数增加。研究表明，这种正相关性足以使整体边际消费倾向在同等暴露基准下增加20%。（JEL E21, E23, E24, E32）

abstract.text: This study investigates the role of retail pharmacy ownership in the opioid epidemic. Using data of prescription opioid orders, we show that compared with chain pharmacies, independent pharmacies dispense 39.1 percent more opioids and 60.5 percent more OxyContin. After an independent pharmacy becomes a chain pharmacy, opioid dispensing decreases. Using the OxyContin reformulation, which reduced nonmedical demand but not the legitimate medical demand, we show that at least one-third of the difference in the amount of OxyContin dispensed can be attributed to nonmedical demand. We show that differences in competitive pressure and whether pharmacists own the pharmacy drive our estimates. (JEL G32, I12, L22, L81)

10.1257/aer.20210357.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了零售药店所有权在阿片类药物泛滥问题中的作用。通过处方阿片类药物订单数据，我们发现与连锁药店相比，独立药店的阿片类药物处方量高出39.1%，奥施康定处方量则高出60.5%。当独立药店转变为连锁药店后，阿片类药物的处方量会下降。通过奥施康定的重新配方分析，我们发现减少的非医疗需求并未影响合法医疗需求，因此奥施康定处方量的差异至少有三分之一可以归因于非医疗需求。我们还发现，竞争压力以及药剂师是否拥有药店等因素影响了我们的研究结果。（JEL G32, I12, L22, L81）

abstract.text: I examine the effects of oligopsony power on allocative efficiency and income redistribution by studying a size regulation in the Chinese tobacco industry that led to ownership consolidation. I show that separate identification of input price markdowns, goods price markups, and productivity is challenging when a subset of inputs is nonsubstitutable, which often holds for materials, and construct and estimate a model to overcome this challenge. I find that the regulation increased input price markdowns by 37 percent on average. This increase in oligopsony power led to a decline in allocative efficiency and redistributed income away from rural households. (JEL D24, D31, G32, G34, L13, L66, P31)

10.1257/aer.20210383.abstractZh: 我通过研究中国烟草行业中的规模管制对配置效率与收入再分配的影响，来探讨寡头买方权力所带来的影响。我发现，当部分投入品不可替代时，区分投入价格下降、商品价格上升以及生产效率的变化变得具有挑战性，这种情况在材料领域尤为常见。我构建并估计了一个模型，以克服这一挑战。研究发现，该管制措施使投入价格平均下降了37%。这种寡头买方权力的增强导致了配置效率的下降，并使收入从农村家庭中重新分配出去。（JEL D24, D31, G32, G34, L13, L66, P31）

abstract.text: We study how the spread of the Lost Cause narrative—a revisionist and racist retelling of the US Civil War—shifted opinions and behaviors toward national reunification and racial discrimination against African Americans. Looking at screenings of The Birth of a Nation, a blockbuster movie that greatly popularized the Lost Cause after 1915, we find that the film shifted the public discourse toward a more patriotic and less divisive language, increased military enlistment, and fostered cultural convergence between former enemies. We document how the racist content of the narrative connects to reconciliation through a “common-enemy” type of argument. (JEL J15, L82, N31, N32, N41, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20210413.abstractZh: 我们研究了“失落事业”叙事的传播如何改变人们的观点和行为，使其倾向于国家统一以及对非裔美国人的种族歧视。通过观看《国家的诞生》这部在1915年后广受欢迎的大片，我们发现这部电影使公众话语转向更加爱国且较少分裂的语言，增加了军事征兵人数，并促进了前敌之间的文化融合。我们记录了这种叙事中的种族主义内容如何通过“共同敌人”式的论点来促进和解。（JEL J15, L82, N31, N32, N41, Z13）

abstract.text: This paper examines the efficacy of second-best trade restrictions at correcting sectoral misallocation due to scale economies or profit-generating markups. To this end, we characterize optimal trade and industrial policies in an important class of quantitative trade models with scale effects and profits, estimating the structural parameters that govern policy outcomes. Our estimates reveal that standalone trade policy measures are remarkably ineffective at correcting mis-allocation, even when designed optimally. Unilateral adoption of corrective industrial policies is also ineffective due to immiserizing growth effects. But industrial policies coordinated internationally via a deep agreement are more transformative than any unilateral policy alternative. (JEL F12, F13,14. L52, O19, O25)

10.1257/aer.20210419.abstractZh: 本文探讨了第二优贸易限制措施在纠正因规模经济或盈利性加价导致的部门资源配置不当方面的有效性。为此，我们在一个包含规模效应和利润的重要定量贸易模型中，描述了最优贸易和工业政策，并估计了决定政策结果的结构性参数。我们的估计结果显示，即使采用最优设计的独立贸易政策措施，在纠正资源配置不当方面也效果显著。由于增长效应的负面影响，单方面实施工业政策也是无效的。然而，通过深度协议在国际层面协调实施的工业政策，其变革性远超任何单边政策选择。（JEL F12, F13,14. L52, O19, O25）

abstract.text: Improving academic outcomes for economically disadvantaged students has proven challenging, particularly for children at older ages. We present two large-scale randomized controlled trials of a high-dosage tutoring program delivered to secondary school students in Chicago. One innovation is to use paraprofessional tutors to hold down cost, thereby increasing scalability. Participating in math tutoring increases math test scores by 0.18 to 0.40 standard deviations, and increases math and nonmath course grades. These effects persist into future years. The data are consistent with increased personalization of instruction as a mechanism. The benefit-cost ratio is comparable to many successful early childhood programs. (JEL H75, I21, I24, I26, I32, J13, J15)

10.1257/aer.20210434.abstractZh: 改善经济弱势学生的学术成果一直具有挑战性，尤其是对于年龄较大的学生而言。我们展示了两项针对芝加哥中学生的大规模随机对照试验，这些试验采用了高剂量辅导计划。一项创新之处在于使用辅助教师来降低成本，从而提升项目的可扩展性。参与数学辅导的学生在数学测试成绩上提高了0.18至0.40个标准差，同时数学和非数学课程成绩也有所提升。这些效果在后续年份中依然持续。数据表明，教学个性化程度的提高是促成这些变化的机制。该项目的效益成本比与许多成功的早期儿童教育项目相当。（JEL H75, I21, I24, I26, I32, J13, J15）

abstract.text: We compare how in-kind food assistance and an electronic voucher-based program affect the delivery of aid in practice. The Government of Indonesia randomized across 105 districts the transition from in-kind rice to approximately equivalent electronic vouchers redeemable for rice and eggs at a network of private agents. Targeted households received 46 percent more assistance in voucher areas. For the bottom 15 percent of households at baseline, poverty fell 20 percent. Voucher recipients received higher-quality rice, and increased consumption of eggs. The results suggest moving from a manual in-kind to electronic voucher-based program reduced poverty through increased adherence to program design. (JEL H53, I18, I32, I38, O12)

10.1257/aer.20210461.abstractZh: 我们比较了实物食品援助和基于电子凭证的计划在实际中如何影响援助的提供。印度尼西亚政府将实物大米转换为电子凭证的过渡过程随机分配到105个地区，这些电子凭证可以在私人代理网络处兑换成大米和鸡蛋。在电子凭证发放的地区，目标家庭获得的援助增加了46%。对于基线时处于贫困最低15%的家庭来说，贫困率下降了20%。电子凭证的领取者获得了质量更高的大米，并且鸡蛋的消费量也有所增加。结果表明，从手工实物援助转向基于电子凭证的计划，通过提高对计划设计的遵守程度来减少贫困。（JEL H53, I18, I32, I38, O12）

abstract.text: We propose a tractable model of asset management in which benchmarking arises endogenously, and analyze its welfare consequences. Fund managers' portfolios are not contractible and they incur private costs in running them. Incentive contracts for fund managers create a pecuniary externality through their effect on asset prices. Benchmarking inflates asset prices and creates crowded trades. The crowding reduces the effectiveness of benchmarking in incentive contracts for others, which fund investors fail to account for. A social planner, recognizing the crowding, opts for contracts with less benchmarking and less incentive provision. The planner also delivers lower asset management costs. (JEL D82, D86, G11, G12, G23, G41)

10.1257/aer.20210476.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个可行的资产管理模型，在该模型中，基准测试是内生产生的，并分析了其福利后果。基金经理的投资组合不可合约化，他们在管理这些投资组合过程中会产生私人成本。对基金经理的激励合同通过其对资产价格的影响产生金钱性外部性。基准测试会推高资产价格，导致交易过于拥挤。这种拥挤现象会降低基准测试在激励合同中的有效性，而基金投资者往往未能考虑到这一点。作为社会规划者，他会意识到这种拥挤现象，并选择包含较少基准测试和较少激励措施的合同。这样的规划者还能降低资产管理的成本。（JEL D82, D86, G11, G12, G23, G41）

abstract.text: This paper describes the results of a policy experiment conducted in coordination with the Nigerian government. In this experiment, some communities were randomly selected to receive a new doctor. These doctors were posted to the public health center serving the community to work for a year. Prior to their arrival, health care was provided by mid-level health care providers (MLP). To separate the effect of (ostensibly higher) quality from that of quantity, another group of communities was provided with an additional mid-level health care worker. A third group of communities received no additional workers. No other inputs were provided. I find a measurable decrease in mortality in communities assigned a doctor but not in communities assigned an additional MLP, suggesting that quality in the health care sector is a significant constraint.

10.1257/aer.20210701.abstractZh: 本文描述了与尼日利亚政府合作进行的一项政策实验的结果。在该实验中，一些社区被随机选中，获得了新的医生。这些医生被派驻到服务该社区的公共卫生中心，工作为期一年。在医生到来之前，医疗服务由中级医疗人员提供。为了区分医疗质量提升与数量增加的影响，另一组社区还获得了额外的中级医疗人员。第三组社区则没有获得额外的医疗人员。其他投入均保持不变。结果发现，获得医生的社区的死亡率有所降低，而获得额外中级医疗人员的社区则没有这种效果，这表明医疗领域的质量是一个重要的制约因素。

abstract.text: Regulators often impose rules that constrain the behavior of market participants. We study the design of regulatory policy in an insurance market as a delegation problem. A regulator restricts the menus of contracts an informed firm is permitted to offer, the firm offers a permitted menu to each consumer, and consumers choose contracts from offered menus. If consumer types and firm signals are ordered in a way that reflects coverage need, the regulator can leverage the firm’s information by forcing the firm to offer specified additional options on each menu. Several extensions illustrate the practical application of our results. (JEL D21, D43, D82, D86, G22, G28, L51)

10.1257/aer.20210710.abstractZh: 监管机构经常制定限制市场参与者行为的规则。我们将保险市场的监管政策设计问题视为一种委托问题进行研究。监管机构会限制一家知情企业可以提供的合同选项，企业向每个消费者提供允许的选项，消费者则从提供的选项中选择合同。如果消费者类型和企业信号按照覆盖需求进行排序，那么监管机构可以通过迫使企业在每个菜单上提供特定的额外选项来利用企业的信息。一些扩展研究展示了我们结果的实际应用价值。（JEL D21, D43, D82, D86, G22, G28, L51）

abstract.text: This paper studies leverage regulation when equity investors and/or creditors have distorted beliefs relative to a planner. We characterize how the optimal regulation responds to arbitrary changes in investors’/creditors’ beliefs, relating our results to practical scenarios. We show that the optimal regulation depends on the type and magnitude of such changes. Optimism by investors calls for looser leverage regulation, while optimism by creditors, or jointly by both investors/creditors, calls for tighter leverage regulation. Our results apply to environments with (i) planners with imperfect knowledge of investors’/creditors’ beliefs, (ii) monetary policy, (iii) bailouts and pecuniary externalities, and (iv) endogenous beliefs. (JEL D62, D83, E52, G01, G21, G28, H81)

10.1257/aer.20210753.abstractZh: 本文研究了在股权投资者和/或债权人相对于规划者的信念存在扭曲时，杠杆监管的问题。我们描述了最优监管如何响应投资者/债权人信念的任意变化，并将我们的结果与实际情景进行了对比。我们发现，最优监管取决于这种变化的类型和幅度。投资者的乐观态度要求更宽松的杠杆监管，而债权人的乐观态度，或投资者和债权人共同乐观的态度，则要求更严格的杠杆监管。我们的研究结果适用于以下情况：(i) 规划者对投资者/债权人的信念了解不完全的情况；(ii) 货币政策；(iii) 救助计划和财务外部性；以及(iv) 内生信念。 (JEL D62, D83, E52, G01, G21, G28, H81)

abstract.text: We use unique data from journal submissions to identify and unpack publication bias and p-hacking. We find initial submissions display significant bunching, suggesting the distribution among published statistics cannot be fully attributed to a publication bias in peer review. Desk-rejected manuscripts display greater heaping than those sent for review; i.e., marginally significant results are more likely to be desk rejected. Reviewer recommendations, in contrast, are positively associated with statistical significance. Overall, the peer review process has little effect on the distribution of test statistics. Lastly, we track rejected papers and present evidence that the prevalence of publication biases is perhaps not as prominent as feared. (JEL A11, A14, C13, L82)

10.1257/aer.20210795.abstractZh: 我们利用期刊投稿中的独特数据来识别并分析出版偏见和数据处理操纵行为。我们发现，初次投稿中存在显著的聚集现象，这表明已发表的统计数据分布并不能完全归因于同行评审中的出版偏见。被拒稿件的聚集程度高于被提交进行评审的稿件；也就是说，具有统计学意义的显著结果更可能被拒稿。相比之下，审稿人的推荐与统计显著性呈正相关。总体而言，同行评审过程对测试统计数据的分布影响甚微。最后，我们追踪了被拒稿件的案例，并发现出版偏见的普遍性可能并不像人们担心的那样严重。（JEL A11, A14, C13, L82）

abstract.text: Offices are social places. Employees and managers take breaks together and talk about family and hobbies. In this study, we show that employees’ social interactions with their managers can be advantageous for their careers, and that this phenomenon contributes to the gender pay gap. We use administrative and survey data from a large financial institution and exploit quasi-random variation induced by the rotation of managers. We provide evidence that when employees have more face-to-face interactions with their managers, they are promoted at a higher rate. This mechanism could explain a third of the gender gap in promotions at this firm. (JEL G21, J16, J31, J71, M12, M51, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20210863.abstractZh: 办公室是社交的场所。员工和经理们会一起休息，谈论家庭和爱好。本研究表明，员工与经理之间的社交互动对其职业发展具有积极作用，而这种现象加剧了性别薪酬差距。我们利用了一家大型金融机构的行政数据和调查数据，并分析了经理轮岗所带来的准随机变化。我们的研究证明，当员工与经理有更多的面对面交流时，他们被晋升的概率会更高。这一机制可以解释该公司性别晋升差距的三分之一。（JEL G21, J16, J31, J71, M12, M51, Z13）

abstract.text: Greece experienced a boom until 2007, followed by a collapse of unprecedented magnitude and persistence. We assess the sources of the boom and the bust, using a rich estimated dynamic general equilibrium model. External demand and government consumption fueled the boom in production, whereas transfers fueled the boom in consumption. Different from the standard narrative, wages and prices declined substantially during the bust. Tax policy accounts for the largest fraction of the bust in production, whereas uninsurable risk accounts for the bust in consumption and wages. We assess how the composition of fiscal adjustment and bailouts affected the crisis. (JEL E21, E23, E24, E32, E62, F41, H20)

10.1257/aer.20210864.abstractZh: 希腊经历了2007年之前的繁荣时期，随后出现了前所未有的严重经济崩溃。我们通过一个复杂的动态一般均衡模型来评估繁荣与崩溃的原因。外部需求和政府消费推动了生产的繁荣，而转移支付则促进了消费的繁荣。与传统的解释不同，在崩溃期间，工资和价格都出现了显著下降。税收政策对生产崩溃的影响最大，而不可保险的风险则导致了消费和工资的崩溃。我们还评估了财政调整与救助措施的不同组合对危机的影响。（JEL E21, E23, E24, E32, E62, F41, H20）

abstract.text: We characterize efficiency in an equilibrium model of investment and capital reallocation with heterogeneous firms facing collateral constraints. The model features two types of pecuniary externalities: collateral externalities, because the resale price of capital affects collateral constraints, and distributive externalities, because buyers of old capital are more financially constrained than sellers, consistent with empirical evidence. We prove that the stationary equilibrium price of old capital is inefficiently high because the distributive externality exceeds the collateral externality, by a factor of two when we calibrate the model. New investment reduces the future price of old capital, providing a rationale for new-investment subsidies. (JEL D21, D24, D25, D62, E22, G31, G32)

10.1257/aer.20210902.abstractZh: 我们在一个均衡模型中描述了效率问题，该模型涉及具有异质性的企业面对抵押约束下的投资与资本再分配。该模型包含两种类型的金钱外部性：抵押外部性，因为资本的转售价格会影响抵押约束；分配外部性，因为旧资本的购买者比出售者面临更大的财务限制，这与实证证据一致。我们证明，由于分配外部性的影响超过了抵押外部性，旧资本的稳态均衡价格实际上是不合理的偏高。通过模型校准，我们发现分配外部性与抵押外部性的比率高达两倍。新的投资会降低旧资本的未来价格，这为新的投资补贴提供了依据。（JEL D21, D24, D25, D62, E22, G31, G32）

abstract.text: Growing reliance on student loans and repayment difficulties have raised concerns of a student debt crisis in the United States, but little is known about the effects of student borrowing on human capital and long-run financial well-being. We use variation induced by recent expansions in federal loan limits combined with administrative data-sets to identify the effects of increased access to student loans on credit-constrained students’ educational attainment, earnings, debt, and loan repayment. Increased student loan availability raises student debt and improves degree completion, later-life earnings, and student loan repayment, while having no effect on homeownership or other types of debt. (JEL G51, I22, I23, I26, J24)

10.1257/aer.20210926.abstractZh: 对学生贷款的日益依赖以及还款困难引发了美国学生债务危机的担忧，但关于学生借款对人类资本和长期财务福祉的影响，目前了解甚少。我们利用联邦贷款限额近期扩大的变化，结合行政数据集，来研究学生贷款增加对信用受限学生的教育成就、收入、债务和贷款还款的影响。学生贷款的增加会提高学生债务水平，并改善学位完成率、后期收入以及贷款还款能力，而对拥有房产或其他类型债务则没有影响。（JEL G51, I22, I23, I26, J24）

abstract.text: We examine multi-generational impacts of positive in utero health interventions using a new research design that exploits sharp increases in prenatal Medicaid eligibility that occurred in some states. Our analyses are based on U.S. Vital Statistics Natality files, which enables linkages between individuals' early life Medicaid exposure and the next generation's health at birth. We find evidence that the health benefits associated with treated generations' early life program exposure extend to later offspring. Our results suggest that the returns on early life health investments may be substantively underestimated.

10.1257/aer.20210937.abstractZh: 我们采用一种新的研究设计，通过考察某些州在产前医疗补助资格方面发生的急剧增加，来探讨积极产前健康干预措施对多代人的影响。我们的分析基于美国生命统计出生数据，这使得能够将个体早期生活中的医疗补助接触情况与下一代出生时的健康状况联系起来。我们发现，与接受治疗的代际在早期生活中的医疗补助接触相关的健康益处会延续到后代。我们的研究结果表明，早期生活健康投资的回报可能被实质性地低估了。

abstract.text: Romanian households could choose schools with one standard deviation worth of additional value added. Why do households leave value added “on the table”? We study two possibilities: (i) information and (ii) preferences for other school traits. In an experiment, we inform randomly selected households about schools' value added. These households choose schools with up to 0.2 standard deviations of additional value added. We then estimate a discrete choice model and show that households have preferences for a variety of school traits. As a result, fully correcting households' beliefs would eliminate at most a quarter of the value added that households leave unexploited. (JEL D12, D83, I21, I28)

10.1257/aer.20210949.abstractZh: 罗马尼亚的家庭可以选择价值增加达到一个标准差的学校。为什么家庭会“忽略”这部分价值增加呢？我们研究了两种可能性：(i)信息因素，以及(ii)对其它学校特征的偏好。在实验中，我们向随机选出的家庭告知学校的价值增加情况。这些家庭会选择价值增加最多达到0.2标准差的学校。随后，我们建立了一个离散选择模型，并发现家庭对多种学校特征都有偏好。因此，如果完全修正家庭的信念，最多只能消除四分之一未被利用的价值增加。(JEL D12, D83, I21, I28)

abstract.text: A large theoretical literature argues laws exert a causal effect on norms, but empirical evidence remains scant. Using a novel identification strategy, we provide a compelling empirical test of this proposition. We use incentivized vignette experiments to directly measure social norms relating to actions subject to legal thresholds. Our large-scale experiments (n = 7,000) run in the United Kingdom, United States, and China show that laws can causally influence social norms. Results are robust across different samples and methods of measuring norms, and are consistent with a model of social image concerns where individuals care about the inferences others make about their underlying prosociality. (JEL C91, C92, D91, K00, K42, P37)

10.1257/aer.20210970.abstractZh: 大量理论文献认为法律对规范具有因果效应，但实证证据仍然有限。我们采用一种新颖的识别策略，对这一命题进行了有力的实证检验。我们通过激励性案例实验，直接测量受法律阈值约束的行为相关的社会规范。我们在英国、美国和中国的大规模实验中（样本量达7,000个），发现法律能够对社会规范产生因果影响。研究结果在不同样本和规范测量方法下均具有稳健性，并且与一种关于社会形象模型的假设一致，即个体关心他人对其潜在亲社会行为的看法。（JEL C91, C92, D91, K00, K42, P37）

abstract.text: A main focus in economics is how to design optimal policies in second-best situations, which often requires a trade-off between giving some individuals more than they deserve, false positives, and others less than they deserve, false negatives. This paper provides novel evidence on people’s second-best fairness preferences from large-scale experimental studies in the United States and Norway. The majority of people are more concerned with false negatives than with false positives, but we document substantial heterogeneity in second-best fairness preferences between the countries and across the political spectrum. The findings shed light on the political economy of social insurance and redistribution. (JEL D63, D72, D78, H23, I38)

10.1257/aer.20211015.abstractZh: 经济学的一个主要焦点是如何在次优情况下设计最优政策，这通常需要在某些个体获得超出其应得份额、产生误报，而在其他个体则获得少于其应得份额、产生漏报之间做出权衡。本文通过在美国和挪威进行的大规模实验研究，提供了关于人们次优公平偏好的新证据。大多数人对漏报的担忧大于对误报的担忧，但我们发现不同国家和政治立场之间的次优公平偏好存在显著差异。这些发现有助于理解社会保险和再分配的政治经济学机制。（JEL D63, D72, D78, H23, I38）

abstract.text: Surveys measuring happiness or preferences generate discrete ordinal data. Ordered response models, which are used to analyze such data, suffer from an identification problem. Their conclusions depend on distributional assumptions about a latent variable. We propose using response times to solve that problem. Response times contain information about the distribution of the latent variable through a chronometric effect. Using an online survey experiment, we verify the chronometric effect. We then provide theoretical conditions for testing conventional distributional assumptions. These assumptions are rejected in some cases, but overall our evidence is consistent with the qualitative validity of the conventional models. (JEL C14, D60, D91, I31)

10.1257/aer.20211051.abstractZh: 测量幸福感或偏好的调查会生成离散的序数数据。用于分析此类数据的有序响应模型存在识别问题。其结论依赖于关于潜在变量的分布假设。我们提出使用响应时间来解决这个问题。响应时间通过时间效应包含了关于潜在变量分布的信息。通过在线调查实验，我们验证了时间效应。然后，我们为检验传统分布假设提供了理论条件。在某些情况下，这些假设被否定，但总体而言，我们的证据与传统模型的定性有效性是一致的。（JEL C14, D60, D91, I31）

abstract.text: When employers' explicit gender requests were unexpectedly removed from a Chinese job board overnight, pools of successful applicants became more integrated: women's (men's) share of callbacks to jobs that had requested men (women) rose by 61 (146) percent. The removal “worked” in this sense because it generated a large increase in gender-mismatched applications, and because those applications were treated surprisingly well by employers, suggesting that employers' gender requests often represented relatively weak preferences or outdated stereotypes. The job titles that were integrated by the ban, however, were not the most gendered ones, and were disproportionately lower-wage jobs. (JEL J16, J23, J41, J63, J71, M51, P31)

10.1257/aer.20211127.abstractZh: 当雇主对性别的明确要求突然被中国一个招聘网站取消后，成功申请者的群体变得更加多元化：那些原本要求男性申请的职位，女性申请者的比例增加了61%（146%）。这种取消要求的方式之所以有效，是因为它大大增加了性别不匹配的申请数量，而且这些申请得到了雇主的积极回应，这表明雇主的性别要求往往反映了相对薄弱的偏好或过时的刻板印象。然而，被取消要求的性别限制并不涉及最具有性别差异的职位，而且这些职位大多属于低薪工作。（JEL J16, J23, J41, J63, J71, M51, P31）

abstract.text: Subjective performance evaluation could induce influence activities: employees might devote too much effort to pleasing their evaluator, relative to working toward the goals of the organization itself. We conduct a randomized field experiment among Chinese local civil servants to study the existence and implications of influence activities. We find that civil servants do engage in evaluator-specific influence to affect evaluation outcomes, partly in the form of reallocating work efforts toward job tasks that are more important and observable to the evaluator. Importantly, we show that introducing uncertainty about the evaluator’s identity discourages evaluator-specific influence activities and improves bureaucratic work performance. (JEL D73, H83, J45, M54, O17, O18, P25)

10.1257/aer.20211207.abstractZh: 主观绩效评估可能会引发影响行为：员工可能会过度努力以取悦评估者，而不是致力于实现组织的目标。我们在中国地方公务员中进行了一项随机实地实验，以研究影响行为的存在及其影响。我们发现，公务员确实会针对评估者进行影响行为，从而影响评估结果，部分表现为将工作精力重新分配到对评估者来说更为重要且更易于观察的任务上。重要的是，我们发现，对评估者的身份引入不确定性可以抑制这种影响行为，并提高官僚工作的绩效。（JEL D73, H83, J45, M54, O17, O18, P25）

abstract.text: Adverse selection in procurement arises when low-cost bidders are also low-quality suppliers. We propose a mechanism called LoLA (lowball lottery auction) which, under some conditions, maximizes any combination of buyer’s and social surplus, subject to incentive compatibility, in the presence of adverse selection. The LoLA features a floor price, and a reserve price. The LoLA has a dominant strategy equilibrium that, under mild conditions, is unique. In a counterfactual analysis of Italian government auctions, we compute the gain that the government could have made, had it used the optimal procurement mechanism (a LoLA), relative to a first-price auction (the adopted format). (JEL D44, D82, H57, L14)

10.1257/aer.20211437.abstractZh: 在采购过程中，当低成本投标者同时也是低质量的供应商时，就会出现逆向选择问题。我们提出了一种名为LoLA（低价拍卖）的机制。在某些条件下，该机制能够在逆向选择的情况下，最大化买方收益和社会总收益，前提是激励相容性得到满足。LoLA具有最低价格和保留价格两个要素。在温和条件下，LoLA存在占优策略均衡，这种均衡是唯一的。通过对意大利政府拍卖的逆向分析，我们计算了如果采用最优采购机制（即LoLA）与采用现行的一价拍卖相比，政府能够获得的收益。（JEL D44, D82, H57, L14）

abstract.text: We study differences in exposure to factor-biased technical change among occupations by providing the first measures of capital-embodied technical change (CETC) and of the elasticity of substitution between capital and labor at the occupational level. We document sizable occupational heterogeneity in both measures, but quantitatively, it is the heterogeneity in factor substitutability that fuels workers’ exposure to CETC. In a general equilibrium model of worker sorting across occupations, CETC accounts for almost all of the observed labor reallocation in the US between 1984 and 2015. Absent occupational heterogeneity in factor substitutability, CETC accounts for only 17 percent of it (JEL I26, J16, J24, J31, O33)

10.1257/aer.20211478.abstractZh: 我们研究了不同职业在受因素偏向的技术变革影响方面的差异，通过首次提供资本蕴含的技术变革指标以及职业层面资本与劳动力之间替代弹性的衡量方法。我们发现这两种指标都存在显著的职业异质性，但从定量角度来看，是因素替代性的异质性导致了工人受到资本蕴含的技术变革的影响。在一个关于工人在不同职业间排序的一般均衡模型中，资本蕴含的技术变革几乎解释了1984年至2015年间美国观察到的所有劳动力重新分配现象。如果没有职业间因素替代性的异质性，资本蕴含的技术变革仅能解释17%的重新分配现象（JEL I26, J16, J24, J31, O33）。

abstract.text: We measure how a network of heroes can legitimize and diffuse extreme political behaviors. We exploit newly declassified intelligence files, novel voting data, and regimental histories to show that home municipalities of French line regiments arbitrarily rotated under Philippe Pétain’s generalship through the heroic World War I battlefield of Verdun diverge politically thereafter, particularly following Pétain’s own overt espousal of authoritarian views. Further, under Pétain’s collaborationist Vichy regime (1940–1944), they raise 7 percent more active Nazi collaborators per capita. These effects extend across all forms of Nazi collaboration and diffuse beyond the veterans themselves. (JEL D72, D74, N34, N44, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20211509.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个由英雄组成的网络如何使极端政治行为合法化并扩散。通过利用新公开的情报文件、新的投票数据以及部队的历史记录，我们发现，在菲利普·贝当将军执政期间，法国军团驻扎的当地市镇在第一次世界大战的凡尔登战场发生了任意的轮换，此后这些市镇的政治立场发生了分化，尤其是在贝当本人公开支持专制观点之后。此外，在贝当的维希政权时期（1940-1944年），这些市镇的人均纳粹合作者数量增加了7%。这些影响涵盖了所有形式的纳粹合作，并且这种影响超出了退伍军人本身的范围。（JEL D72, D74, N34, N44, Z13）

abstract.text: I study ultimatum bargaining with imperfectly observed offers. Imperfectly observed offers must be rejected with positive probability, even when the players’ preferences are common knowledge. Noisier observations imply a greater risk of rejection. In repeated ultimatum bargaining, the responding party can obtain a positive payoff if his signal of the opponent’s offer is also observed by the opponent herself, but not if his signal is private. In alternating-offers bargaining, a player is better off when her own offers are observed more precisely and her opponent’s offers are observed less precisely. Possible applications include international relations, regulation, principal-agency, and product quality provision. (JEL C73, C78, D82)

10.1257/aer.20211524.abstractZh: 我研究的是在不完全观测的报价情况下的最后通牒讨价还价行为。即使玩家的偏好是共同的知识，不完全观测的报价也必须以正概率被拒绝。更嘈杂的观测意味着拒绝的风险更大。在重复的最后通牒讨价还价中，如果回应方发出的对手报价的信号也被对手本人观察到，那么回应方可以获得正收益；但如果他的信号是私密的，则无法获得正收益。在交替报价讨价还价中，当自己发出的报价被更精确地观察到，而对手的报价被不太精确地观察到时，玩家的状况会更好。可能的应用包括国际关系、监管、主从关系以及产品质量供应等领域。（JEL C73, C78, D82）

abstract.text: I study the persuasive effects of slanted language, exploiting a ban on the politically charged term “illegal immigrant” by the Associated Press (AP) news wire. My empirical strategy combines the timing of the ban with variation across media outlets in their baseline reliance on AP copy. I document sizable diffusion of the ban from AP copy to media outlets. Moreover, individuals exposed to the ban through local media show significantly lower support for restrictive immigration policies. This effect is more pronounced for moderates and in locations with fewer immigrants, and does not transfer to views on issues other than immigration. (JEL D72, L82, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20211537.abstractZh: 我研究了带有偏见的语言在说服效果上的影响，利用了美联社新闻专线对“非法移民”这一带有政治色彩的术语的禁令。我的实证策略结合了禁令的实施时间以及不同媒体在依赖美联社报道程度上的差异。我发现禁令从美联社传播到各媒体的速度相当快。此外，通过当地媒体了解到禁令的人对限制性移民政策的支持程度明显较低。这种效应在温和派群体中更为明显，在移民数量较少的地区更为显著，并且这种效应并未转移到对除移民以外其他问题的看法上。（JEL D72, L82, Z13）

abstract.text: We study public versus private provision of health care for veterans aged 65 and older who may receive care provided by the US Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) and in private hospitals financed by Medicare. Utilizing the ambulance design of Doyle et al. (2015), we find that the VA reduces 28-day mortality by 46 percent (4.5 percentage points) and that these survival gains are persistent. The VA also reduces 28-day spending by 21 percent and delivers strikingly different reported services relative to private hospitals. We find suggestive evidence of complementarities between continuity of care, health IT, and integrated care.

10.1257/aer.20211638.abstractZh: 我们研究了65岁及以上的退伍军人医疗保健的公共与私人供给差异，这些退伍军人可能接受美国退伍军人事务部（VA）提供的护理，也可能在由医疗保险资助的私人医院接受治疗。利用Doyle等人（2015年）提出的救护车模型，我们发现VA将28天的死亡率降低了46个百分点（4.5个百分点），且这种生存改善是持久的。VA还将28天的支出减少了21%，并且所提供的服务与私人医院相比有显著不同。我们发现，护理的连续性、健康信息技术以及综合护理之间存在互补性。

abstract.text: We study collaborative work in pairs when potential collaborators are motivated by the reputational implications of (joint or solo) projects. In equilibrium, individual collaboration strategies both influence and are influenced by the public assignment of credit for joint work across the two partners. We investigate the fragility of collaboration to small biases in the public’s credit assignment. When collaborators are symmetric, symmetric equilibria are often fragile, and in nonfragile equilibria individuals receive asymmetric collaborative credit based on payoff-irrelevant “identities.” We study payoff distributions across identities within asymmetric equilibria, and compare aggregate welfare across symmetric and asymmetric equilibria. (JEL A11, D82, I23)

10.1257/aer.20211729.abstractZh: 我们研究了当潜在合作者受到（联合或单独）项目所带来的声誉影响时，两人之间的合作行为。在均衡状态下，个体之间的合作策略既会影响两个合作伙伴之间的公共信用分配，也会受到公共信用分配的影响。我们研究了合作对公共信用分配中微小偏差的脆弱性。当合作者是对称的时，对称均衡往往是不稳定的，在非稳定均衡中，个体会根据与收益无关的“身份”获得不对称的合作信用。我们研究了不对称均衡中不同身份之间的收益分配，并比较了对称均衡与非对称均衡下的总体福利。（JEL A11, D82, I23）

abstract.text: I give conditions under which changes in private spending are accommodated in general equilibrium exactly like changes in aggregate fiscal expenditure. Under such demand equivalence, researchers can use time series evidence on fiscal multipliers to recover the general equilibrium “missing intercept” of shocks to private spending identified in the cross section. Through the lens of this theory, time series estimates of a fiscal multiplier around one suggest a missing intercept close to zero—an observation that I illustrate with an application to the 2008 tax rebates. I also discuss the robustness of this aggregation approach to plausible violations of demand equivalence. (JEL E12, E21, E24, E62, G51, H24, H31)

10.1257/aer.20211751.abstractZh: 我提出了一种条件，在这种条件下，私人支出的变化与总财政支出的变化在一般均衡中能够完全对应。在这种需求等价的情况下，研究人员可以利用关于财政乘数时间序列数据来恢复在横截面数据中确定的私人支出冲击所导致的“缺失截距”。通过这一理论视角，财政乘数约为1的时间序列估计表明“缺失截距”接近于零——这一观察结果我通过2008年税收减免的例子进行了说明。我还讨论了这种聚合方法对于需求等价性被合理违反情况的稳健性。（JEL E12, E21, E24, E62, G51, H24, H31）

abstract.text: How does identity influence economic behavior in the labor market? I investigate this question in rural India, focusing on the effect of caste identity on job-specific labor supply. In a field experiment, laborers choose whether to take up various job offers, which differ in associations with specific castes. Workers are less willing to accept offers that are linked to castes other than their own, especially when those castes rank lower in the social hierarchy. Workers forgo large payments to avoid job offers that conflict with their caste identity, even when these decisions are made in private. (JEL C93, D91, J15, J22, O12, Z13)

10.1257/aer.20211826.abstractZh: 身份如何影响劳动力市场的经济行为？我在印度农村对这一问题进行了研究，重点关注种姓身份对特定职业劳动力供给的影响。在一项实地实验中，劳动者选择是否接受不同职业的聘用，这些职业与特定种姓的关联程度各不相同。劳动者不太愿意接受与自身种姓无关的聘用机会，尤其是当这些种姓在社会等级中地位较低时。即使是在私下做出决定时，劳动者也会放弃高额报酬以避免与自身种姓身份相冲突的聘用机会。（JEL C93, D91, J15, J22, O12, Z13）

abstract.text: I study the economic value of obesity-a status symbol in poor countries associated with raised health risks. Randomizing decision-makers in Kampala, Uganda to view weight-manipulated portraits, I find that obesity is perceived as a reliable signal of wealth but not of beauty or health. Thus, leveraging a real-stakes experiment involving professional loan officers, I show that being obese facilitates access to credit. The large obesity premium, comparable to raising borrower self-reported earnings by over 60%, is driven by asymmetric information and drops significantly when providing more financial information. Notably, obesity benefits and wealth-signaling value are commonly overestimated, suggesting market distortions.

10.1257/aer.20211879.abstractZh: 我研究了肥胖在贫困国家作为一种经济价值，它被视为一种象征，与较高的健康风险相关。在乌干达坎帕拉，我让决策者们随机观看经过体重调整的肖像，发现肥胖被视为财富的象征，而非美貌或健康的标志。因此，通过一项涉及专业贷款官员的真实实验，我发现肥胖有助于获得信贷。肥胖带来的巨大溢价，相当于使借款人的自我报告收入增加超过60%，这一溢价是由信息不对称造成的，而当提供更多财务信息时，这一溢价会显著下降。值得注意的是，肥胖带来的好处和财富象征价值往往被高估，这表明市场存在扭曲现象。

abstract.text: HIV/AIDS has been one of the largest public health crises in recent history, and the US federal government has spent hundreds of billions of dollars fighting the disease. This study examines the impact of the large amounts of federal funding allocated to US cities to combat HIV/AIDS through the Ryan White CARE Act’s first title. The findings indicate that the cost to avoid an HIV/AIDS death through the program is roughly $334,000, that the program has saved approximately 57,000 lives through 2018, and that funding disparities are responsible for the uneven progress in combating HIV/AIDS across the United States. (JEL H51, H75, I12, I18)

10.1257/aer.20220089.abstractZh: HIV/AIDS是近代历史上最大的公共卫生危机之一，美国联邦政府已投入数千亿美元来抗击这一疾病。本研究通过《Ryan White CARE法案》的条款，探讨了联邦资金分配给美国各城市以抗击HIV/AIDS所带来的影响。研究结果表明，通过该计划避免HIV/AIDS死亡的成本约为334,000美元，截至2018年，该计划已挽救了大约57,000人的生命，而资金分配的不均衡是导致美国各地在抗击HIV/AIDS方面进展不一的原因。（JEL H51, H75, I12, I18）

abstract.text: We develop a deep learning model to detect emotions embedded in press conferences after the Federal Open Market Committee meetings and examine the influence of the detected emotions on financial markets. We find that, after controlling for the Federal Reserve’s actions and the sentiment in policy texts, a positive tone in the voices of Federal Reserve chairs leads to significant increases in share prices. Other financial variables also respond to vocal cues from the chairs. Hence, how policy messages are communicated can move the financial market. Our results provide implications for improving the effectiveness of central bank communications. (JEL D83, E31, E44, E52, E58, F31, G14)

10.1257/aer.20220129.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个深度学习模型，用于检测联邦公开市场委员会会议后新闻发布会上嵌入的情绪，并研究这些检测到的情绪对金融市场的影响。我们发现，在控制了美联储的行动以及政策文本中的情绪后，美联储主席的积极语气会导致股价显著上涨。其他金融变量也对主席的言辞反应敏感。因此，政策信息的传达方式能够影响金融市场。我们的研究结果对提高中央银行沟通的有效性具有启示意义。（JEL D83, E31, E44, E52, E58, F31, G14）

abstract.text: We study the nonlinear pricing of goods whose usage generates revenue for the seller and of which buyers can freely dispose. The optimal price schedule is a multi-part tariff, featuring tiers within which buyers pay a marginal price of zero. We apply our model to digital goods, for which advertising, data generation, and network effects make usage valuable, but monitoring legitimate usage is infeasible. Our results rationalize common pricing schemes including free products, free trials, and unlimited subscriptions. The possibility of free disposal harms producer and consumer welfare and makes both less sensitive to changes in usage-based revenue and demand. (JEL D11, D21, D42, L86, M37)

10.1257/aer.20220199.abstractZh: 我们研究了那些使用户为卖家带来收益且买家可以自由处置的商品的非线性定价问题。最优价格安排是一种多层级定价结构，其中某些层级内买家支付的边际价格为零。我们将模型应用于数字商品，因为广告、数据生成和网络效应使得商品的使用具有价值，但监控合法使用行为则难以实现。我们的研究结果为常见的定价方案提供了理论依据，包括免费产品、免费试用和无限订阅等。免费处置的可能性会损害生产者和消费者的福利，并使他们对基于使用量的收入和需求变化更加不敏感。（JEL D11, D21, D42, L86, M37）

abstract.text: We conceptualize and measure upward mobility over income or wealth. At the core of our exercise is the Growth Progressivity Axiom: transfers of instantaneous growth rates from relatively rich to poor individuals increases upward mobility. This axiom, along with mild auxiliary restrictions, identifies an “upward mobility kernel” with a single free parameter, in which mobility is linear in individual growth rates, with geometrically declining weights on baseline incomes. We extend this kernel to trajectories over intervals. The analysis delivers an upward mobility index that does not rely on panel data. That significantly expands our analytical scope to data-poor settings. (JEL D31, D63, I32, O15, O40)

10.1257/aer.20220316.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种概念化并衡量收入或财富上的向上流动性的方法。我们核心的假设是“增长进步性公理”：从相对富裕的个体向贫困个体转移即时增长率，会提升向上的流动性。这一公理，加上一些温和的辅助限制条件，定义了一个“向上流动性核心”，该核心包含一个自由参数，其中流动性与个体增长率呈线性关系，而基线收入的权重则呈几何级下降。我们将这一核心扩展到连续时间段的轨迹上。分析结果得出一个向上流动性指数，该指数不依赖于面板数据，从而显著扩大了我们的分析范围，适用于数据不足的情况。（JEL D31, D63, I32, O15, O40）

abstract.text: This paper reconsiders the problem of a durable-good monopolist who cannot make intertemporal commitments. The buyer’s valuation is binary and his private information. The seller has access to dynamic contracts and, in each period, decides whether to deploy the previous period’s contract or to replace it with a new one. The main result of the paper is that the Coase conjecture fails: the monopo-list’s payoff is bounded away from the low valuation irrespective of the discount factor. (JEL D42, D82, D86, L12)

10.1257/aer.20220357.abstractZh: 本文重新探讨了耐用商品垄断者无法做出跨时承诺的问题。买方的估值具有二元性，且信息为私人信息。卖方能够获取动态合同信息，并在每个时期决定是否采用上一时期的合同，或者更换新的合同。本文的主要结论是，科斯猜想不成立：无论贴现因子如何，垄断者的收益始终存在下限，不会超过低估值水平。（JEL D42, D82, D86, L12）

abstract.text: The evaluation of macroeconomic policy decisions has traditionally relied on the formulation of a specific economic model. In this work, we show that two statistics are sufficient to detect, often even correct, nonoptimal policies, i.e., policies that do not minimize the loss function. The two sufficient statistics are (i) forecasts for the policy objectives conditional on the policy choice and (ii) the impulse responses of the policy objectives to policy shocks. Both statistics can be estimated without relying on a specific structural economic model. We illustrate the method by studying US monetary policy decisions. (JEL E24, E31, E32, E43, E52, E58)

10.1257/aer.20220581.abstractZh: 对宏观经济政策决策的评估传统上依赖于特定经济模型的构建。在本研究中，我们证明两个统计指标就足以检测甚至纠正非最优政策，即那些未能最小化损失函数的政策。这两个必要的统计指标分别是：(i)在政策选择条件下对政策目标的预测；(ii)政策目标对政策冲击的响应。这两个统计指标无需依赖特定的经济结构模型即可进行估计。我们通过研究美国的货币政策决策来说明这种方法的应用。(JEL E24, E31, E32, E43, E52, E58)

abstract.text: Choice screen auctions have been recently deployed in 31 European countries, allowing consumers to choose their preferred search engine on Google’s Android platform instead of being automatically defaulted to Google’s own search engine. I show that a seemingly minor detail in the design of these auctions—whether they are conducted on a “per appearance” or a “per install” basis—plays a major role in the mix and characteristics of auction winners and, consequently, in their expected market share. Furthermore, per install auctions distort search engines’ incentives. Empirical evidence from Android choice screen auctions conducted in 2020 is consistent with my theoretical results. (JEL D44, D47, K21, L40, L86)

10.1257/aer.20220699.abstractZh: 选择屏幕拍卖最近在31个欧洲国家实施，消费者可以在谷歌的Android平台上选择他们偏好的搜索引擎，而不是自动默认使用谷歌自己的搜索引擎。我指出，这些拍卖设计中一个看似微不足道的细节——无论是基于“每外观”还是“每安装”的基础进行拍卖——在拍卖胜者的组合和特征中起着重要作用，进而影响其预期的市场份额。此外，基于每安装的拍卖会扭曲搜索引擎的激励机制。2020年在Android平台上进行的选择屏幕拍卖的实证结果与我的理论结果一致。（JEL D44, D47, K21, L40, L86）

abstract.text: Child marriage remains common even where female schooling and employment opportunities have grown. We experimentally evaluate a financial incentive to delay marriage alongside a girls' empowerment program in Bangladesh. While girls eligible for two years of incentive are 19 percent less likely to marry underage, the empowerment program failed to decrease adolescent marriage. We show that these results are consistent with a signaling model in which bride type is imperfectly observed but preferred types (socially conservative girls) have lower returns to delaying marriage. Consistent with our theoretical prediction, we observe substantial spillovers of the incentive on untreated nonpreferred types.

10.1257/aer.20220720.abstractZh: 即使在女性接受教育和就业机会增加的情况下，童婚现象仍然普遍存在。我们在孟加拉国通过实验评估了经济激励措施与女孩赋权计划相结合的效果。结果显示，有资格享受两年经济激励措施的女孩未婚结婚的可能性降低了19%，而女孩赋权计划未能减少青少年未婚结婚的现象。我们的研究表明，这些结果与信号模型相符，即新娘类型的信息并不完全准确，但更倾向于选择保守的社会观念的女性推迟结婚，从而获得更高的收益。与我们的理论预测一致的是，我们观察到经济激励措施对非首选类型的女孩产生了显著的溢出效应。

abstract.text: The influence of behavioral biases on aggregate outcomes depends in part on self-selection: whether rational people opt more strongly into aggregate interactions than biased individuals. In betting market, auction and committee experiments, we document that some errors are strongly reduced through self-selection, while others are not affected at all or even amplified. A large part of this variation is explained by differences in the relationship between confidence and performance. In some tasks, they are positively correlated, such that self-selection attenuates errors. In other tasks, rational and biased people are equally confident, such that self-selection has no effects on aggregate quantities. (JEL C91, D44, D91)

10.1257/aer.20220915.abstractZh: 行为偏见对总体结果的影响部分取决于自我选择：理性的人是否比有偏见的人更强烈地参与总体互动。在赌博市场、拍卖和委员会实验中，我们发现一些错误通过自我选择得到了显著减少，而另一些则完全没有受到影响，甚至被放大。这种差异很大程度上是由信心与表现之间的关系差异造成的。在某些任务中，信心与表现呈正相关，因此自我选择能够减少错误。而在其他任务中，理性的人和有偏见的人具有相同的信心，因此自我选择对总体数量没有影响。（JEL C91, D44, D91）

abstract.text: We study a generalization of the classical monopoly insurance problem under adverse selection (see Stiglitz 1977) where we allow for a random distribution of losses, possibly correlated with the agent’s risk parameter that is private information. Our model explains patterns of observed customer behavior and predicts insurance contracts most often observed in practice: these consist of menus of several deductible-premium pairs or menus of insurance with coverage limits–premium pairs. A main departure from the classical insurance literature is obtained here by endowing the agents with risk-averse preferences that can be represented by a dual utility functional (Yaari 1987). (JEL D81, D82, D86, D91, G22)

10.1257/aer.20221247.abstractZh: 我们研究了在逆向选择情况下经典垄断保险问题的推广形式（参见Stiglitz 1977），其中损失分布是随机的，且可能与代理人的风险参数相关，而该风险参数是私人信息。我们的模型能够解释观察到的客户行为模式，并预测了实践中最常见的保险合同形式：这些合同由多个免赔额-保费组合或保险覆盖范围-保费组合构成。与经典保险文献的主要区别在于，我们的模型赋予了代理人风险厌恶的偏好，这些偏好可以通过对偶效用函数来表示（Yaari 1987）。（JEL D81, D82, D86, D91, G22）

abstract.text: During World War II, the US government’s Office of Scientific Research and Development (OSRD) supported one of the largest public investments in applied R&D in US history. Using data on all OSRD-funded invention, we show this shock had a formative impact on the US innovation system, catalyzing technology clusters across the country, with accompanying increases in high-tech entrepreneur-ship and employment. These effects persist until at least the 1970s and appear to be driven by agglomerative forces and endogenous growth. In addition to creating technology clusters, wartime R&D permanently changed the trajectory of overall US innovation in the direction of OSRD-funded technologies. (JEL H56, N42, N72, O31, O33, O38, R11)

10.1257/aer.20221365.abstractZh: 在第二次世界大战期间，美国政府的科学研究与发展办公室（OSRD）支持了美国历史上最大的公共应用研发投资之一。通过收集所有由OSRD资助的发明数据，我们发现这一重大事件对美国创新体系产生了深远影响，促进了全国范围内的技术集群发展，同时提升了高科技创业活动和就业人数。这些影响至少持续到了20世纪70年代，并且似乎是由聚合效应和内生增长所驱动的。除了创建技术集群之外，战时研发还永久性地改变了美国整体创新的轨迹，使其更倾向于采用OSRD资助的技术。（JEL H56, N42, N72, O31, O33, O38, R11）

abstract.text: We model legislative decision-making with an agenda setter who can propose policies sequentially, tailoring each proposal to the status quo that prevails after prior votes. Voters are sophisticated, and the agenda setter cannot commit to future proposals. Nevertheless, the agenda setter obtains her favorite outcome in every equilibrium regardless of the initial default policy. Central to our results is a new condition on preferences, manipulability, that holds in rich policy spaces, including spatial settings and distribution problems. Our findings therefore establish that, despite the sophistication of voters and the absence of commitment power, the agenda setter is effectively a dictator. (JEL D71, D72, D78)

10.1257/aer.20221578.abstractZh: 我们模拟了立法决策过程，其中有一个议程设定者可以依次提出政策建议，并根据先前投票后的现状来定制每个提案。选民具有高度理性，而议程设定者无法对未来的提案做出承诺。尽管如此，无论初始默认政策如何，议程设定者在每个均衡状态下都能获得她最理想的结果。我们的研究结果揭示了一个关于偏好和操控性的新条件，这一条件在包括空间设置和分配问题在内的丰富政策空间中仍然成立。因此，我们的发现表明，尽管选民具有高度理性且缺乏承诺能力，议程设定者实际上仍是一个独裁者。（JEL D71, D72, D78）

abstract.text: How does the expectation that a child will receive government benefits in adulthood affect parental investments in the child’s human capital? Most parents whose children receive Supplemental Security Income (SSI) benefits overestimate the likelihood that their child will receive SSI benefits in adulthood. We present randomly selected families with the predicted likelihood that their child will receive SSI benefits in adulthood. Reducing parents’ expectations that children will receive benefits in adulthood does not increase investments in children’s human capital. This zero effect is precisely estimated. Likely explanations include parents working more themselves, nonfinancial goals influencing investment, and families facing investment constraints. (JEL G52, I26, I38, J13, J24, J31)

10.1257/aer.20230010.abstractZh: 孩子成年后是否会获得政府福利的预期，如何影响父母对孩子人力资本的投资？大多数孩子的受益人高估了孩子成年后继续获得社会保障福利的可能性。我们向随机选取的家庭展示了孩子成年后可能获得社会保障福利的概率。降低父母对孩子成年后仍会获得福利的预期，并不会增加对孩子人力资本的投资。这种零效应得到了精确估计。可能的解释包括父母自身的工作时间增加、非财务目标影响投资，以及家庭面临投资限制等因素。（JEL G52, I26, I38, J13, J24, J31）

abstract.text: Do gender attitudes influence interactions with female judges in US circuit courts? In this paper, we propose a judge-specific measure of gender attitudes based on use of gender-stereotyped language in the judge’s authored opinions. Exploiting quasi-random assignment of judges to cases and conditioning on judges’ characteristics, we validate the measure showing that higher-slant judges vote more conservatively in gender-related cases. Higher-slant judges interact differently with female colleagues: they are more likely to reverse lower court decisions if the lower court judge is a woman than a man, are less likely to assign opinions to female judges, and cite fewer female-authored opinions. (JEL D91, J16, K41)

10.1257/app.20210435.abstractZh: 性别态度是否会影响与美国巡回法庭女性法官的互动？本文提出了一种基于法官在判决书中使用性别刻板印象语言来衡量其性别态度的指标。通过采用法官对案件进行准随机分配的方式，并结合法官的个人特征，我们验证了该指标的有效性。研究结果表明，倾向保守的法官在涉及性别的案件中更倾向于采取保守的立场。此外，倾向保守的法官与女性同事的互动方式也有所不同：如果下级法院的法官是女性，他们更有可能推翻该女性的判决；他们较少为女性法官撰写意见；并且引用的女性法官撰写的意见也较少。（JEL D91, J16, K41）

abstract.text: Exploiting the random assignment of Medicaid beneficiaries to managed care plans, we find substantial plan-specific spending effects despite plans having identical cost sharing. Enrollment in the lowest-spending plan reduces spending by at least 25 percent—primarily through quantity reductions—relative to enrollment in the highest-spending plan. Rather than reducing “wasteful” spending, lower-spending plans broadly reduce medical service provision—including the provision of low-cost, high-value care—and worsen beneficiary satisfaction and health. Consumer demand follows spending: a 10 percent increase in plan-specific spending is associated with a 40 percent increase in market share. These facts have implications for the government’s contracting problem and program cost growth. (JEL G22, H51, I13, I18, I38)

10.1257/app.20210843.abstractZh: 通过利用医疗补助受益人在管理式护理计划中的随机分配，我们发现尽管各计划的成本分担相同，但各计划之间的支出存在显著差异。选择支出最低的计划，与选择支出最高的计划相比，可以减少至少25%的支出——主要是通过减少服务数量来实现的。低支出计划并非减少了“浪费性”支出，而是总体上减少了医疗服务提供——包括提供低成本、高价值的护理——从而恶化了受益人的满意度和健康状况。消费者需求随支出变化而变化：计划特定支出的增加10%，会导致市场份额增加40%。这些事实对政府的合同问题和项目成本增长具有启示意义。（JEL G22, H51, I13, I18, I38）

abstract.text: This paper summarizes what is known about the impact of public–private partnerships (PPPs) in the three sectors where they have been used intensively: infrastructure (energy, transport, water and sanitation, and telecommunications), education, and health. It lays out the main elements of economic theory relevant to analyzing the trade-off between PPPs and the public provision of complex projects. It places PPPs within a historical perspective. It reviews empirical evaluations of the effectiveness of PPPs and, whenever possible, the implications for social outcomes. Finally, it draws conclusions on cross-cutting issues that influence the efficiency of PPPs, from contract design and regulation to renegotiations and institutional issues. The paper straightens out and qualifies the record of existing evidence and signals some of the main areas and topics for future fruitful research. (JEL D04, H54, I11, I21, L33)

10.1257/jel.20211607.abstractZh: 本文总结了关于公私合作伙伴关系在以下三个领域应用所产生影响的已知信息：基础设施（能源、交通、水和卫生设施以及电信）、教育和健康领域。文章阐述了分析公私合作伙伴关系与公共项目供给之间权衡时相关的经济理论要点。文章从历史视角出发，回顾了关于公私合作伙伴关系有效性的实证评估，并尽可能探讨了其对社会结果的影响。最后，文章对影响公私合作伙伴关系效率的跨领域问题进行了总结，包括合同设计、监管、重新谈判以及制度问题。本文对现有证据进行了梳理和补充，并指出了未来研究的主要方向和主题。（JEL D04, H54, I11, I21, L33）

abstract.text: Alzheimer's disease (AD) affects one in ten people aged 65 or older and is the most expensive disease in the United States. We describe the central economic questions raised by AD. Although there is overlap with the economics of aging and health, the defining feature of the "economics of Alzheimer's disease" is an emphasis on choice by cognitively impaired patients that affects health and financial well-being, and situations in which dynamic contracts between patients and caregivers are useful but difficult to enforce. A focus on innovation in AD prevention, treatment, and care is also critical given the enormous social cost of AD and present lack of understanding of its causes, which raises questions of optimal resource allocation and alignment of private and social incentives. The enormous scope for economists to contribute to our understanding of AD-related issues including drug development, efficient care delivery, dynamic contracting, long-term care risk, financial decision-making, and the design of public programs for AD suggests a rich research program for many areas of economics.

10.1257/jel.20211660.abstractZh: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）影响着每十名65岁或以上的老年人，是美国医疗费用最高的疾病。本文探讨了AD所引发的核心经济问题。虽然AD的经济学与老龄化及健康经济学存在重叠，但“阿尔茨海默病经济学”的核心特征在于强调认知受损患者所做出的选择对健康和财务福祉的影响，以及患者与护理者之间动态契约的必要性，尽管这种契约的执行存在困难。鉴于AD带来的巨大社会成本，以及目前对其病因了解不足的情况，关注AD预防、治疗及护理方面的创新至关重要。这涉及到最优资源分配问题，以及私人激励与社会激励之间的协调问题。经济学家在理解AD相关问题上具有巨大的贡献空间，包括药物开发、高效护理服务、动态契约、长期护理风险、财务决策，以及AD相关公共项目的设计等。这为经济学领域的许多研究方向提供了丰富的研究机会。

abstract.text: We quantify how switching costs and limited awareness affect consumer inertia in liberalized retail electricity markets by developing and estimating a structural demand model using a novel dataset on electricity contract choices in Belgium. Our data allow us to disentangle different sources of inertia by using a rich combination of macromoments and micromoments. We find that consumers perceive contracts as differentiated and both limited awareness and switching costs hinder efficient choices. Our counterfactuals reveal substantial welfare gains from alleviating both frictions, in particular switching costs, and that a well-regulated monopoly can generate similar consumer surplus as the current deregulated market. (JEL D12, D83, L13, L43, L94, L98)

10.1257/mic.20190163.abstractZh: 我们通过开发并估计一个结构需求模型，利用比利时电力合同选择的相关数据集，来量化转换成本与有限认知对自由化零售电力市场中消费者惰性的影响。我们的数据使我们能够通过结合宏观因素和微观因素，区分不同的惯性来源。研究发现，消费者认为电力合同具有差异性，而有限认知和转换成本都阻碍了有效的选择。我们的反事实分析表明，缓解这两种摩擦，尤其是转换成本，可以带来显著的福利收益，并且一个监管良好的垄断企业能够产生与当前无监管市场相似的消费者剩余。（JEL D12, D83, L13, L43, L94, L98）

abstract.text: We develop and test a theory of blind disclosure. A sender chooses whether to disclose information based on a preliminary, private signal. In the unique equilibrium, contrary to the literature’s canonical unraveling result, senders disclose only if their preliminary signal exceeds a cutoff. This cutoff rule leads to partial unraveling in environments with either risk aversion or moral hazard, and disclosure decreases with uncertainty. Using unique administrative data on disclosed and undisclosed grades in a large university, we find that the model is consistent with student choices during spring 2020 to conceal letter grades by switching to optional pass-fail grades. (JEL D81, D82, I23)

10.1257/mic.20210182.abstractZh: 我们提出并测试了一种盲披露理论。发送者根据一个初步的、私密的信号来决定是否披露信息。在独特的均衡状态下，与文献中常见的披露结果相反，发送者只有在他们的初步信号超过某个阈值时才会披露信息。这一阈值规则在存在风险规避或道德风险的情况下会导致部分披露，并且随着不确定性的增加，披露行为会减少。我们利用一所大型大学中披露和未披露成绩的独特行政数据，发现该模型与2020年春季学生选择通过转换为可选通过-未通过成绩来隐藏成绩等级的行为一致。（JEL D81, D82, I23）

abstract.text: We develop a unified theory of exclusive dealing and exclusionary bundling. In a framework with two competing manufacturers that supply their product(s) through a monopolist retailer, we show that buyer power restores the profitability of such practices involving inefficient exclusion. The mechanism underlying this exclusion is that the compensation required by the retailer to renounce selling the rival product erodes with its buyer power. We further show that our theory holds when buyer power differs across manufacturers or when the retailer can strategically narrow (or expand) its product assortment. (JEL D42, D43, K21, L42, L60, L81)

10.1257/mic.20210191.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种关于独家交易和排他性捆绑行为的统一理论。在一个由两个竞争制造商通过垄断零售商提供产品的框架下，我们证明了买方的力量能够恢复这种涉及低效排他性的行为的盈利能力。这种排他性背后的机制是，零售商为了放弃销售竞争对手的产品而需要支付的补偿费用，随着买方力量的增强而减少。我们进一步表明，当不同制造商之间的买方力量存在差异，或者零售商能够战略性地缩小（或扩大）其产品组合时，我们的理论仍然成立。（JEL D42, D43, K21, L42, L60, L81）

abstract.text: Treatment practices vary widely across hospitals, often with little connection to patients’ medical needs. We assess impacts of these differences in delivery practices at childbirth. We find that infants quasi-randomly delivered at hospitals with higher C-section rates are born in better shape and are less likely to be readmitted, with suggestive evidence of improved survival. These benefits are driven by avoidance of prolonged labors that pose risks to infant health. In contrast, these infants are more likely to visit the emergency department for respiratory-related problems, consistent with a large observational literature linking C-section to chronic reductions in respiratory health. (JEL I11, I12, J13, J16)

10.1257/pol.20210034.abstractZh: 不同医院的护理方式存在很大差异，这些差异往往与患者的医疗需求无关。我们评估了这些护理方式差异在分娩过程中的影响。研究发现，在剖宫产率较高的医院中，准随机分娩的婴儿出生时的健康状况更好，且再次住院的可能性更低，这表明婴儿的存活率有所提高。这些好处主要源于避免了可能对婴儿健康造成风险的长时间分娩。相比之下，这些婴儿更有可能因呼吸系统问题而前往急诊室，这与大量观察性研究的结果一致，这些研究将剖宫产与慢性呼吸系统健康问题联系起来。（JEL I11, I12, J13, J16）

abstract.text: Recent debates over health care reform, including in the context of the Military Health System (MHS) and Veterans Administration, highlight the dispute between public and private provision of health care services. Using novel data on childbirth claims from the MHS and drawing on the combination of plausibly exogenous patient moves and heterogeneity across bases in the availability of base hospitals, we identify the impact of receiving obstetrical care on versus off military bases. We find evidence that off-base care is associated with slightly greater resource intensity, but also notably better outcomes, suggesting marginal efficiency gains from care privatization.

10.1257/pol.20210625.abstractZh: 近期关于医疗改革争议的讨论，包括在军事健康系统和退伍军人管理局的框架下，凸显了公共与私人提供医疗服务之间的分歧。我们利用军事健康系统关于分娩索赔的新数据，并结合患者迁移的可能性以及基础医院可用性的差异，研究接受产科护理与不在军事基地接受护理之间的影响。研究发现，不在军事基地接受护理虽然资源投入略高，但治疗效果明显更好，这表明医疗服务的私有化带来了边际性的效率提升。

abstract.text: We study the impacts of telehealth adoption on geographic competition among urban and rural healthcare providers. We consider a quasinatural experiment: states’ entry into the Interstate Medical Licensure Compact, wherein the entry events facilitate healthcare providers to adopt telehealth technology. By analyzing a representative sample of providers, we first establish the Compact entry shock’s validity and its positive effect on the supply of medical services. We then report evidence that there are service and payment shifts from rural providers to urban providers (i.e., urban providers are more likely to benefit from the Compact entry financially). Relying on patients’ telehealth reimbursement claim data, we observe two mechanisms contributing to the revenue redistribution: the substitution and gateway effects of telehealth. Finally, we show that telehealth readiness and service quality moderate the impact of telehealth adoption. These findings speak to both potentially positive and negative consequences for welfare.

10.1287/isre.2021.0380.abstractZh: 我们研究了远程医疗的采用对城市和农村医疗服务提供者之间地理竞争的影响。我们考虑了一个准自然实验：各州加入州际医疗执照协议，这一举措促使医疗服务提供者采用远程医疗技术。通过对代表性样本的服务提供者进行分析，我们首先验证了该协议带来的冲击效应及其对医疗服务供应的积极影响。随后，我们发现服务与支付方面存在从农村提供者向城市提供者转移的现象（即城市提供者更有可能从该协议的实施中获得经济利益）。基于患者的远程医疗报销数据，我们观察到两种有助于收入再分配的机制：远程医疗的替代效应和门户效应。最后，我们表明远程医疗的准备程度和服务质量能够调节远程医疗采用的影响。这些发现揭示了远程医疗采用可能带来的正面和负面后果。

abstract.text: Mergers and acquisitions in healthcare are increasingly leading to changes in firm management. This paper studies how a change in firm management impacts clinical performance using data on an understudied phenomenon: medical practice acquisitions by physician practice management companies (PPMCs). PPMCs market themselves as offloading the administrative burden of running a medical practice without compromising physician autonomy over clinical decisions. However, a PPMC’s management strategy and practices, such as performance monitoring and financial incentives, could influence physician behavior. For example, some PPMCs advertise increasing revenue through better financial management, whereas others also advertise improving quality through better clinical management. In this paper, I collect data on three large PPMCs that manage the practices of more than 40% of obstetricians and gynecologists (Ob-Gyns) in Florida between 2006 and 2014. An Ob-Gyn’s main clinical decision in childbirth involves a tradeoff between financial and clinical outcomes: cesarean sections (C-sections) are often more highly reimbursed than vaginal births but pose risks to maternal and infant health when not medically necessary. Using difference-in-differences methods, I find heterogeneous effects on C-sections depending on a PPMC’s publicized management strategy. Physicians acquired by PPMCs that focus on financial management increase the use of C-sections, resulting in less clinically appropriate care and worse patient outcomes. The opposite result is found when PPMCs focus on clinical management. I provide qualitative and quantitative evidence that differences in firm management are the most likely driver of changes in C-sections. This paper informs how the corporatization of medicine can alter clinical performance outcomes. This paper was accepted by Stefan Scholtes, healthcare management. Funding: This project was supported by grants from the Agency for Healthcare Research (AHRQ), the National Science Foundation (NSF), and Wharton’s Mack Institute for Innovation [Mack Institute Research Fellowship]. The analysis was conducted using data from the State of Florida’s Agency for Healthcare Administration (AHCA). The content is solely the responsibility of the author and does not necessarily represent the official views of AHRQ, NSF, Mack Institute, or AHCA. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4571 .

10.1287/mnsc.2022.4571.abstractZh: 在医疗保健领域，企业并购越来越多地导致企业管理的变革。本文研究了企业管理变革对临床绩效的影响，研究对象是一种鲜为人知的现象：医生诊所被医生诊所管理公司收购。这些公司声称通过减轻诊所的行政负担来降低运营成本，同时不损害医生在临床决策上的自主权。然而，管理公司的策略和行为，如绩效监控和财务激励措施，可能会影响医生的行为。例如，一些管理公司宣传通过更好的财务管理来增加收入，而另一些则宣传通过更好的临床管理来提高质量。本文收集了2006年至2014年间佛罗里达州40%以上的妇产科医生诊所被三家大型管理公司收购的数据。妇产科医生在分娩时的主要临床决策涉及财务和临床结果之间的权衡：剖宫产手术通常比阴道分娩获得更高的报销，但如果非必要，则会对母亲和婴儿的健康造成风险。通过差异比较方法，我发现剖宫产手术的使用情况因管理公司的公开管理策略而异。那些专注于财务管理的管理公司导致剖宫产手术的使用增加，从而降低了临床适宜性，并导致了更差的患者结果。而当管理公司专注于临床管理时，则出现了相反的结果。本文提供了定性和定量证据，表明企业管理的差异很可能是剖宫产手术变化的主要驱动因素。本文揭示了医药企业化如何改变临床绩效结果。本文由Stefan Scholtes负责医疗管理领域的评审。项目资金由医疗保健研究局（AHRQ）、国家科学基金会（NSF）以及沃顿商学院的Mack创新研究所提供资助[Mack研究所研究奖学金]。数据分析所使用的数据来自佛罗里达州医疗保健管理局（AHCA）的数据库。本文内容仅由作者负责，并不一定代表AHRQ、NSF、Mack创新研究所或AHCA的官方观点。补充材料可访问以下链接获取：https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2022.4571。

abstract.text: Quality disclosures regarding medical outcomes such as patient mortality are common healthcare policy instruments. Mixed evidence exists on whether quality disclosures improve outcomes for disclosed ailments. Moreover, disclosure policies can generate spillovers and impact ailments not targeted by the policy. We examine the effects of quality disclosure regulation on mortality improvements in disclosed and nondisclosed ailments. We use patient records for California hospitals for 1995–2014 and construct three groups of ailments: those that were the target of disclosure regulation, complementary ailments that were not the target of disclosure regulation but are medically related to the disclosed ailments, and medically unrelated ailments. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that quality disclosure regulation is associated with declines in mortality risk of disclosed ailments ranging from 11.5% to 23%. Quality disclosure regulation is also associated with improvements for complementary ailments that are not the target of the disclosure policy. Such positive spillover effects yield an estimated 15.2% decline in mortality risk. Consistent with demand-side pressures driving improvements, market shares become sensitive to disclosed quality measures after disclosure regulation. Our findings of direct and spillover effects have implications for disclosure regulation. This paper was accepted by David Simchi-Levi, accounting. Supplemental Material: The data files and online appendix are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4817 .

10.1287/mnsc.2023.4817.abstractZh: 关于医疗结果的品质披露，如患者死亡率，是常见的医疗政策工具。关于品质披露是否改善所披露疾病的疗效，目前存在不同的研究结果。此外，披露政策可能会产生溢出效应，影响那些并非政策目标范围内的疾病。我们研究了品质披露规定对披露疾病和非披露疾病死亡率改善的影响。我们使用了1995年至2014年间加利福尼亚州医院的患者记录，并将疾病分为三类：那些受到披露规定约束的疾病、那些虽未受披露规定约束但与披露疾病有医学关联的疾病，以及与披露疾病无医学关联的疾病。通过差异-差异设计，我们发现品质披露规定与披露疾病死亡率的下降有关，降幅为11.5%至23%。品质披露规定还改善了非披露政策目标范围内的相关疾病的死亡率。这种积极的溢出效应使得死亡率降低了约15.2%。与推动改善的需求侧压力一致，披露规定实施后，市场份额对披露质量指标变得敏感。我们的直接效应和溢出效应发现对披露规定具有启示意义。本文已被David Simchi-Levi的会计学领域接受。补充材料：数据文件和在线附录可在https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2023.4817获取。

abstract.text: Problem definition: Under the prevailing fee-for-service (FFS) payments, hospitals receive a fixed payment, whereas physicians receive separate fees for each treatment or procedure performed for a given diagnosis. Under FFS, incentives of hospitals and physicians are misaligned, leading to large inefficiencies. Bundled payments (BP), an alternative to FFS unifying payments to the hospital and physicians, are expected to encourage care coordination and reduce ever increasing healthcare costs. However, as hospitals differ in their relationships with physicians in influencing care (level of physician integration), the expected effects of bundling in hospital systems with a varying level of physician integration remains unclear. Academic/practical relevance: There is a lack of both academic and practical understanding of hospitals’ and physicians’ bundling incentives. Our study builds on and expands the recent operations management literature on alternative payment models. Methodology: We formulate game-theoretic models to study (1) the impact of the level of integration between the hospital and physicians in the uptake of BP and (2) the consequences of bundling with respect to overall care quality and costs/savings across the spectrum of integration levels. Results: We find that (1) hospitals with low to moderate levels of physician integration have more incentives to bundle as compared with hospitals with high physician integration; (2) to engage physicians, hospitals need to financially incentivize them, a mechanism that was not available in traditional FFS-based payment models; (3) when feasible, BP is expected to reduce care intensity, and this reduction in care intensity is expected to result in quality improvement and cost savings in hospital systems with low to moderate level of physician integration; (4) however, when bundling happens in hospital systems with a relatively higher level of physician integration, BP may lead to underprovisioning of care and ultimately quality reduction; (5) in an environment where hospitals are also held accountable for quality, the incentives for bundling will be higher for involved parties, yet quality vulnerabilities due to bundling can be exacerbated. Managerial implications: Our findings have important managerial implications for policy makers, payers such as the Center for Medicare and Medicaid Services, and hospitals: (1) policy makers and payers should be aware of and account for potential negative effects of current BP design on a subset of hospital systems, including a possible quality reduction; (2) in deciding whether to enroll in BP, hospitals should consider their level of physician integration and possible implications for quality. Based on our findings, we expect that a widespread use of BP may trigger further market concentration via hospital mergers or service-line closures. Supplemental Material: The online appendices are available at https://doi.org/10.1287/msom.2023.1187 .

10.1287/msom.2023.1187.abstractZh:
问题定义：在现行的按服务收费制度下，医院仅获得固定报酬，而医生则根据每项治疗或诊断操作分别获得报酬。这种制度导致医院和医生的激励机制不协同，从而导致效率低下。捆绑支付作为一种替代方案，能够统一对医院和医生的支付，有望促进医疗服务的协调，并降低不断上升的医疗费用。然而，由于医院在影响医疗服务方面与医生的关系存在差异（即医生整合程度的不同），在医生整合程度不同的医院系统中，捆绑支付的预期效果仍不明确。  
学术/实践意义：目前对于医院和医生在捆绑支付制度下的激励机制，无论是学术上还是实践上，都缺乏深入的理解。我们的研究基于并扩展了近期关于替代支付模式的研究。  
研究方法：我们构建了博弈论模型，以研究（1）医院与医生之间的整合程度对采用捆绑支付的影响，以及（2）捆绑支付对整体医疗质量及成本/节省的影响，这些研究涵盖了不同整合程度的情况。研究结果如下：  
(1) 与医生整合程度较高的医院相比，医生整合程度较低至中等的医院更有动力进行服务捆绑；  
(2) 为了吸引医生，医院需要提供经济激励，而这一机制在传统的基于固定费用支付模式中并不存在；  
(3) 在可行的情况下，捆绑服务有望降低护理强度，从而降低护理强度有助于改善医院系统的质量并节省成本，尤其是在医生整合程度较低至中等的医院系统中；  
(4) 然而，在医生整合程度较高的医院系统中实施捆绑服务可能导致护理供应不足，最终影响服务质量；  
(5) 在医院也需承担质量责任的背景下，参与捆绑服务的各方动力会更强，但捆绑服务带来的质量风险可能会加剧。  

管理启示：我们的研究结果对政策制定者、支付方（如医疗保险和医疗补助服务中心）以及医院具有重要的管理意义：  
(1) 政策制定者和支付方应了解并考虑当前捆绑服务设计可能对部分医院系统产生的负面影响，包括可能降低服务质量；  
(2) 在决定是否参与捆绑服务时，医院应考虑自身的医生整合程度及其对质量的影响。  

根据我们的研究结果，捆绑服务的广泛应用可能会通过医院合并或服务线关闭进一步加剧市场集中。  
补充材料：在线附录可访问 https://doi.org/10.1287/msom.2023.1187 。

abstract.text: We use information on management practices in 1,183 hospitals in 7 different countries, collected in 2010 within the "World Management Survey" initiative, to estimate the role of public ownership on different management dimensions, such as monitoring performance, setting targets and incentivizing employees. A significant variation in management practices both between countries and, within countries, across hospitals is found. We show that managers in public sector hospitals tend to underperform, relative to private hospitals, in all the countries considered. Larger hospitals appear to be better managed, while there is no difference between teaching and other type of hospitals. Publicly owned hospitals appear less efficient in the provision of incentive schemes to promote and reward highly motivated employees, or remove poor performers. Overall, public ownership is associated with a reduction of about 10% in management score, which corresponds approximately to a half-standard deviation.

10.1371/journal.pone.0282313.abstractZh: 我们利用2010年“世界管理调查”项目中收集到的7个不同国家1,183家医院的管理实践信息，来估算公有制在不同管理维度中的作用，例如绩效监控、目标设定以及员工激励。研究发现，无论是在国家之间，还是在同一国家内的不同医院之间，管理实践存在显著差异。结果显示，与私立医院相比，公立医院的管理者在所有被研究的国家中表现都较差。规模较大的医院似乎管理得更好，而教学型医院与其他类型的医院之间则没有差异。公立医院在提供激励措施以促进和奖励高绩效员工，或淘汰表现不佳的员工方面，效率较低。总体而言，公有制与管理得分相比减少了约10%，这大约相当于半个标准差。

abstract.text: Hospital quality has been measured and made publicly available for decades in the US and for more than a decade in Germany, as part of an effort to help those countries achieve quality improvement. The German hospital market presents a unique opportunity to examine the relationship between public reporting and quality improvement in the absence of performance-linked payment incentives in a high-income country. We considered quality indicators from several important categories of health services provided in hospitals (hip, knee, obstetrics, neonatology, heart, neck artery surgery, pressure ulcers, and pneumonia), using structured hospital quality reports from the period 2012-19. Our findings support the idea that public reporting provides a quality benchmark and prevents the provision of very low quality health care services, suggesting that imposing financial punishment on low performers is not necessary and may hinder quality improvement and aggravate health disparities. Although hospitals' intrinsic motivation and market forces play roles in improving quality, they are not sufficient to maintain the quality of high-performing hospitals. Therefore, in addition to rewarding high-performing institutions, aligning quality incentives with the intrinsic professional values of clinical care may be useful in achieving quality improvement.

10.1377/hlthaff.2022.00470.abstractZh: 在美国，医院质量已经经过测量并公开披露数十年，而在德国，这一做法也已持续超过十年，这是为了帮助这些国家实现质量提升而采取的措施。德国医院市场提供了一个独特的机会，可以研究在高收入国家缺乏绩效挂钩支付激励的情况下，公开报告与质量提升之间的关系。我们采用了2012至2019年期间的结构化医院质量报告，从医院提供的多个重要医疗服务类别（髋部、膝关节、产科、新生儿科、心脏、颈动脉手术、压疮和肺炎）中选取了质量指标进行研究。我们的研究结果支持这样的观点：公开报告能够提供一个质量基准，并防止提供质量非常低的服务。这表明，对表现不佳的医院实施经济处罚并非必要，反而可能会阻碍质量提升并加剧健康差异。虽然医院的内在动机和市场力量在提升质量方面起着作用，但它们不足以维持高绩效医院的质量。因此，除了对高绩效机构给予奖励外，将质量激励与临床护理的固有专业价值观相结合，也有助于实现质量提升。

abstract.text: The No Surprises Act prohibits most surprise billing but notably does not apply to ground ambulance services. In this study we created a novel data set that identifies the ownership structure of ground ambulance organizations to compare pricing and billing between private- and public-sector ambulances, with a specific focus on organizations owned by private equity or publicly traded companies. Overall, we found that 28 percent of commercially insured emergency ground ambulance transports during the period 2014-17 resulted in a potential surprise bill. Our analysis illustrates that being transported by a private-sector ambulance in an emergency comes with substantially higher allowed amounts, patient cost sharing, and potential surprise bills compared with being transported by a public-sector ambulance. Further, allowed amounts and cost sharing tended to be higher for private equity- or publicly traded company-owned ambulances than other private-sector ambulances. These findings highlight substantial patient liability and important differences in pricing and billing patterns between public- and private-sector ground ambulance organizations.

10.1377/hlthaff.2022.00738.abstractZh: 《不惊喜法案》禁止大多数意外费用的产生，但特别不适用于地面救护车服务。本研究创建了一个新的数据集，用于识别地面救护车组织的所有权结构，以比较私营和公共部门救护车的定价和计费方式，特别关注由私募股权或上市公司拥有的组织。总体而言，我们发现2014年至2017年期间，28%的商业保险紧急地面救护车运输可能导致意外费用。分析表明，在紧急情况下乘坐私营部门救护车，其允许的医疗费用、患者自付费用以及潜在意外费用均高于乘坐公共部门救护车。此外，由私募股权或上市公司拥有的救护车在允许的医疗费用和患者自付费用方面，往往高于其他私营部门救护车。这些发现凸显了患者责任方面的显著差异，以及公共和私营部门地面救护车组织在定价和计费模式上的重要差异。

abstract.text: Governments in many low- and middle-income countries are developing health insurance products as a complement to tax-funded, subsidized provision of health care through publicly operated facilities. This paper discusses two rationales for this transition. First, health insurance would boost fiscal revenues for health care, as post-treatment out-of-pocket payments to providers would be replaced by pre-treatment insurance premia to health ministries. Second, increased patient choice and carefully designed physician reimbursements would increase quality in the health care sector. This essay shows that, at best, these objectives have only been partially met. Despite evidence that health insurance has provided financial protection, consumers are not willing to pay for unsubsidized premia. Health outcomes have not improved despite an increase in utilization. The authors argue that this is not because there was no room to improve the quality of care but because behavioral responses among health care providers have systematically undermined the objectives of these insurance schemes.

10.1596/1813-9450-10313.abstractZh: 许多低收入和中等收入国家的政府正在开发健康保险产品，作为对通过公共设施提供的税收资助和补贴医疗服务的补充。本文讨论了这一转变的两个理由。首先，健康保险能够增加医疗服务的财政收入，因为患者治疗后的自付费用将被保险保费替代，这些保费将支付给卫生部。其次，增加患者的选择权和精心设计的医生报销机制将提高医疗服务的质量。然而，本文指出，这些目标最多只能部分实现。尽管有证据表明健康保险提供了财务保障，但消费者并不愿意支付未补贴的保费。尽管使用率有所提高，但医疗结果并未改善。作者认为，这并不是因为无法提高护理质量，而是因为医疗服务提供者的行为反应系统性地削弱了这些保险计划的目标。
