abstract.text: Two out of five OECD countries contract out some of the job brokerage and counselling functions of publicly financed employment services using outcome-based payment models. This paper examines several important aspects related to the design and implementation of such outsourcing. First, innovative payment models can improve incentives for external providers to offer training and more effective services for hard-to-place clients. Second, providing forward guidance to providers and accounting for contingencies can mitigate their risks, e.g. of being underpaid relative to expenses incurred, thus lowering service costs. Third, letting individuals choose a provider can result in services that are better tailored and foster ongoing competition between providers. Finally, automating data exchange can, somewhat paradoxically, improve data privacy and data protection while enabling new payment models. These and related findings are discussed with country examples based on desk research and interviews with stakeholders in several OECD countries. The paper builds on work conducted in the project “Reforming the Swedish Public Employment Service”, which was carried out with funding from the European Union via the Technical Support Instrument and was implemented by the OECD in cooperation with the European Commission's Directorate-General for Structural Reform Support.

10.1787/c7a819e8-en.abstractZh: 在经合组织国家的五个国家中，有 두个国家通过基于结果的支付模式，将公共融资就业服务中的一些经纪和咨询职能外包出去。本文探讨了与此类外包设计和实施相关的几个重要方面。首先，创新的支付模式可以提高外部提供者对培训和难以安置的客户提供更有效服务的积极性。其次，向提供者提供前瞻性指导并考虑突发事件，可以降低他们的风险，例如相对于所付出的费用而言，他们的报酬不足，从而降低服务成本。第三，让个人选择提供者，可以使得服务更加个性化，并促进提供者之间的竞争。最后，自动化数据交换可以在某种程度上改善数据隐私和数据保护，同时实现新的支付模式。这些发现以及相关的研究结果，通过基于案头研究和与多个经合组织国家利益相关者进行的访谈，以国家为例进行了讨论。本文基于“改革瑞典公共就业服务”项目的研究成果，该项目由欧盟通过技术支持工具资助，并由经合组织与欧盟委员会结构改革支持总司合作实施。

abstract.text: Objective: Pragmatic trials often implement an intervention across a population of patients but require information unavailable at the population level that must be reported by a subset of patients. In this pragmatic clinical trial, we compared characteristics of seriously ill patients with those who completed a survey evaluating advance care planning across 3 academic health systems. Methods: A deliberate process including health system and external stakeholders and patients was used to design materials for and the approach to seriously ill patients. We developed a survey and conducted a multistep process to identify seriously ill primary care patients. We evaluated the relationships of age, gender, race and ethnicity, and vulnerability using the social vulnerability index in this population, and explored the representativeness of survey respondents compared with the underlying seriously ill population in terms of age, race and ethnicity, and vulnerability measured. Results: About 5% (8707 patients) of the primary care population was classified as seriously ill, 5351 were mailed a survey and 1100 provided survey responses. Hispanic and Black patients were younger than White patients, and Black and Hispanic patients were more vulnerable than White and Asian patients and patients of other races. Representativeness was high across age and race and ethnicity, although White and Hispanic patients were more likely to respond than Black and Asian patients and patients of other races. Vulnerability in the surveyed sample was nearly identical to the population. Conclusions: A tailored survey and recruitment strategy yielded a representative sample of seriously ill, largely older, primary care respondents in the context of a pragmatic clinical trial.

10.18865/ed.33.2-3.091.abstractZh: 目的：实用性试验通常需要在患者群体中进行干预，但需要获取在群体层面无法获得的信息，这些信息必须由一部分患者来报告。在这项实用性临床试验中，我们比较了病情严重的患者与在三个学术医疗系统完成了一项关于预先护理计划评估的患者的特征。方法：通过包括医疗系统、外部利益相关者和患者在内的过程，设计针对病情严重的患者的材料和方法。我们开发了一份调查问卷，并采用多步骤流程来识别病情严重的初级保健患者。我们使用社会脆弱性指数来评估年龄、性别、种族和族裔以及脆弱性等因素，并探讨了调查受访者与病情严重的患者群体在年龄、种族和族裔以及脆弱性方面的代表性。结果：在初级保健患者中，约5%（8707名患者）被归类为病情严重，其中5351名患者收到了调查问卷，1100名患者提供了回复。西班牙裔和黑人患者比白人患者年龄更小，而黑人和西班牙裔患者比白人和亚裔患者以及其他种族的患者更脆弱。尽管白人和西班牙裔患者比黑人和亚裔患者以及其他种族的患者更有可能回复，但在年龄和种族及族裔方面，调查样本的代表性很高。结论：通过量身定制的调查和招募策略，在实用性临床试验的背景下，获得了具有代表性的病情严重的、主要是年长者的初级保健患者样本。

abstract.text: We measure the importance of increasing returns to scale and trade in medical services. Using Medicare claims data, we document that “imported” medical care—services produced by a medical provider in a different region—constitute about one-fifth of US healthcare consumption. Larger regions specialize in producing less common procedures, which are traded more. These patterns reflect economies of scale: larger regions produce higher-quality services because they serve more patients. Because of increasing returns and trade costs, policies to improve access to care face a proximity-concentration tradeoff. Production subsidies and travel subsidies can impose contrasting spillovers on neighboring regions.

10.21034/iwp.68.abstractZh: 我们衡量了规模报酬递增以及医疗服务贸易的重要性。通过利用医疗保险索赔数据，我们发现“进口”医疗服务——即由不同地区的医疗服务提供者提供的服务——约占美国医疗支出的五分之一。较大的地区专注于提供较为少见的医疗服务，这些服务更容易进行贸易。这些模式反映了规模经济：较大的地区能够提供更高质量的服务，因为它们服务的患者数量更多。由于规模报酬递增和贸易成本的存在，改善医疗服务的政策面临着距离与集中度的权衡。生产补贴和旅行补贴可能会对邻近地区产生不同的溢出效应。

abstract.text: Background China hopes to reach the policy goal of patients' first contact with primary health care (PHC) institutions through several health care reform policies. Sense of gain is an essential yardstick for measuring reform proposed in China in recent years. However, how high are patients' "sense of gain" (SG) and frequency of first contact with PHC institutions in China, and what is the relationship between the two? These questions still need findings from relevant empirical studies. Methods An empirical study was conducted using descriptive statistics, correlation analysis, and robust ordered logistic regression methods based on objective statistics from 50 randomly sampled cities in mainland China in 2018 and subjective survey data on access to PHC institutions in 2020. Results In this study, we found that patients' sense of gain to PHC institutions in China in 2020 was medium, and the frequency of patients' first contact with PHC institutions "frequently" and above was low. Different aspects of patients' sense of gain to PHC institutions had a differential impact on the frequency of first contact to PHC institutions. There is a significant positive effect on patients' sense of quantity, quality, equity, and improvement of PHC, but no significant effect on accessibility. Patients' sense of gain to PHC institutions has a differential effect on the frequency of first contact with PHC institutions in different ranks of cities. Sense of quantity has a significant effect only in higher-rank cities. In contrast, the sense of quality and improvement has a significant effect only in lower-rank cities. Conclusion It is necessary for the government to scientifically consider the development status of cities of different ranks and pay attention to the actual demand and expectation of patients for PHC. Then effectively improve patients' sense of gain to achieve the policy goal of patients' first contact with PHC institutions.

10.21203/rs.3.rs-3519719/v1.abstractZh:
背景：中国希望通过多项医疗改革政策实现患者首次接触初级卫生保健机构这一政策目标。获得感是衡量近年来中国所提出的改革措施的重要指标。然而，中国患者的获得感水平以及首次接触初级卫生保健机构的频率究竟如何，这两者之间又存在何种关系？这些问题仍需要相关实证研究来解答。  
方法：本研究采用描述性统计、相关性分析以及稳健有序逻辑回归方法，基于2018年中国大陆50个随机选取城市的客观统计数据，并结合2020年关于患者获取初级卫生保健机构情况的主观调查数据进行了实证研究。  
结果：研究发现，2020年中国患者对于初级卫生保健机构的获得感处于中等水平，而患者首次接触初级卫生保健机构的频率中“频繁”及以上的比例较低。患者获得感的不同方面对首次接触初级卫生保健机构的频率产生了不同的影响。患者对于初级卫生保健的数量、质量、公平性和改善方面的获得感具有显著的正向影响，而对可及性则没有显著影响。在不同等级的城市中，患者获得感对首次接触初级卫生保健机构的频率有不同的影响：数量获得感仅在等级较高的城市具有显著效应；而质量感和改善感仅在等级较低的城市具有显著效应。  
结论：政府需要科学考虑不同等级城市的发展状况，并关注患者对于初级卫生保健的实际需求和期望。从而有效提升患者的获得感，实现患者首次接触基层卫生机构的政策目标。

abstract.text: Evidence suggests that limited attention to all available options often leads individuals to deviate from preference maximization. We propose a framework incorporating choice procedures where individuals consider at least two available options. We show that choices made under sequential elimination (whereby options are eliminated one by one until only one survives) always maximize preferences, whereas choices made directly from menus do not. Using a controlled experiment, we find causal evidence that sequential elimination significantly improves choice consistency with preference maximization among subjects with low cognitive ability. Additionally, we examine individual preferences for sequential elimination and their implications.

10.2139/ssrn.4324642.abstractZh: 有证据表明，对所有可用选项的有限关注往往会导致个体偏离偏好最大化。我们提出了一个包含选择程序的框架，其中个体至少会考虑两个可用的选项。我们证明，在顺序淘汰法下做出的选择（即逐一淘汰选项，直到只剩下一个选项）总是能最大化偏好，而直接从选项菜单中做出的选择则无法做到这一点。通过一项对照实验，我们发现，对于认知能力较低的受试者来说，顺序淘汰法显著提高了选择的一致性与偏好最大化之间的契合度。此外，我们还研究了个体对顺序淘汰法的偏好及其影响。

abstract.text: Responding to the rise of hydraulic fracturing (HF) and risks to water quality, U.S. states mandated disclosure for HF wells. We study whether and how such targeting of corporate externalities with transparency regulation reduces environmental impact. We examine salt concentrations considered HF signatures and find significant reductions in surface water impact between 9-17%, mostly along the intensive margin. Consistent with these findings, we document improvements in operator practices, including fewer wastewater spills . We unpack the transparency mechanism and show that transparency regulation enables social movements and increases public pressure, which in turn drives the documented changes in practices and water quality .

10.2139/ssrn.4328692.abstractZh: 面对水力压裂技术的兴起以及对水质的影响，美国各州强制要求对水力压裂井进行信息披露。我们研究通过透明度监管来针对企业的外部性，是否以及如何减少环境影响。我们分析了被视为水力压裂标志的盐浓度，发现地表水影响的减少幅度在9%到17%之间，尤其是在水力压裂活动频繁的地区。与这些发现一致的是，我们观察到操作人员的操作方式有所改善，包括废水泄漏事件的减少。我们还分析了透明度监管机制，发现该机制能够推动社会运动，并增加公众压力，从而推动实际操作方式和水质方面的改善。

abstract.text: Creating a public firm to compete with private firms is an increasingly debated intervention to address inefficiency in concentrated markets. I develop a mixed oligopoly model with alternative firm objectives and estimate it with consumer-level data from the California insurance exchange, where one-third of consumers have access to a public firm. In the best-fitting model, the public firm places more weight on consumer surplus than producer surplus. Adding a public firm decreases premiums, improves welfare in concentrated markets, and increases surplus the most for disadvantaged subpopulations. Enhancing subsidies for private plans, a leading alternative intervention, increases premiums and reduces welfare.

10.2139/ssrn.4346308.abstractZh: 创建一家公共公司来与私营公司竞争，是一种越来越受到讨论的干预措施，旨在解决集中市场中的低效问题。我开发了一个混合寡头模型，该模型设定了不同的公司目标，并使用加州保险交易所的消费者数据进行了估算。在该交易所中，有三分之一的消费者可以使用公共公司提供的服务。在最佳拟合模型中，公共公司更重视消费者剩余而非生产者剩余。引入公共公司可以降低保费，改善集中市场中的福利状况，并且对弱势群体的剩余影响最大。而提高私营计划的补贴则会导致保费上升并降低福利水平。

abstract.text: We uncover substantial interregional trade in medical services and investigate the contribution of regional increasing returns. In Medicare, one-fifth of production involves a doctor treating a patient from another region. Larger regions produce greater quantity, quality, and variety of medical services, which they “export” to patients from elsewhere, especially smaller regions. We estimate regional quality based on patients’ travel choices, and these revealed-preference estimates align with clinical outcomes. Demographic-based instruments and a case study show that greater local demand increases quality and exports, consistent with economies of scale. We study counterfactual policies that lower travel costs rather than relocating production.

10.2139/ssrn.4393370.abstractZh: 我们发现了医疗服务领域的显著区域间贸易现象，并研究了区域规模经济效应的贡献。在医疗保险体系中，五分之一的生产活动涉及医生为来自其他地区的患者提供医疗服务。规模较大的区域能够生产更多、更高质量、更多样化的医疗服务，并将其“出口”给来自其他地区的患者，尤其是规模较小的区域。我们通过患者的出行选择来估算区域医疗服务质量，这些基于偏好揭示的估算结果与临床效果一致。基于人口统计的模型和案例研究表明，更高的本地需求能够提升医疗服务质量和出口量，这与规模经济的效应是一致的。我们还研究了能够降低出行成本而非转移生产的反事实政策。

abstract.text: This paper proposes semi-instrumental variables (semi-IVs) as an alternative to  instrumental variables (IVs) to identify the causal effect of a binary (or discrete)  endogenous treatment. A semi-IV is a less restrictive form of instrument: it affects  the selection into treatment but is excluded only from one, not necessarily  both, potential outcomes. Having two continuously distributed semi-IVs, one  excluded from the potential outcome under treatment and the other from the  potential outcome under control, is sufficient to nonparametrically point identify  marginal treatment effect (MTE) and local average treatment effect (LATE) parameters.  In practice, semi-IVs provide a solution to the challenge of finding valid  IVs because they are often easier to find: many selection-specific shocks, policies,  prices, costs, or benefits are valid semi-IVs. As an application, I estimate the  returns to working in the manufacturing sector on earnings using sector-specific  characteristics as semi-IVs.

10.2139/ssrn.4396760.abstractZh: 本文提出了半工具变量作为工具变量（IV）的替代方案，用于识别二元（或离散）内生处理的因果效应。半工具变量是一种较为宽松的工具变量形式：它会影响进入处理的决策过程，但仅从其中一个潜在结果中排除，而不一定排除另一个。通过拥有两个连续分布的半工具变量，一个在处理条件下被排除在潜在结果之外，另一个在对照条件下被排除，就足以非参数地识别边际处理效应（MTE）和局部平均处理效应（LATE）参数。实际上，半工具变量为寻找有效的工具变量提供了解决方案，因为它们通常更容易获得：许多与选择相关的冲击、政策、价格、成本或收益都可以作为有效的半工具变量。作为一个应用案例，我使用行业特定特征作为半工具变量，来估计制造业工作的收益对收入的影响。

abstract.text: The importance of place of birth or residence on a host of economic outcomes cannot be overstated. The treatment of households in consumer bankruptcy appears to be no different. Despite the U.S. Bankruptcy Code being federal law, there is extreme geographic variation in the relative use of the two types of consumer bankruptcy  Chapter 7 and Chapter 13  and these differences lead to disparities in bankruptcy's balance between debt relief and creditor repayment. Guided by the legal literature, we develop a framework to decompose the geographic variation into three potential sources: (i) differences in filer characteristics, (ii) differences in how courts steer filers based on those characteristics, and (iii) differences in how frequently filers deviate from court steering. The results reveal that heterogeneity surrounding a single characteristic, disposable income, explains most of the geographic variation in chapter choice. Moreover, we show that disposable income plays an important and overlooked role in screening within the bankruptcy system, and we discuss the legal mechanisms behind this screening. Finally, we explore the consequences of improving uniformity in the bankruptcy system.

10.2139/ssrn.4436706.abstractZh: 出生地或居住地对众多经济结果的重要性不容忽视。在消费者破产案件中，对家庭的对待方式似乎也没有什么不同。尽管《美国破产法》是联邦法律，但在两种消费者破产类型——第7章和第13章的使用上存在着巨大的地理差异，这些差异导致了破产过程中债务减免与债权人偿还之间的不平衡。基于法律文献，我们构建了一个框架，将这种地理差异分解为三个可能的来源：(i) 申请者特征的差异；(ii) 法院根据这些特征对申请者进行指导的方式的差异；以及(iii) 申请者偏离法院指导的频率差异。研究结果表明，单一特征——可支配收入——的异质性解释了大部分关于破产选择地理差异的原因。此外，我们还发现可支配收入在破产体系中的筛选过程中发挥着重要且被忽视的作用，并讨论了这一筛选背后的法律机制。最后，我们探讨了提高破产体系统一性所带来的后果。

abstract.text: Pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) are third-party administrators of prescription drug programs for health insurance plans. They play a crucial role in the healthcare system by negotiating drug prices with pharmacies. Consequently, their payment structure can significantly affect the price of prescription drugs. I study the price effects of requiring PBMs and insurers to replace their default fixed-price contracts with cost-plus contracts. Using difference-in-differences methods, I find that Medicaid pre-rebate drug prices declined by an average of 17% in states that prohibited fixed-price contracting. The estimated price effects were driven by generic drugs, with slight increases in branded drug prices. These findings are consistent with cost-plus contracts reducing the ability of PBMs to profit off of asymmetric information regarding the true cost of drugs when negotiating compensation with insurers, but also inducing some PBM moral hazard by removing their profit incentives to contain costs. I also detect larger price decreases in states that rely more heavily on insurers that are not vertically integrated with a PBM. In markets where PBMs have strong informational advantages over non-integrated insurers, cost-plus contracts may be an effective means of reducing drug spending

10.2139/ssrn.4461979.abstractZh: 药品福利管理者（PBM）是健康保险计划中的处方药项目的第三方管理员。他们在医疗系统中扮演着重要角色，通过与药店协商药品价格来影响药品价格。因此，他们的支付结构会显著影响处方药的价格。我研究了要求PBM和保险公司将默认的固定价格合同改为成本加成合同的定价效应。通过差异-差异方法分析发现，在禁止固定价格合同的州，Medicaid预报销药品价格平均下降了17%。这一价格下降主要受到仿制药的影响，而品牌药品的价格则略有上升。这些发现与成本加成合同减少了PBM在协商补偿时因信息不对称而获得的利润有关，但同时也通过消除控制成本的利润激励，引发了PBM的道德风险。此外，我发现那些更依赖非垂直整合的保险公司的州，药品价格下降幅度更大。在PBM拥有相对于非整合保险公司更强的信息优势的市场中，成本加成合同可能是降低药品支出的有效手段。

abstract.text: For over half a century, limited consumer responsiveness to provider quality has been viewed as a defining feature of health care markets. I show that this apparent exceptionalism partly reflects a failure to distinguish consumer preferences from provider-imposed constraints on access. Using administrative data covering the universe of nursing home residents in California, I construct quality measures based on risk-adjusted mortality that are robust to gaming of publicly provided quality measures and validate them using a distance-based IV strategy. I then use these quality measures as inputs into a structural demand model in which nursing homes may reject patients based on observable characteristics. Conventional demand estimation that treats all options as available yields precise null estimates of average demand for quality. Accounting for unobserved rejections instead reveals positive consumer demand, although average responsiveness remains lower than estimates from hospital settings and varies substantially across baseline demographic and health characteristics. The introduction of nursing home star ratings had limited effects on consumer demand, but counterfactual simulations indicate that financial steering incentives and improved hospital discharge processes may improve allocation and reduce mortality by 5 to 17 percent in spite of supply-side constraints. Finally, demand heterogeneity has important consequences for patient outcomes, explaining roughly 10 percent of the mortality-age gradient.

10.2139/ssrn.4470002.abstractZh: 半个多世纪以来，消费者对医疗服务质量的有限反应一直被视为医疗市场的显著特征。我的研究表明，这种表面上的特殊性部分反映了未能区分消费者的偏好与医疗服务提供者施加的准入限制。通过使用涵盖加州养老院居民的行政数据，我构建了基于风险调整死亡率的质量指标，这些指标能够抵抗对公共提供质量指标的操纵，并通过基于距离的IV策略进行了验证。随后，我将这些质量指标作为结构需求模型的输入，其中养老院可能会根据可观察的特征拒绝患者。传统的需求估计方法将所有选项视为可用，从而得出关于平均质量需求的精确零估计。然而，考虑到未观察到的拒绝情况，结果显示消费者存在积极需求，尽管平均响应程度仍低于医院环境的估计值，并且在不同基础人口统计和健康特征上差异显著。引入养老院星级评级对消费者需求的影响有限，但反事实模拟表明，通过财务引导激励和改善医院出院流程，可以在供应方面存在限制的情况下，将死亡率降低5%到17%。最后，需求异质性对患者结果有重要影响，大约解释了10%的死亡率年龄梯度。

abstract.text: Over the last decade, the U.S. Medicare program has added new billing codes to enhance the financial rewards for Chronic Care Management and Transitional Care Management. We analyze the effects of introducing these new billing codes. First, we provide evidence on the adoption of the new codes by primary care physicians. We show that take-up of the new billing codes occurs gradually and exhibits substantial variation across space and across physician characteristics. Second, we provide evidence on how the new billing codes can both complement and substitute for the billing or provision of other services. We focus on two case studies. As a case of code substitution, we show that Transitional Care Management services partially crowd out traditional office visits following hospital discharges. As a case of code complementarity, we show that both Transitional Care Management and Chronic Care Management services predict increases in annual wellness visits. Overall, our analysis highlights how both new code take-up frictions and the impact of new code billing on existing code billing can be important for assessing the total costs and benefits of payment reforms.

10.2139/ssrn.4475934.abstractZh: 在过去的十年中，美国的Medicare计划增加了新的计费代码，以加强对慢性护理管理和过渡性护理管理的经济奖励。我们分析了引入这些新计费代码的影响。首先，我们提供了关于初级保健医生采用新编码情况的证据。我们发现，新编码的采用是逐步进行的，并且在不同地区以及不同医生特征上存在显著差异。其次，我们研究了新计费代码如何补充或替代其他服务的计费或提供。我们重点研究了两个案例研究。作为代码替代的案例，我们发现过渡性护理管理服务在一定程度上取代了出院后的传统门诊服务。作为代码互补的案例，我们发现过渡性护理管理和慢性护理管理服务都能预测年度健康检查的增加。总体而言，我们的分析强调了新编码的采用摩擦以及新编码计费对现有编码计费的影响，这些因素对于评估支付改革的总成本和收益非常重要。

abstract.text: Top income inequality in the United States has increased considerably within occupations. This phenomenon has led to a search for a common explanation. We instead develop a theory where increases in income inequality originating within a few occupations can "spill over" through consumption into others. We show theoretically that such spillovers occur when an occupation provides non-divisible services to consumers, with physicians our prime example. Examining local income inequality across U.S. regions, the data suggest that such spillovers exist for physicians, dentists, and real estate agents. Estimated spillovers for other occupations are consistent with the predictions of our theory.

10.2139/ssrn.4483667.abstractZh: 美国的收入不平等在各个职业中都有所加剧。这一现象促使人们寻找一个共同的解释。我们提出了一个理论，认为来自少数职业的收入不平等可以通过消费“溢出”到其他职业。理论上，当某个职业为消费者提供不可分割的服务时，这种溢出效应就会发生，医生就是最典型的例子。通过对美国各地区的收入不平等进行考察，数据表明医生、牙医和房地产经纪人确实存在这种溢出效应。其他职业的估计溢出效应也与我们的理论预测一致。

abstract.text: This paper examines a classic rationale for voluntary take-up over automatic enrollment in transfer programs: Take-up may be advantageously ``self-targeted'' on characteristics that are infeasible to use as eligibility criteria. Using a correlation test, we find self-targeting in eight U.S. transfers: on average, recipients have lower consumption and lifetime incomes than similar eligible nonrecipients. Self-targeting focuses redistribution toward the lifetime poor and also increases transfers' within-lifetime insurance value. With a new sufficient-statistics result, we value the social benefits of self-targeting at approximately nine cents per transfer dollar, offsetting the social costs of take-up in some programs.

10.2139/ssrn.4495537.abstractZh: 本文探讨了在转移计划中采用自愿参与而非自动参与的经典理由：自愿参与可以更有优势地针对那些难以作为资格标准的特征进行“自我定位”。通过相关性测试，我们发现在美国的八项转移计划中，受助者平均消费水平较低，终身收入也低于其他符合条件的非受助者。自我定位将再分配资源集中在终身贫困人群身上，同时还能提升转移资金在 lifetime 内的保险价值。根据新的充分统计量结果，我们认为自我定位的社会效益约为每转移资金9美分，这一价值可以抵消某些计划中的社会成本。

abstract.text: We study the housing market response to a country-wide policy that mandated the provision of energy efficiency information with all marketing material at the time of listing. Using the near universe of housing sales in England and Wales, we match in the energy efficiency status of the property from Energy Performance Certificates data. We develop a conceptual framework that makes clear the key channels through which the policy may impact house prices – an information-driven salience channel and a market valuation channel. We provide causal evidence of homebuyers’ willingness to pay for a higher energy rated property, documenting a 1-3% premium to a higher energy efficiency rating at the national level, and a 3-6% premium in the London market. We explore a set of key margins along which homebuyers can respond, ruling out as explanations both a consumption channel and an information channel. We conclude that the elevated EPC-rating premiums are driven by a market valuation channel, a conclusion for which we provide empirical support. Such a conclusion is of key policy importance, as it suggests market-facing energy efficiency regulations can increase demand for more energy efficient housing, even in absence of any discernible demand-side consumption or information effects.

10.2139/ssrn.4527854.abstractZh: 我们研究了住房市场对于一项全国性政策的反应，该政策要求在所有营销材料中都提供能源效率信息。利用英格兰和威尔士的近实住房销售数据，我们将房产的能源效率状态与能源性能证书数据进行了匹配。我们构建了一个概念框架，明确了该政策可能影响房价的几个关键渠道——信息驱动的显著性渠道和市场估值渠道。我们提供了关于购房者愿意为更高能源效率的房产支付更多费用的因果证据，发现全国范围内，能源效率等级提高1-3%的房产价格会上涨，而在伦敦市场，这一溢价达到3-6%。我们探讨了一系列购房者可以响应的关键因素，排除了消费渠道和信息渠道作为解释的可能性。我们得出结论，能源性能等级溢价是由市场估值渠道驱动的，并提供了实证支持。这一结论对于政策制定具有重要意义，因为它表明面向市场的能源效率法规可以增加对更节能住房的需求，即使在没有明显的需求侧消费或信息效应的情况下也是如此。

abstract.text: Excessive turnover can signicantly impair an organization's performance. Using high-quality administrative data and staggered dierence-in-dierences strategies, we evaluate the impact of a programme that encouraged public hospitals to increase staff retention by providing data and guidelines on how to improve the non-pecuniary aspects of nursing jobs. We find that the programme has decreased the nurse turnover rate by 4.49%, decreased exits from the public hospital sector by 5.38%, and reduced mortality within 30 days from hospital admission by 3.45%, preventing 11,400 deaths. Our results are consistent with a theoretical model in which information is provided to managers of multi-unit organizations, who trade off coordinating decisions across units and adapting them to local conditions.

10.2139/ssrn.4541361.abstractZh: 过高的人员流动会显著损害组织的绩效。我们利用高质量的行政数据以及分阶段差异化的策略，评估了一项旨在鼓励公立医院提高员工保留率的计划的影响。该计划提供了关于如何改善护理工作中非金钱方面的数据和指导方针。研究发现，该计划使护士的流动率降低了4.49%，减少了5.38%的公立医院员工离职现象，并降低了30天内住院死亡人数，避免了11,400例死亡。我们的研究结果与一种理论模型一致，该模型认为，向多单位组织的管理者提供信息，可以让他们在协调不同单位的决策以及适应当地条件之间做出权衡。

abstract.text: In revenue-based financing (RBF), AI analytics that enhance borrower revenue assessment can increase investor performance but can also lead to digital inequities if unequally utilized. In partnership with a major RBF platform in Asia, the authors conduct three sequential field experiments using 3,947 investors, intending to devise strategies for addressing disparities through responsible AI delivery. Study 1 demonstrates that (dis)advantaged investors are (less) better able to utilize AI. Root causes are examined through a randomized field experiment in which the treated group receives AI-predictions about borrower revenues; while the control group does not. The treated group shows 1.9% higher return and 0.9% lower delinquency, but benefits go to advantaged (tech-savvy, institutional, high-income, and urban) investors. Underutilization by disadvantaged investors is illustrated by 8.2% less AI-automated investment and 6.8% lower AI integration. This further results in 17.6% more clicks and 5.1% longer time taken to make decisions. Their greater AI aversion is indicated by 69.5% lower perceived usefulness and 25.0% less trust through a follow-up survey. To narrow these gaps, Study 2a introduces explainable AI, but institutional investors continue to benefit the most. Consequently, Study 2b explores whether responsible AI (RAI) that caters to disadvantaged investors reduces the disparities observed in Studies 1 and 2a. Overall findings show that standard AI interventions improve overall investment outcomes but may inadvertently widen digital inequalities. Instead, transparent and user-centric explanations aligned with RAI principles foster equitable engagement and inclusive digital finance.

10.2139/ssrn.4548973.abstractZh: 在基于收入的融资中，能够提升借款人收入评估能力的AI分析可以提高投资者的表现，但如果使用不当，也可能导致数字不平等。作者与亚洲一家主要的基于收入的融资平台合作，进行了三项连续的实地实验，涉及3,947名投资者，旨在制定策略以解决通过负责任的人工智能应用带来的不平等问题。研究1表明，处于不利地位的投资者在利用AI方面表现较差。通过一项随机实地实验来探究根本原因，实验中将AI预测结果提供给实验组，而对照组则没有。实验组显示出1.9%更高的回报率和0.9%更低的违约率，但这一优势主要惠及了技术娴熟、机构背景、高收入以及城市地区的投资者。处于不利地位的投资者使用AI的情况不足，表现为AI自动化投资的减少8.2%以及AI整合能力的下降6.8%。这进一步导致决策次数增加17.6%，决策时间延长5.1%。通过后续调查发现，这些投资者对AI的厌恶程度更高，感知有用性降低了69.5%，信任度降低了25.0%。为了缩小这些差距，研究2a引入了可解释性人工智能，但机构投资者仍然受益最多。因此，研究2b探讨了以服务于弱势投资者的负责任人工智能是否能够有效减少研究1和研究2a中观察到的不平等现象。总体结果表明，标准的人工智能干预措施确实改善了整体投资结果，但可能会无意中加剧数字不平等。相反，符合负责任人工智能原则的透明且以用户为中心的解释方式，有助于促进公平的参与和包容性的数字金融发展。

abstract.text: This study analyzes the effect of the content of report cards on the optimal incentivized payment for physicians. Our analysis assumes that report card disclosure builds a reputation regarding physicians' ability among patients who do not have the expertise to know better. Furthermore, we assume that the insurer designs a payment scheme that designates high-ability physicians to provide advanced treatment and low-ability physicians to provide a conventional treatment. We compare the benchmark (no disclosure) with two disclosure policies: detailed, where patients can recognize what service was provided and the outcome of the advanced treatment for all physicians, and limited, where patients can distinguish only physicians who provided the advanced treatment successfully. Our analysis shows that detailed disclosure requires a higher expected payment than the benchmark, and the insurer can save it by limiting the informativeness of the report. Intuitively, detailed disclosure conveys physician type more precisely, and the insurer must pay an additional wage for the conventional treatment provided by low-ability physicians. Our result implies that incentivization by non-monetary method (report card) and monetary method (pay-for-performance) may work in both complement and substitute.

10.2139/ssrn.4565862.abstractZh: 本研究分析了成绩单内容对医生最优激励支付方式的影响。我们的分析假设，成绩单的公开信息能够建立医生在那些缺乏专业判断能力的患者中的声誉。此外，我们假设保险公司设计了一种支付方案，将高能力的医生分配为提供高级治疗，而将能力较低的医生分配为提供常规治疗。我们将基准情况（不公开信息）与两种公开信息政策进行了比较：一种是详细的公开信息，患者可以了解所有医生提供的服务及高级治疗的效果；另一种则是有限的公开信息，患者只能区分那些成功提供高级治疗的医生。我们的分析表明，详细的公开信息需要更高的预期支付额，而保险公司可以通过限制成绩单的信息量来节省成本。直观地说，详细的公开信息能更精确地传达医生的能力类型，因此保险公司必须为能力较低的医生提供的常规治疗支付额外的报酬。我们的研究结果表明，非货币激励方式（如成绩单）和货币激励方式（如按绩效支付）可以在互补和替代两种情况下都发挥作用。

abstract.text: Jobs increasingly require good decision-making. Workers are valued not only for how much they can do, but also for their ability to decide what to do. In this paper we measure the ability to make good decisions about resource allocation, which we call economic decision-making skill. Our assessment requires an intuitive understanding of comparative advantage and is motivated by a model where decision-makers strategically acquire information about factor productivity under time and effort constraints. Economic decision-making skill strongly predicts labor earnings in representative samples of full-time workers in the U.S. and Denmark, conditional on education, IQ, numeracy, and other covariates. Economic decision-making skill is more valuable in management and other decision-intensive occupations.

10.2139/ssrn.4567680.abstractZh: 工作越来越需要良好的决策能力。员工不仅因其能力而被重视，还因其决策能力而受到重视。在本文中，我们衡量了在资源分配方面的决策能力，将其称为经济决策技能。我们的评估需要直观理解比较优势，并且基于一个模型，该模型描述了决策者在时间和努力限制下如何战略性地获取关于生产要素生产力的信息。在美国和丹麦的代表性全职工人样本中，经济决策技能与劳动收入有很强的相关性，这一关系在考虑教育水平、智商、计算能力以及其他协变量的情况下仍然成立。在经济决策技能方面，管理和其他需要做出决策的职业具有更高的价值。

abstract.text: We show that variation in state-level commercial coverage of physician-administered drugs impacts Medicare patients' utilization: a 10pp increase in commercial exclusion rates leads to a 0.9-1.7pp reduction in share among Part B beneficiaries. Facilities, rather than physicians, drive prescribing variation, likely through the preferred stocking of products with better commercial coverage. Motivated by these findings, we calibrate a model of manufacturer competition over insurance coverage and facility stocking, and find that the stocking channel weakens the government's ability to influence Medicare utilization and that manufacturers can strategically use formulary coverage to soften price competition over facility stocking.

10.2139/ssrn.4578352.abstractZh: 我们发现，州级商业药品覆盖率的差异会影响医疗保险患者的用药情况：商业药品被排除的比例每增加10个百分点，B部分受益人中使用这些药品的比例就会减少0.9到1.7个百分点。导致药品使用差异的其实是医疗机构，而非医生，这可能是因为医疗机构更倾向于选择商业覆盖较好的药品。基于这些发现，我们构建了一个模型，模拟了制造商在药品覆盖率和医疗机构库存方面的竞争。模型显示，医疗机构的库存策略削弱了政府影响医疗保险用药情况的能力，而制造商可以通过利用药品目录的覆盖情况来削弱价格竞争，从而在医疗机构库存方面取得优势。

abstract.text: Specialize? Diversify? Do patients care? The authors investigate the demand-side effects of a hospital’s portfolio strategy, which entails decisions about the depth and breadth of its service offerings. Positing that both depth (focus) and breadth (related focus) signal expertise, the authors use both archival and experimental evidence to examine these effects. The archival study is based on Florida’s State Inpatient Databases (SID) between 2006-2015 and spans all major departments in healthcare delivery. The empirical analysis exploits plausible exogenous variation from other healthcare markets and reveals that patient choice is positively influenced by a hospital’s depth (focus) and breadth (related focus) of expertise in a department. Complementing the archival evidence, the authors also conducted online experiments to examine the signaling effects of hospital portfolio strategy on patient choice behavior. The results provide support for the idea that hospital portfolio strategy does influence patient perceptions of hospital expertise in focal and related areas, and subsequently, their choice behavior. The authors also highlight potential synergistic effects between focus and related focus and heterogeneity in the effects across departments, payor types, and hospital profit-status. These findings underscore the need for managers to adopt a targeted approach to portfolio decisions in healthcare.

10.2139/ssrn.4585878.abstractZh: 专攻还是多元化？患者是否关心这些选择？作者研究了医院投资组合策略的需求侧效应，这一策略涉及对服务提供的深度和广度的决策。作者认为，服务的深度和广度都体现了医院的专长。他们利用档案数据和实验数据来研究这些效应。档案研究基于2006年至2015年佛罗里达州住院患者数据库，涵盖了医疗服务的所有主要部门。实证分析利用其他医疗市场的合理外部变量，发现医院在某个部门的专长深度和广度对患者的选择有积极影响。除了档案数据外，作者还进行了在线实验，以研究医院投资组合策略对患者选择行为的影响。研究结果支持这样的观点：医院的投资组合策略确实会影响患者对医院在相关领域的专长的认知，进而影响其选择行为。作者还强调了专长和相关专长之间的协同效应，以及不同部门、支付方类型以及医院盈利状况下效应的差异。这些发现强调了管理者在医疗领域需要采取有针对性的投资组合决策方式。

abstract.text: Jobs increasingly require good decision-making. Workers are valued not only for how much they can do, but also for their ability to decide what to do. In this paper we develop a theory and measurement paradigm for assessing individual variation in the ability to make good decisions about resource allocation, which we call allocative skill. We begin with a model where agents strategically acquire information about factor productivity under time and effort constraints. Conditional on such constraints, agents’ allocative skill can be defined as the marginal product of their attention. We test our model in a field survey where participants act as managers assigning fictional workers with heterogeneous productivity schedules to job tasks and are paid in proportion to output. Allocative skill strongly predicts full-time labor earnings, even conditional on IQ, numeracy, and education, and the return to allocative skill is greater in decision-intensive occupations.

10.2139/ssrn.4594737.abstractZh: 工作越来越需要良好的决策能力。员工的价值不仅体现在他们的能力上，还体现在他们决定做什么的能力上。在本文中，我们提出了一个理论和测量框架，用于评估个体在资源分配决策方面的能力差异，我们将其称为“分配技能”。我们的模型基于这样一个假设：个体在时间与努力的约束下，策略性地获取有关生产要素生产力的信息。在这样的约束条件下，个体的分配技能可以被定义为他们注意力的边际产出。我们在一项实地调查中测试了我们的模型，参与者扮演管理者的角色，将具有不同生产力安排的虚构工人分配到不同的工作任务中，并且他们的报酬与产出成正比。结果表明，分配技能对全职劳动收入有显著预测作用，即使是在智商、计算能力和教育水平相同的条件下也是如此。此外，在需要做出决策的职业中，分配技能的回报更为显著。

abstract.text: I examine how hospitals respond to financial incentives. In Japan, the per diem  payment is designed to decrease as the length of stay increases to incentivize early dis charge. However, under these nonlinear payment schedules, hospitals can increase re imbursements with repeated discharges and readmissions. Using administrative claims  data, I study hospital responses to a national policy that penalizes immediate post- discharge readmissions to limit repeated admissions. Exploiting variations created by  the program introduction, I find that hospitals delay readmissions for relatively healthy  patients to avoid the penalty, while readmissions immediately after discharge decrease  for relatively unhealthy patients due to selective readmission. Moreover, there are no  detectable effects on health outcomes.

10.2139/ssrn.4607396.abstractZh: 我研究了医院如何响应财务激励措施。在日本，按日计酬的支付方式旨在随着住院时间的延长而减少，以此激励患者尽早出院。然而，在这种非线性的支付安排下，医院可以通过多次出院和再入院来增加补偿。利用行政理赔数据，我研究了医院对一项国家政策的反应，该政策对出院后立即再入院的行为进行处罚，以限制重复入院。通过利用该政策实施带来的变化，我发现医院会延迟对相对健康患者的再入院，以避免处罚；而对于相对不健康的患者，由于选择性再入院的原因，出院后的再入院次数会减少。此外，这些政策对健康结果没有显著影响。

abstract.text: Healthcare systems are increasingly adopting capitation payments to reduce costs. In the conventional capitation payment model, insurance companies receive predetermined, risk-adjusted sums for each patient to provide care over fixed time periods irrespective of individual patient healthcare utilization. Although this model encourages insurers to enhance cost efficiency in theory, the actual outcomes have not always aligned with this expectation, as evidenced by the increased healthcare costs experienced by Medicare following the introduction of Medicare Advantage Plans. Motivated by this observation, we demonstrate, using a simple model, that the conventional capitation model may not effectively incentivize cost reduction, even in competitive insurance markets and when patients can enroll in any available plan. This is due to insurance companies competing to cherry-pick profitable patients by manipulating insurance plan design, particularly when patients are given the option to enroll in alternative plans, such as the fee-for-service-based traditional Medicare Plan. Additionally, we show that, even with perfect information about patient types, which eliminates patient selection, the conventional capitation model may not yield socially optimal outcomes due to externalities stemming from patient choice. Next, we introduce an innovative retrospective capitation payment model that leverages actual healthcare costs associated with each patient. This approach eliminates the need for risk-adjustment procedures and the requirement to predict future medical expenses, all while still incentivizing providers to enhance cost efficiency. Using a general model, we demonstrate that this approach achieves identical outcomes to the conventional capitation model with perfect patient type information in a competitive equilibrium.

10.2139/ssrn.4615485.abstractZh: 医疗系统越来越多地采用按服务量付费的方式来降低成本。在传统的按服务量付费模式中，保险公司会为每位患者获得预先确定的、经过风险调整的金额，用于在一定时间内提供医疗服务，而不考虑每位患者的实际医疗使用情况。虽然这一模式理论上鼓励保险公司提高成本效率，但实际效果并不总是符合这一预期，例如Medicare在引入Medicare Advantage计划后，医疗费用反而增加了。基于这一观察，我们通过一个简单的模型证明，即使在竞争激烈的保险市场中，当患者可以选择任何可用的计划时，传统的按服务量付费模式可能无法有效激励成本降低。这是因为保险公司会通过操纵保险计划设计来争夺盈利患者，尤其是在患者可以选择其他计划的情况下，比如基于服务收费的传统Medicare计划。此外，我们还表明，即使患者类型的信息是完全的，从而消除了患者选择的问题，传统的按服务量付费模式仍可能无法产生社会最优的结果，因为患者选择带来的外部性会影响结果。接下来，我们引入了一种创新的回顾性按服务量付费模式，该模式利用与每位患者相关的实际医疗成本。这种方法消除了风险调整程序和预测未来医疗费用的需要，同时仍然能够激励提供者提高成本效率。通过一般模型，我们证明这种方法在竞争均衡状态下能够实现与具有完全患者类型信息的传统按服务量付费模式相同的效果。

abstract.text: To capture richer substitution patterns, researchers have specified discrete choice demand models with product-dependent price coefficients, though this strategy generally lacks a clear theoretical foundation. In this paper, I examine the implications of this strategy. First, I show that such models are inconsistent with standard utility maximization and therefore preclude the use of the conventional welfare formula. Second, I show how to conduct correct welfare analysis under product-dependent price coefficients using a measure of change in consumer surplus expressed solely in terms of demand. Third, using a well-known dataset on the car market, I estimate a random coefficient logit model with segment-specific price coefficients. I find that this specification yields more intuitive substitution patterns than a conventional random coefficient logit model with a common price coefficient and leads to different counterfactual conclusions in a bonus-malus counterfactual exercise aimed at lowering the average fuel inefficiency of new-car purchases.

10.2139/ssrn.4624771.abstractZh: 为了捕捉更丰富的替代模式，研究人员提出了带有产品依赖价格系数的离散选择需求模型，不过这种策略通常缺乏明确的理论基础。在本文中，我探讨了这种策略的潜在影响。首先，我证明了这种模型与标准效用最大化理论不符，因此无法使用传统的福利公式进行分析。其次，我展示了如何在产品依赖价格系数的情况下，通过仅以需求为衡量标准的消费者剩余变化来进行正确的福利分析。第三，利用一个关于汽车市场的知名数据集，我估计了一个带有特定细分市场价格系数的随机系数Logit模型。我发现，与采用通用价格系数的传统随机系数Logit模型相比，这种模型能够更直观地反映替代模式，并且在旨在降低新车购买平均燃油效率的逆向选择模型中，得出的结论也有所不同。

abstract.text: This paper studies the relative importance of teacher-student match eﬀects and general teacher eﬀectiveness in producing student learning, and quantifies gains from alternative teacher assignments. We estimate a framework that separates these components, allowing match quality to vary with observable student characteristics and unobservable teacher-school factors. Using more than a decade of administrative data from a large urban district, we  address endogenous sorting with quasi-random assignment variation induced by differences in driving time between teachers and schools. Match eﬀects are similar in magnitude to general eﬀectiveness. Teacher-acceptable reassignments can raise average test scores by about 0.13 standard deviations.

10.2139/ssrn.4627702.abstractZh: 本文研究了教师与学生匹配效应与一般教师效能在促进学生学习过程中的相对重要性，并量化了不同教师分配方式所带来的收益。我们构建了一个框架，将这两种效应区分开来，使得匹配质量能够随着可观测的学生特征和不可观测的教师-学校因素而变化。利用来自一个大型城市地区的十多年行政数据，我们研究了由教师与学校之间的通勤时间差异引起的准随机分配所带来的内生排序现象。匹配效应的大小与一般教师效能相当。教师认可的重新分配可以将平均测试分数提高约0.13个标准差。

abstract.text: How do skilled migrant workers affect firms’ performance and output? I estimate the causal effect of EU nurse withdrawal after the Brexit referendum on the performance of English hospitals. Exploiting variation in the reliance on EU workers across hospital providers in pre-referendum years, I find that providers with a mean share of EU nurses before the referendum persistently face 2% more hospital-related deaths after the referendum. This translates to 5,900 additional hospital-related deaths p.a. in England. Unexpected readmissions of patients increase by 5% and reported incidents with harm to patients by 7% respectively. Providers respond to missing EU nurses by hiring UK nurses and fostering promotions in the short run, and by recruiting non-European nurses in the long run.

10.2139/ssrn.4636005.abstractZh: 技术熟练的移民工人如何影响企业的绩效和产出？我估计了英国脱欧公投后欧盟护士撤离对英国医院绩效的因果效应。通过对比公投前各医院对欧盟工人的依赖程度，我发现公投前拥有较高比例欧盟护士的医院在公投后持续面临2%更多的医院相关死亡病例。这相当于英格兰每年额外有5,900例医院相关死亡。患者的意外再入院率增加了5%，而导致患者受伤的事故数量则增加了7%。为了应对缺少欧盟护士的情况，这些医院在短期内会雇佣英国护士并鼓励护士晋升，而在长期内则会招聘非欧盟护士。

abstract.text: How do patient and provider incentives affect the provision of long-term care? Our analysis of 551 thousand nursing home stays yields three main insights. First, Medicaid-covered residents prolong their stays instead of transitioning to community-based care due to limited cost-sharing. Second, when facility capacity binds, nursing homes shorten Medicaid stays to admit more profitable out-of-pocket private payers. Third, providers react more elastically to financial incentives than patients. Thus, targeting provider incentives through alternative payment models, such as episode-based reimbursement, is more effective than increasing patient cost-sharing in facilitating transitions to community-based care and generating long-term care savings.

10.2139/ssrn.4654662.abstractZh: 患者和提供者的激励措施如何影响长期护理的提供？我们对55.1万次养老院住院情况的分析得出了三个主要发现。首先，由于费用分担的限制，接受医疗补助的居民更倾向于延长住院时间，而不是转向社区护理。其次，当养老院的容量有限时，它们会缩短医疗补助患者的住院时间，以接纳更多盈利性强的自费患者。第三，提供者对财务激励的反应比患者更为灵活。因此，通过替代支付模式，如基于病例的报销，来针对提供者的激励措施，比增加患者的费用分担更为有效，有助于促进向社区护理的过渡，并节省长期护理成本。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Improving the rural residents' accessibility to and affordability of health care is recognized as a common target globally. The Health in All Policies approach, from the Declaration of Helsinki to the United Nations' Decade Of Healthy Ageing, strengthened the far-reaching effect of large-scale public policies on health care-seeking behavior; however, the effects of national transport policy on health care-seeking behavior is unclear. OBJECTIVE: This quasi-experimental study aimed to examine the effects of the implementation of transport-driven poverty alleviation (TPA) policy on health care-seeking behavior and medical expenditure among older adults in rural areas and the mechanism underlying these effects. METHODS: We designed a quasi-experiment to estimate the effects of TPA policy implementation on health care-seeking behavior and medical expenditure among older adults in rural areas through a difference-in-differences (DID) analysis based on data from the China Health and Retirement Longitudinal Study in 2011, 2013, 2015, and 2018. The underlying mechanism was analyzed and effect modification patterns were further investigated by poor households, health status, and age. RESULTS: Our findings validated a positive contribution of TPA policy on health care-seeking behavior among older adults in rural areas. After the implementation of TPA policy, the number of inpatient visits increased by annually 0.35 times per person, outpatient medical expenditure increased by 192% per month, and inpatient medical expenditure increased by 57% annually compared with those of older adults in rural areas without the implementation of TPA policy. Further, there was a significant modification effect, with a positive effect among poor households, healthier older adults, and those aged 60-80 years. Additionally, the policy improved the patients' capabilities to seek long-distance care (β=23.16, 95% CI -0.99 to 45.31) and high-level hospitals (β=.08, 95% CI -0.02 to 0.13), and increased individual income to acquire more medical services (β=4.57, 95% CI -4.46 to 4.68). CONCLUSIONS: These findings validate the positive contribution of TPA policy on health care-seeking behavior among older adults in rural areas; however, the medical expenditure incurred was also high. Concerted efforts are needed to address health care-seeking dilemmas in rural areas, and attention must be paid to curbing medical expenditure growth for older adults in rural areas during TPA policy implementation.

10.2196/49603.abstractZh: 背景：提高农村居民获得医疗保健的机会和负担能力被公认为全球共同的目标。从《赫尔辛基宣言》到联合国“健康老龄化十年”倡议，大规模公共政策对寻求医疗保健的行为产生了深远影响；然而，国家交通政策对寻求医疗保健行为的影响尚不明确。目的：本准实验研究旨在探讨交通驱动扶贫政策实施对农村老年人寻求医疗保健行为和医疗支出的影响，以及这些影响的机制。方法：我们设计了一项准实验，基于2011年、2013年、2015年和2018年的《中国健康与退休纵向研究》数据，通过差异-差异分析来估计交通驱动扶贫政策实施对农村老年人寻求医疗保健行为和医疗支出的影响。进一步分析了潜在机制，并通过贫困家庭、健康状况和年龄等因素探讨了效应修饰模式。结果：我们的研究发现证实了交通驱动扶贫政策对农村老年人寻求医疗保健行为的积极贡献。在实施交通驱动扶贫政策后，老年人住院次数每年增加0.35次，门诊医疗支出每月增加192%，住院医疗支出每年增加57%。此外，还存在显著的效应修饰效应，其中贫困家庭、健康状况较好的老年人以及60-80岁年龄段的老年人表现出积极效应。此外，该政策提升了患者寻求远程医疗服务的能力（β=23.16，95%置信区间：-0.99至45.31）以及选择高水平医院的能力（β=0.08，95%置信区间：-0.02至0.13），并增加了个人收入以购买更多医疗服务（β=4.57，95%置信区间：-4.46至4.68）。结论：这些发现证实了TPA政策对农村地区老年人就医行为的积极影响；然而，相应的医疗费用也相当高。需要共同努力来解决农村地区的就医难题，并在TPA政策实施期间关注控制农村地区老年人的医疗支出增长。

abstract.text: The Digital Humanities face the problem of multiple hypothesis testing: Evermore hypotheses are tested until a desired pattern has been found. This practice is prone to mistaking random patterns for real ones. Instead, we should reduce the number of hypothesis tests to only test meaningful ones. We address this problem by using theory to generate hypotheses for statistical models. We illustrate our approach with the example of the European Reformation, where we test a theory on the role of opinion leaders for the adoption of Protestantism with a logistic regression model. Given our specific setting, including choice of data and operationalisation of variables, we do not find enough evidence to claim that opinion leaders contributed via personal visits and letters to the adoption of Protestantism. To falsify or to support a theory, it has to be tested in different settings. Our presented approach helps the Digital Humanities bridge the gap between the qualitative and quantitative camp, advance understanding of structures resulting from human activity, and increase scientific credibility.

10.22148/001c.57764.abstractZh: 数字人文领域面临着多重假设检验的问题：不断进行假设检验，直到找到期望的模式。这种做法容易将随机模式误认为是真实模式。因此，我们应该减少假设检验的数量，只进行有意义的检验。我们通过理论来生成统计模型的假设来解决这个问题。我们以欧洲宗教改革为例，使用逻辑回归模型来检验关于意见领袖对新教采纳作用的理论。考虑到我们的具体环境，包括数据选择和变量的操作化，我们没有足够的证据表明意见领袖通过个人访问和信件对新教的采纳产生了影响。为了验证或支持一个理论，需要在不同的环境中进行检验。我们提出的方法有助于数字人文领域弥合定性和定量研究之间的差距，加深对人类活动产生的结构的理解，并提高科学可信度。

abstract.text: We examine the economic analysis of the relationship between innovation and product market competition. First, we give a brief tour of the intellectual history of the area. Second, we examine how the Aghion-Howitt framework has influenced the development of the literature theoretically and (especially) empirically, with an emphasis on the "inverted U": the idea that innovation rises and then eventually falls as the intensity of competition increases. Thirdly, we look at recent applications and development of the framework in the areas of competition policy, international trade and structural Industrial Organization.

10.2307/jj.4820341.7.abstractZh: 我们探讨了创新与产品市场竞争关系的经济分析。首先，我们对这一领域的学术历史进行了简要回顾。其次，我们研究了Aghion-Howitt框架在理论及实证研究中的发展影响，特别强调了“倒U型”现象：即随着竞争强度的增加，创新会先上升，随后逐渐下降。第三，我们考察了该框架在竞争政策、国际贸易以及结构型产业组织领域的最新应用与发展情况。

abstract.text: Data breach disclosure laws are state-level disclosure mandates intended to protect individuals from the consequences of identity theft. However, we argue that the laws help reduce shareholder risk by encouraging managers to take real actions to reduce firms’ exposure to cyber risk. Consistent with this argument, we find an on-average decrease in shareholder risk, proxied by cost of equity, after the staggered passage of these laws. We also find the effect is attenuated for firms that already took real actions to manage cyber risk before the laws. Further, after these laws, firms are more likely to increase cybersecurity investments and have a cybersecurity officer. Finally, we observe positive abnormal returns on key dates related to the passage of these laws. Our collective evidence suggests that consumer protection disclosure mandates can benefit shareholders and, specifically, that regulators can use disclosure mandates to incentivize managers to reduce firms’ exposure to cyber risk. Data Availability: All data used in this study are publicly available. JEL Classifications: G120; G340.

10.2308/tar-2020-0787.abstractZh: 数据泄露披露法律是州级层面的披露要求，旨在保护个人免受身份盗窃带来的后果。然而，我们认为这些法律通过鼓励管理者采取实际措施来降低企业面临的网络风险，从而有助于减少股东风险。与这一论点一致的是，我们发现在这些法律分阶段实施之后，股东风险平均有所降低，这一变化可以通过股权成本来体现。此外，对于那些在法律实施前就已经采取措施管理网络风险的企业来说，这种效果有所减弱。而且，在这些法律实施后，企业更有可能增加网络安全投资，并配备网络安全官员。最后，我们观察到与这些法律实施相关的关键日期上出现了积极的异常回报。我们的综合证据表明，消费者保护披露要求能够惠及股东，特别是监管机构可以利用这些披露要求来激励管理者降低企业面临的网络风险。数据可用性：本研究使用的所有数据均可公开获取。JEL分类：G120；G340。

abstract.text: Who bears the consequences of administrative problems in healthcare? We use data on repeated interactions between a large sample of U.S. physicians and many different insurers to document the complexity of healthcare billing, and estimate its economic costs for doctors and consequences for patients. Observing the back-and-forth sequences of claim denials and resubmissions for past visits, we can estimate physicians’ costs of haggling with insurers to collect payments. Combining these costs with the revenue never collected, we estimate that physicians lose 18% of Medicaid revenue to billing problems, compared with 4.7% for Medicare and 2.4% for commercial insurers. Identifying off of physician movers and practices that span state boundaries, we find that physicians respond to billing problems by refusing to accept Medicaid patients in states with more severe billing hurdles. These hurdles are quantitatively just as important as payment rates for explaining variation in physicians’ willingness to treat Medicaid patients. We conclude that administrative frictions have first-order costs for doctors, patients, and equality of access to healthcare. We quantify the potential economic gains—in terms of reduced public spending or increased access to physicians—if these frictions could be reduced, and find them to be sizable.

10.24148/wp2023-03.abstractZh: 谁应承担医疗保健行政问题的后果？我们通过大量美国医生与多家保险公司之间的重复互动数据，来揭示医疗账单处理的复杂性，并估算其给医生带来的经济成本以及对患者的影响。通过观察过去就诊过程中索赔被拒和重新提交的情况，我们可以估算医生与保险公司讨价还价以收取费用所付出的成本。将这些成本与未收取的收入相结合，我们发现医生因账单问题而损失了18%的Medicaid收入，而Medicare和商业保险公司的损失分别为4.7%和2.4%。通过识别那些跨州流动的医生，我们发现医生在面对账单问题时，会拒绝在账单障碍更严重的州接受Medicaid患者。这些障碍在解释医生治疗Medicaid患者的意愿差异方面，与支付率一样重要。我们得出结论，行政摩擦对医生、患者以及医疗保健的公平性都造成了首要成本。我们量化了如果这些摩擦能够减少，可能会带来的潜在经济收益——包括减少公共支出或增加医生的可及性。我们发现这些收益是相当大的。

abstract.text: Research Questions:To what extent are NFPs in the Australian aged care sector engage in non-financial performance and risk disclosures in their annual reports?What is the effect of non-financial performance and risk disclosures on the extent of financial vulnerability (FV)?Motivation: Research on measuring and understanding the determinants of FV or financial crisis within the not-for-profit (NFP) sector is both scant and limited.To address these gaps in the literature, the paper investigates the extent to which NFPs in the Australian aged care sector make voluntary disclosures related to non-financial performance management (NFPM) and risk information disclosures and examined the impact of NFPM and risk disclosures on the extent of FV in the Australian aged care NFP sector.Idea: The NFPM and risk information disclosures expected to be negatively associated with FV or financial crisis.Data: Data for the study is taken from publicly available database, the Australian Charities and Not-for-Profit Commission website, and quantitative content analysis was conducted to measure the extent of non-financial disclosures using data collected from the audited annual reports issued by 200 aged care NFPs for the years 2018 and 2019.Tools: The dependent variable of this study is the extent of FV that has been measured using the proposed multi-dimensional FV framework.Descriptive statistics, such as, provides mean, median, standard deviation, maximum and minimum values to recognise nature and extent of NFPM and risk information disclosures.For the inferential statistics, the study analyses the research model using multiple regression analysis.Findings: Panel regression results indicate inadequate disclosures of NFPM, and risk information are associated with the extent of FV of NFPs in the Australian aged care sector.

10.24818/jamis.2023.04006.abstractZh:
研究问题：澳大利亚老年护理领域的非营利组织在其年度报告中，在多大程度上涉及非财务绩效和风险披露？非财务绩效和风险披露对财务脆弱性的程度有何影响？

动机：关于非营利部门财务脆弱性或金融危机决定因素的研究非常有限。为了填补这一文献空白，本文探讨了澳大利亚老年护理领域的非营利组织在多大程度上自愿披露了与非财务绩效管理和风险信息相关的信息，并研究了非财务绩效管理和风险披露对澳大利亚老年护理非营利部门财务脆弱性程度的影响。

思路：预期非财务绩效管理和风险信息的披露会与财务脆弱性或金融危机呈负相关。

数据：研究数据来自公开数据库——澳大利亚慈善与非营利委员会网站。通过定量内容分析，利用200个老年护理非营利组织2018年和2019年发布的年度审计报告中的数据，来衡量非财务披露的程度。

工具：本研究的核心变量是通过提出的多维财务脆弱性框架来衡量的财务脆弱性程度。描述性统计，如均值、中位数、标准差、最大值和最小值，用于识别非财务绩效管理和风险信息披露的性质和程度。在推断统计方面，研究使用多元回归分析来研究模型。

研究结果：面板回归结果显示，非财务绩效管理的不足披露以及风险信息的披露与澳大利亚老年护理领域非营利组织的财务脆弱性程度相关。

abstract.text: This paper explores how immigration can help mitigate nursing home staffing shortages, which are likely to worsen as baby boomers age. We show that local increases in immigration lead to fewer falls, less use of restraints, and fewer pressure ulcers among nursing home residents, as well as improvements in other measures of quality of care. Consistent with a labor market explanation, we find that immigration increases the local supply of workers in nursing fields, with the largest effect on the number of nurse aides - the workers primarily responsible for hands-on care in nursing homes.

10.3368/jhr.0720-11063r2.abstractZh: 本文探讨了移民如何帮助缓解养老院的人员短缺问题，这一问题随着婴儿潮一代的老化而可能进一步加剧。我们发现，当地移民的增加导致养老院居民跌倒次数减少、使用约束装置的次数减少，压力性溃疡的发生率也降低，同时其他护理质量的指标也有所改善。与劳动力市场理论相符的是，我们发现移民增加了护理领域的本地劳动力供应，其中对护士助手的影响最为显著——护士助手主要负责在养老院中的实际护理工作。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of Medicaid expansions to parents and childless adults on adult mortality. Specifically, we evaluate the long-run effects of eight state Medicaid expansions from 1994 through 2005 on all-cause, healthcare-amenable, non-healthcare-amenable, and HIV-related mortality rates using state-level data. We utilize the synthetic control method to estimate effects for each treated state separately and the generalized synthetic control method to estimate average effects across all treated states. Using a 5% significance level, we find no evidence that Medicaid expansions affect any of the outcomes in any of the treated states or all of them combined. Moreover, there is no clear pattern in the signs of the estimated treatment effects. These findings imply that evidence that pre-ACA Medicaid expansions to adults saved lives is not as clear as previously suggested.

10.3386/w30818.abstractZh: 本文探讨了医疗补助计划对有父母或无子女成年人死亡率的影响。具体而言，我们利用州级数据，评估了1994年至2005年间八项州级医疗补助计划扩展对全因死亡率、与医疗保健相关的死亡率、与医疗保健无关的死亡率以及与艾滋病相关的死亡率的长期影响。我们采用合成控制法分别估算每个受影响的州的影响，并使用广义合成控制法估算所有受影响的州的平均影响。在5%的显著性水平下，我们没有发现医疗补助计划扩展对任何受影响的州或所有受影响的州的综合结果产生任何影响。此外，估计出的处理效应在符号上也没有明显的规律。这些发现表明，关于医疗补助计划扩展在ACA实施前为成年人节省生命的说法并不像之前认为的那样明确。

abstract.text: Privatization has been shown to increase the growth and profitability of government-owned firms. However, the effects on consumers have been understudied. We study potential trade- offs in the US hospital sector, where government control of capacity declined by 42% over 1983–2019. Private operators may improve hospitals’ financial viability and reduce the need for subsidies, but a focus on profitability may adversely affect access for unprofitable low-income patients and care quality. Combining multiple patient- and hospital-level administrative datasets with national hospital survey data, we study 258 hospital privatizations during the 2000–2018 period. Private operators increase profitability through a reduction in employment and an increase in the mean revenue per patient. The latter is achieved by cream-skimming more profitable patients and services, as well as by increasing prices. However, we detect an increase in mortality rates among elderly (aged 65+) patients, suggesting a decline in care quality. We also find a decrease in aggregate admissions of low-income patients at the market level and an increase in mortality among the near-elderly (ages 55–64), particularly in low-income markets. Overall, we estimate that the 258 hospital privatizations led to approximately 920 additional deaths per year and $694 million in annual savings for local governments by the end of our study period.

10.3386/w30824.abstractZh: 研究表明，私有化能够提升政府所属企业的增长和盈利能力。然而，其对消费者的影响却尚未得到充分研究。我们研究了美国医院领域的潜在权衡：1983年至2019年间，政府对医院容量的控制减少了42%。私人运营商可能会改善医院的财务状况并减少补贴需求，但过于关注盈利能力可能会不利地影响低收入患者的就医机会和医疗质量。通过结合多个患者和医院层面的行政数据以及全国医院调查数据，我们研究了2000年至2018年间发生的258起医院私有化案例。私人运营商通过减少员工数量和提高每位患者的平均收入来提高盈利能力。后者是通过将更有利可图的患者和服务纳入服务范围以及提高价格来实现的。然而，我们发现老年患者（65岁以上）的死亡率有所上升，这表明医疗质量有所下降。我们还发现，在市场中，低收入患者的总入院人数减少，而近老年人群（55至64岁）的死亡率上升，尤其是在低收入地区。总体而言，我们估计在这258起医院私有化案例中，每年导致约920名患者死亡，同时为地方政府节省了6.94亿美元。

abstract.text: Using field-experimental data on gym attendance, we analyze the relationship between imperfect memory and people’s awareness of their limited self-control. We develop a model that generates predictions about how imperfect recall is linked to forecasts and demand for behavior change, and we develop techniques for testing whether recall is selective. Empirically, we find that people overestimate both past and future attendance, and are more likely to recall attendances than absences. Larger overestimation of past attendance is associated with (i) more overestimation of future attendance, (ii) a lower willingness to pay to motivate higher future attendance, and (iii) a smaller gap between goal and forecasted attendance. Additionally, we find suggestive evidence that memory is motivated. We link biased memory to structural estimates of quasi-hyperbolic discounting with naivete.

10.3386/w30825.abstractZh: 我们利用关于健身房出勤率的实地实验数据，分析了不完美记忆与人们对自己有限自我控制能力认知之间的关系。我们开发了一个模型，该模型能够预测不完美回忆如何与行为改变的预测和需求相关联，并提出了测试回忆是否具有选择性的方法。通过实证分析，我们发现人们高估了过去和未来的出勤率，并且更倾向于回忆出勤情况而非缺席。对过去出勤率的过度高估与以下因素相关：(i) 对未来出勤率的过度高估；(ii) 较低的支付意愿来激励更高的未来出勤率；(iii) 目标出勤率与预测出勤率之间的差距较小。此外，我们还发现了一些暗示性证据，表明记忆行为是有动机驱动的。我们将有偏的记忆与具有天真性的准超线性折扣结构估计联系起来。

abstract.text: We study the international spillover effects of air pollution by developing a framework that integrates recent advances in atmospheric science into econometric estimation with microdata on mortality and health. Combining transboundary particle trajectory data with the universe of individual-level mortality and emergency room visit data in South Korea, we find that transboundary air pollution from China significantly increases mortality and morbidity in South Korea. Using these estimates, we show that a recent Chinese environmental policy “war on pollution” generated a substantial international spillover benefit. Finally, we examine China’s strategic pollution reductions and provide their implications for the potential Coasian bargaining.

10.3386/w30830.abstractZh: 我们研究了空气污染的国际溢出效应，通过构建一个框架来整合大气科学的最新进展与基于微观数据的死亡率和健康数据之间的经济计量估计。结合中国跨境颗粒物轨迹数据以及韩国个体层面的死亡率和急诊就诊数据，我们发现来自中国的跨境空气污染显著增加了韩国的死亡率和发病率。利用这些估计结果，我们表明中国最近的环境政策“污染攻坚战”带来了显著的国际溢出效益。最后，我们考察了中国在污染减排方面的战略措施，并分析了这些措施对潜在科阿辛式谈判的影响。

abstract.text: In recent decades, death rates from poisonings, suicides, and alcoholic liver disease have dramatically increased in the United States. We show that these "deaths of despair" began to increase relative to trend in the early 1990s, that this increase was preceded by a decline in religious participation, and that both trends were driven by middle-aged white Americans. Using repeals of blue laws as a shock to religiosity, we confirm that religious practice has significant effects on these mortality rates. Our findings show that social factors such as organized religion can play an important role in understanding deaths of despair.

10.3386/w30840.abstractZh: 近几十年来，美国的中毒、自杀和酒精性肝病导致的死亡率显著上升。我们发现，这些“绝望之死”现象在20世纪90年代初开始增加，而这一增长之前伴随着宗教参与率的下降，且这两种趋势都是由中年白人美国人主导的。通过将蓝法的废除作为对宗教性的冲击，我们证实了宗教实践对这些死亡率有显著影响。我们的研究结果表明，诸如有组织的宗教活动这样的社会因素在理解“绝望之死”现象中起着重要作用。

abstract.text: The rise of shale gas and tight oil development has triggered a major debate about hydraulic fracturing (HF).In an effort to mitigate risks from HF, especially with respect to water quality, many U.S. states have introduced disclosure mandates for HF wells and fracturing fluids.We use this setting to study whether targeting corporate activities that have dispersed environmental externalities with disclosure regulation to create public pressure reduces their environmental impact.We find significant improvements in water quality, examining salts that are considered signatures for HF impact, after the disclosure mandates are introduced.We document effects along the extensive and the intensive margin, though most of the improvement comes from the latter.Supporting this interpretation, we find that, after the disclosure mandates, operators pollute less per unit of production, use fewer toxic chemicals, and cause fewer spills and leaks of HF fluids and wastewater.We also show that disclosure enables public pressure and that this pressure facilitates internalization.

10.3386/w30842.abstractZh: 页岩气和致密油资源的开发引发了关于水力压裂技术的重大讨论。为了减轻水力压裂带来的风险，尤其是水质方面的风险，许多美国州政府实施了水力压裂井和压裂液的披露要求。我们利用这一背景研究，通过披露法规来针对那些具有分散性环境影响的公司活动，是否能够产生公众压力，从而降低其环境影响。研究发现，在披露要求实施后，水质得到了显著改善，尤其是那些被认为是水力压裂影响的标志性的盐分指标。我们还在广泛和密集的层面上都发现了改善效果，不过大部分改善来自后者。支持这一解释的是，我们发现，在披露要求实施后，运营商每单位产量的污染量减少，使用的有毒化学物质也减少了，水力压裂液和废水的泄漏和溢出事件也减少了。我们还表明，披露机制能够产生公众压力，而这种压力有助于内部化环境问题。

abstract.text: Aggregate data show a large and decades-long decline in construction sector productivity.This decline in such a large sector has had a material effect on secular productivity growth for the economy as a whole.Prior work has focused on the role of potential measurement problems in construction, particularly output deflators in the measurement of productivity.This paper brings some new evidence to bear on the industry's measured productivity problems and suggests that measurement error is probably not the sole source of the stagnation.First, using measures of physical productivity in housing construction, productivity is falling or, at best, stagnant over multiple decades.Second, there has been a noticeable decline over time in the efficiency with which construction firms translate materials inputs into output, and a corresponding shift toward more value-added-intensive production.Third, using state-level data, we do not find evidence of patterns of within-industry reallocation that might be expected of efficiently operating input and output markets.States with more productive construction sectors do not see growth in their shares of total U.S. construction activity; if anything, their shares fall.This may point to frictions in these markets that slow or stop what is in many other markets an important channel for productivity growth.

10.3386/w30845.abstractZh: 汇总数据显示，建筑行业的生产力在数十年间出现了大幅下降。如此大的行业范围内的下降，对整个经济体的长期生产力增长产生了实质性影响。先前的研究主要关注建筑领域潜在测量问题，特别是用于衡量生产力的产出平减指数。本文提供了一些新的证据，表明测量误差可能不是导致停滞的唯一原因。首先，从住房建筑的物理生产力指标来看，生产力在数十年间持续下降，或者至少处于停滞状态。其次，建筑企业将材料投入转化为产出的效率随着时间的推移而下降，同时出现了向更高附加值生产方式的转变。第三，利用州级数据，我们没有发现任何表明行业内部资源重新分配的模式，而这些模式通常出现在高效运作的投入产出市场中。那些拥有更高效建筑行业的州，其在美国建筑活动中的份额并没有增长；相反，它们的份额甚至有所下降。这可能表明，这些市场存在一些阻碍或阻止生产力增长的摩擦。

abstract.text: Concerns have been raised about the “demise of democracy”, possibly accelerated by pandemic-related restrictions. Using a survey experiment involving 8,206 respondents from five Western democracies, we find that subjects randomly exposed to information regarding civil liberties infringements undertaken by China and South Korea to contain COVID-19 became less willing to sacrifice rights and more worried about their long-term-erosion. However, our treatment did not increase support for democratic procedures more generally, despite our prior evidence that pandemic-related health risks diminished such support. These results suggest that the start of the COVID-19 crisis was a particularly vulnerable time for democracies.

10.3386/w30846.abstractZh: 有人对“民主的衰落”提出了担忧，这种衰落可能因疫情相关的限制措施而加速。我们通过一项涉及8,206名来自五个西方民主国家的受访者的调查实验发现，那些随机接触到有关中国和韩国为控制COVID-19而侵犯公民自由的信息的受访者，更不愿意牺牲权利，反而更加担心这些权利会长期受到侵蚀。然而，尽管我们之前的研究表明疫情相关的健康风险会降低对民主程序的支持，但我们的实验并未增加人们对民主程序的一般支持。这些结果表明，COVID-19危机的爆发对民主国家来说是一个特别脆弱的时期。

abstract.text: Using data from the Fatality Analysis Reporting System for the period 1983-1997, Cohen and Einav (Review of Economics and Statistics 2003; 85(4): 828–843) found that mandatory seatbelt laws were associated with a 4 to 6 percent reduction in traffic fatalities among motor vehicle occupants. After successfully replicating their two-way fixed effects estimates, we (1) add 22 years of data (1998-2019) to capture additional seatbelt policy variation and observe a longer post-treatment period, (2) employ the interaction-weighted estimator proposed by Sun and Abraham (2021) to address potential bias due to heterogeneous and dynamic treatment effects, and (3) estimate event-study models to investigate pre-treatment trends and explore lagged post-treatment effects. Consistent with Cohen and Einav (2003), our updated estimates show that primary seatbelt laws are associated with a 5 to 9 percent reduction in fatalities among motor vehicle occupants. Estimated effects of secondary seatbelt laws are smaller in magnitude and sensitive to model choice.

10.3386/w30851.abstractZh: 科恩和埃纳夫利用1983-1997年致命事故报告系统的数据，发现强制佩戴安全带的法律与机动车乘员交通事故死亡率降低了4%至6%有关。在成功复制了他们的双向固定效应估计后，我们（1）增加了22年的数据（1998-2019年），以涵盖更多的安全带政策变化，并观察到更长的治疗期；（2）采用孙和亚伯拉罕在2021年提出的交互加权估计方法，以解决由于异质性和动态处理效应导致的潜在偏差；（3）通过事件研究模型来调查治疗前的趋势，并探讨滞后于治疗后的效应。与科恩和埃纳夫（2003年）的研究结果一致，我们的更新估计显示，主要安全带法律与机动车乘员交通事故死亡率降低了5%至9%有关。次要安全带法律的影响幅度较小，且对模型选择较为敏感。

abstract.text: The United States spends substantially more on health care than most developed countries, yet leaves a greater share of the population uninsured. We suggest that incremental insurance expansions focused on addressing market failures will propagate inefficiencies and are not likely to facilitate active policy decisions that align with societal coverage goals. By instead defining a basic bundle of services that is publicly financed for all, while allowing individuals to purchase additional coverage, policymakers could both expand coverage and maintain incentives for innovation, fostering universal access to innovative care in an affordable system.

10.3386/w30854.abstractZh: 美国的医疗保健支出远高于大多数发达国家，然而仍有更大比例的人口没有保险。我们认为，逐步扩大保险覆盖范围以应对市场失灵的做法只会加剧效率低下，并且不太可能促进符合社会保障目标的积极政策决策。相反，政策制定者可以定义一套由公共资金资助的基本服务，同时允许个人购买额外的保险。这样既能扩大保险覆盖范围，又能保持创新的动力，从而在可负担的体系中实现全民获得创新医疗服务的目标。

abstract.text: The potential of artificial intelligence (AI) to simplify existing healthcare processes and create new, more efficient ones is a major topic of discussion in the industry. Yet healthcare lags other industries in AI adoption. In this paper, we estimate that wider adoption of AI could lead to savings of 5 to 10 percent in US healthcare spending—roughly $200 billion to $360 billion annually in 2019 dollars. These estimates are based on specific AI-enabled use cases that employ today’s technologies, are attainable within the next five years, and would not sacrifice quality or access. These opportunities could also lead to nonfinancial benefits such as improved healthcare quality, increased access, better patient experience, and greater clinician satisfaction. We further present case studies and discuss how to overcome the challenges to AI deployments. We conclude with a review of recent market trends that may shift the AI adoption trajectory toward a more rapid pace.

10.3386/w30857.abstractZh: 人工智能在简化现有医疗流程以及创造更高效的新流程方面的潜力，是业界热议的话题。然而，在人工智能的采用方面，医疗行业仍落后于其他行业。本文估计，更广泛地采用人工智能可以使得美国医疗支出节省5%到10%，即每年约2000亿至3600亿美元。这些估计基于特定的、利用当前技术实现的人工智能应用场景，这些场景在未来五年内可以实现，且不会牺牲医疗质量或患者获取机会。这些机会还可能导致非财务方面的好处，如提高医疗质量、增加患者获取机会、改善患者体验以及提升临床医生的满意度。我们进一步提供了案例研究，并讨论了如何克服人工智能部署中的挑战。最后，我们回顾了近期市场趋势，这些趋势可能会使人工智能的采用速度加快。

abstract.text: High administrative costs in U.S. health care have provoked concern among policymakers over potential waste, but many of these costs are generated by managed care policies that trade off bureaucratic costs against reductions in moral hazard. We study this trade-off for prior authorization restriction policies in Medicare Part D, where low-income beneficiaries are randomly assigned to default plans. Beneficiaries who face restrictions on a drug reduce their use of it by 26.8%. Approximately half of marginal beneficiaries are diverted to another related drug, while the other half are diverted to no drug. These policies generated net financial savings, reducing drug spending by $96 per beneficiary-year (3.6% of drug spending), while only generating approximately $10 in paperwork costs. Revealed preference approaches suggest that the cost savings likely exceed beneficiaries’ willingness to pay for foregone drugs.

10.3386/w30878.abstractZh: 美国医疗保健领域的高昂行政成本引发了政策制定者对于潜在浪费的担忧，但这些成本中的许多是由管理式护理政策所引发的，这些政策在降低道德风险的同时也带来了官僚成本。我们研究了Medicare Part D中的预先授权限制政策中的这种权衡，其中低收入受益人被随机分配到不同的默认计划。面临药物使用限制的受益人减少了26.8%的药物使用量。大约一半的边际受益人被转向另一种相关药物，而另一半则被转向不服用任何药物。这些政策带来了净财务节省，每位受益人的药物支出减少了96美元/年（占药物支出的3.6%），而仅产生了大约10美元的文书工作成本。揭示性偏好方法表明，节省的成本可能超过了受益人愿意为放弃的药物支付的金额。

abstract.text: We examine why minority and poor households are often underrepresented in studies that require active participation. Using data from a serological study with randomized participation incentives, we find large participation gaps by race and income when incentives are low, but not when incentives are high. We develop a framework for using randomized incentives to disentangle the roles of hesitancy and non-contact in driving the participation gaps, and find that hesitancy is the predominant factor. Hesitancy rates strongly correlate with hospitalization rates and COVID-19 risk, suggesting that individuals facing higher health risks may be underrepresented in studies with low incentives.

10.3386/w30880.abstractZh: 我们探讨了为什么在需要积极参与的研究中，少数族裔和贫困家庭往往被忽视。通过一项带有随机参与激励措施的血清学研究数据，我们发现当激励措施较低时，不同种族和收入群体之间的参与率存在较大差距，而当激励措施较高时则不存在这种差距。我们提出了一个框架，利用随机激励措施来揭示犹豫和非接触行为在造成参与率差距中的作用，并发现犹豫是主要因素。犹豫率与住院率和COVID-19风险高度相关，这表明面临更高健康风险的个体可能在激励措施较低的研究中被忽视。

abstract.text: Administrative barriers to social insurance program take-up are pervasive, including in subsidized health insurance. We conducted a randomized controlled trial with Massachusetts’ Affordable Care Act marketplace to reduce these barriers and other behavioral frictions. We find that a “check the box” streamlined enrollment intervention raises enrollment by 11%, more than personalized reminder letters (7.9% increase) or generic reminder letters (4.5% increase). Effects are concentrated among individuals eligible for zero-premium plans, who faced no further administrative burdens of setting up payments. Producing this enrollment effect through premium reduction would cost about $6 million in subsidies, highlighting the importance of these burdens.

10.3386/w30885.abstractZh: 社会保险计划的参保过程中存在普遍的行政障碍，包括补贴型健康保险。我们通过在马萨诸塞州的《平价医疗法案》市场进行了一项随机对照试验，以减少这些障碍和其他行为障碍。研究发现，采用“勾选选项”的简化参保干预措施可使参保人数增加11%，这一效果优于个性化提醒函（增加7.9%）或通用提醒函（增加4.5%）。这种效果主要出现在那些符合零保费计划条件的个体中，他们无需承担额外的缴费设置行政负担。通过降低保费来实现这一参保效果，大约需要600万美元的补贴，这凸显了这些行政负担的重要性。

abstract.text: This study investigates how competition influences the prescribing practices of physicians. U.S. state law changes granting nurse practitioners (NPs) the authority to prescribe controlled substances without physician oversight generate exogenous increases in competition by expanding patients’ options when seeking care. In response, we find that general practice physicians (GPs)—the physician specialty that competes most directly with NPs—significantly increase their prescribing of opioids and controlled anti-anxiety medications. GPs also increase their co-prescribing of opioids and benzodiazepines, a practice that violates prescribing guidelines. These effects are more pronounced in areas with more NPs per GP at baseline and lead to sizable increases in fatal drug overdoses. In contrast, we observe no changes in prescribing among physician specialties that do not compete with NPs, nor in the prescribing of drug classes not directly affected by the law changes. Our findings are consistent with a simple model of physician behavior in which competition for patients leads physicians to move toward the preferences of marginal patients. These results demonstrate that more competition will not always lead to improvements in patient care and can instead lead to excessive service provision.

10.3386/w30889.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了竞争如何影响医生的处方行为。美国州法律的变化赋予执业护士在没有医生监督的情况下开具控制性药物的权力，这通过扩大患者在寻求医疗服务时的选择范围，从而增加了竞争。作为与执业护士最直接竞争的医生专业，全科医生显著增加了阿片类药物和控安眠药的处方量。全科医生还增加了阿片类药物和苯二氮卓类药物的联合处方，这种做法违反了处方指南。在每名全科医生对应的护士数量较多的地区，这些影响更为明显，并导致致命药物过量事件的显著增加。相比之下，那些不与执业护士竞争的医生专业，以及那些不受法律变化直接影响的药物类别的处方情况，均未发生变化。我们的研究结果与一个简单的医生行为模型一致，即竞争促使医生倾向于满足边缘患者的需求。这些结果表明，更多的竞争并不总会导致患者护理质量的改善，反而可能导致过度服务供给。

abstract.text: Burnout of physicians and other medical personnel is a major problem in the economics of healthcare systems, potentially costing billions of dollars. Knowledge of the determinants and costs of burnout at the organization level is sparse, making it difficult to assess the net benefits of interventions to reduce burnout at the level where arguably the greatest change can be affected. In this paper, we use data from a midsize healthcare organization with about 500 clinicians in 2021-22 to advance analysis of clinical burnout in two ways. First, we estimate the costs of clinician burnout beyond the widely studied losses due to turnover. Including hard-to-measure and potentially long-term costs that arise from reduced patient satisfaction and lower productivity of burnt-out clinicians at work, our analysis suggests a much higher cost of burnout per clinician than previous estimates that exclude these costs. Second, we use standard medical billing and administrative operating data to forecast turnover and productivity of clinicians to serve as an early warning system. Accurate estimates of both the cost of burnout now and of likely future costs should help decision-makers be proactive in their approach to solving the burnout crisis currently affecting the healthcare industry. While our empirical analysis relates to a particular healthcare organization, the framework for quantifying the costs of burnout can be used by other organizations to assess the cost-effectiveness of ameliorative policies.

10.3386/w30895.abstractZh: 医生和其他医疗人员的职业倦怠是医疗系统经济学中的一个重大问题，可能造成数十亿美元的损失。关于组织层面职业倦怠的决定因素和成本的认知十分有限，这使得评估减少职业倦怠的干预措施在最能产生显著影响的层面上的净效益变得困难。在本文中，我们利用了一家中型医疗机构在2021-2022年的数据，从两个方面对临床职业倦怠进行分析。首先，我们估算了临床医生职业倦怠的成本，除了广泛研究的因人员流失造成的损失之外，还包括了因患者满意度下降和倦怠医生的工作效率降低而产生的难以衡量且可能长期的成本。我们的分析表明，每位临床医生的职业倦怠成本远高于之前未考虑这些成本的估算。其次，我们利用标准的医疗计费和管理运营数据来预测临床医生的流失率和工作效率，以此作为预警系统。准确估算当前和未来的职业倦怠成本，有助于决策者采取积极措施解决当前影响医疗行业的职业倦怠问题。虽然我们的实证分析是针对某一特定医疗机构的，但量化职业倦怠成本的框架可以被其他组织用来评估缓解政策的成本效益。

abstract.text: This paper uses the severe economic crisis in Turkey in 2008-2009 as a quasi-experiment to evaluate the impact of worsening economic conditions during pregnancy on birthweight. Using birth history data from the 2008 and 2013 waves of the Demographic Health Surveys, we find that the economic crisis resulted in decreased birthweight in Turkey, especially impacting infants born to mothers with lower educational levels. Furthermore, a procyclical relationship exists between provincial income levels and the birthweight of infants born to mothers with lower levels of education. However, this relationship is only statistically significant during the crisis period. These results highlight how economic constraints on mothers with lower socio-economic status during economic crises can negatively affect birth outcomes. Furthermore, we examine shifts in fertility behavior and find a decrease in childbirth rates during the crisis, particularly in economically disadvantaged provinces. In line with this decrease in fertility, we also observe a reduced propensity to seek an abortion during the crisis period. Overall, these findings underscore the importance of understanding how economic crises affect infant health and the need for targeted interventions to support vulnerable populations, as well as addressing underlying socio-economic disparities to mitigate their impact on infant well-being.

10.3386/w30902.abstractZh: 本文以2008-2009年土耳其的严重经济危机作为准实验，评估妊娠期间经济状况恶化对出生体重的影响。通过2008年和2013年人口健康调查中的出生数据，我们发现经济危机导致土耳其的出生体重下降，尤其是对教育水平较低的母亲所生的婴儿影响更大。此外，省级收入水平与教育水平较低的母亲所生婴儿的出生体重之间存在顺周期性关系，但这种关系仅在危机期间具有统计学意义。这些结果凸显了经济危机期间社会经济地位较低的母亲所面临的经济限制如何对出生结果产生负面影响。此外，我们还研究了生育行为的变化，发现危机期间，特别是在经济条件较差的省份，分娩率有所下降。与生育率下降相一致的是，我们在危机期间也观察到寻求堕胎的倾向减少。总体而言，这些发现强调了理解经济危机如何影响婴儿健康的重要性，以及需要针对弱势群体的干预措施，同时解决潜在的社会经济差异，以减轻其对婴儿福祉的影响。

abstract.text: We study how the societal disruptions of the COVID-19 pandemic impacted diagnosis of a prevalent childhood mental health condition, Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD). Using both nationwide private health insurance claims and a single state’s comprehensive electronic health records, we compare children exposed to the pandemic to same aged children prior to the pandemic. We find the pandemic reduced new ADHD diagnoses by 8.6% among boys and 11.0% among girls nationwide through February 2021. We further show that higher levels of in-person schooling in Fall 2020 dampened the decline for girls but had no moderating effect for boys.

10.3386/w30909.abstractZh: 我们研究了COVID-19大流行对社会的影响如何改变了儿童常见心理健康问题——注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）的诊断。通过全国范围内的私人健康保险索赔数据以及一个州的综合电子健康记录，我们将大流行期间接触疫情的儿童与疫情前的同龄儿童进行了对比。研究发现，截至2021年2月，大流行导致全国范围内男孩的新发ADHD诊断减少了8.6%，女孩减少了11.0%。此外，2020年秋季更高水平的面对面教学在一定程度上缓解了女孩诊断数量的下降，但对男孩的影响则不明显。

abstract.text: Some harm reduction strategies encourage individuals to switch from a harmful addictive good to a less harmful addictive good; examples include e-cigarettes (substitutes for combustible cigarettes) and methadone and buprenorphine (substitutes for opioids). These have proven to be controversial. Advocates argue that people struggling with addiction benefit because they can switch to a less harmful substance, but opponents argue that this could encourage abstainers to begin using the harm-reduction method or even, eventually, the original addictive good. This paper builds on theories of addiction to model the introduction of a harm reduction method, and demonstrates the conditions under which each side is correct.

10.3386/w30926.abstractZh: 一些减少危害的策略鼓励人们从有害的成瘾性物品转向危害较小的成瘾性物品；例如电子香烟（可燃香烟的替代品）以及美沙酮和丁丙诺啡（阿片类药物的替代品）。这些措施引发了争议。支持者认为，与成瘾作斗争的人可以通过转向危害较小的物质而受益，但反对者则认为，这可能会促使不使用者开始使用这种减少危害的方法，甚至最终转向原来的成瘾性物品。本文基于成瘾理论，对引入减少危害的方法进行了建模，并探讨了各方观点正确的条件。

abstract.text: Financial ties between drug companies and medical researchers are thought to bias studies published in medical journals. To enable readers to account for such bias, most medical journals require authors to disclose potential conflicts of interest. We examine whether disclosure reduces article citations, indicating a discount. A challenge to estimating this effect is selection as drug companies may seek out higher quality authors. Our analysis confirms this positive association. Including observable controls for article and author quality attenuates but does not eliminate this relation. We perform three tests. First, we show that the positive association is weaker for review articles, which are more susceptible to bias. Second, we examine article recommendations to family physicians among articles that are a priori more homogenous in quality.
