We find a significantly negative association between disclosure and expert recommendations, consistent with discounting. Third, we conduct an analysis within author and article, exploiting journal policy changes that result in conflict disclosure by an author. We examine the effect of this disclosure on citations to a previously published article by the same author. This analysis reveals a negative citation effect. Overall, our evidence is consistent with the notion that other researchers discount articles with disclosed conflicts.

10.3386/w30927.abstractZh: 药物公司与医学研究人员之间的财务关系被认为会影响发表在医学期刊上的研究。为了帮助读者识别这种偏见，大多数医学期刊要求作者披露潜在的利益冲突。我们研究了披露这些信息是否会降低文章的引用次数，即是否存在一种“折扣效应”。估计这一效应的一个挑战是选择问题，因为药物公司可能会寻找更高质量的作者。我们的分析证实了这种正相关关系。然而，对文章和作者质量的观察性控制虽然减弱了这种关系，但并未完全消除它。我们进行了三项测试：首先，我们发现对于更容易受到偏见影响的综述文章，这种正相关关系较弱；其次，我们研究了在质量上较为均匀的文章中，这些文章对家庭医生推荐的影响，发现披露利益冲突与专家推荐之间存在显著的负相关关系，这与“折扣效应”一致；第三，我们分析了作者和文章层面的情况，利用期刊政策的变化来考察作者披露利益冲突对同一作者先前发表文章的引用次数的影响。这项分析显示，披露利益冲突会导致文章的引用次数减少。总体而言，我们的证据与其他研究者的观点一致，即其他研究者会对披露了利益冲突的文章进行折扣处理。

abstract.text: US healthcare is undergoing a period of substantial change, with many hospitals vertically integrating with physician practices. Such integration could improve quality by promoting care coordination, but could also worsen it by impacting care delivery. Evidence on how physicians alter their behavior from the changes in financial ownership and the incentive structures of the integrated organizations is scant. We examine Medicare patients treated by gastroenterologists, a specialty with a recent increase in vertical integration. Using a causal model and large-scale patient-level national panel data that include 2.6 million patient visits across 5,488 physicians, we examine changes in various measures of care delivery. We find that physicians significantly alter care processes (e.g., in using anesthesia with deep sedation) after they vertically integrate, and that patients' post-procedure complications increase substantially. We provide evidence that the financial incentive structure of the integrated practices is the main reason for the changes in physician behavior, since it discourages the integrated practices from allocating expensive resources to relatively unprofitable procedures. Although integration improves operational efficiency measured by physicians' throughput, it negatively affects quality and overall spending. We note some potential policy levers through which policymakers could mitigate the negative consequences of vertical integration.

10.3386/w30928.abstractZh: 美国的医疗保健正经历着重大变革，许多医院正在与医生诊所进行垂直整合。这种整合可以通过促进护理协调来提高质量，但也可能通过影响护理服务而降低质量。关于医生在财务所有权和整合组织的激励结构变化下行为变化的证据非常有限。我们研究了由胃肠病学家治疗的Medicare患者，这一专业领域最近出现了垂直整合的趋势。利用因果模型和大规模的患者级全国面板数据，这些数据包含了5,488名医生处理的260万次患者就诊记录，我们研究了护理服务各项指标的变化。我们发现，医生在垂直整合后显著改变了护理流程（例如，在深度镇静麻醉的使用上），并且患者的术后并发症显著增加。我们有证据表明，整合实践中的财务激励结构是医生行为变化的主要原因，因为这种激励结构使得整合实践不愿将昂贵的资源投入到相对不盈利的诊疗项目中。尽管整合提高了医生的运营效率，但它对质量和整体支出产生了负面影响。我们注意到一些可能的政策手段，政策制定者可以通过这些手段来减轻垂直整合带来的负面后果。

abstract.text: This paper estimates consumer demand for firearms with the aim of predicting the likely impacts of firearm regulations on the number and types of guns in circulation. We first conduct a stated-choice-based conjoint analysis and estimate an individual-level demand model for firearms. We validate our estimates using aggregate moments from observational data. Next, we use our estimates to simulate changes in the number and types of guns in circulation under alternative regulations. Importantly, we find that bans or restrictions that specifically target “assault weapons” increase demand for handguns, which are associated with the vast majority of firearm-related violence. We provide distributions of consumer surplus under counterfactuals and discuss how those distributions could be useful for crafting policy.

10.3386/w30934.abstractZh: 本文通过估计消费者对枪支的需求，旨在预测枪支法规对流通中的枪支数量和类型可能产生的影响。我们首先进行基于选择偏好的联合分析，并估算出个人层面的枪支需求模型。我们利用观测数据中的聚合矩来验证我们的估计结果。接下来，我们利用这些估计结果来模拟在不同法规下流通中的枪支数量和类型的变化。重要的是，我们发现专门针对“攻击性武器”的禁令或限制措施会增加对手枪的需求，而手枪与绝大多数与枪支相关的暴力事件有关。我们还提供了在反事实情境下的消费者剩余分布，并讨论了这些分布如何有助于政策制定。

abstract.text: We revisit the cyclical nature of birth rates and infant health and investigate to what extent the relationship between aggregate labor market conditions and birth outcomes is mitigated by the consumption smoothing income assistance delivered through unemployment insurance (UI). We introduce a novel empirical test of standard neoclassical models of fertility that directly tests the prediction of opposite-signed income and intertemporal substitution effects of business cycles by examining the interaction of the aggregate unemployment rate with a measure of potential income replacement from UI. Our results show that as UI benefit generosity reaches 100 percent income replacement, there is no effect of the unemployment rate on fertility rates. This implies that the well-documented cyclical nature of fertility rates is about access to liquidity. We also provide novel evidence that infant health is countercyclical based on timing of conception, but procyclical based on time in utero. The negative relationship between the in utero aggregate unemployment rate and infant health also disappears when potential UI replacement rates reach 100 percent. Our results indicate that the social insurance provided by UI has a pro-natalist effect and improves babies’ health.

10.3386/w30937.abstractZh: 我们重新审视了出生率和婴儿健康的周期性特征，并探讨总体劳动力市场状况与出生结果之间的关系在多大程度上受到失业保险所提供的消费平滑收入援助的缓解。我们引入了一种新的实证测试方法来检验标准新古典生育模型，该测试通过考察总体失业率与失业保险提供的潜在收入替代程度之间的相互作用，直接检验了商业周期对收入正负效应以及跨期替代效应的影响。我们的结果显示，当失业保险的福利水平达到100%的收入替代时，失业率对生育率的影响消失。这表明，生育率的周期性特征主要与流动性获取有关。我们还发现了一些新的证据：婴儿健康状况在受孕时间上呈现反周期性，但在子宫内的时间上则呈现顺周期性。当潜在失业保险替代率达到100%时，子宫内总体失业率与婴儿健康状况之间的负相关关系也会消失。我们的研究结果表明，失业保险所提供的社会保障具有促进生育的效果，并能改善婴儿的健康状况。

abstract.text: The US spends more than 4 trillion dollars per year on health care, largely conducted by private providers and reimbursed by insurers. A major concern in this system is overbilling, waste and fraud by providers, who face incentives to misreport on their claims in order to receive higher payments. In this work, we develop novel machine learning tools to identify providers that overbill insurers. Using large-scale claims data from Medicare, the US federal health insurance program for elderly adults and the disabled, we identify patterns consistent with fraud or overbilling among inpatient hospitalizations. Our proposed approach for fraud detection is fully unsupervised, not relying on any labeled training data, and is explainable to end users, providing reasoning and interpretable insights into the potentially suspicious behavior of the flagged providers. Data from the Department of Justice on providers facing anti-fraud lawsuits and case studies of suspicious providers validate our approach and findings. We also perform a post-analysis to understand hospital characteristics, those not used for detection but associate with a high suspiciousness score. Our method provides an 8-fold lift over random targeting, and can be used to guide investigations and auditing of suspicious providers for both public and private health insurance systems.

10.3386/w30946.abstractZh: 美国每年在医疗保健上的支出超过4万亿美元，这些服务主要由私人机构提供，并由保险公司进行报销。这一体系中的一个主要问题是过度收费、浪费以及医疗服务提供商的欺诈行为。这些机构为了获得更高的支付金额，往往会虚报费用。在这项研究中，我们开发了新颖的机器学习工具来识别向保险公司虚报费用的医疗服务提供者。我们利用来自美国联邦医疗保险计划（针对老年人和残疾人的健康保险计划）的大规模索赔数据，发现了与住院期间欺诈或过度收费相关的模式。我们提出的欺诈检测方法是完全无监督的，不依赖任何标记的训练数据，并且对最终用户来说是可解释的，能够提供关于被标记医疗服务提供者潜在可疑行为的合理性和解释性见解。来自司法部的关于面临欺诈诉讼的医疗服务提供者的数据，以及关于可疑服务提供者的案例研究，验证了我们的方法和发现。我们还进行了后分析，以了解与高可疑性评分相关的医院特征，这些特征并未用于检测。我们的方法比随机目标定位提高了8倍的效果，可以用于指导对可疑服务提供商的调查和审计，适用于公共和私人健康保险系统。

abstract.text: We explore physicians’ role in moderating compliance with recommended vaccinations. Using administrative data on the universe of Danish children and their healthcare providers, we first construct and validate a measure of providers’ propensities to facilitate recommended vaccinations from birth to age 6 based on a two-way fixed effects model. We then show that the measure meaningfully affects uptake of the human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine among adolescent patients and speeds recovery from a media-induced crisis to perceived HPV vaccine safety. Providers affect decisions beyond those of their own patients, influencing the uptake of patients’ younger cousins by one-fifth as much as own patients’ uptake.

10.3386/w30951.abstractZh: 我们探讨了医生在调节疫苗接种依从性方面的作用。利用丹麦儿童及其医疗服务提供者的行政数据，我们首先基于双向固定效应模型构建并验证了一个衡量医疗服务提供者从出生到6岁期间促进疫苗接种倾向的指标。随后我们发现，该指标显著影响了青少年患者接种人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）疫苗的情况，并加速了从媒体引发的危机到对HPV疫苗安全性的认知恢复过程。医疗服务提供者的影响不仅限于其自身患者的决策，还影响了患者较年轻亲属的疫苗接种率，其影响程度相当于自身患者的五分之一。

abstract.text: While the traditional role of insurers is to provide protection against individuals’ idiosyncratic risks, insurers themselves face substantial uncertainties due to aggregate shocks. To prevent insurers from passing these aggregate risks onto consumers, governments have increasingly adopted dynamic pricing regulations, which limit insurers’ ability to change premiums over time. We evaluate dynamic pricing regulation using an equilibrium model of the U.S. long-term care insurance market, featuring insurers’ lack of commitment and endogenous market structures. We find that stricter dynamic pricing regulation has a limited impact on improving consumer welfare, while it reduces insurer profits and increases market concentration.

10.3386/w30952.abstractZh: 虽然保险公司的传统职责是提供对个体特有风险的保障，但保险公司自身也面临着由于整体冲击而产生的重大不确定性。为了防止保险公司将这些整体风险转嫁给消费者，政府越来越多地采用动态定价法规，这限制了保险公司随时间调整保费的能力。我们通过美国长期护理保险市场的均衡模型来评估动态定价法规的影响，该模型考虑了保险公司的非承诺行为以及市场结构的内生性。研究发现，更严格的动态定价法规对改善消费者福利的影响有限，同时会降低保险公司的利润并增加市场集中度。

abstract.text: The causal effects of fertility are a central focus in the social sciences, but the analysis is challenged by the endogeneity of fertility choices. Earlier work has proposed several “natural experiments” from twin births or gender composition of earlier births to assess whether having more children affects adults’ outcomes, though there are limitations to using rare (twins) and weak (gender composition) instrumental variables for fertility. This paper proposes a new “natural experiment” approach to assessing the causal effects of fertility by measuring the combination of couples’ genetics in predicting fertility—a dyadic genetic instrumental variable, where the key idea (exclusion restriction) is that the interactions of the couple’s genetics that shift the likelihood of fertility is unknown to the couples. We use a nationally representative sample of couples to examine the long-lasting effects of fertility on older adults’ life outcomes, including labor market outcomes, personality traits, and subjective wellbeing. We find that fertility reduces females’ extraversion and years of working and some evidence indicates that fertility reduces both males’ and females’ lifetime number of jobs worked.

10.3386/w30955.abstractZh: 生育的因果效应是社会科学中的一个核心话题，但生育选择的内生性问题给分析带来了挑战。早期的研究通过双胞胎出生或早期出生的性别构成等“自然实验”来探讨多子女是否会影响成年人的结果，不过使用罕见（双胞胎）和弱（性别构成）的工具变量存在局限性。本文提出了一种新的“自然实验”方法，通过测量夫妻遗传特征对生育能力的综合影响来评估生育的因果效应——这是一种双元遗传工具变量，其核心思想是夫妻对影响生育可能性的遗传特征之间的相互作用并不知晓。我们采用全国代表性样本来研究生育对老年人生活结果的长期影响，包括劳动力市场状况、人格特质和主观幸福感。研究发现，生育会降低女性的外向性和工作年限，并有证据表明生育会减少男性和女性的工作年限。

abstract.text: Although debates over immigration remain contentious, one important sector served heavily by immigrants faces a critical labor shortage: nursing homes. We merge a variety of data sets on immigration and nursing homes and use a shift-share instrumental variables analysis to assess the impact of increased immigration on nursing home staffing and care quality. We show that increased immigration significantly raises the staffing levels of nursing homes in the U.S., particularly in full time positions. We then show that this has an associated very positive effect on patient outcomes, particularly for those who are short stayers at nursing homes, and particularly for immigration of Hispanic staff.

10.3386/w30960.abstractZh: 尽管关于移民的争论仍然充满争议，但有一个重要行业正面临严重的劳动力短缺问题：养老院。我们整合了关于移民和养老院的各种数据集，并使用转移份额工具变量分析来评估移民增加对养老院人员配置和护理质量的影响。研究表明，移民的增加显著提高了美国养老院的人员配置水平，尤其是全职职位的人员数量。此外，这一变化对患者的治疗效果也有非常积极的影响，尤其是对那些在养老院停留时间较短的患者，尤其是那些来自西班牙裔的移民员工。

abstract.text: Building on prior evidence that mothers often have a stronger preference for spending on children than fathers do, we use a randomized experiment to evaluate the impacts of a communication training program for mothers on child health in Uganda. The hypothesis is that the training will enable women to better convey their knowledge and preferences to their husbands and, thereby, boost investments in children's health. We find that the program increases spousal discussion about the family's health, nutrition, and finances. However, this does not increase overall adoption of health-promoting behaviors or improve child anthropometrics. One exception is that the communication training increases women's and children’s intake of protein-rich foods as well as household spending on these foods.

10.3386/w30962.abstractZh: 基于先前的研究表明，母亲往往比父亲更倾向于在子女身上投入资金，我们采用随机实验来评估针对母亲的沟通培训计划对乌干达儿童健康的影响。我们的假设是，这种培训将使女性能够更好地向丈夫传达自己的知识和偏好，从而增加对儿童健康的投资。我们发现，该计划增加了夫妻之间关于家庭健康、营养和财务方面的讨论。然而，这并没有增加人们采取健康促进行为的整体比例，也没有改善儿童的人体测量数据。不过，沟通培训确实增加了妇女和儿童摄入富含蛋白质的食物，以及家庭在这些食品上的支出。

abstract.text: Using comprehensive U.S. drug claims data, we show that adherence to asthma control medication declined during the COVID-19 pandemic. We find that young children exhibited a 40 percent decrease in adherence by the end of 2020. The responses were less negative for older children and positive for adults. We provide additional evidence that parental attention played a role in driving this decrease, based on heterogeneity by pre-pandemic mail order usage and the number of parental scripts. Policy implications for improving pediatric adherence are discussed.

10.3386/w30968.abstractZh: 通过利用全面的美国药品索赔数据，我们发现，在COVID-19疫情期间，儿童对哮喘控制药物的依从性有所下降。研究发现，到2020年底，幼儿的依从性下降了40%。而较大年龄儿童的依从性下降幅度较小，成人的依从性则有所提升。我们还发现，基于疫情前的邮购用药情况和父母处方数量，父母的关注在导致这一下降中起到了一定作用。文章还讨论了改善儿童用药依从性的政策建议。

abstract.text: Consumer choices are increasingly mediated by algorithms, which use data on those past choices to infer consumer preferences and then curate future choice sets. Behavioral economics suggests one reason these algorithms so often fail: choices can systematically deviate from preferences. For example, research shows that prejudice can arise not just from preferences and beliefs, but also from the context in which people choose. When people behave automatically, biases creep in; snap decisions are typically more prejudiced than slow, deliberate ones, and can lead to behaviors that users themselves do not consciously want or intend. As a result, algorithms trained on automatic behaviors can misunderstand the prejudice of users: the more automatic the behavior, the greater the error. We empirically test these ideas in a lab experiment, and find that more automatic behavior does indeed seem to lead to more biased algorithms. We then explore the large-scale consequences of this idea by carrying out algorithmic audits of Facebook in its two biggest markets, the US and India, focusing on two algorithms that differ in how users engage with them: News Feed (people interact with friends' posts fairly automatically) and People You May Know (people choose friends fairly deliberately). We find significant out-group bias in the News Feed algorithm (e.g., whites are less likely to be shown Black friends' posts, and Muslims less likely to be shown Hindu friends' posts), but no detectable bias in the PYMK algorithm. Together, these results suggest a need to rethink how large-scale algorithms use data on human behavior, especially in online contexts where so much of the measured behavior might be quite automatic.

10.3386/w30981.abstractZh: 消费者的选择越来越多地受到算法的干预，这些算法利用过去的选择数据来推断消费者的偏好，然后为未来的选择提供建议。行为经济学指出，这些算法经常失败的一个原因是，消费者的选择可能会系统性地偏离他们的偏好。例如，研究表明，偏见不仅源于偏好和信念，还源于人们做出选择的情境。当人们的行为是自动化的时，偏见就会逐渐显现；仓促的决定通常比缓慢、深思熟虑的决定更具偏见性，并可能导致用户自己并不想要或无意的行为。因此，基于自动化行为的算法可能会误解用户的偏见：行为越自动化，误差就越大。我们在实验室实验中对这些观点进行了实证测试，发现更自动化的行为确实会导致更偏见的算法。接着，我们通过对Facebook在美国和印度两个最大市场的算法审计，探讨了这一观点的大规模影响，重点关注两种在用户与算法互动方式上有所不同的算法：新闻推送（用户会相当自动地与朋友的文章互动）和“你可能认识的人”（用户会相当刻意地选择朋友）。我们发现新闻推送算法存在显著的群体偏见（例如，白人朋友的文章不太可能被展示给黑人朋友，穆斯林朋友的文章也不太可能被展示给印度教朋友），但PYMK算法则没有检测到明显的偏见。这些结果表明，我们需要重新思考大规模算法如何使用人类行为的数据，尤其是在在线环境中，因为许多被测量的行为可能是自动化的。

abstract.text: This paper examines whether loss of locally available hospital-based obstetric services affects racial/ethnic disparities in intrapartum care access and birth outcomes in rural areas of the US. To conduct causal inference, we combine difference-in-difference and propensity score matching methods to control for observable and time-invariant unobservable heterogeneity across counties. Using data from Vital Statistics birth certificate records from 2005-2018 from rural counties in the mainland US, our empirical analysis reaches several findings. Women in counties that lost obstetric services are more likely to receive intrapartum care outside their counties of residence and to deliver in an urban county compared to women in matched counties. Nonetheless, there are no consistent effects of obstetric unit closure on maternal and infant health in the full sample. Among Black mothers, however, obstetric unit closure is not associated with delivering in an urban county, and there is a more consistent pattern of negative effects of closure on infant health. Importantly, the adoption of scope-of-practice laws for certified nurse midwives, the adoption of telehealth payment parity laws and the ACA Medicaid expansions have implications for narrowing racial/ethnic disparities in health in response to obstetric unit closures.

10.3386/w30986.abstractZh: 本文探讨了失去当地可用的产科服务是否会影响美国农村地区分娩护理的种族/族裔差异以及分娩结果。为了进行因果推断，我们结合了差异分解和倾向得分匹配方法，以控制各县之间可观测且时间不变的不可观测异质性。利用2005-2018年美国大陆农村县的生命统计出生证明数据，我们的实证分析得出了几个结论：失去产科服务的县中的女性更有可能在居住县以外的地区接受分娩护理，并在城市县分娩。然而，在全部样本中，产科单位关闭并未对孕产妇和婴儿健康产生一致的影响。不过，对于黑人母亲来说，产科单位关闭与在城市县分娩无关，且关闭对婴儿健康的负面影响更为明显。重要的是，针对认证护士助产士的执业范围法律、远程医疗支付平等法律以及ACA医疗补助扩展政策，都有助于缩小产科单位关闭后健康方面的种族/族裔差异。

abstract.text: Although yet to be clearly identified as a clinical condition, there is immense concern at the health and wellbeing consequences of long COVID. Using data collected from nearly half a million Americans in the period June 2022-December 2022 in the US Census Bureau’s Household Pulse Survey (HPS), we find 14 percent reported suffering long COVID at some point, half of whom reported it at the time of the survey. It peaks in midlife in the same way as negative affect. Ever having had long COVID is strongly associated with negative affect (anxiety, depression, worry and a lack of interest in things). The effect is larger among those who currently report long COVID, especially if they report severe symptoms. In contrast, those who report having had short COVID report higher wellbeing than those who report never having had COVID. Long COVID is also strongly associated with physical mobility problems, and with problems dressing and bathing. It is also associated with mental problems as indicated by recall and understanding difficulties. Again, the associations are strongest among those who currently report long COVID, while those who said they had had short COVID have fewer physical and mental problems than those who report never having had COVID. Vaccination is associated with lower negative affect, including among those who reported having had long COVID.

10.3386/w30988.abstractZh: 尽管长新冠尚未被明确认定为一种临床病症，但其对健康的危害仍引发极大担忧。根据美国人口普查局在2022年6月至2022年12月期间对近50万美国人进行的家庭脉搏调查数据，14%的人表示曾在某个时期患有长新冠，其中一半人在调查时就已经出现症状。长新冠的影响在中年时期最为明显，这与负面情绪的表现方式相似。曾经患过长新冠的人，其负面情绪（如焦虑、抑郁、担忧以及对事物的兴趣缺失）更为严重。对于那些目前报告患有长新冠的人来说，这种影响更为显著，尤其是那些症状严重的患者。相比之下，那些报告曾患过短新冠的人，其健康状况比从未感染过新冠的人要好。长新冠还与身体活动能力问题、穿衣和洗澡方面的困难密切相关。此外，它还与心理问题有关，表现为记忆和理解方面的困难。同样，这些关联在目前报告患有长新冠的人中最为明显，而那些曾患过短新冠的人，其身体和心理健康问题相对较少。接种疫苗与较低的负面情绪相关，包括那些报告曾患过长新冠的人。

abstract.text: Governments in many low- and middle-income countries are developing health insurance products as a complement to tax-funded, subsidized provision of health care through publicly operated facilities. This paper discusses two rationales for this transition. First, health insurance would boost fiscal revenues for health care, as post-treatment out-of-pocket payments to providers would be replaced by pre-treatment insurance premia to health ministries. Second, increased patient choice and carefully designed physician reimbursements would increase quality in the health care sector. This essay shows that, at best, these objectives have only been partially met. Despite evidence that health insurance has provided financial protection, consumers are not willing to pay for unsubsidized premia. Health outcomes have not improved despite an increase in utilization. We argue that this is not because there was no room to improve the quality of care but because behavioral responses among health care providers have systematically undermined the objectives of these insurance schemes.

10.3386/w30996.abstractZh: 许多低收入和中等收入国家的政府正在开发健康保险产品，作为对通过公共设施提供的税收资助和补贴医疗服务的补充。本文讨论了这一转变的两个理由。首先，健康保险能够增加医疗服务的财政收入，因为患者治疗后的自付费用将被保险保费替代，这些保费将支付给卫生部。其次，增加患者的选择权和精心设计的医生报销机制将提高医疗服务的质量。然而，本文指出，这些目标最多只能部分实现。尽管有证据表明健康保险提供了财务保障，但消费者并不愿意支付未补贴的保费。尽管使用率有所提高，但医疗结果并未改善。我们认为，这并不是因为无法提高护理质量，而是因为医疗服务提供者的行为反应系统性地削弱了这些保险计划的目标。

abstract.text: This paper provides the first quantitative economic models of pharmacy benefit management regulation. The price-theoretic models allow for various market frictions and imperfections including market power, coordination costs, tax distortions, and incomplete innovation incentives. A rigorous economic interpretation is provided for what are sometimes called “rebate walls” or “rebate traps.” Applicable types of regulation include rebate rules, such as the HHS rebate rule and the Insulin Act; disclosure requirements such as the PBM Transparency Act of 2023; and pharmacy contract restrictions such as the CMS Medicare rule to take effect in 2024. Utilization of brands and generics, plan spending, cost sharing, spillovers to nonpharmacy medical spending, government budgets, and the pace of drug innovation are among the outcomes tracked by the open-source model.

10.3386/w30998.abstractZh: 本文首次提出了关于药品福利管理监管的定量经济模型。价格理论模型能够考虑各种市场摩擦与缺陷，包括市场力量、协调成本、税收扭曲以及创新激励的不完善性。文章对所谓的“返利壁垒”或“返利陷阱”进行了严谨的经济学解释。适用的监管类型包括返利规则，如美国卫生与公共服务部的返利规则以及《胰岛素法案》；信息披露要求，如2023年的PBM透明度法案；以及药品合同限制，如将于2024年生效的CMS医疗保险规则。开源模型追踪了品牌与仿制药的使用情况、计划支出、费用分担、对非药品医疗支出的影响、政府预算，以及药品创新的步伐等结果。

abstract.text: With count-valued outcomes y in {0,1,...,M} identification and estimation of average treatment effects raise no special considerations beyond those involved in the continuous-outcome case. If partial identification of the distribution of treatment effects is of interest, however, count-valued outcomes present some subtle yet important considerations beyond those involved in continuous-outcome contexts. This paper derives appropriate bounds on the distribution of treatment effects for count-valued outcomes.

10.3386/w31005.abstractZh: 对于计数型结果y属于{0,1,...,M}的情况，平均处理效应的识别与估计并不比连续型结果的情况需要更多的特殊考虑。然而，如果关注处理效应分布的部分识别问题，计数型结果则涉及一些微妙但重要的考虑因素。本文为计数型结果的处理效应分布推导出了适当的界限。

abstract.text: While hypothesis testing is a highly formalized activity, hypothesis generation remains largely informal. We propose a systematic procedure to generate novel hypotheses about human behavior, which uses the capacity of machine learning algorithms to notice patterns people might not. We illustrate the procedure with a concrete application: judge decisions about who to jail. We begin with a striking fact: The defendant’s face alone matters greatly for the judge’s jailing decision. In fact, an algorithm given only the pixels in the defendant’s mugshot accounts for up to half of the predictable variation. We develop a procedure that allows human subjects to interact with this black-box algorithm to produce hypotheses about what in the face influences judge decisions. The procedure generates hypotheses that are both interpretable and novel: They are not explained by demographics (e.g. race) or existing psychology research; nor are they already known (even if tacitly) to people or even experts. Though these results are specific, our procedure is general. It provides a way to produce novel, interpretable hypotheses from any high-dimensional dataset (e.g. cell phones, satellites, online behavior, news headlines, corporate filings, and high-frequency time series). A central tenet of our paper is that hypothesis generation is in and of itself a valuable activity, and hope this encourages future work in this largely “pre-scientific” stage of science.

10.3386/w31017.abstractZh: 虽然假设检验是一种高度形式化的活动，但假设生成仍然在很大程度上是非正式的过程。我们提出了一种系统性的方法来生成关于人类行为的创新假设，该方法利用机器学习算法识别人们可能忽略的模式。我们通过一个具体案例来说明这一方法：对谁应该被监禁的决策。我们首先注意到一个显著的事实：被告的面部特征对法官的监禁决定起着至关重要的作用。实际上，仅根据被告照片中的像素，算法就能解释高达一半的可预测差异。我们开发了一种方法，让人类参与者与这个黑盒算法互动，以产生关于面部特征如何影响法官决策的假设。这些方法生成的假设既具有解释性，又具有创新性：它们无法用人口统计数据（如种族）或现有的心理学研究来解释；它们也不是人们或专家所已知的（即使是无意识的）。尽管这些结果是具体的，但我们的方法具有通用性。它提供了一种从任何高维数据集中生成创新且可解释假设的方法（例如手机、卫星、在线行为、新闻标题、企业报告以及高频时间序列数据）。我们论文的核心观点是，假设生成本身就是一个有价值的活动，希望这能鼓励未来在这一仍处于“前科学”阶段的领域进行的研究。

abstract.text: In agreements settling patent challenges in the drug industry, the plaintiff brand commonly licenses the defendant generic to sell prior to patent expiry. Some agreements require the generic to pay the brand royalties. Despite the superficial flow of profits, royalty terms may function as part of an anticompetitive “reverse payment” made to the generic in exchange for delayed entry. Typically, the brand launches its own authorized generic (AG) during the first-to-file generic’s 180-day exclusivity period so there are two initial generic competitors. A royalty structure that deters the brand’s AG launch reduces the number of entrants to one, conveying net value to the generic and potentially inducing it to delay its entry. Our simple model shows that royalties usually have no place in a brand-generic agreement between rational actors. However, when royalties are conditioned on the brand’s AG launch, a range of royalty rates exists that both conveys net value to the generic and deters the brand from rationally introducing an AG. Declining royalty terms in a brand’s settlement with a first-to-file generic thus raise a red flag that the agreement is a pay-for-delay. Although the numbers are small, empirical analysis based on publicly available materials corroborates this conclusion.

10.3386/w31018.abstractZh: 在解决药品行业专利纠纷的协议中，原告品牌通常会授权被告仿制药在专利到期前销售。某些协议要求仿制药向品牌支付特许权使用费。尽管这种利润分配看似简单，但特许权使用费条款实际上可能构成一种反竞争性的“反向支付”，即仿制药因延迟进入市场而获得利益。通常，品牌会在首家提交仿制药的180天独占期内推出自己的授权仿制药，因此最初会有两个竞争仿制药。如果特许权使用费结构阻碍品牌推出授权仿制药，那么进入市场的竞争者就会减少到一个，从而使仿制药获得净收益，并可能促使其延迟进入市场。我们的简单模型表明，在理性行为者的品牌与仿制药协议中，通常不应存在特许权使用费。然而，当特许权使用费与品牌推出授权仿制药挂钩时，就会存在一系列特许权使用费率，这些费率既能为仿制药带来净收益，又能阻止品牌理性地推出授权仿制药。因此，品牌在与首家提交仿制药的协议中降低特许权使用费，就表明该协议是一种“支付代价以延迟进入市场”的安排。虽然金额不大，但基于公开资料进行的实证分析也证实了这一结论。

abstract.text: We uncover substantial interregional trade in medical services and investigate the contribution of regional increasing returns. In Medicare, one-fifth of production involves a doctor treating a patient from another region. Larger regions produce greater quantity, quality, and variety of medical services, which they “export” to patients from elsewhere, especially smaller regions. We estimate regional quality based on patients’ travel choices, and these revealed-preference estimates align with clinical outcomes. Demographic-based instruments and a case study show that greater local demand increases quality and exports, consistent with economies of scale. We study counterfactual policies that lower travel costs rather than relocating production.

10.3386/w31030.abstractZh: 我们发现了医疗服务领域的显著区域间贸易现象，并研究了区域规模经济效应的贡献。在医疗保险体系中，五分之一的生产活动涉及医生为来自其他地区的患者提供医疗服务。规模较大的区域能够生产更多、更高质量、更多样化的医疗服务，并将其“出口”给来自其他地区的患者，尤其是规模较小的区域。我们通过患者的出行选择来估算区域医疗服务质量，这些基于偏好揭示的估算结果与临床效果一致。基于人口统计的模型和案例研究表明，更高的本地需求能够提升医疗服务质量和出口量，这与规模经济的效应是一致的。我们还研究了能够降低出行成本而非转移生产的反事实政策。

abstract.text: Do different patient choices reflect what they value or what they know? We study this question using variation created by rounded star ratings for GP practices, which changes the information about providers that patients can publicly observe. Differences in the demand response to these ratings indicate that some groups—notably high-income patients—are better informed about provider quality. We develop an empirical demand model that allows both information and preferences to vary across patients and find that heterogeneity in choice overwhelmingly reflects differences in information. Standard full-information demand models underestimate the gains from improving providers by more than 50%, and fail to capture the incidence of those gains. Low-income and other low-information groups benefit substantially from such improvements even when their observed demand for highly-rated GPs is weak.

10.3386/w31033.abstractZh: 不同的患者选择是否反映了他们的价值观或认知？我们通过使用圆形星级评分来研究这一问题，这种评分方式改变了患者能够公开了解的信息。对评分的反应差异表明，某些群体——尤其是高收入患者——对医疗服务提供者质量的了解更为充分。我们开发了一个实证需求模型，该模型允许信息和偏好在患者之间有所不同，并发现选择的差异主要反映了信息上的差异。标准的完全信息需求模型低估了改善医疗服务所带来的收益，低估幅度超过50%，并且未能捕捉到这些收益的实际发生情况。即使低收入和其他信息匮乏的群体对高评分医疗服务提供者的需求较弱，他们仍然可以从这样的改进中获得显著的好处。

abstract.text: We examine the transmission of lifespan across generations using a unique dataset containing more than 26 million individuals born between 1880 and 1920. We document new facts about the absolute and relative mobility in lifespan. On average across cohorts, 47% of men and 57 percent of women lived longer than their parents, though this varied across cohorts. Relative measures show higher mobility, with substantially less variation across time and subpopulations. The intergenerational correlation in lifespan (a measure of persistence rather than mobility) is about 0.09 for both sexes – this low correlation is observed across races, education groups, cohorts, and birth states. Finally, we document that the intergenerational persistence of lifespan is much smaller than the persistence in socio-economic status. Moreover, correlations in lifespan and in education are largely independent of each other, suggesting that mobility in well-being may be larger than measures of income alone suggest.

10.3386/w31034.abstractZh: 我们使用一个包含超过2600万人的独特数据集，研究了寿命在代际间的传递情况。这些个体出生于1880年至1920年间。我们发现，在绝对和相对意义上，寿命的流动性存在差异。总体而言，47%的男性寿命比其父母长，57%的女性寿命也更长，不过这一比例在不同队列中有所不同。相对流动性指标显示，寿命的流动性更高，且在不同时间和子群体间的差异较小。在代际间，寿命的持续性相关性约为0.09，这一数值在性别、教育群体、队列和出生地等方面都保持一致。最后，我们发现，寿命的代际持续性远小于社会经济地位的持续性。此外，寿命与教育状况之间的相关性在很大程度上是独立的，这表明福祉的流动性可能比单纯的收入指标所显示的更为显著。

abstract.text: The Medicare hospice program is intended to provide palliative care to terminal patients, but patients with long stays in hospice are highly profitable, motivating concerns about overuse among the Alzheimer’s and Dementia (ADRD) population in the rapidly growing for-profit sector. We provide the first causal estimates of the effect of for-profit hospice on patient spending using the entry of for-profit hospices over twenty years. We find hospice has saved money for Medicare by offsetting other expensive care among ADRD patients. As a result, policies limiting hospice use including revenue caps and anti-fraud lawsuits are distortionary and deter cost-saving admissions.

10.3386/w31035.abstractZh: Medicare临终关怀计划旨在为临终患者提供姑息治疗，但长期入住临终关怀的患者往往能够获得高额收益，这引发了人们对在快速发展的营利性行业中阿尔茨海默病及痴呆症患者过度使用临终关怀的担忧。我们通过分析二十年来营利性临终关怀机构的设立情况，首次对营利性临终关怀对患者支出的影响进行了因果分析。研究发现，临终关怀通过替代其他昂贵的护理服务，为Medicare节省了资金。因此，限制临终关怀使用的政策，包括收入上限和反欺诈诉讼，实际上会扭曲医疗资源的分配，并阻碍患者寻求成本节约的医疗服务。

abstract.text: The United Nations Human Development Index (HDI) is arguably the most widely used alternative to gross domestic product for measuring national development. This is in large part due to its multidimensional nature, as it incorporates not only income, but also education and health. However, the country-level resolution of the global HDI data released by the Human Development Report Office of the United Nations Development Programme (N=191 countries) has limited its use at the local level. Recent efforts used survey data to produce HDI estimates for first-level administrative units (e.g., states/provinces). Here, we build on recent advances in machine learning and satellite imagery to develop the first global estimates of HDI for second-level administrative units (e.g., municipalities/counties, N = 61,530) and for a global 0.1° × 0.1° grid (N=819,309). To accomplish this we develop and validate a generalizable downscaling technique based on satellite imagery that allows for training and prediction with observations of arbitrary shape and size. This enables us to train a model using provincial administrative data and generate HDI estimates at the municipality and grid levels. Our results indicate that more than half of the global population was previously assigned to the incorrect HDI quintile within each country, due to aggregation bias resulting from lower resolution estimates. We also illustrate how these data can improve decision-making. We make these high-resolution HDI estimates publicly available in the hope that they increase understanding of human wellbeing globally and improve the effectiveness of policies supporting sustainable development. We also make available the satellite features necessary to increase the spatial resolution of any other administrative data that is detectable via imagery.

10.3386/w31044.abstractZh: 联合国人类发展指数（HDI）可以说是衡量国家发展的另一种广泛使用的指标，仅次于国内生产总值。这主要得益于其多维度特性，因为它不仅包含收入数据，还涵盖了教育与健康方面的指标。然而，联合国开发计划署人类发展报告办公室发布的全球人类发展指数数据在国家级层面的解析，限制了其在地方层面的应用。近期的研究利用调查数据，为一级行政单位（如州/省）提供了人类发展指数估计值。在此基础上，我们结合机器学习和卫星图像技术的最新进展，首次为二级行政单位（如市镇/县，共61,530个）以及全球0.1°×0.1°的网格区域（共819,309个）提供了全球范围的人类发展指数估计值。为此，我们开发并验证了一种基于卫星图像的通用降尺度技术，该技术能够使用任意形状和大小的观测数据进行训练和预测。这使得我们能够利用省级行政数据训练模型，并在市镇和网格级别生成人类发展指数估计值。我们的研究结果表明，由于低分辨率估计导致的汇总偏差，每个国家中超过一半的人口被错误地划分到了错误的人类发展指数五分位数中。我们还展示了这些数据如何有助于改进决策过程。我们希望将这些高分辨率的人类发展指数估计值公开提供，从而增进全球对人类福祉的理解，并提升支持可持续发展的政策效果。此外，我们还提供了通过卫星图像可检测到的其他行政数据的空间分辨率提升所需的卫星特征。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of COVID-19 vaccination on food insufficiency in the United States, using data from the Household Pulse Survey. Our primary research design exploits variation in vaccine eligibility across states over time as an instrumental variable to address the endogeneity of vaccination decision. We find that vaccination had a substantial impact on food hardship by reducing the likelihood of food insufficiency by 24%, with even stronger effects among minority and financially disadvantaged populations. These results are robust to alternative specifications and the use of regression discontinuity as an alternative identification strategy. We also show that vaccine eligibility had a positive spillover impact on food assistance programs, notably reducing participation in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program and the use of its benefits, suggesting that vaccination policies can help alleviate the government’s fiscal burden during public health crises. Our analysis offers detailed insights into the potential mechanisms linking vaccination to food insufficiency. We demonstrate that vaccination yields changes in both material circumstances and financial expectations. Specifically, vaccination increases the use of regular income for spending needs and reduces reports of insufficient food due to unaffordability. Additionally, we find that vaccination improves financial optimism, reflected in expectations for future employment income loss and the ability to meet mortgage and debt obligations. Our findings are consistent with the notion that this optimism, along with labor market recovery, diminished the need for precautionary savings, reduced reliance on government assistance, and encouraged household spending on essential goods like food, ultimately lowering food insufficiency.

10.3386/w31045.abstractZh: 本文利用家庭脉搏调查的数据，探讨了COVID-19疫苗接种对美国粮食不足的影响。我们的主要研究设计利用各州随时间变化的疫苗接种资格差异作为工具变量，以解决疫苗接种决策的内生性问题。研究发现，疫苗接种对粮食困难的影响显著，将粮食不足的可能性降低了24%，在少数族裔和财务困难群体中这种影响更为明显。这些结果在采用其他模型设定和回归不连续法作为识别策略时依然成立。我们还发现，疫苗接种资格对粮食援助计划产生了积极的溢出效应，特别是减少了补充营养援助计划的参与度和对其福利的使用，这表明疫苗接种政策可以在公共卫生危机期间帮助减轻政府的财政负担。我们的分析提供了关于疫苗接种与粮食不足之间潜在机制的具体见解。我们发现，疫苗接种既改变了物质状况，也改变了财务预期。具体而言，疫苗接种增加了将常规收入用于生活需求的程度，并减少了因经济困难而报告粮食不足的情况。此外，我们还发现，疫苗接种提高了财务乐观情绪，这体现在对未来就业收入损失以及履行抵押贷款和债务义务的预期上。我们的研究结果与以下观点一致：这种乐观情绪以及劳动力市场的复苏，减少了预防性储蓄的需求，降低了对政府援助的依赖，并鼓励家庭在食品等必需品上的支出，最终降低了粮食不足的情况。

abstract.text: Health plan payment systems with community-rated premiums typically include risk adjustment, risk sharing or both to compensate insurers for predictable profits (on young and healthy people) and predictable losses (on the elderly and chronically ill). This paper shows how a payment system based only on risk sharing (like in Australia), is improved by combining risk sharing with risk adjustment. Using Australia’s private health insurance market as a case study, we compare and assess the current risk sharing based payment system against alternative systems which combine risk adjustment and risk sharing. Specifically, we develop outcome measures to compare the models in terms of incentives for risk selection and incentives for cost control. We find that a payment system composed of risk adjustment based on simple risk-adjustor variables, supplemented with outlier risk sharing outperforms the current system based solely on risk sharing. Our results show that as more and better data become available, reliance on risk sharing can be reduced whilst the use of risk adjustment can be expanded. In an additional analysis, we show that changes in the payment system affect the redistribution of claims costs across different levels of coverage. We discuss qualitatively additional measures that can be taken to achieve the desired level of redistribution.

10.3386/w31052.abstractZh: 以社区评级保费为基础的医疗计划支付系统通常包含风险调整、风险分担或两者结合，以补偿保险公司因年轻健康人群带来的可预测收益以及老年人和慢性病患者带来的可预测损失。本文展示了仅基于风险分担的支付系统（如澳大利亚的体系）如何通过结合风险调整来改进。以澳大利亚的私人健康保险市场为案例研究，我们对比并评估了当前基于风险分担的支付系统与结合风险调整与风险分担的替代系统。具体来说，我们开发了结果指标，以比较这些模型在风险选择激励和成本控制激励方面的表现。研究发现，基于简单风险调整变量的风险调整系统，辅以异常风险分担机制，其表现优于仅基于风险分担的当前系统。我们的结果表明，随着更多、更好的数据变得可用，可以减少对风险分担的依赖，同时扩大风险调整的应用范围。在另一项分析中，我们展示了支付系统的变化如何影响不同保险等级之间的索赔成本分配。我们还讨论了为实现期望的再分配水平可以采取的额外措施。

abstract.text: We study the association between infectious disease prevalence and income inequality. We hypothesize that random social mixing in an income-unequal society brings into contact a) susceptible and infected poor and b) the infected-poor and the susceptible-rich, raising infectious disease prevalence. We investigate this association by examining whether countries with elevated levels of income inequality have higher rates of pulmonary Tuberculosis (TB) incidence per capita. We analyzed publicly available country-level panel data for a large cross-section of countries between 1995 and 2013. A “negative control” using anemia (a non-communicable disease, and hence impervious to the hypothesized mechanism) is also applied. We find that elevated levels of income inequality were positively associated with tuberculosis prevalence. All else equal, countries with income-Gini coefficients 10% apart are a statistically significant 4% different in tuberculosis incidence. Income inequality had a null effect on anemia, the negative control. Our cross-country regression results suggest that income inequality may create conditions where TB spreads more easily.

10.3386/w31053.abstractZh: 我们研究了传染病发病率与收入不平等之间的关联。我们假设，在收入不平等的社会中，随机的社会交往使得a)易感的贫困人群与b)感染者的贫困人群以及易感的富裕人群接触，从而增加了传染病的发病率。我们通过分析收入不平等程度较高的国家的人均肺结核发病率来研究这一关联。我们使用了1995年至2013年间大量国家的公开数据。同时，我们还使用了贫血这一“负控制变量”（一种非传染性疾病，因此不受假设机制的影响）。研究发现，收入不平等程度的增加与肺结核发病率呈正相关。在其他条件相同的情况下，收入基尼系数相差10%的国家，肺结核发病率相差4%。收入不平等对贫血这一负控制变量没有显著影响。我们的跨国回归结果表明，收入不平等可能会创造有利于结核病传播的条件。

abstract.text: We study a difference-in-differences (DiD) framework where groups experience unequal treatment statuses in the pre-policy change period. This approach is commonly employed in empirical studies but it contradicts the canonical model's assumptions. We show that in such settings, the standard DiD approach fails to recover the average treatment effect (ATT), unless the treatment effect is immediate and constant over time. Furthermore, the usual parallel trends test is invalid, meaning one may find pre-trends when the parallel trends assumption holds, and vice versa. We discuss two solutions. First, we show that including a linear term trend will recover the ATT if the differences in trends are constant over time (both in unequal baseline and canonical DiD settings) but not otherwise. Second, estimation in reverse also recovers the ATT if the potential outcomes do not depend on past treatments and post-policy statuses are converging.

10.3386/w31063.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个差异-差异（DiD）框架，其中各组在政策变更前的时期面临不平等的待遇状况。这种方法在实证研究中常被采用，但它与经典模型的假设相矛盾。我们指出，在这种情况下，标准的DiD方法无法恢复平均处理效应（ATT），除非处理效应是即时且随时间保持不变的。此外，通常使用的平行趋势检验是无效的，这意味着当平行趋势假设成立时，可能会发现前期趋势，反之亦然。我们提出了两种解决方案。首先，我们表明，如果趋势差异随时间保持不变（无论是在不平等基线还是经典DiD设置中），那么包含线性趋势项将能够恢复ATT，但在其他情况下则无法做到。其次，如果潜在结果不依赖于过去的处理，且政策后的状态趋于一致，那么逆向估计也能恢复ATT。

abstract.text: We describe how the COVID-19 pandemic affected reproductive choices in New York City, the most acutely impacted area of the United States. We contrast changes in New York City with reproductive outcomes in the rest of the US. We find that births to New York City residents fell 8.4% more between March, 2020 and February 2021 than that would have been expected given trends leading up to the pandemic. Births to US-born residents of New York City fell 5.5% over the same year, triple the observed decline in the rest of the US. Births to foreign-born New York City residents fell 11.4%, twice the decline observed in the rest of the US. Reported induced abortions to New York City residents fell precipitously whereas induced abortions nation-wide rose slightly. The acute downturn and robust recovery in births in New York City maps closely with the spike in mortality and its equally rapid decline three months later. We conclude that the fear and uncertainty in the early months of the pandemic is the best explanation for the sudden, but brief drop in births in New York City.

10.3386/w31070.abstractZh: 我们描述了COVID-19大流行如何影响了纽约市的生育选择，纽约市是美国受疫情影响最严重的地区。我们将纽约市的变化与美国其他地区的生育结果进行了对比。我们发现，2020年3月至2021年2月期间，纽约市居民的出生数量比疫情前的趋势预计减少了8.4%。同期，纽约市美国出生的居民出生数量减少了5.5%，是美国其他地区下降幅度的三倍。而纽约市外国出生的居民出生数量减少了11.4%，是美国其他地区下降幅度的两倍。纽约市居民的自杀流产数量急剧下降，而全国范围内的自杀流产数量则略有上升。纽约市出生数量的急剧下降和迅速恢复，与死亡率的急剧上升及其三个月后的迅速下降密切相关。我们得出结论，疫情初期出现的恐惧和不确定性是纽约市出生数量突然但短暂下降的最佳解释。

abstract.text: Over half of the U.S. population receives health insurance through an employer, with employer premium contributions creating a flat "head tax" per worker, independent of their earnings. This paper develops and calibrates a stylized model of the labor market to explore how this uniquely American approach to financing health insurance contributes to labor market inequality. We consider a partial-equilibrium counterfactual in which employer-provided health insurance is instead financed by a statutory payroll tax on firms. We find that, under this counterfactual financing, in 2019 the college wage premium would have been 11 percent lower, non-college annual earnings would have been $1,700 (3 percent) higher, and non-college employment would have been nearly 500,000 higher. These calibrated labor market effects of switching from head-tax to payroll-tax financing are in the same ballpark as estimates of the impact of other leading drivers of labor market inequality, including changes in outsourcing, robot adoption, rising trade, unionization, and the real minimum wage. We also consider a separate partial-equilibrium counterfactual in which the current head-tax financing is maintained, but 2019 U.S. health care spending as a share of GDP is reduced to the Canadian share; here, we estimate that the 2019 college wage premium would have been 5 percent lower and non-college annual earnings would have been 5 percent higher. These findings suggest that health care costs and the financing of health insurance warrant greater attention in both public policy and research on U.S. labor market inequality.

10.3386/w31091.abstractZh: 美国超过一半的人口通过雇主获得健康保险，雇主的保费贡献形成了一种固定的“人头税”，这种税与个人的收入无关。本文开发并校准了一个简化的劳动力市场模型，以探讨这种独特的美国健康保险融资方式如何导致劳动力市场的不平等。我们考虑了一个部分均衡的反事实情景，即雇主提供的健康保险由企业缴纳的法定工资税来融资。研究发现，在这种反事实融资下，2019年大学毕业生的工资溢价将降低11%，非大学毕业生的年收入将增加3%，而非大学毕业生的就业人数将增加近50万。这种从人头税转向工资税融资的劳动力市场效应，与其他主要导致劳动力市场不平等的因素的影响相当，包括外包的变化、机器人技术的采用、贸易的上升、工会化以及实际最低工资的变化。我们还考虑了一个单独的部分均衡反事实情景，即维持当前的人头税融资方式，但2019年美国医疗保健支出占GDP的比例降低到加拿大水平；在这种情况下，我们估计2019年大学毕业生的工资溢价将降低5%，非大学毕业生的年收入将增加5%。这些发现表明，医疗保健成本和健康保险的融资方式值得在公共政策和关于美国劳动力市场不平等的研究中给予更多关注。

abstract.text: Many states have recently changed their scope of practice laws and granted full practice authority to nurse practitioners, allowing them to practice without oversight from physicians. Physician groups have argued against this change, citing patient safety concerns. In this paper, we use a ratio-in-ratio approach to evaluate whether the transition to full practice authority results in harm to patients as proxied by rates of malpractice payouts and adverse action reports against nurse practitioners. We find no evidence of such harm, and instead find that physicians may benefit from the law change in terms of reduced malpractice payouts against them.

10.3386/w31109.abstractZh: 许多州最近修改了执业范围相关法律，授予护士执业者完全的执业权，使其能够无需医生监督即可执业。医生团体则反对这一变化，认为这会对患者安全造成威胁。在本文中，我们采用比率-比率方法评估向完全执业权转变是否会对患者造成伤害，具体通过医疗事故赔偿金额和针对护士执业者的不良行为报告数量来反映。我们发现没有证据表明这种转变会对患者造成伤害，相反，我们发现医生可能会因减少针对他们的医疗事故赔偿而从中受益。

abstract.text: The COVID-19 pandemic caused significant disruption in schooling in the U.S., and student test scores showed dramatic declines by the end of the 2020-21 school year. We use state test score data to analyze patterns of test score recovery over the 2021-22 school year. On average, we find that 20% of test score losses are recovered in English language arts (ELA) by 2022, compared to 37% in math. These recovery rates do not significantly vary across demographic characteristics, baseline achievement rates, in-person schooling rates in the pandemic school year, or category-based measures of recovery funding allocations. We observe large state-level variation in recovery rates in ELA – from full recovery to further losses. This evidence suggests state-level factors play an important role in students' academic recovery, but we are unable to isolate particular state factors. Future work should focus on this variation to facilitate a broader recovery effort.

10.3386/w31113.abstractZh: COVID-19疫情对美国的教育体系造成了严重破坏，到2020-21学年末，学生的考试成绩出现了显著下降。我们利用各州的考试成绩数据来分析2021-22学年的成绩恢复情况。平均而言，我们发现英语语言艺术科目的考试成绩有20%在2022年得到了恢复，而数学科目的恢复率则达到了37%。这些恢复率在不同人口特征、基线成绩水平、疫情期间是否进行面对面教学，以及基于类别的恢复资金分配方面并没有显著差异。我们观察到各州在英语语言艺术科目成绩恢复率上存在较大差异——从完全恢复到进一步下降不等。这些证据表明，州级因素在学生的学业恢复过程中起着重要作用，但我们未能确定具体的州级因素。未来的研究应关注这种差异，以推动更广泛的恢复工作。

abstract.text: The national hepatitis C elimination initiative provides an opportunity to dramatically expand access to hepatitis C virus (HCV) treatment and put the US on a path to eliminating hepatitis C. Our objective was to project the health benefits and cost savings of this initiative. A previously developed mathematical model was updated to simulate trends in HCV disease burden and cost of care in the US for the next 20 years under status quo and national hepatitis C elimination initiative. Within five years, the initiative will diagnose 92.5% of all persons with HCV and cure 89.6% of HCV infection. Over 10 years, compared with the status quo, the initiative will avert 20,000 cases of hepatocellular carcinoma, 49,100 cases of diabetes, and 25,000 cases of chronic kidney disease. The initiative will also avert 24,000 deaths adding 220,000 life years. These benefits in improved health will save $18.1 billion in direct healthcare spending, of which $13.3 billion would accrue to the federal government. Over 20 years, the health benefits would increase by more than 2-fold and cost savings by 3-fold. The cost savings would further increase if the HCV incidence rate decreases because of rapid decline in HCV prevalence. In conclusion, the national hepatitis C elimination initiative would substantially reduce HCV-related morbidity and mortality and would reduce healthcare spending at 10 years and beyond.

10.3386/w31139.abstractZh: 国家丙型肝炎消除计划为大幅扩大丙型肝炎病毒（HCV）治疗的可及性提供了机会，使美国能够走上消除丙型肝炎的道路。我们的目标是预测这一计划带来的健康效益和成本节约效果。先前开发的数学模型被更新，以模拟在现状和国家丙型肝炎消除计划下，未来20年美国HCV疾病负担和护理成本的趋势。在五年内，该计划将诊断92.5%的HCV感染者，并治愈89.6%的HCV感染病例。在10年内，与现状相比，该计划将避免20,000例肝细胞癌、49,100例糖尿病和25,000例慢性肾脏疾病。此外，该计划还将避免24,000例死亡，增加220,000个生命年。这些改善健康的效益将节省181亿美元的直接医疗支出，其中133亿美元将归联邦政府所有。在20年内，健康效益将增加两倍以上，成本节约将增加三倍。如果HCV发病率因HCV流行率的迅速下降而降低，成本节约将进一步增加。总之，国家丙型肝炎消除计划将大幅减少与HCV相关的发病率和死亡率，并在10年后及以后降低医疗支出。

abstract.text: Many public programs let individuals choose between publicly provided benefits and a subsidized private alternative. We investigate the determinants of health insurance choice in Medicare—a setting with vast geographic variation in the share of individuals selecting the public option versus private alternative. We analyze insurance decisions among individuals who move to quantify the relative importance of individual-specific factors (such as preferences or income) and place-specific factors (such as local health insurance options) on insurance decisions. We find roughly 40% of the geographic variation in the share selecting private coverage is due to place-based factors, while the remainder is explained by individuals. Our findings highlight the importance of individual factors in these decisions and may inform discussions about the use of policy to address geographic disparities.

10.3386/w31141.abstractZh: 许多公共项目允许个人在公共提供的福利和补贴的私人选择之间做出选择。我们研究了医疗保险中健康保险选择的决定因素——这一领域在地理分布上存在巨大差异，即不同地区的个人选择公共选项或私人选项的比例各不相同。我们通过分析迁移过程中的保险决策，来量化个体特定因素（如偏好或收入）与地点特定因素（如当地的健康保险选项）对保险决策的影响。我们发现，大约40%的地理差异是由于地点因素造成的，其余部分则是由个体因素导致的。我们的研究结果强调了个体因素在这些决策中的重要性，并可能为讨论如何利用政策解决地理差异问题提供参考。

abstract.text: Despite efforts to address the opioid crisis, opioid-related overdoses remain a significant contributor to mortality. State efforts to reduce overdose deaths by removing barriers to naloxone have recently focused on pharmacy channels, but the specifics of these laws and the contexts in which they are implemented vary widely. In this paper, we use novel methods robust to heterogeneous effects across states and time-varying policy effects to estimate the effects on naloxone pharmacy distribution of two types of laws: laws authorizing non-patient-specific prescription distribution of naloxone and laws granting pharmacists prescriptive authority for naloxone. We find that both types of laws significantly increase the volume of naloxone dispensed through pharmacies. However, relative to laws authorizing non-patient-specific prescription distribution, effects are significantly larger for pharmacist prescriptive authority laws. These larger effects only partially derive from increased naloxone prescribing by pharmacists. We also estimate large, significant increases in pharmacy dispensation of naloxone prescribed by non-pharmacist prescribers, with particularly large increases among family medicine physicians, with particularly large increases among family medicine physicians. The relative benefits of pharmacist prescriptive authority laws versus non-patient-specific distribution are larger among Non-Hispanic Black individuals, suggesting an important role of these policies for reducing disparities in access to naloxone.

10.3386/w31142.abstractZh: 尽管人们努力应对阿片类药物危机，与阿片类药物相关的过量死亡仍然是一个重要的死亡原因。各州通过消除纳洛酮使用障碍来减少过量死亡的努力，最近主要集中在药店渠道上，但这些法律的具体内容和实施背景差异很大。在本文中，我们采用了一种能够应对不同州和随时间变化的政策效应的新方法，来估算两种类型法律对药店纳洛酮分发的影响：一种是授权非特定患者处方纳洛酮的法律，另一种是赋予药剂师处方纳洛酮权力的法律。我们发现，这两种法律都显著增加了通过药店提供的纳洛酮数量。然而，与授权非特定患者处方纳洛酮的法律相比，赋予药剂师处方权力的法律所带来的影响更为显著。这些更大的影响部分源于药剂师增加了纳洛酮的处方量。我们还估计了非药剂师处方者提供的纳洛酮在药店中的分发量显著增加，其中家庭医学医生的增加尤为显著。与非特定患者处方分发相比，赋予药剂师处方权力的法律在非西班牙裔黑人人群中带来的相对优势更大，这表明这些政策在减少纳洛酮获取不平等方面发挥了重要作用。

abstract.text: This review article, which was solicited by the Geneva Risk and Insurance Review, surveys work that has been done using an empirical framework for analyzing selection in insurance markets developed by Einav, Finkelstein, and Cullen (2010). We briefly review that framework, and then describe a number of empirical applications that researchers have undertaken across an array of settings in both insurance and credit markets. We also discuss some of the useful extensions to the original framework that others have made and applied. The review is intended to be useful for scholars who may want to apply the framework in their own work on insurance, credit, or other selection markets.

10.3386/w31146.abstractZh: 这篇综述文章由《日内瓦风险与保险评论》委托撰写，旨在回顾使用Einav、Finkelstein和Cullen（2010年）提出的实证框架来分析保险市场选择问题的研究成果。我们简要介绍了该框架，然后描述了研究人员在保险和信贷市场等多种环境中进行的多项实证研究。此外，我们还讨论了其他学者对原始框架所做的有益扩展及其应用情况。本文旨在为那些希望在自己的保险、信贷或其他选择市场研究中使用该框架的学者提供帮助。

abstract.text: We provide novel evidence on the role of negative social comparisons in population health behaviors by exploiting variation in Miss America and Miss USA beauty pageant winners. We show that there was more front-page newspaper coverage and more pageant-related internet search behavior following a home-state win. Teen girls and pageant-aged women with home-state winners were more likely to report that they were trying to lose weight, and pregnant women gained less gestational weight. We do not detect meaningful changes for teen boys, young adult men, or older women for whom social comparisons were plausibly less salient.

10.3386/w31156.abstractZh: 我们通过研究“美国小姐”选美比赛冠军的变化，为负面社会比较在人群健康行为中的作用提供了新的证据。我们发现，在本地获胜者之后，报纸的头版报道和与选美比赛相关的网络搜索行为都有所增加。拥有本地获胜者的少女和适赛年龄的女性更有可能表示自己正在努力减肥，而怀孕的女性则减少了孕期体重的增加。对于青少年男孩、年轻男性以及年龄较大的女性来说，我们没有发现显著的变化，因为对他们而言，社会比较的影响可能相对较小。

abstract.text: We assess the impacts of a randomized school-based deworming intervention in Kenya on the mortality of recipients’ children using a 23-year longitudinal data set of over 6,500 original participants and their offspring. The under-5 mortality rate fell by 22% (17 deaths per 1000 live births) for children of treatment group individuals. We find that a combination of improved health, education and living standards, increased urban residence, delayed fertility, and greater use of health care in the parent generation contributed to the reduction. The results provide evidence for meaningful intergenerational benefits of child health investments.

10.3386/w31162.abstractZh: 我们评估了肯尼亚一项基于学校的驱虫干预措施对受干预儿童死亡率的影响，研究使用了包含6,500多名原始参与者及其后代的23年纵向数据集。治疗组儿童群体的5岁以下儿童死亡率下降了22%（每1000个活产婴儿中有17例死亡）。我们发现，健康状况、教育水平和生活水平的提高，城市居住时间的延长，生育年龄的推迟，以及父母一代对医疗保健的更大依赖，共同促进了这一下降。这些结果证明了儿童健康投资在代际间具有显著的好处。

abstract.text: We demonstrate how mothers, fathers, and 15–17-year-old students alter their schedules around the K-12 academic year. Using regression discontinuity (RDD) methods, combined with dates on school year start and end dates by locality, we document several notable results. First, mothers are substantially more affected by the school year than are fathers. When school is in session, mothers sleep less, spend more time caring for family members and driving them around, and spend less time on eating, free time and exercise. Fathers see changes that are generally similar in sign but smaller in magnitude compared to mothers. 15–17-year-olds naturally reduce time spent in educational pursuits when school is out (a decrease of about 5.5 hours per day on weekdays), and most of that time is substituted toward free time (an additional 2+ hours per day) and sleep (1+ hours per day). Our results provide a holistic picture of how families build their days around the K-12 school calendar and have implications for policies targeted toward women’s and teenage children’s health and well-being.

10.3386/w31177.abstractZh: 我们研究了母亲、父亲以及15至17岁的学生如何调整他们的日程安排以适应K-12学年。通过回归不连续法，并结合各地学年开始和结束的日期，我们得出了一些显著的结果。首先，母亲受到学年的影响比父亲更为显著。在学校上课期间，母亲的睡眠时间减少，花费更多时间照顾家庭成员和开车接送他们，同时用于饮食、休闲和锻炼的时间也减少。父亲所经历的变化在趋势上大致相似，但幅度小于母亲。15至17岁的学生在放学期间自然会减少用于学习的时间（工作日每天减少约5.5小时），而这部分时间则更多地被用于休闲（每天增加2小时以上）和睡眠（每天增加1小时以上）。我们的研究结果全面展示了家庭如何根据K-12学年日历安排日常活动，这对针对女性及青少年儿童健康与福祉的政策制定具有参考价值。

abstract.text: The effects of minimum wages on employment, wages, earnings, and incomes, have been studied and debated for decades. In recent years, however, researchers have turned to the effects on a multitude of other behaviors and outcomes – largely related to health. I review and assess the large and growing body of evidence on minimum wage effects on a wide variety of health outcomes and health-related behaviors. The evidence, even focusing on the more-compelling studies, is decidedly mixed. The evidence on physical health points in conflicting directions, and may lean towards adverse effects, possibly a reflection, in part, of the conflicting influences of minimum wages on factors that can affect health (related to how higher income is spent). In particular, research on the effects of minimum wages on diet and obesity sometimes points to beneficial effects, while other evidence indicates that higher minimum wages increase smoking and drinking and reduce exercise (and possibly hygiene). In contrast, there is rather strong evidence that higher minimum wages reduce suicides, partly consistent with the evidence of effects on other measures of mental health/depression being either positive or mixed. Overall, policy conclusions that minimum wages improve health are unwarranted or at least premature. Moreover, this research literature would benefit from more rigorous evidence, borrowing from the longer-running research on the labor market impacts of minimum wages.

10.3386/w31191.abstractZh: 关于最低工资对就业、工资、收入等的影响，已经进行了数十年的研究和讨论。然而，近年来，研究人员开始关注其对其他多种行为及结果的影响，这些影响主要与健康相关。我回顾并评估了大量关于最低工资对各类健康结果和健康相关行为影响的证据，这些证据数量庞大且不断增长。即便聚焦于那些更具说服力的研究，结果也相当复杂。关于身体健康方面的证据方向不一，有些研究认为最低工资可能带来负面影响，这可能与最低工资对影响健康的因素产生相互矛盾的影响有关（尤其是关于高收入如何分配的问题）。例如，关于最低工资对饮食和肥胖的影响，有些研究认为最低工资有积极作用，而另一些研究则表明较高的最低工资会增加吸烟和饮酒的频率，并减少运动量（可能还会降低卫生状况）。相反，有相当多的证据表明，较高的最低工资可以减少自杀行为，这与最低工资对其他心理健康/抑郁指标的影响呈正相关或混合性结果。总体而言，认为最低工资能改善健康的政策结论是不合理的，或者至少还为时过早。此外，这些研究文献需要更严谨的证据支持，尤其是借鉴那些长期研究最低工资对劳动力市场影响的成果。

abstract.text: Across many sectors, research has established that management explains a notable portion of productivity differences across organizations.A remaining question, however, is whether it is managers themselves or firm-wide management practices that matter.We shed light on this question by analyzing store-level data from two multibillion-dollar retail companies.In this setting, managers move between stores but management practices are set by firm policy and largely fixed, allowing us to hone in on managers' personal roles in determining store performance.We find: (i) managers affect and explain a large share of the variance of store-level productivity; (ii) negative assortative matching between managers and stores, which may reflect both firms' decisions and a selection-driven bias that we characterize and argue might apply in other settings using movers designs; (iii) managers who move do so on average from less productive to more productive stores; (iv) female managers are less likely to move stores than male managers; (v) manager quality is generally hard to explain with the observables in our data, but is correlated with the ratio of full-time to part-time workers; (vi) managers who obtain high labor productivity also tend to obtain high energy productivity, revealing some breadth in managers' skills applicability; (vii) high-performing managers in stable growth times are also high-performing during turbulent times; and (viii) exogenous productivity shocks improve the quality of initially low quality managers, suggesting managers can learn.We explain implications of these findings for productivity research.

10.3386/w31192.abstractZh: 在许多领域，研究已经表明，管理因素解释了组织间生产力差异的相当一部分。然而，还有一个问题，那就是是管理者本身，还是整个公司的管理实践在起作用。我们通过分析两家市值数十亿美元的零售公司的门店级数据来解答这个问题。在这种情况下，管理者会在不同门店之间调动，但管理实践是由公司政策决定的，并且基本固定不变，这使我们能够更精确地了解管理者在决定门店绩效中的个人作用。我们发现：(i) 管理者对门店级生产力的变化有很大影响；(ii) 管理者与门店之间的负面匹配可能反映了公司的决策以及我们称之为“选择驱动偏差”的现象，这种现象可能适用于其他使用移动设计的情境；(iii) 移动的管理者通常是从效率较低的门店转移到效率较高的门店；(iv) 女性管理者比男性管理者更不愿意更换门店；(v) 用我们数据中的可观测指标很难解释管理者的质量，但管理者的质量与全职员工与兼职员工的比例相关；(vi) 获得高劳动生产率的管理者往往也具有较高的能源生产率，这表明管理者的技能具有广泛的适用性；(vii) 在稳定增长时期表现优异的管理者，在动荡时期同样表现出色；(viii) 外部生产率冲击能够提升最初质量较低的管理者的素质，表明管理者可以学习。我们解释了这些发现对生产率研究的意义。

abstract.text: We report results from the first randomization of a regulatory reform in the health sector. The reform established minimum quality standards for patient safety, an issue that has become increasingly salient following the Ebola and COVID-19 epidemics. In our experiment, all 1348 health facilities in three Kenyan counties were classifi ed into 273 markets, and the markets were then randomly allocated to treatment and control groups. Government inspectors visited health facilities and, depending on the results of their inspection, recommended closure or a timeline for improvements. The intervention increased compliance with patient safety measures in both public and private facilities (more so in the latter) and reallocated patients from private to public facilities without increasing out-of-pocket payments or decreasing facility use. In treated markets, improvements were equally marked throughout the quality distribution, consistent with a simple model of vertical differentiation in oligopolies. Our paper thus establishes the use of experimental techniques to study regulatory reforms and, in doing so, shows that minimum standards can improve quality across the board without adversely affecting utilization.

10.3386/w31203.abstractZh: 我们报告了健康领域监管改革首次随机化的结果。该改革确立了患者安全的最低质量标准，这一问题在埃博拉和COVID-19疫情之后变得更加突出。在我们的实验中，肯尼亚三个县的1348家医疗机构被划分为273个市场，然后这些市场被随机分配到治疗组和对照组。政府检查员对医疗机构进行视察，并根据检查结果建议关闭或设定改进时间表。该干预措施提高了公共和私人医疗机构对患者安全措施的遵守程度（在私人医疗机构中提升幅度更大），并将患者重新分配到公共医疗机构，而并未增加患者的自付费用或降低医疗机构的使用率。在受干预的市场中，质量的提升在整个分布范围内都表现得相当明显，这与寡头垄断中垂直差异的简单模型相符。因此，我们的论文证明了使用实验技术来研究监管改革是可行的，并且表明最低标准可以在不影响利用率的情况下提升整体质量。

abstract.text: Economic theory and empirical studies conclude that the cost of voluntary employer-sponsored health insurance falls on employees. However, the distribution of incidence and the mechanism through which incidence occurs have not been well-established. We provide new evidence about incidence by examining the dependent coverage mandate in the ACA, which requires group insurance to allow adult children to age 26 to remain on their parents’ policies. We establish that the incidence of the mandate fell on covered employees as a group. We then consider three situations in which the benefits of this new coverage to an employee differ from the costs to an employer. First, we compare incidence where the young adult dependent is the youngest child in the family to the situation where the child is not the youngest (so the family could add a dependent to existing family coverage). We find that incidence falls mainly on households where the newly-eligible child is the youngest in the household. Second, higher-income households face a lower tax price of coverage than do lower-income households. We find that the incidence of the mandate falls mainly on the highest income households. Finally, we find that the mandate leads to increased commuting time for parents of newly-eligible dependents.

10.3386/w31220.abstractZh: 经济理论和实证研究表明，雇主自愿提供的健康保险成本最终由员工承担。然而，保险覆盖率的分配以及其产生机制尚未得到充分研究。我们通过分析《平价医疗法案》中关于团体保险覆盖的强制性规定，为这一问题提供了新的证据。该规定要求成年子女在26岁之前必须继续享受父母的保险福利。我们发现，这一强制规定的主要影响对象为受保险覆盖的员工群体。接下来，我们考虑了三种情况下，这种新保险对员工的益处与对雇主的代价之间的差异。首先，我们比较了年轻成年子女作为家庭中最年幼的孩子的情况，以及孩子并非最年幼的情况（即家庭可以再增加一名受保险覆盖的成员）。研究发现，这种强制规定的主要影响对象为家庭中最年幼的孩子。其次，高收入家庭在支付保险费用方面比低收入家庭要低。我们发现，这一强制规定的主要影响对象为高收入家庭。最后，我们发现，这一强制规定导致父母为新增受保险覆盖的子女增加了通勤时间。

abstract.text: We use a five percent sample of Americans’ credit bureau data, combined with a regression discontinuity approach, to estimate the effect of universal health insurance at age 65—when most Americans become eligible for Medicare—at the national, state, and local level. We find a 30 percent reduction in debt collections—and a two-thirds reduction in the geographic variation in collections—with limited effects on other financial outcomes. The areas that experienced larger reductions in collections debt at age 65 were concentrated in the Southern United States, and had higher shares of black residents, people with disabilities, and for-profit hospitals.

10.3386/w31223.abstractZh: 我们采用了美国信用局数据的5%样本，并结合回归不连续方法，来估计在65岁时——大多数美国人开始有资格享受医疗保险的时候——全民健康保险对全国、州和地方层面的影响。研究发现，债务催收次数减少了30%，地理上的催收差异也减少了三分之二，但对其他财务结果的影响有限。在65岁时，催收债务减少幅度较大的地区集中在美国南部，这些地区黑人群体比例较高，残疾人比例也较高，同时营利性医院的数量也较多。

abstract.text: Using spatial and temporal variation in openings of fast food restaurants in Norway between 1980 and 2007, we study the effects of changes in the supply of high caloric nutrition on the health and cognitive ability of young adult males. Our results indicate that exposure to these establishments during childhood and adolescence increases BMI and has negative effects on cognition. Heterogeneity analysis does not reveal meaningful differences in the effects across groups, including for those with adverse prenatal health or high paternal BMI, an exception being that cognition is only affected by exposure at ages 0--12 and this effect is mediated by paternal education.

10.3386/w31226.abstractZh: 通过研究1980年至2007年间挪威快餐餐厅营业时间在空间和时间上的变化，我们探讨了高热量营养供应变化对年轻男性健康和认知能力的影响。研究结果表明，在儿童期和青春期频繁接触这些餐厅会增加体重指数，并对认知能力产生负面影响。异质性分析并未发现不同群体之间存在显著差异，包括那些在孕期健康状况不佳或父亲体重指数较高的人群。例外情况是，认知能力仅受到0-12岁期间接触这些餐厅的影响，且这种影响与父亲的教育水平有关。

abstract.text: This research is the first to identify the impact of armed conflict exposure for the average male randomly drawn from the population on subsequent intimate partner violence (IPV). We exploit a population-level natural experiment in service location assignment of draftees under Turkey’s universal conscription system, inducting 90% of all draft-age men for 15-to-18 months, with nearly a quarter of them being deployed to the conflict zone during our analysis period, 1984-to-2011, in the southeast of the country to curb the Kurdistan Workers’ Party (PKK) insurgency. Purging any confounding influence of civilian exposure, the innovative design of our survey captures isolated exposure during military service. Results show that conflict zone deployment increases physical and psychological IPV perpetration from husband to wife. Probing the mechanisms, our analysis first renders the use of violence as an instrumental behavior in intrahousehold bargaining as an unlikely mechanism by eliminating labor market outcomes and economic- and social-controlling behaviors from the list of usual suspects. Moreover, we rule out the possibility of risky health habits exacerbating the unfavorable effects of combat. Then, we show compelling evidence that normalizing violence in everyday life, likely emerging as an expressive behavior when arguments escalate, is the primary mediating pathway.

10.3386/w31227.abstractZh: 本研究首次探讨了武装冲突经历对随机抽取的普通男性随后发生亲密伴侣暴力行为的影响。我们利用了土耳其普遍征兵制度下的一项群体级自然实验，该制度要求90%的适龄男性接受15至18个月的军事训练，其中近四分之一的人在1984至2011年的分析期间被部署到冲突地区，以遏制库尔德工人党（PKK）的叛乱活动。通过排除平民经历对结果的干扰，我们的调查设计能够捕捉到军事服务期间个体经历的孤立影响。研究结果表明，在冲突地区服役会增加夫妻之间的暴力行为。在探究其机制时，我们首先排除了将暴力行为作为家庭内部谈判工具的可能性，因为劳动力市场结果以及经济和社会控制行为并不符合这一机制。此外，我们排除了危险健康习惯加剧战斗不利影响的可能性。最后，我们发现，在日常生活中将暴力行为常态化，当冲突升级时，暴力行为可能成为一种表达性行为，这是导致暴力行为的主要中介因素。

abstract.text: We examine mortality differences between Americans with and without a four-year college degree over the period 1992 to 2021. From 1992 to 2010, both groups saw falling mortality, but with greater improvements for the more educated; from 2010 to 2019, mortality fell for those with a BA and rose for those without; from 2019 to 2021, mortality rose for both groups, but more rapidly for the less educated. In consequence, the mortality gap between the two groups rose in all three periods, unevenly until 2010, faster between 2010 to 2019, and explosively during the pandemic. The overall period saw dramatic changes in patterns of mortality, but gaps rose consistently, not only in all-cause mortality, but in each of thirteen broad classifications of cause of death. Gaps increased for causes of death whose rates have risen in the last thirty years, whose rates have fallen in the last thirty years, and whose rates fell and then rose. Gaps rose for causes where rates were originally higher for those without a BA, and where rates were originally lower for those without a BA. Although mechanisms and stories are different for each cause of death, the widening gap is seen throughout.

10.3386/w31236.abstractZh: 我们研究了1992年至2021年间，拥有和没有四年制大学学位的美国人之间的死亡率差异。从1992年到2010年，两组人的死亡率都在下降，但受教育程度较高的人群改善幅度更大；从2010年到2019年，拥有学士学位的人的死亡率下降，而没有学士学位的人的死亡率上升；从2019年到2021年，两组人的死亡率都上升，但受教育程度较低的人群上升速度更快。因此，在这三个时期，两组人之间的死亡率差距都在扩大，直到2010年这种差距变得更加不均匀，在2010年到2019年期间扩大得更快，在疫情期间则急剧上升。整个时期，死亡率模式发生了显著变化，但差距始终在扩大，不仅在所有原因导致的死亡率上如此，在十三种主要死因分类中也是如此。在过去三十年中死亡率上升的原因、过去三十年中死亡率下降的原因，以及死亡率先下降后上升的原因，导致的差距都在扩大。对于那些原本没有学士学位的人死亡率较高的原因，以及那些原本没有学士学位的人死亡率较低的原因，导致的差距也在扩大。尽管每种死因的机制和情况各不相同，但差距扩大的趋势在整个研究期间都普遍存在。

abstract.text: Many government program applications result in procedural denials due to administrative burdens associated with applying. We identify the intake interview as a key barrier to take-up of the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program and study the effect of an alternative application process designed to reduce burdens. Using a field experiment involving 65,000 Los Angeles applicants, we find that access to flexible interviews initiated by the applicant increases approvals by six percentage points, doubles early approvals, and increases long-term participation by over two percentage points. Our findings highlight the importance of incorporating flexibility when designing program integrity policies to minimize procedural denials.

10.3386/w31239.abstractZh: 许多政府项目申请因行政手续繁琐而遭到拒绝。我们发现，接待面试是阻碍人们参与补充营养援助计划的重要障碍之一，并研究了一种旨在减轻手续负担的替代申请流程的效果。通过一项涉及65,000名洛杉矶申请人的实地实验，我们发现，由申请人主导的灵活面试方式可以将批准率提高6个百分点，将早期批准率提高一倍，并将长期参与率提高超过2个百分点。我们的研究结果强调了在设计项目政策时加入灵活性以最小化程序性拒绝的重要性。

abstract.text: The suicide rate in the United States has risen nearly 40 percent since 2000. This increase is puzzling because suicide rates had been falling for decades at the end of the 20th Century. In this paper, we review important facts about the changing rate of suicide. General trends miss the story of important differences across groups – suicide rates rose substantially among middle aged persons between 2005 and 2015 but have fallen since. Among young people, suicide rates began a rapid rise after 2010 that has not abated. We review empirical evidence to assess potential causes for recent changes in suicide rates. The economic hardship caused by the Great Recession played an important role in rising suicide among prime-aged Americans. We illustrate that the increase in the prevalence of depression among young people during the 2010s was so large it could explain nearly all the increase in suicide mortality among those under 25. Bullying victimization of LGBTQ youth could also account for part of the rise in suicide. The evidence that access to firearms or opioids are major drivers of recent suicide trends is less clear. We end by summarizing evidence on the most promising policies to reduce suicide mortality.

10.3386/w31242.abstractZh: 自2000年以来，美国的自杀率上升了近40%。这一增长令人困惑，因为到了20世纪末，自杀率一直在下降。在本文中，我们回顾了关于自杀率变化的重要事实。总体趋势掩盖了不同群体之间的显著差异——2005年至2015年间，中年人的自杀率显著上升，但此后有所下降。在年轻人中，自杀率自2010年后迅速上升，且这一趋势并未减弱。我们通过实证证据来评估近期自杀率变化的可能原因。大衰退带来的经济困境在导致美国壮年人群自杀率上升中发挥了重要作用。我们指出，2010年代年轻人中抑郁症的患病率大幅增加，这一因素几乎可以解释25岁以下人群自杀死亡率的上升。对LGBTQ青年来说，遭受欺凌也可能成为自杀率上升的原因之一。关于获取枪支或阿片类药物是否是近期自杀趋势的主要驱动因素，证据尚不清晰。最后，我们总结了减少自杀死亡率的最有希望的政策措施。

abstract.text: Voluntary participation is a central feature of payment reforms that are being tested in US healthcare. These programs frequently incentivize provider participation with financial rewards linked to performance, although there are questions about their efficacy in attracting participants or on the treatment effects for participants drawn by such incentives. We inform this debate by studying the introduction of a voluntary Medicare payment reform to reduce spending on hospital surgeries. We show that hospitals with a higher financial gain predicted by the payment formula are more likely to participate. We leverage quasi-experimental variation in the potential financial gain to instrument for participation and quantify the treatment effect for “complier” hospitals: those induced to participate by the incentive. Although participating hospitals are disproportionately nonprofit overall, financial compliers are disproportionately of for-profit ownership. Compliers generate greater savings than the average participant by decreasing medical services more aggressively. Selection on favorable historical trends or changes in patient mix do not explain the savings. However, we detect some worsening of care quality in complier hospitals. Overall, the results suggest that the use of financial incentives increases both the participation in and the treatment effect of this voluntary program.

10.3386/w31256.abstractZh: 自愿参与是美国医疗保健领域正在测试的支付改革的核心特征。这些项目通常通过与绩效相关的财务奖励来激励提供者的参与，不过关于这些激励措施在吸引参与者或对受激励的参与者治疗效果方面的有效性仍存在疑问。我们通过研究一项旨在减少医院手术支出的自愿医疗保险支付改革，来探讨这一问题。研究发现，根据支付公式预测的财务收益更高的医院更有可能参与该改革。我们利用潜在财务收益的准实验差异作为参与度的工具，并量化了“自愿参与”医院的治疗效果：那些因激励措施而参与进来的医院。尽管参与医院的整体性质多为非营利性，但财务上自愿参与的医院则多为营利性机构。自愿参与的医院通过更积极地减少医疗服务来节省成本，其节省效果优于普通参与者。然而，我们并未发现历史趋势或患者结构变化对节省成本的影响。不过，我们确实观察到自愿参与医院的服务质量有所下降。总体而言，结果表明，使用财务激励措施既增加了参与者的数量，也提升了该自愿项目的治疗效果。

abstract.text: Bias among health care providers can lead to poor-quality care and poor health outcomes, and it can exacerbate disparities. We use a randomized controlled trial to evaluate an intervention to reduce family planning provider bias towards young women in 227 clinics in Tanzania, Burkina Faso, and Pakistan. The intervention educated providers about bias towards young women, facilitated communication about bias with other providers, and offered non-financial public awards to clinics with the least biased care. After 12 months, the intervention led to less-biased attitudes and beliefs among providers and more comprehensive counseling. Clients also perceived better treatment at intervention clinics compared to control clinics. Despite reductions in reported bias, we find mixed evidence regarding changes in method dispensing.

10.3386/w31269.abstractZh: 医疗提供者的偏见可能导致医疗服务质量低下和健康状况不佳，并加剧医疗不平等现象。我们采用随机对照试验的方法，在坦桑尼亚、布基纳法索和巴基斯坦的227家诊所中评估了一项减少医疗提供者针对年轻女性偏见的干预措施。该干预措施向医疗提供者普及了关于针对年轻女性偏见的知识，促进了其他医疗提供者之间关于偏见的交流，并为偏见最少的诊所提供了非经济性的公开奖励。经过12个月后，该干预措施使得医疗提供者的偏见态度和观念有所减少，咨询内容也更为全面。客户也认为在干预诊所接受的治疗比对照诊所更好。尽管报告的偏见有所减少，但关于治疗方法的变化，我们获得的证据并不一致。

abstract.text: In his Labor Day address, President Biden stated that the U.S. “has the highest drug prices in the world, and there is no reason for it.” For new branded drugs, the first part of that statement is supported by a recent RAND Report (Mulcahy et. al. 2021) which found U.S. average prices are 2.3 times those present in both the 32 OECD countries overall and in the UK separately. In this research, we consider the second part of that statement, and identify the economic factors that suggest some “reasons for it.” Viewing pharmaceutical markets through the lens of the theories of global public goods and alliances, as developed by Olson and Zeckhauser (1966), we explain the observed pricing differences along with their implications the for the global supply of innovative new drugs. Similar views were advanced in two U.S. government reports (CEA 2018, 2020), and also by Goldman and Lakdawala (2018). We develop these ideas further and implement them empirically. A commonly held theory presumes that drug companies in the U.S set prices for patented drugs at profit- maximizing levels that fund and incentivize substantial research and development efforts. In contrast, in the rest of the world (ROW), national authorities set prices minimally above marginal costs of production, allowing few revenues remaining to support R&D (CEA Report 2018; Blumenthal 2018; Hooper and Henderson 2022). The ROW countries are then considered to be fully free riding on U.S. research efforts. We examine this argument both theoretically and empirically, and find it wanting. We apply global public good theory to examine the pricing of branded drugs. To this end, we describe the optimal global contribution, as supported by the Lindahl pricing model, and show theoretically that existing independently determined contributions and thereby aggregate R&D levels are likely sub-optimal. Then we implement the model by calculating the contribution to the global public good as represented by short-term profits or quasi-rents received from sales of all branded drugs. These calculations are derived from pricing data contained in the RAND Report along with two market-based estimates of marginal costs. We find that, while ROW contributions are less than those found in the United States, they are more than minimal, and do not approach zero for most countries. When we regress these positive contributions on a country’s size of GDP along with various controls, we find that GDP size alone is a powerful determinant of national contributions. It remains economically and statistically significant without regard to the controls introduced. In addition, we estimate how large are the contributions of ROW countries to the global public good. We offer reasons why US pharmaceutical prices and contributions per capita are nevertheless higher than those found in all ROW countries. We also suggest actions aimed to promote R&D efforts that are closer to the global optimum.

10.3386/w31272.abstractZh: 在劳动节演讲中，拜登总统指出，美国的药品价格“位居世界之首，这毫无道理”。对于新品牌药品而言，该声明的第一部分得到了最近一份兰德报告的支持（Mulcahy等人，2021年），该报告发现美国的平均药品价格是美国32个经合组织国家整体水平的2.3倍，而英国则更是如此。在这项研究中，我们考虑了该声明中的第二部分，并确定了一些“存在这种价格差异的原因”的经济因素。通过运用奥尔森和泽克豪泽尔（1966年）提出的全球公共物品和联盟理论来审视药品市场，我们解释了这些价格差异及其对全球创新药品供应的影响。类似的观点也出现在两份美国政府报告中（CEA 2018年、2020年），以及戈德曼和拉克达瓦拉（2018年）的研究中。我们进一步发展这些理论，并对其进行实证分析。一种普遍持有的理论认为，美国的药品公司会设定专利药品的价格，使其达到利润最大化的水平，从而资助并激励大量的研究和开发工作。相比之下，在世界其他地区，国家当局设定的价格仅略高于生产边际成本，因此几乎没有收入用于支持研发工作（CEA报告2018年；Blumenthal 2018年；Hooper和Henderson 2022年）。因此，世界其他地区可以完全利用美国的研发成果。我们从理论上和实证上检验了这一论点，发现其缺乏说服力。我们运用全球公共物品理论来研究品牌药品的价格问题。为此，我们描述了由Lindahl定价模型支持的最优全球贡献，并从理论上表明，现有独立确定的贡献以及由此产生的研发水平很可能是次优的。然后，我们通过计算所有品牌药品销售所获得的短期利润或准租金来实施该模型，以此代表对全球公共物品的贡献。这些计算基于RAND报告中的定价数据，以及两个基于市场的边际成本估计。我们发现，虽然全球其他国家的贡献低于美国，但它们仍然高于最低水平，并且大多数国家的贡献并未接近零。当我们将这些正面贡献与各国的GDP规模以及各种控制因素进行回归分析时，我们发现GDP规模本身是决定国家贡献的强大因素。即使考虑到引入的控制因素，这一因素在经济和统计上仍然具有重要意义。此外，我们还估算了全球其他国家对全球公共物品的贡献程度。我们提出了为什么美国药品价格及人均贡献高于所有全球其他国家的理由，并建议采取一些措施来促进更接近全球最优水平的研发努力。

abstract.text: There has been significant media attention on the issue of childhood obesity, leading policymakers to reform the National School Lunch Program (NSLP) to include stricter nutritional requirements. We use data on school lunch menus to document improvements in the nutritional quality of school meals between 1991 and 2010. We then evaluate how this change in nutritional content maps into obesity outcomes, using panel data on a nationally representative cohort of children, tracking them from kindergarten entry in fall 2010 through the end of fifth grade in spring 2016. We find little evidence that participation in the school lunch program leads to weight gain, as measured by changes in obesity, overweight, and BMI. These results suggest that improvements in the nutritional content of school lunches have been largely successful in reversing the previously negative relationship between school lunches and childhood obesity. Unrelated to school lunch participation, we find a strong relationship between mother’s obesity status and both the level and growth of children’s obesity, especially for girls and among high-SES families.

10.3386/w31287.abstractZh: 关于儿童肥胖问题，媒体对此给予了大量关注，促使政策制定者改革国家学校午餐计划，以纳入更严格的营养要求。我们利用学校午餐菜单的数据，记录了1991年至2010年间学校餐食营养质量的改善情况。随后，我们通过全国代表性儿童群体的面板数据，评估了这种营养内容变化对肥胖状况的影响，这些数据记录了这些儿童从2010年秋季进入幼儿园到2016年春季五年级结束期间的状况。研究发现，参与学校午餐计划并未导致体重增加，无论是从肥胖、超重或BMI的变化来看都是如此。这些结果表明，学校午餐营养内容的改善在扭转学校午餐与儿童肥胖之间的负面关系方面取得了显著成效。此外，我们发现母亲的肥胖状况与儿童肥胖的程度和增长之间存在强烈关联，尤其是在女孩以及高社会经济地位家庭中的儿童身上。

abstract.text: We investigate the role of knowledge spillovers in determining firms' incentives to invest in exploratory versus incremental R&D.
