We link drug candidates to molecularly similarly drugs that are developed in the future and show that novel drug candidates generate greater knowledge spillovers: they are more likely to inspire the development of subsequent successful drugs than incremental candidates. Building off this empirical finding, we develop a model of R&D in which firms face a tradeoff: incremental drug candidates are easier to evaluate because they are based on more established science, while novel drugs present more opportunities for future learning. We provide empirical evidence that firms place less value on learning and are therefore reluctant to develop novel drugs. We provide additional evidence that firms are more willing to engage in exploration when they expect to appropriate a greater fraction of spillover knowledge, when they expect drugs to generate many follow on innovations, and when they face lower discount rates.

10.3386/w31290.abstractZh: 我们研究了知识溢出在决定企业投资探索性研发与增量研发动机中的作用。我们将候选药物与未来可能开发出的分子结构相似的药物联系起来，发现新型候选药物能够产生更大的知识溢出效应：它们更有可能激发后续成功药物的开发，而增量候选药物则相对较弱。基于这一实证发现，我们构建了一个研发模型，其中企业面临一个权衡：增量候选药物由于基于更成熟的科学基础，因此更容易评估；而新型药物则提供了更多未来学习的机会。我们通过实证数据表明，企业对于学习的重视程度较低，因此不太愿意开发新型药物。此外，我们还发现，当企业预期能够获取更多的溢出知识、预期药物能够产生大量后续创新，以及面临较低的折现率时，企业更愿意进行探索性研发。

abstract.text: In medical treatment and elsewhere, it has become standard to base treatment intensity (dosage) on evidence in randomized trials. Yet it has been rare to study how outcomes vary with dosage. In trials to obtain drug approval, the norm has been to specify some dose of a new drug and compare it with an established therapy or placebo. Design-based trial analysis views each trial arm as qualitatively different, but it may be highly credible to assume that efficacy and adverse effects (AEs) weakly increase with dosage. Optimization of patient care requires joint attention to both, as well as to treatment cost. This paper develops methodology to credibly use limited trial evidence to choose dosage when efficacy and AEs weakly increase with dose. I suppose that dosage is an integer choice t ∊ (0, 1, . . . , T), T being a specified maximum dose. I study dosage choice when trial evidence on outcomes is available for only K dose levels, where K < T + 1. Then the population distribution of dose response is partially rather than point identified. The identification region is a convex polygon determined by linear equalities and inequalities. I characterize clinical and public-health decision making using the minimax-regret criterion. A simple analytical solution exists when T = 2 and computation is tractable when T is larger.

10.3386/w31305.abstractZh: 在医疗及其他领域，基于随机试验的证据来确定治疗强度（剂量）已成为标准做法。然而，研究结果如何随剂量变化的情况却较为罕见。在获得药物批准的试验中，通常会指定某种新药的剂量，并将其与现有的疗法或安慰剂进行比较。基于设计的试验分析将每个试验组视为具有质的差异，但假设疗效和不良反应随剂量轻微增加可能是可信的。优化患者护理需要同时关注这两方面，以及治疗成本。本文提出了一种方法，利用有限的试验证据来合理选择剂量，特别是当疗效和不良反应随剂量轻微增加时。我假设剂量是一个整数选择 t ∈ (0, 1, …, T)，其中 T 是规定的最大剂量。当只有 K 个剂量水平的相关试验证据可用时，即 K < T + 1，我研究了剂量选择问题。此时，剂量响应的总体分布是部分而非点确定的。识别区域是由线性等式和不等式确定的凸多边形。我使用极小极大遗憾准则来描述临床和公共卫生决策过程。当 T = 2 时，存在简单的解析解；而当 T 较大时，计算也是可行的。

abstract.text: Canonical economic theory clearly predicts means-tested transfers will reduce work. We provide new evidence on this question in the context of the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP)—the backbone of the U.S. safety net. It is challenging to identify the causal effects of SNAP, so we introduce an examiner design based on conditional random assignment of SNAP applicants to caseworkers using rich administrative data. We empirically establish that caseworkers help determine whether applicants receive benefits. We then use this as an instrument for SNAP receipt to produce new, comprehensive and generalizable evidence of the labor supply effects of modern SNAP. Our results shed light on why the canonical theory’s predictions might not always bear out.

10.3386/w31307.abstractZh: 经典经济理论明确指出，以收入为基础的转移支付会减少劳动力供给。我们在美国安全网的重要组成部分——补充营养援助计划（SNAP）的背景下，为这一问题提供了新的证据。要确定SNAP的因果效应非常困难，因此我们采用了一种基于条件随机分配的检验设计，将SNAP申请人与个案工作者进行随机分配，利用丰富的行政数据进行分析。我们通过实证研究发现，个案工作者确实参与了决定申请人是否获得福利的决策过程。随后，我们利用这一变量作为SNAP领取情况的指标，得出了关于现代SNAP对劳动力供给影响的新的、全面且可推广的结论。我们的研究结果有助于解释为什么经典理论的预测并不总是成立。

abstract.text: Over the last decade, the U.S. Medicare program has added new billing codes to enhance the financial rewards for Chronic Care Management and Transitional Care Management. We analyze the effects of introducing these new billing codes. First, we provide evidence on the adoption of the new codes by primary care physicians. We show that take-up of the new billing codes occurs gradually and exhibits substantial variation across space and across physician characteristics. Second, we provide evidence on how the new billing codes can both complement and substitute for the billing or provision of other services. We focus on two case studies. As a case of code substitution, we show that Transitional Care Management services partially crowd out traditional office visits following hospital discharges. As a case of code complementarity, we show that both Transitional Care Management and Chronic Care Management services predict increases in annual wellness visits. Overall, our analysis highlights how both new code take-up frictions and the impact of new code billing on existing code billing can be important for assessing the total costs and benefits of payment reforms.

10.3386/w31336.abstractZh: 在过去的十年中，美国的Medicare计划增加了新的计费代码，以加强对慢性护理管理和过渡性护理管理的经济奖励。我们分析了引入这些新计费代码的影响。首先，我们提供了关于初级保健医生采用新编码情况的证据。我们发现，新编码的采用是逐步进行的，并且在不同地区以及不同医生特征上存在显著差异。其次，我们研究了新计费代码如何补充或替代其他服务的计费或提供。我们重点研究了两个案例研究。作为代码替代的案例，我们发现过渡性护理管理服务在一定程度上取代了出院后的传统门诊服务。作为代码互补的案例，我们发现过渡性护理管理和慢性护理管理服务都能预测年度健康检查的增加。总体而言，我们的分析强调了新编码的采用摩擦以及新编码计费对现有编码计费的影响，这些因素对于评估支付改革的总成本和收益非常重要。

abstract.text: Approximately 75% of children aged 2 to 4 worldwide are regularly subjected to violent discipline across the globe. We study the impact of a virtually-delivered intervention on positive parenting practices in Jamaica. We find the intervention improves caregiver knowledge (0.52 SD) and attitudes around violence (0.2 SD) and leads to meaningful changes in caregiver disciplining behaviors, with a 0.12 SD reduction in violence against children. Treatment children also experience fewer emotional problems (0.17 SD). When we return nine months later, we also find reductions in caregiver depression (0.12 SD), anxiety (0.16 SD), and parental stress (0.16 SD) for treatment caregivers. The virtual delivery has important scalable policy implications which could help decrease violence against children across the globe.

10.3386/w31338.abstractZh: 全球约有75%的2至4岁儿童经常遭受暴力管教。我们研究了在牙买加实施的虚拟干预措施对积极育儿实践的影响。研究发现，该干预措施提升了看护者的知识水平（0.52标准差）和关于暴力的态度（0.2标准差），并显著改变了看护者的管教行为，使针对儿童的暴力行为减少了0.12标准差。接受干预的儿童还出现了较少的情绪问题（0.17标准差）。九个月后再次调查时，我们发现看护者的抑郁情绪（0.12标准差）、焦虑情绪（0.16标准差）以及父母压力（0.16标准差）都有所下降。这种虚拟干预方式具有重要的政策推广意义，有助于减少全球范围内的儿童暴力问题。

abstract.text: Vaccinations are a cost-effective tool to prevent child mortality and morbidity; however, their access and take-up remain low in developing countries. We analyze the effects on child vaccinations of a large-scale community-based health worker program that aimed to reach remote areas distant from public health facilities in Madagascar. We identify these effects using a triple-difference design that leverages the time and geographic variation in the program rollout and the geocoded household distance to the closest health facility. Our findings indicate that, on average, the program did not improve the vaccination uptake in treated areas; however, the community health workers component had an additional effect on children’s vaccinations in the most remote areas from the closest health facility. Despite this improvement, we find that mothers’ religious affiliation might constitute a barrier for the vaccination uptake of the most remote and vulnerable children.

10.3386/w31340.abstractZh: 疫苗接种是一种成本效益高的手段，可以有效预防儿童死亡和疾病；然而，在发展中国家，疫苗的普及率仍然很低。我们分析了一项大规模基于社区的卫生工作者计划对儿童疫苗接种的影响，该计划旨在覆盖马达加斯加远离公共卫生设施的偏远地区。我们采用三重差分设计来识别这些影响，该设计利用了计划实施时间和地理差异，以及家庭与最近卫生设施的距离。我们的研究发现表明，平均而言，该计划并未提高受干预地区的疫苗接种率；不过，社区卫生工作者在距离最近卫生设施最远的偏远地区对儿童疫苗接种产生了额外的积极影响。尽管有这些改善，我们发现母亲的宗教归属可能成为最偏远和脆弱儿童接种疫苗的障碍。

abstract.text: The COVID-19 related public health emergency led to federal legislation that changed the landscape of Medicaid coverage for low-income people in the United States. Beginning in 2020, policy responses led to a surge in Medicaid enrollment due to federal rules preventing Medicaid disenrollment, and total Medicaid enrollment increased more from January 2020-2023 than the net increase in insurance coverage from 2013-2017 following the Affordable Care Act’s implementation. As these policies come to an end, it is crucial to understand their implications for the future of Medicaid. This paper provides an overview of Medicaid’s enrollment, renewal and funding policies, highlighting how these policies changed during and immediately following the acute phases of the COVID-19 pandemic, describes enrollment increases and their composition, reviews literature relevant to the policy and its unwinding, and identifies key areas for research. By examining this unprecedented period of Medicaid policy, we can inform future policy decisions and optimize safety net programs to be effective in a broad set of circumstances.

10.3386/w31342.abstractZh: 与COVID-19相关的公共卫生紧急状况促使联邦立法，改变了美国低收入人群的医疗补助覆盖范围。自2020年起，政策响应导致医疗补助的注册人数激增，因为联邦法规禁止医疗补助的退出。从2020年1月至2023年，医疗补助的总注册人数增加幅度超过了《平价医疗法案》实施后的2013年至2017年间保险覆盖范围的净增加幅度。随着这些政策的结束，了解它们对医疗补助未来的影响至关重要。本文概述了医疗补助的注册、续签和资金政策，重点介绍了在COVID-19疫情急性期及之后这些政策的变化，描述了注册人数的增加及其构成，回顾了与政策及其撤销相关的文献，并指出了研究的关键领域。通过研究这一前所未有的医疗补助政策时期，我们可以为未来的政策决策提供参考，并优化安全网计划，使其在多种情况下都能有效发挥作用。

abstract.text: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine is the most prestigious and coveted award in medical research. Anecdotal evidence and related research suggest that receiving it may adversely affect research productivity. We compared the post-Nobel research output of laureates (prize years: 1950-2010) with their pre-Nobel output and with the output of a matched control group consisting of winners of the Lasker Award, another highly prestigious medical research prize. Pre-Nobel, laureates’ publications were more voluminous, highly cited, and novel than those of (future) Lasker winners. Post-Nobel, laureates’ productivity decreased sharply, eventually falling below that of Lasker winners on all three measures. These declines may reflect diversionary effects of the Prize, changed incentives, or intrinsically different career arcs for medical researchers who win the Nobel Prize.

10.3386/w31352.abstractZh: 诺贝尔生理学或医学奖是医学研究领域最负盛名、最受瞩目的奖项。一些传闻和相关研究指出，获得该奖项可能会对研究生产力产生负面影响。我们对比了获奖者获得奖项后的研究产出（获奖年份：1950-2010年）与获得奖项前的产出，同时还将这些获奖者与另一项享有极高声誉的医学研究奖项——拉斯克奖的获奖者进行了比较。在获得奖项之前，获奖者的论文数量更多、被引用次数更高，且研究内容更具创新性，这些特点都优于未来的拉斯克奖获奖者。然而，在获得奖项之后，获奖者的研究生产力显著下降，最终在所有三个指标上均低于拉斯克奖获奖者。这种下降可能反映了该奖项带来的干扰效应、激励机制的改变，或是获得诺贝尔 Prize的医学研究者的职业发展轨迹与常规研究者有所不同。

abstract.text: Health insurers often tie payments to providers’ quality of care. Although payers do this to elicit more effort from providers, some providers may game the system by avoiding patients who would cause their quality scores to fall. We use annual variation in the criteria for Medicare’s Quality Incentive Program in dialysis to distinguish strategic patient dropping from higher-quality care. Patients who would reduce their facilities’ scores are 14.3–71.5% more likely to switch facilities, often to ones that suggest the move was involuntary, while under certain conditions facilities exert more effort to improve their scores by providing better care.

10.3386/w31353.abstractZh: 健康保险公司通常将支付与医疗服务提供者的服务质量挂钩。虽然支付方这样做是为了促使提供者更加努力，但有些提供者可能会通过避开那些会导致其服务质量评分下降的患者来操纵这一系统。我们通过分析医疗保险质量激励计划中透析服务标准的年度变化，来区分战略性患者流失与高质量医疗服务之间的区别。那些可能导致医疗机构评分下降的患者，更有可能更换医疗机构，而更换后的医疗机构往往表明这种更换并非出于自愿。在某些条件下，医疗机构会通过提供更好的医疗服务来努力提升其评分。

abstract.text: We provide the first revealed preference estimates of the benefits of routine weather forecasts. The benefits come from how people use advance information to reduce mortality from heat and cold. Theoretically, more accurate forecasts reduce mortality if and only if mortality risk is convex in forecast errors. We test for such convexity using data on the universe of mortality events and weather forecasts for a twelve-year period in the U.S. Results show that erroneously mild forecasts increase mortality whereas erroneously extreme forecasts do not reduce mortality. Making forecasts 50% more accurate would save 2,200 lives per year. The public would be willing to pay $112 billion to make forecasts 50% more accurate over the remainder of the century, of which $22 billion reflects how forecasts facilitate adaptation to climate change.

10.3386/w31361.abstractZh: 我们首次提供了关于常规天气预报所带来的利益的揭示性偏好估计。这些利益来源于人们如何利用提前的信息来降低因高温和低温导致的死亡率。理论上，只有当预测误差的死亡率风险呈凸函数时，更准确的预测才能降低死亡率。我们通过美国十二年的死亡事件与天气预报数据来检验这种凸性。结果表明，错误预测的轻微偏差会增加死亡率，而错误预测的极端偏差则不会降低死亡率。如果天气预报的准确率提高50%，每年可以挽救2,200条生命。公众愿意支付1,120亿美元来换取在世纪剩余时间内天气预报准确率提高50%，其中220亿美元用于反映天气预报对适应气候变化的作用。

abstract.text: Historically coal has offered both benefits and costs to urban areas. Benefits include coal’s role in fueling industry and thus employment. The primary costs are air pollution and its impact on human health. This paper starts by using a Rosen-Roback style model to examine how differences in local coal availability affect equilibrium city employment. Drawing on the model, the paper surveys papers that examine the net effects of coal on the growth in city population and air pollution on health. The paper then turns to papers that explicitly consider the trade-offs between production benefits and pollution disamenities across space and over time. The paper ends with a discussion of opportunities for future work on coal and cities in historical settings.

10.3386/w31365.abstractZh: 从历史上看，煤炭对城市地区既带来了好处，也带来了代价。好处包括煤炭在推动工业发展、从而增加就业方面的作用。主要的代价则是空气污染及其对人类健康的影响。本文首先采用Rosen-Roback模型来研究当地煤炭供应差异如何影响城市就业均衡。基于该模型，本文还回顾了那些研究煤炭对城市人口增长影响以及空气污染对健康影响的论文。随后，本文进一步探讨了那些明确考虑生产效益与污染问题之间权衡的论文。最后，本文讨论了未来在历史背景下研究煤炭与城市关系的机会。

abstract.text: Top income inequality in the United States has increased considerably within occupations. This phenomenon has led to a search for a common explanation. We instead develop a theory where increases in income inequality originating within a few occupations can "spill over" through consumption into others. We show theoretically that such spillovers occur when an occupation provides non-divisible services to consumers, with physicians our prime example. Examining local income inequality across U.S. regions, the data suggest that such spillovers exist for physicians, dentists, and real estate agents. Estimated spillovers for other occupations are consistent with the predictions of our theory.

10.3386/w31366.abstractZh: 美国的收入不平等在各个职业中都有所加剧。这一现象促使人们寻找一个共同的解释。我们提出了一个理论，认为来自少数职业的收入不平等可以通过消费“溢出”到其他职业。理论上，当某个职业为消费者提供不可分割的服务时，这种溢出效应就会发生，医生就是最典型的例子。通过对美国各地区的收入不平等进行考察，数据表明医生、牙医和房地产经纪人确实存在这种溢出效应。其他职业的估计溢出效应也与我们的理论预测一致。

abstract.text: Lead exposure has detrimental effects on fertility, infants, children, and adults. Despite the success in removing lead from on-road gasoline, industrial and aviation emissions continue to pose a substantial global challenge. Other major sources of exposure include dust, soil resuspension, and consumption of contaminated water or food. Both animal studies and evidence from humans support claims of an adverse relationship between lead pollution and human health. Since lead exposure is not randomly assigned, quasi-experimental studies play a crucial role in this knowledge base. Among these studies, extensive research links elevated blood lead levels in children to academic and behavioral outcomes, but more limited attention has been given to lead’s impact on fertility, infant mortality, and infant health. This paper examines the existing quasi-experimental literature on lead and fertility, infant mortality, and infant birth outcomes, highlighting key results, methods, and implications for policymakers.

10.3386/w31379.abstractZh: 铅暴露对生育能力、婴儿、儿童和成人都有负面影响。尽管在去除道路汽油中的铅方面取得了成功，但工业和航空领域的排放仍然构成严重的全球挑战。其他主要的暴露源包括灰尘、土壤重新悬浮以及饮用受污染的水或食物。动物研究和人类证据都支持铅污染与人类健康之间存在不良关系的观点。由于铅暴露并非随机发生，准实验研究在这一知识体系中起着至关重要的作用。在这些研究中，大量研究将儿童血液中铅含量升高与学业成绩和行为表现联系起来，但关于铅对生育能力、婴儿死亡率和婴儿健康的影响的研究则相对较少。本文对现有的关于铅与生育能力、婴儿死亡率和婴儿出生结果相关的准实验研究进行了分析，并强调了关键结果、研究方法以及对政策制定者的启示。

abstract.text: We study the effect of community access to mental health and substance use treatment on police officer safety, proxied with on-duty assaults on officers. Police officers often serve as first-responders to people experiencing mental health and substance use crises, which can place police officers at risk. Combining agency-level data on police officer on-duty assaults and county-level data on treatment centers that offer mental health and substance use care, we estimate panel fixed-effects regressions. An additional four centers per county (the average annual increase observed in our data) leads to a 1.3% reduction per police agency in on-duty police officers assaults.

10.3386/w31391.abstractZh: 我们研究了社区对心理健康和物质使用治疗的获取情况对警察安全的影响，这一影响可以通过警察在执勤期间的袭击事件来体现。警察通常作为应对人们面临心理健康和物质使用危机的第一响应者，这可能会使警察面临风险。通过结合警察在执勤期间的袭击数据以及提供心理健康和物质使用治疗的县级治疗中心数据，我们进行了面板固定效应回归分析。每个县额外增加四个治疗中心（我们数据中观察到的平均年度增加数量），会导致每个警察机构执勤中的警察袭击事件减少1.3%。

abstract.text: Most of the 600,000 adults returning to the community from state and federal prisons annually in the U.S. carry substantial debt, have low income and low education, and limited formal employment prior to entering prison. Upon reentry, they face financial hardship, high rates of morbidity and mortality, and high incidence of re-offense. Medicaid coverage, as a means-tested transfer program providing subsidized health insurance, may influence reincarceration through both financial and health channels. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive look at the effects of public health insurance coverage on post-release behavior of formerly incarcerated adults. We study a natural experiment in which two separate state policy changes resulted in a 60 percentage point increase in Medicaid enrollment at release. Using a series of linked individual level administrative datasets, we estimate the effects of this change in Medicaid enrollment, finding declines in reincarceration, increased employment, and higher health care use. Leveraging data on financial concerns and need for mental health and substance use treatment to examine mechanisms, we find support for a financial channel and mixed support for health channels. Policies that enhance access to healthcare and provide financial security for this population may have significant benefits for individuals and society.

10.3386/w31394.abstractZh: 在美国，每年有60万名成年人在从州和联邦监狱回归社区后，背负着大量债务，收入低，教育水平低，在入狱前也仅有有限的正式就业机会。重新回归社会后，他们面临经济困难、高发病率和高死亡率，以及再次犯罪的高发生率。医疗补助作为一种通过经济状况评估提供的补贴性健康保险计划，可能通过经济和健康两个渠道影响再入狱的情况。本文全面探讨了公共健康保险覆盖对曾经被监禁的成年人释放后的行为影响。我们研究了一个自然实验，其中两项不同的州政策变化导致释放时医疗补助的注册率增加了60个百分点。通过一系列关联的个人层面行政数据集，我们估计了这一医疗补助注册变化的影响，发现再入狱率下降，就业增加，医疗使用率提高。利用关于经济问题以及心理健康和物质使用治疗需求的数据来研究机制，我们发现经济渠道具有支持性，而健康渠道则表现出混合性的支持。为这一群体提供更好的医疗保健服务并保障其经济安全，可能会对个人和社会产生显著的好处。

abstract.text: The Affordable Care Act eliminated cost-sharing for contraception for Americans with health insurance, but substantial cost sharing remains for uninsured individuals who seek care through Title X—a national family planning program that provides patient-centered, subsidized contraception and reproductive health services in the U.S. This paper uses a randomized control trial (RCT) to examine how cost-sharing at Title X providers affects the choice of contraceptive method. The study randomizes vouchers that cover any contraceptive method up to the cost of 50% or 100% of a name-brand intra-uterine device (IUD). The results show that Title X clients are highly constrained by the out-of-pocket costs of contraception. The offer of free contraception is associated with a 40% increase in the use of any birth control method (ITT effect), a 94% increase in the value of birth control purchased, a 328-day (226%) increase in the period covered by contraceptives purchased, and a 324% increase in the likelihood of choosing a long-acting, reversible method (an IUD or implant). The results imply that eliminating the costs of contraception for Title X clients nationwide would reduce undesired pregnancies by 5.3%, birth rates by 3.9%, and abortions by 8.3%, and save $1.43 billion in the first year of the program.

10.3386/w31397.abstractZh: 《平价医疗法案》为拥有健康保险的美国人取消了避孕措施的费用分担，但对于未投保且通过《国家计划生育计划》寻求医疗服务的个人来说，仍需承担相当大的费用。本文通过随机对照试验（RCT）来研究《国家计划生育计划》提供者的费用分担如何影响避孕方法的选择。实验通过随机分配凭证，这些凭证可以覆盖高达50%或100%的品牌宫内节育器（IUD）费用的任何避孕方法。研究结果显示，《国家计划生育计划》的受助者受到避孕措施自付费用的极大限制。免费避孕措施的提供使使用任何避孕方法的比例增加了40%，避孕产品的购买价值增加了94%，避孕措施覆盖的时间延长了328天（相当于226%），选择长效可逆避孕方法（如IUD或植入剂）的可能性增加了324%。研究结果表明，在全国范围内取消《国家计划生育计划》客户的避孕费用分担，可以将不希望发生的妊娠减少5.3%，出生率降低3.9%，堕胎数量减少8.3%，并在该计划实施的第一个年度节省14.3亿美元。

abstract.text: Science funding agencies such as the NIH, NSF, and their counterparts around the world are often criticized for being too conservative, funding incremental innovations over more radical but riskier projects. One explanation for their conservatism is the way the agencies use peer review of scientific proposals. Peer review is the cornerstone of research allocation decisions, but agencies typically base decisions on a simple average of peer review scores. More novel ideas are less likely to gain consistently high ratings across evaluators and are less likely to be funded. Using a discrete choice experiment conducted with a large sample of active biomedical researchers, we find that—in contrast to funding agencies—scientists systematically prefer to fund projects with more reviewer dissensus. Rather than purely focusing on the first moment of the distribution of reviewer scores, they also value the second moment. Further, scientists with the greatest domain expertise on a proposal are more enthusiastic about dissensus, and while appetite for dissensus shrinks as budgets become tighter, it does not disappear completely. Applying our estimates to prior studies mimicking NIH’s review process shows that incorporating expert scientists’ preferences for dissensus would change marginal funding decisions for ten percent of projects worth billions of dollars per year.

10.3386/w31409.abstractZh: 像NIH、NSF这样的科学资助机构，以及世界各地的类似机构，常常因过于保守而受到批评，它们更倾向于资助那些渐进式的创新，而非那些更具风险但可能带来更大回报的项目。这种保守态度的一个解释是，这些机构在评审科学提案时采用同行评审的方式。同行评审是科学研究资金分配决策的基础，但机构通常只是基于同行评审评分的简单平均值来做出决策。那些更具创新性的想法不太可能获得一致的高评分，因此也不太可能被资助。通过对大量活跃的生物医学研究人员进行离散选择实验，我们发现——与资助机构不同——科学家们更倾向于资助那些存在更多意见分歧的项目。他们不仅关注评分分布的第一时刻，还重视第二时刻的情况。此外，对于某个提案而言，拥有最丰富领域专业知识的科学家，对意见分歧的接受程度更高。虽然随着预算的收紧，他们对意见分歧的接受程度会下降，但这种倾向并不会完全消失。将我们的估计结果应用于之前模仿NIH评审流程的研究中，我们发现，如果纳入专家科学家对意见分歧的偏好，那么每年价值数十亿美元的项目中，有10%的项目所需的边际资金决策将会发生变化。

abstract.text: The Child Tax Credit (CTC) was substantially expanded through the American Rescue Plan Act of 2021, making the benefit more generous, fully refundable, and more periodic. Early studies documented the positive impact of the expanded CTC on reducing poverty and food insufficiency, but there is little research on the impact it had on household spending and, specifically, its impact on child-related spending. We use data from the Consumer Expenditure Interview Survey (CE) and impute CTC payments for all qualifying households to examine whether the expanded CTC increased spending overall, in major categories, and on specific items related to children's education and development. Our findings indicate that families utilized the CTC payments to enhance the well-being of both their children and the entire household. For each $100 of imputed CTC payment, our models show that families spent $75, mainly on food ($28), housing ($31), and child-related goods and services ($15). We also found that the spending response for low-income households, Hispanic households, and non-Hispanic Black households was larger than the spending response of the average household. By analyzing the variation in spending response by race and ethnicity, we are providing policy makers with valuable insights into the experience of marginalized communities.

10.3386/w31412.abstractZh: 儿童税收抵免（CTC）通过2021年《美国救援计划法案》大幅扩展，使该福利更加慷慨、可全额退还，并且发放频率更高。早期的研究表明，扩展的CTC对减少贫困和食物不足产生了积极影响，但关于其对家庭支出影响的研究较少，尤其是对其与儿童相关支出的影响。我们利用消费者支出调查数据，为所有符合条件的家庭估算CTC支付金额，以研究扩展的CTC是否增加了总体支出、主要类别支出以及与儿童教育和发展相关的具体项目支出。我们的研究结果表明，家庭利用CTC支付来提升其子女和整个家庭的福祉。对于每100美元的CTC支付金额，我们的模型显示，家庭在食品（28美元）、住房（31美元）以及与儿童相关的商品和服务（15美元）上的支出分别增加了75美元。我们还发现，低收入家庭、西班牙裔家庭和非西班牙裔黑人家庭的支出反应比平均家庭更为强烈。通过分析不同种族和族裔的支出反应差异，我们为政策制定者提供了有关边缘化社区经历的宝贵信息。

abstract.text: Full automation using Artificial Intelligence (AI) predictions may not be optimal if humans have information not available to the AI (contextual information). We study human-AI collaboration using an information experiment with professional radiologists. Results show that providing (i) AI predictions does not improve performance on average, whereas (ii) contextual information does. Radiologists do not realize the gains from AI assistance because of errors in belief updating – they underweight AI predictions and treat their own information and AI predictions as statistically independent. Unless these mistakes can be corrected, the optimal human-AI collaboration design delegates cases either to humans or to AI, but rarely to AI assisted humans.

10.3386/w31422.abstractZh: 使用人工智能预测实现完全自动化可能并非最优选择，因为人类掌握着人工智能无法获取的信息（即上下文信息）。我们通过与专业放射科医生的信息实验来研究人类与人工智能的协作关系。结果表明，提供人工智能预测平均而言并不能提升性能，而上下文信息的提供则能够带来提升。放射科医生未能意识到人工智能辅助带来的优势，原因在于信念更新的错误——他们低估了人工智能的预测结果，并将自己的信息与人工智能的预测结果视为统计上独立的。除非能够纠正这些错误，否则最优的人类与人工智能协作方式是将病例分配给人类或人工智能，但很少分配给由人工智能辅助的人类。

abstract.text: The New Cooperative Medical Scheme (NCMS) rolled out in China from 2003-2008 provided insurance to 800 million rural Chinese. We combine aggregate mortality data with individual survey data, and identify the impact of the NCMS from program rollout and heterogeneity across areas in their rural share. We find that there was a significant decline in aggregate mortality, with the program saving more than one million lives per year at its peak, and explaining 78% of the entire increase in life expectancy in China over this period. We confirm these mortality effects using micro-data on mortality, other health outcomes, and utilization.

10.3386/w31423.abstractZh: 新合作医疗计划（NCMS）于2003年至2008年间在中国实施，为8亿中国农村人口提供了医疗保障。我们结合总体死亡数据和个人调查数据，分析了该计划实施对农村地区的显著影响以及地区间的差异。研究发现，总体死亡率显著下降，在计划实施的高峰期，每年挽救了超过一百万人的生命，并解释了这一时期中国预期寿命整体增长的78%。我们通过关于死亡率、其他健康结果和医疗利用的微观数据进一步证实了这些死亡率的改善效果。

abstract.text: Existing research on selection in insurance markets focuses on how adverse selection distorts prices and misallocates products across people. This ignores the distributional consequences of who pays the higher prices. In this paper, we show that the distributional incidence depends on the correlations between income, expected costs, and insurance demand. We discuss the general implications for the design of subsidies and mandates when policymakers value both equity and efficiency. Then, in an empirical case study of a large employer, we show that the incidence of selection falls on higher-income employees, who are more likely to choose generous health insurance plans.

10.3386/w31435.abstractZh: 现有关于保险市场选择问题的研究主要关注逆向选择如何扭曲价格以及如何导致产品在不同人群之间的错配。然而，这些研究忽略了谁会支付更高价格这一分配后果。在本文中，我们指出分配负担的分配情况取决于收入、预期成本与保险需求之间的相关性。我们讨论了当政策制定者同时重视公平与效率时，补贴和强制措施的设计应如何调整。最后，通过对一个大型雇主的实证案例研究，我们发现选择问题的负担主要落在高收入员工身上，这些员工更有可能选择较高的医疗保险计划。

abstract.text: I demonstrate that the profound change in working from home (WFH) in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic is concentrated among individuals with college degrees. Relative to 2015-19, the number of minutes worked from home on “post-pandemic” (August 2021-December 2022) weekdays increased by 78 minutes for college graduates; for non-graduates, it was 22 minutes. The share of work done at home (for those who worked at all) increased by 22% for graduates and 7% for non-graduates. Average minutes worked changed little for either group. Daily time spent traveling (e.g., commuting) fell by 21 minutes for college graduates and 6 minutes for non-graduates. I examine how time-use patterns change for college graduates relative to non-graduates over the same period. College graduates experience a relative shift from eating out to eating at home, an increase in free time, and an increase in time spent with children, with the latter effect being concentrated among fathers. Thus, while the gender gap in childcare among college graduates may be diminished by the WFH revolution, gaps in children’s outcomes by parents’ college attainment may be exacerbated by it.

10.3386/w31439.abstractZh: 我证明，在COVID-19大流行之后，居家工作模式的深刻变化主要集中在拥有大学学位的人群中。与2015-19年期间相比，在“后疫情时代”（2021年8月至2022年12月），大学毕业生在工作日居家工作的分钟数增加了78分钟；非毕业生则增加了22分钟。对于所有工作的人来说，在家完成工作的比例，大学毕业生增加了22%，非毕业生则增加了7%。两组人的平均工作时间几乎没有变化。大学毕业生每天用于通勤的时间减少了21分钟，非毕业生则减少了6分钟。我进一步研究了同期大学毕业生与非毕业生在时间使用模式上的变化。大学毕业生相对地从外出就餐转变为在家就餐，自由时间有所增加，与子女相处的时间也有所增加，其中父亲这一效应更为明显。因此，虽然居家工作模式可能缩小了大学毕业生在育儿方面的性别差距，但父母的教育程度差异可能会加剧子女成长过程中的差异。

abstract.text: Staggered difference-in-differences designs are pervasive in policy evaluations but little is known about the mechanisms of policy diffusion: How and why do such policies spread across jurisdictions? In this study, we highlight the role of elections in policy diffusion in settings where municipal elections are asynchronous due to historical reasons. First, we empirically show the presence of policy diffusion using neighbors’ election cycles as instruments for neighbors’ policy adoption. Second, we further demonstrate interactions of municipalities’ election cycles with neighbors’ adoption and show that they follow neighbors’ policy only during their own election timing, indicating that policy diffuses through elections.

10.3386/w31441.abstractZh: 交错差异-差异设计在政策评估中非常常见，但关于政策扩散的机制却知之甚少：这些政策是如何以及为何在各个司法管辖区之间传播的？在这项研究中，我们重点关注在由于历史原因导致市政选举不同步的情况下，选举在政策扩散中的作用。首先，我们通过使用邻居的选举周期作为工具变量，实证展示了政策扩散的存在。其次，我们进一步证明了市政选举周期与邻居采纳政策之间的互动关系，并表明这些政策仅在自己的选举期间跟随邻居的政策，这表明政策是通过选举来传播的。

abstract.text: Pragmatic cancer screening trials mimic real-world scenarios in which patients and doctors are the ultimate arbiters of treatment. Intention-to-screen (ITS) analyses of such trials maintain randomization-based apples-to-apples comparisons, but differential adherence (the failure of subjects assigned to screening to actually get screened) makes ITS effects hard to compare across trials and sites. We show how instrumental variables (IV) methods address the nonadherence challenge in a comparison of estimates from 17 sites in five randomized trials measuring screening effects on colorectal cancer incidence. While adherence rates and ITS estimates vary widely across and within trials, IV estimates of per-protocol screening effects are remarkably consistent. An application of simple IV tools, including graphical analysis and formal statistical tests, shows how differential adherence explains variation in ITS impact. Screening compliers are also shown to have similar demographic characteristics to those of the full trial study sample. These findings argue for the clinical relevance of IV estimates of cancer screening effects.

10.3386/w31443.abstractZh: 务实的癌症筛查试验模仿了现实世界中的情景，在这种情景中，患者和医生是治疗的最终决策者。对这些试验的筛查意向分析能够保持基于随机化的同类比较，但不同受试者的依从性差异（即被分配到筛查组的人中，实际进行筛查的比例不同）使得难以跨试验和地点比较这些分析的结果。我们展示了如何利用工具变量方法来解决非依从性问题，通过比较来自五项随机试验的17个试验的估计结果，这些试验分别研究了筛查对结直肠癌发病率的影响。尽管不同试验之间的依从率以及筛查意向分析的结果存在很大差异，但工具变量方法得出的每例受试者符合筛查标准的效果估计却非常一致。通过简单的工具变量工具，包括图形分析和正式的统计检验，可以揭示不同受试者的依从性差异如何解释筛查效果的差异。此外，筛查依从性较高的受试者的特征与整个试验样本中的受试者特征相似。这些发现强调了工具变量方法在评估癌症筛查效果方面的临床意义。

abstract.text: Health expenditure data almost always include extreme values, implying that the underlying distribution has heavy tails. This may result in infinite variances as well as higher-order moments and bias the commonly used least squares methods. To accommodate extreme values, we propose an estimation method that recovers the right tail of health expenditure distributions. It extends the popular two-part model to develop a novel three-part model. We apply the proposed method to claims data from one of the biggest German private health insurers. Our findings show that the estimated age gradient in health care spending differs substantially from the standard least squares method.

10.3386/w31444.abstractZh: 健康支出数据几乎总是包含极端值，这意味着其潜在分布具有重尾特性。这可能导致方差无限增大，以及高阶矩的偏差，从而影响常用的最小二乘法。为了处理极端值，我们提出了一种估计方法，能够捕捉健康支出分布的右尾部分。该方法将流行的两部分模型扩展为新的三部分模型。我们将所提出的方法应用于德国最大的私人健康保险公司之一的索赔数据。研究发现，与健康支出标准的最小二乘法相比，所估计的年龄梯度存在显著差异。

abstract.text: We estimate health associations across generations and dynasties using information on healthcare visits from administrative data for the entire Norwegian population. A parental mental health diagnosis is associated with a 9.3 percentage point (40%) higher probability of a mental health diagnosis of their adolescent child. Intensive margin physical and mental health associations are similar, and dynastic estimates account for about 40% of the intergenerational persistence. We also show that a policy targeting additional health resources for the young children of adults diagnosed with mental health conditions reduced the parent-child mental health association by about 40%.

10.3386/w31446.abstractZh: 我们利用挪威全体人口行政数据中的医疗就诊信息，估计了不同世代和家族之间的健康关联。父母的精神健康诊断与子女精神健康诊断的概率高出9.3个百分点（40%）。身体和心理健康之间的关联程度相似，而家族间的关联贡献了约40%的代际持续性。我们还发现，针对被诊断出精神健康问题的成年人子女提供额外健康资源的政策，可使父母与子女之间的精神健康关联减少约40%。

abstract.text: Despite a recent and dramatic re-evaluation of the health consequences of alcohol consumption, very little is known about the effects of in utero exposure to alcohol on long-run outcomes such as later-life mortality. Here, we investigate how state by year variation in alcohol control arising from the repeal of federal prohibition affects mortality for cohorts born in the 1930s. We find that individuals born in wet states experienced higher later-life mortality than individuals born in dry states, translating into a 3.3% increase in mortality rates between 1990 and 2004 for affected cohorts.

10.3386/w31451.abstractZh: 尽管最近对酒精消费对健康的影响进行了重新评估，但关于子宫内接触酒精对长期结果（如晚年死亡率）的影响，我们知之甚少。本研究探讨了由于联邦禁令的废除而导致的各州酒精管控政策的变化，以及这些变化对1930年代出生的群体晚年死亡率的影响。研究发现，出生在禁酒州的个体比出生在戒酒州的个体在晚年死亡率更高，1990年至2004年间，受影响群体的死亡率增加了3.3%。

abstract.text: Previous literature presents mixed evidence on the effect of alcohol consumption on labor market outcomes. Due to limitations of available structural methods that model state dependence and unobserved heterogeneity, previous literature has not separately identified the causal pathways linking moderate versus heavy alcohol use to employment. This study develops a multiple-equation dynamic discrete choice ordered logit model, separately identifying the contribution of state dependence (within and between outcomes) and unobserved heterogeneity. Using this newly-developed methodology, this study finds that moderate alcohol use increases employment, indicating that policies that target alcohol consumption separately by dosage level may be beneficial to employment.

10.3386/w31453.abstractZh: 先前的研究对于酒精消费对劳动力市场结果的影响存在不同的研究结果。由于现有的结构模型在模拟状态依赖性和未观测异质性方面的局限性，之前的研究未能单独识别出中度与重度酒精使用与就业之间的因果路径。本研究开发了一个多方程动态离散选择有序逻辑模型，分别识别了状态依赖性（在结果内部和结果之间）以及未观测异质性的影响。利用这一新开发的方法论，本研究发现中度酒精使用会增加就业率，这表明针对不同酒精消费水平制定政策可能对就业有积极影响。

abstract.text: A significant literature has documented trend increases in pain among Americans over the last two or three decades. There is no single explanation seeming to work well for the increase. We show that, rather than resulting from a smooth upward trend, the increase was almost entirely concentrated in the 2007-2010 period, the time of the Great Recession, a result not uncovered in prior work. The disproportionate increase in pain among the less educated is also shown to have occurred primarily at the time of the Recession, with either little or no trend before or after. The Recession jump occurred only at older ages and, by cohort, primarily only at the ages when they experienced the Recession. However, the jump is difficult to explain, for while there was a temporary decline in employment during the Recession, it is unclear why there it should be followed by a permanent increase in pain. We assess a number of explanations related to family structure, the deterioration of family life, hysteresis, and biopsychosocial channels. While some factors have potential explanatory power, the rise in pain continues to be mysterious and deserves further research in light of our new findings.

10.3386/w31455.abstractZh: 已有大量文献记录了过去两到三十年间美国人的疼痛程度呈上升趋势。目前尚无一种单一的解释能够很好地解释这一现象。我们的研究表明，这种疼痛程度的增加并非持续性的上升趋势，而是主要集中在2007至2010年期间，即经济大衰退时期，这一点在之前的研究中并未被注意到。受教育程度较低的人群中疼痛程度的增加也主要发生在经济大衰退期间，在此之前或之后则几乎没有或没有这种趋势。疼痛程度的突然增加仅发生在年龄较大的群体中，并且主要出现在那些经历经济大衰退的年龄段。然而，这种突然增加的原因难以解释，因为虽然经济大衰退期间就业人数有所减少，但为何随后疼痛程度会持续增加仍不清楚。我们评估了多种解释，包括家庭结构、家庭生活状况的恶化、滞后效应以及生物心理社会因素等。尽管某些因素具有潜在的解释力，但疼痛程度的增加仍然令人困惑，根据我们的新发现，这一现象值得进一步研究。

abstract.text: Is government guiding the invisible hand at the top of the labor market? We use new administrative data to measure physicians' earnings and estimate the influence of healthcare policies on these earnings, physicians' labor supply, and allocation of talent. Combining the administrative registry of U.S.~physicians with tax data, Medicare billing records, and survey responses, we find that physicians' annual earnings average $350,000 and comprise 8.6% of national healthcare spending. The age-earnings profile is steep; business income comprises one-quarter of earnings and is systematically underreported in survey data. There are major differences in earnings across specialties, regions, and firm sizes, with an unusual geographic pattern compared with other workers. We show that health policy has a major impact on the margin: 25% of physician fee revenue driven by Medicare reimbursements accrues to physicians personally. Physicians earn 6% of public money spent on insurance expansions. We find that these policies in turn affect the type and quantity of medical care physicians supply in the short run; retirement timing in the medium run; and earnings affect specialty choice in the long run.

10.3386/w31469.abstractZh: 政府是否在劳动力市场的顶端发挥着“看不见的手”的作用？我们利用新的行政数据来衡量医生的收入，并估算医疗政策对这些收入、医生劳动力供应以及人才分配的影响。结合美国的医生行政登记数据、税收数据、医疗保险账单记录以及调查数据，我们发现医生每年的平均收入为35万美元，占全国医疗支出的8.6%。年龄与收入的对比非常明显：商业收入占收入的一半，而在调查数据中系统性地被低估了。不同专业、地区和企业规模之间的收入存在显著差异，其地理分布与其他职业相比也呈现出不寻常的模式。我们发现医疗政策对医生收入有重大影响：由医疗保险报销产生的25%的医生费用收入直接归医生个人所有。医生获得的收入占公共医疗支出中用于保险扩展部分的6%。我们还发现，这些政策反过来影响医生在短期内提供的医疗服务类型和数量；中期来看，退休时间的选择；长期而言，收入则影响医生选择专业的方向。

abstract.text: We examine the mortality effects of a 1947 school reform in Japan, which extended compulsory schooling from primary to secondary school by as much as 3 years. The abolition of secondary school fees also indicates that those affected by the reform likely came from disadvantaged families who could have benefited the most from schooling. Even in this relatively favorable setting, we fail to find that the reform improved later-life mortality up to the age of 87 years, although it significantly increased years of schooling. This finding suggests limited health returns to schooling at the lower level of educational attainment.

10.3386/w31472.abstractZh: 我们研究了1947年日本一项学校改革对死亡率的影响。该改革将义务教育年限从小学延长至中学，延长了最多3年。取消中学学费也表明，受改革影响的人群可能来自贫困家庭，这些家庭本应能从教育中获得最大收益。即便在相对有利的情况下，我们仍未能发现该改革在87岁之前显著改善了晚年死亡率，尽管它确实显著增加了受教育年限。这一发现表明，教育对健康的回报在较低的教育水平阶段是有限的。

abstract.text: Shortages and rationing are common in health care, yet we know little about the consequences. We examine an 18-month shortage of the pediatric Haemophilus Influenzae Type B (Hib) vaccine. Using insurance claims data and variation in shortage exposure across birth cohorts, we find that the shortage reduced uptake of high-value primary doses by 4 percentage points and low-value booster doses by 26 percentage points. This suggests providers largely complied with rationing recommendations. In the long-run, catch-up vaccination occurred but was incomplete: shortage-exposed cohorts were 4 percentage points less likely to have received their booster dose years later. We also find that the shortage and rationing caused provider switches, extra provider visits, and negative spillovers to other care.

10.3386/w31479.abstractZh: 在医疗保健领域，短缺和配给制度很常见，但我们对其后果知之甚少。我们研究了为期18个月的B型流感嗜血杆菌疫苗短缺事件。通过保险索赔数据以及不同出生队列中短缺暴露程度的变化，我们发现该短缺事件使高价值的基础疫苗接种率降低了4个百分点，而低价值的加强疫苗接种率则降低了26个百分点。这表明医疗服务提供者基本上遵循了配给建议。从长远来看，补种疫苗的工作虽然进行了，但效果并不完全：在经历短缺的队列中，几年后接受加强疫苗的比例降低了4个百分点。我们还发现，短缺和配给制度导致了医疗服务提供者的更换、额外的就诊次数，以及对其他护理服务的负面影响。

abstract.text: We examine how health insurance expansions influence the entry and location decisions of health care providers. While it is generally expected that reductions in consumer prices following insurance expansions will prompt supply-side growth to meet increased demand (Arrow, 1963), we demonstrate both theoretically and empirically that expansions of insurance with low, regulated provider reimbursements (e.g., Medicaid) can instead lead the supply side to contract. Additionally, we show that expansions of insurance with high, market-based prices (e.g., private coverage) can reduce acceptance of public coverage even as they drive growth in the overall concentration of providers.

10.3386/w31483.abstractZh: 我们研究了健康保险扩展如何影响医疗服务提供者的进入和选址决策。虽然通常认为，保险扩展后消费者价格的下降会促使供应方面增长以满足增加的需求（Arrow，1963年），但我们的理论和实证研究表明，低额、受监管的提供者报销机制下的保险扩展（例如医疗补助计划）反而可能导致供应方面收缩。此外，我们还发现，高额的、基于市场的价格下的保险扩展（例如私人保险）可能会降低对公共保险服务的接受度，同时却会促进医疗服务提供者整体集中度的增长。

abstract.text: Evaluating insurance coverage at the individual level abstracts away from the family-level decision making behind healthcare utilization. While traditional private insurance tends to be offered to either adult individuals or whole families, public insurance eligibility is determined person-by-person. Income eligibility thresholds for public coverage can differ for parents and children, and even among children in different age groups. Having different insurance sources, or a mix of insured and uninsured members of a family, may be disruptive to consistent medical care. In this paper we investigate how changes in eligibility thresholds for adults and children are associated with mismatched patterns of insurance coverage. Using the Current Population Survey and the Survey of Income and Program Participation, we document the patterns of insurance mismatch over time and their relationship to Medicaid and State Children’s Health Insurance Program income eligibility thresholds. We find that expansions of parent thresholds can promote uniform insurance coverage for families. These results are driven by families led by single mothers, who are more likely to be affected by Medicaid expansions for parents. Treating a family as the main unit of observation provides important insights and details potential unintended consequences of individual-level public insurance policy.

10.3386/w31491.abstractZh: 在个体层面评估保险覆盖情况，可以脱离医疗使用背后的家庭级决策。传统私人保险通常只提供给成年人或整个家庭，而公共保险的资格则按个人情况确定。父母和子女在公共保险资格上的收入门槛可能不同，甚至不同年龄段的儿童也是如此。拥有不同的保险来源，或者家庭中有保险成员和无保险成员，可能会影响到医疗服务的连贯性。本文研究了成人和儿童资格门槛的变化如何与保险覆盖的不匹配现象相关联。通过利用当前人口调查和收入及项目参与调查的数据，我们记录了保险不匹配的模式随时间的变化情况，以及其与医疗补助和州儿童健康保险计划收入门槛之间的关系。我们发现，提高父母的保险门槛可以促进家庭的统一保险覆盖。这些结果主要出现在由单亲母亲领导的家庭中，这些家庭更有可能受到医疗补助扩展的影响。将家庭作为主要的观察单位，可以揭示个人层面公共保险政策可能带来的意外后果。

abstract.text: Rising reports of suicidal behaviors in children and adolescents have led to the recognition of a youth mental health crisis. However, reported rates can be influenced by access to screening and changes in reporting conventions, as well as by changes in social stigma. Using data on all hospital visits in New Jersey from 2008-2019, we investigate two inflection points in adolescent suicide-related visits and show that a rise in 2012 followed changes in screening recommendations, while a sharp rise in 2016-2017 followed changes in the coding of suicidal ideation. Rates of other suicidal behaviors including self-harm, attempted suicides, and completed suicides were essentially flat over this period. These results suggest that underlying suicide-related behaviors among children, while alarmingly high, may not have risen as sharply as reported rates suggest. Hence, researchers should approach reported trends cautiously.

10.3386/w31493.abstractZh: 关于儿童和青少年自杀行为的报道不断增加，这促使人们意识到青少年心理健康危机的存在。然而，报告的发病率可能会受到筛查机会、报告方式的变化以及社会污名的变化的影响。我们利用2008年至2019年间新泽西州所有医院就诊的数据，研究了青少年自杀相关就诊的两个转折点。结果显示，2012年的上升是由于筛查建议的变化所致，而2016-2017年的急剧上升则是因为自杀念头编码方式的变化。在此期间，其他自杀行为的发生率，包括自伤、自杀未遂和自杀既遂，基本保持不变。这些结果表明，尽管儿童中的自杀相关行为数量令人担忧地高，但其实际上升幅度可能并不如报告中所显示的那么明显。因此，研究人员在对待报告的趋势时应保持谨慎态度。

abstract.text: A menu description exposes strategyproofness by presenting a mechanism to player i in two steps. Step (1) uses others’ reports to describe i’s menu of potential outcomes. Step (2) uses i’s report to select i’s favorite outcome from her menu. We provide novel menu descriptions of the Deferred Acceptance (DA) and Top Trading Cycles (TTC) matching mechanisms. For TTC, our description additionally yields a proof of the strategyproofness of TTC’s traditional description, in a way that we prove is impossible for DA.

10.3386/w31506.abstractZh: 菜单描述通过分两步机制向玩家i展示策略不可预测性。第一步利用其他玩家的报告来描述i的潜在结果菜单。第二步利用i自己的报告，从她的菜单中选择她最喜欢的结果。我们对延迟接受和顶级交易周期这两种匹配机制提出了新颖的菜单描述。对于顶级交易周期，我们的描述还证明了该机制的传统描述具有策略不可预测性，而这一点在延迟接受机制中是不成立的。

abstract.text: Recent research has documented a link between consumer risk preferences over health and the willingness to pay (WTP) for medical technologies. However, the absence of empirical health risk preference estimates so far limits the implementation of this generalized risk-adjusted cost-effectiveness (GRACE) theory, which addresses several limitations of traditional cost-effectiveness analysis (CEA). To address this gap, we elicit from a nationally representative U.S. sample individual risk preference parameters over health-related quality of life (HRQoL) that shed light on health risk attitudes and enable GRACE valuation of medical technology. We find individuals exhibit risk-seeking preferences at low levels of health, switch to risk-averse preferences at health equal to 0.485 (measured on a zero to one scale), and become most risk-averse when their health is perfect (coefficient of relative risk aversion = 4.36). The risk preference estimates imply an empirical premium for disease severity: each unit of health is worth three times more to patients with serious health conditions (health equals 0.5) than those who are perfectly healthy. They also imply that traditional CEA overvalues treatments for the mildest diseases by more than a factor of two. Use of traditional CEA both overstimulates mild disease treatment innovation and underprovides severe disease treatment innovation.

10.3386/w31524.abstractZh: 近期的研究发现，消费者对健康风险的态度与他们对医疗技术的支付意愿之间存在关联。然而，迄今为止缺乏关于健康风险偏好的实证估计，限制了这种广义风险调整成本效益（GRACE）理论的应用，而该理论能够弥补传统成本效益分析（CEA）的局限性。为了填补这一空白，我们从一个具有全国代表性的美国样本中收集了个体对与健康相关的生活质量（HRQoL）的风险偏好参数，这些参数有助于了解健康风险态度，并支持对医疗技术的GRACE评估。研究发现，个体在健康水平较低时表现出风险寻求偏好，当健康水平达到0.485（以0到1的尺度衡量）时，则转变为风险规避偏好，而当健康状态达到完美时（相对风险规避系数为4.36），个体则表现出最强的风险规避倾向。这些风险偏好估计结果表明，疾病严重程度对个体具有实际上的价值：对于健康状况较差的患者（健康水平为0.5），每单位健康的价值是健康完全良好的患者的三倍。此外，这些结果还表明，传统的CEA对最轻微疾病的 치료方案高估了两倍以上。使用传统的CEA不仅过度刺激了轻微疾病的治疗创新，而且未能充分支持严重疾病的治疗创新。

abstract.text: Requiring graphic warning labels (GWLs) on cigarette packaging has become a highly contentious unresolved legal battle. The constitutionality depends, in part, on the likely impact of GWLs on smoking decisions, and whether they generate knowledge as opposed to emotional reactions against smoking. Using an online discrete choice stated preference experiment we compare tobacco choices (cigarettes, e-cigarettes, quitting) for those presented with a GWL versus the currently existing label. We find the fraction of individuals choosing cigarettes to be lower and quitting higher for the GWL group. Our findings reveal that the differences between groups were primarily driven by the evocation of fear and disgust rather than an improvement in health knowledge related to the GWL. The discrete choice experiment also provides new evidence on how cigarette prices, e-cigarette prices, and policy-manipulable e-cigarette attributes such as e-cigarette warning labels, and flavor availability influence tobacco product choices.

10.3386/w31534.abstractZh: 在香烟包装上要求使用图形警示标签（GWLs）已成为一个存在争议且尚未解决的法律问题。其合宪性部分取决于GWLs对吸烟决策可能产生的影响，以及它们是否能引发基于知识的而非情感上的反对吸烟的反应。我们通过在线离散选择偏好实验，比较了在看到GWL标签与现有标签的情况下，人们选择烟草产品（香烟、电子香烟、戒烟）的情况。研究发现，选择香烟的人的比例在GWL组较低，而选择戒烟的人的比例则较高。我们的研究结果表明，两组之间的差异主要源于恐惧和厌恶情绪的激发，而非与GWL相关的健康知识的提升。该离散选择实验还提供了新的证据，表明香烟价格、电子香烟价格，以及可操控的电子香烟属性（如电子香烟警示标签、口味可用性）都会影响人们对烟草产品的选择。

abstract.text: The pharmaceutical market has experienced a massive wave of vertical integration between pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) and health insurers in recent years. Using a unique dataset on insurer-PBM contracts, we document increasing vertical integration in Medicare Part D–vertically integrated insurers' market share increased from about 30% to 80% between 2010 and 2018. Next, we evaluate a large insurer-PBM merger in 2015 to assess the trade-offs of vertical integration–harms to competition due to input and customer foreclosure on the one hand and improved efficiency on the other. We find premium increases after the merger for insurers who bought PBM services from rivals, which is consistent with vertically integrated PBMs raising costs through input foreclosure.

10.3386/w31536.abstractZh: 近年来，药品市场出现了药房福利管理公司（PBMs）与健康保险公司之间大规模的垂直整合现象。通过一项关于保险公司与PBM合同数据的独特研究，我们发现，在Medicare Part D市场中，垂直整合的保险公司的市场份额从2010年的约30%上升到2018年的80%。接下来，我们评估了2015年的一次大型保险公司与PBM的合并，以分析垂直整合带来的竞争损害——一方面是由于对供应商和客户的控制而引发的负面影响，另一方面则是效率的提升。研究发现，从竞争对手那里购买PBM服务的保险公司，其保费在合并后有所上升，这与垂直整合的PBM通过控制供应商而提高成本的做法相符。

abstract.text: Urban forests are ubiquitous, yet their impacts and values remain largely unknown. We study a massive urban afforestation policy in Beijing that planted 1/3 of a million acres of greenery in less than a decade. We conduct a remote-sensing audit of the program, finding that it contributes to a substantial greening up of the city. This causes significant downwind air quality improvement, reducing average PM2.5 concentration at city population hubs by 4.2%. Rapid vegetation growth unexpectedly led to a 7.4% increase in pollen exposure. Analysis of medical claims data shows that increased aeroallergens triggered emergency room visits, mirroring pollution effects though much less severe. Monetized net health benefits of the program amount to 1.5% of the city’s GDP. Urban forests are only partially capitalized in housing values, with buyers mainly appreciating proximity to green spaces but not the air quality improvements they bring.

10.3386/w31554.abstractZh: 城市森林无处不在，但其影响和价值仍然鲜为人知。我们研究了北京一项大规模的绿化政策，该政策在不到十年的时间里种植了30万英亩的绿地。我们对这一项目进行了遥感监测，发现它显著促进了城市的绿化。这导致空气质量显著改善，城市人口密集区的PM2.5平均浓度降低了4.2%。然而，植被的快速生长却意外地导致花粉暴露增加了7.4%。医学索赔数据分析表明，空气中过敏源的增加引发了急诊就诊，其影响虽然不如污染严重，但同样令人担忧。该项目的净健康效益相当于城市GDP的1.5%。城市森林对房价的影响只是部分性的，购房者主要受益于靠近绿地的优势，而空气质量改善带来的好处则未得到充分体现。

abstract.text: This paper examines the impact of school accountability on adult crime and economic self-sufficiency. We employ a unique source of linked administrative data from a Southern state and exploit exogenous variation generated by the state's accountability regime. Our findings indicate that a school's receipt of a lower accountability rating, at the bottom end of the ratings distribution, decreases adult criminal involvement. Accountability pressures also reduce the propensity of students' reliance on social welfare programs in adulthood and these effects persist at least until when individuals reach their early 30s. Further examination reveals that our results are consistent with an explanation related to improvements in human capital accumulation.

10.3386/w31556.abstractZh: 本文探讨了学校问责制对成人犯罪和经济自给能力的影响。我们利用了南方一个州提供的独特关联行政数据来源，并分析了该州问责制制度所引发的外部变化。研究发现，学校在问责评级分布中处于较低等级时，成人犯罪率会下降。问责压力还减少了学生在成年后依赖社会福利项目的倾向，这些效应至少持续到个体30岁出头。进一步分析表明，我们的研究结果与人力资本积累改善的解释相一致。

abstract.text: Public disability programs provide financial support to 12 million working-age individuals per year, though not all eligible individuals take up these programs. Mixed evidence exists regarding the impact of Medicaid eligibility expansion on program take-up, and even less is known about the relationship between Medicaid expansion and racial and ethnic disparities in take-up. Using 2009—2020 Current Population Survey (CPS) data, we compare changes in Supplemental Security Income (SSI) and Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) take-up among respondents with disabilities living in Medicaid expansion states to respondents with disabilities living in non-expansion states, before and after Medicaid expansion. We further explore heterogeneity by race/ethnicity. We find that Medicaid expansion reduced SSI take-up by 10% overall, particularly among White and Hispanic respondents (10% and 21%, respectively). Medicaid expansion increased SSDI take-up by 8% overall, particularly among White and Black respondents (9% and 11%, respectively). Moreover, we find that Medicaid expansion reduced the probability that respondents with disabilities had employer-sponsored health insurance by approximately 8%, suggesting that expansion may have reduced job-lock among the SSDI-eligible, contributing to the observed increase in SSDI take-up.

10.3386/w31557.abstractZh: 公共残疾项目每年为1200万劳动年龄人士提供经济支持，但并非所有符合条件的个人都会选择这些项目。关于医疗补助资格扩展对项目接受程度的影响，目前存在不同的研究结果，而关于医疗补助扩展与种族和族裔差异之间的关系则知之甚少。利用2009至2020年的当前人口调查数据，我们比较了在医疗补助扩展州和非扩展州生活的残疾人士在医疗补助扩展前后，补充安全收入和社会安全残疾保险接受情况的变化。我们还探讨了不同种族/族裔群体的差异。研究发现，医疗补助扩展总体上使补充安全收入的接受率降低了10%，尤其是在白人和西班牙裔人群中（分别降低了10%和21%）。而社会安全残疾保险的接受率则整体上升了8%，尤其是在白人和黑人人群中（分别上升了9%和11%）。此外，我们发现医疗补助扩展使残疾人士拥有雇主赞助的健康保险的概率降低了约8%，这表明扩展可能减少了符合社会安全残疾保险资格的人士的就业锁定问题，从而促进了社会安全残疾保险接受率的上升。

abstract.text: This paper examines the tradeoffs of monitoring for wasteful public spending. By penalizing unnecessary spending, monitoring improves the quality of public expenditure and incentivizes firms to invest in compliance technology. I study a large Medicare program that monitored for unnecessary healthcare spending and consider its effect on government savings, provider behavior, and patient health. Every dollar Medicare spent on monitoring generated $24–29 in government savings. The majority of savings stem from the deterrence of future care, rather than reclaimed payments from prior care. I do not find evidence that the health of the marginal patient is harmed, indicating that monitoring primarily deters low-value care. Monitoring does increase provider administrative costs, but these costs are mostly incurred upfront and include investments in technology to assess the medical necessity of care.

10.3386/w31559.abstractZh: 本文探讨了监控措施对浪费性公共支出的权衡。通过惩罚不必要的支出，监控措施提升了公共支出的质量，并激励企业投资合规技术。我研究了一个大型的医疗保险项目，该项目对不必要的医疗支出进行了监控，并考察了其对政府节省成本、医疗服务提供者行为以及患者健康的影响。医疗保险在监控上每花费一美元，就能带来24至29美元的政府节省成本。大部分节省的成本来自于对未来护理行为的威慑作用，而非从之前的护理中回收费用。我没有发现边际患者的健康状况受到损害的证据，这表明监控措施主要起到了抑制低价值护理的作用。监控确实增加了医疗服务提供者的行政成本，但这些成本大多发生在前期，包括用于评估医疗必要性的技术投资。

abstract.text: Does the intellectual endowment of born children affect their parents’ future fertility choices? We study the effect of positive or negative shocks to child endowment on the intensive margin of fertility using data on intellectually gifted and intellectually disabled children. Because families with an exceptional-endowment child differ from those without, we propose quasi-experiments that exploit differences in the child’s birth order to estimate the effect of their birth on further fertility. We find that the birth of a gifted child increases family size. However, parents must be able to recognize the endowment’s exceptional ability for it to have an effect. Similarly, the birth of an intellectually disabled child negatively affects family size, but only when the child is of high birth order. Our results point to child endowment as an important factor in determining fertility choices.

10.3386/w31560.abstractZh: 天生智力出众的儿童是否会影响其父母的生育选择？本研究通过研究智力超常和智力障碍儿童出生时所处的顺序，探讨了儿童智力状况的积极或消极影响对生育选择的影响。由于智力出众的儿童所出生的家庭与没有这种儿童的家庭有所不同，我们设计了实验性研究，利用这些差异来估计出生顺序对生育选择的影响。研究发现，智力出众的儿童出生会增加家庭规模。然而，父母必须能够认识到这种儿童所具备的卓越能力，才能对其生育选择产生影响。同样，智力障碍儿童出生也会对家庭规模产生负面影响，但仅当该儿童处于较高的出生顺序时才会如此。我们的研究结果表明，儿童智力状况是决定生育选择的重要因素之一。

abstract.text: This paper provides estimates of the contemporaneous effect of drinking water quality violations on students’ academic achievement. Using student-level test score data with residential addresses, geographic information on water systems, and drinking water violations from North Carolina, I estimate the within-student impacts of poor water quality on student test scores. Exposure to a bacteria violation during the school year decreases math scores by about 0.038 standard deviations when the public is uninformed. Results suggest that poor water quality may impact retention or comprehension of material throughout the school year.

10.3386/w31564.abstractZh: 本文对饮用水质量违规对学生学业成绩的影响进行了估算。利用包含学生住址、水系统地理信息以及北卡罗来纳州饮用水违规记录的测试成绩数据，我们评估了水质不良对学生测试成绩的影响。在公众不知情的情况下，学年期间遭遇细菌违规事件会导致数学成绩下降约0.038个标准差。研究结果表明，水质不良可能会影响整个学年的留级率或学生对知识的理解能力。

abstract.text: Previous research in the US has found negative health effects of contamination when it triggers regulatory violations. An important question is whether levels of contamination that do not trigger a health-based violation impact health. We study the impact of drinking water contamination in community water systems on birth outcomes using drinking water sampling results data in Pennsylvania. We create an overall water quality index and an index specific to reproductive health. We focus on the effects of water contamination for births not exposed to regulatory violations. Our most rigorous specification employs mother fixed effects and finds changing from the 10th to the 90th percentile of water contamination (among births not exposed to regulatory violations) increases low birth weight by 12% and preterm birth by 17%.

10.3386/w31567.abstractZh: 美国之前的研究发现，污染会引发监管违规，从而对健康产生负面影响。一个重要的问题是，那些不会引发健康问题的污染水平是否会对健康产生影响。我们研究了宾夕法尼亚州社区供水系统中的饮用水污染对出生结果的影响，使用了饮用水采样数据。我们创建了一个整体水质指数和一个专门针对生殖健康的指数。我们重点关注那些未受到监管违规影响的出生案例中的水质污染影响。我们最严谨的模型采用了母亲固定效应，发现水质污染从第10百分位上升到第90百分位时，低出生体重率增加12%，早产率增加17%。

abstract.text: There are widespread differences in total factor productivity across producers in the U.S. and around the world. To explain these variations, we use simple economic insights to test the extent to which U.S. hospitals misallocate inputs by examining if the marginal return to specific inputs, conditional on total cost, differs from zero. This test does not require knowledge of the production function or specific input prices. We find large and systematic deviations from efficiency: Holding spending fixed, misallocation is estimated to account for as much as 3.3 percentage points (11% of mortality) across hospitals, and explains roughly 25% of hospital productivity variation. These results suggest large gains from improving how—not how much—hospitals spend.

10.3386/w31569.abstractZh: 在美国和全球范围内，不同生产者的全要素生产率存在广泛差异。为了解释这些差异，我们利用简单的经济原理来测试美国医院在投入分配上的偏差程度，即特定投入的边际回报是否为零。这一测试不需要了解生产函数或具体投入价格的信息。我们发现，在支出固定的情况下，投入分配不当导致的效率损失高达3.3个百分点（占死亡率的11%），并且大约解释了25%的医院生产率差异。这些结果表明，改进医院支出方式所带来的收益是巨大的。

abstract.text: High-speed internet has increased the amount of information available in health care markets. Online information may improve health outcomes if it reduces information frictions and helps patients choose higher quality providers or causes providers to improve quality. We examine how health outcomes for common procedures in Medicare changed after broadband internet rolled out across ZIP Codes from 1999 to 2008. Estimates imply that broadband expansion improved health outcomes by 5%. Broadband access primarily helped patients choose higher-quality providers; we also find some evidence that broadband improved provider quality. We use a structural model to decompose the improvements in patient outcomes over time. Counterfactual simulations imply that broadband roll-out was responsible for 16% of the improvement in outcomes by the end of the period.

10.3386/w31579.abstractZh: 高速互联网增加了医疗保健市场中的信息量。如果在线信息能够减少信息摩擦，并帮助患者选择更优质的医疗服务提供者，或者促使医疗服务提供者提升服务质量，那么这些信息可能会改善健康结果。我们研究了从1999年到2008年间，随着宽带互联网在多个邮政编码区普及，Medicare常见医疗程序的健康结果发生了哪些变化。估计结果显示，宽带网络的普及使健康结果改善了5%。宽带接入主要帮助患者选择了更优质的医疗服务提供者；我们还发现了一些证据表明，宽带网络也提升了医疗服务提供者的质量。我们使用结构模型来分解这些随时间变化的健康结果改善情况。反事实模拟显示，到该时期末，宽带网络的普及对健康结果的改善贡献了16%。

abstract.text: This paper examines the extent to which changes in working-age shares associated with population aging might slow economic growth in upcoming years. We first analyze the economic effects of changing working-age shares in a standard empirical growth model using country panel data from 1950–2015. We then juxtapose the estimates with predicted shifts in population age structure to project economic growth in 2020–2050. Our results indicate that population aging will slow economic growth throughout much of the world. Expansions of labor supply due to improvements in functional capacity among older people can cushion much of this demographic drag.

10.3386/w31585.abstractZh: 本文探讨了与人口老龄化相关的劳动年龄人口比例变化在多大程度上可能会减缓未来几年的经济增长。我们首先使用1950年至2015年的国家面板数据，在一个标准的实证增长模型中分析了劳动年龄人口比例变化的经济效应。随后，我们将这些估计结果与人口年龄结构的预测变化相结合，以预测2020至2050年的经济增长情况。我们的研究结果表明，全球大部分地区的经济增长将会因人口老龄化而放缓。由于老年人功能能力的提升，劳动力供应的扩大可以抵消这一人口红利带来的负面影响。

abstract.text: Seasonal allergies affect over 400 million people globally, yet the broader economic consequences of pollen exposure remain understudied. Evidence from Japan’s ambulance records suggests that high-pollen days are associated with increases in accidents, including traffic accidents and work-related injuries, which may reflect impaired cognitive performance. Retail scanner data and cellphone mobility records indicate that individuals already engage in avoidance behaviors, such as purchasing allergy products and limiting outdoor activities on weekends. This suggests that relying on individual self-protection may be insufficient to offset these risks, and thus greater government intervention may be warranted to mitigate pollen-related harm.

10.3386/w31593.abstractZh: 季节性过敏影响了全球超过4亿人，然而花粉暴露带来的更广泛的经济后果仍未被充分研究。来自日本救护车记录的证据表明，花粉较多的日子与事故增加有关，包括交通事故和工作相关伤害，这可能反映了认知能力的下降。零售扫描数据和手机移动记录显示，人们已经采取了避免行为，例如购买过敏防护产品以及周末限制户外活动。这表明，仅靠个人自我防护可能不足以抵消这些风险，因此政府可能需要采取更多干预措施来减轻与花粉相关的危害。

abstract.text: Substance abuse is a major risk factor for intimate partner violence (IPV). We investigate how a key supply-side intervention – the abuse-deterrent reformulation of a widely-diverted opioid, OxyContin – affected IPV. Our results indicate counties with greater baseline rates of prescription opioid usage experienced relatively larger declines in IPV after OxyContin’s reformulation. The reformulation reduced IPV only in states with small illicit drug markets, while states with large illicit drug markets experienced increased heroin-involved IPV due to substitution towards illicit opioids. Our results underscore the importance of identifying populations at high risk of substitution to illicit opioids and moderating this risk with evidence-based policies.

10.3386/w31609.abstractZh: 物质滥用是亲密伴侣暴力的主要风险因素。我们研究了一种关键的供应端干预措施——对广泛被滥用的阿片类药物奥施康定进行改型，以抑制其滥用行为——对亲密伴侣暴力的影响。研究结果表明，在处方阿片类药物使用率较高的县，奥施康定的改型后亲密伴侣暴力的发生率有所下降。这种改型仅在非法毒品市场较小的州减少了亲密伴侣暴力，而在非法毒品市场较大的州，由于人们转向非法阿片类药物，涉及海洛因的亲密伴侣暴力有所增加。我们的研究结果强调了识别面临向非法阿片类药物替代风险的高风险人群的重要性，并需要通过基于证据的政策来降低这种风险。

abstract.text: Adolescents in Sub-Saharan Africa have some of the highest rates of intimate partner violence across the globe. This paper evaluates the impact of a randomized controlled trial that offers females a goal setting activity to improve their sexual and reproductive health outcomes and offers their male partners a soccer intervention, which educates and inspires young men to make better sexual and reproductive health choices. Both interventions reduce female reports of intimate partner violence. Impacts are larger among females who were already sexually active at baseline. We develop a model to understand the mechanisms at play. The soccer intervention improves male attitudes around violence and risky sexual behaviors. Females in the goal setting arm take more control of their sexual and reproductive health by exiting violent relationships. Both of these mechanisms drive reductions in IPV.

10.3386/w31624.abstractZh: 撒哈拉以南非洲的青少年在亲密伴侣暴力方面拥有全球最高的发生率之一。本文评估了一项随机对照试验的影响，该试验为女性提供了目标设定活动，以改善她们的性健康和生殖健康状况，并为她们的男性伴侣提供了足球干预措施，旨在教育并激励年轻男性做出更好的性健康和生殖健康选择。这两种干预措施都减少了女性对亲密伴侣暴力的报告。对于在基线时已经具有性活跃性的女性来说，这些影响更为显著。我们建立了一个模型来理解其中的机制。足球干预措施改善了男性对暴力和风险性行为的态度。参与目标设定活动的女性通过脱离暴力关系，获得了更多对自己性健康和生殖健康的控制权。这两种机制共同推动了亲密伴侣暴力的减少。

abstract.text: Percutaneous coronary intervention facility openings may have differential effects on treatment and health outcomes for Black versus White patients in residentially segregated versus integrated communities. This study looked at changes in patient treatment and health outcomes (same-day PCI, PCI during hospitalization, 30-day mortality, and 1-year mortality) after the opening of a PCI facility within a 15-minute drive of a community. Findings show that Black patients in integrated communities experienced the greatest benefits after a PCI opening for every outcome examined. Healthcare stakeholders may be able to use this data to prioritize PCI openings in communities that will derive the greatest benefits

10.3386/w31626.abstractZh: 经皮冠状动脉介入治疗设施的开放可能对居住隔离社区与融合社区中的黑人与白人患者的治疗和健康结果产生不同的影响。本研究考察了在距离社区15分钟车程范围内开设介入治疗设施后，患者治疗及健康结果（当日冠状动脉介入治疗、住院期间冠状动脉介入治疗、30天死亡率以及1年死亡率）的变化。研究结果表明，在融合社区中，黑人在介入治疗设施开放后，所有评估的结果都获得了最大的改善。医疗相关人士可以利用这些数据来优先在那些将获得最大利益的社区中开设介入治疗设施。

abstract.text: This chapter reviews the econometric approaches typically used to deal with the spike of zeros when modeling non-negative outcomes such as expenditures, income, or consumption.

10.3386/w31632.abstractZh: 本章回顾了在建模非负变量（如支出、收入或消费）时，通常用于处理零值尖峰问题的计量经济学方法。

abstract.text: Mental health disorders account for a significant share of the overall global disease burden. The economic losses from such disorders are staggeringly large, particularly in low-income countries, where people are faced with several unexpected shocks. We test whether improved communication can mitigate such mental health disorders. Partnering with a major telecommunications company, we implement low-cost communication interventions that provide mobile calling credits to a nationally representative set of low-income adults in Ghana during the COVID-19 pandemic. Individuals’ inability to make unexpected calls, need to borrow SOS airtime, and to seek digital loans decreased significantly relative to a control group. As a result, the programs led to a significant decrease in mental distress (-9.8%), the likelihood of severe mental distress by -2.3 percentage points (a quarter of the mean prevalence), and domestic violence, with null impact on consumption expenditure. The effects are stronger for monthly mobile credits than a lump-sum. We present evidence that improvements in both business-related services and social inclusion and/or protection are relevant explanations. Simple cost-benefit analysis shows that providing communication credit to low-income adults is a cost-effective policy for improving mental health. Communication – the ability to stay connected – meaningfully improves mental well-being and interventions about communication are particularly valuable when implemented as many installments.

10.3386/w31638.abstractZh: 心理健康障碍占全球疾病负担的很大一部分。这类疾病的经济损失极其巨大，尤其是在低收入国家，人们面临着多种意想不到的冲击。我们测试了改善沟通是否能够有效缓解这些心理健康问题。通过与一家大型电信公司合作，我们在COVID-19疫情期间为加纳一组具有全国代表性的低收入成年人提供了低成本的通信干预措施，包括移动通话信用额度。与对照组相比，个人无法进行意外通话、需要借贷通话时间以及寻求数字贷款的情况显著减少。结果，这些项目显著降低了心理困扰程度（-9.8%），严重心理困扰的可能性降低了2.3个百分点（相当于平均患病率的四分之一），同时也没有对消费支出产生显著影响。对于每月提供的移动通话信用额度而言，其效果比一次性提供信用额度更为显著。我们的证据表明，改善商业相关服务以及促进社会包容性和/或保护也是重要的解释因素。简单的成本效益分析表明，为低收入成年人提供通信信用额度是一种具有成本效益的改善心理健康政策。沟通——保持联系的能力——显著提升了心理健康状况，而分期实施的沟通干预措施尤其有价值。

abstract.text: We study how reminding high-risk patients with chronic disease of their upcoming primary care appointments impacts their health care and behaviors. We leverage a natural experiment in Chile’s public healthcare system that sent reminders before preventative care appointments to over 300,000 patients with type 2 diabetes and hypertension across 315 public primary care clinics between 2013 and 2018. Employing both a difference-in-differences and instrumental variables approach on national administrative patient-level data, we show that reminders increased preventative care visits, which led to more health screenings and improved medication adherence. In this at-scale program, we find substantial variation in implementation fidelity across clinics, which, once accounted for increases our estimates by over a third. Reminders also increased hospitalizations and reduced in-hospital mortality, suggesting an improvement in timely care-seeking behavior among high-risk patients. Our findings inform healthcare settings where patients must first visit their primary care provider for approval before undergoing tests, receiving medication prescriptions, or getting referrals to other specialists. Through intervening at the first step in the cascade of care, we find that a simple intervention like reminders can have large and meaningful downstream effects.

10.3386/w31643.abstractZh: 我们研究了提醒患有慢性病的高风险患者即将到来的初级保健预约对他们医疗保健和行为的影响。我们利用智利公共医疗保健系统中的一个自然实验，在2013年至2018年间，向315个公共初级保健诊所的30多万名2型糖尿病和高血压患者发送了预防性护理预约提醒。通过采用差异-差异法和工具变量方法，基于全国行政患者级数据，我们发现提醒增加了预防性护理的就诊次数，从而促进了更多的健康筛查和药物依从性的改善。在这个大规模项目中，我们发现不同诊所在实施效果上存在显著差异，一旦考虑到这些因素，我们的估计值增加了三分之一以上。提醒还减少了住院次数和院内死亡率，表明高风险患者的及时就医行为有所改善。我们的发现对于那些患者必须先就诊于初级保健医生以获得批准，才能接受检查、获得药物处方或转介给其他专科医生的情况具有参考价值。通过在护理链的第一步进行干预，我们发现像提醒这样的简单干预措施可以产生巨大且有意义的后续影响。

abstract.text: In 1996, following an epidemic, Pfizer tested a new drug on 200 children in Muslim Nigeria. 11 children died while others were disabled. We study the effects of the disclosure, in 2000, of the deaths of Muslim children in the Pfizer trials on vaccine compliance among Muslim mothers. Muslim mothers reduced routine vaccination of children born after the 2000 disclosure. The effect was stronger for educated mothers and mothers residing in minority Muslim neighborhoods. The disclosure did not affect other health-seeking behavior of mothers. The results illustrate the potential spillover effects of perceived medical malpractice on future vaccine hesitancy.

10.3386/w31655.abstractZh: 1996年，在疫情之后，辉瑞公司在尼日利亚的穆斯林地区对200名儿童进行了新药的试验。其中11名儿童死亡，其他儿童则出现了残疾。我们研究了2000年辉瑞试验中对穆斯林儿童死亡事件的公开报道对穆斯林母亲疫苗接种意愿的影响。结果显示，在2000年公开报道后，穆斯林母亲减少了为子女接种常规疫苗的行为。这一影响在受过教育的母亲以及居住在穆斯林少数民族社区的母亲中更为明显。不过，这一公开报道并未影响母亲们的其他健康寻求行为。研究结果揭示了被视作医疗过失的信息可能对未来疫苗接种意愿产生的影响。

abstract.text: We evaluate the introduction of direct-acting antiviral (DAA) therapy for Hepatitis C (HCV) on liver transplant allocation in the United States. We develop a model of listing and organ acceptance behavior for patients with both HCV-positive and HCV-negative end-stage liver disease. In the model, DAAs obviate the need for transplant for some HCV-positive patients, which shortens the waiting list, potentially benefiting HCV-negative registrants and inducing marginal HCV-negative patients to list. Using data from the universe of transplants between 2005 and 2019, we find that DAA availability resulted in an additional 5,682 liver transplants to HCV-negative recipients between 2014 and 2019, driven in part by a 37% average annual increase in HCV-negative waiting list registrations. Our estimates imply that DAAs generated $7.52 billion in positive externalities for HCV-negative patients during this period.

10.3386/w31673.abstractZh: 我们评估了在美国引入直接作用抗病毒疗法（DAA疗法）对丙型肝炎（HCV）患者肝脏移植分配的影响。我们建立了一个模型，用于分析HCV阳性及HCV阴性终末期肝病患者的器官分配与接受行为。该模型显示，DAA疗法使得部分HCV阳性患者无需进行移植手术，从而缩短了等待名单的时间，这可能有利于HCV阴性患者，并促使部分HCV阴性患者主动申请器官分配。通过2005至2019年间肝脏移植数据的研究发现，DAA疗法的普及使得2014至2019年间HCV阴性受者获得了额外的5,682例肝脏移植手术，这一增长部分是由于HCV阴性患者的等待名单登记人数年均增加了37%。我们的估算表明，在此期间，DAA疗法为HCV阴性患者带来了总计75.2亿美元的正面效益。

abstract.text: Jobs increasingly require good decision-making.Workers are valued not only for how much they can do, but also for their ability to decide what to do.In this paper we develop a theory and measurement paradigm for assessing individual variation in the ability to make good decisions about resource allocation, which we call allocative skill.We begin with a model where agents strategically acquire information about factor productivity under time and effort constraints.Conditional on such constraints, agents' allocative skill can be defined as the marginal product of their attention.We test our model in a field survey where participants act as managers assigning fictional workers with heterogeneous productivity schedules to job tasks and are paid in proportion to output.Allocative skill strongly predicts full-time labor earnings, even conditional on IQ, numeracy, and education, and the return to allocative skill is greater in decision-intensive occupations.

10.3386/w31674.abstractZh: 工作越来越需要良好的决策能力。员工不仅因其能力而被重视，还因其决定做什么的能力而被重视。在本文中，我们提出了一个理论和测量框架，用于评估个体在资源分配决策方面的能力差异，我们将其称为“分配技能”。我们从一个模型出发，该模型描述了 Agent 在时间和努力限制下获取关于要素生产率的信息的策略性行为。在这些限制条件下，Agent 的分配技能可以被定义为其注意力的边际产品。我们在一项实地调查中测试了我们的模型，参与者扮演管理者角色，将具有不同生产率安排的虚构工人分配到工作任务中，并依据产出获得报酬。分配技能能够强烈预测全职劳动力的收入，即使是在智商、计算能力和教育水平给定的情况下也是如此，而且在决策密集型职业中，分配技能的回报更高。

abstract.text: We study the implications of police discretion for public safety.Highway patrol officers exercise discretion over fines by deviating from statutory fine rules.Relying on variation across officers in this discretionary behavior, we find that harsher sanctions reduce future traffic offending and crash involvement.We then show that officer discretion over sanctions decreases public safety by comparing observed reoffending rates with those in a counterfactual without discretion, estimated using an identification at infinity approach.About half the safety cost of discretion is due to officer decisions which result in harsh sanctions for motorists who are least deterred by them.We provide evidence that this officer behavior is attributable to a preference for allocating harsh fines to motorists with higher recidivism risk, who are also the least responsive to harsher sanctions.

10.3386/w31678.abstractZh: 我们研究了警察自由裁量权对公共安全的影响。公路巡逻警察在罚款决定上行使自由裁量权，偏离法定的罚款规则。通过对比不同警察在这方面的自由裁量行为，我们发现更严厉的处罚可以减少未来的交通违法行为和交通事故。接着，我们通过比较实际观察到的再犯罪率与没有自由裁量权的情况下的再犯罪率，来揭示警察自由裁量权对公共安全的影响。自由裁量权带来的大约一半的安全成本，是由于警察选择对那些最不受严厉处罚措施影响的驾驶者施加严厉的处罚所致。我们有证据表明，这种警察行为源于一种偏好，即将严厉的罚款分配给那些再犯罪风险更高、且对更严厉处罚反应最不积极的驾驶者。

abstract.text: We provide the first estimates of the negative impact of exposure to extremely high temperatures during pregnancy on mothers’ labor market outcomes. We employ individual-level survey data from China and leverage plausibly exogenous fluctuations in heat exposure within cities. The results demonstrate that exposure to extremely hot weather during pregnancy reduces women’s wages and labor supply later in life and increases the likelihood that they will work in an unskilled sector. The effects are stronger for heat exposure during the third gestational trimester. The mechanism for these results is that extreme temperature exposure during pregnancy undermines maternal health. Our analysis proposes a new channel through which extreme weather generates health and economic costs.

10.3386/w31684.abstractZh: 我们首次估算了孕期暴露于极端高温对母亲劳动力市场结果产生的负面影响。我们采用了来自中国的个体级调查数据，并利用了城市内热暴露的 plausible 外生波动。研究结果表明，孕期暴露于极端高温会降低女性的工资和劳动力供给，并增加她们在非技能行业工作的可能性。在妊娠第三孕期暴露于高温的影响更为显著。这些结果的机制在于，孕期极端高温会损害母亲的健康。我们的分析提出了一种新的渠道，通过这一渠道，极端天气会导致健康和经济方面的损失。

abstract.text: Moral hazard and provider-induced demand may contribute to overutilization of scarce health care resources. The U.S. health care system includes several compensatory cost-containment mechanisms, but their effects depend on how patients and providers respond. We investigate hospice programs’ responses to a cap in the Medicare hospice benefit on their average annual payments per patient. We estimate their intensive margin responses to the cap by leveraging variation in cap-related financial incentives generated by the policy’s nonlinear design and the transition between fiscal years. We find that programs on track to exceed the cap in the last three months of a fiscal year raise their enrollment rates by 5.7% and their live discharge rates by 4.3% on average, reducing their cap liabilities. The marginal enrollees have longer average remaining lifetimes and are less likely to have been recently hospitalized. Their hospice spells are also more likely to be fragmented by subsequent live discharges. On the extensive margin, we find that cap liabilities are associated with terminations of Medicare provider certification numbers, suggesting that the cap impacts market structure. Current policy discussions about reducing the cap should consider its potential effect on market structure.

10.3386/w31691.abstractZh: 道德风险以及医疗服务提供方诱导的需求可能会导致稀缺的医疗保健资源的过度使用。美国的医疗保健系统包含多种补偿性成本控制机制，但这些机制的效果取决于患者和医疗服务提供方的反应。我们研究了临终关怀项目对医疗保险临终关怀福利上限政策影响的反应，该政策限制了每位患者的平均年度支付金额。我们通过利用政策非线性的设计以及财政年度之间的转换所带来的财务激励变化，来估计这些项目对上限政策的反应。研究发现，在财政年度的最后三个月内，那些即将超过上限的项目，其注册率平均增加了5.7%，而实际出院率则增加了4.3%，从而减少了其上限负债。这些项目的边际注册者平均剩余寿命更长，且最近住院的可能性较低。他们的临终关怀计划也更有可能因后续的实际出院而变得分散。从整体来看，我们发现上限负债与医疗保险提供者认证数量的减少有关，这表明该政策对市场结构产生了影响。当前关于降低上限的讨论应考虑到其对市场结构的潜在影响。

abstract.text: We investigate the consequences of anti-LGBT laws in Poland for suicide attempts and fatalities by applying border-area difference-in-differences models to county-level data. We find that annual suicide attempts increased by 16%, or 5 attempts per 100k capita, after the enactment of anti-LGBT statutes. This rise in suicide attempts was concentrated among men, and was associated with 11 additional suicides per 100k individuals aged 30-49. We also find an increase in suicide attempts in areas that deliberated, but subsequently rejected anti-LGBT resolutions, providing evidence that stigmatization of minority groups leads to declines in population mental health.

10.3386/w31702.abstractZh: 我们通过应用边界区差异-差异模型对县级数据进行分析，研究了波兰反LGBT法律对自杀企图和死亡人数的影响。研究发现，在反LGBT法规实施后，年度自杀企图增加了16%，即每10万人口中有5起自杀事件。这一增长主要集中在男性中，并且与每10万30-49岁人群中额外增加了11起自杀事件相关。我们还发现，在曾讨论但随后拒绝反LGBT决议的地区，自杀企图也有所增加，这证明了对少数群体的污名化会导致人口心理健康状况的下降。

abstract.text: Happiness data—survey respondents’ self-reported well-being (SWB)—have become increasingly common in economics research, with recent calls to use them in policymaking. Researchers have used SWB data in novel ways, for example to learn about welfare or preferences when choice data are unavailable or difficult to interpret. Focusing on leading examples of this pioneering research, the first part of this review uses a simple theoretical framework to reverse-engineer some of the crucial assumptions that underlie existing applications. The second part discusses evidence bearing on these assumptions and provides practical advice to the agencies and institutions that generate SWB data, the researchers who use them, and the policymakers who may use the resulting research. While we advocate creative uses of SWB data in economics, we caution that their use in policy will likely require both additional data collection and further research to better understand the data.

10.3386/w31727.abstractZh: 在经济学研究中，幸福感数据——即受访者自我报告的幸福感——变得越来越常见，最近也有呼吁将其用于政策制定。研究人员以新颖的方式使用幸福感数据，例如在没有选择数据或难以解释的情况下，用来了解福利或偏好。本综述的第一部分通过简单的理论框架，逆向工程了现有应用中的一些关键假设。第二部分讨论了与这些假设相关的证据，并为生成幸福感数据的机构、使用这些数据的研究人员以及可能利用研究成果的政策制定者提供了实用建议。虽然我们提倡在经济学中创造性地利用幸福感数据，但我们也提醒，在政策中应用这些数据可能需要额外的数据收集以及进一步的研究，以更好地理解这些数据。

abstract.text: Analyses of self-reported-well-being (SWB) survey data may be confounded if people use response scales differently. We use calibration questions, designed to have the same objective answer across respondents, to measure dimensional (i.e., specific to an SWB dimension) and general (i.e., common across questions) scale-use heterogeneity. In a sample of ~3,350 MTurkers, we find substantial such heterogeneity that is correlated with demographics. We develop a theoretical framework and econometric approaches to quantify and adjust for this heterogeneity. We apply our new estimators in several standard SWB applications. Adjusting for general-scale-use heterogeneity changes results in some cases.
