10.3386/w31728.abstractZh: 对自我报告幸福感调查数据的分析可能会因受访者使用回答量表的方式不同而产生混淆。我们采用了校准问题，这些问题的目标答案在受访者之间是相同的，以此来衡量维度上的（即特定于某个幸福感维度的）和一般性的（即跨问题共通的）量表使用差异。在约3,350名MTurkers的样本中，我们发现这种差异是显著的，并且与人口统计特征相关。我们提出了理论框架和计量经济学方法，以量化并调整这种差异。我们在几个标准的幸福感应用中应用了我们的新估计方法。调整一般性量表使用差异后，在某些情况下，结果发生了变化。

abstract.text: We investigate whether increased racial diversity of clinical trial principal investigators could increase the enrollment of Black patients, which currently lags population and disease-burden shares. We conducted a survey experiment in which respondents were shown a photo of a current NIH investigator in which race (Black/White) was randomized. Sex was also randomized as a relevant benchmark. Black respondents reported 0.35 standard deviation units higher interest in participating in a clinical study led by a race concordant investigator (a 12.6% increase). Sex concordance had no effect. Further analyses indicate that perceived trustworthiness and attractiveness are the most important factors explaining these results.

10.3386/w31732.abstractZh: 我们研究了临床试验主要研究人员的种族多样性增加是否能够提高黑人患者的注册人数，目前黑人的注册人数在人口和疾病负担比例上均处于较低水平。我们进行了一项调查实验，实验中向受访者展示了一位当前在NIH工作的研究人员的照片，其中种族（黑人/白人）是随机分配的。性别也作为相关基准进行了随机分配。黑人受访者表示，参与由种族一致的研究人员领导的临床研究的热情高出0.35个标准差单位（即增加了12.6%）。性别一致性对结果没有影响。进一步分析表明，感知的可信度和吸引力是解释这些结果的最重要因素。

abstract.text: We estimate the effects of cash transfers on a severe measure of child welfare: maltreatment. To do so, we leverage year-to-year household variation from a universal and unconditional cash transfer, the Alaska Permanent Fund Dividend (PFD). Using linked individual-level administrative data on PFD payments and child maltreatment referrals, we show that an additional $1,000 to families in the first few months of a child's life reduces the likelihood that a child is referred to Child Protective Services by age three by 2.0 percentage points, or 10 percent, on average. Estimates indicate that additional cash transfers also reduce child mortality.

10.3386/w31733.abstractZh: 我们评估了现金转移对儿童福利的负面影响。为此，我们利用阿拉斯加永久基金股息这一普遍且无条件的现金转移政策所带来的年度家庭差异数据。通过结合个人层面的行政数据，我们发现，在孩子生命的最初几个月向家庭额外提供1,000美元，可以使孩子在三岁前被转介到儿童保护服务机构的概率平均降低2.0个百分点，即10%。研究还表明，额外的现金转移也有助于降低儿童死亡率。

abstract.text: We study the role of physicians in driving geographic variation of US healthcare utilization. We estimate a model that separates variation in average utilization of Medicare beneficiaries due to physicians, non-physician supply side factors, and patient demand. The model is identified by migration of patients and physicians across areas, as well as by variation in within-area matching. We find that physicians vary greatly in the intensity with which they treat otherwise similar patients, and that at least a third of geographic differences in healthcare utilization can be explained by differences in average physician treatment intensity. Conservatively, physicians are three times as important as non-physician supply-side factors in explaining geographic variation. Around three-fifths of physicians’ role comes from differences across areas in physician practice styles within the same specialty, while the other two-fifths reflects differences across areas in physician specialty mix.

10.3386/w31749.abstractZh: 我们研究了医生在驱动美国医疗利用地理差异中的作用。我们建立了一个模型，该模型区分了由于医生、非医生供应方因素以及患者需求导致的医疗保险受益人平均利用情况的差异。该模型的识别基于患者和医生在不同地区的迁移情况，以及区域内匹配的变化。我们发现，医生在对待相似患者时的治疗强度存在很大差异，至少三分之一的医疗利用地理差异可以通过医生平均治疗强度的差异来解释。保守估计，医生在解释地理差异方面的重要性是非医生供应方因素的三倍。大约五分之三的医生作用源于同一专业领域内不同地区的医生执业风格差异，而另外五分之二则反映了不同地区医生专业组合的差异。

abstract.text: Newborn health is an important component in the chain of intergenerational transmission of disadvantage. This paper contributes to the literature on the determinants of health at birth in two ways. First, we analyze the role of maternal endowments and investments (education and smoking in pregnancy) on the probability of having a baby who is small for gestational age (SGA). We estimate both the total impact of maternal endowments on birth outcomes, and we also decompose it into a direct, “biological” effect and a “choice” effect, mediated by maternal behaviors. Second, we estimate the causal effects of maternal education and smoking in pregnancy, and investigate whether women endowed with different traits have different returns. We find that maternal cognition affects birth outcomes primarily through maternal education, that personality traits mainly operate by changing maternal smoking, and that the physical fitness of the mother has a direct, “biological” effect on SGA. We find significant heterogeneity in the effects of education and smoking along the distribution of maternal physical traits, suggesting that women with less healthy physical constitutions should be the primary target of prenatal interventions.

10.3386/w31761.abstractZh: 新生儿健康是代际劣势传递链中的一个重要组成部分。本文从两个方面为关于出生时健康决定因素的文献做出了贡献。首先，我们分析了母亲的教育水平和孕期吸烟行为对婴儿体重不足概率的影响。我们估算了母亲教育水平和孕期吸烟行为对出生结果的总影响，并将其分解为直接的“生物学”效应和通过母亲行为介导的“选择”效应。其次，我们估算了母亲教育和孕期吸烟行为的因果效应，并研究了具有不同特征的母亲是否会有不同的回报。我们发现，母亲的认知水平主要通过教育水平影响出生结果，人格特征主要通过改变孕期吸烟行为来影响出生结果，而母亲的身体健康状况则对婴儿体重不足有直接的“生物学”影响。我们发现，教育和吸烟行为对母亲身体特征的影响存在显著的异质性，这表明身体健康状况较差的女性应该是产前干预的主要目标群体。

abstract.text: This paper examines whether school COVID-19 policies influenced enrollment differently by student age and race/ethnicity. Unlike much prior research, we (i) analyze enrollments for virtually the entire U.S. public school population for both the 2020-21 and 2021-22 school years, (ii) compare enrollment trends within districts in order to isolate subgroup heterogeneity from district characteristics, and (iii) account for district selection into preferred learning modes. Analyzing data on over 9,000 districts that serve more than 90% of public school students in the U.S., we find enrollment responses to COVID policies differed notably. We find that White enrollments declined more than Black, Hispanic, and Asian enrollments in districts that started the 2020-21 school year virtually, but in districts that started in-person the reverse was true: non-White enrollments declined more than White enrollments. Moreover, Black, Hispanic, and Asian families responded more than White families to higher COVID-19 death rates in the months preceding the start of the 2021 school year. In 2021-22, enrollment differences by the previous year’s learning mode persisted. Racial/ethnic differences did not vary by whether the district required masking in classrooms. These findings are consistent with the greater risk faced by communities of color during the pandemic and demonstrate an additional source of disparate impact from COVID policies.

10.3386/w31765.abstractZh: 本文探讨了学校针对COVID-19的政策是否因学生的年龄和种族/族裔不同而产生了不同的入学影响。与以往许多研究不同，我们（i）分析了2020-21学年和2021-22学年的几乎所有美国公立学校学生的入学情况；（ii）比较了不同学区内的入学趋势，以排除学区特征对入学情况的影响；以及（iii）考虑了学区选择对首选学习模式的影响。通过对超过9,000个学区的数据进行分析，这些学区服务了美国90%以上的公立学校学生，我们发现学生对COVID政策的反应存在显著差异。我们发现，在2020-21学年以线上方式开始的学区中，白人的入学人数下降幅度大于黑人、西班牙裔和亚裔学生的入学人数；而在以线下方式开始的学区中，情况则相反：非白人学生的入学人数下降幅度大于白人学生的入学人数。此外，在2021学年开始前的几个月里，黑人、西班牙裔和亚裔家庭对更高的COVID-19死亡率的反应比白人家庭更为强烈。在2021-22学年，前一年的学习模式对入学情况的影响仍然存在。种族/族裔差异并不受学区是否要求学生在教室中佩戴口罩的影响。这些发现与疫情期间有色人种社区面临更大的风险相一致，并表明COVID政策带来的不同影响还有另一个来源。

abstract.text: Firearm violence is a critical public health crisis in the U.S., marked by a significant number of homicides involving firearms, including indiscriminate shootings in public spaces. This study investigates the largely unexplored impact of such violence on newborn health. We adopt two approaches. First, we analyze the 2002 'beltway sniper' attacks in the Washington DC metropolitan area, using administrative birth records with maternal residential addresses in Virginia. The beltway sniper attacks, a series of random shootings in the Washington DC metropolitan area, caused widespread terror and disruption over three weeks. Leveraging both spatial and temporal variation, we compare outcomes of children exposed to the attacks in utero due to timing or having a residential address near a shooting location to those who were not exposed. Second, we investigate the impact of in-utero exposure to mass shootings on infant health using restricted-access U.S. Vital Statistics Natality records between 2006 and 2019 and leveraging variation in the timing of mass shootings in counties with at least one shooting. We document substantial, previously overlooked costs on pregnant women and infants. Exposure to the beltway sniper attacks during pregnancy increased the likelihood of very low birthweight and very premature birth by 25%. The analysis of national mass shootings confirms these findings with slightly smaller effect sizes. These results emphasize the need to consider the broader impact of violence on vulnerable populations when assessing the cost of firearm violence. The estimates suggest additional costs of $155 million (2023 dollars) for the beltway sniper attacks and $75 million annually for mass shootings.

10.3386/w31774.abstractZh: 枪支暴力是美国一个严重的公共卫生危机，其特点是以枪支为凶器的谋杀案数量众多，包括在公共场所发生的无差别枪击事件。本研究探讨了此类暴力对新生儿健康的影响，这一领域目前尚未得到充分研究。我们采用了两种研究方法。首先，我们分析了2002年华盛顿特区大都会区发生的“环城公路狙击手”袭击事件，利用带有母亲居住地址的行政出生记录进行分析。这些袭击事件在华盛顿特区大都会区连续发生，造成了三周内的广泛恐慌和混乱。通过对比那些在子宫内暴露于这些袭击事件中的儿童与未暴露的儿童，我们发现了一些差异。其次，我们利用2006年至2019年间美国生命统计数据的限制访问权限，研究了子宫内暴露于大规模枪击事件对婴儿健康的影响。我们发现，在至少有一个枪击事件的县中，子宫内暴露于这些事件会使极低出生体重和早产的风险增加25%。对全国大规模枪击事件的分析也证实了这些发现，但效应大小略有减小。这些结果强调了在评估枪支暴力的成本时，需要考虑暴力对弱势群体的更广泛影响。估计数据显示，“环城公路狙击手”袭击事件造成的额外成本为1.55亿美元（按2023年美元计算），而大规模枪击事件每年造成的额外成本约为7500万美元。

abstract.text: Between 2000 and 2020, the share of US hospital bed capacity under multi-unit firms (systems) increased from 58% to 81% – a rapid corporatization of a sector with $1.3 trillion in annual spend. However, little is known about how system ownership affects hospital profitability and quality. We combine novel, patient-level transaction price data from a large commercial insurer, Medicare claims, and New York hospital discharges between 2012 and 2018 to study changes at over 100 independent hospitals that transition to system ownership. The targets obtain differentially higher prices than a matched comparison group, but the operating cost reductions, primarily obtained by reducing employees in support functions, capital, and financing costs, are far greater and exhibit significant economies of scale with acquirer firm size. In contrast, we detect small and statistically insignificant effects on operating costs at 135 system-owned hospitals acquired by other systems, suggesting that the switch to system ownership is the key to achieving these savings. However, corporatization may worsen quality of care on some dimensions.

10.3386/w31776.abstractZh: 在2000年至2020年间，由多单位企业（系统）运营的美国医院床位比例从58%上升到81%——这是一个年营业额达1.3万亿美元的行业的快速企业化进程。然而，关于企业所有权如何影响医院盈利能力和服务质量，目前了解甚少。我们结合了一家大型商业保险公司提供的患者交易价格数据、医疗保险索赔数据，以及2012年至2018年间纽约州医院的出院数据，研究了100多家转为企业化运营的医院的变化情况。这些医院的目标患者获得的收费比对照组要高，但运营成本降低的效果更为显著，主要体现在减少支持职能的员工、资本投入和融资成本等方面。此外，我们还发现，由其他系统收购的135家企业化医院在运营成本上的影响较小，且统计上并不显著，这表明转向企业化运营是实现这些成本节约的关键。不过，企业化进程可能会在某些方面恶化医疗服务质量。

abstract.text: China’s distinctive demographic landscape, early retirement policies, and deeply ingrained gender norms provide a unique backdrop for investigating gender disparities in retirement and subjective well-being. Drawing upon data from the China Family Panel Studies and leveraging the variation around the pensionable age cutoff, we find substantial increases in retirement rates, surging by 19 percentage points for males and 13 percentage points for females in proximity to this age threshold. Notably, retirement manifests significant gender heterogeneity in its influence on life satisfaction, leading to an enhancement among males while not yielding statistically significant improvements among females. Furthermore, this study probes multiple dimensions of subjective well-being and objective health behaviors, laying bare gender disparities in health, behaviors, perceptions of income and social status, and confidence about the future. Males showcase improvements in healthy behaviors, report enhanced self-perceived health, perceive higher relative income and social status, and exude greater confidence about their future. In stark contrast, females show no statistically significant changes along these dimensions. In fact, they tend to engage in health-compromising behaviors, such as increased smoking, and exhibit higher rates of obesity. These findings underscore the imperative of recognizing gender disparities in the consequences of retirement on subjective well-being. They highlight the need for targeted policies aimed at enhancing social and economic opportunities for women, ultimately striving for greater gender equality in the post-retirement phase.

10.3386/w31780.abstractZh: 中国独特的人口结构、提前退休政策以及根深蒂固的性别规范为研究退休和主观幸福感方面的性别差异提供了独特的背景。通过中国家庭面板研究的数据，并考虑退休年龄截止点的差异，我们发现退休率有显著上升，男性退休率上升了19个百分点，女性则上升了13个百分点。值得注意的是，退休对生活满意度的影响存在显著的性别差异，男性在这一点上有所改善，而女性则没有显示出统计学上的显著改善。此外，本研究还探讨了主观幸福感和客观健康行为的多个维度，揭示了健康、行为、对收入和社交地位的看法以及对未来信心的性别差异。男性在健康行为方面表现出改善，自我感知健康程度提高，相对收入和社交地位感知更高，对未来也更有信心。相比之下，女性在这些方面并没有显示出统计学上的显著变化。事实上，她们往往倾向于采取危害健康的行为，如吸烟增加，并且肥胖率也较高。这些发现强调了在退休对主观幸福感的影响中识别性别差异的重要性。它们也凸显了需要制定有针对性的政策，以增强女性的社会和经济机会，最终实现退休后阶段的更大性别平等。

abstract.text: We study the diffusion of a clinically unproven treatment for COVID-19 in Argentina. As the pandemic spread, nebulized ibuprofen reached thousands of patients, even some seriously ill, despite warnings by the regulator and medical societies. We use daily data on drug deliveries for all towns in one of the largest provinces to study diffusion patterns and find a role for learning. An experimental survey is also consistent with learning. A key dimension affecting diffusion is ideology: towns and subjects classified as “right-wing” are more likely to adopt and to learn.

10.3386/w31781.abstractZh: 我们研究了一种尚未经过临床验证的COVID-19治疗方法在阿根廷的扩散情况。随着疫情的蔓延，尽管监管机构及医学协会发出了警告，但雾化布洛芬仍被应用于数千名患者，其中包括一些病情严重的患者。我们利用一个最大省份内所有城镇的药品配送日数据来研究扩散模式，并发现学习在扩散过程中起到了一定作用。实验性调查也证实了学习对扩散的影响。影响扩散的一个关键因素是意识形态：被归类为“右翼”的城镇和受试者更有可能采用并学习这种治疗方法。

abstract.text: Economics has long studied how consumers respond to the disclosure of information about firms. We study a case in which the disclosed information is unrelated to the product or firm leadership, but which could still potentially affect consumer patronage through the mechanism of repugnance, as described in Roth (2007). The information in this case concerns the arrest of Jared Fogle, the advertising pitchman for the Subway sandwich franchise, who was arrested in 2015 on charges of sex with a minor and child pornography. We study how the disclosure of this information, which was widely covered in the media, affected patronage of Subway. We estimate synthetic control models using data from a large nationwide survey of consumers regarding the restaurants they patronize. Despite the close and long-standing association of Jared Fogle with Subway, and heavy publicity of his crimes, we consistently fail to detect any effect of the Jared Fogle scandal on the probability of visiting a Subway restaurant. These results contrast with past studies of negative information disclosure, which tend to find negative impacts on sales, revenue, or stock price of the relevant companies. The absence of an effect in this case suggests that repugnance did not drive demand, and that consumers largely separated the offenses of a symbol of the firm from the products of the firm.

10.3386/w31782.abstractZh: 经济学长期以来一直研究消费者对企业信息披露的响应。我们研究了一个案例，其中披露的信息与产品或企业领导层无关，但仍然可能通过厌恶机制影响消费者的消费行为，正如Roth在2007年所描述的那样。这个案例中的信息涉及Subway三明治品牌的广告代言人Jared Fogle的被捕，他于2015年因性侵未成年人和儿童色情罪被捕。我们研究了这一信息被媒体广泛报道后，对Subway消费行为的影响。我们使用一项全国性的消费者调查数据，建立了合成控制模型。尽管Jared Fogle与Subway有着密切且长期的关系，并且他的罪行受到了大量报道，但我们始终未能发现Jared Fogle丑闻对访问Subway餐厅概率的任何影响。这些结果与以往关于负面信息披露的研究不同，后者通常发现负面信息会对相关公司的销售额、收入或股价产生负面影响。在这种情况下缺乏影响表明，厌恶情绪并未驱动需求，消费者基本上将企业的象征性与企业的产品区分开来。

abstract.text: In theory, there are several reasons why physician organizational form might affect the price, quantity, and quality of physician services. In this paper, we examine the association between three aspects of physician organizational form and opioid prescribing: solo versus group practice; integration with a hospital versus independent practice; and the average age of the other physicians in the physician’s group. We present three key findings. First, physicians who switch from solo to group practice, particularly large-group practice, significantly reduce their prescribing relative to those who stay in solo practice. Conversely, physicians who switch from group to solo practice significantly increase their prescribing by approximately the same amount. Second, physicians who switch from independent to hospital-integrated practice (and those who switch from integrated to independent practice) generally do not significantly change their prescribing. Third, among group-practice physicians, there are significant differences in prescribing by the average of age of physicians in the group, holding constant the physician’s own age and other characteristics of the group, the physician, and the physician’s patients. Physicians in groups with a higher average age (excluding the index physician) prescribe more intensively and are more likely to write inappropriate opioid prescriptions than physicians in younger groups – holding other factors constant.

10.3386/w31785.abstractZh: 理论上，医师组织形式可能会影响医师服务的价格、数量和质量，原因有多种。本文探讨了医师组织形式与阿片类药物处方之间的三个方面的关联：单人执业与团队执业；与医院整合的执业模式与独立执业模式；以及医师所在团队中其他医师的平均年龄。我们得出三个主要结论：首先，从单人执业转为团队执业的医师，尤其是大型团队执业的医师，其处方量显著减少；相反，从团队执业转为单人执业的医师，其处方量也显著增加，但增幅大致相同。其次，从独立执业转为医院整合执业的医师，以及从整合执业转为独立执业的医师，其处方量通常没有显著变化。第三，在团队执业的医师中，即使其他因素保持不变，不同团队中医师的平均年龄对处方量也有显著影响。在平均年龄较高的团队中，医师的处方更为密集，且更有可能开具不适当的阿片类药物处方。

abstract.text: Hospitals play a key role in patient outcomes and spending, but efforts to improve their quality are hindered because we do not know whether hospital quality indicators are causal or biased. We evaluate the validity of commonly used quality indicators, such as mortality, readmissions, inpatient costs, and length-of-stay, using a quasi-experimental design where hospital closures reallocate large numbers of patients to hospitals of different quality. This setting allows us to measure whether patient outcomes improve as much as quality indicators predict when a relatively low-quality hospital closes, or decline as predicted when a relatively high-quality hospital closes. Using more than 20 years of Medicare claims for over 30 million patients admitted with five common diagnoses, we find that hospital quality indicators overstate differences in the causal impact of hospitals on mortality and readmission rates by 7 percent or less, but overstate differences in the causal impact of hospitals on inpatient cost and length-of-stay measures by closer to 40 percent. On average, hospital closures reduce patient mortality by shifting patients to higher quality hospitals, but the but the effect varies widely depending on the relative quality of the closing hospital.

10.3386/w31789.abstractZh: 医院在患者的治疗效果和医疗费用方面起着关键作用，但改善医院质量的努力受到阻碍，因为我们不清楚医院质量指标是否具有因果关系或是否存在偏差。我们采用准实验设计来评估常用质量指标的有效性，例如死亡率、再入院率、住院成本和住院时间。在这种设计中，医院关闭会将大量患者重新分配到不同质量水平的医院。这一设置使我们能够测量：当质量相对较低的医院关闭时，患者的治疗效果是否如质量指标所预测的那样有所改善；或者当质量相对较高的医院关闭时，治疗效果是否如预期那样下降。通过对超过20年的医疗保险索赔数据进行分析，涉及300多万名因五种常见疾病住院的患者，我们发现医院质量指标对医院在死亡率和再入院率方面的因果影响的夸大程度不超过7%，但对住院成本和住院时间的因果影响的夸大程度接近40%。平均而言，医院关闭通过将患者转移到质量更高的医院来降低患者的死亡率，但这种效果因关闭医院的相对质量而异。

abstract.text: The U.S. does not have a federal paid sick leave (PSL) policy; however, multiple states have adopted PSL mandates which compel employers to provide employees with, on average, seven days of PSL per year. PSL can facilitate healthcare use among women of child-bearing ages, including use of family planning services. We combine administrative, health insurance claims, and survey data with difference-in-differences methods to shed light on these possibilities. Our findings indicate that state PSL mandates reduce birth rates, potentially through increased use of contraceptive services, and changes in employment and marital status post-mandate.

10.3386/w31801.abstractZh: 美国没有联邦层面的带薪病假政策；然而，多个州已经实施了带薪病假规定，要求雇主每年为员工提供平均七天的带薪病假。带薪病假有助于育龄妇女获得医疗服务，包括使用计划生育服务。我们结合行政数据、健康保险索赔数据以及调查数据，并运用差异-差异方法来分析这些可能性。我们的研究结果表明，各州的带薪病假规定能够降低出生率，这可能是由于增加了避孕服务的使用，以及政策实施后对就业和婚姻状况的影响。

abstract.text: The global COVID-19 vaccination campaign is the largest public health campaign in history, with over 2 billion people fully vaccinated within the first 8 months. Nevertheless, the impact of this campaign on all-cause mortality is not well understood. Leveraging the staggered rollout of vaccines, we find that the vaccination campaign across 141 countries averted 2.4 million excess deaths, valued at $6.5 trillion. We also find that an equitable counterfactual distribution of vaccines, with vaccination in each country proportional to its population, would have saved roughly 670,000 more lives. However, this distribution approach would have reduced the total value of averted deaths by $1.8 trillion due to redistribution of vaccines from high-income to low-income countries.

10.3386/w31812.abstractZh: 全球COVID-19疫苗接种运动是历史上规模最大的公共卫生行动，在最初的8个月内，超过20亿人完成了疫苗接种。然而，这一运动对全因死亡率的影响尚不清楚。通过利用疫苗接种的逐步推进策略，我们发现141个国家之间的疫苗接种行动避免了240万例超额死亡，这相当于65万亿美元的价值。我们还发现，如果疫苗分配更加公平，即每个国家的疫苗接种数量与其人口比例相匹配，那么大约可以挽救67万条生命。不过，这种分配方式会导致因疫苗从高收入国家向低收入国家重新分配而使得总避免的死亡价值减少1.8万亿美元。

abstract.text: This paper presents and assesses analytical strategies that respect the bounded count structures of outcomes that are encountered often in health and other applications. The paper's main motivation is that the applied econometrics literature lacks a comprehensive discussion and critique of strategies for analyzing and understand such data. The paper's goal is to provide a treatment of prominent issues arising in such analyses, with particular focus on evaluations in which bounded count outcomes are of interest, and on econometric modeling of their probability and moment structures. Hopefully the paper will provide a toolkit for researchers so they may better appreciate the range of questions that might be asked of such data and the merits and limitations of the analytical methods they might contemplate to study them. It will be seen that the choice of analytical method is often consequential: questions of interest may be unanswerable when some familiar analytical methods are deployed in some circumstances.

10.3386/w31814.abstractZh: 本文提出了并评估了适用于常见于健康及其他领域中的有限计数结果的分析策略。本文的主要动机在于，现有的应用计量经济学文献在分析和理解此类数据的方法上缺乏全面的讨论与批判。本文的目标是为这类分析中出现的重要问题提供解决方案，特别关注那些涉及有限计数结果的评估，以及对其概率和矩结构进行计量经济建模的研究。希望本文能为研究人员提供一个工具包，使他们能够更好地理解针对此类数据可能提出的一系列问题，以及他们可能考虑使用的分析方法的优点与局限性。需要注意的是，选择分析方法往往具有重大影响：在某些情况下，使用一些常见的分析方法可能会导致一些难以解答的问题。

abstract.text: Social Security Disability Insurance and Supplemental Security Income, the United States’ two primary disability income support programs, each offer a pathway to public health insurance in addition to cash benefits. This implies that expansions in public health insurance availability, such as the ACA’s Medicaid expansions, may impact disability program participation and employment of people with disabilities. However, prior research has yielded mixed results as to the impact of Medicaid expansion on these outcomes. Using a stacked difference-in-differences design and data from the Current Population Survey, we demonstrate that the ACA’s Medicaid expansions increased SSDI receipt among individuals ages 50-64 with physical, self-care and independent living disabilities, consistent with a “job unlock” mechanism. Exploiting the longitudinal nature of the CPS, we show that treatment effects are heterogeneous and concentrated among persons with ongoing disabilities (as opposed to new disabilities) as reported on the CPS’s 6-question functional impairment sequence. We also show suggestive evidence of a reduction in SSI, but find that it is sensitive to specification and data preparation choices, which we illustrate through comparison with other recent work. Effects on employment are inconclusive. Our findings provide further evidence of work capacity among SSDI beneficiaries.

10.3386/w31816.abstractZh: 美国的两项主要残疾收入支持计划——社会保障残疾保险和补充安全收入计划，除了提供现金福利外，还提供了获得公共健康保险的途径。这意味着公共健康保险覆盖范围的扩大，例如《平价医疗法案》中的医疗补助计划扩展，可能会影响残疾人的参与度和就业情况。然而，先前的研究对于医疗补助计划扩展对这些结果的影响得出了不同的结论。我们利用分层差异比较设计以及当前人口调查的数据，证明《平价医疗法案》中的医疗补助计划扩展增加了50-64岁有身体、自我照顾和独立生活方面残疾的人的社会保障残疾保险领取金额，这与“就业解锁”机制相符。通过利用当前人口调查的纵向数据，我们发现治疗效果存在异质性，且主要集中在那些持续存在残疾的人身上（而非新出现的残疾），这一点可以从当前人口调查关于6项功能障碍问题的调查中得出。我们还发现了一些关于补充安全收入减少的线索性证据，但发现这种影响对模型设定和数据处理方式非常敏感，我们通过与其他近期研究的比较来说明这一点。关于对就业的影响，研究结果并不明确。我们的发现进一步证明了社会保障残疾保险受益人在工作能力方面的表现。

abstract.text: Spain together with Scotland are two countries that exhibit the largest expansions in long term care (LTC) in the last two decades, universalizing subsidies and supports. This paper is part of a global effort to provide a snapshot of the trends in LTC use and access, as well as the financing, and organization of the LTC system compared to other higher-income countries. The passage of Act 39/2006 on the Promotion of Personal Autonomy and Care for Dependent Persons (SAAD in Spanish) on December 14th, 2006, universalized coverage for care subsidies and supports, allowing access to care conditioned only on individuals’ assessment of care needs. As a consequence, LTC spending as a percentage of GDP has risen from 0.5% in 2003 to nearly 0.9% in 2019, despite private LTC insurance playing a minor role. Still today, LTC remains heavily reliant on informal care, which is now partially subsidized by a caregiving subsidy as part of SAAD. Long-term care spending in Spain amounts to between 1.27% (conservative estimates) and 1.70% (flexible estimation) of GDP. Finally, the system reveals significant gender imbalances in the provision of care, with women accounting for most caregivers in both formal (87%) and informal (58%) care.

10.3386/w31825.abstractZh: 西班牙和苏格兰是过去二十年里长期护理服务扩张最为显著的两个国家，这两个国家都实现了补贴和支持的普及化。本文是全球范围内对长期护理使用与获取情况、资金筹措以及与其他高收入国家相比的护理体系组织方式进行研究的成果之一。2006年12月14日通过的《关于促进个人自主性和对依赖者的照顾的第39/2006号法案》使护理补贴和支持的覆盖范围变得普遍化，使得个人只需根据自身的护理需求来评估是否需要护理服务。因此，长期护理支出占GDP的比例从2003年的0.5%上升到了2019年的近0.9%，尽管私人长期护理保险的作用相对较小。至今，长期护理服务仍然严重依赖非正式护理，而这一服务现在部分由SAAD中的护理补贴来补贴。西班牙的长期护理支出占GDP的比例在1.27%（保守估计）到1.70%（灵活估计）之间。最后，该体系在护理服务的提供方面显示出显著的性别不平衡，女性承担了大部分正式护理（87%）和非正式护理（58%）的工作。

abstract.text: We examine cost-plus lagged-price reimbursement contracts, focusing on Medicare Part B's payment for physician-administered drugs. Our theoretical model shows that lagged-price reimbursement can raise launch prices but lower prices in later periods. While previous research showed Part B increased launch prices, we estimate its effect on later prices (net of rebates). Drugs more exposed to Medicare have lower price growth. A drug with above median Part B exposure has a 10% lower price after 3 years than a below median exposure drug that launched at the same price, with a larger effect for newly approved molecules.

10.3386/w31834.abstractZh: 我们研究了成本加成滞后价格报销合同，重点关注医疗保险部分B对医生处方药物的支付方式。我们的理论模型表明，滞后价格报销可能会提高药物的初始价格，但在后期会降低价格。虽然先前的研究显示医疗保险部分B确实提高了药物的初始价格，但我们估计了其对后期价格的影响（扣除回扣后的价格）。在医疗保险覆盖范围内的药物，其价格增长幅度较低。对于在医疗保险部分B覆盖范围内较高的药物来说，三年后的价格比那些在同等价格下推出的、覆盖范围较低的药物低10%，对于新批准的药品来说，这种影响更为显著。

abstract.text: Difference-in-Difference (DID) estimators are a valuable method for identifying causal effects in the public health researcher’s toolkit. A growing methods literature points out potential problems with DID estimators when treatment is staggered in adoption and varies with time. Despite this, no practical guide exists for addressing these new critiques in public health research. We illustrate these new DID concepts with step-by-step examples, code, and a checklist. We draw insights by comparing the simple 2 × 2 DID design (single treatment group, single control group, two time periods) with more complex cases: additional treated groups, additional time periods of treatment, and with treatment effects possibly varying over time. We outline newly uncovered threats to causal interpretation of DID estimates and the solutions the literature has proposed, relying on a decomposition that shows how the more complex DID are an average of simpler 2X2 DID sub-experiments.

10.3386/w31842.abstractZh: 差异差异估计方法在公共卫生研究者的工具箱中是一种有价值的识别因果效应的方法。越来越多的研究指出，当治疗的实施是分阶段进行的，并且随时间变化时，差异差异估计方法可能存在问题。尽管如此，目前还没有实用的指南来应对公共卫生研究中这些新的批评。我们通过逐步示例、代码和检查清单来说明这些新的差异差异概念。通过比较简单的2×2差异差异设计（单一治疗组、单一对照组、两个时间周期）与更复杂的案例：额外的治疗组、额外的时间周期以及治疗效果可能随时间变化的案例，我们获得了一些见解。我们概述了新发现的对差异差异估计的因果解释性的威胁以及文献提出的解决方案，这些解决方案依赖于一种分解方法，表明更复杂的差异差异实际上是更简单的2×2差异差异子实验的平均值。

abstract.text: This paper examines the relationship between extreme socioeconomic disadvantage and poor health by providing the first detailed and accurate picture of mortality patterns among people experiencing homelessness in the U.S. Our analyses center on 140,000 people who were sheltered or unsheltered homeless during the 2010 Census, by far the largest sample ever used to study this population and the only sample designed to be nationally representative. These individuals, along with housed comparison groups, are linked to Social Security Administration data on all-cause mortality from 2010-2022 to estimate the magnitude of health disparities associated with homelessness. We find that non-elderly people experiencing homelessness have 3.5 times the mortality risk of those who are housed, accounting for differences in demographic characteristics and geography, and that a 40-year-old homeless person faces a similar mortality risk to a housed person nearly twenty years older. Our results reveal notable patterns in relative mortality risk by age, race, gender, and Hispanic ethnicity and suggest that within the homeless population, employment, higher incomes, and more extensive observed family connections are associated with lower mortality. The mortality hazard of homeless individuals rose by 33 percent during the COVID-19 pandemic, an increase that, while similar in proportional terms to the increase for the housed population, affected a much larger share of the homeless population due to their substantially elevated baseline mortality rate. These findings elucidate the persistent hardships associated with homelessness and show that the well-documented gradient between health and poverty persists into the extreme lower tail of socioeconomic disadvantage.

10.3386/w31843.abstractZh: 本文通过提供美国无家可归者死亡模式的首次详细且准确的描述，探讨了极端社会经济劣势与健康状况不佳之间的关系。我们的分析聚焦于2010年人口普查期间被收容或无人收容的140,000名无家可归者，这是迄今为止用于研究这一人群的最大样本，也是唯一旨在实现全国代表性的样本。这些个体与有住房的对照组被关联至2010-2022年的社会保障局全因死亡数据，以估算与无家可归相关的健康差异的严重程度。我们发现，非老年无家可归者的死亡风险是有住房者的3.5倍，这考虑了人口特征和地理差异的影响；一个40岁无家可归者与一个年龄近20岁的有住房者面临相似的死亡风险。我们的研究结果揭示了按年龄、种族、性别和西班牙裔族群划分的相对死亡风险模式，并表明在无家可归者中，就业、较高收入以及更紧密的家庭关系与较低的死亡风险相关。在COVID-19疫情期间，无家可归者的死亡风险上升了33%，虽然这一比例与有住房者的增长相似，但由于无家可归者原本的死亡率就较高，因此其受影响的比例要大得多。这些发现揭示了与无家可归相关的持续困境，并表明健康与贫困之间的明显差距一直存在于社会经济劣势的最底层。

abstract.text: Many environmental hazards produce health effects that take years to arise, but quasi-experimental studies typically measure outcomes and treatment over short time periods. We develop a new approach to overcome this challenge and use it to gauge the effect of exposure to air pollution on US life expectancy. Using changes in wind direction as an instrument for daily sulfur dioxide levels, we first characterize the short-run mortality effects of acute exposure during the time period 1972-1988. Exposure causes two distinct mortality patterns: a short-run mortality displacement effect, and a persistent accelerated aging effect. We then incorporate our estimates into a flexible health production model to quantify the lifelong effects of chronic air pollution exposure for a cohort born in 1972. Model calculations of the effect of chronic exposure on life expectancy are 7-8 times larger than the effect implied by simple extrapolation of our short-run empirical estimates. Ninety percent of the survival benefits accrue after the first fifty years of life, implying that most of the 1970 Clean Air Act's health benefits have yet to emerge for cohorts born after its passage.

10.3386/w31858.abstractZh: 许多环境危害对健康的影响需要数年时间才会显现，而准实验研究通常会在较短的时间段内测量结果和治疗方法的效果。我们提出了一种新的方法来克服这一挑战，并用它来评估空气污染对美国预期寿命的影响。我们通过使用风向变化作为每日二氧化硫水平的指标，首先描述了1972年至1988年期间急性暴露对短期死亡率的影响。暴露导致了两种不同的死亡率模式：一种是在短期内的死亡率位移效应，另一种则是持续的加速老化效应。随后，我们将这些估计结果纳入一个灵活的健康生产模型中，以量化1972年出生的群体因长期空气污染暴露而受到的终生影响。模型计算表明，长期暴露对预期寿命的影响比我们简单外推短期实证估计所得到的效应要大7-8倍。90%的生存益处集中在生命的前50年，这意味着1970年《清洁空气法》实施后出生的群体，其大部分健康益处尚未显现。

abstract.text: The provision of long-term care (LTC) for senior citizens in Italy is at the center of the recent policy debate. Italy has witnessed a spectacular increase in the share of people aged 65 and over and in particular of people aged 80 and over, which could translate in large increases in the number of people in need of care. We show that individuals who are in need of LTC have lower economic resources than the average, so that many frail older people have little financial means to pay out-of-pocket for formal care. In fact, publicly provided care is highly fragmented, with stark differences emerging in terms of coverage and generosity across Italian regions. Hence, the supply of LTC is relying heavily on the informal support of members of the family, especially women, at the same time formal care is characterised by a significant underground economy of unskilled carers.

10.3386/w31861.abstractZh: 在意大利，为老年人提供长期护理服务是近期政策讨论的核心议题。意大利65岁及以上人口的比例出现了显著增长，尤其是80岁及以上人口的比例，这可能导致需要护理服务的人员数量大幅增加。研究表明，需要长期护理服务的个体其经济资源低于平均水平，因此许多身体虚弱的老年人几乎没有足够的经济能力自费支付正式护理费用。实际上，公共提供的护理服务存在严重的不均衡现象，不同地区的覆盖范围和福利水平差异巨大。因此，长期护理服务的提供在很大程度上依赖于家庭成员，尤其是女性的非正式支持，同时正式护理服务也伴随着大量非技术型护理人员的地下经济活动。

abstract.text: Unions play a crucial role in determining wages and employment outcomes. However, union bargaining power may also have important effects on non-pecuniary working conditions. We study the effects of right-to-work laws, which removed agency shop protection and weakened union powers on long hours and non-standard work schedules that may adversely affect workers' health and safety. We exploit variation in the timing of enactment across US states and compare workers in bordering counties across adopting states and states that did not adopt the laws yet. Using the stacked approach to difference-in-differences estimates proposed by Cengiz et al. (2019), we find evidence that right-to-work laws increased the share of workers working long hours by 6%, while there is little evidence of an impact on hourly wages. The effects on long hours are larger in more unionized sectors (i.e. construction, manufacturing, and transportation). While the likelihood of working non-standard hours increases for particular sectors (education and public administration), there is no evidence of a significant increase in the overall sample.

10.3386/w31867.abstractZh: 工会在决定工资和就业结果方面发挥着至关重要的作用。然而，工会的谈判力量也可能对非金钱性的工作条件产生重要影响。我们研究了“工作自由法”的影响，该法律取消了代理工会的保护，并削弱了工会的权力，这可能对长时间工作和非标准工作时间安排产生不利影响，从而损害工人的健康和安全。我们利用美国各州实施该法律的时间差异，比较了采用该法律的州与未采用该法律的州之间的邻近县内的工人情况。通过Cengiz等人（2019年）提出的差异-差异估计方法，我们发现“工作自由法”使长时间工作的工人比例增加了6%，而对时薪的影响则较小。在工会化程度较高的行业（如建筑、制造业和交通运输业），长时间工作的影响更为显著。虽然某些行业（如教育和公共行政领域）的非标准工作时间的可能性增加，但总体样本中没有证据表明这种增加是显著的。

abstract.text: Analyzing data spanning three decades covering the near universe of births, we study county-level differences in Cesarean section (C-section) rates among first-time mothers of singleton births. Our research reveals persistent geographic variation in C- section rates for both low- and high-risk groups. Counties with elevated C-section rates consistently perform more C-sections across mothers at all levels of appropriateness for the procedure. These elevated rates of C-section in high C-section counties are associated with reduced maternal and infant morbidity. We also find that C-section decisions are less responsive to underlying risks for Black mothers relative to white mothers, suggesting potential welfare-reducing disparities.

10.3386/w31871.abstractZh: 我们分析了涵盖近三十年数据的生育数据，研究了单胎妊娠首次分娩的母亲在县级范围内的剖宫产率差异。研究发现，无论是低风险还是高风险群体，剖宫产率都存在持续的地理差异。剖宫产率较高的县，在所有适合进行手术的母亲群体中，剖宫产手术数量都更为频繁。这些剖宫产率较高的县，其母婴发病率也相对较低。此外，我们发现，与白人母亲相比，黑人母亲在做出剖宫产决策时，对潜在风险的反应更为迟钝，这可能意味着存在降低福利的潜在差异。

abstract.text: This paper contributes a broad overview of the Canadian long-term care system. Taking an economist’s viewpoint, we bring together supply and demand factors to provide an economic analysis of the current and future path for long-term care. Like other OECD countries, the coming demographic wave of older baby boomers will put tremendous stress on the existing financial, organizational, and physical structures of the long-term care system. Unlike other OECD countries, Canada’s system is organized almost entirely at the subnational level, with provinces and territories having by far the largest role in financing and regulating long-term care. We provide institutional and empirical details on the evolution and future of Canada's long-term care system.

10.3386/w31875.abstractZh: 本文对加拿大的长期护理体系进行了全面的概述。从经济学家的视角出发，我们结合供需因素，对当前及未来的长期护理发展路径进行了经济分析。与其他经合组织国家一样，即将到来的老年婴儿潮将给现有长期护理体系的财务、组织和物理结构带来巨大压力。与其他经合组织国家不同的是，加拿大的体系几乎完全是在地方层面组织的，各省和地区在长期护理的融资和监管方面发挥着重要作用。本文还提供了关于加拿大长期护理体系的发展与未来走向的制度和实证细节。

abstract.text: The population of the United States, as with the rest of the world, is aging rapidly, with the most rapid growth occurring among the age 85 and older population, those who rely most on long-term care. In this chapter, we review the delivery and financing of long-term care in the U.S. We show that the resources of most elderly in the U.S. are insufficient to finance these ongoing long-term care needs and the public sector finances the majority of long-term care spending. At the same time, informal care plays a critical role, with the elderly at every age and every disability level receiving informal care more frequently than formal care. Indeed, when properly valued, informal care accounts for more than one-third of the nearly 2 percent of U.S. GDP devoted to long-term care.

10.3386/w31881.abstractZh: 美国的人口老龄化速度与其他国家一样迅速，其中85岁及以上人群的增长最为显著，这些人最需要长期护理。在本章中，我们回顾了美国长期护理的提供和融资情况。我们发现，美国大多数老年人的资源不足以满足这些长期护理需求，而公共部门承担了大部分长期护理支出。同时，非正式护理发挥着关键作用，各个年龄层和不同残疾水平的老年人都更频繁地接受非正式护理，而非正式护理所占比重超过了美国GDP中用于长期护理的近2%。

abstract.text: The developed world is in the midst of an enormous demographic transition, with life expectancy increasing and fertility falling, leading to a rapid aging of the population. This trend has critical implications for long-term care around the world. This paper serves as the introduction to a volume that brings together experts from ten countries to compare long term care systems. We find a number of important similarities: only a minority of those elderly receiving assistance rely solely on formal care (i.e. care in an institution or through paid home care) while the majority of care is provided informally by family or other unpaid caregivers; without public support, the cost of long-term care would be beyond the financial means of a large fraction of the elderly in each country, particularly for the oldest and most disabled; and the public sector bears the majority of the costs of formal long-term care in every country. There are, however, important differences across countries, particularly in the extent to which formal care is delivered in institutions or at home, and in the division between the use of formal and informal care. Given the importance of informal care across all countries studied, we conclude that any estimate of the social costs of long-term care must account for the implicit costs of informal care. In undertaking such an evaluation of informal care, we find that it comprises at least one-third of all long-term care spending for all countries studied, with an average portion of nearly fifty percent.

10.3386/w31882.abstractZh: 发达国家正经历着巨大的人口结构转变，预期寿命延长而生育率下降，导致人口迅速老龄化。这一趋势对全球的长期护理服务产生了重要影响。本文作为一本汇集了来自十个国家专家的著作的引言，旨在比较各国的长期护理体系。我们发现一些重要的相似之处：接受援助的老年人中，仅有少数完全依赖正式护理（即在机构或付费家庭护理中接受护理），而大多数护理是由家人或其他无偿护理人员提供的非正式护理；如果没有公共支持，长期护理的成本将超出每个国家大部分老年人的经济承受能力，尤其是那些年龄最大和残疾最严重的老年人；在每个国家，正式长期护理的大部分成本由公共部门承担。然而，各国之间也存在重要差异，特别是在正式护理在机构或家庭中的提供程度，以及正式护理与非正式护理之间的分工方面。鉴于非正式护理在所有研究国家中的重要性，我们得出结论，任何关于长期护理社会成本的估算都必须考虑非正式护理的隐性成本。在对非正式护理进行此类评估后，我们发现它至少占所有研究国家长期护理支出总量的三分之一，平均比例接近百分之五十。

abstract.text: Opioid overdose deaths in older adults increased substantially over the past two decades. This increase occurred despite the availability of effective treatments. Methadone, one of three medications approved for opioid use disorder (OUD) treatment, was not covered by Medicare — the primary insurer of older Americans — for OUD until 2020. We study the response of opioid treatment programs (OTPs), the only healthcare providers that can dispense methadone for OUD in the U.S., to this policy change using administrative data and a difference-in-differences framework. We examine provider acceptance of Medicare payment and the number of treatment episodes, before and after the policy change, in OTPs relative to other substance use disorder treatment facilities. Our findings show a surge in Medicare acceptance by OTPs and an increase in the number of treatment episodes post-policy, signalling the importance of insurance for OUD treatment provision.

10.3386/w31884.abstractZh: 在过去二十年里，老年人群体中因阿片类药物过量导致的死亡人数显著增加。尽管有有效的治疗方法存在，这一增长仍然发生了。美沙酮是三种被批准用于治疗阿片类药物使用障碍的药物之一，但在2020年之前，美沙酮并未被美国老年人的主要保险机构——医疗保险覆盖。我们利用行政数据和差异-差异框架，研究了美国唯一能够为阿片类药物使用障碍患者提供美沙酮治疗的医疗机构——阿片类药物治疗项目对此政策变化的反应。我们考察了在政策变化前后，与其他物质使用障碍治疗机构相比，阿片类药物治疗项目对医疗保险支付的接受程度以及治疗次数的变化。我们的研究结果显示，阿片类药物治疗项目对医疗保险的接受度显著上升，政策变化后治疗次数也有所增加，这凸显了保险在阿片类药物使用障碍治疗中的重要性。

abstract.text: The U.S. opioid crisis is now driven by fentanyl, a powerful synthetic opioid that currently accounts for 90% of all opioid deaths. Fentanyl is smuggled from abroad, with little evidence of how this happens. We find a positive relationship between state-level imports and drug overdoses, which is consistent with fentanyl smuggling occurring via legal trade flows. This relationship accounts for 14,000-20,000 deaths per year, and is not explained by geographic differences in “deaths of despair,” general demand for opioids, or import competition. Our results suggest that fentanyl smuggling via imports is pervasive and a key determinant of recent opioid problems.

10.3386/w31885.abstractZh: 美国的阿片类药物危机现在由芬太尼所驱动，这是一种强大的合成阿片类药物，目前占所有阿片类药物死亡病例的90%。芬太尼是从国外走私进来的，但关于这种走私方式的具体途径却缺乏证据。我们发现，州级进口量与药物过量死亡之间存在正相关关系，这与芬太尼通过合法贸易渠道走私的情况相符。这种关系每年导致14,000至20,000人死亡，而这一现象无法用地理上的“绝望死亡”、对阿片类药物的总体需求或进口竞争来解释。我们的研究结果表明，通过进口途径进行的芬太尼走私现象非常普遍，是近期阿片类药物问题的重要诱因。

abstract.text: While state incarceration policies have received much attention in research on the causes of mass incarceration in the U.S., their roles in shaping population health and health disparities remain largely unknown. We examine the impacts of two signature state incarceration policies adopted during the “tough on crime” era of the 1990s—three strikes and truth in sentencing—on Black and White birth outcomes. Using a difference-in-differences event study research design that models the dynamic impacts of these policies over time, we find that these policies had opposing effects on birth outcomes. We find that birth weight outcomes—including mean birth weight and low birth weight—for Black infants worsened markedly in the year three strikes policies were adopted. By contrast, birth outcomes for Black and White infants gradually improved after truth in sentencing policies were adopted. The discordant findings point to distinct, countervailing mechanisms by which sentencing policies can affect population health. We provide suggestive evidence that three strikes policies adversely impacted Black birth outcomes through affective mechanisms, by inducing highly racialized, stigmatizing public discourse around the time of policy adoption, while truth in sentencing likely impacted birth outcomes via material mechanisms, namely gradually reductions in community incarceration and crime rates. Altogether, these findings point to the need to further interrogate state criminal legal system policies for their impacts on population health, considering whether, how, and for whom these policies result in health impacts.

10.3386/w31888.abstractZh: 虽然关于美国大规模监禁原因的研究中，州政府监禁政策受到了广泛关注，但它们在塑造人口健康与健康差异方面的作用却仍鲜为人知。本研究考察了20世纪90年代“严厉打击犯罪”时期两项具有代表性的州政府监禁政策——三罚制与量刑公平原则——对黑人和白人婴儿出生结果的影响。通过差异-差异事件研究设计，模拟这些政策随时间的变化影响，我们发现这些政策对出生结果产生了相反的效果。研究发现，在实行三罚制政策的那一年，黑人婴儿的出生体重——包括平均出生体重和低出生体重——显著恶化。相比之下，在实行量刑公平原则后，黑人和白人婴儿的出生结果逐渐改善。这些不一致的发现表明，量刑政策可以通过不同的机制影响人口健康。我们有证据表明，三罚制政策通过情感机制对黑人的出生结果产生了负面影响，引发了政策实施期间高度种族化的、具有污名化的公共讨论；而量刑公平原则则可能通过物质机制影响出生结果，即逐步降低社区的监禁率和犯罪率。总的来说，这些发现表明有必要进一步探讨州刑事法律体系政策对人口健康的影响，考虑这些政策是否、如何以及针对谁产生了健康影响。

abstract.text: There is substantial evidence that cost-sharing in medical care constrains total health spending. However, there is relatively little (and unclear) evidence on its health effects, particularly in low- and middle-income countries. This paper re-evaluates the link between outpatient cost-sharing and health, studying Colombia’s entire formal sector workforce observed monthly between 2011 and 2018 with individual-level health care utilization records linked to payroll data and vital statistics. Because Colombia’s national health system imposes discrete breaks in outpatient cost-sharing requirements across the earnings distribution, we estimate a dynamic regression discontinuity model, finding that greater outpatient cost-sharing initially reduces use of outpatient care (including consultations and drugs), resulting in fewer diagnoses of common chronic diseases – and over time, increases the prevalence and severity of chronic diseases as well as use of inpatient care. Ultimately, greater outpatient cost-sharing measurably increases mortality, raising 8-year mortality by 4 deaths per 10,000 individuals. To the best of our knowledge, this study is the first to show a relationship between cost-sharing and adult mortality risk in a low- or middle-income country, a relationship important to incorporate into social welfare analyses of cost-sharing policies.

10.3386/w31908.abstractZh: 有大量证据表明，医疗中的费用分担限制了总医疗支出。然而，关于其健康影响的证据相对较少且不明确，尤其是在低收入和中等收入国家。本文重新评估了门诊费用分担与健康之间的关系，研究了2011年至2018年间哥伦比亚整个正规部门劳动力的数据，这些数据与工资数据和人口统计数据相关联。由于哥伦比亚的国家医疗体系在收入分布中设置了不同的门诊费用分担要求，我们采用动态回归断点模型进行估计，发现较高的门诊费用分担最初会减少门诊护理的使用，包括咨询和药物治疗，从而导致常见慢性疾病的诊断减少。随着时间的推移，这会增加慢性疾病的患病率和严重程度，以及住院护理的使用。最终，较高的门诊费用分担会显著增加死亡率，使10,000人中的死亡率增加4例。据我们所知，这是首次在低收入或中等收入国家显示费用分担与成人死亡风险之间的关系，这一关系对于分析费用分担政策的社会福利影响非常重要。

abstract.text: We provide the first quasi-experimental estimates of variation in suicide impulsivity by age by examining the impact of firearm purchase delay laws by age. Prior studies of firearm purchase delay laws use traditional two-way-fixed-effects estimation, but we demonstrate that bias due to heterogenous treatment effects may have inflated previous estimates relative to our stacked-regression approach. We also develop a triple-difference stacked-regression estimator to confirm the robustness of our results. We find that purchase delay laws reduce firearm suicide for the overall adult population, but this effect is largely driven by a 6.1 percent reduction in firearm suicides for young adults ages 21-34. We demonstrate that the relationship between purchase delay laws and firearm suicide reduction weakens with age and is not driven by gun ownership rates. We argue that this is due to the impulsiveness of young adults in committing suicide, indicating that removing firearm access for young adults may provide a critical deterrent to suicide.

10.3386/w31917.abstractZh: 我们首次通过准实验方法，基于不同年龄群体的数据，对自杀冲动性的变化进行了估计，重点研究了枪支购买延迟法律对不同年龄群体的影响。以往关于枪支购买延迟法律的研究通常采用传统的双向固定效应估计方法，但我们发现，由于异质处理效应的影响，之前的估计结果可能有所偏差，相比之下，我们的堆叠回归方法能够提供更准确的估计结果。我们还开发了一种三重差分堆叠回归估计方法，以验证我们研究结果的稳健性。研究发现，枪支购买延迟法律确实减少了整体成年人群的枪支自杀行为，但这一效果主要体现在21-34岁年轻成年人的枪支自杀行为减少了6.1%。我们还发现，购买延迟法律与枪支自杀减少之间的关系随着年龄的增长而减弱，且这一关系并非由枪支拥有率所驱动。我们认为，这主要是由于年轻成年人自杀时的冲动性，因此，限制年轻成年人的枪支获取权可能成为预防自杀的有效手段。

abstract.text: Kidney exchange emerges as a pioneering application in the early stages of market design. In contrast to most other successful applications in the field, where design economists primarily serve as consultants to decision-makers, in the context of kidney exchange, they assumed the role of outsider critics, ultimately succeeding in shaping real-life practices and institutions. This paper delves into the strategies that facilitated this influential role. Drawing on our two-decade involvement in shaping kidney and liver exchange clearinghouses in the United States and Turkey, we provide insights into factors pivotal for the effectiveness of market design research in shaping policy. Building upon these experiences and incorporating lessons from school choice reforms in the 2000s, Sönmez (2023) introduces a novel institutional design paradigm termed "minimalist market design." Recent years have witnessed tangible outcomes resulting from integrated research and policy efforts employing this framework, notably contributing to the 2021 reform of the US Army's cadet branching system and the establishment of reserve systems during the Covid-19 pandemic for vaccine and therapy allocation across multiple states.

10.3386/w31941.abstractZh: 肾脏交换在市场设计的早期阶段便成为了一项开创性的应用。与领域内大多数成功的应用不同，在这些应用中，设计经济学家主要担任决策者的顾问角色，而在肾脏交换项目中，他们则扮演了外部批评者的角色，最终成功塑造了现实中的实践与制度。本文深入探讨了促成这一影响力的策略。基于我们在美国和土耳其参与肾脏和肝脏交换清算所设计的两十年经验，我们揭示了市场设计研究在塑造政策方面至关重要的因素。基于这些经验，并结合2000年代学校选择改革中的经验教训，Sönmez（2023）提出了一种名为“简约市场设计”的新制度设计范式。近年来，通过采用这一框架进行综合研究和政策努力，已经取得了切实的成果，例如推动了2021年美国陆军学员分配系统的改革，以及在新冠疫情期间为多个州建立了疫苗和治疗资源分配的后备系统。

abstract.text: Are birth outcomes of physician mothers affected by their long work hours and physically demanding job? Using Texas birth data from 2007-2014, we compared birth outcomes between physicians and another highly educated group, lawyers, and between surgeons and non-surgeon physicians. Further, using a difference-in-differences framework, we examine whether a 2011 duty hour reform impacted the physician birth outcomes. We find that physicians have an increased incidence of low birthweight and small for gestational age infants, with the results driven by surgeons. We find evidence that duty hour reforms were associated with improved birth outcomes for younger physicians.

10.3386/w31955.abstractZh: 医生母亲的生育结果是否受到她们长时间的工作和繁重的工作负担的影响？通过2007-2014年德克萨斯州的生育数据，我们比较了医生与其他高学历群体（如律师）以及外科医生与非外科医生的生育结果。此外，我们采用差异-差异框架，研究2011年工作时间改革是否对医生的生育结果产生了影响。研究发现，医生的低出生体重和小于胎龄儿的发病率较高，这一结果主要出现在外科医生中。我们还发现，工作时间改革与年轻医生的生育结果改善有关。

abstract.text: Several research strands document the life-cycle impacts of lead exposure during early life. Yet little is known about the long-run effects of lead exposure during early life on old-age mortality outcomes. In this study, we employ Social Security Administration death records linked to the full-count 1940 census and document that birth-city lead status negatively affects later life old age longevity. These impacts are larger for cities with acidic water and older pipeline systems that allow higher lead levels to leach into drinking water. Further, we show that the impacts are almost exclusively concentrated on the lead status of the birth-city and not the city of residence later in life. An instrumental variable strategy suggests reductions in longevity associated with birth-city lead status of about 9.6 months. We also find education, socioeconomic standing, and income reductions during early adulthood as candidate mechanisms. Finally, we use WWII enlistment data and observe reductions in measures of cognitive ability among lead-exposed individuals.

10.3386/w31957.abstractZh: 多项研究记录了早期铅暴露对生命周期的影响。然而，关于早期铅暴露对老年死亡率的长期影响，目前知之甚少。本研究利用社会保障管理局的死亡记录，结合1940年人口普查数据，发现出生地的铅污染状况会对晚年寿命产生负面影响。对于水源呈酸性的城市以及管道系统较老、允许更高浓度的铅渗入饮用水的城市来说，这种影响更为显著。此外，我们发现这些影响几乎完全集中在出生地的铅污染状况上，而非后来居住的城市环境。通过工具变量分析，我们发现出生地铅污染状况与寿命缩短的关系约为9.6个月。我们还发现，教育水平、社会经济地位和收入在成年早期有所下降，这些因素可能是导致寿命缩短的机制。最后，通过二战征兵数据，我们发现铅暴露人群的认知能力有所下降。

abstract.text: We estimate the causal impact of access to means-tested public health insurance coverage (Medicaid) on health outcomes and recidivism for those recently released from incarceration. To do so, we leverage a policy change in South Carolina that allowed simplified Medicaid enrollment for previously incarcerated eligible individuals. Using linked administrative data on criminal convictions and health insurance claims, we find that reducing barriers in access to Medicaid for vulnerable populations increases enrollment and utilization of some health care services. However, we do not find that this improved health care insurance access reduces 1-year or 3-year recidivism, suggesting that effectiveness of such policies is context dependent.

10.3386/w31971.abstractZh: 我们估算了获得基于经济状况评估的公共健康保险（Medicaid）对刚从监狱释放的人的健康结果和再犯率的影响。为此，我们利用了南卡罗来纳州的一项政策变化，该变化允许之前被监禁的符合条件个体简化地加入Medicaid。通过结合犯罪定罪和健康保险索赔的行政数据，我们发现减少弱势人群获取Medicaid的障碍能够增加某些健康服务的注册和使用率。然而，我们没有发现这种改善的健康保险获取方式能够降低一年或三年的再犯率，这表明此类政策的有效性取决于具体情境。

abstract.text: This study investigates how enhanced regulation can promote innovation, focusing on the impacts of a significant regulatory reform in China's pharmaceutical sector implemented in 2015. Inspired by regulatory practices in the U.S., the reform aimed to address application backlogs and reduce administrative waiting time for new drug development. Using data at the drug and firm levels during 2012--2021, we make three main findings: (1) drug categories experiencing improved approval times witnessed a surge in investigational new drug applications and related clinical trials; (2) despite little improvement in innovativeness (measured by novel targets unexplored by U.S. counterparts) within drug categories, the reform led to changes in firm composition, attracting innovative new firms and boosting overall drug innovativeness; and (3) the market recognized the improvement in drug innovation, as reflected in stock price adjustments post new drug registrations after the reform. Our findings demonstrate that regulatory barriers can hinder the entry of innovative firms and suggest that latecomers could boost their innovation potential by adopting specific, effective regulatory practices from frontier countries.

10.3386/w31976.abstractZh: 本研究探讨了加强监管如何促进创新，重点关注2015年中国制药行业实施的重大监管改革的影响。该改革借鉴了美国的监管实践，旨在解决申请积压问题并缩短新药开发的行政等待时间。通过2012年至2021年间药物和企业的数据分析，我们得出三个主要结论：(1) 审批时间有所改善的药品类别，其新药申请和相关临床试验数量显著增加；(2) 尽管药品类别内的创新性（以美国同类产品未探索的新靶点衡量）几乎没有改善，但改革导致了企业结构的改变，吸引了创新型企业，并提升了整体药品的创新性；(3) 市场对新药品创新的认可体现在改革后新药注册后的股价调整上。我们的研究表明，监管障碍可能会阻碍创新型企业的进入，并提示后来者可以通过借鉴前沿国家的具体、有效的监管实践来提升其创新潜力。

abstract.text: This paper studies the labor market impacts of firm accommodation decisions and assesses implications for the design of social insurance for workplace disability. We leverage a unique workers’ compensation (WC) program in Oregon that provides wage subsidies to firms for accommodating workers with workplace disabilities. Leveraging rich administrative data and a policy change to the wage subsidy, we show that accommodation rates respond to the subsidy rate and that receipt of accommodation leads to a significant increase in employment and earnings a year later. To explore welfare implications, we develop and estimate a frictional labor market model of accommodation as a form of human capital investment. Worker turnover and imperfect experience rating in WC lead to under-accommodation and inefficient labor market outcomes after workplace disability. Counterfactual simulations show that subsidizing accommodation not only improves long-run labor market outcomes of workers experiencing work-related disability but also leads to welfare gains for most workers.

10.3386/w31978.abstractZh: 本文研究了企业 accommodating 决策对劳动力市场的影響，並评估了这对工作场所残疾社会保险设计的启示。我们利用了俄勒冈州一项独特的工人补偿计划，该计划向企业提供工资补贴，以帮助企业安置有工作场所残疾的员工。通过利用丰富的行政数据以及工资补贴政策的调整，我们发现 accommodating 率会受到补贴率的影响，而获得 accommodating 后，员工的就业率和收入会在一年后显著上升。为了探讨福利影响，我们开发并估计了一个关于 accommodating 的摩擦性劳动力市场模型，将其视为一种人力资本投资。工人流动性和不完全的经验评估会导致在工作场所发生残疾后 accommodating 不足，从而导致劳动力市场的效率低下。反事实模拟表明，补贴 accommodating 不仅改善了有工作相关残疾工人的长期劳动力市场结果，还为大多数工人带来了福利收益。

abstract.text: We study the intergenerational health consequences of forced displacement and incarceration of Japanese Americans in the US during WWII. Incarcerated mothers had babies who were less healthy at birth. This decrease in health represents a shift in the entire birthweight distribution due to exposure to prison camps. Imprisoned individuals were less likely to have children with fathers of other ethnic groups but were more likely to receive prenatal care, invest in education, and participate in the labor market. To the extent human capital effects mitigate the full negative effects of incarceration on intergenerational health, our results are a lower bound.

10.3386/w31992.abstractZh: 我们研究了二战期间美国日裔美国人被迫流离失所和监禁对其代际健康的影响。被监禁的母亲所生的婴儿出生时健康状况较差。这种健康状况的下降反映了由于接触集中营而导致的整个出生体重分布的变化。被监禁的人生育的孩子中，父亲为其他族裔群体的可能性较低，但他们更有可能接受产前护理、投资教育并参与劳动力市场。在人力资本效应能够缓解监禁对代际健康的全部负面影响的情况下，我们的研究结果只是一个下限。

abstract.text: We estimate the role of firms in worker health care utilization. Using linked administrative data on Austrian workers from 1998-2018, we exploit mobility between firms to estimate how much a firm contributes to worker-level differences in utilization in a setting with non-employer provided universal health care. We find that firms are responsible for nearly 30 percent of the variation in across-worker health care expenditures. Effects are not driven by changes in geography or industry. We then estimate a measure of relative firm-specific utilization and explore existing correlates to help explain these effects.

10.3386/w32011.abstractZh: 我们估计了企业在工人医疗护理利用中的角色。利用1998年至2018年奥地利工人的关联行政数据，我们利用企业间的流动性来估计企业在非雇主提供的全民医疗护理环境下，对工人医疗护理利用差异的贡献程度。我们发现，企业几乎负责了工人医疗护理支出差异的30%。这些影响并非由地理或行业变化所驱动。随后，我们估计了企业特定医疗护理利用的相对指标，并探讨了现有的相关因素，以帮助解释这些影响。

abstract.text: This study aims to investigate efficient practices pursuing the sustainability of healthcare organizations, as the healthcare sector and its activities affect different spheres of social life, the economy, and the state’s performance, highlighting the importance of this subject. To achieve the aim of this study, a systematic review methodology was applied, and the data were obtained from 67 papers published within the scope of the two most cited databases: Scopus and Web of Science. As a result of the analysis, the following efficient practices were suggested to improve the sustainability of healthcare organizations: improvements in management practices, leadership practices, manager selection, the engagement of clinicians in the management, the promotion of organizational culture and management style, the promotion of virtual health communication, environmental supply chain management, rational resource consumption, and waste management.

10.3390/su15032353.abstractZh: 本研究旨在探讨实现医疗组织可持续性的高效实践。由于医疗行业及其活动影响着社会生活的各个领域、经济以及国家的绩效，因此这一主题的重要性不言而喻。为了实现研究目标，采用了系统综述的方法，数据来源于在两大知名数据库——Scopus和Web of Science上发表的67篇论文。通过分析，提出了以下有助于提高医疗组织可持续性的高效实践：改进管理实践、领导方式、管理者选拔、鼓励临床医生参与管理、促进组织文化和管理风格、推动虚拟健康沟通、实施环境供应链管理、合理资源利用以及废弃物管理。

abstract.text: Smallholder farmers who rely on home garden agroforestry are experiencing significant impacts from climate change. To mitigate these effects, it is crucial for farmers to have access to various adaptation strategies. This study collected data from 384 randomly selected respondents in 18 kebeles over three districts, using descriptive statistics and a multivariate probit model to evaluate the factors influencing smallholder farmers’ decisions on their adaptation strategies against climate change. In Ethiopia’s Gedeo zone, this study found that smallholder farmers employ a range of adaptation methods, including expanding their agroforestry system, implementing modern agriculture techniques, conserving soil and water, diversifying their livelihoods, and employing various coping mechanisms. By analyzing data using the multivariate probit model, this study found several factors that had a significant impact on smallholder farmers’ choice of adaptation options. These factors include social network, age, education level, farming experience, household size, cultivated land size, annual income, and livestock holding. In addition, factors such as perception of climate change, previous experience of crop failure, recurrent drought, and access to information about climate change, occurrence of frost, agricultural extension contacts, access to farmer-to-farmer extension services, and perception of land infertility also influence their decision-making process. Our findings highlight the importance of improving institutional services in rural areas, promoting education on climate change, and strengthening social networks to enhance the ability of smallholder farmers to cope with the effects of climate change.

10.3390/su15118997.abstractZh: 依赖家庭农园农林系统的小农户正面临气候变化带来的显著影响。为了减轻这些影响，农民必须能够获得各种适应策略。本研究在三个地区的18个村庄中，随机选取了384名受访者，使用描述性统计和多元Probit模型来评估影响小农户选择适应策略的因素。在埃塞俄比亚的Gedeo地区，研究发现小农户采用了多种适应方法，包括扩大农林系统、实施现代农业技术、保护土壤和水资源、多样化生计方式以及运用各种应对机制。通过多元Probit模型分析数据，本研究发现一些因素对小农户选择适应方案有显著影响。这些因素包括社会网络、年龄、教育水平、农业经验、家庭规模、耕地面积、年收入以及牲畜数量。此外，对气候变化的认知、以往作物歉收的经历、反复出现的干旱、获取有关气候变化信息的机会、霜冻的发生、农业推广服务、获取农民之间的推广服务以及土地贫瘠的认知等也影响着他们的决策过程。我们的研究结果强调了改善农村地区机构服务的重要性，推广气候变化教育，并加强社会网络，以提高小农户应对气候变化的能力。

abstract.text: BACKGROUND: Purchasing systems aim to improve resource allocation in healthcare markets. The Netherlands is characterized by four different purchasing systems: managed competition in the hospital market, a non-competitive single payer system for long-term care (LTC), municipal procurement for home care and social services, and self-procurement via personal budgets. We hypothesize that managed competition and competitive payer reforms boost reallocations of provider market share by means of active purchasing, ie, redistributing funds from high-quality providers to low-quality providers. METHODS: We define a Market Activity Index (MAI) as the sum of funds reallocated between providers annually. Provider expenditures are extracted from provider financial statements between 2006 and 2019. We compare MAI in six healthcare sectors under four different purchasing systems, adjusting for reforms, and market entry/exit. Next, we perform in-depth analyses on the hospital market. Using multivariate linear regressions, we relate reallocations to selective contracting, provider quality, and market characteristics. RESULTS: No difference was found between reallocations in the hospital care market under managed competition and the non-competitive single payer LTC (MAI between 2% and 3%), while MAI was markedly higher under procurement by municipalities and personal budget holders (between 5% and 15%). While competitive reforms temporarily increased MAI, no structural effects were found. Relatively low hospital MAI could not be explained by market characteristics. Furthermore, the extent of selective contracting or hospital quality differences had no significant effects on reallocations of funds. CONCLUSION: Dutch managed competition and competitive purchaser reforms had no discernible effect on reallocations of funds between providers. This casts doubt on the mechanisms advocated by managed competition and active purchasing to improve allocative efficiency.

10.34172/ijhpm.2023.7506.abstractZh:
背景：采购系统旨在改善医疗保健市场的资源分配。荷兰拥有四种不同的采购系统：医院市场的管理式竞争、长期护理的非竞争性单一支付者系统、市政部门对家庭护理和社会服务的采购，以及通过个人预算进行的自主采购。我们假设管理式竞争和竞争性支付者改革通过积极的采购行为，即将资金从优质提供者重新分配给低质量提供者，从而促进提供者市场份额的重新分配。

方法：我们将市场活动指数定义为每年在提供者之间重新分配的资金总额。我们从2006年至2019年的提供者财务报表中提取了支出数据。我们比较了在四种不同采购系统下的六个医疗保健领域的市场活动指数，并调整了改革和市场进入/退出因素的影响。接下来，我们对医院市场进行了深入分析。通过多元线性回归分析，我们将资金重新分配与选择性合同、提供者质量和市场特征联系起来。

结果：在管理式竞争下的医院护理市场，资金重新分配没有差异，而非竞争性单一支付者长期护理市场的资金重新分配在2%到3%之间。而市政部门和个人预算持有者的采购模式下，市场活动指数明显更高，在5%到15%之间。虽然竞争性改革暂时增加了市场活动指数，但没有发现结构性效应。相对较低的医院市场活动指数无法用市场特征来解释。此外，选择性合同的范围或医院质量差异对资金重新分配没有显著影响。结论：荷兰式的管理式竞争和竞争性采购改革对资金在供应商之间的重新分配没有明显影响。这让人对管理式竞争和积极采购所主张的提高资源配置效率的机制产生怀疑。

abstract.text: This paper studies the extent to which the cyclicality of occupational mobility shapes that of aggregate unemployment and its duration distribution. We document the relation between workers' occupational mobility and unemployment duration over the long run and business cycle. To interpret this evidence, we develop a multisector business cycle model with heterogenous agents. The model is quantitatively consistent with several important features of the US labor market: procyclical gross and countercyclical net occupational mobility, the large volatility of unemployment and the cyclical properties of the unemployment duration distribution, among many others. Our analysis shows that occupational mobility due to workers' changing career prospects, and not occupation‐wide differences, interacts with aggregate conditions to drive the fluctuations of the unemployment duration distribution, and the aggregate unemployment rate.

10.3982/ecta12498.abstractZh: 本文研究了职业流动性周期性变化对总体失业状况及其持续时间分布的影响程度。我们记录了长期内以及商业周期中，工人职业流动性与失业持续时间之间的关系。为了解释这些现象，我们构建了一个包含异质代理人的多部门商业周期模型。该模型与美国劳动力市场的几个重要特征在数量上是一致的：顺周期的显性职业流动性与逆周期的隐性职业流动性、失业的较大波动性，以及失业持续时间分布的周期性特征等。我们的分析表明，由于工人职业前景的变化而导致的职业流动性，而非整个职业领域的差异，与总体经济条件相互作用，从而驱动了失业持续时间分布以及总体失业率的波动。

abstract.text: Shape restrictions have played a central role in economics as both testable implications of theory and sufficient conditions for obtaining informative counterfactual predictions. In this paper, we provide a general procedure for inference under shape restrictions in identified and partially identified models defined by conditional moment restrictions. Our test statistics and proposed inference methods are based on the minimum of the generalized method of moments (GMM) objective function with and without shape restrictions. Uniformly valid critical values are obtained through a bootstrap procedure that approximates a subset of the true local parameter space. In an empirical analysis of the effect of childbearing on female labor supply, we show that employing shape restrictions in linear instrumental variables (IV) models can lead to shorter confidence regions for both local and average treatment effects. Other applications we discuss include inference for the variability of quantile IV treatment effects and for bounds on average equivalent variation in a demand model with general heterogeneity.

10.3982/ecta13830.abstractZh: 在经济学中，形状限制作为理论的可检验推论以及获得有信息量的反事实预测的充分条件，发挥着核心作用。本文提出了一种在由条件矩限制定义的已识别和部分识别模型中，在形状限制下进行推断的一般程序。我们的检验统计量和提出的推断方法基于带有和没有形状限制的情况下，广义矩估计目标函数的最小值。通过一种自助法程序，可以获得在真实局部参数空间的一个子集上的统一有效临界值。在对生育对女性劳动力供给影响的实证分析中，我们展示了在线性工具变量模型中采用形状限制，可以使得局部和平均处理效应的置信区间变短。我们讨论的其他应用包括推断分位数工具变量处理效应的变异性，以及在一个具有一般异质性的需求模型中，对平均等效变异的界限进行估计。

abstract.text: Job loss comes with large present value earnings losses which elude workhorse models of unemployment and labor market policy. I propose a parsimonious model of a frictional labor market in which jobs differ in terms of unemployment risk and workers search off‐ and on‐the‐job. This gives rise to a job ladder with slippery bottom rungs where unemployment spells beget unemployment spells. I allow for human capital to respond to time spent out of work and estimate the framework on German Social Security data. The model captures the joint response of wages, employment, and unemployment risk to job loss which I measure empirically. The key driver of the “unemployment scar” is the loss in job security and its interaction with the evolution of human capital and, in particular, the search for better employment.

10.3982/ecta14008.abstractZh: 失业带来的巨大当前价值收益损失是传统的失业和劳动力市场模型无法解释的。我提出了一个简约的摩擦性劳动力市场模型，该模型认为不同职位在失业风险以及工人在职和离职时的搜寻行为上存在差异。这一模型描绘了一个底部不稳固的职位阶梯，失业事件会引发更多的失业事件。我考虑了人力资本对失业时间的反应，并利用德国社会保障数据对模型进行了实证检验。该模型能够捕捉到工资、就业和失业风险对职位丧失的联合反应，这些反应都是我通过实证数据得出的。而“失业疤痕”的主要成因是职位安全性的丧失，以及人力资本的变化，尤其是寻找更好就业机会的过程。

abstract.text: We quantify the distortionary effects of nexus tax laws on Amazon's distribution network investments between 1999 and 2018. We highlight the role of two features of the expansion of Amazon's network: densification of the network of distribution facilities and vertical integration into package sortation. Densification results in a reduction in the cost of shipping orders, but comes at the expense of higher facility operating costs in more expensive areas and lower scale economies of processing shipments. Nexus laws furthermore generate additional sales tax liabilities as the network grows. Combining data on household spending across online and offline retailers with detailed data on Amazon's distribution network, we quantify these trade‐offs through a static model of demand and a dynamic model of investment. Our results suggest that Amazon's expansion led to significant shipping cost savings and facilitated the realization of aggregate economies of scale. We find that abolishing nexus tax laws in favor of a non‐discriminatory tax policy would induce the company to decentralize its network, lowering its shipping costs. Non‐discriminatory taxation would also entail lower revenue, however, as tax‐inclusive prices would rise, resulting in a fall in profit overall. This drop and the decline in consumer welfare from higher taxes together fall short of the increases in tax revenue and rival profit, suggesting that the abolishment of nexus laws would lead to an increase in total welfare.

10.3982/ecta15265.abstractZh: 我们量化了1999年至2018年间，关联税法对亚马逊分销网络投资造成的扭曲效应。我们强调了亚马逊网络扩展的两个特征的作用：分销设施网络的密集化以及与包裹分拣的纵向整合。网络密集化降低了订单运输成本，但代价是昂贵地区的设施运营成本上升，以及处理运输业务的规模经济效益降低。此外，随着网络的扩大，关联税法还会产生额外的销售税负担。通过结合在线和线下零售商的家庭消费数据，以及亚马逊分销网络的详细数据，我们通过静态需求模型和动态投资模型来量化这些权衡。我们的研究结果表明，亚马逊的扩张显著降低了运输成本，并促进了规模经济的实现。我们发现，废除关联税法，采用非歧视性税收政策，将促使公司分散其网络布局，从而降低运输成本。然而，非歧视性税收也会带来收入下降，因为包含税收的价格会上升，导致整体利润减少。这种下降以及由于税收增加而导致的消费者福利下降，并未超过税收收入和竞争对手利润的增加，这表明废除关联税法将提升总体福利。

abstract.text: R&D investment reduces current profits, so short‐term pressure to hit profit targets may distort R&D. In the data, firms just meeting Wall Street forecasts have lower R&D growth and subsequent innovation, while managers just missing receive lower pay. But short‐termist distortions might not quantitatively matter if aggregation or equilibrium dampen their impact. So I build and estimate a quantitative endogenous growth model in which short‐termism arises naturally as discipline on conflicted managers and boosts firm value by about 1%. But short‐termism reduces R&D, and the social return to R&D is higher than the private return due to standard channels including knowledge spillovers and imperfect competition. So at the macro level, short‐termist distortions slow growth by 5 basis points yearly and lower social welfare by about 1%.

10.3982/ecta15420.abstractZh: 研发投资会降低当期利润，因此短期内追求利润目标的压力可能会扭曲研发行为。数据显示，仅勉强达到华尔街预期的公司，其研发增长和后续创新都会受到影响，而未能达到预期的管理者薪酬也会降低。然而，如果通过汇总或均衡机制来减弱这些短期主义的扭曲效应，那么其量化影响可能并不显著。因此，我构建并估计了一个定量内生增长模型，在该模型中，短期主义作为对冲突管理层的约束自然产生，并提升公司价值约1%。但短期主义会抑制研发活动，而研发的社会回报高于私人回报，这得益于知识溢出效应和不完全竞争等因素。因此，在宏观层面上，短期主义的扭曲每年会减缓经济增长5个基点，并降低社会福利约1%。

abstract.text: This paper studies the welfare effects of encouraging rural–urban migration in the developing world. To do so, we build and analyze a dynamic general‐equilibrium model of migration that features a rich set of migration motives. We estimate the model to replicate the results of a field experiment that subsidized seasonal migration in rural Bangladesh, leading to significant increases in migration and consumption. We show that the welfare gains from migration subsidies come from providing better insurance for vulnerable rural households rather than from correcting spatial misallocation by relaxing credit constraints for those with high productivity in urban areas that are stuck in rural areas.

10.3982/ecta15962.abstractZh: 本文研究了在发展中国家鼓励农村向城市迁移对福利的影响。为此，我们构建并分析了一个动态一般均衡迁移模型，该模型包含丰富的迁移动机。我们通过估计模型来复制一项实地实验的结果，该实验对孟加拉国农村地区的季节性迁移提供了补贴，从而显著增加了迁移和消费。我们发现，迁移补贴带来的福利收益来自于为脆弱的农村家庭提供更好的保障，而不是通过放宽对在城市地区但被滞留在农村地区的具有高生产力的人的信贷限制来纠正空间配置的不均衡。

abstract.text: We study extensive‐form games and mechanisms allowing agents that plan for only a subset of future decisions they may be called to make (the planning horizon ). Agents may update their so‐called strategic plan as the game progresses and new decision points enter their planning horizon. We introduce a family of simplicity standards which require that the prescribed action leads to unambiguously better outcomes, no matter what happens outside the planning horizon. We employ these standards to explore the trade‐off between simplicity and other objectives, to characterize simple mechanisms in a wide range of economic environments, and to delineate the simplicity of common mechanisms such as posted prices and ascending auctions, with the former being simpler than the latter.

10.3982/ecta16310.abstractZh: 我们研究了广义形式博弈以及允许代理人仅针对部分未来决策进行规划的机制（即规划范围）。随着博弈的推进，代理人可能会更新其所谓的战略计划，新的决策点也会进入他们的规划范围。我们提出了一系列简单性标准，要求所采取的行动无论规划范围之外发生什么情况，都能带来更明确的好处。我们利用这些标准来探讨简单性与其他目标之间的权衡，以描述在各种经济环境中的简单机制，并区分常见机制（如公开价格和升序拍卖）的简单性，其中公开价格机制比升序拍卖机制更为简单。

abstract.text: In this paper, we formulate and estimate a flexible model of job mobility and wages with two‐sided heterogeneity. The analysis extends the finite mixture approach of Bonhomme, Lamadon, and Manresa (2019) and Abowd, McKinney, and Schmutte (2019) to develop a new Classification Expectation‐Maximization algorithm that ensures both worker and firm latent‐type identification using wage and mobility variations in the data. Workers receive job offers in worker‐type segmented labor markets. Offers are accepted according to a logit form that compares the value of the current job with that of the new job. In combination with flexibly estimated layoff and job finding rates, the analysis quantifies the four different sources of sorting: job preferences, segmentation, layoffs, and job finding. Job preferences are identified through job‐to‐job moves in a revealed preference argument. They are in the model structurally independent of the identified job wages, possibly as a reflection of the presence of amenities. We find evidence of a strong pecuniary motive in job preferences. While the correlation between preferences and current job wages is positive, the net present value of the future earnings stream given the current job correlates much more strongly with preferences for it. This is more so for short‐ than long‐tenure workers. In the analysis, we distinguish between type sorting and wage sorting. Type sorting is quantified by means of the mutual information index. Wage sorting is captured through correlation between identified wage types. While layoffs are less important than the other channels, we find all channels to contribute substantially to sorting. As workers age, job arrival processes are the key determinant of wage sorting, whereas the role of job preferences dictate type sorting. Over the life cycle, job preferences intensify, type sorting increases, and pecuniary considerations wane.

10.3982/ecta16425.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们构建并估计了一个具有双向异质性的工作流动性和工资灵活模型。该分析扩展了Bonhomme、Lamadon和Manresa（2019年）以及Abowd、McKinney和Schmutte（2019年）的有限混合方法，提出了一种新的分类期望最大化算法，该算法通过数据中的工资和流动性变化，实现了工人和企业的潜在类型识别。在工人类型分割的劳动力市场中，工人会收到工作机会。这些机会的接受程度取决于一个逻辑斯蒂模型，该模型比较了当前工作和新工作的价值。结合灵活估计的裁员和求职率，该分析量化了四种不同的排序来源：工作偏好、分割、裁员和求职。工作偏好通过工作间的转移在揭示性偏好理论中得以识别。它们在模型中与已识别的工作工资结构独立，这可能是便利性的体现。我们发现工作偏好中存在强烈的金钱动机。虽然偏好与当前工作工资之间的相关性是正向的，但未来收入流的净现值与对当前工作的偏好之间的相关性则更为强烈。这一点对于短期和长期工作的工人尤为明显。在分析中，我们区分了类型排序和工资排序。类型排序通过互信息指数来量化。工资排序则通过已识别的工资类型之间的相关性来体现。虽然裁员的重要性低于其他渠道，但我们发现所有渠道都对排序产生了实质性影响。随着工人年龄的增长，工作到达过程成为工资排序的关键决定因素，而工作偏好则决定了类型排序。在生命周期中，工作偏好会增强，类型选择会增多，而金钱方面的考虑则会减少。

abstract.text: What drives the dynamics of top wealth inequality? To answer this question, I propose an accounting framework that decomposes the growth of the share of aggregate wealth owned by a top percentile into three terms: a within term, which is the average wealth growth of individuals initially in the top percentile relative to the economy; a between term, which accounts for individuals entering and exiting the top percentile due to changes in their relative wealth rankings; and a demography term, which accounts for individuals entering or exiting the top percentile due to death and population growth. I obtain closed‐form expressions for each term in a wide range of random growth models. Evidence from the Forbes 400 list suggests that the between term accounts for half of the recent rise in top wealth inequality.

10.3982/ecta16755.abstractZh: 是什么驱动了顶级财富不平等的动态变化？为了回答这个问题，我提出了一个会计框架，将顶级百分位数所拥有的总财富份额的增长分解为三个因素：第一个因素是“内部因素”，即最初处于顶级百分位数的人群相对于整个经济体的平均财富增长；第二个因素是“外部因素”，它考虑了由于相对财富排名的变化而导致个体进入或退出顶级百分位数的情况；第三个因素是“人口因素”，它考虑了由于死亡和人口增长而导致个体进入或退出顶级百分位数的情况。我在多种随机增长模型中得到了每个因素的封闭形式表达式。来自《福布斯》400强榜单的证据表明，外部因素解释了近期顶级财富不平等加剧的一半原因。

abstract.text: This paper proposes a Sieve Simulated Method of Moments (Sieve‐SMM) estimator for the parameters and the distribution of the shocks in nonlinear dynamic models where the likelihood and the moments are not tractable. An important concern with SMM, which matches sample with simulated moments, is that a parametric distribution is required. However, economic quantities that depend on this distribution, such as welfare and asset prices, can be sensitive to misspecification. The Sieve‐SMM estimator addresses this issue by flexibly approximating the distribution of the shocks with a Gaussian and tails mixture sieve. The asymptotic framework provides consistency, rate of convergence, and asymptotic normality results, extending existing results to a new framework with more general dynamics and latent variables. An application to asset pricing in a production economy shows a large decline in the estimates of relative risk aversion, highlighting the empirical relevance of misspecification bias.

10.3982/ecta17068.abstractZh: 本文提出了一种用于非线性动态模型中参数和冲击分布的筛选模拟矩估计方法（Sieve‐SMM），这些模型中的似然函数和矩函数难以处理。与样本对应的模拟矩估计方法的一个重要问题是，需要一个参数化的分布。然而，依赖于该分布的经济量，如福利和资产价格，可能会受到误设的影响而变得敏感。筛选模拟矩估计方法通过灵活地使用高斯分布和尾部混合筛选器来近似冲击分布，从而解决了这一问题。该渐近框架提供了一致性、收敛速率和渐近正态性结果，将现有结果扩展到具有更一般动态和潜变量的新框架中。在生产经济中的资产定价应用中，相对风险厌恶的估计值大幅下降，这凸显了误设偏差的实证重要性。

abstract.text: We develop a new nonparametric approach for discrete choice and use it to analyze the demand for health insurance in the California Affordable Care Act marketplace. The model allows for endogenous prices and instrumental variables, while avoiding parametric functional form assumptions about the unobserved components of utility. We use the approach to estimate bounds on the effects of changing premiums or subsidies on coverage choices, consumer surplus, and government spending on subsidies. We find that a $10 decrease in monthly premium subsidies would cause a decline of between 1.8% and 6.7% in the proportion of subsidized adults with coverage. The reduction in total annual consumer surplus would be between $62 and $74 million, while the savings in yearly subsidy outlays would be between $207 and $602 million. We estimate the demand impacts of linking subsidies to age, finding that shifting subsidies from older to younger buyers would increase average consumer surplus, with potentially large impacts on enrollment. We also estimate the consumer surplus impact of removing the highly‐subsidized plans in the Silver metal tier, where we find that a nonparametric model is consistent with a wide range of possibilities. We find that comparable mixed logit models tend to yield price sensitivity estimates toward the lower end of the nonparametric bounds, while producing consumer surplus impacts that can be both higher and lower than the nonparametric bounds depending on the specification of random coefficients.

10.3982/ecta17215.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种新的非参数方法用于离散选择分析，并利用该方法研究加州平价医疗法案市场中的健康保险需求。该模型允许价格内生和工具变量存在，同时避免了关于未观测效用组成部分的参数化函数形式假设。我们使用该方法估计了保费或补贴变化对保险选择、消费者剩余以及政府补贴支出的影响范围。研究发现，每月补贴减少10美元会导致有补贴的成年人中拥有保险的比例下降1.8%至6.7%。总年度消费者剩余的减少幅度在6200万至7400万美元之间，而年度补贴支出的节省幅度则在2.07亿至6.02亿美元之间。我们还估计了将补贴与年龄挂钩对需求的影响，发现将补贴从年长消费者转向年轻消费者会增加平均消费者剩余，从而对参保率产生较大影响。此外，我们还评估了取消银牌级高度补贴计划对消费者剩余的影响，发现非参数模型与多种可能性结果一致。研究发现，类似的混合Logit模型通常得出的价格敏感性估计值位于非参数界限的较低端，而消费者剩余的影响则可能因随机系数的具体设定而高于或低于非参数界限。

abstract.text: We propose a framework for analyzing the sensitivity of counterfactuals to parametric assumptions about the distribution of latent variables in structural models. In particular, we derive bounds on counterfactuals as the distribution of latent variables spans nonparametric neighborhoods of a given parametric specification while other “structural” features of the model are maintained.
