Our approach recasts the infinite‐dimensional problem of optimizing the counterfactual with respect to the distribution of latent variables (subject to model constraints) as a finite‐dimensional convex program. We also develop an MPEC version of our method to further simplify computation in models with endogenous parameters (e.g., value functions) defined by equilibrium constraints. We propose plug‐in estimators of the bounds and two methods for inference. We also show that our bounds converge to the sharp nonparametric bounds on counterfactuals as the neighborhood size becomes large. To illustrate the broad applicability of our procedure, we present empirical applications to matching models with transferable utility and dynamic discrete choice models.

10.3982/ecta17232.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个框架，用于分析反事实对结构模型中潜在变量分布参数假设的敏感性。具体来说，我们推导了反事实的界限，当潜在变量的分布跨越给定参数规格的非参数邻域时，同时模型的其他“结构”特征保持不变。我们的方法将优化反事实的无限维问题，即针对潜在变量的分布进行优化（受模型约束），重新表述为一个有限维的凸规划问题。我们还开发了MPEC版本的方法，以进一步简化具有内生参数（例如，由均衡约束定义的价值函数）的模型中的计算。我们提出了插入估计器来估计这些界限，并提出了两种推断方法。我们还表明，随着邻域大小的增加，我们的界限会收敛到尖锐的非参数反事实界限。为了说明我们方法的广泛适用性，我们展示了其在具有可转移效用的匹配模型和动态离散选择模型中的实证应用。

abstract.text: I study the optimal provision of information in a long‐term relationship between a sender and a receiver. The sender observes a persistent, evolving state and commits to send signals over time to the receiver, who sequentially chooses public actions that affect the welfare of both players. I solve for the sender's optimal policy in closed form: the sender reports the value of the state with a delay that shrinks over time and eventually vanishes. Even when the receiver knows the current state, the sender retains leverage by threatening to conceal the future evolution of the state.

10.3982/ecta17345.abstractZh: 我研究在发送者与接收者之间的长期关系中，信息最优提供的问题。发送者观察到一个持续且不断变化的状态，并承诺随时间向接收者发送信号。接收者则依次选择会影响双方福利的公共行动。我以封闭形式求解发送者的最优策略：发送者以逐渐缩短并最终消失的延迟报告状态的价值。即使接收者已知当前状态，发送者通过威胁隐藏状态的未来演变，仍然能够保持影响力。

abstract.text: Identifying the strategies that are played is critical to understanding behavior in repeated games. This process is difficult because only choices (not strategies) are observable. Recently, a debate has emerged regarding whether subjects play mixed strategies in the indefinitely repeated prisoner's dilemma. We use an experimental approach to elicit mixed strategies from human subjects, thereby providing direct empirical evidence. We find that a majority of subjects use mixed strategies. However, the data also suggest subjects' strategies are becoming less mixed over time, and move toward three focal pure strategies: Tit For Tat, Grim Trigger, and Always Defect. We use the elicited strategies to provide an empirically‐relevant foundation for analyzing commonly used mixture model estimation procedures.

10.3982/ecta17482.abstractZh: 识别所采用的策略对于理解重复博弈中的行为至关重要。这一过程很困难，因为只能观察到选择而非策略。最近，关于实验对象是否在无限重复的囚徒困境中采用混合策略的问题引发了争论。我们采用实验方法从人类受试者那里获取混合策略的信息，从而提供了直接的实证证据。我们发现，大多数受试者都采用混合策略。然而，数据也表明，随着时间的推移，受试者的策略逐渐变得不那么混合，而是趋向于三种主要的纯策略：以牙还牙、残酷触发和始终背叛。我们利用这些获得的策略为分析常用的混合模型估计方法提供了基于实证的依据。

abstract.text: In this paper, we present a unifying framework for analyzing equilibria and designing interventions for large network games sampled from a stochastic network formation process represented by a graphon. To this end, we introduce a new class of infinite population games, termed graphon games , in which a continuum of heterogeneous agents interact according to a graphon, and we show that equilibria of graphon games can be used to approximate equilibria of large network games sampled from the graphon. This suggests a new approach for design of interventions and parameter inference based on the limiting infinite population graphon game. We show that, under some regularity assumptions, such approach enables the design of asymptotically optimal interventions via the solution of an optimization problem with much lower dimension than the one based on the entire network structure. We illustrate our framework on a synthetic data set and show that the graphon intervention can be computed efficiently and based solely on aggregated relational data.

10.3982/ecta17564.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们提出了一个统一的框架，用于分析大型网络游戏的均衡状态并设计干预措施。这些游戏是从一个由图组成的随机网络形成过程中抽样的。为此，我们引入了一类新的无限人群游戏，称为图游戏。在这种游戏中，一系列异质性的代理人根据图进行互动。我们证明了图游戏的均衡状态可以用来近似从图中抽样得到的大型网络游戏的均衡状态。这为我们基于极限无限人群图游戏设计干预措施和参数推断提供了一种新的方法。我们表明，在某些常规性假设下，这种方法可以通过解决一个维度远低于基于整个网络结构的优化问题，来设计渐进最优的干预措施。我们在一个合成数据集上验证了我们的框架，并展示了图游戏干预措施可以高效地计算出来，而且只需基于聚合的关系数据即可。

abstract.text: Most U.S. government spending on highways and bridges is done through “scaling” procurement auctions, in which private construction firms submit unit price bids for each piece of material required to complete a project. Using data on bridge maintenance projects undertaken by the Massachusetts Department of Transportation (MassDOT), we present evidence that firm bidding behavior in this context is consistent with optimal skewing under risk aversion: firms limit their risk exposure by placing lower unit bids on items with greater uncertainty. We estimate the amount of uncertainty in each auction, and the distribution of bidders' private costs and risk aversion. Simulating equilibrium item‐level bids under counterfactual settings, we estimate the fraction of project spending that is due to risk and evaluate auction mechanisms under consideration by policymakers. We find that scaling auctions provide substantial savings relative to lump sum auctions and show how our framework can be used to evaluate alternative auction designs.

10.3982/ecta17673.abstractZh: 美国政府在高速公路和桥梁建设上的支出大多通过“规模化”采购招标进行。在这种招标方式中，私人建筑公司需要为完成一个项目所需的每一种材料提交单价投标。利用马萨诸塞州交通部承担的桥梁维护项目的数据，我们发现，在这种环境下，企业的投标行为符合风险厌恶条件下的最优偏差：企业通过为不确定性较大的项目提交较低的单价来降低风险。我们估算了每次招标中的不确定性程度，以及投标者的私人成本和风险厌恶程度。通过模拟在反事实情境下的均衡投标情况，我们估算了项目中因风险而产生的支出比例，并评估了政策制定者所考虑的招标机制。研究发现，与一次性招标相比，规模化招标能够带来显著的成本节约，同时我们的框架还可以用于评估其他不同的招标设计方案。

abstract.text: We document a strong empirical connection between corporate taxation and the manufacturing labor share, both in the US and across OECD countries. Our estimates associate 30 to 60% of the observed decline in labor shares with the fall in corporate taxation. Using an equilibrium model of an industry where firms differ in their capital intensities, we show that lower corporate tax rates reduce the labor share by raising the market share of capital‐intensive firms. The tax elasticity of the labor share depends on the joint distribution of labor intensities and value added at the micro level. Given the empirical distribution in the US manufacturing sector, our quantitative analysis suggests that corporate tax cuts explain a significant part of the decline in the manufacturing labor share since the 1950s. The shift away from traditionally large, labor‐intensive production units raised the concentration of market shares and reduced the concentration of employment.

10.3982/ecta17702.abstractZh: 我们发现了企业税收与制造业劳动力份额之间存在强烈的实证关联，这一关联在美国和 OECD 国家均存在。我们的估计显示，观察到的劳动力份额下降中有 30% 到 60% 与企业税收的降低有关。通过构建一个企业资本强度存在差异的行业均衡模型，我们发现较低的企业税率会通过提高资本密集型企业的市场份额来减少劳动力份额。劳动力份额对税收的弹性取决于微观层面劳动强度和附加值之间的联合分布。根据美国制造业部门的实证数据，我们的定量分析表明，自 20 世纪 50 年代以来，企业税收减免解释了制造业劳动力份额下降的相当一部分原因。从传统上劳动密集型的生产单位转向资本密集型生产单位，导致市场份额的集中，同时减少了就业集中度。

abstract.text: Two key features distinguish the general class of recursive preferences from the standard model of dynamic choice: (i) agents may care about the intertemporal distribution of risk, and (ii) their rates of time preference, rather than being fixed, may vary with the level of consumption. We investigate what these features imply in the context of a repeated strategic interaction. First, we show that opportunities for intertemporal trade may expand the set of feasible payoffs relative to that in a static interaction. Two distinct sources for such trade are identified: endogenous heterogeneity in the players' rates of time preference and a hedging motive pertaining to the intertemporal distribution of risk. The set of equilibrium payoffs may on the other hand shrink drastically as many efficient outcomes become unsustainable no matter the level of patience. This “antifolk” result occurs when the players prefer stage outcomes to be positively correlated rather than independent across time. Intuitively, such preferences make it inefficient to offset short‐term losses with future gains, while this is needed to ensure that security levels are met on path. We also establish a folk theorem: if security levels are met on path, such play can be sustained in a subgame perfect equilibrium provided that the players are sufficiently patient.

10.3982/ecta17756.abstractZh: 递归偏好的一般类别与动态选择的标准模型有两个关键区别：(i) 代理人可能关心风险的时间分布；(ii) 他们的时间偏好率并非固定，而是会随着消费水平的变化而变化。我们研究了这些特征在重复策略互动中的含义。首先，我们表明时间跨度的交易机会可能会扩大可行收益的集合，相对于静态互动而言。我们发现了两种不同的交易来源：玩家时间偏好率的内生异质性和与风险时间分布相关的对冲动机。另一方面，由于许多高效的结果在任何耐心水平下都变得不可持续，均衡收益集合可能会大幅缩小。这种“反 folk”结果发生在玩家更倾向于阶段结果在时间上正相关而非独立时。直观上，这种偏好使得用未来的收益来抵消短期损失变得效率低下，而这是确保路径上安全水平得以维持所必需的。我们还建立了一个 folk 定理：如果路径上安全水平得以维持，只要玩家有足够的耐心，这种游戏就可以在子博弈完美均衡中持续下去。

abstract.text: This paper studies a first‐price common‐value auction in which bidders do not know the number of their competitors. In contrast to the case of common‐value auctions with a known number of rival bidders, the inference from winning is not monotone, and a “winner's blessing” emerges at low bids. As a result, bidding strategies may not be strictly increasing, but instead may contain atoms. Moreover, an equilibrium fails to exist when the expected number of competitors is large and the bid space is continuous. Therefore, we consider auctions on a grid. On a fine grid, high‐signal bidders follow an essentially strictly increasing strategy, whereas low‐signal bidders pool on two adjacent bids on the grid. The solutions of a “communication extension” based on Jackson, Simon, Swinkels, and Zame (2002) capture the equilibrium bidding behavior in the limit, as the grid becomes arbitrarily fine.

10.3982/ecta17793.abstractZh: 本文研究了一种第一价格共同价值拍卖机制，在这种拍卖中，竞买者并不知晓竞争对手的数量。与竞买者数量已知的共同价值拍卖不同，在赢得拍卖的情况下，竞买者的策略并非单调的，低出价时会出现“赢家优势”。因此，竞买策略可能不会严格递增，而是可能包含一些特殊的策略。此外，当预期竞争对手数量较多且出价空间连续时，均衡并不存在。因此，我们考虑了在网格上的拍卖。在精细的网格上，信号较强的竞买者会采取严格递增的策略，而信号较弱的竞买者则会在网格上相邻的两个出价处进行合作。基于Jackson、Simon、Swinkels和Zame（2002）的研究成果，我们提出了“通信扩展”模型，该模型能够捕捉到当网格变得任意精细时，均衡竞买行为的变化趋势。

abstract.text: We develop a class of tests for time‐series models such as multiple regression with growing dimension, infinite‐order autoregression, and nonparametric sieve regression. Examples include the Chow test and general linear restriction tests of growing rank p . Employing such increasing p asymptotics, we introduce a new scale correction to conventional test statistics, which accounts for a high‐order long‐run variance (HLV), which emerges as p grows with sample size. We also propose a bias correction via a null‐imposed bootstrap to alleviate finite‐sample bias without sacrificing power unduly. A simulation study shows the importance of robustifying testing procedures against the HLV even when p is moderate. The tests are illustrated with an application to the oil regressions in Hamilton (2003).

10.3982/ecta17918.abstractZh: 我们开发了一类用于时间序列模型的检验方法，包括具有增长维度的多元回归、无限阶自回归以及非参数筛选回归。例如，Chow检验和针对增长秩p的一般线性限制检验。通过采用这种递增p的渐近方法，我们为传统检验统计量引入了新的尺度校正项，以考虑随着样本量增大而出现的高阶长期方差问题。我们还提出了一种通过零假设自举法进行的偏差校正方法，以在不过度牺牲检验功效的情况下减轻有限样本偏差的影响。模拟研究表明，即使当p处于中等水平时，对高阶长期方差进行稳健性检验也是非常重要的。这些检验方法以Hamilton（2003）关于石油回归的研究为例进行了说明。

abstract.text: We develop an urban growth model where human capital spillovers foster entrepreneurship and learning in heterogeneous cities. Incumbent residents limit city expansion through planning regulations so that commuting and housing costs do not outweigh productivity gains from agglomeration. The model builds on strong microfoundations, matches key regularities at the city and economy‐wide levels, and generates novel predictions for which we provide evidence. It can be quantified by relying on few parameters and gives us a basis to estimate them. We examine counterfactuals relaxing planning regulations or constraining city growth to assess the effect of cities on economic growth and aggregate output.

10.3982/ecta17936.abstractZh: 我们开发了一个城市增长模型，该模型认为人力资本的外溢效应能够促进异质城市中的创业和创新活动。现有居民通过规划法规限制城市扩张，以确保通勤和住房成本不会超过集聚带来的生产力提升。该模型基于坚实的微观基础，结合了城市层面和经济整体层面的关键规律，并提出了一些新的预测结果，并提供了相应的证据支持。该模型可以通过较少的参数进行量化，为我们估计这些参数提供了基础。我们研究了放宽规划法规或限制城市扩张的反事实情景，以评估城市对经济增长和总产出的影响。

abstract.text: I study regulation of noncompete employment contracts, assessing the trade‐off between restricting worker mobility and encouraging firm investment. I develop an on‐the‐job search model in which firms and workers sign dynamic wage contracts with noncompete clauses and firms invest in their workers' general human capital. Employers use noncompete clauses to enforce buyout payments when their workers depart, ultimately extracting rent from future employers. This rent extraction is socially excessive, and restrictions on these clauses can improve efficiency. The optimal regulation policy is characterized. In an application to the managerial labor market using a novel contract data set, I find the optimal policy to be quantitatively close to a ban.

10.3982/ecta18128.abstractZh: 我研究非竞争性雇佣合同的监管问题，探讨限制员工流动性与促进企业投资之间的权衡。我构建了一个在职搜寻模型，在该模型中，企业与员工签订包含非竞争条款的动态工资合同，同时企业还会投资于员工的一般人力资本。雇主利用非竞争条款在员工离职时强制要求支付买断金，从而从未来的雇主那里获取租金。这种租金获取行为在社会上是过度的，对这类条款的限制可以提高效率。我确定了最优的监管政策。在将这一模型应用于管理劳动力市场的案例研究中，我发现最优政策在数量上接近于全面禁止。

abstract.text: We postulate a continuous‐time heterogeneous agent model with a financial sector and households to study the nonlinear linkages between aggregate and financial variables. In our model, the interaction between the supply of bonds by the financial sector and the precautionary demand for bonds by households produces significant endogenous aggregate risk . This risk makes the economy transition between a high‐leverage region and a low‐leverage region, which, in turn, creates state dependence in impulse responses: the same shock starting from the high‐leverage region gets propagated and amplified more than when the shock arrives when leverage is low. State dependence in impulse responses generates a time‐varying aggregate precautionary savings motive that, by moving the risk‐free rate, justifies the leverage level of the financial sector in each region. Finally, we illustrate the usefulness of neutral networks to solve for the nonlinear perceived law of motion of the model, and the importance of household heterogeneity in driving its quantitative properties.

10.3982/ecta18180.abstractZh: 我们提出了一个连续时间异质代理模型，该模型包含金融部门和家庭，用于研究总体变量与金融变量之间的非线性联系。在我们的模型中，金融部门提供的债券供应与家庭对债券的预防性需求之间的相互作用，产生了显著的内生总体风险。这种风险使得经济在高杠杆区域与低杠杆区域之间转换，进而在脉冲响应中产生了状态依赖性：来自高杠杆区域的同一冲击在传播和放大时，比来自低杠杆区域的冲击表现得更为显著。脉冲响应中的状态依赖性产生了随时间变化的总体预防性储蓄动机，这种动机通过影响无风险利率，决定了每个区域金融部门的杠杆水平。最后，我们展示了中性网络在解决模型非线性运动规律问题上的有效性，以及家庭异质性在驱动模型定量特性方面的重要性。

abstract.text: Public employment programs may affect poverty both directly through the income they provide and indirectly through general equilibrium effects. We estimate both effects, exploiting a reform that improved the implementation of India's National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme (NREGS) and whose rollout was randomized at a large (sub‐district) scale. The reform raised beneficiary households' earnings by 14%, and reduced poverty by 26%. Importantly, 86% of income gains came from non‐program earnings, driven by higher private‐sector (real) wages and employment. This pattern appears to reflect imperfectly competitive labor markets more than productivity gains: worker's reservation wages increased, land returns fell, and employment gains were higher in villages with more concentrated landholdings. Non‐agricultural enterprise counts and employment grew rapidly despite higher wages, consistent with a role for local demand in structural transformation. These results suggest that public employment programs can effectively reduce poverty in developing countries, and may also improve economic efficiency.

10.3982/ecta18181.abstractZh: 公共就业计划可以通过提供收入直接减少贫困，也可以通过一般均衡效应间接减少贫困。我们通过一项改革来估计这两种效应，该改革改善了印度国家农村就业保障计划（NREGS）的实施效果，并且该计划的实施是在较大规模（子地区）上随机分配的。这项改革使受益家庭的收入增加了14%，贫困率降低了26%。重要的是，86%的收入增长来自非计划收入，这主要是由于私营部门的实际工资和就业增加所致。这种模式似乎更多地反映了不完美的竞争劳动力市场，而非生产率提升：工人的保留工资增加，土地回报下降，在土地持有更为集中的村庄，就业收益更高。尽管工资上升，非农业企业的数量和就业人数却迅速增长，这与当地需求在结构转型中的作用相一致。这些结果表明，公共就业计划可以在发展中国家有效减少贫困，并可能提高经济效率。

abstract.text: The method of synthetic controls is a fundamental tool for evaluating causal effects of policy changes in settings with observational data. In many settings where it is applicable, researchers want to identify causal effects of policy changes on a treated unit at an aggregate level while having access to data at a finer granularity. This article proposes an extension of the synthetic controls estimator that takes advantage of this additional structure and provides nonparametric estimates of the heterogeneity within the aggregate unit. The idea is to replicate the quantile function associated with the treated unit by a weighted average of quantile functions of the control units. This estimator relies on the same mathematical theory as the changes‐in‐changes estimator and can be applied in both repeated cross‐sections and panel data with as little as a single pre‐treatment period. It also provides a unique counterfactual quantile function for any type of distribution.

10.3982/ecta18260.abstractZh: 合成控制法是一种用于评估在观测数据环境下政策变化因果效应的基本工具。在许多适用的情况下，研究人员希望能够在获得更细粒度数据的同时，从总体层面识别政策变化对受处理单元的因果效应。本文提出了一种合成控制估计量的扩展方法，该方法利用这一额外结构，提供对总体单元内异质性的非参数估计。其思路是通过控制单元的分位数函数的加权平均值来复制受处理单元对应的分位数函数。该估计量依赖于与“变化中的变化”估计量相同的数学理论，可以应用于重复横截面和面板数据，甚至只需要一个预处理期即可使用。此外，该方法还能为任何类型的分布提供独特的反事实分位数函数。

abstract.text: How do political connections affect firm dynamics, innovation, and creative destruction? We extend a Schumpeterian growth model with political connections that help firms ease bureaucratic and regulatory burden. The model highlights how political connections influence an economy's business dynamism and innovation, and generates a number of implications guiding our empirical analysis. We construct a new large‐scale data set for the period 1993–2014, on the universe of firms, workers, and politicians, complemented with corporate financial statements, patent data, and election data, so as to define connected firms as those employing local politicians. We identify a leadership paradox: market leaders are much more likely to be politically connected, but much less likely to innovate. Political connections relate to a higher rate of survival, as well as growth in employment and revenues, but not in productivity—a result that we also confirm using the regression discontinuity design. At the aggregate level, gains from political connections do not offset losses stemming from lower reallocation and growth.

10.3982/ecta18338.abstractZh: 政治关系如何影响企业动态、创新以及创造性破坏？我们扩展了熊彼特的增长模型，加入了政治关系因素，这些关系有助于企业减轻官僚和监管负担。该模型揭示了政治关系如何影响经济的商业活力和创新，并提出了一些指导我们实证分析的推论。我们构建了一个涵盖1993年至2014年期间的企业、工人和政治人物的大规模数据集，同时补充了企业财务报表、专利数据和选举数据，以将那些与当地政治家有联系的企业纳入研究范围。我们发现了一个领导悖论：市场领导者更有可能拥有政治关系，但创新的可能性却相对较低。政治关系与更高的生存率以及就业和收入的增长相关，但与生产率的增长无关——这一结果我们通过回归不连续设计也得到了验证。从整体来看，政治关系的收益并未抵消因再分配和增长不足所带来的损失。

abstract.text: This paper argues that a unified analysis of consumption and production is required to understand the long‐run behavior of the U.S. labor share. First, using household data on the universe of consumer spending, I document that higher‐income households spend relatively more on labor‐intensive goods and services as a share of their total consumption. Interpreted as nonhomothetic preferences, this fact implies that economic growth increases the aggregate labor share through an income effect. Second, using disaggregated data on factor shares and capital intensities, I document that equipment‐intensive goods experienced relatively larger declines in their labor shares. Based on this finding, I estimate that capital and labor are gross substitutes, and that investment‐specific technical change reduces the labor share. Given the estimated elasticities, a parsimonious neoclassical model quantitatively matches the observed low‐frequency movements in the aggregate labor share since the 1950s, both its relative stability until about 1980 and its decline thereafter.

10.3982/ecta18580.abstractZh: 本文认为，为了理解美国劳动份额的长期走势，需要对消费和生产进行统一分析。首先，利用家庭消费支出的数据，我发现高收入家庭在总消费中用于劳动密集型商品和服务的比例相对较高。如果将这一事实解释为非同质偏好，那么经济增长会通过收入效应增加总体劳动份额。其次，通过分解要素份额和资本强度的数据，我发现设备密集型商品的劳动份额出现了相对较大的下降。基于这一发现，我估计资本和劳动是完全替代品，而特定于投资的技术变革会降低劳动份额。根据估计的弹性系数，一个简约的新古典模型能够定量匹配自20世纪50年代以来总体劳动份额出现的低频变动，包括其直到1980年左右的相对稳定状态以及之后的下降趋势。

abstract.text: We develop a new approach for the identification of Pareto‐improving tax reforms. This approach yields necessary and sufficient conditions for the existence of Pareto‐improving reform directions. A main insight is that “Two brackets are enough”: When the system cannot be improved by altering tax rates in one or two income brackets, then there is no continuous reform direction that is Pareto‐improving. We also show how to check whether a given tax reform is Pareto‐improving. We use these tools to study the introduction of the Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) in the United States in 1975. A robust finding is that, prior to the EITC, the U.S. tax‐transfer system was not Pareto‐efficient. Under plausible assumptions about behavioral responses, the 1975 reform was not Pareto‐improving. Qualitatively, though, it had the right properties: A similar reform with earnings subsidies made available to a broader range of incomes would have been Pareto‐improving.

10.3982/ecta18600.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种识别帕累托改进性税收改革的新方法。该方法得出了存在帕累托改进性改革方向的必要充分条件。我们的主要见解是：“两个税级就足够了”：当系统无法通过调整一个或两个收入税级来改进时，就不存在连续的帕累托改进性改革方向。我们还展示了如何判断一个给定的税收改革是否具有帕累托改进性。我们利用这些工具研究了1975年美国引入劳动所得税抵免政策的情况。研究发现，在引入劳动所得税抵免政策之前，美国的税收转移系统并不具有帕累托效率。在合理的行为反应假设下，1975年的改革并不具有帕累托改进性。不过，从性质上看，这一改革具有正确的特性：如果为更广泛的收入范围提供类似的收入补贴，那么这一改革将具有帕累托改进性。

abstract.text: This paper revisits the New Keynesian framework, theoretically and quantitatively, in an economy with multiple sectors and input‐output linkages. Analytical expressions for the Phillips curve and welfare, derived as a function of primitives, show that the slope of all sectoral and aggregate Phillips curves is decreasing in intermediate input shares, while productivity fluctuations endogenously generate an inflation‐output tradeoff—except when inflation is measured according to the novel divine coincidence index. Consistent with the theory, the divine coincidence index provides a better fit in Phillips curve regressions than consumer prices. Monetary policy can no longer achieve the first‐best, resulting in a welfare loss of 2.9% of per‐period GDP under the constrained‐optimal policy, which increases to 3.8% when targeting consumer inflation. The constrained‐optimal policy must tolerate relative price distortions across firms and sectors in order to stabilize the output gap, and it can be implemented via a Taylor rule that targets the divine coincidence index.

10.3982/ecta18654.abstractZh: 本文从理论和数量上重新审视了新凯恩斯主义框架在具有多个部门及投入产出联系的经济体系中的应用。通过对基本变量进行推导得出的菲利普斯曲线和福利函数表达式表明，所有部门和总体菲利普斯曲线的斜率随着中间投入份额的增加而下降。此外，生产率波动会内生地产生通胀与产出之间的权衡——除非通胀是根据新的“神圣巧合指数”来衡量的。与理论一致的是，“神圣巧合指数”在菲利普斯曲线回归中的拟合效果优于消费者价格。在受限最优政策下，货币政策无法实现最优结果，导致每期GDP的福利损失为2.9%；而当以消费者通胀为目标时，这一损失则上升至3.8%。受限最优政策必须容忍企业和部门之间的相对价格扭曲，以稳定产出缺口，而这一政策可以通过一个以“神圣巧合指数”为目标的泰勒规则来实施。

abstract.text: We propose a new simulation‐based estimation method, adversarial estimation, for structural models. The estimator is formulated as the solution to a minimax problem between a generator (which generates simulated observations using the structural model) and a discriminator (which classifies whether an observation is simulated). The discriminator maximizes the accuracy of its classification while the generator minimizes it. We show that, with a sufficiently rich discriminator, the adversarial estimator attains parametric efficiency under correct specification and the parametric rate under misspecification. We advocate the use of a neural network as a discriminator that can exploit adaptivity properties and attain fast rates of convergence.

10.3982/ecta18707.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的基于模拟的估计方法——对抗性估计，用于结构模型。该估计器被构建为一个极小极大问题的解，其中生成器使用结构模型生成模拟观测值，而鉴别器则用于判断观测值是否为模拟结果。鉴别器在保持分类准确性的同时最大化其性能，而生成器则试图最小化这种准确性。我们证明，在鉴别器足够丰富的条件下，对抗性估计器在参数设定正确时能够达到参数效率，而在参数设定错误时也能达到参数速率。我们建议使用神经网络作为鉴别器，因为它能够利用自适应特性并实现快速的收敛速度。

abstract.text: Work on relational employment agreements often predicts low payments or termination for poor performance. The possibility of saving can, however, limit the effectiveness of monetary incentives in motivating an employee with diminishing marginal utility for consumption. We study the role of savings and their observability in optimal relational contracts. We focus on the case where players are not too patient, and hence the constant first‐best effort cannot be implemented. If savings are hidden, the relationship eventually deteriorates over time. In particular, both payments and effort decline. On the other hand, if savings are public, consumption is initially high, so the agent's savings fall over time, and effort and payments to the agent increase. The findings thus suggest how tacit agreements on consumption can forestall the deterioration of dynamic relationships in which the agent can save.

10.3982/ecta18742.abstractZh: 关于关系性雇佣协议的研究通常预测，对于表现不佳的员工，支付金额会较低或存在终止雇佣的风险。然而，储蓄的可能性可以限制金钱激励在激励员工时的有效性，因为员工的消费边际效用会逐渐降低。我们研究了储蓄及其可观察性在最优关系性合同中的作用。我们关注的是那些玩家不够耐心的情况，因此无法实施持续的最佳努力。如果储蓄被隐藏，关系会随着时间而恶化，支付金额和努力都会下降。另一方面，如果储蓄是公开的，消费初期会较高，因此代理人的储蓄会随时间减少，而努力和支付给代理人的金额则会增加。这些发现表明，关于消费的默契协议可以防止动态关系中的恶化，因为代理人能够进行储蓄。

abstract.text: What is the role of credit scores in credit markets? We argue that it is, in part, the market's assessment of a person's unobservable type, which here we take to be patience. We postulate a model of persistent hidden types where observable actions shape the public assessment of a person's type via Bayesian updating. We show how dynamic reputation can incentivize repayment. Importantly, we show how an economy with credit scores implements the same equilibrium allocation. We estimate the model using both credit market data and the evolution of individuals' credit scores. We conduct counterfactuals to assess how more or less information used in scoring individuals affects outcomes and welfare. If tracking of individual credit actions is outlawed, poor young adults of low type benefit from subsidization by high types despite facing higher interest rates arising from lower dynamic incentives to repay.

10.3982/ecta18771.abstractZh: 信用评分在信用市场中的作用是什么？我们认为，部分原因在于市场对个人不可观测类型的评估，这里我们将这种类型视为耐心。我们提出了一个关于持续隐藏类型的模型，其中可观测的行为通过贝叶斯更新来影响公众对个人类型的评估。我们展示了动态声誉如何激励还款行为。重要的是，我们展示了具有信用评分的经济体系如何实现相同的均衡分配。我们使用信用市场数据以及个人信用评分的演变来估计该模型。我们通过反事实分析来评估在评分过程中使用更多信息或较少信息对结果和福利的影响。如果禁止追踪个人的信用行为，那么类型较低的贫困年轻人尽管面临更高的利率，但由于高类型的人提供了补贴，他们仍然可以从这种状况中受益，因为高类型的人有更高的还款动力。

abstract.text: We use a two‐stage experiment on agricultural lending in Mali to test whether selection into lending is predictive of heterogeneous returns to capital. Understanding this heterogeneity, and the selection process which reveals it, is critical for guiding modeling of credit markets in developing countries, as well as for policy. We find such heterogeneity: returns to capital are higher for farmers who borrow than for those who do not. In our first stage, we offer loans in some villages and not others. In the second stage, we provide cash grants to a random subset of all farmers in villages where no loans were offered, and to a random subset of the farmers who do not borrow in villages where loans were offered. We estimate seasonal returns to the grant of 130% for would‐be borrowers, whereas we find returns near zero for the sample representative of non‐borrowers. We also provide evidence that there are some farmers—particularly those that are poor at baseline—that have high returns but do not receive a loan.

10.3982/ecta18916.abstractZh: 我们通过在马里进行的两阶段实验来测试选择进入贷款市场是否预示着资本回报的异质性。理解这种异质性以及揭示其选择过程对于指导发展中国家信贷市场的建模以及政策制定至关重要。我们发现确实存在这种异质性：借款的农民获得的资本回报高于未借款的农民。在第一阶段，我们在一些村庄提供贷款，而在其他村庄则不提供。在第二阶段，我们对那些在提供贷款但未获得贷款的村庄中随机选取的农民，以及那些在提供贷款时未借款的村庄中随机选取的农民，提供现金补助。我们估计，对于潜在借款人来说，获得补助的回报率为130%，而对于代表非借款人的样本来说，回报接近零。此外，我们还发现有一些农民——尤其是那些在初始阶段就处于贫困状态的农民——虽然获得了高回报，但却没有获得贷款。

abstract.text: This paper considers the problem of testing whether there exists a non‐negative solution to a possibly under‐determined system of linear equations with known coefficients. This hypothesis testing problem arises naturally in a number of settings, including random coefficient, treatment effect, and discrete choice models, as well as a class of linear programming problems. As a first contribution, we obtain a novel geometric characterization of the null hypothesis in terms of identified parameters satisfying an infinite set of inequality restrictions. Using this characterization, we devise a test that requires solving only linear programs for its implementation, and thus remains computationally feasible in the high‐dimensional applications that motivate our analysis. The asymptotic size of the proposed test is shown to equal at most the nominal level uniformly over a large class of distributions that permits the number of linear equations to grow with the sample size.

10.3982/ecta18979.abstractZh: 本文探讨了检验是否存在一个非负解的问题，该解适用于一个可能欠定的线性方程组，且已知其系数。这种假设检验问题在许多情境下自然出现，包括随机系数、处理效应和离散选择模型，以及一类线性规划问题。作为首次尝试，我们提出了一种新颖的几何表征方法，用于描述无效假设，即满足无限多不等式约束的参数集合。利用这一表征方法，我们设计了一种仅需求解线性规划问题的检验方法，因此在高维应用中仍然具有计算可行性。研究表明，所提出的检验的渐近规模最多等于名义水平，且这一结论适用于大多数允许线性方程数量随样本量增长的分布情况。

abstract.text: We show that foreign capital liberalization reduces capital misallocation and increases aggregate productivity for affected industries in India. The staggered liberalization of access to foreign capital across disaggregated industries allows us to identify changes in firms' input wedges, overcoming major challenges in the measurement of the effects of changing misallocation. Liberalization increases capital overall. For domestic firms with initially high marginal revenue products of capital (MRPK), liberalization increases revenues by 23%, physical capital by 53%, wage bills by 28%, and reduces MRPK by 33% relative to low MRPK firms. The effects of liberalization are largest in areas with less developed local banking sectors, indicating that inefficiencies in that sector may cause misallocation. Finally, we propose an assumption under which a novel method exploiting natural experiments can be used to bound the effect of changes in misallocation on treated industries' aggregate productivity. These industries' Solow residual increases by 3–16%.

10.3982/ecta19039.abstractZh: 我们表明，外资自由化减少了资本的错配，并提升了印度受影响的行业的总体生产力。通过分阶段放开不同行业对外资的准入，我们能够识别企业投入要素的变化，从而克服衡量错配效应变化的主要挑战。自由化总体上增加了资本总量。对于初始资本边际收益产品较高的国内企业而言，自由化使收入增加了23%，实物资本增加了53%，工资支出增加了28%，而资本边际收益产品则相对低一些的企业减少了33%。在本地银行业发展较为落后的地区，自由化的效应最为显著，这表明该行业的低效可能导致了资本的错配。最后，我们提出了一个假设，在该假设下，可以利用自然实验来估算错配变化对受处理行业总体生产力的影响。这些行业的索罗剩余会增加3%到16%。

abstract.text: Gul and Pesendorfer (2015) propose a promising theory of decision under uncertainty, they dub Hurwicz expected utility (HEU). HEU is a special case of α ‐maxmin EU that allows for preferences over sources of uncertainty. It is consistent with most of the available empirical evidence on decision under risk and uncertainty. We show that HEU is also tractable and can readily be measured and tested. We do this by deriving a new two‐parameter functional form for the probability weighting function, which fits our data well and which offers a clean separation between ambiguity perception and ambiguity aversion. In two experiments, we find support for HEU's predictions that ambiguity aversion is constant across sources of uncertainty and that ambiguity aversion and first order risk aversion are positively correlated.

10.3982/ecta19221.abstractZh: Gul和Pesendorfer在2015年提出了一个关于不确定性下决策的有前景理论，他们将其称为Hurwicz期望效用（HEU）。HEU是α-maxmin期望效用的一个特例，它允许对不确定性来源进行偏好排序。这一理论与大多数关于风险和不确定性下决策的经验证据是一致的。我们证明HEU也是易于处理的理论，并且可以方便地进行测量和验证。我们通过推导一个新的双参数概率加权函数形式来实现这一点，该形式与我们的数据非常吻合，并且能够清晰地区分模糊感知和模糊厌恶。在两项实验中，我们发现HEU的预测得到了支持：模糊厌恶在不同不确定性来源之间是恒定的，而且模糊厌恶与一阶风险厌恶之间存在正相关关系。

abstract.text: This paper theoretically and empirically investigates factional arrangements within the Chinese Communist Party (CCP), the governing political party of the People's Republic of China. Using detailed biographical information of political elites in the Central Committee and provincial governments, we present a set of new empirical regularities within the CCP, including systematic patterns of cross‐factional balancing at different levels of the political hierarchy and substantial faction premia in promotions. We propose and estimate an organizational economic model to characterize factional politics within single‐party nondemocratic regimes and its economic implications.

10.3982/ecta19274.abstractZh: 本文从理论和实证的角度，对中国共产党（CCP）内部的派系安排进行了研究。中国共产党是中华人民共和国的执政党。通过详细分析中央委员会和省级政府中的政治精英的生平信息，我们发现了一些新的实证规律，包括政治层级不同层面上的系统性跨派系平衡机制，以及晋升过程中显著的派系溢价现象。我们提出并估算了一个组织经济模型，以描述单一政党非民主制度下的派系政治及其经济影响。

abstract.text: There is an innate human tendency, one might call it the “league table mentality,” to construct rankings. Schools, hospitals, sports teams, movies, and myriad other objects are ranked even though their inherent multi‐dimensionality would suggest that—at best—only partial orderings were possible. We consider a large class of elementary ranking problems in which we observe noisy, scalar measurements of merit for n objects of potentially heterogeneous precision and are asked to select a group of the objects that are “most meritorious.” The problem is naturally formulated in the compound decision framework of Robbins's (1956) empirical Bayes theory, but it also exhibits close connections to the recent literature on multiple testing. The nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator for mixture models (Kiefer and Wolfowitz (1956)) is employed to construct optimal ranking and selection rules. Performance of the rules is evaluated in simulations and an application to ranking U.S. kidney dialysis centers.

10.3982/ecta19304.abstractZh: 人类天生具有一种倾向，可以称之为“排行榜心态”，即倾向于对事物进行排名。学校、医院、运动队、电影以及无数其他对象都会被排名，尽管这些对象的多维度特性表明，最多只能得到部分排序结果。我们考虑了一类基本的排名问题，在这个问题中，我们对具有潜在异质性的n个对象进行噪声性的标量测量，并需要选出“最具价值”的对象群体。这个问题自然可以运用Robbins（1956）的经验贝叶斯理论框架来构建，但它也与最近关于多重检验的文献有着密切的联系。为了构建最优的排名和选择规则，我们采用了混合模型的非参数最大似然估计方法（Kiefer和Wolfowitz，1956）。通过模拟实验评估了这些规则的性能，并将其应用于对美国肾脏透析中心的排名。

abstract.text: We develop a new approach to estimating the causal effects of treatments or instruments that combine multiple sources of variation according to a known formula. Examples include treatments capturing spillovers in social or transportation networks and simulated instruments for policy eligibility. We show how exogenous shocks to some, but not all, determinants of such variables can be leveraged while avoiding omitted variables bias. Our solution involves specifying counterfactual shocks that may as well have been realized and adjusting for a summary measure of non-randomness in shock exposure: the average treatment (or instrument) across shock counterfactuals. We use this approach to address bias when estimating employment effects of market access growth from Chinese high-speed rail construction.

10.3982/ecta19367.abstractZh: 我们提出了一种新的方法来估计处理或工具变量的因果效应，这些方法根据已知的公式结合多种变异来源。例如，处理可以捕捉社会或交通网络中的溢出效应，而模拟工具则用于政策资格评估。我们展示了如何利用某些但并非所有变量的外生冲击，同时避免遗漏变量偏差。我们的解决方案包括指定可能实际发生的反事实冲击，并调整冲击暴露的非随机性综合度量：即在不同反事实情况下平均处理（或工具）的效果。我们利用这种方法来解决从中国高铁建设估计市场开放增长对就业影响的偏差问题。

abstract.text: This paper assesses when the validity of difference‐in‐differences depends on functional form. We provide a novel characterization: the parallel trends assumption holds under all strictly monotonic transformations of the outcome if and only if a stronger “parallel trends”‐type condition holds for the cumulative distribution function of untreated potential outcomes. This condition for parallel trends to be insensitive to functional form is satisfied if and essentially only if the population can be partitioned into a subgroup for which treatment is effectively randomly assigned and a remaining subgroup for which the distribution of untreated potential outcomes is stable over time. These conditions have testable implications, and we introduce falsification tests for the null that parallel trends is insensitive to functional form.

10.3982/ecta19402.abstractZh: 本文评估了“差异中的差异”的有效性是否取决于函数形式。我们提出了一种新的描述方法：如果未处理潜在结果的累积分布函数满足一个更强的“平行趋势”类型条件，那么对于所有严格单调的结果变换，平行趋势假设仍然成立。只有当人群可以被划分为一个子群体，在该子群体中治疗是随机分配的，以及另一个子群体中未处理潜在结果的分布随时间稳定时，平行趋势才对函数形式不敏感。这些条件具有可检验的含义，我们提出了针对“平行趋势对函数形式不敏感”这一零假设的验证测试。

abstract.text: We study the investment incentives created by truthful mechanisms that allocate resources using approximation algorithms. Some approximation algorithms guarantee nearly 100% of the optimal welfare in the allocation problem but guarantee nothing when accounting for investment incentives. An algorithm's allocative and investment guarantees coincide if and only if its confirming negative externalities are sufficiently small. We introduce fast approximation algorithms for the knapsack problem that have no confirming negative externalities and guarantees close to 100% for both allocation and investment.

10.3982/ecta19559.abstractZh: 我们研究了由使用近似算法分配资源的真实机制所创造的投资激励。某些近似算法在分配问题中几乎可以保证100%的最优福利，但在考虑投资激励时则无法保证任何结果。一个算法的分配和投资保证只有在其确认的负面外部性足够小的情况下才会同时成立。我们为背包问题引入了快速近似算法，这些算法没有确认的负面外部性，并且在分配和投资方面都接近100%的保证。

abstract.text: We study a regulation in Chile that mandates warning labels on products whose sugar or caloric concentration exceeds certain thresholds. We show that consumers substitute from labeled to unlabeled products—a pattern mostly driven by products that consumers mistakenly believe to be healthy. On the supply side, we find substantial reformulation of products and bunching at the thresholds. We develop and estimate an equilibrium model of demand for food and firms' pricing and nutritional choices. We find that food labels increase consumer welfare by 1.8% of total expenditure, and that these effects are enhanced by firms' responses. We then use the model to study alternative policy designs. Under optimal policy thresholds, food labels and sugar taxes generate similar gains in consumer welfare, but food labels benefit the poor relatively more.

10.3982/ecta19603.abstractZh: 我们研究了智利的一项法规，该法规要求对含糖量或热量超过一定阈值的产品标注警告标签。我们发现，消费者更倾向于选择未标注标签的产品，这种现象主要出现在那些被消费者误认为健康的产品上。在供应方面，我们发现产品配方发生了重大改革，并且在特定阈值处出现了集中现象。我们建立并估计了一个关于食品需求、企业定价及营养选择的均衡模型。研究发现，食品标签使消费者总支出增加了1.8%，而这些效果因企业的响应而得到增强。随后，我们利用该模型研究了不同的政策设计方案。在最优政策阈值下，食品标签和糖税在提高消费者福利方面产生类似的效果，但食品标签对贫困群体的福利提升更为显著。

abstract.text: As search frictions in the market for a consumer product decline, buyers are able to locate and access more and more sellers. In response, sellers choose to design varieties of the product that are more and more specialized in order to take advantage of the heterogeneity in buyers' preferences. I find conditions on the fundamentals of the market under which the increase in specialization exactly offsets the decline in search frictions. Under these conditions, the extent of competition and the extent of price dispersion remain constant over time even though search frictions are vanishing. Buyer's surplus and seller's profit, however, grow over time at a constant endogenous rate, as the increase in specialization allows sellers to cater better and better to the preferences of individual buyers.

10.3982/ecta19653.abstractZh: 随着消费者产品市场的搜索摩擦减少，买家能够找到并接触到越来越多的卖家。作为回应，卖家选择设计越来越专业化的产品，以利用买家偏好上的差异。我发现，在某些市场基本条件下，专业化的增加正好抵消了搜索摩擦的减少。在这些条件下，尽管搜索摩擦正在消失，但竞争程度和价格差异程度随时间保持不变。然而，随着专业化的增加，买家的 surplus 和卖家的利润会以恒定的内生速率增长，因为专业化程度的提高使得卖家能够更好地满足个别买家的偏好。

abstract.text: The discourse around pay transparency has focused on partial equilibrium effects: how workers rectify pay inequities through informed renegotiation. We investigate how employers respond in equilibrium. We study a model of bargaining under two‐sided incomplete information. Our model predicts that transparency reduces the individual bargaining power of workers, leading to lower average wages. A key insight is that employers credibly refuse to pay high wages to any one worker to avoid costly renegotiations with others. When workers have low individual bargaining power, pay transparency has a muted effect. We test our model with an event‐study analysis of U.S. state‐level laws protecting the right of private sector workers to communicate salary information with their coworkers. Consistent with our theoretical predictions, transparency laws empirically lead wages to decline by approximately 2%, and wage declines are smallest in magnitude when workers have low individual bargaining power.

10.3982/ecta19788.abstractZh: 关于薪酬透明度的讨论主要集中在部分均衡效应上：即工人如何通过知情后的重新谈判来纠正薪酬不平等。我们研究了雇主在均衡状态下的反应。我们研究了一个在双边信息不完全条件下的讨价还价模型。我们的模型预测，透明度会降低工人的个体讨价还价能力，从而导致平均工资下降。一个关键的洞察是，雇主会可信地拒绝向任何一名工人支付高工资，以避免与其他工人进行昂贵的重新谈判。当工人的个体讨价还价能力较低时，薪酬透明度的影响较为有限。我们通过一项事件研究分析来验证我们的模型，该研究针对美国各州保护私营部门工人与同事沟通薪资信息的法律进行了研究。与我们的理论预测一致，透明度法律实际上导致工资下降了约2%，而当工人的个体讨价还价能力较低时，工资下降的幅度最小。

abstract.text: Since network data commonly consists of observations from a single large network, researchers often partition the network into clusters in order to apply cluster‐robust inference methods. Existing such methods require clusters to be asymptotically independent. Under mild conditions, we prove that, for this requirement to hold for network‐dependent data, it is necessary and sufficient that clusters have low conductance, the ratio of edge boundary size to volume. This yields a simple measure of cluster quality. We find in simulations that when clusters have low conductance, cluster‐robust methods control size better than HAC estimators. However, for important classes of networks lacking low‐conductance clusters, the former can exhibit substantial size distortion. To determine the number of low‐conductance clusters and construct them, we draw on results in spectral graph theory that connect conductance to the spectrum of the graph Laplacian. Based on these results, we propose to use the spectrum to determine the number of low‐conductance clusters and spectral clustering to construct them.

10.3982/ecta19816.abstractZh: 由于网络数据通常包含来自单个大型网络的观测数据，研究人员常常将网络划分为多个簇，以便应用簇鲁棒性推断方法。现有的此类方法要求簇在渐近意义上相互独立。在温和的条件下，我们证明了，对于依赖网络的数据，簇具有低传导率这一要求是充分且必要的。低传导率是指边边界大小与体积的比率。这提供了一种简单的簇质量衡量方法。通过模拟发现，当簇具有低传导率时，簇鲁棒性方法在控制大小方面优于哈希集中值估计器。然而，对于缺乏低传导率簇的重要网络类型，前者可能会表现出显著的大小失真。为了确定低传导率簇的数量并构建它们，我们借鉴了谱图论中的结果，这些结果将传导率与图拉普拉斯算子的谱联系起来。基于这些结果，我们提出利用谱来确定低传导率簇的数量，并利用谱聚类来构建这些簇。

abstract.text: The United States spends significant amounts on non‐medical transfers for its working‐age population in a wide range of programs that support low‐ and middle‐income households. How valuable are these programs for U.S. households? Are there simpler, welfare‐improving ways to transfer resources that are supported by a majority? What are the macroeconomic effects of such alternatives? We answer these questions in an equilibrium, life‐cycle model with single and married households who face idiosyncratic productivity risk, in the presence of costly children and potential skill losses of females associated with non‐participation. Our findings show that a potential revenue‐neutral elimination of the welfare state generates large welfare losses in the aggregate, although most households support the move as losses are concentrated among a small group. We find that a Universal Basic Income program does not improve upon the current system. If, instead, per‐person transfers are implemented alongside a proportional tax, a Negative Income Tax experiment, it becomes feasible to improve upon the current system. Providing per‐person transfers to all households is costly, and reducing tax distortions helps to provide for resources to expand redistribution.

10.3982/ecta19921.abstractZh: 美国为劳动年龄人口提供了大量用于非医疗领域的转移支付，这些项目旨在支持低收入和中等收入家庭。这些项目对美国家庭来说究竟有多大的价值？是否存在更简单、更能改善福利的资源配置方式，并且这些方式能得到大多数人的支持？这样的替代方案在宏观经济上会产生什么影响？我们在一个均衡的、涵盖单身和已婚家庭的模型中回答了这些问题。这些家庭面临独特的生产力风险，同时还存在孩子抚养成本高以及女性因不参与而可能失去技能的问题。我们的研究发现，即使取消福利制度，也不会产生巨大的福利损失，因为损失主要集中在少数家庭身上。我们发现，普遍基本收入计划并不能改善当前的体系。相反，如果实施个人转移支付，并配合比例性税收或负所得税政策，那么改善当前体系是可行的。向所有家庭提供个人转移支付成本较高，而减少税收扭曲则有助于提供资源以扩大再分配范围。

abstract.text: We investigate the ability of a platform to design its marketplace to promote competition, improve consumer surplus, and increase its own payoff. We consider demand‐steering rules that reward firms that cut prices with additional exposure to consumers. We examine the impact of these rules both in theory and by using simulations with artificial intelligence pricing algorithms (specifically Q‐learning algorithms, which are commonly used in computer science). Our theoretical results indicate that these policies (which require little information to implement) can have strongly beneficial effects, even when sellers are infinitely patient and seek to collude. Similarly, our simulations suggest that platform design can benefit consumers and the platform, but that achieving these gains may require policies that condition on past behavior and treat sellers in a nonneutral fashion. These more sophisticated policies disrupt the ability of algorithms to rotate demand and split industry profits, leading to low prices.

10.3982/ecta19978.abstractZh: 我们研究了一个平台设计其市场以促进竞争、提高消费者剩余并增加自身收益的能力。我们考虑了那些奖励降价且能增加消费者接触度的需求引导规则。我们通过理论和模拟实验来检验这些规则的影响，其中模拟实验使用了人工智能定价算法（特别是Q学习算法，这种算法在计算机科学中很常见）。我们的理论结果表明，这些政策（实施起来所需的信息很少）即使当卖家具有无限耐心并试图勾结时，也能产生显著的好处。同样，我们的模拟实验表明，平台设计确实能够惠及消费者和平台，但要实现这些收益，可能需要基于过去行为制定的政策，并以非中立的方式对待卖家。这些更复杂的政策会破坏算法调整需求和分配行业利润的能力，从而导致价格降低。

abstract.text: An agent observes the set of available projects and proposes some, but not necessarily all, of them. A principal chooses one or none from the proposed set. We solve for a mechanism that minimizes the principal's worst‐case regret. We compare the single‐project environment in which the agent can propose only one project with the multiproject environment in which he can propose many. In both environments, if the agent proposes one project, it is chosen for sure if the principal's payoff is sufficiently high; otherwise, the probability that it is chosen decreases in the agent's payoff. In the multiproject environment, the agent's payoff from proposing multiple projects equals his maximal payoff from proposing each project alone. The multiproject environment outperforms the single‐project one by providing better fallback options than rejection and by delivering this payoff to the agent more efficiently.

10.3982/ecta20157.abstractZh: 一个代理人观察了所有可用的项目，并提议其中一些项目，但不一定全部。委托人从提议的项目中选择一个或选择不选择任何项目。我们找到了一种机制，能够最小化委托人在最坏情况下的遗憾。我们比较了代理人只能提议一个项目的单一项目环境与可以提议多个项目的多项目环境。在两种环境中，如果代理人提议了一个项目，并且委托人的收益足够高，那么这个项目肯定会被选中；否则，随着代理人收益的增加，被选中的概率会降低。在多项目环境中，代理人提议多个项目所带来的收益等于他单独提议每个项目时的最大收益。多项目环境优于单一项目环境，因为它提供了比被拒绝更好的备选方案，并且能更有效地为代理人带来收益。

abstract.text: We study how discounting and monitoring jointly determine whether cooperation is possible in repeated games with imperfect (public or private) monitoring. Our main result provides a simple bound on the strength of players' incentives as a function of discounting, monitoring precision, and on‐path payoff variance. We show that the bound is tight in the low‐discounting/low‐monitoring double limit, by establishing a public‐monitoring folk theorem where the discount factor and the monitoring structure can vary simultaneously.

10.3982/ecta20206.abstractZh: 我们研究了折扣和监控如何共同决定在存在不完美（公共或私人）监控的重复博弈中是否可能实现合作。我们的主要结果提供了一个简单的界限，用于描述玩家的激励强度与折扣、监控精度以及路径上的收益方差之间的关系。我们证明，在低折扣/低监控的双限制条件下，这个界限是紧的，并通过建立一个公共监控的 folk 定理来证明了这一点，该定理允许折扣因子和监控结构同时发生变化。

abstract.text: We incorporate forward‐looking capital accumulation into a dynamic discrete choice model of migration. We characterize the steady‐state equilibrium; generalize existing dynamic exact‐hat algebra techniques to incorporate investment; and linearize the model to provide an analytical characterization of the economy's transition path using spectral analysis. We show that capital and labor dynamics interact to shape the economy's speed of adjustment toward steady state. We implement our quantitative analysis using data on capital stocks, populations, and bilateral trade and migration flows for U.S. states from 1965–2015. We show that this interaction between capital and labor dynamics plays a central role in explaining the observed decline in the rate of income convergence across U.S. states and the persistent and heterogeneous impact of local shocks.

10.3982/ecta20273.abstractZh: 我们将前瞻性资本积累纳入一个动态离散选择模型来研究迁移问题。我们描述了稳态均衡状态；将现有的动态精确代数技术推广以包含投资因素；并对模型进行线性化处理，通过谱分析对经济的转型路径进行解析描述。我们发现，资本和劳动力的动态相互作用决定了经济向稳态调整的速度。我们基于1965年至2015年美国各州的资本存量、人口数据以及双边贸易和迁移流动数据，实施了定量分析。结果表明，资本和劳动力动态之间的相互作用在解释美国各州收入收敛速度的下降以及局部冲击的持续性和异质性影响方面起着核心作用。

abstract.text: We combine personnel records of the United States federal bureaucracy from 1997 to 2019 with administrative voter registration data to study how ideological alignment between politicians and bureaucrats affects turnover and performance. We document significant partisan cycles and turnover among political appointees. By contrast, we find no political cycles in the civil service. At any point in time, a sizable share of bureaucrats is ideologically misaligned with their political leaders. We study the performance implications of this misalignment for the case of procurement officers. Exploiting presidential transitions as a source of “within‐bureaucrat” variation in political alignment, we find that procurement contracts overseen by misaligned officers exhibit greater cost overruns and delays. We provide evidence consistent with a general “morale effect,” whereby misaligned bureaucrats are less motivated to pursue the organizational mission. Our results thus help to shed some of the first light on the costs of ideological misalignment within public organizations.

10.3982/ecta20355.abstractZh: 我们结合了1997年至2019年美国联邦官僚机构的人事记录与行政选民登记数据，研究政治家与官僚之间的意识形态一致性如何影响人员流动和绩效。我们发现政治任命人员中存在显著的党派周期和人员流动现象。相比之下，公务员队伍中并未出现类似的党派周期。在任何时候，都有相当比例的官僚与他们的政治领导人存在意识形态上的不一致。我们研究了这种不一致对采购官员绩效的影响。通过利用总统换届作为“官僚内部”政治一致性变化的来源，我们发现由意识形态不一致的官员负责的采购合同更容易出现成本超支和延误。我们的研究结果与“士气效应”理论相符，即意识形态不一致的官僚更不愿意致力于组织目标。因此，我们的研究结果有助于初步了解公共组织中意识形态不一致所带来的成本问题。

abstract.text: This paper develops and deploys a methodology for testing whether people correctly value tools that reduce attention costs. We call these tools bandwidth enhancements (BEs) and characterize how demand for BEs varies with the pecuniary incentives to be attentive, under the null hypothesis of correct perceptions and optimal choice. We examine if the theoretical optimality conditions are satisfied in three experiments. The first is a field experiment ( n = 1373) with an online education platform, in which we randomize incentives to complete course modules and incentives to utilize a plan‐making tool to complete the modules. In the second experiment ( n = 2306), participants must complete a survey in the future. We randomize survey‐completion incentives and how long participants must wait to complete the survey, and we elicit willingness to pay for reminders. The third experiment ( n = 1465) involves a psychometric task in which participants must identify whether there are more correct or incorrect mathematical equations in an image. We vary incentives for accuracy, elicit willingness to pay to reduce task difficulty, and examine the impact of learning and feedback. In all experiments, demand for reducing attention costs increases as incentives for accurate task completion increase. However, in all experiments—and across all conditions—our tests imply that this increase in demand is too small relative to the null of correct perceptions. These results suggest that people may be uncertain or systematically biased about their attention cost functions, and that experience and feedback do not necessarily eliminate bias.

10.3982/ecta20400.abstractZh: 本文开发并应用了一种方法来测试人们是否能够正确评估那些能够降低注意力成本的工具。我们将这些工具称为带宽增强工具（BEs），并研究了在正确感知和最优选择的零假设下，对BEs的需求如何随着用于保持注意力的金钱激励而变化。我们通过三项实验来检验这些理论上的最优条件是否得到满足。第一项实验是在一个在线教育平台进行的实地实验，参与者被随机分配完成课程模块的激励措施，以及使用计划工具来完成模块激励措施。第二项实验中有2306名参与者需要完成一项未来调查，实验中随机分配了完成调查的激励措施以及参与者等待时间，同时调查了人们对提醒服务的支付意愿。第三项实验涉及一项心理测量任务，参与者需要判断图像中正确的数学方程数量更多还是错误的数学方程数量更多。实验中改变了准确性的激励措施，调查了人们为降低任务难度而愿意支付的费用，并研究了学习和反馈对需求的影响。在所有实验中，随着准确完成任务激励的增加，降低注意力成本的需求也随之增加。然而，在所有实验中——以及所有条件下——我们的测试表明，这种需求的增加相对于正确感知的零假设来说太小。这些结果表明，人们可能对自己的注意力成本函数存在不确定性或系统性偏见，而经验和反馈并不能一定消除这种偏见。

abstract.text: Emissions abatement alone cannot address the consequences of global warming for weather disasters. We model how society adapts to manage disaster risks to capital stock. Optimal adaptation—a mix of firm‐level efforts and public spending—varies as society learns about the adverse consequences of global warming for disaster arrivals. Taxes on capital are needed alongside those on carbon to achieve the first best. We apply our model to country‐level control of flooding from tropical cyclones. Learning rationalizes empirical findings, including the responses of Tobin's q , equity risk premium, and risk‐free rate to disaster arrivals. Adaptation is more valuable under learning than a counterfactual no‐learning environment. Learning alters social‐cost‐of‐carbon projections due to the interaction of uncertainty resolution and endogenous adaptive response.

10.3982/ecta20442.abstractZh: 单纯的减排措施无法解决全球变暖对天气灾害的影响。我们模拟了社会如何适应以管理灾难对资本存量的风险。最优的适应措施——包括企业层面的努力和公共支出——会随着社会逐渐了解全球变暖对灾害发生频率的负面影响而发生变化。除了对碳排放征税外，还需要对资本征税以实现最佳效果。我们将模型应用于对热带气旋引发的洪水进行国家层面的控制。学习过程有助于解释实证研究结果，包括托宾系数、股权风险溢价以及无风险利率对灾害发生频率的反应。在缺乏学习的情况下，适应措施的价值更高。由于不确定性解决与内生性适应反应的相互作用，学习过程改变了社会碳成本预测。

abstract.text: Nearest neighbor (NN) matching is widely used in observational studies for causal effects. Abadie and Imbens (2006) provided the first large‐sample analysis of NN matching. Their theory focuses on the case with the number of NNs, M fixed. We reveal something new out of their study and show that once allowing M to diverge with the sample size an intrinsic statistic in their analysis constitutes a consistent estimator of the density ratio with regard to covariates across the treated and control groups. Consequently, with a diverging M , the NN matching with Abadie and Imbens' (2011) bias correction yields a doubly robust estimator of the average treatment effect and is semiparametrically efficient if the density functions are sufficiently smooth and the outcome model is consistently estimated. It can thus be viewed as a precursor of the double machine learning estimators.

10.3982/ecta20598.abstractZh: 最近邻匹配在观察性研究中被广泛用于因果效应的分析。Abadie和Imbens在2006年首次进行了关于最近邻匹配的大样本分析。他们的理论主要关注当最近邻的数量M固定时的情形。我们从他们的研究中发现了一些新的内容，并表明：一旦允许M随着样本量的变化而变动，他们分析中一个内在统计量就可以作为治疗组和对照组之间协变量密度比的一致估计量。因此，当M发生变化时，结合Abadie和Imbens在2011年提出的偏差校正方法，可以得到一个双重稳健的平均处理效应估计量，并且如果密度函数足够平滑，且结果模型能够被一致估计，那么这个估计量还具有半参数效率。因此，它可以被视为双重机器学习估计量的先驱。

abstract.text: We study sequential bargaining between a proposer and a veto player. Both have single‐peaked preferences, but the proposer is uncertain about the veto player's ideal point. The proposer cannot commit to future proposals. When players are patient, there can be equilibria with Coasian dynamics: the veto player's private information can largely nullify proposer's bargaining power. Our main result, however, is that under some conditions there also are equilibria in which the proposer obtains the high payoff that he would with commitment power. The driving force is that the veto player's single‐peaked preferences give the proposer an option to “leapfrog,” that is, to secure agreement from only low‐surplus types early on to credibly extract surplus from high types later. Methodologically, we exploit the connection between sequential bargaining and static mechanism design.

10.3982/ecta20658.abstractZh: 我们研究了提议者与否决者之间的序贯讨价还价行为。双方都拥有单峰偏好，但提议者对否决者的理想点并不确定。提议者无法对未来提议做出承诺。当双方都具备耐心时，可能会出现具有科亚斯动态特性的均衡：否决者的私人信息在很大程度上会削弱提议者的讨价还价能力。然而，我们的主要结论是，在某些条件下，还存在一种均衡，在这种均衡中，提议者能够获得他在拥有承诺能力时所能获得的高额收益。其背后的驱动力在于，否决者的单峰偏好为提议者提供了一种“跳跃式”的策略，即早期从低剩余类型那里获得协议，之后再可信地从高剩余类型那里获取剩余。在方法论上，我们利用了序贯讨价还价行为与静态机制设计之间的联系。

abstract.text: This paper notes a simple connection between synthetic control and online learning. Specifically, we recognize synthetic control as an instance of Follow‐The‐Leader (FTL). Standard results in online convex optimization then imply that, even when outcomes are chosen by an adversary, synthetic control predictions of counterfactual outcomes for the treated unit perform almost as well as an oracle weighted average of control units' outcomes. Synthetic control on differenced data performs almost as well as oracle weighted difference‐in‐differences, potentially making it an attractive choice in practice. We argue that this observation further supports the use of synthetic control estimators in comparative case studies.

10.3982/ecta20720.abstractZh: 本文指出合成控制与在线学习之间存在简单的联系。具体来说，我们将合成控制视为“跟随领导者”策略的一种应用。在线凸优化领域的标准结果表明，即使结果由对手选择，合成控制对受处理单元的反事实结果的预测效果，几乎与控制单元结果的加权平均值相当。在差异数据上的合成控制效果，几乎与加权差异分析相当，这可能使其在实践中成为一个有吸引力的选择。我们认为，这一观察结果进一步支持了在比较案例研究中使用合成控制估计器的必要性。

abstract.text: We study the investment effects of market integration on renewable energy expansion. Our theory highlights that market integration not only improves allocative efficiency by gains from trade but also incentivizes new investment in renewable power plants. To test our theoretical predictions, we examine how recent grid expansions in the Chilean electricity market changed electricity production, wholesale prices, generation costs, and renewable investments. We then build a structural model of power plant entry to quantify the impact of market integration with and without the investment effects. We find that the market integration in Chile increased solar generation by around 180%, saved generation costs by 8%, and reduced carbon emissions by 5%. A substantial amount of renewable entry would not have occurred in the absence of market integration. Our findings suggest that ignoring these investment effects would substantially understate the benefits of market integration and its important role in expanding renewable energy.

10.3982/ecta20769.abstractZh: 我们研究了市场整合对可再生能源扩展的投资效应。我们的理论指出，市场整合不仅通过贸易带来的收益提升了配置效率，还激励了在可再生能源发电厂上的新投资。为了验证我们的理论预测，我们考察了智利电力市场近期电网扩展对电力生产、批发价格、发电成本以及可再生能源投资的影响。随后，我们构建了一个发电厂进入的结构模型，以量化有无投资效应的市场整合所带来的影响。研究发现，智利的市场整合使太阳能发电增加了约180%，发电成本降低了8%，碳排放量减少了5%。如果没有市场整合，就不会有如此大量的可再生能源进入市场。我们的研究结果表明，忽略这些投资效应将严重低估市场整合带来的好处，以及它在扩展可再生能源方面的重要作用。

abstract.text: What is the pathway to development in a world marked by rising economic nationalism and less international integration? This paper answers this question within a framework that emphasizes the role of demand‐side constraints on national development, which is identified with sustained poverty reduction. In this framework, development is linked to the adoption of an increasing returns to scale technology by imperfectly competitive firms that need to pay the fixed setup cost of switching to that technology. Sustained poverty reduction is measured as a continuous decline in the share of the population living below $1.90/day purchasing power parity in 2011 U.S. dollars over a five‐year period. This outcome is affected in a statistically significant and economically meaningful way by domestic market size, which is measured as a function of the income distribution, and international market size, which is measured as a function of legally‐binding provisions to international trade agreements, including the General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade, the World Trade Organization, and 279 preferential trade agreements. Counterfactual estimates suggest that, in the absence of international integration, the average resident of a low‐ or lower‐middle‐income country does not live in a market large enough to experience sustained poverty reduction. Domestic redistribution targeted towards generating a larger middle class can partially compensate for the lack of an international market.

10.3982/ecta20787.abstractZh: 在一个经济民族主义加剧、国际一体化程度降低的世界中，发展的路径是什么？本文在一个强调需求侧约束对国家发展作用的框架内回答了这个问题，这一发展被定义为持续减少贫困。在这个框架中，发展与不完全竞争企业采用规模报酬递增的技术有关，这些企业需要支付转换到该技术的固定成本。持续减少贫困被定义为在五年时间内，生活在2011美元购买力平价下每天收入低于1.90美元的人口比例持续下降。这一结果在统计上显著且经济上有意义地受到国内市场规模的影响，而国内市场规模又取决于收入分配情况；同时，国际市场规模也受到具有法律约束力的国际贸易协定（包括关税与贸易总协定、世界贸易组织以及279个优惠贸易协定）的影响。反事实估计表明，如果没有国际一体化，低收入或中低收入国家的普通居民将无法生活在足够大的市场中以实现持续减少贫困的目标。针对培养更大规模中产阶级的国内再分配措施可以部分弥补国际市场的缺失。

abstract.text: We study the propagation of monetary shocks in a sticky‐price general equilibrium economy where the firms' pricing strategy features a complementarity with the decisions of other firms. In a dynamic equilibrium, the firm's price‐setting decisions depend on aggregates, which in turn depend on the firms' decisions. We cast this fixed‐point problem as a Mean Field Game and prove several analytic results. We establish existence and uniqueness of the equilibrium and characterize the impulse response function (IRF) of output following an aggregate shock. We prove that strategic complementarities make the IRF larger at each horizon. We establish that complementarities may give rise to an IRF with a hump‐shaped profile. As the complementarity becomes large enough, the IRF diverges, and at a critical point there is no equilibrium. Finally, we show that the amplification effect of the strategic interactions is similar across models: the Calvo model and the Golosov–Lucas model display a comparable amplification, in spite of the fact that the non‐neutrality in Calvo is much larger.

10.3982/ecta20797.abstractZh: 我们研究在价格粘性的一般均衡经济中货币冲击的传播情况。在这种经济环境中，企业的定价策略与其他企业的决策存在互补性。在动态均衡中，企业的价格设定决策取决于各种总量因素，而这些总量因素又取决于企业的决策。我们将这个固定点问题转化为一个平均场博弈，并证明了几个分析结果。我们证明了均衡的存在性和唯一性，并描述了在总量冲击后产出 impulse response 函数（IRF）的特征。我们证明，战略互补性使得每个时间范围内的 IRF 更大。我们还发现，互补性可能导致 IRF 呈现出驼峰状的特征。当互补性足够大时，IRF 会发散，而在某个临界点处将不再存在均衡。最后，我们表明，战略互动的放大效应在不同模型中是相似的：尽管 Calvo 模型中的非中性程度要远大于 Golosov–Lucas 模型，但两者的放大效应是可比的。

abstract.text: In this paper, I consider two normative questions: (1) how should policymakers approach tradeoffs that involve different age groups, and (2) at what rate should policymakers discount the consumption of future generations? I demonstrate that, under standard assumptions, these two questions are equivalent: caring more about the future means caring less about the elderly. Even small differences between the social discount rate and the market interest rate can have significant quantitative implications for the relative value placed on the consumption of different age groups.

10.3982/ecta20844.abstractZh: 在本文中，我探讨了两个规范性问题：(1)政策制定者应该如何处理涉及不同年龄群体的权衡问题；(2)政策制定者应该以什么比率对后代的消费需求进行折现？我证明，在标准假设下，这两个问题是等价的：更关注未来意味着对老年人的关注减少。即使社会折现率与市场利率之间存在微小差异，也会对不同年龄群体的消费价值产生显著的量化影响。

abstract.text: Structural transformation in most currently developing countries takes the form of a rapid rise in services but limited industrialization. In this paper, we propose a new methodology to structurally estimate productivity growth in service industries that circumvents the notorious difficulties in measuring quality improvements. In our theory, the expansion of the service sector is both a consequence—due to income effects—and a cause—due to productivity growth—of the development process. We estimate the model using Indian household data. We find that productivity growth in nontradable consumer services such as retail, restaurants, or residential real estate was an important driver of structural transformation and rising living standards between 1987 and 2011. However, the welfare gains were heavily skewed toward high‐income urban dwellers.

10.3982/ecta20964.abstractZh: 大多数当前发展中国家的结构性转型表现为服务业的迅速崛起，但工业化程度有限。在本文中，我们提出了一种新的方法来结构性地估算服务行业的生产力增长，该方法避免了衡量质量提升方面的显著困难。根据我们的理论，服务行业的扩张既是发展过程的一个结果——由于收入效应——也是其一个原因——由于生产力增长。我们使用印度家庭数据来估算该模型。我们发现，在1987年至2011年间，非贸易性消费服务领域如零售、餐饮或住宅房地产的生产力增长是结构性转型和生活水平提升的重要驱动力。然而，福利收益主要集中在高收入城市居民身上。

abstract.text: Using a new survey of firms in New Zealand, we document how exogenous variation in the macroeconomic uncertainty perceived by firms affects their economic decisions. We use randomized information treatments that provide different types of information about the first and/or second moments of future economic growth to generate exogenous changes in the perceived macroeconomic uncertainty of some firms. The effects on their decisions relative to their initial plans as well as relative to an untreated control group are measured in a follow‐up survey six months later. We find that as firms become more uncertain, they reduce their prices, employment, and investment, their sales decline, and they become less likely to invest in new technologies or open new facilities. These ex post effects of uncertainty are similar to how firms say they would respond to higher uncertainty when asked hypothetical questions.

10.3982/ecta21004.abstractZh: 通过一项针对新西兰企业的新调查，我们记录了企业感知到的宏观经济不确定性变化对其经济决策的影响。我们采用了随机信息处理的方法，向企业提供关于未来经济增长的各类信息，从而人为地改变某些企业感知到的宏观经济不确定性。我们在六个月后的后续调查中，测量了这些企业相对于初始计划以及相对于未接受处理的对照组，其决策的变化情况。研究发现，随着企业感知到的不确定性增加，它们的价格、就业和投资都会减少，销售额也会下降，同时它们投资新技术或开设新设施的可能性也会降低。这些不确定性带来的事后效应，与企业在被问及假设问题时所表示的对更高不确定性的反应相似。

abstract.text: We show that, in a general family of linearized structural macroeconomic models, knowledge of the empirically estimable causal effects of contemporaneous and news shocks to the prevailing policy rule is sufficient to construct counterfactuals under alternative policy rules. If the researcher is willing to postulate a loss function, our results furthermore allow her to recover an optimal policy rule for that loss. Under our assumptions, the derived counterfactuals and optimal policies are robust to the Lucas critique. We then discuss strategies for applying these insights when only a limited amount of empirical causal evidence on policy shock transmission is available.

10.3982/ecta21045.abstractZh: 我们证明，在一系列线性化的结构性宏观经济模型中，只要了解对现行政策规则产生的同时性冲击和新闻冲击的实证可估计的因果效应，就足以构建在不同政策规则下的反事实情景。如果研究者愿意假设一个损失函数，我们的结果还允许她找到该损失下的最优政策规则。在我们的假设下，所推导出的反事实情景和最优政策对卢卡斯批判具有鲁棒性。接下来，我们讨论了在仅有有限实证证据关于政策冲击传导的情况下，如何应用这些见解的策略。

abstract.text: This paper describes the response of the economy to large shocks in a nonlinear production network. A sector's tail centrality measures how a large negative shock transmits to GDP, that is, the systemic risk of the sector. Tail centrality is theoretically and empirically very different from local centrality measures such as sales share—in a benchmark case, it is measured as a sector's average downstream closeness to final production. It also measures how large differences in sector productivity can generate cross‐country income differences. The paper also uses the results to analyze the determinants of total tail risk in the economy. Increases in interconnectedness can simultaneously reduce the sensitivity of the economy to small shocks while increasing the sensitivity to large shocks. Tail risk is related to conditional granularity , where some sectors become highly influential following negative shocks.

10.3982/ecta21064.abstractZh: 本文描述了经济在非线性生产网络中对重大冲击的响应。某一行业的尾部中心性衡量了重大负面冲击对GDP的影响，即该行业的系统性风险。尾部中心性与局部中心性指标如销售份额在理论和实证上有着显著区别——在基准案例中，尾部中心性被定义为该行业与最终生产环节的平均距离。它还衡量了行业生产力差异如何导致国家间的收入差异。本文还利用这些结果分析了经济中总尾部风险的决定因素。增强互联互通性可以同时降低经济对小型冲击的敏感性，同时提高对经济重大冲击的敏感性。尾部风险与条件粒度相关，某些行业在负面冲击后会变得极具影响力。

abstract.text: This paper shows that there is more scope for a borrower to engage in a sustainable infinite debt rollover (a “Ponzi scheme”) when interest/growth rates are stochastic. In this context, I prove that the relevant “r vs. g” comparison uses the yield r long to an infinite‐maturity zero‐coupon bond. I show that r long is lower than the risk‐neutral expectation of the short‐term yield when it is variable, and that r long is close to the minimal realization of the short‐term yield when it is highly persistent. The paper applies these results to illustrative heterogeneous agent dynamic stochastic general equilibrium models to obtain similarly weakened sufficient conditions for the existence of public debt bubbles.

10.3982/ecta21090.abstractZh: 本文指出，在利率/增长率呈随机分布的情况下，借款人进行可持续的无限债务滚动（一种“庞氏骗局”）的空间更大。在此背景下，我证明了相关的“r与g”比较是基于无限期限零息债券的长期收益率r。我表明，当短期收益率具有波动性时，长期收益率r低于风险中性预期值；而当短期收益率高度持续性时，长期收益率r接近短期收益率的最小实现值。本文将这些结果应用于具有异质性的动态随机一般均衡模型，得出了同样弱化的存在公共债务泡沫的充分条件。

abstract.text: One dominant approach to evaluate the causal effect of a treatment is through panel data analysis, whereby the behaviors of multiple units are observed over time. The information across time and units motivates two general approaches: (i) horizontal regression (i.e., unconfoundedness), which exploits time series patterns, and (ii) vertical regression (e.g., synthetic controls), which exploits cross‐sectional patterns. Conventional wisdom often considers the two approaches to be different. We establish this position to be partly false for estimation but generally true for inference. In the absence of any assumptions, we show that both approaches yield algebraically equivalent point estimates for several standard estimators. However, the source of randomness assumed by each approach leads to a distinct estimand and quantification of uncertainty even for the same point estimate. This emphasizes that researchers should carefully consider where the randomness stems from in their data, as it has direct implications for the accuracy of inference.

10.3982/ecta21248.abstractZh: 评估干预措施因果效应的一种主流方法是通过面板数据分析，即观察多个单位随时间的行为变化。时间和单位上的信息促使了两种通用方法：(i) 水平回归（即无混杂性），它利用时间序列模式；(ii) 垂直回归（例如合成控制），它利用横截面模式。传统观念通常认为这两种方法是不同的。我们证明，在估计方面，这种看法部分是错误的，但在推断方面通常是正确的。在没有其他假设的情况下，我们展示了这两种方法对于几种标准估计量都能得到代数上等效的点估计。然而，每种方法所假设的随机性来源导致了不同的估计对象，甚至对于相同点估计，不确定性的量化也各不相同。这强调了研究人员在考虑数据中随机性的来源时应当谨慎，因为这直接影响了推断的准确性。

abstract.text: This paper studies gender differences in performance in a male‐dominated competitive environment chess tournaments. We find that the gender composition of chess games affects the behaviors of both men and women in ways that worsen the outcomes for women. Using a unique measure of within‐game quality of play, we show that women make more mistakes when playing against men. Men, however, play equally well against male and female opponents. We also find that men persist longer before losing to women. Our results shed some light on the behavioral changes that lead to differential outcomes when the gender composition of competitions varies.

10.3982/qe1404.abstractZh: 本文研究了在男性主导的竞技环境中，不同性别在棋类比赛中的表现差异。我们发现，棋局中性别构成的不同会影响男女的行为，从而恶化女性的比赛结果。通过一种独特的衡量标准来评估棋局内的表现质量，我们发现女性在与男性对弈时更容易犯错。然而，男性在与男女对手对弈时表现相当。我们还发现，男性在输给女性之前会坚持更长时间。我们的研究结果揭示了导致比赛结果差异的行为变化。

abstract.text: The purpose of this research is to determine how payer-provider integration influences health care business performance. The research examines whether integration reduces agency difficulties and encourages participants to collaborate for better outcomes. To collect data, the research study used secondary sources. We assessed the integrated hospital against its fee-for-service partner. The cost of occupational accidents dropped by 9% at an integrated hospital, occupational accidents cost 9% less. The main reason was an emphasis on careful treatment and speedier recovery. It focuses on Finnish workplace health initiatives. It provides preliminary evidence that the integration of payors and providers enhances operations. Vertical integration may arrange outcomes, but it requires careful analysis. Multiple approaches are combined. Strict change management is advised. The research shows that merging health care payors and providers not only benefits individuals but also minimizes care costs without compromising quality or client satisfaction. This is one of the few studies that examine payor-provider mergers in healthcare operations management over time. It advances knowledge of ways to boost operational efficiency.

10.47363/pms/2023(7)e106.abstractZh: 本研究旨在探讨支付方与提供方整合对医疗保健业务绩效的影响。研究考察了整合是否能够减少代理困难，并促使各方合作以实现更好的结果。为了收集数据，研究人员采用了二手资料。我们对整合后的医院与其按服务收费的合作伙伴进行了对比分析。整合后的医院职业事故发生率下降了9%，职业事故成本也降低了9%。其主要原因在于注重细致的治疗和更快的康复过程。本研究重点关注芬兰的职场健康举措，并提供了初步证据，表明支付方与提供方的整合能够提升运营效率。虽然垂直整合可能有助于安排结果，但需要进行仔细分析。建议采用多种方法相结合的方式进行整合。研究结果表明，将医疗保健支付方与提供方合并不仅有利于个人，还能在不影响质量或客户满意度的情况下降低护理成本。这是少数研究探讨医疗保健运营管理中支付方与提供方合并随时间变化的影响的研究之一，为提升运营效率提供了知识支持。

abstract.text: This paper proposes semi-instrumental variables (semi-IVs) as an alternative to instrumental variables (IVs) to identify the causal effect of a binary (or discrete) endogenous treatment. A semi-IV is a less restrictive form of instrument: it affects the selection into treatment but is excluded only from one, not necessarily both, potential outcomes. Having two continuously distributed semi-IVs, one excluded from the potential outcome under treatment and the other from the potential outcome under control, is sufficient to nonparametrically point identify marginal treatment effect (MTE) and local average treatment effect (LATE) parameters. In practice, semi-IVs provide a solution to the challenge of finding valid IVs because they are often easier to find: many selection-specific shocks, policies, prices, costs, or benefits are valid semi-IVs. As an application, I estimate the returns to working in the manufacturing sector on earnings using sector-specific characteristics as semi-IVs.

10.48550/arxiv.2303.12667.abstractZh: 本文提出半工具变量作为工具变量的替代方案，用于识别二元（或离散）内生处理的因果效应。半工具变量是一种较为宽松的工具变量形式：它影响进入处理的决策过程，但仅被排除在其中一个潜在结果之外，而不一定同时被排除在两者之外。通过拥有两个连续分布的半工具变量，一个被排除在治疗下的潜在结果之外，另一个被排除在对照组的潜在结果之外，就足以非参数地识别边际处理效应和局部平均处理效应参数。在实践中，半工具变量为寻找有效的工具变量提供了解决方案，因为它们通常更容易获得：许多与选择相关的冲击、政策、价格、成本或收益都可以作为有效的半工具变量。作为应用示例，我使用行业特定特征作为半工具变量，来估计在制造业工作对收入的影响。

abstract.text: We develop an Empirical Bayes grading scheme that balances the informativeness of the assigned grades against the expected frequency of ranking errors. Applying the method to a massive correspondence experiment, we grade the racial biases of 97 U.S. employers. A four-grade ranking limits the chances that a randomly selected pair of firms is mis-ranked to 5% while explaining nearly half of the variation in firms' racial contact gaps. The grades are presented alongside measures of uncertainty about each firm's contact gap in an accessible rubric that is easily adapted to other settings where ranks and levels are of simultaneous interest.

10.48550/arxiv.2306.13005.abstractZh: 我们开发了一种经验贝叶斯评分方案，该方案在权衡评分的信息量与排名错误的预期频率之间取得了平衡。将该方法应用于一项大规模对应实验，我们对97家美国雇主的种族偏见进行了评分。四级排名将随机选取的一对公司的排名错误概率限制在5%以内，同时能够解释公司种族接触差距变化近一半的原因。这些评分结果与对每家公司接触差距的不确定性度量一起被呈现出来，这些度量以易于理解的格式呈现，可以轻松适应其他需要同时关注排名和等级的情况。

abstract.text: The referral cooperation hospital choice has been studied to better rationalize the allocation of healthcare assets and enhance the efficacy of resource utilization. Choosing hospitals to work within a collaborative referral arrangement is a crucial step in the patient-referral process. A referral cooperative hospital is chosen after careful consideration of these aspects to guarantee that patients will get the kind of detailed treatment that is appropriate for their condition. The concept of multi-criteria decision-making (MCDM) is used due to various criteria. The VIKOR method is the MCDM method used in this paper to rank the referral cooperation hospitals. The VIKOR method is integrated with the single-valued neutrosophic set to overcome uncertain information. The single-valued neutrosophic VIKOR method is applied to a case study in Egypt. We achieved quality of care as the best criterion from the eleven criteria used.

10.5281/zenodo.8194830.abstractZh: 关于转诊合作医院的选择问题，已经进行了研究，旨在更好地合理分配医疗资源，并提高资源利用的效率。在患者转诊过程中，选择参与协作转诊安排的医院是一个至关重要的步骤。在仔细考虑这些因素后，会选定一个转诊合作医院，以确保患者能够获得与其病情相适应的详细治疗。由于存在多种标准，因此采用了多标准决策方法。本文使用的多标准决策方法是VIKOR方法，该方法用于对转诊合作医院进行排名。VIKOR方法结合单值中立集的使用，以克服不确定信息的影响。单值中立VIKOR方法已应用于埃及的一个案例研究。在所使用的十一个标准中，我们认为护理质量是最优的标准。

abstract.text: Inefisiensi merupakan salah satu masalah yang perlu diperhatikan pada klaim yang diajukan oleh fasilitas kesehatan ke BPJS Kesehatan. Dengan jumlah klaim yang semakin meningkat, cara tradisional seperti verifikasi manual tidak akan dapat menangani jumlah data yang sangat besar dalam waktu singkat, sementara terdapat tuntutan untuk mempercepat penyelesaian klaim dengan jumlah verifikator yang terbatas. Salah satu cara yang dapat diadopsi adalah dengan menggunakan Machine Learning untuk mendeteksi transaksi yang berpotensi Inefisien dengan cepat. Penelitian ini membandingkan beberapa algoritma Machine Learning berupa Random Forest, Gradient Boosting Classifier, Decision Tree, Support Vector Machine, Naive Bayes, CatBoost dan XGBoost. Selain itu juga digunakan metode oversampling dan undersampling karena dataset yang digunakan tidak seimbang. Hasil terbaik didapat dengan menggunakan model Random Forest + Tomek Links yang menghasilkan F1 Score sebesar 60.97, dengan lima variabel yang paling berpengaruh yaitu biaya, lokasi fasilitas kesehatan, usia peserta, diagnosa dari FKTP dan diagnosa primer peserta.

10.53756/jjkn.v3i1.134.abstractZh: 效率低下是医疗机构向BPJS Kesehatan提出索赔时需要关注的问题之一。随着索赔数量的不断增加，传统的手动验证方式无法在短时间内处理如此庞大的数据量，而要求在有限的验证人员条件下加快索赔处理速度的需求也日益凸显。一种可行的解决方案是使用机器学习技术来快速识别可能存在效率问题的交易。本研究比较了多种机器学习算法，包括随机森林、梯度提升分类器、决策树、支持向量机、朴素贝叶斯、CatBoost和XGBoost。此外，由于数据集不平衡，还采用了过采样和欠采样的方法。最终，使用随机森林+Tomek链接模型取得了最佳效果，F1分数达到了60.97，其中影响最大的五个变量分别是费用、医疗机构的位置、参保者的年龄、疾病诊断以及参保者的初次诊断。

abstract.text: Long-term care is characterised by its high cost of provision so that most elders cannot afford it themselves. As a consequence, some form of public insurance or reduced payments to ensure access to long-term care become necessary. By extension, eligibility criteria and reimbursements to long-term care providers also become fundamental to making the market work. In this thesis, I present three chapters that study the regulation of the (residential) long-term care market.

10.5463/thesis.284.abstractZh: 长期护理的特点是其提供成本很高，因此大多数老年人无法自行承担。因此，需要某种形式的公共保险或降低支付额以确保人们能够获得长期护理服务。由此延伸，长期护理提供者的资格标准和报销机制也成为使市场运作的基本要素。在本论文中，我提出了三章内容，分别研究（住宅型）长期护理市场的监管问题。

abstract.text: We analyze the effects of a mixed compensation (MC) scheme for specialists on the quality of their healthcare services. To do so, we exploit a major reform that was implemented in Quebec (Canada) in 1999. The government introduced a payment mechanism combining a fixed per diem with a reduced fee per clinical service. Using panel patient-doctor data covering the period 1996-2016 and including 320,441 patients, we estimate a multi-state multi-spell hazard model with correlated heterogeneity, analogous to a difference-in-differences approach. We compute three output-based quality indicators from our model. Our results suggest that the reform reduced the quality of MC specialist services as measured by the risk of re-hospitalization within 30 days after discharge and the risk of mortality within one year after discharge. These effects vary depending upon the specialty of the treating doctor.

10.54932/cttw3290.abstractZh: 我们分析了针对专业人员的混合补偿方案对医疗服务质量的影响。为此，我们利用了1999年加拿大魁北克实施的一项重大改革。政府引入了一种支付机制，将固定每日津贴与每次临床服务的降低费用相结合。我们使用了1996年至2016年的患者-医生面板数据，共包含320,441名患者，并采用多状态多变异风险模型进行估计，该模型类似于差异-差异方法。我们从模型中计算出三个基于输出的质量指标。研究结果表明，该改革降低了MC专业服务的质量，具体表现为出院后30天内再次住院的风险以及出院后一年内死亡的风险。这些影响因治疗医生的专业领域而异。

abstract.text: In this paper, we studied the moral hazard in healthcare. As part of the analysis, we looked at 126.3 thousand hospitalization cases in the Georgian healthcare system in 2018-2019. According to the group of diagnoses, we compared the length of stay of inpatients funded under government programs with the cases covered by a pocket of patients or private insurance companies. As a result of the study, we found that the length of stay under the universal health care program is, on average, 0.26 days (CI 95%; [0.22-0.30]) longer than in other circumstances. The difference is statistically significant (t = -12.58; P<.05). Thus, our result is the empirical evidence of theoretical reasoning that predicts an increase in the moral hazard under the government healthcare program.

10.62343/cjss.2023.232.abstractZh: 在本文中，我们研究了医疗保健领域的道德风险问题。作为分析的一部分，我们研究了2018-2019年间格鲁吉亚医疗保健系统中126.3千例住院病例。根据诊断结果，我们比较了由政府项目资助的住院患者的住院时长与由私人患者或私人保险公司承担费用的患者住院时长。研究结果表明，在全民医疗保健计划下，患者的平均住院时长比其他情况下长0.26天（95%置信区间：[0.22-0.30]）。这一差异具有统计学意义（t = -12.58；P<.05）。因此，我们的研究结果证实了理论预测，即政府医疗保健计划下道德风险会增加。

abstract.text: Responding to the rise of hydraulic fracturing (HF) and risks to water quality, U.S. states mandated disclosure for HF wells. We study whether and how such targeting of corporate externalities with transparency regulation reduces environmental impact.
